Title: Knowledge & Enablement Lead
Location: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States
Description:
"No one can whistle a symphony. It takes a whole orchestra to play it." — H.E. Luccock

Role Overview

Mercury's Business Risk and Enablement team is hiring a Knowledge & Enablement Lead to own the frameworks and governance for how Mercury's risk operations — and the BPO partners who deliver them — document, learn, and prove what they do, as we scale toward bank readiness.

This is one role spanning two disciplines: knowledge management (the single source of truth for how work gets done) and training (how internal and vendor teams learn to do it). It is a system design and framework role with real execution target behind it. You will set the requirements, standards, and review cadence that risk operations documents and trains against. You will also partner with a BPO-based team of content writers who produce against those standards, as well as drive adoption through enablement practitioners embedded on other teams.

If you need positional authority to make change happen, this is the wrong role. If you can set a knowledge and enablement standard so clearly that people adopt it because it's obviously better, it's the right one.

About Our Team

The Business Risk and Enablement team’s primary function is to build and run a first line of defence (1LOD) risk program that gives business leaders a clear way to identify, document, and manage their risks.  The enablement team directly supports this by centralizing standards for quality, training, and documentation across the various operations teams. 

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the knowledge framework. Define the architecture for the canonical library of risk-operations procedures — the ownership model, versioning, last-published and next-review dates, deprecation rules, and a live annual review cycle. Design for how knowledge is increasingly accessed and applied through AI-powered tools, not only how it is documented and stored. This is a systems problem before it is a writing problem.
  • Set policy, procedure, and documentation standards. Own the standards, templates, and structural conventions that govern how policy and procedure get written across risk operations — structured so business risk can build self-assessments and controls directly from them, and so compliance can approve regulatory content against a consistent format rather than a bespoke one each time.
  • Govern adoption and quality. Run the governance layer that keeps standards live: review cadence, compliance against the standard, exception handling, and escalation when programs drift. Own the audit and examination readiness of the documentation estate.
  • Partner with internal and BPO enablement teams. Collaborate with technical content writers and training leads — helping to identify priorities, provide feedback, and set standards.
  • Define requirements for teams you don't manage. Set the enablement and documentation requirements that enablement practitioners embedded across risk programs execute against, and make those requirements clear, useful, and adoptable without a reporting line to enforce them.
  • Architect training and certification. Design a training and certification system built for vendor delivery — translating complex operational content for BPO audiences through milestone-based curricula, topic-level certifications, and routing by certification — distinct from an internal-only L&D lens.
  • Instrument the function. Define and report the metrics that show the programs improving over time: time-to-productivity, certification coverage, procedure freshness and review compliance, and the link between quality-failure patterns and training interventions.
  • Enable cross-skilling. Build the documentation and certification pathways that let staffing flex across risk programs (onboarding, ODD/EDD, AML/sanctions, fraud, disputes) as demand moves

Qualifications

  • 7–10+ years of experience in knowledge management, enablement/L&D, operational training, or related functions, including experience building or substantially scaling a knowledge-management and/or enablement function.
  • Experience operating in a regulated industry or similarly complex, control-oriented environment.
  • A hybrid skill set spanning knowledge management and enablement/L&D — able to design both the systems that govern how operational knowledge is created and maintained and how teams are trained and certified against it.
  • Experience designing knowledge, training, and certification programs for BPO or outsourced operations teams, with an understanding of how to make complex information clear, accessible, and actionable for a BPO audience.
  • Experience leading a team, pod, or vendor-delivered group — setting priorities and performance expectations, providing direct feedback, maintaining a high quality bar, and developing capability.
  • Track record of setting standards that teams outside your reporting line actually adopted, demonstrating strong cross-functional influence without authority.
  • Strong systems thinking and writing skills, with the ability to build practical operating models and cadence in ambiguous or evolving environments.
  • Experience defining and reporting metrics that demonstrate the effectiveness of knowledge and enablement programs, including their impact on operational performance.
  • A thoughtful perspective on how AI can improve knowledge management and enablement, including how AI-powered tools can help teams find and apply accurate information in real time.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Experience in financial services, banking*, fintech, payments, or a related financial-services environment.
  • Familiarity with regulated operations such as KYC/KYB, AML, fraud, or disputes, and with what an examiner or internal auditor expects documentation to look like.
  • Familiarity with knowledge-management and enablement platforms ideally Guru, WorkRamp, or similar tools.
  • Experience operating as the central standard-setter across a federated or decentralized organization.
  • Startup or high-growth experience; comfort building from a blank page.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

Title: CX Operations Enablement Specialist
Description:
Who we are

The real world is the next frontier, and at Metropolis, we are creating the artificial intelligence to make it responsive. We are pioneering the Recognition Economy — a future where mundane repetition disappears and being known unlocks access, comfort, and belonging everywhere you go. From transforming parking into a seamless drive-in, drive-out experience for millions of Members to expanding our intelligence layer across retail and hospitality, we are building a world that feels instinctive and magical. The future isn’t coming; it’s here, and we need builders, innovators, and problem solvers to help us create it.

Who you are

Metropolis is seeking a CX Operations Enablement Specialist to serve as the operational translator and steward of our Customer Experience knowledge ecosystem. In this role, you will tear down process friction, embed our "Trust-First" support philosophy, and ensure our frontline human agents and AI support tools have access to highly accurate, empathetic, and actionable information. Partnering closely with Operations, Product, QA, Training, and AI Strategy teams, you will architect SOPs, manage our knowledge libraries, and empower support teams to drive First Contact Resolution (FCR) and deliver exceptional customer outcomes.

What you'll do

  • Serve as the operational owner of Customer Experience knowledge, managing the customer-facing Help Center and internal Knowledge Library
  • Lead the comprehensive teardown and rebuild of legacy SOPs, replacing rigid policies with workflows anchored in our core framework: Acknowledge, Empathize, Verify, Resolve
  • Build localized, compliant SOPs and decision trees for complex operational workflows, such as Dynamic Pricing disputes and 3rd-Party Reservation failures
  • Own, restructure, and maintain the Gladly CRM macro library (CX Answers) and FAQs to drive First Contact Resolution (FCR) while aligning with the Metropolis brand voice
  • Serve as the primary CX liaison to Operations Launch teams, ensuring localized knowledge assets and documentation are delivered prior to go-live for new locations
  • Act as the direct operational bridge to Experience Integrity and Government Relations to establish strictly compliant agent guardrails for regulatory-sensitive workflows
  • Structure organizational knowledge clearly so it can be effectively ingested and retrieved by our AI Agent (Parker) and internal LLMs
  • Partner with CX AI Content Analysts to close documentation gaps that cause AI hallucinations or routing failures
  • Conduct recurring knowledge audits to identify gaps, partnering with QA and Training to ensure operational alignment

What we're looking for

  • Experience managing or maintaining knowledge bases, help centers, or complex SOP documentation systems such as Gladly, Zendesk, Guru, or Confluence
  • Experience in Customer Support, Customer Experience, or a fast-paced operational environment
  • Strong technical writing, editing, and documentation skills with a hyper-focus on clarity, empathy, and usability
  • Ability to translate complex, localized operational and legal requirements into user-friendly documentation for frontline BPO agents
  • Strong project management skills, specifically in driving cross-functional alignment ahead of strict launch deadlines
  • Experience leveraging AI tools to transform static workflows into responsive, high-output processes

While not required, these are a plus:

  • Experience supporting AI-powered customer support solutions or familiarity with generative AI tools like Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT
  • Experience with Gladly, Zendesk, Intercom, or similar CRM platforms
  • Experience creating customer support documentation at scale
  • Understanding of information architecture, content strategy, and knowledge management best practices

4 Days in Office: Metropolis values in-person collaboration to drive innovation, strengthen culture, and enhance the Member experience. Our corporate team members hold to our office-first model, which requires employees to be on-site at least four days a week, fostering organic interactions that spark creativity and connection

When you join Metropolis, you'll join a team of world-class product leaders and engineers, building an ecosystem of technologies at the intersection of parking, mobility, and real estate. Our goal is to build an inclusive culture where everyone has a voice and the best idea wins. You will play a key role in building and maintaining this culture as our organization grows. The anticipated base salary for this position is $63,000.00 USD to $75,000.00 USD annually. Title: CX Knowledge Base & Conversational AI Manager
Description:
THE BIGGEST NAME IN HOME. THE BOLDEST TEAM IN E-COMMERCE.

Ashley Digital is the e-commerce engine behind Ashley Furniture Industries — one of the most recognized home brands in the world. As the world's largest manufacturer of home furnishings and the largest furniture store brand in North America, Ashley is in a category unto itself. Our team sits at the intersection of world-class retail and digital innovation, driving the e-commerce experience for millions of customers across every platform and touchpoint. If you’ve shopped online for a mattress in the last decade, there’s a good chance you’ve already experienced our award-winning Nectar Sleep and DreamCloud. We're a fast-moving, highly collaborative team operating at a transformational moment, and we're charged with shaping how people discover, explore, and buy home furnishings. Our expertise spans data science, performance marketing, product, and creative, and our work reaches millions of customers every day. It's a rare combination: the energy of a tech company, the stability of an industry leader, and the opportunity to build something truly significant. If you're energized by transformation, collaboration, and meaningful impact at scale, Ashley Digital is where ambition meets opportunity. 

 

To be considered for this remote opportunity, you must reside and be authorized to work within the United States.

 

About the Role:

Great AI conversations don't happen by accident, they're designed, measured, and continuously improved. As our AI Conversation & Knowledge Manager, you'll own the performance of our customer-facing AI experiences across Ashley Digital's brands. You'll combine customer insights, conversation design, analytics, and knowledge management to ensure every interaction helps customers achieve the right outcome quickly while driving measurable business results.

This role is equal parts strategist, analyst, writer, and systems thinker. You'll define how customers interact with AI, establish success metrics, analyze performance, identify optimization opportunities, and continuously improve conversational experiences through experimentation and iteration.

You'll partner closely with Product, Customer Support, Operations, CRM, QA, Legal, Brand, and AI Enablement teams to ensure our AI experiences remain accurate, conversational, on-brand, and continuously optimized using customer sentiment, behavioral insights, and business performance metrics.

Success in this role isn't measured by the number of knowledge articles but through improvements in customer satisfaction, resolution quality, conversion, retention, operational efficiency, and the overall customer experience.

 

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Own the end-to-end performance of Ashley Digital's AI customer experience, defining customer intents, desired outcomes, success metrics, and conversation strategy across all AI workflows.
  • Design, test, and continuously improve conversational experiences through prompts, response logic, routing, escalation strategies, and system instructions, ensuring every interaction feels natural, helpful, and true to the Ashley Digital brand.
  • Balance automation with customer experience by determining when AI should resolve customer needs independently and when human support delivers the best outcome.
  • Monitor customer sentiment, conversation quality, and behavioral analytics to continuously improve tone, clarity, empathy, resolution quality, and overall customer experience.
  • Analyze AI performance using KPIs such as CSAT, One-Touch Resolution, Total Resolution Time, containment, escalation, retention, conversion, and AOV to identify optimization opportunities and prioritize the roadmap.
  • Build and maintain a continuous improvement framework by leveraging customer sentiment, QA findings, conversation analytics, operational data, and experimentation to optimize AI performance and customer outcomes.
  • Conduct recurring conversation reviews to identify friction points, underperforming workflows, emerging customer trends, and knowledge gaps, translating insights into actionable improvements.
  • Partner closely with Customer Support, Product, Engineering, QA, Operations, CRM, Legal, and Brand teams to align AI experiences with evolving customer needs, business priorities, and operational processes.
  • Own and maintain the enterprise knowledge base, ensuring it serves as the trusted source of truth for both AI and human support.
  • Establish scalable knowledge management practices, including taxonomy, metadata, governance, content lifecycle management, templates, and authoring standards that keep information accurate, AI-ready, and easy to maintain.
  • Continuously improve the knowledge base using conversation insights, customer feedback, and operational changes to ensure content remains current, relevant, and effective.
  • Communicate performance trends, business impact, and strategic recommendations to stakeholders through clear reporting, dashboards, and data-driven insights.

The responsibilities described above are not exhaustive. You may be asked, from time to time and as reasonably required by business needs, to perform other duties consistent with your skills and role, including work for or on behalf of our related entities. This job description does not constitute a contract of employment and may be modified at any time, subject to applicable law.

 

What Success Looks Like:

  • Improve customer experience by increasing customer sentiment, CSAT, and One-Touch Resolution while reducing Total Resolution Time.
  • Optimize AI performance by increasing successful AI containment and reducing unnecessary escalations caused by knowledge or workflow gaps.
  • Drive business impact by improving customer conversion, Average Order Value (AOV), and customer retention where AI supports the customer journey.
  • Establish a measurable continuous improvement program that uses analytics, experimentation, customer feedback, and operational insights to identify issues, prioritize opportunities, and drive ongoing optimization.
  • Deliver consistent, conversational, on-brand AI experiences across every customer touchpoint.

 

Skills & Qualifications:

  • 5+ Experience in LLM prompting, Conversation Design, UX Writing, Linguistics, or related CX operations
  • Deep understanding of conversation AI workflows and data integrations.
  • Strong writing and communication skills with exceptional attention to detail
  • Experience analyzing customer conversations and identifying operational trends
  • Strong problem-solving and cross-functional collaboration skills
  • Experience with Intercom Fin or similar conversational AI platforms.

  • Experience managing enterprise knowledge bases, preferably in Notion.

Title: Program Manager, Technical Enablement
Location: San Francisco, CA; New York, NY
Description:
Scale AI’s customer-facing engineering organization is one of the fastest-growing and most technically demanding in enterprise AI. Frontier Agentic Engineers sit at the center of our most strategic relationships; building, integrating, and troubleshooting directly with customers. Until now, there has been no dedicated enablement function to support them.

As Program Manager, Technical Enablement, you will build that function from the ground up. Your job is to make sure every engineer who joins this team ramps quickly and confidently, has access to an authoritative, maintained knowledge base they can actually trust, and stays sharp as Scale’s platform and product surface evolves. You will own the full enablement lifecycle for customer-facing engineering, from day one onboarding through ongoing development, and you will be measured on ramp speed, knowledge base health, and the sustained readiness of the teams you support.

This role sits within the Enablement org and partners closely with FAE leadership, the broader Enablement team, and cross-functional stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Delivery.

 

You will:

Build and Own Engineering Onboarding

  • Design and launch a structured, role-based onboarding program for new FAE hires, taking engineers from environment setup through meaningful technical contribution within their first 30 days.
  • Define fully ramped success criteria by role and communicate them clearly to new hires and their managers.

 

Own and Govern the Engineering Knowledge Base

  • Audit, consolidate, and maintain the authoritative technical knowledge base for customer-facing engineering, eliminating fragmentation, broken link chains, and stale documentation.
  • Establish a review cadence to keep content current as the platform evolves; tag owners and set expiration dates for key docs.
  • Create a clear document hierarchy so engineers always know which resources are canonical and which are deprecated.
  • Work with internal experts to surface the right documentation for the right audience, distinguishing what a new hire needs on Day 1 from what an established engineer needs to go deep.

 

Drive Ongoing Technical Development (Everboarding)

  • Develop and maintain a recurring enablement cadence (live sessions, async updates, release summaries) that keeps tenured engineers up to date on new capabilities, product changes, and evolving enterprise use cases.
  • Identify readiness gaps through feedback loops with managers and new hires, and develop targeted content to close them.

 

Stakeholder Collaboration & Program Management

  • Serve as the embedded enablement partner to FAE leadership, maintaining a close pulse on what the teams need as the business scales.
  • Collaborate with the broader Enablement team to adapt existing GTM enablement content for engineering audiences and bring engineering learnings back to the org.
  • Manage multiple concurrent programs with clear milestones, keeping stakeholders informed on roadmap progress and program effectiveness.
  • Report on program health and outcomes to engineering and Enablement leadership on an ongoing basis.

 

Ideally you’ll have:

  • 4+ years of professional experience in enablement, program management, technical training, or a closely related role.
  • 2+ years of program management experience, with a track record of taking programs from zero to launched in a fast-moving environment.
  • Experience supporting technical teams, engineers, solutions engineers, or similar, at a B2B technology company.
  • Strong instincts for knowledge management: you’ve built or significantly improved a documentation system and have clear opinions on what makes them work.
  • Comfort navigating technical content: you don’t need to write code, but you can read a technical architecture doc, identify what’s outdated, and work with engineers to fix it.
  • Excellent written communication skills and a bias toward creating content that people actually use.
  • Proficiency with AI tools for content creation, summarization, and workflow automation.

 

Nice to haves:

  • Background in developer tools, AI/ML platforms, or technical product environments where the end user is an engineer or technical practitioner.
  • Experience building LMS-based learning paths or structured onboarding curricula for technical audiences.
  • Familiarity with tiered instructional design or adult learning principles applied to technical content.
  • Prior experience collaborating with Product, Engineering, or Delivery teams to extract and systematize institutional knowledge.
  • Experience in a high-growth, venture-backed environment where you’ve built programs from scratch without waiting for perfect infrastructure.

At Stoke, we believe a thriving space economy will enable a vibrant, sustainable, and equitable future here on Earth. That is why we’re building Nova, our fully and rapidly reusable launch vehicle. Designed for daily flight, Nova tackles the core challenges of space transportation by reducing cost, increasing availability, and improving reliability. By radically lowering launch costs and increasing flight cadence, we’re helping create a truly scalable space industry.

Our team is mission-driven, collaborative, and empowered to take ownership of their work. If you want to work alongside some of the most dedicated and talented people on Earth, we’d love to have you join us.

Description

Boltline is Stoke’s software platform designed to accelerate engineering and manufacturing for hardware teams. It helps organizations manage product data, workflows, traceability, and collaboration across the full lifecycle from design through production. Boltline brings together engineering, manufacturing, and operational data into a unified system so teams can move faster while maintaining confidence in their processes.

The Product Enablement Lead for Boltline is responsible for helping customers successfully learn, adopt, and implement the Boltline platform within their engineering and manufacturing environments. This role translates complex product capabilities into clear documentation, tutorials, and training materials that enable users to confidently use Boltline. You will create structured workflows and best practices that show organizations how to implement engineering and manufacturing processes using the platform.
 
You will also gather structured feedback from users and customers, organize feature requests and usability insights, and help the product team prioritize improvements that make Boltline more powerful and easier to adopt.

You must be ready to stay focused, move fast, self-direct, and learn on the fly.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain comprehensive Boltline product documentation, including how‑to guides, feature explanations, and implementation resources
  • Create customer education materials such as tutorials, onboarding guides, workflow walkthroughs, and example engineering/manufacturing use cases 
  • Design and deliver Boltline training sessions for customers, including virtual sessions and on‑site workshops
  • Build and manage a secure, AI-enabled product knowledge and learning experience that transforms trusted Boltline expertise into personalized, on-demand guidance for employees and customers—accelerating adoption and value realization while protecting company IP
  • Translate engineering and manufacturing workflows (BOM management, traceability, configuration management, production processes) into clear product usage guidance
  • Partner closely with Boltline Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to ensure documentation accurately reflects product capabilities
  • Collect, organize, and analyze customer feedback, feature requests, and usability insights from Boltline users
  • Structure and prioritize feedback from customers and internal teams to inform the Boltline product roadmap
  • Own and maintain the Boltline knowledge base and ensure documentation remains accurate as the product evolves

Qualifications

  • Experience producing high-quality technical documentation, tutorials, or knowledge base content for software products
  • Experience implementing or working with engineering or manufacturing processes such as product lifecycle management, BOM management, production workflows, or traceability systems
  • Strong ability to translate complex technical systems into clear, structured explanations for users
  • Familiarity with using AI tools to support product enablement, knowledge delivery, and personalized, on-demand learning experiences
  • Experience gathering, organizing, and synthesizing customer feedback into actionable insights
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to deliver training sessions or workshops
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with product managers, engineers, and customer-facing teams

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working as part of a software product development organization
  • Background in manufacturing, aerospace, industrial engineering, or hardware product development environments
  • Experience creating implementation playbooks or workflow guides for complex technical products
  • Familiarity with modern documentation platforms, knowledge bases, or developer documentation tools
  • Familiarity with using structured product documentation to train or ground AI assistants and testing their outputs for accuracy, consistency, and overall quality
  • Experience supporting enterprise software customers or technical SaaS products

Title: AI Knowledge & Governance Lead
Description:
Zafin is an AI platform company helping regulated institutions modernize how critical work is designed, governed, and delivered. Our technology enables organizations to move faster while maintaining the governance, accountability, and control required in highly regulated environments.

Our portfolio includes Zafin AIOS, an agent orchestration platform for governed AI work; the Zafin Banking Platform, which helps banks modernize product, pricing, offers, billing, loyalty, and relationship management; and Zafin IO, an integration platform that connects data, systems, and workflows across complex enterprise environments.

Headquartered in Toronto, Canada, Zafin partners with leading financial institutions across North America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia-Pacific. As AI transforms the future of financial services, we're building the platforms that help regulated organizations adopt AI responsibly and at scale.

What’s the Opportunity? 

The AI Knowledge & Governance leader is a strategic leadership role responsible for establishing the knowledge, governance, trust, and compliance capabilities that underpin Zafin’s AI Operating System (AIOS). The position ensures AI solutions are built on trusted knowledge, governed by enterprise standards, and operated safely, transparently, and in compliance with regulatory expectations, enabling clients to confidently adopt AI within regulated environments.

This role also establishes and evolves the governance, risk, compliance, evaluation, and responsible AI frameworks that enable AIOS to operate securely and responsibly across enterprise environments.

The role owns the AI Knowledge and Governance pillars of the AIOS model: defining enterprise standards for knowledge lifecycle management. For example, capture, curation, publication, and reuse of knowledge on one side; evaluation, security, auditability, operating controls, and regulatory compliance on the other. These capabilities ensure AI solutions remain trusted, explainable, reusable, and production-ready across all Functional Delivery Units (FDUs).

The role also defines evaluation and compliance standards that all FDUs must satisfy before production deployment and owns the audit and monitoring framework governing AI agent behavior, safety, and regulatory compliance across the platform. This role also defines the governance metrics, operating reviews, assurance mechanisms and participates in cadenced forums to continuously monitor AI quality, risk, compliance, and knowledge maturity across the platform. The outputs feed directly into the AI agent quality and risk layer of the platform's metrics framework, including escaped defect rate, architecture compliance, and security gate pass rate to name a few. 

The role serves as the primary point of accountability for AI knowledge and governance with client engagement(s), partnering with client risk, compliance, legal, audit, and technology leaders to ensure AIOS aligns with client governance requirements and any emerging AI regulatory expectations.

What Will You Do? 

  • Define enterprise evaluation, risk, compliance, and responsible AI standards required of FDUs prior to production deployment of AI solutions.
  • Own the enterprise audit, monitoring and governance framework governing AI behaviour, safety, explainability, regulatory compliance, and operational performance across AIOS.
  • Lead the integration of knowledge and governance controls across all squads to embed evaluation and governance controls into delivery from design through production
  • Partner with client risk, compliance, and audit functions to validate that the platform meets banking regulatory requirements (e.g., Model Risk Management, AI governance frameworks).

  • Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to translate complex business, regulatory, and operational knowledge into AI knowledge assets and standards.
  • Working understanding of enterprise data architecture and integration patterns as they relate to knowledge and content systems.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting an audit or regulatory examination involving AI or automated decision-making.
  • Experience leading enterprise AI governance, model risk, responsible AI, or enterprise risk functions in regulatory industries and/or enterprise software organizations.
  • Track record of building governance frameworks and audit systems that scaled across organizations.
  • Regulatory examination experience or direct interaction with banking regulators (Federal Reserve, OCC, FDIC, etc.).
  • Expertise in specific banking regulatory frameworks (e.g., SR 11-7, SR 21-1, Model Risk Management) or emerging AI governance standards to enterprise AI solutions.

Title: Associate - Knowledge Management
Description:
About Zinnov

Zinnov is a global management consulting firm that helps organizations make decisions that actually get used — and deliver results that matter. For over two decades, we’ve partnered with leading enterprises, high-growth technology companies, and investors to answer some of the toughest questions they face:

  • Where should we invest?

  • How do we scale globally?

  • What capabilities will win in the next decade?

Our work shapes market entry strategies, global operating models, M&A decisions, and long-term growth bets. We’re known for being data-led, execution-focused, and outcome-driven — not opinion-heavy slideware.

At Zinnov, how you work matters as much as what you deliver. We value independent thinking, crisp communication, and early ownership. With 450+ professionals across 10 global offices, we work across industries including Digital Services, ER&D, Enterprise Software, Semiconductors, Healthcare, BFSI, Automotive, Media & Telecom, and Private Equity.

Zinnov isn’t for everyone. It’s for people who want steep learning curves, honest feedback, and the chance to see their work influence real business decisions — not just presentations.

 

Why Corporate Functions? 

Zinnov’s Corporate Functions teams power how the firm delivers at scale—building the internal engine behind high-growth, high-impact work. You’ll get: 

  • Hands-on ownership in running and scaling core operations (including Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Governance). 
  • Exposure to end-to-end enablement models that strengthen operating engines, employee experience, and scalable processes. 
  • A highly cross-functional environment with close collaboration across delivery/PMO and domain teams to drive consistent execution. 

About the Role

At Zinnov, knowledge is not documentation. It is strategic capital.

As an Associate – Knowledge Management, you will help architect, govern, and scale an AI-enabled knowledge ecosystem that powers marketing, thought leadership, and enterprise impact. This role sits at the intersection of information architecture, automation, analytics, and AI. You will work closely with the KM Lead to transform how institutional knowledge is captured, structured, discovered, and activated across marketing systems and repositories. 

What You’ll Do

Enterprise Knowledge Architecture

  • Manage and optimize SharePoint Online and enterprise knowledge portals.
  • Design scalable site structures, permission models, and workflows.
  • Build metadata schemas, taxonomy frameworks, and tagging standards.
  • Improve enterprise-wide discoverability and search performance.
  • End-to-end Content Management

Governance & Lifecycle Excellence

  • Define and operationalize content lifecycle frameworks.
  • Audit repositories and eliminate redundant or outdated content.
  • Standardize documentation formats and knowledge templates.
  • Ensure compliance with governance and information standards.

Analytics-Led KM Optimization

  • Build dashboards tracking repository usage, search success, and content contribution.
  • Translate usage data into structured improvement plans.
  • Identify knowledge gaps and improvement areas through data-led diagnosis.

AI-Enabled Knowledge Transformation

  • Apply AI tools for auto-tagging, summarization, and intelligent Q&A.
  • Support implementation of LLM-driven search and recommendation systems.
  • Assist in prompt design, evaluation of AI outputs, and governance frameworks.
  • Explore multi-model AI use cases across text, documents, and structured data.

Stakeholder Enablement

  • Partner with SMEs to capture tacit knowledge and convert it into reusable assets.
  • Conduct knowledge harvesting and documentation workshops.

What You Bring

Qualifications & Experience

  • 2–3 years of experience in Knowledge Management or content systems.
  • Strong hands-on expertise in SharePoint Online or enterprise KM platforms.
  • Experience in metadata design, taxonomy creation, and workflow configuration.
  • Understanding of knowledge lifecycle and governance frameworks.

Key Skills

  • Working knowledge of AI/ML fundamentals and LLM concepts.
  • Familiarity with NLP use cases such as classification and entity extraction.
  • Experience using AI productivity tools.
  • Strong analytical mindset with Excel or Power BI proficiency.
  • Structured thinking and strong systems orientation.

What Success Looks Like 

  • Marketing knowledge becomes easier to discover and reuse—strong taxonomy, cleaner portals, and better search success.
  • Repositories stay governed and current—redundant content reduces and lifecycle routines run predictably.
  • Adoption improves—teams contribute more consistently and rely on KM assets in daily execution.
  • AI enablement compounds—auto-tagging, summarization, and Q&A reduce manual effort and improve speed-to-insight.
  • Reporting becomes decision-ready—dashboards show what’s used, what’s missing, and what to improve next.

Zinnov is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, communities, and experiences.

Title: Content & Enablement Specialist
Description: About CodeRabbit CodeRabbit is the leading AI code review platform, trusted by more than 17,000 customers and 150,000 open-source projects, conducting over 2 million code reviews each week. We build the symbiotic partnership between developers and AI that makes shipping fast software safe again, reviewing every pull request, IDE change, and CLI commit so teams can move quickly without breaking things. We are a fast-moving, well-funded company, fresh off a $143M Series C at a $1.5B valuation — building Agentic Change Management, the control layer for software changes created by humans and agents. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck moves from implementation to judgment and helping human judgment scale is exactly the problem we exist to solve. Short-form video or interactive tutorial production How we work The team runs on measured results. Campaigns ship with control groups, numbers are labeled by source, and every report traces to rules anyone can audit. OTE for this role is $130K. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location.

Title: Support Knowledge Manager
Description: About the role Join the team transforming how we support Hinge Health members by building the knowledge engine that powers both human specialists and AI. As the Support Knowledge Manager, you will own the structure, quality, and day-to-day health of support knowledge. You will strengthen and scale our content operations program, create practical standards for how knowledge is written and maintained, and help teams keep information current as our products, services, and processes evolve. Your work will ensure our member-facing teams and the systems supporting them always retrieve the right information at the right time. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys building new systems and repeatable processes. You will own and shape Support’s knowledge management program end to end, with the opportunity to establish the structure, standards, and cross-department partnerships that improve how our teams support members at scale. Who You Are You are an information architect who enjoys designing clear structures, ownership models, and content lifecycles. You are a strong writer and editor who can turn complex information into clear, practical guidance. You are an operator who can lead at all levels, make progress in ambiguity, and build workflows and processes that others can adopt. You are a collaborative partner who can influence across teams and build trust without relying on formal authority. You are curious, pragmatic, and motivated by improving the experience for members and the teams who support them. What You’ll Accomplish In your first 3 months Build a clear picture of our current support knowledge, including internal articles, help center content, macros and scripting, process and policy documentation, and product guides. Define core content health measures and stand up a basic dashboard to create visibility into content coverage, consistency, freshness, utilization, and performance. Define practical content standards and a review process, including clear owners, approval paths, and update and review timelines. Improve the information architecture of our knowledge base, including taxonomy, labeling, metadata, templates, and content relationships. Rewrite content so it is clear and useful for frontline specialists, AI systems, and other content consumers at Hinge Health. Establish working relationships and feedback loops within Support Operations and with Quality, Product, Marketing/Brand, and other content owners and consumers across the company. In your first 6 months Operationalize a regular reporting cadence and use the measures to prioritize improvements, tracking indicators such as verification status, content age, time to publish, content utilization, and search coverage. Create feedback loops with Support Operations (Service Delivery and Support Systems), Analytics, and Quality teams to identify improvement opportunities and turn recurring questions into prioritized content improvements. Launch repeatable processes with partner teams for documenting launches, product changes, policy updates, and operational changes. In your first year Own and continuously improve the support knowledge program, including its structure, standards, ownership model, review cadence, and performance reporting. Optimize how content tools and AI-supported workflows work together, partnering with vendors, Product, and Engineering to understand performance and prioritize improvements that improve member support outcomes. Improve the reliability of the information used by both specialists and AI, contributing to improvements in AI-supported resolutions, specialist productivity, ticket handle time, and CSAT. Support content localization and scalable practices as Hinge Health expands into new markets. Become a trusted partner to Support and cross-functional teams that create or maintain member-facing or internal-facing knowledge. Basic Qualifications 3+ years of experience owning or managing knowledge, content, documentation, ideally for a support operations, customer service, or similar customer-facing department. Comfortable using content health and support data to prioritize work and measure success. Experience managing content for multiple audiences and formats, such as internal support guidance, help center articles, process or policy documentation, and internal- and external-facing product guides. Hands-on experience administering a knowledge base or content repository. Experience with tools such as Zendesk Guide, Salesforce Knowledge, Intercom, Confluence, Guru, or a comparable platform is valuable. Bachelor’s degree in a related field (for example: Communications, Technical Writing, Information Science, Business) or equivalent practical experience. Preferred Qualifications Experience using AI tools to improve content workflows, such as drafting, localizing, updating, or reviewing content, with a willingness to continue learning as the tools evolve. Experience supporting a technical SaaS, consumer technology, or other complex product. Familiarity with customer support AI tools, virtual agents, search, AI-assisted knowledge workflows. Familiarity with Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS) or a similar knowledge-management methodology. Experience partnering with Quality Assurance, Product, Engineering, and vendors to optimize content for AI retrieval. Experience working in healthcare, digital health, or a similar regulated environment. About Hinge Health At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare – starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. With an AI-powered human-centered care model, Hinge Health leverages cutting-edge technology to improve outcomes, experiences and costs to help people move beyond their pain. The platform addresses a broad spectrum of MSK care – from acute injury, to chronic pain, to post-surgical rehabilitation – through personalized, evidence-based care. Title: Customer Success Enablement Specialist (Knowledge Management & AI)
Description: Do you want to impact the hardest-working people in the world? Then Jobber might be the place for you! We are looking for a Customer Success Enablement Specialist (Knowledge Management & AI) to join our Customer Success department. Jobber exists to help people in small businesses be successful. We work with small home service businesses, like your local plumbers, painters, and landscapers, to transform the way service is delivered through technology. With Jobber they can quote, schedule, invoice, and collect payments from their customers while providing an easy and professional customer experience. Running a small business today isn’t like it used to be—the way we consume and deliver service is changing rapidly, technology is evolving, and customers expect more. That’s why we put the power and flexibility in their hands to run their businesses how, where, and when they want! Our culture of transparency, inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation has been recognized by Great Place to Work, Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and more. Jobber has also been named on the Globe and Mail’s Canada’s Top Growing Companies list, and Deloitte Canada’s Technology Fast 50™, Enterprise Fast 15, and Technology Fast 500™ lists. With an Executive team that has over thirty years of industry experience of leading the way, we’ve come a long way from our first customer in 2011—but we’ve just scratched the surface of what we want to accomplish for our customers . The Team: Our Customer Success team works together with other teams and stakeholders to bring our company values to life for our customers. By being humble, supportive, and truly giving a sh*t, the team ensures that our customers are successful in Jobber. This team thrives on meaningful and impactful communication with one another and with our customers, and plays a significant role in the lives of the entrepreneurs and business owners who use Jobber. The Enablement team is a central function within Jobber’s Customer Success organization, supporting the growth and performance of Customer Onboarding and Product Support. As a Center of Excellence, Enablement owns the programs, tools, and frameworks that drive operational excellence and skill development in these areas. We work cross-functionally to ensure that every team member, regardless of channel or customer type, has the knowledge, confidence, and support to deliver value. The Role: As Customer Success Enablement Specialist , you create and maintain the trusted knowledge that powers Jobber's Customer Success teams and the AI experiences that support them. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Enablement & Knowledge Systems , your focus is technical writing, content design, and knowledge management, ensuring information is clear, discoverable, and optimized for both people and AI. Working within the Enablement team, you partner closely with Product, AI, Data, Customer Success, and subject matter experts to create and maintain the knowledge that powers Customer Success workflows, in-flow learning, conversational & agentic AI, agent assist, search, self-service, and other AI-enabled customer experiences. This is a hands-on knowledge management role in an AI-first Customer Success organization. The knowledge you create is more than documentation. It forms the trusted knowledge layer that enables Customer Success teams to find accurate answers and powers AI systems to deliver reliable, contextual support. By creating high quality, structured, and AI-ready knowledge, you help improve customer experiences, strengthen AI performance, and enable Jobber to scale support through both people and technology. In this role, you own a portfolio of knowledge assets from creation through ongoing maintenance, ensuring they remain accurate, well structured, discoverable, and optimized for both human use and AI retrieval. You continuously improve your content alongside product, process, and customer changes, applying established knowledge management and AI readiness standards. The quality of the knowledge you own directly contributes to content quality, AI performance, and release readiness, supporting the overall health of Jobber's knowledge ecosystem. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys bringing structure to complexity and takes pride in creating knowledge that helps both people and AI perform at their best. You bring strong technical writing and information architecture skills, exercise sound editorial judgment, and use customer, operational, and AI performance signals to continuously improve the quality, usability, and effectiveness of the knowledge you own. The Customer Success Enablement Specialist will: Own a portfolio of knowledge assets: Create, maintain, and continuously improve knowledge assets throughout their lifecycle, ensuring they remain accurate, discoverable, version controlled, and aligned with Jobber's knowledge management and AI readiness standards. Create trusted, AI-ready knowledge: Develop knowledge base articles, SOPs, workflows, playbooks, and enablement content that supports Customer Success teams and AI-enabled experiences. Apply technical writing, information architecture, taxonomy, metadata, and content standards to optimize knowledge for both people and AI. Translate change into knowledge: Partner with Product, AI, Data, Customer Success, and subject matter experts to turn product releases, process updates, and operational changes into trusted knowledge that keeps Customer Success teams and AI experiences current. Continuously improve knowledge quality: Use QA findings, Voice of Customer insights, search analytics, frontline feedback, and AI performance signals to identify knowledge gaps, improve content, validate AI readiness, and strengthen the quality of your portfolio. Support learning in the flow of work: Create and maintain role-specific onboarding resources, reference materials, and performance support content that helps Customer Success teams learn, adapt, and perform confidently. Contribute to AI enablement: Partner across Product, AI, Data, Customer Success, and Enablement to support AI-powered workflows, validate knowledge quality, and improve the knowledge layer that powers conversational & agentic AI, agent assist, search, self-service, and other AI-enabled experiences. To be successful, you should have: Experience in knowledge management, technical writing, enablement, or a related field within a SaaS or customer-facing organization, with a track record of creating and maintaining high quality knowledge content using platforms such as Confluence, Guru, Notion, or Helpjuice, grounded in established knowledge management practices such as Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS). Hands-on experience administering modern help desk and knowledge base software, such as Zendesk Guide, Intercom, Help Scout, or Document360, with familiarity with HTML and CSS for custom formatting and basic Markdown highly preferred. Hands-on experience with Git-based documentation workflows, a Docs as Code approach where content is authored, version controlled, and peer reviewed in GitHub, which the team uses actively. Strong technical writing, information architecture, and content design skills, with a critical eye for structuring information. You organize complex technical hierarchies, taxonomy, metadata, tags, and content standards so that dry, multi-layered workflows stay highly digestible for people and optimized for AI retrieval. Technical curiosity and aptitude, with comfort diving into platform settings, reading API documentation, and capturing clean, annotated screenshots or GIFs that make guides visually clear. General knowledge of technical disciplines, such as coding, software design, servers, databases, networks, cloud, certificates, and middleware, enough to document technical concepts accurately and credibly. Experience owning the end-to-end documentation creation process, with strong time-management skills and the ability to provide clear status updates on tasks as assigned. Experience preparing knowledge for AI-enabled experiences, including conversational & agentic AI, agent assist, LLM-based search, self-service, or other AI-powered knowledge systems. Strong editorial judgment and a continuous improvement mindset, using customer feedback, search insights, QA findings, conversation intelligence, and AI performance signals to strengthen the quality and effectiveness of knowledge. Excellent collaboration skills, with the ability to partner across Product, AI, Data, Customer Success, and subject matter experts to translate complex information into trusted knowledge. Strong organization and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage an assigned portfolio of knowledge assets in a fast paced environment. Location : We believe great collaboration is intentional, and sometimes that means coming together in person to build, brainstorm, and connect. To support this, the role is open to candidates based in one of our hub cities: Edmonton, Toronto, Vancouver, or Kitchener-Waterloo. Compensation: At Jobber, we believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and reflective of your experience and growth. This role has a minimum annual salary of $71,700, a midpoint of $84,400, and a maximum salary of $97,100, designed to show the progression from learning the ropes to truly excelling. We design our compensation to reflect each team member’s skills and experience in relation to the complexity of the role, ensuring a fair and competitive salary. Our range is intentionally broad to support both your growth and long-term impact. The higher end of the range is reserved for those who have demonstrated deep expertise and lasting contributions within the role, while offers below the midpoint reflect expected proficiency and strong potential with room to develop in the role. Some opportunities may be a lateral move and are not guaranteed a compensation bump. This approach ensures that compensation aligns with both an individual’s current capabilities and their opportunity for future growth. Base salary is just one part of a total compensation package that will include equity rewards, annual stipends for health and wellness, retirement savings matching, and an extended health package with fully paid premiums for body and mind. Your professional growth matters to us too! You’ll have access to a dedicated talent development program that includes career coaching and opportunities for career development. We believe in transparency and open conversations about compensation. If you have any questions about our approach, we’re happy to discuss them throughout the hiring process! What you can expect from Jobber: A total compensation package that includes an extended health benefits package with fully paid premiums for both body and mind, matching in RRSP, TFSA or FHSA, and stock options. A dedicated Talent Development team and access to coaching, learning, and leadership programs to help you grow your career, reach your goals, and unlock your full potential. A unique opportunity to build, grow, and leave your impact on a $400-billion industry that has no dominant player...yet. To work with a group of people who are humble, supportive, and give a sh*t about our customers. We believe that diverse teams perform better and that fostering an inclusive work environment is a key part of growing a successful team. We welcome people of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Title: CX Knowledge Architect
Description: Who We Are Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together . We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. About the Role: Own CX enablement knowledge strategy + systems globally. Notion ships quickly, and our customer experience depends on support teams being able to find accurate answers fast. This role exists to keep our internal knowledge base fresh as it scales—by designing durable information architecture and governance that keeps pace with frequent product change. What’s different at Notion: you’ll use Notion as customer zero, building a living system of record structured for both humans and AI—so the right people (and the right agents) can retrieve the right information at the right time. You’ll own the internal knowledge base end-to-end (content + page structure), partnering with CX Enablement, Product Ops, QA, and Vendor Ops to keep it reliable and effective. What You'll Achieve: Own end-to-end CX knowledge as a system: Make it dramatically faster for CX teams to retrieve trustworthy, up-to-date knowledge, improving support quality and efficiency as Notion grows. Design and evolve information architecture (IA): Define how knowledge is structured, governed, maintained, and measured across the full lifecycle (intake → draft → review → publish → maintenance → archive). Set quality standards + governance: define templates, authoring guidelines, and review/approval paths (especially for high-risk policy areas like billing, legal, security, pricing). Maintain accuracy + freshness at scale: expand knowledge creation + maintenance programs so launch content and updates don’t bottleneck on a single team. Build modular, reusable knowledge: drive standard sections and reusable modules (definitions, constraints, escalation paths, policy snippets) using synced blocks and consistent structure to enable reuse across KB + macros. Supervise content agents + KB automation: Optimize the KB for AI retrieval, and use AI to improve quality and coverage (AI-assisted content QA, gap detection, and draft suggestions with human review), with clear standards for what gets published. Partner cross-functionally for support readiness: triage and coordinate requests from CX, Product, Eng, and Legal/Finance; translate decisions into support-ready guidance (decision trees, escalation paths, KB updates, internal comms). Measurably improve freshness, launch coverage, and workflow efficiency—while raising the bar on the system’s quality, usability, and durability. Skills You'll Need to Bring: Program + system ownership: experience owning an end-to-end knowledge system (not just shipping individual docs) in knowledge management, CX enablement, technical writing, content ops, or adjacent roles. Information architecture + governance depth: ability to design scalable IA (taxonomy/tagging/page structures) and run governance/review models that protect quality and reduce risk. Systems thinking + operational excellence: can build durable processes that scale across many contributors and withstand high change velocity; experience building modular, reusable content components. Quality and maintenance rigor: demonstrated ability to run content QA, audit cadences, and freshness programs. Data-informed prioritization + AI literacy: uses qualitative + quantitative signals to focus on the highest-impact work, and understands how structure affects AI/human retrieval. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $136,000- $160,000 per year. Title: Senior Revenue Enablement Manager
Description: About Payscale Payscale is the pioneer of compensation intelligence, helping organizations make smarter pay decisions that drive business performance. For more than 20 years, Payscale has combined trusted market data with AI-powered technology to deliver actionable insights that turn pay from a cost into a catalyst for growth. The Payscale Intelligence Cloud portfolio of solutions — Ascent, JobNav, and Paycycle — empower top companies and businesses like Cintas, Leidos, Chipotle, Ohio State University, and TJX Companies. Create confidence in your compensation. Payscale. To learn more, visit www.payscale.com . Job Summary We are seeking an experienced Revenue Enablement Manager to design, implement, and optimize scalable learning programs that drive revenue impact and organizational effectiveness. This role sits at the intersection of execution and strategy—you will own enablement initiatives end-to-end while beginning to shape broader enablement frameworks and business strategy. Reporting to Director, Solutions Consulting & Enablement, you will partner with Revenue organization, Product, Marketing, and Customer Success to diagnose performance gaps, deliver targeted solutions, and measure impact. What You'll Do Enablement Strategy & Program Design Design and launch scalable enablement programs and learning initiatives that directly impact sales productivity, product adoption, and customer retention Develop specialized expertise in learning methodologies and engagement techniques; apply these to assess organizational performance gaps and recommend targeted solutions Design and contribute to onboarding programs for new Revenue team members, including curriculum development, content creation, facilitation, practice activities, and ongoing reinforcement Establish or refine enablement frameworks that align with quarterly business goals and annual company strategy Conduct formal training needs assessments using surveys, data analysis, and stakeholder interviews to identify root causes of performance shortfalls Create comprehensive enablement roadmaps with clear timelines, success metrics, and resource requirements Revenue & Business Impact Measure and communicate the revenue impact of enablement programs; link training initiatives directly to key sales outcomes (pipeline, win rates, quota attainment) Analyze enablement effectiveness through data; design and implement KPIs to track adoption, completion, and performance outcomes Proactively review company goals and revenue metrics to identify enablement gaps and improvement opportunities Collaborate with leadership to define enablement priorities and ROI; recommend program adjustments based on business results Connect enablement efforts to competitive positioning and market dynamics Cross-Functional Leadership & Execution Lead cross-functional teams to develop content, run workshops, and deliver training at scale Navigate competing enablement priorities between Sales, Product, Marketing, and Customer Success; build influence to resolve adoption friction Manage stakeholder expectations and feedback loops; synthesize input from end-users and partners to continuously improve programs Partner with L&D, HR, and People teams on organizational change management for major enablement launches Coordinate with Product and Marketing on go-to-market enablement for new features and product launches Change Management & Adoption Design and execute change management strategies for major enablement initiatives Measure adoption and engagement; identify and address barriers to adoption through dialogue and data-driven problem-solving Coach team members and stakeholders on program changes; deliver constructive feedback on enablement effectiveness Demonstrate strong organizational change management capabilities to drive adoption and organizational alignment Content & Technical Excellence Create and oversee development of enablement content across formats: e-learning, presentations, guides, video, and knowledge management systems Use advanced analytics and reporting to assess training impact and identify trends Integrate and optimize the enablement technology stack (LMS, CRM, knowledge bases), leveraging automation and AI-powered solutions to increase personalization and efficiency Maintain documentation standards and processes that scale as the enablement function grows We'd love to talk with you if you have: 5-7 years of experience in enablement, training, learning & development, revenue operations, or related field Demonstrated expertise in designing and launching training programs that have improved sales or business outcomes Strong analytical skills; comfort with data reporting, performance metrics, and using insights to drive decisions Excellent collaboration and influence skills; ability to navigate cross-functional environments and competing priorities Proficiency with enablement tools (LMS, CRM, knowledge management platforms) and data analytics; experience with Gong, Claude, Seismic a plus Experience conducting needs assessments and diagnosing root causes of performance gaps Ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously while maintaining quality and attention to detail Strong presentation and facilitation skills, with demonstrated experience delivering engaging training, workshops, and practice-based sessions to both small and large audiences Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to present Nice to Have Experience with change management frameworks and stakeholder engagement strategies Background in sales, product, or customer-facing functions (to deepen product/market understanding) Familiarity with Revenue tools such as Salesforce, ZoomInfo, Outreach, Nooks, and related best practices to drive tool adoption and performance Track record of implementing new tools, platforms, or processes Knowledge of sales methodologies, buyer journeys, or go-to-market strategy Project management certification or experience leading large-scale organizational initiatives Location Payscale has an employee centric remote-first model that provides you the flexibility to do your best work in a space that supports you, while also finding time to collaborate in person for the moments that matter. In our remote-first model, employees can work from the location that works best for them. We do not have centralized corporate offices. Employees can choose to work from home, in company-paid co-working spaces, or any combination of the two that best suits their unique needs. If you work from home, we recommend ensuring that you can meet the following technology, equipment and workspace requirements: High-Speed Internet - A stable broadband or fiber connection (satellite is highly discouraged) with a minimum speed of 100 Mbps in a dedicated workspace that has a reliable Wi-Fi signal. Device for Multifactor Authentication (MFA/2FA) - smartphone, tablet, etc. When it matters (usually no more than a few times a year) we take the time to gather for in-person events. Payscale has employees across the US, Canada, UK, The Philippines and Romania however we are currently unable to hire in the Quebec Province, Northern Ireland, and Hawaii. Benefits and Perks All around awesome culture where together we strive to live our 5 values: Data informed decision making. Customer first. Always. Succeed together. Relentless about results. Obsessed with excellence. Lead the change. Shape the standard. An open and inclusive environment where you’ll learn and grow through programs and resources like: Monthly company All Hands meetings Regular opportunities for executive leadership exposure through things like AMAs Access to continued learning & development opportunities Our commitment to a continuous feedback culture which allows us to drive performance and career growth A growing network of Employee Resource Groups Company sponsored volunteer hours And more! Our more standard benefits Flexible paid time off, giving you the opportunity to rest, relax and recharge away from work 14 Paid Company Holidays, includes 2 floating holidays (you choose!) A comprehensive benefits plan including medical, dental, life, vision, disability, and life insurance covered up to 100% by Payscale Unlimited infertility coverage benefits through our medical plans Additional supplemental health benefits offered to you and your family 401(k) retirement program with a fully vested immediate company match 16 weeks of paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents Health Savings Account (HSA) options and company contributions each pay period Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options for pre-tax employee allocations Annual remote work stipend to be used on wellness or home office equipment Equal Opportunity Employer: We embrace equal employment opportunity. Payscale is committed to a policy of equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. It is our policy that employees will not be subjected to unlawful discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, or ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran or military status, marital status, sexual orientation, political ideology, and any other basis protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including but not limited to: recruitment, hiring, transfers, promotions, training, discipline, termination, compensation and benefits, performance appraisals, education, and social and recreational programs. We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you. If you have a disability or impairment and need assistance with the application process, please email recruiting@payscale.com for support. Fraud Alert: Payscale values security and privacy. During your job application and interview process, we will never ask for your personal banking or financial information, social security number, or other sensitive information, if you are unsure if a message is from Payscale, please email recruiting@payscale.com

Title: Associate Manager, Enablement and Strategy
Description: About Us Here at Tarro we build products that empower small brick and mortar restaurants by liberating them of the operational burden of running their business. We accomplish this by providing a frictionless connection between them and their customers through our multi-product ecosystem offering AI-enabled order taking, delivery enablement, payment solutions, and point-of-sale software. At Tarro, we use a combination of bits (technology) and atoms (people) to solve real world problems facing small business owners. We obsess over placing our customers first and working backwards from there. When our customers succeed, we succeed. The restaurant industry in the US is over a $1 trillion total addressable market (TAM), but remains relatively underserved by technology. Large chains are able to afford expensive tech that gives them a huge advantage; we believe that small restaurant owners deserve access to the same technologies at an affordable price. Tarro has been profitable for nearly a decade and seen 5x revenue growth in the past four years. As of our last fundraising round in mid-2022, we were valued at $450M and have since seen substantial growth across customer acquisition, product development and company headcount. Thousands of loyal restaurants have entrusted Tarro with their success, and together we have supported nearly 20 million customers. We are proud to be named one of Built In’s top companies to work for in 2023. To learn more about our culture, values and how you can be a part of helping mom & pop restaurants thrive, please visit us here ! What we’re looking for We are looking for a bilingual Enablement & Strategy Associate Manager (Mandarin & English) to help elevate the capabilities and performance of our client-facing teams. This role is ideal for someone who is a fast learner, highly proactive, and excited to build programs and systems from the ground up. You will play a key role in strengthening how our teams operate by designing enablement initiatives, improving processes, and ensuring our teams are equipped to perform at a high level. You should be comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities, and enjoy taking ownership of complex problems and turning them into practical, scalable solutions. What you’ll accomplish You will build the systems, programs, and playbooks that enable our client teams to deliver a best-in-class experience to restaurant partners. You will establish a culture of continuous learning by creating programs that encourage knowledge sharing, skill development, and operational excellence across teams. You will partner closely with product, engineering, and client support teams to ensure our teams stay ahead of product updates and evolving operational needs. You will design and implement performance measurement frameworks that evaluate agent performance, training effectiveness, and operational outcomes. You will create feedback loops that continuously improve training programs and operational processes. You will identify capability gaps across teams and design enablement initiatives that raise the overall quality of execution. You will drive high-impact operational initiatives that improve how our teams operate and scale. You will help build scalable infrastructure for training, documentation, and knowledge management. Year 1 Deliverables Build and Scale the Training Function Design and implement Tarro’s end-to-end training and enablement strategy, starting with account executives. Establish the infrastructure for scalable learning — selecting and implementing the right LMS and knowledge base tools. Build modular training curriculums that can be easily localized or adapted for different teams and geographies. Oversee Training Operations Own the onboarding experience for new hires — ensuring smooth ramp-up, clear milestones, and strong operational readiness. Develop train-the-trainer programs and empower internal leads to deliver training consistently. Track training completion, effectiveness, and performance improvement metrics to ensure measurable outcomes. Enable Cross-Functional Scale Partner with Client Operations Support, Client Tech, CSM, Menu and SDR leads to identify skill gaps and build tailored enablement plans. Create and maintain alignment between product updates, process changes, and the training library. Work with Product Operations to ensure new feature rollouts are supported by timely, effective learning materials. Drive Continuous Improvement Audit current training content, identify gaps, and lead the refresh cycle for process or feature updates. Use data from QA, performance dashboards, and call analysis to identify coaching opportunities. Champion a culture of continuous learning — embedding feedback loops and recognition for development. About You You have 2–4 years of experience in a high-intensity environment, such as management consulting, startups, private equity, or investment banking. You are bilingual in Mandarin and English, with strong written and verbal communication skills. You have demonstrated the ability to drive projects end-to-end with high ownership, ideally while managing or mentoring high-calibre teammates. You enjoy building things from 0 → 1 and are comfortable rolling up your sleeves to execute quickly. You are comfortable operating in fast-paced environments with ambiguity and rapid change. Bonus Points You have experience in a consumer driven industry with a passion for the customer. You have experience building training programs, playbooks, or enablement systems. You have worked in fast-growing technology or startup environments. You have experience working cross-functionally with product, engineering, and operations teams. You have a roll up your sleeves mentality with current or prior experience working in a fast-paced, collaborative, highly ambiguous environment, frequently wearing more than one hat. If you do not meet all the requirements listed above which candidates rarely do, don't worry. We still encourage you to apply! Tarro is committed to hiring the best team to empower small businesses to thrive. We believe that a diverse workforce is paramount to our success. We welcome talent from all backgrounds - including but not limited to - race, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, nationality, religion, veteran status, political affiliation, and disability.
