Title: Knowledge Systems Integrator
Description:
SMX is seeking a Knowledge Systems Integrator to support government client at Camp Smith. The Knowledge Systems Integrator (KSI) / Knowledge Manager will enable units to leverage emerging AI technologies and integrate them with DOW operational technology (OT) to enhance mission effectiveness. This role is responsible for integrating Knowledge Management practices with SharePoint, Power Platform, Maven Smart System, and other tools used to support military, defense, intelligence, operational, and business process workflows. This role ensures interoperability between advanced analytic tools and current OT systems across air, space, cyber, and Joint operational domains. The KSI leads rapid prototyping, experimentation, and deployment of AI enabled capabilities while applying KM principles to ensure knowledge sharing, adoption, and sustained utility. The Knowledge Systems Integrator helps ensure that organizational knowledge is not only stored, but structured, governed, searchable, reusable, and ready to support AI-enabled workflows.

This position requires a current DoD Top Secret SCI security clearance which requires US citizenship for work on DoD contracts.

This position is full-time onsite in Aiea, Hawaii.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and support AI-integrated systems that improve client workflows and decision-making.
  • Transform operational and business processes into tools that can be integrated into AI-enabled environments.
  • Support Maven Smart System as the primary AI and operational integration platform.
  • Develop AI-enabled workflows that connect organizational knowledge, data, tools, and decision processes.
  • Support the design and development of in-house LLM capabilities trained or turned on approved organizational data, where authorized.
  • Develop retrieval-augmented generation workflows using trusted organizational data sources.
  • Support AI agent workflows that retrieve information, summarize content, call tools, generate draft products, and support human decision-making.
  • Design prompt templates, prompt chains, structured outputs, and reusable AI patterns.
  • Integrate AI systems with cloud environments, APIs, databases, knowledge repositories, dashboards, and workflow tools.
  • Support embedding models, vector search, knowledge retrieval, data ingestion, and AI search capabilities.
  • Develop rapid solution development, prototyping, and fielding of emerging technologies to test and evaluate AI system performance, accuracy, relevance, and usefulness.
  • Work with the AI Integrator and Knowledge Systems Integrator to ensure AI tools are operationally useful, adopted by users, and connected to real client workflows.
  • Support AI governance, human-in-the-loop review, data protection, and auditability.
  • Coordinate with partner organizations, technical teams, and operational stakeholders to ensure AI tools meet SOF operational requirements.
  • Develop training programs, documentation, and knowledge sharing initiatives to optimize adoption of AI enabled tools.
  • Apply KM frameworks to ensure knowledge capture, retention, and continuous improvement within AI enabled operations.

Required Skills & Experience 

The requirements are structured to welcome entry-to-mid-level KMs who are eager to learn, while highly valuing technical capabilities as growth accelerators.
Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Knowledge Management, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration, Intelligence Studies, Military Studies, or related field.

  • Experience supporting military, defense, intelligence, operations, or business process environments.

Desired Skills & Experience 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • SharePoint administration or power-user experience
  • Microsoft Power Platform familiarity
  • Requirements gathering & Business process mapping
  • Metadata, taxonomy, and content organization
  • Military or defense operational awareness
  • Collaboration with technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Documentation and user support
  • Working knowledge of AI-enabled tools
  • Experience with Maven Smart System or Palantir-related tools (Ontology, Pipeline Builder), AWS (S3, Bedrock, Kendra), or advanced Microsoft Azure cloud tools.

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted search, summarization, or workflow automation

Title: Training Content Specialist
Description:
AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today’s five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.

Position Summary 

The Training Content Specialist designs, develops, and maintains the instructional materials, work instructions, and learning content that qualify technicians to build flight hardware. Working within a regulated AS9100 and ITAR-controlled production environment, this role translates technical processes, engineering documentation, and subject-matter-expert knowledge into clear, repeatable, audit-ready training and operational content. 

This is a builder role for someone who can sit between the shop floor and the documentation system — capturing how work is actually done, then structuring it so a new technician can learn it the same way every time. The output of this role directly affects build quality, qualification rigor, and the irreversibility of on-orbit hardware. 

 

Key Responsibilities 

Content Development 

  • Author, format, and maintain training materials: instructor guides, technician workbooks, slide decks, job aids, quick-reference cards, and assessment instruments. 
  • Develop training videos and revise manufacturing work instructions and process documentation in coordination with Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, and Warehouse. 

 Minimum Qualifications 

  • 3+ years developing technical training content, work instructions, or procedural documentation — preferably in a manufacturing, aerospace, defense, or other regulated production environment. 
  • Basic visual/media skills: photo editing, diagramming, simple instructional video capture and editing. 
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical processes into clear, structured, step-by-step content for a hands-on technical audience. 
  • Strong technical writing and editing skills with attention to accuracy, consistency, and document control. 
  • Proficiency with document and content tools (e.g., MS Office/Google Workspace, PDF authoring) and willingness to learn internal systems. 
  • Must be a U.S. Person as defined under ITAR (22 CFR §120.62) — U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, or protected individual — due to export-control requirements. 

 Preferred Qualifications 

  • Bachelor's degree in instructional design, technical communication, engineering, or a related field. 
  • Experience authoring content in an AS9100, ISO 9001, or comparable quality-managed environment. 
  • Familiarity with e-learning authoring tools (e.g., Articulate, Captivate) and/or an LMS. 
  • Background in or exposure to electronics assembly, composites, mechanical assembly, or other flight/precision hardware processes. 
  • Experience with structured qualification frameworks (e.g., OJT/qualification standards, CFETP-style training documents). 

 Core Competencies 

  • Clarity under complexity — distills dense technical processes into usable content. 
  • Documentation discipline — rigorous about versioning, traceability, and standards. 
  • SME collaboration — earns trust on the floor and extracts knowledge effectively. 
  • Ownership — drives content from request to controlled release with minimal oversight. 
  • Quality mindset — understands that content accuracy maps directly to hardware quality. 

 

This job description may not be inclusive to the duties and responsibilities listed. Additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time or the scope of the job may change as needed by business demands.

Our Values:

We look for people who embody our values - Care, Do, Try & Shine.

Title: Technical Writer
Description:
At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations. 
 
Join Accenture Federal Services, a technology company within global Accenture. Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands-on experience, certifications, industry training and more. 
 
Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward!
 

We are seeking a Technical Writer with experience producing clear, accurate documentation for complex software and hardware systems. This role involves working both independently and with engineers, project managers, and other stakeholders to create and maintain a variety of technical documents.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain documentation, including user guides, SOPs, required deliverables, and security-related documents for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Create technical content that is clear, accurate, user-friendly, and meets DoW and project standards.
  • Collaborate with subject-matter experts to gather and verify information.
  • Use an issue tracking system (GitLab) to monitor development progress and provide documentation support as systems evolve.
  • Work with the government Configuration Manager to help track customer deliveries of materials and use revision logs and tracking spreadsheets to maintain version control.
  • Take initiative to spot missing or unclear information and address gaps to ensure documentation is complete and effective.

You have:

  • Active Secret clearance or higher
  • At least 2 years of technical writing experience, including demonstrated experience developing technical documentation for DoW (DoD) programs
  • Experience working with engineering or technical teams
  • Ability and willingness to work fully onsite in San Diego, CA

Nice to have:

  • Proficiency with MadCap Flare.
  • Familiarity with configuration management, versioning, and documentation standards.
  • Working knowledge of SELinux/Linux, GitLab, VMWare, HTML, image editing tools, and basic programming concepts.
  • Detail-oriented and able to improve and streamline legacy documentation.
  • Familiarity with CUI (Controlled Unclassified Information) handling requirements
  • Strong communication skills
  • Highly proficient with Microsoft Word.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
  • Strong editing and organizational skills.

Title: Governance and Taxonomy Specialist
Description:
At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations. 
 
Join Accenture Federal Services, a technology company within global Accenture. Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands-on experience, certifications, industry training and more. 
 
Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward!
 

We are seeking a detail‑oriented, strategic, and highly collaborative Governance and Taxonomy Specialist to join our Ecosystem Readiness & Delivery Enablement Team. This role sits at the intersection of data governance, taxonomy design, content migration, customer insights, and digital ecosystem modernization. Working closely with the Technical Engagement Manager & Data PM and the Release Train Engineer (RTE), you will serve as a critical integrator—ensuring governance standards, taxonomy structures, and data practices are consistently applied, thoroughly tested, and ready to scale as our enterprise transitions through key phases a data modernization initiative. 

The work:  

This is not a passive policy-writing role. You will actively operationalize governance recommendations, pilot new approaches, implement automation and AI-driven workflows, and ensure that foundational governance protocols are strong enough to support future phases of work and potential onboarding of external support vendors. You will play a pivotal part in stabilizing and maturing the digital ecosystem, ensuring it is compliant, user-informed, and technically sound. You will implement and contribute to data, website design, and security governance standards for the foundational phase of a data modernization initiative as part of the broader uniform governance program. You will support the establishment of initial governance processes, documentation, and compliance frameworks needed to anchor long-term ecosystem stability. You will continually support improvements in information architecture, navigation, search, and content/data migration efforts. You will define foundational data management policies and processes, partnering with stakeholders to develop, pilot, and implement these structures across the ecosystem. You will develop and update documentation, including process guides, design artifacts, onboarding materials, and governance protocols, to reflect enhancements, new features, or policy changes. 

Here’s what you need: 

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in data governance, taxonomy design, content migration, customer insights, and/or digital ecosystem modernization 
  • Experience with taxonomy management, data governance, or information architecture 
  • Adept at synthesizing customer insights and applying them to structural improvements 
  • Ability to define baseline taxonomy protocols associated with innovation activities, such as optimizing content for Generative AI search experiences and other emerging technologies 
  • Ability to collaborate with key stakeholders to refine and support data onboarding and governance processes.  

Bonus if you have:  

  • Experience with modern Data Catalog tools such as Databricks, Atlassian, Collibra, and Immuta 
  • Experience owning development of formal enterprise documentation and training materials 
  • Experience enforcing standard data governance policies in an enterprise program

Title: Technical Writer, RMS
Department: Hardware Platform : Hardware Test Operations : Hardware Test Operations
Description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Anduril is seeking an experienced technical writer to partner with our Test & Evaluation group to generate and maintain developmental test and operation-focused technical documentation. The team strongly believes that documentation is a key part of the test and product development process. In this role you will work closely with test engineers, pilots, and various subject matter experts to understand how they use our products, identify gaps in understanding, and use documentation to close the gap. The Technical Writer will play a foundational role in setting the tone and quality bar on written artifacts, as well as helping to grow the technical documentation function as a whole at Anduril.

With our focus on defense and national security, product docs play a critical role in ensuring that front-line decision makers have the best tools and information possible about Anduril systems. As a Technical Writer, your mission is to make this process as easy and seamless as possible, with exceptionally written and presented artifacts, while building world-class infrastructure and tooling for creating and maintaining our documentation content at scale.

Written content artifacts under this charter may include things like: checklists, procedures, operational manuals, maintenance manuals, templates, user guides, release notes, troubleshooting guides, and API documentation. You will partner with test engineering, product management, and the business across all phases of product development — from ground truth need-finding, to execution, to field testing and validation — to ensure that the user has the right documentation available.

The Test and Evaluation team at Anduril works across the entire spectrum of products and business lines, as well as all flight operations and test range management. Our team conducts full system level development testing, new production acceptance testing, sub-component qualification testing and much more. In short, if it involves test, we support it. If you are interested in working in an extremely innovative and fast paced environment, where your work directly makes an impact and difference in the products that are fielded, this a fantastic opportunity.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Build partnerships across the business to understand our users and our products, with specific focus on hardware and its supporting software components used by the Test & Evaluation group and operators.
  • Generate, review, and edit documentation, that is Test & Evaluation-focused and of the highest quality
  • Research highly technical subject matter, organizes information from multiples sources, and express technical information in written form that is comprehensible to a wide audience of reader
  • Contribute to Anduril’s technical writing toolkit, working on everything from style guides to the documentation lifecycle and review process

 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • A bachelor's degree in English, communications, linguistics, or related field. May substitute equivalent technical experience in lieu of education.
  • 5+ years of demonstrated excellence generating technical documentation
  • Previous experience creating technical documentation in the Aerospace industry and/or DOD
  • Familiarization of military writing standards and verbiage (412TW-TIH-20-01)
  • Experience reading and interpreting engineering documentation
  • Use multiple word processing and presentation tools such as MS Word, PowerPoint, and Visio
    etc.
  • Must have strong communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills, with emphasis on technical subjects
  • The ability to thrive with a high level of autonomy and responsibility, managing competing demands and occasional tight deadlines
  • Basic development proficiency - we value the ability to apply software development best practices to documentation systems
  • A passion for excellent documentation and user experiences
  • Must possess and be able to maintain an active Secret security clearance, Top Secret preferred.
  • In this role, you will be subject to pre-employment and randomized substance screening, as required by the Company.

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline from an accredited college or university
  • 7+ years of demonstrated excellence generating technical documentation
  • Previous experience creating technical documentation for developmental aircraft (Manned or UAS), weapons, or missile systems
  • Familiarization with team workspace software (JIRA, Confluence, SharePoint)
  • Experience drafting S1000D compliant technical publications
  • Experience with and understanding of the DoD logistics process
US Salary Range
$87,000—$116,000 USD

Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Title: Sr. Technical Writer, Mission Autonomy
Description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Company Overview

Anduril is a defense technology company, bringing Silicon Valley talent and funding to the defense sector. Our technology helps our customers solve their toughest challenges by enabling them to make better, more informed decisions in life-and-death situations. We’ve assembled a diverse team of experts in artificial intelligence, computer vision, sensor fusion, optics, and data analysis that are creating software and hardware solutions to radically evolve the capabilities of the United States and our allies. If you are passionate about solving problems that have real impact, come join Anduril and build the future of defense.

Team Overview

Anduril’s Mission Autonomy team builds the software ecosystem used to command and control collaborative combat aircraft (CCA). Our software is deployed both onboard air vehicles and within operator-controlled Ground Control Stations, and it supports the complete “Day-in-the-Life” of these vehicles: operator training, mission planning, mission execution, and mission debrief. Our software is deliberately built to be agnostic to any single air vehicle or software platform, and it is integrated against government reference architectures and interfaces so that it can operate across a competitive vendor ecosystem. Our responsibilities include autonomy software development, air vehicle and ground system integration, flight test support, and the technical documentation that lets operators, integrators, and developers use our autonomy stack correctly. We are seeking an experienced senior technical writer to build and maintain autonomy software documentation in accordance with program and customer requirements. We believe that the quality of our documentation should reflect the quality of our products, which are world-class.

Role Specifics

As a senior technical writer, your mission is to partner with our autonomy, platform integration, and flight test teams to deliver accurate, updated, and easy-to-understand documentation on how to integrate, configure, and operate Anduril’s Mission Autonomy software. You will do whatever it takes to organize our engineering and program delivery functions in this mission. In this role, you will work closely with engineers, autonomy behavior developers, test engineers, and various subject matter experts to understand our software, identify integrator and operator workflows, and use documentation to close the gap. As such, the technical writer will play a foundational role in setting the bar for tone, voice, and quality across our written artifacts.

With Anduril’s focus on defense and national security, autonomy documentation plays a critical role in ensuring operators in every role, from Air Vehicle Controller to Quarterback, understand how our autonomy behaves across its operating modes, what it will and will not do on its own, and how to task, override, and approve its actions. Your mission is to make the process of learning how to employ autonomous systems as easy and seamless as possible, with exceptionally written and presented artifacts.

You will identify relevant stakeholders and lead them through a documentation roadmap with established key milestones and targets. This will require an in-depth understanding of what teams are relevant to documentation, and what an organized effort toward collaboration entails. You are to ensure that stakeholders are engaged at the right time, and you will guide them towards a finished user-facing document that plainly meets customer needs. Finally, you will work with our account teams to ensure that contract deliverables are accurate, on time, and in the right format, including documentation that must align to government reference architecture releases and flight test event schedules.

Written content artifacts under this charter may include things like: mission planning, execution, and debrief user guides; autonomy task and behavior overviews; deployment, configuration, and management manuals; message and API reference catalogs; architecture and design documents; integration and test procedures; flight manual and checklist inputs; glossaries; and release notes. You will partner with ILS, product, and engineering teams across all phases of product development to ensure users have the right documentation available, including the third-party air vehicle and ground control vendors who integrate against our autonomy interfaces.

Another critical aspect of this role is to build the infrastructure and tooling needed for creating and maintaining our documentation content at scale. This role spans two authoring environments, and you will be fluent in both. Internally, we run a docs-as-code pipeline so that technical documentation stays aligned with engineering. For customer and contract deliverables, we author structured content in S1000D using RapidAuthor against our Common Source Data Base. A significant part of your charter is keeping these two environments coherent, so that engineering-authored source content flows into formal deliverables without being rewritten from scratch. This structure will enable technical writing contributions from elsewhere across the business. In this role, you will co-lead efforts to define requirements, identify software solutions, and then implement them while also building process and training to scale this function across other teams.

What you’ll do

  • Generate, review, and edit documentation that is user-focused. Work with engineering and test to deliver task, conditions, standard-centric documentation
  • Document autonomy behaviors, operating modes, and failure and contingency handling so that users and integrators can predict system response, and keep that documentation current as behaviors change release over release
  • Own interface and message reference documentation for the autonomy stack, working from government reference interface definitions, protobuf and schema definitions, and the source code itself, and support vendor integration events with clear, testable interface documentation
  • Produce developer and integrator reference material that is accurate to the implementation, including architecture and design documents, sequence and state diagrams, and configuration references
  • Contribute to Anduril’s technical writing toolkit - working on everything from style guides to the documentation lifecycle and review process, and also relevant software tool procurement through definition requirements for things like authoring and publishing tools, spanning both our internal docs-as-code pipeline, including its static site generator, search, linting, and CI deployment, and our S1000D authoring and publishing environment
  • Run the intake and triage path for documentation requests from across the program, and keep the published site accurate, navigable, and current release over release
  • Evaluate and prioritize tasks required to successfully support product documentation efforts and keep them on track. Help drive the best decision for the company by using a data-driven approach and consider input from stakeholders to ensure well-informed decisions. You should be prepared to fill gaps that represent risks to the documentation roadmap
  • Communicate and help manage expectations. Ensure risks are noted with adequate time, mitigations are identified, and resources are allocated
  • Support flight test and demonstration events by capturing procedures, configuration baselines, and lessons learned, and by turning test results into documentation updates
  • Help build a culture of technical documentation by creating process and training for others to contribute content. Refine our product maturity framework so that documentation is a meaningful step towards productization of new systems.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of demonstrated excellence generating technical documentation, including documentation for software or software-intensive systems
  • Experience reading and interpreting engineering documentation, including interface and message definitions, schemas, and requirements artifacts, and comfort reading source code
  • Experience building content in a variety of content authoring tools including word editors and specialized authoring software (e.g. Arbortext, RapidAuthor)
  • Working knowledge of S1000D structured authoring, including data module development against a Common Source Data Base and applicable business rules
  • Comfort working in a developer toolchain: Git-based version control and pull request review, Markdown or MDX, and documentation that builds and deploys through CI as part of a software pipeline
  • Strong communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills, with emphasis on technical subjects
  • Must thrive with autonomy and responsibility, managing competing priorities and tight deadlines. Impeccable project-management skills
  • Passion for excellent documentation and user experience
  • Must be eligible for Secret and higher security clearance (US)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience writing technical user-facing documentation
  • Previous experience creating technical documentation in Aerospace and Defense (for DoD)
  • Experience documenting uncrewed aircraft systems, autonomy or AI/ML software, flight software, or mission planning systems
  • Familiarity with government reference architectures, applications, and interfaces for autonomy and collaborative combat aircraft (e.g. A-GRA, A-GRI), and with the message-level interfaces they define
  • Hands-on experience with a documentation static site generator such as Docusaurus, MkDocs, or Sphinx, including sidebar and information architecture, search, and diagram-as-code tooling such as Mermaid
  • Military exposure and experience, particularly with military technical documentation writing and formatting standards, guidelines, and verbiage (S1000D, MIL-STD-40051, etc), and with flight manual standards such as MIL-STD-38784 or MIL-DTL-7700
  • Experience Documenting Software Release content in an Agile environment
  • Experience supporting airworthiness, safety-of-flight, or test readiness review documentation

Title: Senior Technical Writer, Intelligence Systems
Description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM
Anduril Intelligence Systems (AIS) is focused on positioning Anduril as a lead provider of specialized engineering and products for Intelligence Community (IC) customers. We work within the IC to understand their requirements, shape their concepts of operation, and deliver exquisite capability across their problem set. We aim to develop and deploy critically needed capabilities that address our customers’ most pressing national security requirements.

ABOUT THE JOB
Anduril is seeking a technical writer to partner with our intelligence systems engineering team to generate and maintain engineering and developer-focused technical documentation. The team strongly believes that documentation is a key part of the product development process. In this role you will work closely with developers and users to understand how products are developed as well as how they are used, identify gaps in understanding, and use documentation to close the gap. You will be play a foundational role in setting the tone and quality bar on written artifacts.

With our focus on defense and national security, product docs play a critical role in ensuring that front-line decision makers have the best tools and information possible about Anduril systems. As a Technical Writer, your mission is to make this process as easy and seamless as possible, with exceptionally well-written and presented artifacts, while building world-class infrastructure and tooling for creating and maintaining our documentation content at scale.
Written content artifacts under this charter may include things like: compliance, process documentation, user guides, release notes, troubleshooting guides, and API documentation. You will partner with engineering, product management, and the business across all phases of product development — from ground truth need-finding, to execution, to field testing and validation — to ensure that the user has the right documentation available
 
This is an opportunity to join a small and start-up like team to help shape Anduril’s product documentation experience from the ground up.

 WHAT YOU'LL DO
  • Generate, review, and edit documentation, that is user-focused and of the highest quality.
  • Documentation covers full development lifecycle – from planning and design to technical configuration, deployment, and integration
  • Work with engineering to ship user-friendly documentation that not only informs and instructs but also contributes to a robust user experience.
  • Contribute to Anduril’s technical writing toolkit, working on everything from style guides to the documentation lifecycle and review process.
  • Build partnerships across the business to understand our users and our products.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Experience: 8+ years of demonstrated excellence generating technical documentation for various levels of technical audiences for a variety of product types.
  • Technical Aptitude: Reading and interpreting software and hardware user documentation for complex technical products as well as a highly structured certification process.
  • Writing Ability: A proven clear and persuasive writing and in-person communication skills for a variety of audiences from extremely technical to lay person
  • Mission-First Mindset: You put the needs of the customer and the mission first. You are motivated by the opportunity to radically evolve national and allied defense capabilities.
  • Adaptability: You thrive in unstructured environments. You are a self-starter who can work independently, solve vague technical problems, and drive tasks to completion without constant supervision.
  • Collaboration & Low-Ego: Collaborate closely with engineering staff, subject matter experts (SMEs) and program management to translate complex technical concepts into clear user-friendly documentation and ensure seamless project delivery.
  • Passion and Curiosity: A passion for excellent documentation and user experience combined with a curiosity for new technology.
  • Development Skills: Basic development proficiency - we value the ability to apply software development best practices to documentation systems.
  • Personal Responsibility: The ability to thrive with a high level of autonomy and responsibility, managing competing demands and tight deadlines.
  • Willingness to streamline and or augment existing processes and products using artificial intelligence.
  • Clearance: Currently possesses and able to maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.
  • In this role, you will be subject to pre-employment and randomized substance screening, as required by the Company.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Experience using, evaluating, and implementing modern software and automation tools to help manage high volume technical writing requirements.
  • Toolset includes Docs-as-Code, Sphinx, VS Code, basic command line skills, Git (or other source control systems), Mastery of Adobe Acrobat and MS Office Suite.

$146,000—$194,000 USD

Title: Technical Program Manager – Advanced Manufacturing
Description:
At Relativity Space, we’re building rockets to serve today’s needs and tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

About the Team: 

Relativity Space pioneered large-scale additive manufacturing with our Terran 1 rocket, the largest 3D-printed object to fly. Now a distinct business unit within Relativity, Horizon Manufacturing Technologies is advancing next-generation manufacturing for aerospace and beyond. The team operates at the frontier of manufacturing innovation, where creativity meets capability. This is an environment where cutting-edge R&D is put into production, industrializing advanced manufacturing capabilities to solve customer problems. You’ll work alongside welders, robotics engineers, data scientists, and systems engineers at the intersection of hardware and software, creating an end-to-end additive manufacturing platform that serves a wide variety of applications. From exploring new materials to unlocking faster print speeds, to designing complex, organic geometries that can’t be built any other way, it’s high-impact work that sets the foundation for the future of advanced manufacturing.

About the Role:

  • Lead complex programs from kickoff through delivery, partnering with engineering, operations, supply chain, and customers to execute against cost, schedule, and technical objectives.
  • Translate customer requirements and program goals into actionable plans, driving alignment across cross-functional teams and maintaining visibility into progress, risks, and dependencies.
  • Serve as the primary interface between technical teams, leadership, and customers, facilitating technical reviews, communicating program status, and enabling timely decision-making.
  • Own program execution by maintaining integrated schedules, preparing customer-facing status reports, coordinating and reviewing technical deliverables, and ensuring clear, accurate communication throughout the program lifecycle
  • Own the commercial and operational success of assigned programs, maintaining accountability for budgets, forecasts, customer commitments, contract execution, schedule performance and overall program profitability.
  • Drive program governance by managing requirements, configuration and change control, risk mitigation, and compliance with quality and regulatory standards.

About You:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Program Management, or a related technical field.
  • 3+ years of experience managing multiple technical programs in aerospace, defense, advanced manufacturing, or another highly regulated engineering environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence technical and business stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Proven ability to influence technical decisions and align diverse stakeholders around common objectives.
  • Exceptional technical writing and communication skills, with experience developing customer-facing reports, reviewing technical documentation, and translating complex engineering concepts into clear, actionable communication.
  • Excellent commercial and financial awareness, with experience framing decisions in terms of cost, timing, risk and performance.

Nice to haves but not required:  

  • Experience with additive manufacturing, advanced manufacturing, or new product development.
  • Working knowledge of quality and regulatory standards such as AS9100, ISO 9001, ITAR/EAR, DFARS, or NIST 800-171
  • Project Management Professional Certification (PMP)
  • Knowledge of materials, manufacturing, operations and additive manufacturing standards.

Compensation is only one part of our total rewards package. Relativity Space offers competitive salary and equity, a generous PTO and sick leave policy, parental leave, an annual learning and development stipend, and more! To see some of the benefits & perks we offer, please visit here.

Title: Learning & Content Administrator
Description:
FreedomCare is a healthcare company that has been dedicated to revolutionizing the home care industry since 2016. We support our patients by ensuring they have the power to choose a caregiver who will care for them in the comfort of their own homes. Our mission spans coast to coast, supporting patients across the U.S.

We pride ourselves on our values which drive the level of care that we deliver to our patients:

  • Here For You (An attitude of service, empathy, and availability)
  • Own It (Drive and ownership)
  • Do the Right Thing (High integrity)
  • Be Positive (Great attitude and a can-do positive approach to challenges)

Join our team and make a positive impact on the lives of others! We are looking for a Learning & Content Admin for our People & Culture team.

Must be willing to travel: This role is remote and requires occasional travel to any FreedomCare location nationally when necessary.  

Department & Position Overview:

The Learning & Content Administrator is responsible for developing and maintaining a centralized knowledge base, managing the company’s Learning Management System (LMS), and creating learning assets to support employee and caregiver training. This role ensures that our workforce has access to the right information at the right time while championing user-friendly and engaging content across multiple platforms. This position requires a blend of content development, knowledge management, LMS administration, and instructional design skills to drive efficient learning and information-sharing across FreedomCare.

Every Day You Will:

  • Develop, organize, and maintain internal knowledge bases, SharePoint sites, and documentation hubs to ensure accessibility and usability.
  • Write, edit, and optimize process documentation, job aids, call scripts, and internal communications to support employees and caregivers.
  • Oversee SharePoint site structure, ensuring content is well-organized, searchable, and up-to-date.
  • Collaborate with subject matter experts (SMEs) to document evolving processes and best practices.
  • Establish governance for content maintenance, version control, and user feedback integration to improve knowledge accessibility.
  • Serve as the LMS administrator, managing course uploads, learner enrollments, compliance tracking, and system configurations for internal staff and field workers.
  • Troubleshoot technical LMS issues, providing user support and liaising with vendors for resolutions.
  • Partner with the Salesforce team to maintain LMS integrations and reporting accuracy.
  • Set up/maintain automated learning pathways, reminders, and certifications based on compliance requirements and internal training needs.
  • Generate regular reports and analyze training data, course engagement, and learner feedback to improve user experience and optimize content.

Title: Systems Technical Writer
Description:
Who we are

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. 

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. 

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. 

The role

As Systems Technical Writer, you will own the creation and maintenance of technical documentation across Helsing's multidisciplinary drone hardware and software programmes. Working directly with mechanical, electrical, software and aerodynamics engineers, you will extract first-principles technical knowledge from complex system architectures and translate it into precise, structured documentation used by both internal engineering teams and external operators. Your work ensures that the integrity of engineering intent is preserved from system requirement through to end-user procedure, directly supporting programme maturation, compliance and operational readiness. 

The day-to-day

  • Author and maintain high-quality technical publications including Interface Control Documents, System Architecture Descriptions, Operator Manuals and Maintenance Guides, drawing on direct analysis of CAD assemblies, electrical schematics, software APIs and aerodynamic test data 

  • Document physical, electrical and logical integration interfaces, including wire harnesses, pinouts and signal telemetry protocols, working in close collaboration with electronics and software engineers to ensure accuracy and traceability 

  • Author flight-test procedures, aerodynamic performance envelopes and flight-limitation documentation in partnership with flight-test and aerodynamics teams, ensuring outputs meet regulatory and operational standards 

  • Create clear isometric line art, block diagrams and system flowcharts derived from SolidWorks, NX or electrical schematics, ensuring visual documentation meets the precision required for assembly, integration and troubleshooting workflows 

  • Participate in design reviews, validation events and hands-on hardware integration sessions to verify the accuracy of draft procedures, maintaining requirements traceability from high-level system specifications down to individual component guides within PLM and version control systems 

You should apply if you

  • Have authored structured technical documentation across multidisciplinary engineering domains, including mechanical, electrical, software and aerodynamic systems, within aerospace, defence, robotics or UAV programmes 

  • Can read and interpret 3D CAD assemblies, electrical wire harness schematics, PCB layouts and software API documentation to produce accurate, first-principles technical content without requiring intermediaries 

  • Are proficient in structured authoring tools such as MadCap Flare, Adobe FrameMaker, LaTeX or Confluence, and have worked within PLM and version control environments such as Windchill, Arena, Git or equivalent 

  • Have translated highly complex engineering architectures into user-facing procedures and operator manuals that are clear, compliant and structured for a non-specialist audience 

  • Communicate clearly and precisely in both written and spoken English and German, and can convey complex engineering concepts accurately to technical and non-technical audiences alike. 

  • Act decisively with minimal guidance, own outcomes end-to-end and initiate solutions without waiting for direction 

Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with aerodynamic performance documentation and flight manual authoring within a certified or regulated aerospace or UAV operating environment 

  • Experience creating visual technical content directly from CAD source files, reducing dependency on engineering team bandwidth for illustration and diagram production 

Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields 

  • Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns

  • The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world

  • Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward

  • In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts

  • We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and VSOP options

  • Relocation support: up to €2,500 and 4 weeks temporary accommodation

  • Learning: €500/£450 yearly allowance

  • Health & wellness: gym membership and mental health support (Nilo.health)

  • Social: regular company events and monthly social allowances

  • Enhanced parental leave: 22 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers & 6 weeks for secondary caregivers

  • Family support: 5 days of paid family emergency leave, 100% remote work option during pregnancy and phased return to work

  • A hands-on onboarding program (affectionately labelled “Infraduction”), in which you will be building tooling and applications to be used across the company. This is your opportunity to learn our tech stack, explore the company, and learn how we get things done - all whilst working with other engineering teams from day one 

 

Helsing is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

Title: Senior Developer Experience Writer
Description:
Our everyday digital experiences are in the midst of a realtime revolution. Whether chatting alongside a livestreaming event, receiving realtime financial information, or working with colleagues in an online collaborative environment - consumers simply expect realtime digital experiences as standard. At Ably we’re not just witnessing this revolution, we’re powering it - at scale.

At the heart of our mission lies a commitment to putting developers first. Ably provides a suite of products to build, extend, and deliver powerful digital experiences in realtime, delivering billions of messages for millions of devices every day and supporting organizations like Harness, EA, Panasonic and HubSpot.

Working at Ably means helping to build the infrastructure and technology that will power and shape the future of the internet. The opportunity in front of us is immense. And we’d like your help.

About this role

Thousands of developers around the world use Ably's SDKs and APIs to power realtime features in their applications. The Developer Experience team is responsible for ensuring that Ably is a platform that exemplifies great developer experience, and is a reference point that other companies aspire to.

As our Senior Developer Experience Writer, you’ll be contributing directly to this goal; helping developers to quickly understand Ably, build confidently and ultimately succeed with the platform. At its core, this is an AI-focussed role; you’ll be in charge of  setting up the foundations that empower engineers to produce first-class developer documentation with AI at scale. You’ll use AI to automate checks, maintain quality, and allow for rapid iteration in the content itself, as well as in the documentation platform. You’ll still be setting the standards for technical content across the business, and using your expertise to shape the information architecture.

This is a modern take on technical writing; you’ll be using AI to both increase your own output, whilst also increasing the velocity of other contributors. The same core values still apply though - ensuring that users can quickly understand and succeed with Ably.

Day to day you will

  • Use AI to produce quality content. You’ll write reusable prompts and skills that docs contributors can use to ensure their content meets Ably’s quality standards. 
  • Define and uphold content standards. You'll help define what great looks like; from docs structure and style to making sure that PRs are always exceeding standards. You’ll leverage AI to check for technical accuracy, and make sure that content always assists developers in learning and succeeding with Ably in the fastest and easiest ways possible.
  • Build engaging educational content templates. You’ll lead by example by producing reference content that others can use as a pattern to write similar content. This will be in the format of templates and skills that team members can leverage.
  • Empower engineers to write great content. You'll coach and support engineering contributors to ensure that they’re always producing accurate, well-structured, developer-friendly content.
  • Champion effective AI use. You'll promote the use of AI for efficiency, while maintaining a sharp eye for quality ensuring content meets editorial standards, is technically accurate, and is free from AI-generated patterns that undermine trust or clarity.
  • Maintain and elevate the docs platform. You'll take responsibility for shaping the documentation platform's components, structure and tooling. This includes making sure content is logically structured, and easily navigable, and that it helps external developers understand Ably in new and exciting ways. 

We'd love to talk if you have

  • Proven success creating technical content for developers, such as documentation, API references and guides; with a portfolio that others have visibly learned from.
  • Experience reviewing and giving feedback on technical writing, with the ability to coach others to improve their craft.
  • Experience and a desire to work in an AI-forward environment. Experience in automation, working with agents and producing quality content at scale is a bonus.
  • Experience of using AI tools as a core part of your workflow for writing, research and coding, as well as understanding their output and limitations.
  • Familiarity with APIs, SDKs, and modern web development tools, with the ability to read, write and reason about code examples in at least one programming language (ideally JavaScript).
  • Strong instincts for developer experience, particularly around onboarding, and a genuine desire to produce experiences that delight developers.
  • A proactive, self-directed mindset with the ability to take ownership of projects end to end, from ideation through to completion.
  • Experience at a startup or growth-stage company, or the adaptability to thrive in a fast-paced, agile environment with a focus on rapid iteration, with excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Bonus points if you have

  • Experience in maintaining and shaping a documentation platform or developer portal.
  • Familiarity with information architecture principles and content strategy.
  • Familiarity with git-driven workflows for managing content changes.
  • Some knowledge or understanding of event-driven architecture.

What’s it like to work at Ably?

We’re tackling planet-scale problems and our ambitions are a testament to that. You’ll join a successful, deeply motivated and collaborative team that thrives on innovation, experimentation and autonomy. To get a sense of life at Ably, visit our careers page. You can also read about the origins of Ably's core values on our blog.

We believe in fostering a culture that's built on inclusivity and mutual respect among all team members, and we recognise that each individual is different and will want to be supported in their role in different ways. We provide a range of perks and benefits to aid folks' development and wellbeing, allowing them to be their best selves and do great work.

  • A remote-first and flexible work environment. UK-based teams come together in person once per month in our London hub (next to Old Street) and we get together as a company twice per year. Aside from that, you’re welcome to work wherever suits best for you.
  • Equity. We’re a growing start-up and we want all team to members to share in the success of the company through our EMI share options programme.
  • Enhanced holiday allowance. Our policy provides Ablyans with 28 days of paid annual leave (27 regular days, plus a day off to enjoy your birthday).
  • Enhanced parental leave package, so that you can take the time you need to get to know your new family member, rest and recover.
  • Home workstation budget of £500 on joining (and £150 p/a thereafter), so that your home office is set up to serve you well and that you have everything you need to work comfortably.
  • Personal learning and development budget of £1000 annually, and 5% L&D time during working hours to focus on improving your skillset.
  • Private healthcare with BUPA.
  • Medical cash plan to cover a range medical and dental costs.
  • Mental wellbeing coaching and counselling from Self Space.
  • Monthly wellbeing budget via Juno.
  • Life assurance and income protection.
  • Access to Tech & Cycle to Work schemes.
  • Weekly snack allowance for our end-of-week “Need To Know” meeting.
  • A fully-paid one-month sabbatical after five years with Ably.

Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging at Ably

We believe our differences as individuals is what makes us great. Our people are at the heart of what we do, and we encourage everyone to be their most authentic self at Ably: we see inclusivity and openness as fundamental to creating long-term success as an organization. We encourage applications from all backgrounds regardless of age, disability, gender, sexual orientation, parental status, race, religion, educational background or neurodiversity. Ably has an amazing opportunity ahead of us, and we want anyone to be able to contribute to that opportunity.

If you enjoy working as part of a technology company, value open source, and love solving hard problems - then we’d love to hear from you, regardless of whether you fit the job description exactly or not. If in doubt, drop us an email; we’d be more than happy to give you some advice on your application.

Title: Documentation Engineer
Description:
ABOUT TALON.ONE:

 

Talon.One is the most powerful incentives engine that unifies loyalty, promotions and gamification into one holistic platform. Backed by enterprise-grade security and scalability, Talon.One empowers companies to build personalized, profitable promotions and loyalty programs using any data.

Today, over 250 of the world’s most-loved brands including Adidas, Sephora and Carlsberg work with Talon.One to drive deeper engagement and lasting loyalty with their customers.

 

ABOUT THE TEAM:

The Developer Experience (DevX) team supports customers integrating and using Talon.One. The team is responsible for the product docs, developer docs, in-product UX copy, and the technical infrastructure behind the docs platform. Our primary audience spans two groups: marketing users operating the product (campaign managers, loyalty managers), and backend engineers integrating our APIs.

We use the docs-as-code approach. The content lives in GitHub and the documentation website runs on Docusaurus. The API reference is generated from OpenAPI specifications.

We are looking for a Documentation Engineer to help us extend our documentation platform and write new documentation for our customers. You will sit within the DevX team and work with Product teams. You write code and build tooling, and you also write documentation: reference content, integration guides, and developer-facing copy that no automation can produce to the right standard.

 

 

ONCE YOU ARE HERE YOU WILL:

  • Write reference documentation, integration guides, tutorials, and product documentation
  • Work in tandem with our current documentation engineer to find new ideas and solutions to current challenges
  • Co-own the pipeline from OpenAPI spec to published API reference: validation, transformation, and deployment
  • Build and maintain the scripts and CI jobs
  • Reduce manual work for the technical writing team through tooling and process improvements
  • Make deliberate decisions about how documentation is structured for AI agent consumption, not only human readers
  • Contribute to OpenAPI spec quality by working with writers and engineers on field naming, example coverage, and schema structure

 

WHAT WE NEED YOU TO BRING TO THE TABLE:

  • Developer empathy. You approach and write docs to increase an integrating engineer’s efficiency. You can produce clear, accurate content, not just tooling around it
  • You can write code without AI as a crutch. You write scripts, debug error output, and ship working solutions independently
  • Comfort with JavaScript/TypeScript. Our tooling uses it throughout
  • Fluency with CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience working with or reading OpenAPI 3.x specifications
  • Clear understanding of what makes documentation machine-readable, not only human-readable
  • Practical experience with AI tools, especially Claude. You use them daily and know how to prompt for useful output
  • A preference for correctness over volume. You know when to automate and when automation produces noise

 

OUR TECHNOLOGY:

  • Docusaurus for the docs site
  • GitHub and GitHub Actions for content workflows and CI
  • Scalar for API reference rendering
  • OpenAPI 3.x as the single source of truth for API docs
  • JavaScript/TypeScript for tooling and site customization
  • Claude for AI-assisted workflows

 

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU:
  • 90+ team of engineers, product managers and product designers in Berlin
  • Leaders with 8+ years of experience building our promotions engine
  • €1,000 annual learning budget and free German language courses to boost your skills
  • 30 days of annual leave, plus extra paid days for your birthday and moving day
  • Home office setup budget, a monthly home office allowance
  • Freedom to work from abroad for up to 90 days worldwide!
  • Mental health support with nilo.health and a discounted Urban Sports Club membership
  • 20% company subsidy on your pension contributions
  • Subsidised BVG public transport ticket and a dog-friendly Berlin office where your furry friend is welcome
  • Lease your ideal bike through BusinessBike

Title: Technical Writer - Docs Excellence
Description:
This is Adyen

Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition. 

For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

The Role

Our Docs Excellence team is looking for a systems-minded Technical Writer to join us in Chicago. This isn't a traditional writing role: we treat technical content as structured, living knowledge rather than static pages, and you'll operate as equal parts System Builder and Technical Curator.

You'll step into an established documentation practice: existing style guidelines, a domain-based team structure, and a workflow that blends traditional technical writing with AI-assisted tooling, and you'll help evolve it further as a Knowledge Architect. As System Builder, you'll design the metadata schemas, ontology, and context rules that guide automated first-pass content generation. As Technical Curator, you'll apply exceptional editorial judgment to review, fact-check, and refine that output into precise, trustworthy, and well-structured developer documentation.

What You'll Do

  • Design and maintain metadata schemas (YAML front matter), ontology, and rules that support automated, first-pass content generation workflows.
  • Review, edit, and fact-check auto-generated content and code snippets for technical accuracy, edge cases, and voice.
  • Author and refine API reference guides, integration workflows, and conceptual docs in a docs-as-code environment (Git, Markdown).
  • Partner with Product Managers, Engineers, Support, and Implementation Managers to capture platform logic and validate merchant integration flows.
  • Structure documentation so it works for two audiences at once: human developers navigating integrations, and AI systems parsing context.

Who You Are

  • 3+ years documenting complex technical spaces, including APIs, SDKs, or developer platforms, with a portfolio that shows real writing and editing craft.
  • Comfortable thinking beyond the page: you can design ontologies, metadata schemas, and structured information models.
  • A high-judgment editor who can spot hallucinations, inaccuracies, or structural gaps in automated drafts.
  • Fully fluent in Git, Markdown, and docs-as-code toolchains.
  • A practical, hands-on user of AI tools and LLMs to gather context and streamline documentation work.
  • Someone who asks why before executing. We value critical thinking and problem-solving as much as craft.
  • Comfortable managing multiple stakeholders and adapting to a fast-moving, evolving environment.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with Postman, VS Code, or similar tools.
  • Basic ability to read code snippets (Java, Python, TypeScript) to verify API logic.

Team & Location
You'll join a global community of 15 writers, supported by 2 engineering teams and a senior PM across Amsterdam, Madrid, and Chicago. This role is based in our Chicago office; we operate a hybrid model (3 days/week in office).

Why Adyen?

This is an exceptional opportunity to join a solid, established company with a startup mindset, characterized by small teams, direct communication, and work on important challenges. We offer an environment of ownership and speed. 

The annual base salary range for this role is $100,000 - $125,000 plus RSUs; to learn more about our compensation philosophy, please click here. This position is based out of the Chicago office.

Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments 

Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen. 

Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!

What’s next?

Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here. Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.

 

This role is based out of our Chicago office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.

Title: Technical Writer
Description:
Company Overview

Allen Control Systems (ACS) is a cutting-edge defense startup founded by two former Navy electrical engineers with a proven track record in robotics and software. We are developing a small, autonomous gun turret that employs advanced computer vision and control systems to precisely target and neutralize small drones and loitering munitions. Our innovative approach requires overcoming significant technical challenges, making this an exciting and dynamic environment for experienced professionals.

With an engineering-first culture, ACS values technical excellence and innovation. Backed by our founders’ successful exits from two previous ventures acquired for a combined $180M in 2022, we are committed to ensuring that the groundbreaking technologies we develop have a real-world impact.

Position Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Technical Writer to develop, organize, and maintain comprehensive technical documentation for ACS’s autonomous counter-drone system. This role requires a strong ability to translate complex engineering concepts across robotics, computer vision, and embedded control systems into clear, accurate, and compliant publications that support operators, field users, and government customers.

What You’ll Do:

  • Work directly with ACS engineers and founders to gather and document technical information on the autonomous turret platform, including computer vision systems, control systems, robotics hardware, and embedded software.
  • Create and maintain operator manuals, user guides, system integration documents, maintenance procedures, and safety documentation for ACS’s counter-drone system.
  • Develop government-facing technical deliverables compliant with applicable DoD and MIL-SPEC standards (e.g., MIL-STD-40051, S1000D, or applicable Technical Orders).
  • Collaborate with mechanical and electrical engineers to document hardware assembly, wiring, and maintenance procedures for the autonomous turret platform.
  • Support proposal efforts and contract deliverables by producing technical narratives, SOWs, and program documentation for government customers.
  • Manage document version control and maintain consistency across all publication types as the ACS product evolves rapidly.
  • Prepare and submit documentation deliverables to government agencies and program offices, ensuring compliance with contractual requirements and review timelines.

What You’ll Need:

  • 3-7 years of experience in technical writing, with at least some focus on defense, aerospace, robotics, or hardware systems.
  • Start-up exposure: comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with limited process and high autonomy.
  • Familiarity with DoD documentation standards, ITAR compliance requirements, and MIL-SPEC writing guidelines (e.g., MIL-STD-40051, S1000D).
  • Experience managing technical illustrations, system diagrams, and schematics within documentation for complex hardware or electromechanical systems.
  • Proficiency in documentation tools (Adobe FrameMaker, MS Office Suite, Confluence, XML editors).
  • Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to manage multiple deliverables in a fast-paced environment.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary
  • Health, Dental, Vision Insurance
  • Paid Time Off
