Title: Partner Readiness Technical Lead
Description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

 

THE ROLE

We are looking for a dynamic and highly skilled Partner Readiness Technical Lead to design the knowledge foundations that power Everpure's global partner ecosystem. 

This role sits at the intersection of partner enablement, knowledge architecture, instructional design, and AI. Rather than simply creating learning content, you will architect how partner knowledge is captured, structured, connected, and delivered across multiple experiences—including instructor-led training, digital learning, just-in-time guidance, and conversational learning agents.

As part of the Global Partner Enablement team, you will work closely with product management, product marketing, subject matter experts, instructional designers and partner field teams to transform complex product and solution knowledge into scalable, reusable, AI-ready learning assets.

This position is ideal for someone who thrives on turning complexity into clarity, brings a systems-thinking mindset to learning design, and can balance technical depth with instructional simplicity. Success in this role means building knowledge once and enabling it to be consumed everywhere—by partners, instructors, search, recommendation engines, and conversational AI.

Please note that this is a technical lead role requiring deep technical expertise in storage and data management. This is NOT a instructional designer role or an external customer facing role. This role focuses on internal stakeholder alignment and training creation. 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Partner readiness architecture

  • Design scalable partner readiness architectures from a technical point of view that support Everpure's global partner ecosystem 
  • Define partner learning objectives, competency models, and knowledge structures aligned to partner roles and routes to market.
  • Identify what partners need to know, understand, and be able to do to succeed.
  • Translate product launches and solution updates into structured partner readiness frameworks.

AI-ready knowledge design

  • Structure content to support both traditional learning experiences and AI-powered knowledge consumption.
  • Design modular, reusable learning objects optimized for digital learning, instructor-led training, microlearning, guided selling, conversational AI and just-in-time support.

Enablement experience design

  • Translate complex technical concepts into digestible, persona-based learning outcomes.
  • Design persona-based learning journeys for Account Executives, Systems Engineers and Solution Architects.
  • Tailor learning experiences for: Resellers, Distributors, MSPs and GSIs.
  • Recommend the most effective learning modality based on business objectives rather than defaulting to e-learning.

Knowledge capture

  • Lead structured discovery sessions with SMEs from product management, product marketing, and field teams.
  • Capture product, competitive, technical, sales, and field knowledge.
  • Transform expert knowledge into reusable enablement assets that can power multiple delivery channels.
  • Reduce duplicate content through modular knowledge design.
  • Collaborate with instructional design teams to hand off clear blueprints and structured outlines for content development.

Quality and governance

  • Ensure consistency, taxonomy alignment, and brand compliance across all partner readiness assets.
  • Validate technical accuracy, instructional quality, and business alignment.
  • Support governance for learning architecture, reusable assets, competencies, and content lifecycle management.
  • Validate that learning outcomes tie directly to partner competencies, business priorities and program requirements.

AI innovation

  • Leverage AI throughout the learning lifecycle.
  • Use AI to accelerate knowledge capture, content analysis, curriculum design, assessment generation, localization and content maintenance.
  • Design learning assets that can be consumed by conversational learning agents and future agentic AI experiences.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging AI technologies that improve partner readiness and learning effectiveness.

WHAT YOU BRING

Experience

  • Demonstrable experience in technical partner enablement, systems engineering, technical marketing, knowledge management, or a related field.
  • Proven experience supporting enterprise technology solutions such as storage, cloud, cybersecurity, AI, or data platforms.
  • Proven track record of enabling global partner ecosystems across multiple routes to market.

Skills

  • Exceptional ability to translate complex technical information into structured knowledge and learning experiences.
  • Strong systems-thinking mindset with experience designing modular, reusable, AI-ready content architectures.
  • Proven ability to facilitate knowledge discovery with senior technical SMEs.
  • Strong understanding of competency-based enablement and persona-driven learning.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent English is required; proficiency in additional languages is a plus.
  • Ability to collaborate across functions and geographies in a matrixed environment.
  • Experience designing and validating assessments to measure learning effectiveness and impact.
  • Hands-on experience using AI to accelerate partner readiness workflows.
  • Understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic search, metadata, and AI-ready content principles.
  • Experience designing content that supports both human learning and AI-assisted experiences.
  • Curiosity to continuously explore emerging AI technologies that transform partner enablement.

#LI-ONSITE

Title: Senior Manager, Customer Education
Description:
At Qualia, we've built the leading B2B real estate technology that transforms the home buying and selling experience into a simple, secure, and enjoyable process. Our SMB and Enterprise products bring together users from across the real estate ecosystem—homebuyers and sellers, lenders, title and escrow agents, and real estate agents—onto a single shared digital closing platform, providing greater clarity and transparency to real estate transactions. Today, through our business customers across the country, millions of consumers use Qualia to close on homes every year.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

As the Senior Manager of Customer Education, you will lead the strategy, development, and delivery of the programs and resources that help Qualia customers build proficiency, adopt our products, and achieve long-term value.

You will oversee Qualia’s customer education ecosystem, including Qualia University, the Knowledge Base, customer-facing educational content, one-to-many programming, and one-to-one instructor-led training. You will also lead the growth of Qualia’s new paid customer training service, developing the programs, operating models, and delivery standards needed to scale training as a consistent and valuable professional service.

This role will be responsible for creating a connected customer education strategy across self-service, digital, and live learning channels. You will ensure customers can easily find accurate, relevant, and role-specific education while helping the team prioritize the programs and content that have the greatest impact on customer adoption, proficiency, satisfaction, and long-term success.

You will lead a multidisciplinary team responsible for customer content, knowledge management, digital learning, and customer training. You will partner closely with Product, Product Marketing, Customer Success, Support, Professional Services, Sales, Operations, and other stakeholders to translate customer needs, product changes, and business priorities into scalable educational experiences. 

This role requires strong people leadership, customer education expertise, content and knowledge management experience, operational rigor, and the ability to move comfortably between long-term strategy and hands-on execution.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead a multidisciplinary team responsible for customer content, knowledge management, digital education, and instructor-led training and continue to foster the team’s strong culture of customer empathy, accountability, collaboration, creativity, operational discipline, and high-quality execution
  • Own the vision, strategy, roadmap, and operating model for customer education across Qualia with particular focus on how AI changes the practice of customer education at Qualia — production, delivery, personalization, assessment, and what needs to be taught at all.
  • Own the growth and P&L of Qualia's paid training program — pricing, packaging, margin, capacity planning, and sales enablement — and define the boundary between free and paid offerings. Partner with Sales, CS, and Finance on positioning, scoping, contracting, and fulfillment to hit annual bookings and utilization targets.
  • Create a cohesive education ecosystem that connects Qualia University, the Knowledge Base, customer-facing content, webinars, workshops, and instructor-led training
  • Oversee the development and maintenance of self-paced and instructor led courses, learning paths, certifications, knowledge articles, videos, job aids, release education, facilitator materials, and other customer-facing resources
  • Establish standards and operating processes for each of the team’s programs including quality assurance, content architecture, taxonomy and governance
  • Define and measure the success of each program, analyze program performance and drive continuous improvement
  • Communicate program strategy, performance, capacity considerations, risks, and recommendations to senior leadership
  • Ensure customer-facing content remains accurate, accessible, relevant, consistent, and aligned with Qualia’s products, brand, and customer needs
  • Build and maintain strong cross functional partnerships with Sales, Product, Marketing, Customer Success, Professional Services, Finance, Legal, and Operations 
  • Manage relevant platforms, tools, vendors, and budgets supporting customer education, knowledge, content, and training programs

YOUR BACKGROUND THAT LIKELY MAKES YOU A MATCH

  • 8+ years of experience in customer education, customer training, content strategy, knowledge management, instructional design, professional services, customer success, or a related function, preferably in a B2B SaaS environment
  • 4+ years of people leadership experience, including experience leading multidisciplinary or cross-functional teams
  • Experience building and commercializing a paid customer training or professional services program, including ownership of pricing, packaging, capacity planning, and program P&L. Experience launching a program from inception strongly preferred.
  • Experience owning a program budget or P&L, utilization targets, and unit economics
  • Demonstrated experience developing and scaling customer education programs across digital, self-service, one-to-many, and instructor-led formats
  • Strong understanding of customer education strategy, instructional program development, adult learning principles, content operations, and knowledge management
  • Experience owning or managing an LMS, customer academy, knowledge base, or similar customer learning and content ecosystem
  • Experience establishing content governance, taxonomy, quality standards, intake processes, operating models, and measurement frameworks
  • Strong program and project management skills, with the ability to translate strategy into clear priorities and executable plans
  • Strong analytical orientation with the ability to use customer insights, program data, and business outcomes to guide decisions
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex products, workflows, and concepts into clear and accessible customer education
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled content development, knowledge search, automation, personalization, or digital learning experiences is preferred
  • Experience working in a complex, regulated, workflow-driven, or vertical SaaS industry is preferred


Based in Austin, TX with the ability to work in the office a minimum of two days per week is preferred.

WHY QUALIA

Qualia is made up of incredibly bright, mission-driven coworkers who are passionate about using technology to solve real-world problems—and we're growing quickly. In order to continue building an engaging and dynamic organization, we're committed to giving everyone the support they need to do great work.

Our benefits package is designed to allow our team members to be their best selves, both in and out of the workplace. In addition to comprehensive health plans, a 401k program, and commuter benefits, we prioritize family and personal well-being through professional development, parental leave, and a flexible time off policy. Qualia offers a robust online onboarding program to train new hires, biweekly all hands meetings, and a variety of internal virtual events to keep employees connected.

We believe diverse perspectives and backgrounds are critical to building great technology, and our goal is to cultivate an environment where people feel equally valued and respected. Qualia is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, age, citizenship, socioeconomic status, disability, or veteran status.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree to the collection, processing, and use of your personal information as described in our Employee Data Privacy Notice.

Title: Technical Writer
Description:
Who We Are

Simpplr is the AI-powered intranet for unifying the digital workplace. It brings people, trusted knowledge, apps, and agents into a coherent digital experience. Powered by a proprietary EX Knowledge Graph, Simpplr synthesizes signals and context across connected systems to deliver personalized information and actions. The platform serves as a digital hub supporting communications, engagement, employee services, and work. With low-code extensibility and enterprise-grade security and governance, Simpplr enables confident operation at scale. More than 1,000 organizations — including AAA, the NHS, Penske, and Moderna — trust Simpplr to keep their workforce informed, aligned, and productive. Learn more at simpplr.com.

About the role

You'll join our Technical Support team as a technical writer. You'll write the documentation that helps customers understand and use the product. You'll report into Support, so you'll work closely with agents and support leaders to shape what the knowledge base should become. You'll also partner with product managers, designers, and engineers to document features before they ship.

Your writing will shape how well customers can help themselves. You'll help reduce ticket volume, speed up support responses, and give the AI assistants that handle customer questions better material to work with. It's a hands-on writing role that directly affects customer experience.

What you'll do

  • Write and update knowledge base articles for the product areas you own, including admin guides, how-tos, and troubleshooting content
  • Work with the support team to spot common customer issues, close gaps in the KB, and decide what to update next
  • Partner with PMs and engineers as new features get built, drafting release notes, in-app help text, and UX microcopy along the way
  • Own one or two product areas as your main focus, and pitch in on shared areas when needed
  • Create your own screenshots and short screen recordings to go with your writing
  • Explain AI features clearly, including what they can and cannot do, and how the guardrails work
  • Write content that reads well for people and also works for the AI assistants pulling from the KB
  • Review and edit content from other writers against our style and voice guidelines
  • Help keep the KB healthy, including style guide upkeep, consistent terminology, and review workflows
  • Refresh older docs as the product changes, and clean up what's outdated

What we're looking for

  • 3 to 6 years of technical writing or product content experience, ideally at a B2B SaaS company
  • A good understanding of how enterprise software works, including permissions, roles, integrations, admin versus end-user experiences, and multi-step workflows
  • Clear, concise writing with strong editorial judgment and the ability to edit your own work well
  • Familiarity with common style guides such as the Microsoft Writing Style Guide or the Google Developer Documentation Style Guide
  • Product thinking: you connect features to the real problems users are trying to solve, and you see content as part of the product experience
  • Comfort looking at support data like ticket trends and common failure points to guide your work
  • A sense of how the KB feeds into support tools, whether that's agent assist, chatbots, or AI assistants
  • Comfort working in agile cycles with shifting scope and tight turnarounds
  • A portfolio with published KB articles, release notes, or product UX copy
  • Hands-on experience with a content management system (CMS) for knowledge base or help center content, including publishing and review workflows, versioning, tagging or taxonomy setup, and managing content across draft, review, and published states
  • Hands-on experience writing API documentation, including endpoint references, request and response examples, authentication flows, error handling, and code snippets
  • Basic understanding of information architecture and how to structure content well

Nice to have

  • Writing experience in intranet, employee experience, collaboration, or productivity products
  • Exposure to Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS) or a similar way of running support content
  • Experience writing for or about AI and LLM features, including prompt guidance and content that AI can retrieve from cleanly
  • Comfort using AI tools responsibly in your own writing workflow, from drafting to editing
  • Some background in content design systems or terminology governance

What you'll get

  • Meaningful ownership from day one, with room to grow into content strategy and IA work
  • Mentorship from a senior IC on UX writing, content design, and information architecture
  • Direct partnership with support, product, and design teams
  • A predictable release cadence and clear delivery expectations
  • Visibility into how your work moves the metrics Support cares about

 

Your Voice, Unfiltered:

We value the real you. To ensure a fair and authentic experience for everyone, we ask that you do not use AI tools (such as real-time answer generators, transcription apps, or note-taking bots) during your interview

Our process is designed to hear your unique story, thought process, and lived experience in real-time. Use of unauthorized AI tools may result in disqualification, as we want to ensure every candidate is evaluated on their own individual merits. We’re excited to meet the person behind the resume!

If you need assistive technology or AI tools for accessibility (e.g., live captioning), please notify your recruiter in advance. We are committed to providing an inclusive interview experience.

At Simpplr we believe that when work is good, life is better and that belief guides all we do. Including how we approach our flexible work model. Simpplr operates with a Hub-Hybrid-Remote model. This model is role-based with exceptions and provides employees with the flexibility that many have told us they want.

Title: Associate Technical Writer (Remote Eligible - Costa Rica)
Description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

We are seeking an Associate Technical Writer to plan, develop, and maintain customer-facing content for the Smartsheet Help Center and internal product documentation. As an Associate Technical Writer, you own documentation quality across our product knowledge base — enabling customers, internal teams, and AI experiences to self-serve and reducing support and training burden. You have

  • Strong command of English language both oral and written (C1 and above)
  • Experience developing templates and processes for ensuring consistent delivery
  • Understanding of SEO and GEO best practices
  • Experience using analytics tools (Google Analytics, for example) to make impactful content decisions
  • A passion for technology and familiarity with the benefits and challenges of working on a SaaS product

  • Familiarity with video content production — scripting, screen recording, or light editing

  • Experience with content production, for example, moving a document from a draft stage in one tool and formatting and publishing it to a CMS

The ideal candidate combines strong program management expertise with experience working within a Legal environment, hands-on knowledge of Asana, familiarity with legal technology, and a passion for operational improvement and innovation.

  • Hands-on experience with Asana as a project and work management platform.

  • Demonstrated experience with process improvement and operational excellence methodologies.
  • Strong analytical skills, including experience developing KPIs and executive-level reporting.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across functions and levels.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced environment and managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience evaluating, implementing, or scaling AI-powered legal technology.

Title: Technical Product Manager II, Content Metadata
Description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

About the Role:

The Publishing group at the New York Times is responsible for the content management system for all of the Times: one that empowers development teams to build and evolve innovative experiences with speed and agility, and one that empowers editors and creators with a unified and interconnected suite of tools they can use with confidence to make the world's best journalism.

The Content Data Products Team at the New York Times is responsible for building and governing centralized, flexible platforms that serve as the definitive, compliance-cleared source for our content data. As the media landscape evolves, ensuring that our rich archive of journalism is seamlessly structured, fully attributed, and ready for next-generation platforms is a core priority. We are seeking a curious, collaborative, and analytical Technical Product Manager II to lead strategy and development for content metadata, focusing on attribution, taxonomy, and the development of a knowledge graph.

Content metadata plays a foundational role in The Times' AI strategy. As a Technical Product Manager II, you will own a vision for metadata systems that takes into account editorial needs and objectives, the requirements of our AI Platforms and Products group, Partnerships, differences across Times brands (News, Cooking, Wirecutter, The Athletic, and Games) and multimedia content types, and the requirements of our journalistic mission. You'll provide strategic direction for and oversee the execution of a product roadmap, leading a team of engineers. You'll report to the Senior Technical Product Manager, Content Data Products.

This is a hybrid role based in our New York City headquarters. You can typically expect to come into the office 2 days/week.

Responsibilities:

  • Own and drive the product strategy and roadmap for content metadata and taxonomy, including foundational work towards the development of a knowledge graph.
  • Partner with operations, legal, and cross-functional teams to map archival data structures, systematically identifying and addressing metadata gaps to improve the depth of our content catalog.
  • Collaborate with engineering, design, editorial/taxonomy teams, and the AI Platforms & Products mission to gather requirements & prioritize features.
  • Communicate product vision, strategy, and progress to partners and stakeholders.
  • Lead the product development lifecycle from conception to launch, ensuring timely delivery and high-quality results.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 3–5 years of experience in technical product management, metadata architecture, digital asset management/content management systems, or enterprise information systems.
  • Proven track record of successfully launching and managing complex software products.
  • Experience communicating complex technical concepts to a variety of audiences.
  • 3+ years of experience working with engineering teams
  • Understanding of SQL and an intuitive grasp of relational database architecture. Must be comfortable diving into database schemas to audit and understand data structure.
  • A proven track record of entering ambiguous cross-functional spaces, conducting independent research, interviewing diverse stakeholders, and defining technical requirements.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • A degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or Library/Information Science with a focus on Information Architecture or Taxonomy.
  • Proven experience managing data classification, complex metadata models, or combining disparate datasets across multiple systems.
  • Familiarity with knowledge graphs, semantic web concepts, or an active curiosity about how structured metadata powers modern search engines and AI features.
  • Experience working in an Agile environment

Title: Technical Writer
Description:
Voyager is an innovative space, defense, and national security technology company committed to advancing and delivering transformative, mission-critical solutions. We tackle the most complex challenges to unlock new frontiers for human progress, fortify national security, and protect critical assets to lead in the race for technological and operational superiority from ground to space. 

Forge the Future: Join Voyager Technologies 

The future belongs to those who build it. At Voyager Technologies, we’re building technologies that protect lives, expand frontiers and prepare us for what’s next. And we’re doing that with people who are wired to solve, build, adapt and lead. These roles are not for the faint of heart.  

You’ll help lay the foundation for humanity's future. Join a culture where innovation thrives, curiosity is rewarded, and impact is real. We’re a company of doers, thinkers and builders, united by purpose and grounded in reality. 

If you want to put your skills to work where the stakes are real and the mission is bigger than any one person, forge the future with Voyager. 

The Technical Writer for Voyager Energetics is responsible for creating, maintaining, and controlling a comprehensive library of regulatory, operational, and safety-critical documentation in support of energetics manufacturing operations.

The position reports to the Quality Manager and is part of the Quality Department based in Penrose, Colorado This role is onsite at Penrose, Colorado.

In this role, the essential functions are:

Documentation Development & Control

  • Author, revise, and maintain SOPs, work instructions, batch records, traveler documents, and process control documents for all energetic and non-energetic manufacturing operations.
  • Develop and update hazard analysis documents including Job Hazard Analyses (JHAs), Process Hazard Analyses (PHAs), and Explosive Safety Site Plans (ESSPs) in coordination with safety personnel.
  • Produce and revise Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS), Technical Data Packages (TDPs), and product specifications as required by customer or regulatory demand.

Quality System Support

  • Support the Quality Management System (QMS) by documenting quality procedures, nonconformance reports (NCRs), Corrective Action / Preventive Action (CAPA) records, and internal audit findings.
  • Collaborate with R&D Engineers, Production Engineers, Quality Engineers, and QA Inspectors to ensure documentation accurately reflects current validated processes in a standardized format.
  • Assist with creation and formatting of First Article Inspection Reports (FAIRs) and associated quality records.

Training Material Development

  • Develop and revise employee training materials, visual aids, and competency assessments covering explosive safety, handling procedures, PPE requirements, and regulatory compliance topics in a standardized format.
  • Coordinate with supervisors and subject matter experts to ensure training content accurately reflects current SOPs and regulatory requirements; maintain training records in coordination with HR and the Safety department.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Interface regularly with engineers, chemists, safety officers, quality personnel, and production supervisors to gather technical information and verify document accuracy.
  • Participate in document review cycles, incorporating feedback from cross-functional subject matter experts while maintaining document integrity and clarity.
  • Communicate document status, revision schedules, and compliance deadlines to department managers.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Technical Communication, English, Journalism, Chemistry, Engineering, or a related field; OR Associate's degree with a minimum of 4 years of directly relevant technical writing experience in a regulated manufacturing environment in lieu of a Bachelor's degree
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in technical writing within a manufacturing, defense, chemical, or similarly regulated industrial environment
  • Demonstrated experience writing SOPs, work instructions, or regulatory documentation in a compliance-driven setting
  • Exceptional written English communication skills; ability to produce clear, concise, and unambiguous technical prose
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio) and document management or controlled document software systems
  • Working knowledge of document control principles and revision history management
  • Must be a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident; must be able to pass a federal background investigation consistent with ATF and applicable DoD requirements (18 U.S.C. § 842)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior exposure to explosives, pyrotechnics, propellants, ammunition, or defense manufacturing
  • Familiarity with regulatory frameworks including ATF 27 CFR Part 555, DoD Explosives Safety standards (DoD 6055.09-M), OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119 (PSM), and GHS/HazCom requirements

Title: Senior Technical Writer / Senior Documentation Engineer
Description:
Role Overview

The Senior Documentation Engineer is the documentation authority for a value stream (department). You manage the documentation system, information architecture, AI workflows, quality standards, and strategic direction for your domain. Your documentation is vital for implementation teams and partners that integrate the Backbase software in the bank's software ecosystem. You actively seek out users' feedback and use it to improve the documentation and the documentation system.

Key Responsibilities

  • Documentation system: Manages the AI-powered documentation system that is based on docs-as-code and Git. Continuously improves the tools and processes and kills bottlenecks.
  • Documentation skills: Produces developer documentation and functional documentation with a clear separation in content types. Enforces writing style guidelines, terminology, templates, grammar, and spelling. Is hyperfocused on quality, seamless content flow, and avoiding bloat. Owns the information hierarchy of assigned documentation sets. Acts as a documentation authority within the value stream and advises teams on their documentation needs.
  • Technical and domain knowledge: Understands the readers' SDLC and how documentation plays a vital role in their work. Has a basic understanding of software development. Has a deep understanding of the products delivered by their value stream and can connect it to the wider Backbase platform. Quickly learns new functional domains and is able to interview R&D product managers to understand the product. Can converse easily with R&D developers to assess technical documentation needs or check technical details. Translates this technical and domain knowledge into effective instructions for AI-powered tools.
  • Legal and support terms: Understands the support terms and the legal impact of the documentation.
  • User advocate: Knows the target audience and their documentation needs and pain points. Translates this knowledge into strategic advice to the value stream leadership.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience: 4-10 years as a documentation specialist, technical writer, or equivalent, in the field of developer documentation.
  • Education: Either a Bachelor/Master's degree in software engineering/related field (combined with professional-level language proficiency) or university-level analytical skills (combined with professional-level language proficiency and a strong aptitude for technology)

General Competencies

Personal

  • Accountability: Tracks work items vigorously, routinely spots gaps and bugs and creates appropriate work items. Keeps their promises. Manages their calendar, inbox, messages, meetings, and office attendance as a professional.
  • Prioritization: Focuses on delivering customer value, responds quickly to user requests, divides time across release-related work, bug reports, and improvements.
  • Growth mindset: Seeks out learning opportunities, asks for feedback, asks questions, and helps others to learn and grow. Challenges decisions when they have a concern. Actively participates in group meetings and makes their voice heard during discussions. Suggests and leads improvement projects.

People

  • Stakeholder management: Communicates pro-actively, keeping managers and stakeholders actively updated. Raises issues with the appropriate team or leader. Follows-up with people. Suggests changes to value stream leaders and discusses their requests and suggestions as an equal.
  • Teams: Builds confidence and trust with their teams through reliability, predictability, and transparency of process and output. Models best behavior to fellow team members and holds them accountable for quality.
  • Collaboration: Establishes a fruitful collaboration with teams and fellow documentation engineers. Balances helping others and saying no. Practices active listening and clear communication. Focuses on problem solving. May coach and supervise less experienced team members.

Project Management

  • Process: Follows established processes and communicates these with their teams. Drives improvements to processes.
  • Projects: Oversees a large or complex documentation project with various stakeholders from beginning to end.

Title: Senior Manager, Website Content
Description:
Company Introduction

WorldStrides is the global leader in educational travel and experiential learning. The company was founded in 1967 to provide middle school travel programs to Washington, D.C. and has grown to provide a wide range of programs for more than half a million students annually to over 100 countries around the world. WorldStrides offers experiential learning programs in educational travel, performing arts, language immersion, career exploration, service-learning, study abroad, and sports. Each of these experiences helps students to see beyond the classroom and to see the world – and themselves – in new ways.

Job Description:

WorldStrides' website is our most important marketing asset — and it is underperforming as a lead generation tool. As Senior Manager of Website Content, you will own the content strategy and execution across worldstrides.com and all program sub-sites, transforming them into high-performing, SEO-driven, conversion-optimized destinations for educators, students, and parents. You will bring together editorial strategy, SEO expertise, UX sensibility, and project management rigor to build a website content engine that drives organic traffic, captures leads, and tells the WorldStrides story at every stage of the funnel. 

Responsibilities:

 Website Content Strategy 

  • Own the website content strategy across worldstrides.com and all program pages — from homepage messaging to destination content to conversion landing pages
  • Develop a segment-specific content architecture for K-12 Domestic, International, and Performing Arts that reflects each audience's distinct decision journey
  • Audit, prioritize, and systematically update existing content to improve quality, accuracy, SEO performance, and brand consistency 

 SEO & Organic Traffic Growth 

  • Own the SEO strategy — keyword research, content gap analysis, on-page optimization, and internal linking architecture
  • Build an editorial content calendar that supports organic search growth through destination guides, trip planning resources, and educator-focused content
  • Partner with Sr Manager, Paid Media to ensure landing pages convert paid traffic efficiently 

 CMS Management & Execution 

  • Manage the CMS day-to-day — publishing, updating, and A/B testing content across the site
  • Collaborate with Creative & Production on photography, video, and design assets for the site
  • Work with IT/Development on content improvements and UX enhancements
  • Maintain content governance — ensuring all published content is on-brand, accurate, and current 

 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE 

  • Organic search traffic growing quarter-over-quarter across all program areas
  • Website MQL conversion rate improving through content optimization and CRO
  • All program pages meeting brand and SEO quality standards within 6 months
  • Bounce rate and time-on-site improving across key landing pages 

Qualifications:

  • 5–7 years of website content strategy, digital content, or SEO experience
  • Demonstrated ability to own a website content program end-to-end from strategy to execution
  • Strong SEO expertise including technical SEO fundamentals, keyword research, and content optimization
  • Experience managing a CMS such as WordPress, Contentful, or similar platforms
  • Excellent writing and editing skills — you produce compelling, on-brand content yourself
  • Analytical — you use GA4, Search Console, and content performance data to make decisions  
  • Experience in education, travel, or destination marketing content (preferred)
  • UX or CRO background — you have run A/B tests and interpreted user behavior data (preferred)
  • Familiarity with Salesforce or HubSpot for understanding web-to-CRM lead flow (preferred)

Work Perks

  • Comprehensive health benefits: medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, accident, critical illness, disability insurance, FSA/HSA options with employer HSA contributions, and a generous 401(k) match.
  • Generous paid time off including 11 paid company holidays, 25 PTO days the first year (prorated), 1 paid volunteer day, 4 mental health days, and bereavement
  • Professional development support, including up to $5,250 annually for tuition reimbursement and up to $1,000 for certifications annually
  • Opportunities for paid and discounted travel
  • Flexible work schedule providing on-site, remote, and hybrid office opportunities
  • Encouraged participation in a wide variety of Employee Resource Groups
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and wellness resources, including fitness centers at select locations
  • Paid parental, caregiver, and disability leave
  • Team Member Discount Program
  • Engaging, collaborative, and fun work environment

Compensation Range

Title: Head of Developer Experience
Description: Application demands are rapidly changing while the experience to design and operate infrastructure is rapidly diminishing. A new platform abstraction is needed to support agentic development, agentic applications, and an entirely new set of application workloads. We think Convex is the team and platform best placed to define this abstraction. Convex works differently from the tools people are used to. The right way to build with it isn't always obvious, and increasingly the developer learning it is an agent rather than a person. Helping people and their agents make sense of something this new is still the domain of very talented humans, and we want you to be one of them. The Team: Convex has assembled a team of engineers who have built and designed some of the largest platforms in the world, with exabytes of data, millions of transactions per second, and shipped desktop and mobile software onto billions of devices. We are a group of friendly, collaborative, and passionate people who love working in-person together in our office in San Francisco. We hire primarily in SF but have a few experienced folks working remotely in certain situations. The Role: We're looking for a Head of Developer Experience to own how developers and agents become great at building on Convex. You'll set the strategy, hold the point of view, and lead the team behind it. The docs, the writing, the developer narrative, and the advocacy your team takes to the community all flow from one thing: a real understanding of the product and a clear opinion on how people should build on it. Some weeks you'll go deep with the engineering team on something we just shipped and turn it into docs a developer, or the agent writing their code, can pick up easily. Other weeks you'll step back to decide what story we're telling developers this quarter, where the docs are falling short, and what your team should focus on next. The best person for this is someone who's genuinely excited to move between all of it. What You'll Do: Set the strategy and point of view for how developers and agents learn to be successful on Convex. Lead and grow the developer experience team, and build out documentation as a function over time. Own the Convex docs and the information architecture behind them, ensuring that Convex stays legible from a developer's first day to their most expert work, for humans and agents alike. Craft the writing and developer narrative that shape how people understand Convex, from our blog to the way we explain what we ship. Work closely with engineering and the founders to turn what we build into things people can learn from. What Excites Us: You've written developer docs or technical content that real developers relied on, and you have the work to show for it. You've led a team before, ideally one doing developer-facing or content work, and know how to grow people and help them do their best work. You can code, or read it closely enough to keep every example honest. Genuine interest in how AI is changing the way software gets built, and a point of view on what developers and their agents need. Interest in working in-person at Convex's office in SF. Ideal Characteristics This is an attempt to outline some characteristics of people who tend to thrive at Convex. We have a high demand for deep thinking and clear communication, while also having the typical demands of a small startup. Can they actually write? Writing is the heart of this job. We're not looking for someone who can produce serviceable copy, but someone who can take something complicated and make it clear, with a structure that scans and a point of view that sticks. It's the rarest thing we're looking for and the hardest to fake. Do they have a point of view? The best developer content and the best developer experience both come from someone who has a clear idea of what good looks like and pushes for it. We want someone who can look at how developers build on Convex today, form a strong opinion about how they should, and then build the docs, the writing, and the team to make that real. Can they go deep technically? You don't have to be the strongest engineer in the room, but you do have to engage seriously with the technical material and earn the team's trust. Convex is genuinely deep, and hand-waving doesn't survive contact with a skeptical developer. It shouldn't survive contact with you first. Can they build and lead a team? This is a leadership role, so a big part of the job is getting great work out of other people, not just producing it yourself. That means hiring well, giving people real ownership, developing their judgment, and caring more about what the team ships than what you could have written on your own. The best leaders we've worked with are the ones who make everyone around them better. Do they value simplicity and pragmatism? We have a bias toward doing fewer things better. A lot of this job is telling what actually matters apart from what's merely nice to have, pointing the team at the former, and shipping it rather than polishing forever. It's a startup, and knowing what to leave undone matters as much as knowing what to build. Do they bring energy to the room? Startups are hard. Building something from nothing is hard. Driving forward progress despite uncertainty is hard. Shitting on stuff is easy and just brings everyone else down. We have a high bar for quality but also a high bar for being constructive, positive, and excited about making things better. We're meant to be having fun here. * The salary range for this full-time position is > $250,000 + equity + benefits

Title: Senior Product Designer, Content Design & Language Systems
Description: Artificial Intelligence. Actual Impact. At Docebo, we’re using AI to change how people learn at work—and we mean actually change it. We’re an AI-powered learning platform that helps organizations create, deliver, and manage training all in one place. But our real mission goes deeper: we help teams move faster, work smarter, and focus on the work that truly matters. Our platform is built with intelligent, time-saving tools that personalize learning, eliminate busywork, and turn training from a checkbox into a superpower. The result? Better experiences for learners and real results for businesses. We’re shaping the future of learning with a team that isn’t afraid to challenge the status quo. If you're excited by the idea of using AI to make work-life better for real people–you’ll feel right at home here. And it’s not just what we build, it’s how we show up. At Docebo, our values aren’t just posters on the wall—they guide how we work every day. We call it the Docebo Heart : trust by default, assume positive intent, and create space for different perspectives to thrive. So… what are you waiting for? Join 900+ Docebians around the world and help us reinvent the way people learn, because learning never stops. The Adventure Ahead 🚀 As a Senior Product Designer, Content Design & Language Systems , you’ll lead ambiguous product problems where workflow, interaction, information architecture, and language need to work together. You’ll help make Docebo’s complex enterprise experiences clearer, more consistent, and easier to use for admins, creators, managers, and learners. This is not a traditional UX writing role or a localization-operations role. You’ll be a hands-on Product Designer who shapes product behaviour as well as product language. You’ll design complete workflows, build reusable terminology and content patterns, improve AI review and confidence experiences, and embed language guidance into our design system and delivery practices. You’ll shape problems before solutions are fixed, choose appropriate discovery and validation methods, and connect customer evidence, product data, business context, technical constraints, accessibility, and localization risk to clear product decisions. You’ll partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, UX Research, Elemental / Design System, Accessibility, Technical Writing / Localization, AI teams, and other Product Designers—building a shared quality capability without becoming a bottleneck or approval queue. The Day-to-Day 💻 Frame Ambiguous Workflow and Language Problems: Turn incomplete or conflicting inputs into clear problem statements, hypotheses, decision questions, and an actionable path to learning. Lead Discovery and Define Outcomes: Select appropriate research and validation methods; combine customer evidence, product analytics, business context, technical constraints, and localization insight to establish measurable success signals and visible trade-offs. Design Complete Product Workflows: Lead interaction, information-architecture, and content decisions across roles, permissions, states, edge cases, accessibility, responsive behaviour, errors, confirmations, approvals, and recovery. Build Docebo’s Product Language System: Establish terminology, product voice and tone, reusable microcopy patterns, audience guidance, and language principles that improve clarity across product areas. Design Trustworthy AI Moments: Create patterns that help people understand what AI did, what informed it, what needs attention, and how to review, edit, regenerate, approve, reverse, or recover. Embed Guidance into Product Systems: Partner with Elemental / Design System to create component-level guidance, default strings, usage examples, do-and-don’t guidance, and reusable quality checks. Design for Localization Readiness: Own product-side standards for translation-ready writing, terminology reuse, variables and placeholders, language previews, and localization constraints while partnering with Technical Writing / Localization on operational workflows. Prototype and Audit with AI-Assisted Methods: Use appropriate-fidelity prototypes and AI-assisted workflows to explore product behaviour, evaluate alternatives, audit language, and assess usability and technical feasibility before significant implementation investment. Partner Through Shipped Quality: Work closely with Engineering on implementation strategy, design QA, product polish, and post-release iteration using customer feedback and product evidence. Create Reusable Leverage: Turn repeated workflow and language needs into patterns, assets, documentation, terminology, prompts, or practices that improve more than one feature. Mentor and Facilitate: Help designers and cross-functional partners build stronger product-language judgment through critique, decision reviews, workshops, concise documentation, and practical guidance. Your Superpowers 🦸‍♀️ Your portfolio shows ownership of complex, ambiguous workflows or significant product-area work with visible customer and product impact—not only writing samples You can explain how you triangulated qualitative research, quantitative evidence, business risk, localization considerations, and technical constraints You demonstrate strong interaction, visual, information-architecture, content-design, accessibility, and product-language judgment across difficult states and edge cases You have created or contributed to product-language systems, terminology frameworks, component guidance, content pattern libraries, or other reusable product standards You show how prototypes, experiments, audits, or validation changed product direction before or after release You can define meaningful outcomes, distinguish signal from activity, and explain what the team learned after launch You have influenced Product and Engineering decisions early, managed disagreement constructively, and stayed accountable through implementation quality You understand how product language must work across design systems and languages, including translation readiness, terminology reuse, variables, layout constraints, and inclusive communication You use AI-assisted tools thoughtfully for research, synthesis, language exploration, prototyping, quality review, or implementation critique while retaining human judgment and accountability You have helped other designers or cross-functional partners build stronger judgment through mentorship, critique, facilitation, and practical guidance Bonus Points 🌟 Experience designing language and interaction patterns for AI-assisted, agentic, recommendation, conversational, generated-output, or automation workflows Experience with localization tooling and practices such as Lokalise, terminology management, localization previews, translation-quality review, or localization-to-codebase workflows Contributions to design systems, accessibility maturity, product-language systems, research practices, or reusable interaction patterns Experience with enterprise learning, HR technology, content authoring, analytics, knowledge management, administration, or skills platforms Practical experiments with tools such as Codex or similar systems—for AI-assisted audits, product-language linting, prompt packs, prototypes, plugins, scripts, or app-level language guidance—that show you learn by making Our Interview Process 🗺️ Step 1: A 30-minute video call with a member of our Talent team. We’ll get to know you, share more about the role and team, and confirm that we’re aligned. Step 2: A 45–60-minute conversation with the hiring manager focused on your experience, approach, and what interests you about the opportunity. Step 3: A 60-minute portfolio deep dive and collaborative case discussion focused on complex workflow ownership, content and interaction decisions, reusable systems, evidence, craft, and measurable learning or impact. Step 4: A final conversation focused on product-area influence, mentorship, values alignment, and cross-functional decision making. Our Hybrid Work Philosophy 🤝 Great work can happen anywhere but coming together helps us go further. Our team spends three days a week in the office (Tuesday-Thursday) to collaborate, solve problems, and learn from each other. With flexibility the rest of the week, it’s a balance designed to help everyone do their best work and keep growing. Our Total Rewards Philosophy 🎉 Our Total Rewards Philosophy centers around three core areas to reward and care for our People: Rewarding Impact: We lead with competitive pay to reward the impact, skills and traits that fuel our success. Fostering Holistic Wellbeing: We care deeply about and invest in the whole person with programs that support our people’s physical, mental, and financial well-being. Empowering Our Talent Culture: We build a culture of trust and empowerment by designing our rewards and benefits with transparency, equity, and flexibility, enabling our people to do their best work and stay for the long haul. Our Promise to You 😍 Financial Wellness: Own a piece of Docebo through our Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP) at a 15% discount, plus a competitive compensation package. Your Well-Being, Covered: You’ll get access to health benefits, so you can get the care you need when you need it. Rest, Relax, Repeat: Rest and recharge with paid vacation days, two company-wide Docebo Days, floating holidays for cultural celebrations, and your birthday off! Family First : We provide coverage offering you time with your little one(s) so you can soak up all those precious moments. Fun fact: we had 30 Docebian babies join the family in 2025! Fuel for Your Day: Receive a meal voucher for every working day, so you can focus on doing your best work while enjoying a meal that keeps you energized. Connections That Count: Connect with global communities through our Employee Resource Groups (including PRIDE, DWA, BIDOC, and Green Ambassadors) and company-wide events that keep the fun rolling all year long.

Title: Senior Technical Writer (Remote)
Description: Who We Are Having surpassed $300M ARR and continuing to grow, Optro helps enterprises transform risk into opportunity through its AI-powered GRC Intelligence Platform. More than 50% of the Fortune 500, including 7 of the Fortune 10, leverage our award-winning technology to move their businesses forward with greater clarity and agility. And our customers love us: Optro is top-rated on G2.com and Gartner Peer Insights. At Optro, we inspire each other to innovate and are proud of what we are producing. We spend each day thinking of new ways to help our customers and contribute to the greater good of our company and our surrounding communities. We are all about assisting each other and breaking through barriers to create the most loved audit, risk, ESG, and InfoSec platform by our customers. This is how we have become one of the 500 fastest-growing tech companies in North America for the seventh year in a row, as ranked by Deloitte! Why This Role is Exciting As a Technical Writer at Optro, you will play a key role in ensuring our customer- and developer-facing content is clear, accurate, and delivered on a reliable cadence. You will work closely with Product, Engineering & Design (PED) teams and cross-functional stakeholders to produce high-quality documentation and content — with a strong emphasis on using AI tooling to streamline and scale how content is collected, drafted, and published. Key Responsibilities Content Ownership Collaborate with Product teams and other stakeholders to draft, edit, and publish accurate, well-structured product content on a reliable cadence. Own and continuously improve an AI-assisted workflow for collecting source material, drafting, and preparing content for publication — in accordance with Optro's data handling and usage guidelines — while maintaining ownership of accuracy, tone, and final quality. Maintain well-structured, easily navigable content so users can quickly find what they need. Process & Systems Improvement Strengthen foundational content structure, information architecture, and terminology to reduce friction for the people who rely on it. Build reusable resources — style guides, templates, and contribution workflows — that enable others to contribute content at scale, rather than relying on a single owner for all output. Continuously evolve content and structure to keep pace with how the business and its users actually operate. Cross-Functional Collaboration Collaborate with stakeholders such as product managers, engineers, product marketing, and support teams to gather information and ensure content consistently and accurately reflects new features and changes. Identify documentation and process gaps and propose improvements — including opportunities for further automation. What Success Looks Like: First 120 Days Learn the existing content processes end-to-end, including current sources of manual effort (research, verification, coordination, and publication). Design and stand up an AI-tooling-supported workflow for collecting source material, drafting content, and streamlining the path to publication. Pilot the new workflow against at least one live cycle, incorporating feedback and refining based on real results. Document the new process so it's repeatable, scalable, and sustainable beyond the initial build. Attributes for a Successful Candidate 5+ years of experience as a technical writer or technical support role with a writing component in a B2B SaaS or similar technical environment Excellent written and verbal communication skills Demonstrated experience building or improving repeatable processes and scalable workflows, ideally within a documentation, content, or operations context Experience working within documentation systems, style guides, or content standards — and a strong instinct for consistency and quality Solid understanding of Knowledge Base & CMS tools A bias toward proposing and driving solutions, not just surfacing pain points or blockers — this role requires ownership through to resolution An entrepreneurial mindset — you're energized by building and are comfortable navigating ambiguity Nice to Have Domain knowledge of the Governance, Risk and Compliance space Experience or strong interest in using AI tools to improve writing and content workflows Familiarity with Agile or Scrum methodologies Familiarity with HTML and CSS Perks (United States) Launch a career at one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in North America and EMEA! Title: Technical Writer - PostgreSQL
Description: We are looking for a talented and flexible Technical Writer to join one of our distributed open-source software development teams. You will work on the PostgreSQL database and related components, in close collaboration with our dedicated PostgreSQL team. Percona Distribution for PostgreSQL brings together essential enterprise components from the broader PostgreSQL open-source community into a single, integrated distribution designed and tested to ensure compatibility. You will represent our voice to our technical customers and provide complete, clear documentation for our PostgresSQL products . We seek someone committed to delivering consistent, high-quality, and on-time documentation, whether in the form of guides, user manuals, help files, or man pages. You should be comfortable working in version-controlled environments, as we adopt a docs-as-code methodology. You will be embedded in the PostgreSQL team, but also working alongside the Product Documentation team, which comprises several technical writers dedicated to developing a scalable documentation strategy that drives user adoption and effective use of our products. You are expected to collaborate with the other writers as we aim to continuously improve our practices. Location/time zone Remote work from home. Open to worldwide candidates, but the team median is UTC-2, so we recommend candidates operate within +/- 4 hours of this baseline. What you will do Create all technical documentation from install/configuration/troubleshooting guides, how-tos, user manuals, man pages, to --help prompts Participate in team ceremonies. Collaborate with the Engineering Manager, Product Manager, Devs, and QA to output high-quality documentation Use text, markdown, images, and diagrams to ensure that audiences of all experience levels can extract value from our documentation Leverage AI tooling to quickly draft, polish, format, and refine content Maintain documentation versioning and be a contributor to our overall documentation strategy Your experience Graduate-level written English and excellent verbal communication skills Experience with documenting complex systems and writing user-oriented documentation 3+ years of experience as a technical writer and ability to write high-quality and precise documentation Experience with markup languages (Markdown preferred) Experience with the installation and configuration of database server software on Linux Docs-as-code experience. Knowledge of Jenkins, git, Markdown, HTML, and/or JavaScript (strongly recommended) Experience in leveraging AI tooling for documentation purposes Comfortable with Linux command line Distributed system development and/or database server development Fluent in developer tools like git, gcc, gdb Working autonomously in a globally distributed organization Collaborating with open source communities and colleagues via mailing lists, Slack, etc. Using collaboration/tracking tools like Jira/Notion Proven success working in a distributed environment Quick learner and great team player What will (really) make you stand out A developer or DevOps background Having a track record of contributing to PostgreSQL or other open source projects. Being an active member of the PostgreSQL community A solid understanding of PostgreSQL internals to write accurate content to potentially contribute upstream A solid working knowledge of advanced concepts such as database storage engines, at-rest encryption, and cloud orchestration Ability to build and maintain automated documentation testing, CI/CD pipelines for documentation process, and validation tools Experienced conference speaker, technical blog writer, active on public forums or mailing lists Communication, travel, and remote collaboration Percona is a globally distributed, remote-first organization that values active communication and collaboration. While working from your home office, it's important to engage openly and proactively with your team. We promote lively discussions, idea sharing, and transparent work updates. To foster a strong team environment, we depend on consistent communication via tools like Slack, Zoom, and Jira, which keep us connected, aligned, and supportive across different time zones. Although travel isn't always necessary, there may occasionally be opportunities for conferences or in-person meetups to strengthen relationships and ensure strategic alignment. Working environment, planning, and growth At Percona, we prioritize a structured work environment to support your focus and flow. We organize our tasks within specific timeframes and scopes, minimizing shifting priorities to allow you to concentrate on assigned tasks. This planning process is collaborative, involving the entire team, Product, and customer insights. Professional growth is a focus for us, as we designate Fridays as no-meeting days. This provides us dedicated time for deep work, tackling challenging issues, or exploring new technologies. Typical day as a technical writer in the PostgreSQL team at Percona Morning (flexible, as you own your schedule): Start your day by checking Slack, email, and Jira for updates. Focus on writing tasks: new features, guides, bug fixes, and release notes for PostgreSQL and related tools. Respond to open and outstanding requests if needed. Mid-day: Lunch break and casual Slack interactions. Resume writing, attend technical discussions (if scheduled), planning sessions, or join a brief team sync (Zoom). Afternoon: Continue focusing on writing tasks. Reply to questions on the forum, draft blog posts or contribute to upstream documentation. Research and learn new technologies. Plan for the next day and wrap up tasks. Key points Expect regular communication through Slack, Zoom, and Jira. Active engagement in team rituals is a must. Continuous learning and problem-solving are fundamental to the role. Work hours are flexible, around scheduled team syncs or customer meetings. We don’t micromanage your tasks; instead, we hire you for your expertise and capacity to deliver high-quality documentation. <!--WEB-ONLY--> Why Percona? At Percona, we believe an open world is a better world. Our mission is to enable everyone to innovate freely, by providing the best open source database software, support, and services. We make databases and applications run better through a unique combination of expertise and open source software built with the community for you. Our technical teams are experts in MySQL, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and MariaDB. Percona is proud to be a remote-only and globally dispersed workforce – we have colleagues in more than 50 countries! We offer a collaborative, highly-engaged culture where your ideas are welcome and your voice is heard. Our staff receives generous benefits including flexible work hours and various paid time off programs, all your equipment for your remote office, funds for career development (external training, certifications, conferences), ongoing connectivity allowances, and the opportunity to participate in our equity incentive plan. We also have benefits that support a healthy work/life balance such as The Percona Adventure Team, Work-from-Anywhere, FlowDays, FryDays, and overall flexibility. We also support being socially responsible through our PAVE volunteering program and Women Transforming Technology. If you love the idea of working with a high-growth tech company that is one of the best in the business and known globally as a leader in the open-source database space, let’s talk! Connect with us and stay up to date on our latest news and developments by following us on LinkedIn and Twitter . We look forward to connecting with you!

Knowledge of Jenkins, git, Markdown, HTML, and/or JavaScript (strongly recommended) Experience in leveraging AI tooling for documentation purposes Comfortable with Linux command line Distributed system development and/or database server development Fluent in developer tools like git, gcc, gdb Working autonomously in a globally distributed organization Collaborating with open source communities and colleagues via mailing lists, Slack, etc. Using collaboration/tracking tools like Jira/Notion Proven success working in a distributed environment Quick learner and great team player What will (really) make you stand out A developer or DevOps background Having a track record of contributing to PostgreSQL or other open source projects. Although travel isn't always necessary, there may occasionally be opportunities for conferences or in-person meetups to strengthen relationships and ensure strategic alignment. This planning process is collaborative, involving the entire team, Product, and customer insights. Professional growth is a focus for us, as we designate Fridays as no-meeting days. This provides us dedicated time for deep work, tackling challenging issues, or exploring new technologies. Focus on writing tasks: new features, guides, bug fixes, and release notes for PostgreSQL and related tools. Respond to open and outstanding requests if needed. Title: Developer Experience Engineer
Description: What You'll Do You'll own the entire developer experience function. This means doing absolutely everything to do with developer experience, including: Developer Success: You'll be in all customer Slack channels as the frontline to help answer their questions and solve their problems. You'll give them advice on best practices for integrating with our API, and provide thoughtful support when they get stuck or need advice. Technical Writing: You'll develop high-quality sample code, documentation, and technical demos to improve the developer experience. Product: You'll chat with our customers to deeply understand what they need. You'll advocate for them by communicating their feedback to the rest of the team. You'll be the person we lean on when we build out self-serve developer flows, and optimize our products and developer resources for agents. Internal Tools and Workflows: You’ll build tools to make our debugging processes more efficient and triaging less time consuming. You’ll have full agency to add new tools and processes as needed to help our customers to be more successful, faster. And Other Things: Rarely, you may need to join sales calls as a technical resource, contribute to a technical marketing blog post, etc. Most of the developer experience work will be post-sales. This means that at the moment, this role doesn't involve speaking at tech conferences or writing a ton of marketing content. What It Will Be Like Huge impact. You'll have a major role in building a culture centered around customer empathy. You get to build the foundations of the company and developer experience. No bureaucracy. You’ll own and drive every initiative you work on from start to finish. We fully trust you. Massive growth opportunities. And not just on the technical/customer-facing side. Anything you want to learn about the business we’ll teach you. Your Qualifications Deep customer empathy, including the desire to help people and solve their problems Strong ability to communicate complex technical topics in a simple and understandable way 2-3 years of software development experience Who You Are You want to work hard. As a founding member of the team, there is a lot of work that needs to be done. Self-starter who finds excitement in building a function from scratch Passionate about being a founding startup member Feels fulfillment in helping others Not afraid to do things that have never been done before Enjoys speaking with customers Who is this not a fit for? You can’t work hard right now. Being one of the first developer experience engineers at a startup is going to be a lot of work. The entire company is less than 30 people, and this will likely the hardest job you've ever had. You need a stability. As a fast growing startup with 1000+ customers and 10+ years of runway, we're in a pretty good spot. However, startups are inherently risky. If stability is important to you, this founding role may not be the right fit. You’re not excited about helping developers. You won’t be able to succeed at this role unless you love our customers and want to truly help them in whatever way possible. Our Company Culture (Why you may or may not be excited about joining us) Raw hours make a difference Working too many hours doesn't guarantee success, but working too few leads to failure. We expect everyone to put in their best effort every day, but we generally don't expect you to work late evenings or on weekends. We are careful to avoid burnout, but we also don't want to sugarcoat the fact that raw hours can make a huge difference in a startup. Customer obsession We would be nothing without our customers, and we believe being obsessed about our customers is a competitive advantage. Every single member of the team at Recall responds to customers, helps them debug issues, and deeply understands our customer's goals, even outside of Recall. The easiest way to obsess over our customers is to genuinely care about as humans, which naturally turns into the desire to want to help them. What we offer Competitive equity Computer and workspace enhancements Unlimited vacation Quarterly company off-sites with the team and explore exciting destinations around the world Opportunity to take on significant responsibility and ownership in building out Recall
