Title: Technical Writer
Description: Xona is the navigational intelligence company bringing real-time, centimeter-level certainty to any device, anywhere on Earth. With Pulsar – the world’s most advanced PNT satellite infrastructure in Low Earth Orbit – Xona will offer a future-proof, backwards-compatible global positioning system optimized for absolute precision, superior power, and robust protection. Overview : As our first Technical Writer , you'll be embedded with the program team and support engineering, launch, and manufacturing across the company - from satellite development documentation to launch campaign packages to documentation standards for the production floor. This is a cross-functional role that touches every part of how we build, test, launch, and operate spacecraft. Success in this role looks like: Engineering review packages are delivered on schedule with minimal revision cycles Launch documentation is complete, tracked, and delivered on schedule New team members can readily find relevant documentation Documentation standards you help establish scale as the team grows What You'll do: Engineering Documentation Support engineering teams across bus, payload, Guidance Navigation & Control (GNC), Flight Software (FSW), and subsystems in producing and maintaining technical documents including Interface Control Documents (ICDs), test procedures, design specs, and review packages. You'll attend design reviews and work directly with engineers to extract technical details and translate them into clear, accurate, and actionable documentation. Launch Documentation Management Own the organization, tracking, and on-time delivery of launch campaign documentation - including launch readiness review packages, mission assurance documentation, range safety submissions, and pre/post-launch reports. Coordinate with program, safety, and range/launch provider teams to make sure every required document is complete, routed for approval, and submitted against the campaign timeline. Contract Documentation Generate, edit, and maintain contract deliverable documentation - including reports, data packages, and compliance documents - ensuring accuracy and timely delivery against contractual requirements. Mission Operations Develop and maintain team Service Level Agreement (SLA) definitions with other teams like Service Operations and satellite subsystems, document escalation paths, and system configurations to support reliable on-orbit operations and ground system management. Maintain documentation supporting regulatory compliance (e.g., FCC/NOAA licensing, Orbital Debris Mitigation plans). Document Control Help establish and maintain the organization, versioning, and accessibility of technical documentation - making sure the right people can find the right document at the right time. As our first writer, you'll play a key role in selecting and setting up systems that work for our team. Cross-Site Coordination Work across geographically distributed engineering and manufacturing teams to ensure documentation stays consistent, synchronized, and accessible across sites. Some travel between sites may be required. Work Instructions & SOPs Build and maintain templates for manufacturing work instructions and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and review content drafted by engineers and technicians against those templates for clarity and consistency. Subject matter experts own the technical content - your role is giving it a clear, standardized structure. Process Building Develop lightweight documentation standards and templates that scale as the company and program grow. Required 4–7 years of technical writing experience in aerospace, defense, hardware manufacturing, or a similarly technical field Comfortable working directly with engineers to extract technical content and translate it into clean, usable documentation - ICDs, test procedures, design specs, and review packages Proven ability to build clear documentation templates and review technical content for accuracy, clarity, and consistency Self-directed and able to manage multiple documentation workstreams simultaneously in a fast-moving environment Comfortable asking questions when requirements are unclear - we value clarity over assumptions Preferred Experience documenting spacecraft, satellite, or precision hardware development programs Experience managing documentation through a launch campaign or similarly high-stakes, deadline-driven review cycle Experience supporting program reviews such as Preliminary Design Review (PDR), Critical Design Review (CDR), or Manufacturing Readiness Review (MRR) with documentation packages Proficiency with documentation tools such as Confluence, Google Workspace, or similar Familiarity with manufacturing work instructions, SOPs, or quality management systems Interest in growing into a documentation lead or program management role as the team scales For U.S. Roles: To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the United States (i.e. Green Card holder), or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3). For U.K. Roles: To comply with U.K. regulations, this role requires Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) checks, and successful candidates must be eligible to obtain UK Security Clearance (SC). For Canada Roles: Successful candidates must obtain and hold a security clearance at the reliability status level, and pass security assessment for the Canadian Controlled Goods Program (CGP) and ITAR. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Maintains current knowledge of relevant cyber security and related technologies Serve as a technical Cyber SME, onsite task lead, and primary point of contact for customer. Hungry - Be Eager.Our hunger for excellence drives an insatiable appetite for innovation and continuous improvement, propelling us forward in the face of new and unprecedented challenges. Title: Associate Technical Writer
Description: About Hevo: Hevo is a no-code Data Pipeline platform trusted by 1,000+ companies globally, including Postman, Shopify, Doordash and Gartner. Backed by $42M from Peak XV Partners and Chiratae Ventures, we power the data infrastructure of companies that move fast. We are consistently rated #1 on G2 in the ETL and Data Integration category (4.5+ rating) and are a Snowflake Premier Partner. Our product is in the market, loved by customers, and now entering its next growth phase. With 600+ US customers already on the platform and a product that has matured significantly over the last two years, this is the ground-floor moment. Before the team scales, before the brand becomes obvious. The upside is real and uncapped. About the Role: We're looking for an Associate Technical Writer who's comfortable working in a docs-as-code environment and can partner with AI tools (e.g., Claude) for all aspects of the work — not just writing, but operating within an automated documentation pipeline. This is an opportunity to own documentation end-to-end within a modern, AI-assisted workflow, working closely with engineering, product, and support stakeholders to keep a shared source of truth accurate and consistent. What You'll Do: Create and maintain user documentation using a docs-as-code workflow — Markdown/YAML source files, Git-based version control, and CI-driven publishing (e.g., Jekyll). Independently own small documentation tickets and projects end-to-end, from research through PR merge. Use AI-assisted tools (Claude or equivalent) to draft, summarize, restructure, or QA content, while critically reviewing and editing AI output rather than publishing it as-is. Conduct research and gather technical information from product specs, engineering discussions, and existing docs to fill knowledge gaps. Follow and help enforce documentation standards, style guides, and metadata conventions (e.g., structured fields for error messages, FHS-style rule sets) across a shared source of truth. Work in Git-based workflows: branching, raising PRs, responding to review comments, and triggering automation for doc builds/publishing. Collaborate with engineering, product, and support stakeholders to validate technical accuracy before publishing. Flag ambiguous, unverified, or inferred content rather than publishing unconfirmed information. What We're Looking For: Strong written English and ability to simplify technical concepts for end users. Basic familiarity with Markdown, Git (clone/branch/commit/PR), and a willingness to use docs-as-code tooling. Comfort using AI writing/review tools as part of a daily workflow (prompting, verifying, editing output), including the ability to create and manage Claude skills. Ability to read and interpret product UI, API docs, or basic YAML/JSON structures well enough to document them. Detail-oriented, especially around consistency (terminology, tone, formatting) across a large, distributed content set. 0-2 years of experience in technical writing, content, or a related field; internships or academic writing experience acceptable. Bonus Points: Exposure to a ticketing/PM tool (Jira, Confluence) and Slack-based collaboration. Intermediate AI skills creation.

Title: IT Support and Governance Specialist Consultant
Description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a IT Support and Governance Specialist Consultant based in Brazil. As an IT Support and Governance Specialist Consultant, you will help organizations design and implement effective models for application and IT service support. The role combines technical expertise, service management, governance, and process improvement to strengthen operational continuity and service quality. You will assess existing support models, identify risks and bottlenecks, and translate findings into practical improvements. The position involves establishing ITIL and COBIT-based processes, service structures, SLAs, responsibilities, controls, and operational indicators. You will also evaluate applications, integrations, monitoring capabilities, documentation, and operational readiness during transitions into support. The role offers an opportunity to work closely with technical teams, business stakeholders, and suppliers in complex technology environments. This is a fully remote consulting opportunity suited to a senior professional who combines hands-on technical knowledge with strong governance and communication skills. Accountabilities: Diagnose existing application and IT service support models, identifying risks, bottlenecks, operational gaps, and opportunities for improvement across processes, applications, integrations, and suppliers. Design and implement processes for incident, problem, request, change, and knowledge management based on ITIL and COBIT practices. Structure service catalogs, service levels, responsibility matrices, SLAs, escalation mechanisms, and other elements required for effective IT service management. Assess applications and integrations for documentation quality, monitoring capabilities, failure management, supportability, and operational readiness. Define operational readiness, acceptance, knowledge-transfer, and stabilization criteria for transitioning projects and solutions into ongoing support. Establish operational indicators, controls, governance routines, and monitoring mechanisms for internal teams and technology suppliers. Validate support models through pilots and assisted implementations, supporting teams during adoption and stabilization. Deliver practical processes, procedures, controls, and performance indicators that can be incorporated into day-to-day operations. Establish clear boundaries between support, corrective activities, enhancements, and projects, ensuring effective coordination between support, development, infrastructure, and suppliers. Ensure traceability of operational activities and decisions in alignment with governance, security, compliance, and audit requirements. Structure knowledge-management and continuity mechanisms to reduce dependency on individual employees and improve organizational resilience. Formalize the transition of support models to internal teams, including documentation, outstanding items, responsibilities, and continuous-improvement plans. Facilitate workshops, knowledge-transfer sessions, and team training to support successful implementation and adoption. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. Senior-level experience in application support and in implementing or improving IT service management processes. Applied knowledge of ITIL and COBIT, including experience defining responsibilities, SLAs, controls, processes, and operational indicators. Strong technical understanding of enterprise applications, APIs, integrations, and databases. Ability to analyze application logs, perform SQL queries, and contribute to technical troubleshooting and root-cause analysis. Experience with incident and problem management, root-cause analysis, production changes, and transitions from project delivery into ongoing support. Experience working with ITSM tools and collaborating with technical teams, business stakeholders, and external suppliers. Ability to facilitate workshops, document processes clearly, and take a hands-on approach to implementation and team enablement. Strong communication, organization, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders. Experience in critical or regulated environments is a plus. Knowledge of observability, SRE, DevOps, and operational automation is desirable. Experience with ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, BusinessMap, or equivalent ITSM/process-management platforms is an advantage. ITIL, COBIT, or related service-management and IT governance certifications are a plus. Benefits Fully remote work model. Meal allowance. Food allowance. Monthly home-office allowance. Medical insurance. Dental insurance. Life insurance. Birthday day off. TotalPass / Wellhub access. Access to health and well-being services through a dedicated health platform. Discounts and partnerships with businesses and educational institutions. Welcome kit. Structured onboarding program. Access to professional learning and development initiatives. Internal knowledge-sharing and learning activities. Ongoing career and technical development opportunities. Support initiatives focused on employee well-being and professional growth. Title: Technical Writer
Description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Writer based in India. This role offers the opportunity to shape how customers understand, adopt, and troubleshoot an enterprise SaaS product. You will create clear, useful documentation across knowledge bases, admin guides, how-to content, troubleshooting resources, release notes, and product experiences. Working closely with Support, Product, Design, and Engineering teams, you will turn complex product information into accessible content that helps customers solve problems independently. You will also contribute to documentation for AI-powered features, ensuring content is useful for both people and AI assistants. The role combines hands-on writing with content strategy, information architecture, editorial quality, and knowledge management. It is well suited to a technically minded writer who enjoys connecting customer needs, product capabilities, and measurable support outcomes. Accountabilities Write, publish, and maintain high-quality knowledge base content, including admin guides, how-to articles, troubleshooting documentation, and product help content. Partner with Support teams to identify recurring customer issues, analyze ticket trends, identify documentation gaps, and prioritize content improvements. Work with Product Managers and Engineers throughout the product development lifecycle to document new features before release. Create release notes, in-app help content, UX microcopy, and other product-facing documentation as needed. Take ownership of one or two core product areas while contributing to shared documentation initiatives across the broader product portfolio. Create supporting visual content, including screenshots and short screen recordings, to make technical concepts easier to understand. Develop clear documentation for AI-powered features, including their capabilities, limitations, workflows, and applicable guardrails. Create content that is useful to both human readers and AI-powered support tools that retrieve information from the knowledge base. Review and edit documentation produced by other writers to ensure consistency with established style, voice, terminology, and quality standards. Maintain knowledge base health by supporting style-guide updates, terminology governance, review processes, taxonomy, and content organization. Regularly audit and refresh existing documentation to ensure it remains accurate as the product evolves. Contribute to broader content strategy and information architecture initiatives as opportunities arise. Requirements 3–6 years of professional experience in technical writing, product content, UX writing, or a related field, ideally within a B2B SaaS or enterprise software environment. Strong understanding of enterprise software concepts, including permissions, roles, integrations, administrative and end-user experiences, and multi-step workflows. Excellent writing and editing skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly, concisely, and accurately. Strong editorial judgment and the ability to independently review and improve your own work. Familiarity with established technical writing standards such as the Microsoft Writing Style Guide or Google Developer Documentation Style Guide. Strong product mindset, with the ability to connect product features to real user needs and understand documentation as part of the overall product experience. Experience using support data, customer feedback, ticket trends, or recurring failure points to inform documentation priorities. Understanding of how knowledge bases support customer service technologies, including agent-assist tools, chatbots, and AI assistants. Hands-on experience with a CMS or knowledge base platform, including publishing workflows, review processes, versioning, tagging, taxonomy, and draft-to-published content management. Hands-on experience writing API documentation, including endpoint references, request and response examples, authentication, error handling, and code snippets. Basic knowledge of information architecture and effective content organization. Experience working in agile product development environments with changing priorities and tight delivery timelines. A portfolio demonstrating published knowledge base articles, release notes, product documentation, or UX content. Experience documenting AI or LLM-powered features is advantageous, including prompt guidance and content optimized for AI retrieval. Familiarity with Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS) or similar support-content methodologies is a plus. Experience with intranet, employee experience, collaboration, or productivity software is beneficial. Familiarity with content design systems, terminology governance, or structured content practices is advantageous. Ability to collaborate effectively with Support, Product, Engineering, and Design teams. Willingness to work from the designated office location or according to the applicable hybrid working arrangement. Benefits Opportunity to take meaningful ownership of technical content from day one. Title: Manager, Technical Writing Team
Description: About Mainspring Mainspring Energy manufactures and delivers fuel-flexible, low-emissions local power solutions that rapidly add new capacity and deliver reliable, affordable, and sustainable electric power. The company began commercial shipments of its Mainspring Linear Generators in 2020 and today has hundreds of megawatts in advanced development and field operations for leading Fortune 500 companies, data centers, and utilities. Mainspring also partners with global energy leaders including AEP, NextEra Energy Resources, Schneider Electric, and more. The core values that ground our work, guide our decisions, and connect us together: Pragmatic Optimism Excellence without Ego Proactive Collaboration Job Overvew Why Join Us At Mainspring, technical documentation isn't just a support function—it’s the backbone of our operations. You won’t be tethered to a desk; you’ll be on the floor, working directly with our hardware and engineering teams. This role offers the unique opportunity to lead and evolve our established documentation systems while staying deeply connected to the 'hands-on' reality of building the grid of the future. If you thrive on translating complex physical systems into clear, actionable guides and want to lead a team that is as comfortable with a wrench as they are with a style guide, this is the place for you. As Mainspring scales, our technical documentation must be as innovative and reliable as our energy technology. We are looking for a Manager of Technical Writing to lead the team responsible for translating complex engineering and manufacturing processes into the clear, actionable documentation that fuels our growth. You will be a player-coach: driving high-level documentation strategy, overseeing the creation of digital technical visuals (CAD, schematics, process flows), and mentoring a team of writers. Your mission is to ensure that our technical documentation is accurate, accessible, and scalable, and that all relevant technical writing SOPs are maintained and kept up to date. Key Responsibilities Team Leadership & Mentorship: Lead a high-performing team of technical writers. Foster a culture of excellence, natural curiosity, and "hands-on" technical engagement. Manage workloads, set priorities, and provide professional development for the team Documentation Strategy & Governance: Establish and maintain global standards for technical documentation styles, tools, processes, and systems for company-wide documentation management and revision control. Ensure consistency across all manuals, assembly instructions, and digital databases Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Engineering, Manufacturing, and Field Service to ensure documentation is deeply integrated with hardware development and operational workflows. Act as the bridge between technical experts and end-users Visual Content Oversight: Guide the team in creating high-quality technical visuals, including CAD-derived illustrations, schematics, and process flows. Ensure the team has the necessary tools and training in software like Enovia PLM and Solidworks Composer Hands-on Content Development: Act as a player-coach by actively contributing to the creation of high-priority technical documentation. You will balance management duties with direct involvement in complex documentation tasks to ensure we meet critical project milestones Qualifications Experience: 7+ years of experience in technical writing within an engineering or manufacturing environment, with at least 2+ years in a leadership or management role Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Technical Communication, English, Engineering, or a related field Technical Mastery: Proven ability to distill complex mechanical and electrical systems into unambiguous documentation. Strong proficiency in CAD software and visual documentation tools Hands-On Mindset: You enjoy working in-person in a "hands-on" shop environment. You have excellent mechanical intuition and aren't afraid to pick up a tool to better understand a process Communication & Influence: Exceptional writing and interpersonal skills. Ability to influence stakeholders and build buy-in for documentation standards across a rapidly scaling organization Does your experience not meet all of our posted requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to positions unless they meet every listed requirement. At Mainspring, we are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, flexible, and collaborative environment, so if you want to help us transition the world to clean and affordable electricity, and don’t meet all posted requirements for a particular role, we’d still love to hear from you. Mainspring can sometimes be flexible enough to shift responsibilities for the right person, or otherwise identify open or upcoming roles that may better fit your professional background. Title: Technical Writer
Description: A World-Changing Company Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more. The Role As a technical writer and editor, you’ll play a key role in helping our customers succeed by creating, maintaining, and improving documentation that supports users of Palantir’s products. At Palantir, we view documentation as a key part of product development. Working at the intersection of users and Palantir’s products, you will develop an understanding of user needs and help them get the most out of our software. You’ll be a thought partner with our product development teams, combining your communication skills with empathy for users and product knowledge. Your work will primarily be on written documentation, but may also include interactive tutorials, recorded demonstrations, or other communication channels. Teams and individuals at Palantir operate with a high degree of autonomy and independence. In this role, you’ll be responsible for setting priorities for your work, deciding where to allocate your time based on an assessment of stakeholder and organizational needs. You should be comfortable thinking about the “big picture” narrative and structure of our documentation, as well as diving into the details. On any given day, you might find yourself editing a guide drafted by a developer, writing a new tutorial for a critical workflow, or identifying an area that needs improvement and partnering with a team to make the fix. You will also gain exposure to the technical infrastructure for composing and distributing platform documentation. Core Responsibilities Understand and communicate the value proposition of Palantir’s products. Create user documentation in partnership with developers and business teams. Review and edit documentation to maintain a high level of quality. Identify, triage, and resolve needs in documentation. Maintain style guides and best practices for writing, improving, and publishing documentation. Manage and structure multi-stakeholder documentation projects. Uphold a culture in which developers are engaged with documenting their products, including hosting training sessions and workshops. What We Value Commitment to quality and accuracy in communication and writing, with the ability to translate complex technical subjects into clear, concise prose suited for the intended audience. Ability to prioritize, adapt, and operate in unstructured environments as part of a fast-moving team. Enthusiasm for learning about and communicating new technology and concepts. Experience working with engineering teams as part of the software development process. What We Require Outstanding writing and editing skills. 3+ years of technical writing experience or similar experience in software development. Experience with programming, scripting, or statistical packages; previous work in software engineering or data science is a plus. Salary The estimated salary range for this position is estimated to be $88,000 - $122,000/year. Total compensation for this position may also include Restricted Stock units, sign-on bonus and other potential future incentives. Further note that total compensation for this position will be determined by each individual’s relevant qualifications, work experience, skills, and other factors. This estimate excludes the value of any potential sign-on bonus; the value of any benefits offered; and the potential future value of any long-term incentives. Our benefits aim to promote health and wellbeing across all areas of Palantirians’ lives. We work to continuously improve our offerings and listen to our community as we design and update them. The list below details our available benefits and some of the perks that can be enjoyed as an employee of Palantir Technologies. Benefits • Employees (and their eligible dependents) can enroll in medical, dental, and vision insurance as well as voluntary life insurance • Employees are automatically covered by Palantir’s basic life, AD&D and disability insurance • Commuter benefits • Relocation assistance • Take what you need paid time off, not accrual based • 2 weeks paid time off built into the end of each year (subject to team and business needs) • 10 paid holidays throughout the calendar year • Supportive leave of absence program including time off for military service and medical events • Paid leave for new parents and subsidized back-up care for all parents • Fertility and family building benefits including but not limited to adoption, surrogacy, and preservation • Stipend to help with expenses that come with a new child • Employees can enroll in Palantir’s 401k plan Life at Palantir We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region. In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Working closely with Sales, Project Managers, Customer Success Managers, Resource Management, customers, and technical delivery teams, you will ensure projects are prioritized, planned, and delivered on schedule while balancing organizational capacity and business objectives. Monitor project portfolios, identify risks, issues, and dependencies, and drive mitigation and escalation activities when required. Maintain project requests, schedules, dashboards, operational metrics, templates, and project documentation. Lead post-project reviews, root cause analysis activities, and continuous improvement initiatives to improve delivery outcomes and operational efficiency. Successfully manage multiple competing priorities while ensuring alignment to customer commitments and business objectives. Identify, evaluate, and support the implementation of AI-powered tools, AI agents, copilots, and intelligent automation solutions that improve project scheduling, reporting, capacity planning, operational visibility, knowledge management, and decision-making. Demonstrated experience managing project schedules, delivery commitments, stakeholder communications, and competing priorities in a customer-facing environment. Strong understanding of capacity planning, resource forecasting, workload management, and operational performance metrics. Knowledge of Data Migration methodologies, ETL processes, data integration concepts, and systems design principles. Experience using project and operational management platforms such as JIRA, Kimble, Smartsheet, Confluence, or similar tools. Experience working in production, SaaS, healthcare technology, or customer delivery environments. Experience leveraging Generative AI, AI copilots, intelligent automation, or agent-based solutions to improve business processes and operational efficiency. Understanding of workflow automation, prompt engineering, AI governance, and responsible AI practices. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. Self-motivated with exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail, and a continuous improvement mindset. Your key Strengths: PointClickCare domain knowledge Experience with healthcare technology solutions, including EHR, EMR, Pharmacy, or clinical systems. Experience with Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform, AI Builder, Azure AI Services, OpenAI technologies, Anthropic (Claude), or comparable AI platforms. Experience developing, implementing, or managing AI agents, digital assistants, chatbots, or workflow automation solutions. Familiarity with modern data and analytics platforms such as Databricks, Azure Data Lake, and enterprise reporting solutions. PMP, Agile, Scrum, or related project management certifications. #Toronto Contract duration is 8 months. Title: Technical Writer (R5661)
Description: Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. Job Description: Shield AI is seeking an experienced V-BAT Technical Writer to support the integration and operational lifecycle of next-generation autonomous aircraft systems. This role is embedded within engineering and flight test environments and is responsible for translating highly complex aerospace, avionics, and autonomy systems into precise, usable technical documentation. The ideal candidate brings deep experience working alongside engineers and subject matter experts to produce clear, structured documentation across all program phases, from early design and system development through initial flight testing and sustained mission operations. This position will directly support V-BAT platform documentation, including service bulletins, operator manuals, maintenance procedures, system descriptions, and mission support materials. What you'll do: Partner closely with aerospace, software, and systems engineers to develop accurate, high-fidelity technical documentation for advanced aircraft systems. Manage multiple documentation efforts across development, flight test, and operational phases in a fast-paced, iterative environment. Translate complex engineering concepts, including avionics, autonomy, and mission systems, into clear, structured guidance for operators, maintainers, and internal teams. Review and edit technical content for accuracy, clarity, consistency, and adherence to program standards. Research and interpret engineering artifacts such as system architectures, design specifications, interface control documents, software descriptions, and test procedures. Aggregate and synthesize technical inputs from cross-functional teams, including flight test, hardware, software, and operations. Develop and maintain technical publications, including service bulletins, aircraft operating procedures, maintenance manuals, troubleshooting guides, training materials, and mission documentation. Create and manage supporting visuals such as system diagrams, workflows, illustrations, and annotated graphics. Identify gaps, inconsistencies, or missing technical information and proactively drive resolution with engineering teams. Maintain documentation standards, templates, and version control across a growing body of technical publications. Support rapid updates to documentation based on flight test results, system changes, and operational feedback. Fulfill additional responsibilities as required in support of V-BAT program objectives. Required qualifications: 3-10 years of technical writing/editing experience, preferably in aerospace, defense, or complex engineering systems. Bachelor’s degree in Technical Writing, Engineering, English, or a related field. Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining technical documentation for aircraft systems, complex hardware/software platforms, or similar domains. Proven ability to work directly with engineers and subject matter experts to extract and document technical information. Strong understanding of structured documentation practices and lifecycle documentation management. Exceptional writing, editing, and organizational skills with a focus on clarity and precision. Ability to distill complex system behavior into concise, user-focused documentation. High attention to detail and consistency across large documentation sets. Self-sufficient, proactive work style with the ability to manage competing priorities under tight timelines. Ability to identify missing, ambiguous, or conflicting technical information. Comfortable working across distributed teams and time zones. Interest in working in a fast-moving, non-traditional defense and aerospace environment. Preferred qualifications: Experience with advanced aircraft systems, UAVs, autonomy, avionics, or mission systems documentation. Familiarity with DoD technical manual standards and specifications (e.g., MIL-STD, S1000D, or service-specific formats). Experience using Microsoft Office, Adobe FrameMaker, or XML-based authoring tools. Background in flight test documentation or operational procedure development. Defense industry or aerospace program experience. Master’s degree in English, Technical Communication, or a related discipline. Project management experience supporting complex technical programs. Experience leveraging AI-assisted tools to enhance documentation workflows. #LI-AA1 #LC Full-time regular employee offer package: Pay within range listed + Bonus + Benefits + Equity Temporary employee offer package: Pay within range listed above + temporary benefits package (applicable after 60 days of employment) Salary compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, licenses and certifications, and specific work location. Title: Technical Writer (Pune, India)
Description: About Us Spin.AI is the parent company of Revyz. Together, we are fast-growing B2B SaaS companies dedicated to cloud data protection, enterprise cybersecurity, and automated data management. We build cutting-edge cloud security and disaster recovery solutions for modern enterprises. Spin.AI provides an all-in-one SaaS security platform called SpinOne that protects mission-critical data across environments like Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Salesforce, and Slack. Our software helps organizations stop ransomware (with an industry-leading 2-hour recovery SLA), uncover "Shadow IT" risks, and manage SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM). Revyzoperates as a specialized subsidiary within the Spin.AI family and is a data security and compliance platform purpose-built for the Atlassian ecosystem. Our native SaaS applications help IT and security teams automatically back up, clone, optimize, and granularly restore critical data within Jira Software, Jira Service Management (JSM), and Confluence Cloud. Summary As a Technical Writer, you will bridge the gap between complex engineering concepts and compelling, educational content for Revyz & Spin.AI’s SaaS products. You will be working closely with engineering, product marketing, and customer enablement to create resources that don’t just document what the product does, but accelerate a user from novice to power user. Your goal is to build out a modern documentation infrastructure that drives platform adoption and builds brand trust across technical communities. Your primary goal will be to author high-quality user guides, support documentation, and tutorials that empower both internal teams and external customers to maximize the value of our products. Key Responsibilities: Develop & Maintain Technical documentation Create, edit, and maintain clear, concise, and user-focused technical documentation for support pages, including user guides, release notes, knowledge base articles, process documentation, and troubleshooting FAQs. Manage Content Lifecycle: Own the end-to-end documentation creation process, including information architecture, version control, content structures, and regular content audits to ensure accuracy as software evolves. Cross-Departmental Collaboration: Work closely with software engineers, product managers, QA teams, customer success, and product marketing to gather and validate highly technical information. Title: Technical Writer, User Terminal (UT) Engineering
Description: Telesat (Nasdaq and TSX: TSAT) is a leading global satellite operator, providing reliable and secure satellite-delivered communications solutions worldwide to broadcast, telecommunications, corporate and government customers for over 55 years. Support migration and organization of documentation within Confluence, SharePoint, Jama, and related tools. Drive continuous improvement of UT engineering documentation quality and accessibility. Title: Senior Technical Writer
Location: New York, New York, United States
Description:
Location: New York, NY (In-office 4x per week “Grand Central”)

Company: Kizen, www.kizen.com

Senior Technical Writer, Insurance or Financial Services

About Us

Kizen is a leading AI platform for the future of work, redefining how people and AI seamlessly move and improve as one. Founded on the principle that technology should make work more meaningful, Kizen creates AI systems (AKA assistants) that learn, adapt, and improve over time, just like the people who use them.

Some of the ways we support these teams include: helping insurance agents manage contracting and commissions, enabling healthcare providers to deliver proactive patient care, and empowering financial institutions to classify documents and extract data automatically. We’re solving operational problems and helping the world’s most complex organizations give their teams the tools they need to do more, grow faster and live better.

And this is just the beginning! Kizen is where enterprises get AI that works on day one and is flexible enough to shape it to their own organizations. Our AI-first platform is easy to adopt, scale, and trust making it a destination for developers to build new applications and business teams to customize AI assistants, all in one place.

Join us in transforming how industries work, one person, one workflow, one AI assistant at a time!

About the Role

Kizen is seeking an experienced Senior Technical Writer with a strong background in InsurTech, financial, or insurance operations to create high-quality developer and user-facing documentation for our insurance product suite, including Commissions Copilot, Contracting, and AgentCRM. This is a hands-on individual contributor role focused on execution.

You will work directly with Product Owners, Engineers, and Solution Architects to translate complex technical concepts into clear, usable documentation that improves the customer experience.

This role is ideal for a writer who thrives in highly technical environments, understands the insurance industry, solutioning and developer workflows, and takes pride in producing precise, structured documentation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Apply working knowledge of insurance distribution workflows (producer contracting, commissions, hierarchy structures, carrier credentialing) to produce documentation that is accurate, contextually relevant, and useful to insurance-industry end users and developers.
  • Collaborate with the Insurance Product Owner and Solutions team to document vertical-specific features, data models, and integration patterns unique to the insurance space.
  • Write, edit, and maintain developer-facing documentation including:
    • API documentation
    • Integration guides
    • Plugin documentation
    • Developer tutorials & walkthroughs
    • Technical workflows & concepts
    • Release notes
  • Read, interpret, and validate OpenAPI specifications (.yaml / .json).
  • Partner with engineering teams to document new software features, API endpoints, data models, and error handling.
  • Own documentation quality, clarity, accuracy, and usability.
  • Contribute to documentation architecture, organization, and navigation to support a strong developer experience.
  • Operate within a Docs-as-Code environment using Git-based workflows.
  • Interview subject matter experts and independently gather technical details.
  • Manage documentation projects from intake through publication.
  • Continuously improve documentation based on product changes and developer needs.

Requirements

Preferred Insurance Background. You should have an understanding of the insurance industry, including familiarity with concepts such as contracting, commissions management, FMOs/IMOs, carrier relationships, or insurance distribution workflows.

Technical Acumen. You need to have strong technical abilities to be able to understand the complexity of our application and solution framework. You should be able to independently create solutions yourself using common integration iPaaS products and API testing tools.

Collaboration. You should have excellent collaboration skills, as the whole team works together to deliver functionality. You should strive to encourage and empower your team members as we aim to maintain a healthy work environment where we can achieve success, together. You should be eager to mentor newer members of the team as we grow.

Communication. You must offer support and transparency to your team, so you need to be able to provide clear status and expectations. You must effectively communicate progress and dependencies to a variety of stakeholders, and consistently update when things go off track.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 5 years of technical writing experience focused on software or technical platforms.
  • Bachelor's degree in Communication, English, Journalism, or Computer Science
  • Proven experience documenting InsurTech or insurance-adjacent SaaS products in a regulated industry
  • Experience writing API and developer documentation for SaaS, platform, or enterprise software products.
  • Strong understanding of the OpenAPI Specification.
  • Ability to read and validate .yaml and .json specification files.
  • Proficiency with Docs-as-Code workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with GitHub/GitLab or Gitbooks.
  • Advanced working knowledge of Markdown.
  • Demonstrated understanding of developer experience (DX) principles.
  • Strong information architecture skills with the ability to structure complex documentation.
  • Experience working within Agile product teams.
  • Excellent SME interviewing and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Strong project management abilities with a track record of delivering documentation on schedule.
  • Portfolio required — applications without work samples will not be considered.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience documenting HealthTech or FinTech SaaS products in a regulated industry
  • Familiarity with AI-driven or ML-powered SaaS products, including comfort documenting agentic workflows, model outputs, or AI-assisted process automation.
  • Familiarity with documentation platforms beyond GitBook.
  • UX/UI Writing experience.
  • Background working in high-growth SaaS

Work Location Requirement

This role is based in the New York Tri-State Area and follows a hybrid schedule of four days in the office and one day remote. Candidates must reside in the New York Tri- State area. We are not hiring for this position outside of this market.

We’re looking for a person who:

  • Has enough insurance or regulated-industry fluency to ask the right questions when documenting complex workflows like agent contracting or commissions hierarchies.
  • Thrives in fast-paced environments and doesn’t shy away from a challenge
  • Loves using data to question the norm and drive smarter decisions
  • Has an entrepreneurial spirit and wants to help build something game-changing
  • Genuinely enjoys helping others succeed — and has the tech chops to back it up
  • Is excited about AI, automation, and being on the frontlines of tech innovation

Why Join Kizen?

We’re a fast-growing company that values innovation, growth, and continuous improvement. By joining Kizen, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping the future of the company while enjoying a supportive, dynamic, and collaborative workplace. You’ll have opportunities for professional development, impact, and career advancement.

What We Offer

  • Career Growth Opportunities
  • Engaging Work Culture
  • Top-Tier Compensation
  • Equity Package
  • Healthcare Coverage
  • Professional Development Stipends
  • PTO 

Kizen is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture that celebrates authenticity to win as one. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, citizenship or immigration status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Kizen, we fully comply with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). We are dedicated to embracing challenges and creating an accessible, inclusive workplace for all individuals. 

The base salary range for this position is $125,000-$145,000. However, base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to base salary, we also offer generous equity and benefits packages.

If you’re excited about creating impactful experiences and contributing to a fast-paced, people-focused team, we’d love to meet you!

OTE - $143,000k- $166,000k

$125,000—$166,000 USD

Title: Operational Readiness Analyst
Description:
Nymbus (https://nymbus.com/) isn’t just a leader in fintech; we’re a community of innovators passionate about reimagining banking. Our award-winning modern core platform and cloud-based technology serve as the backbone for financial institutions eager to modernize and excel.  

We operate with an AI-first mindset across our business, continuously improving how we work and the value we deliver to our clients. Our culture is grounded in collaboration, accountability, and a strong commitment to execution.

The journey to growth begins with doing something different, and that journey starts with the talented people who make Nymbus successful. Thank you for considering Nymbus as the catalyst for the next chapter of your career. 

 

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

Nymbus is a remote-first company. Occasional travel may be required for client engagements, team planning sessions, or project activities. Highly collaborative, client-facing environment with stakeholders across data, engineering, and product teams. 

Working hours primarily align with the Eastern Time Zone; candidates located in the Eastern or Central time zones are preferred.

This position is performed remotely and requires flexibility in work hours to accommodate client implementations, release cycles, testing windows, on call availability, and occasional in office work requirements. 

 

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS  

The physical requirements outlined herein are indicative of those essential for an employee to effectively carry out the primary responsibilities of this position. The employee is regularly seated and frequently engages in activities such as using hands to handle, finger, or feel. Periodic standing and walking may also be necessary. Additionally, there may be occasional lifting or movement of objects weighing up to 10 pounds. Specific visual capabilities essential for this role include close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus. 

 

INTERNET REQUIREMENTS  

As a condition of employment, this role requires the candidate to maintain a stable, high speed internet connection. 

 

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Operational Readiness Analyst supports the day to day operational infrastructure of the Digital Experience Center (DXC), a multitenant contact center supporting multiple financial institution clients. Working under the direction of the Operational Readiness Manager, this role helps build, configure, test, document, and maintain the systems, forms, routing, content, and processes that DXC agents and clients rely on every day.  

This is a hands-on execution role. The analyst assists with Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) platform administration, IVR script maintenance, virtual agent and agent assist configuration, digital and electronic form builds, knowledge management, operational reporting, and vendor case management. The analyst also supports new client implementations by configuring the environment, building the required forms, content, and documentation, and validating that everything works before go live.  

Success in this role requires someone organized, technically curious, and comfortable moving between configuration work, testing, documentation, and client facing deliverables. The work is detailed and often deadline driven, and accuracy matters because these systems directly affect how customers reach their financial institution and how agents serve them.  

 

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES:

1. CCaaS Platform Administration and Vendor Support

  • Assist with administration of the CCaaS platform, including user provisioning, role and permission assignment, security profiles, and access reviews.
  • Support configuration of skills, queues, routing rules, points of contact, hours of operation, holiday schedules, and dispositions across multiple client environments.
  • Help maintain and audit platform configuration to ensure settings remain consistent, accurate, and aligned to client requirements.
  • Assist with platform release reviews, feature evaluations, and regression testing following vendor updates.
  • Review CCaaS vendor release notes ahead of each release and identify new features, changes, and deprecations that affect DXC configuration, workflows, agent experience, or client setup.
  • Summarize release findings with recommended actions, risks, and opportunities, and provide them to the Operational Readiness Manager for review and leadership discussion.
  • Perform routine platform health checks and escalate anomalies to the Operational Readiness Manager.
  • Monitor vendor service status, incident notifications, and scheduled maintenance announcements, and alert the Operational Readiness Manager and affected DXC teams to timing and expected impact.
  • Track platform incidents, degradations, and outages through resolution, documenting start and end times, affected functionality, workarounds applied, and operational impact.
  • Validate platform functionality following maintenance windows, vendor changes, and incident resolution, and report residual issues promptly.
  • Maintain a running record of incident and outage history to support trend review, vendor accountability, and service level discussions.
  • Support the intake, triage, and documentation of agent reported platform issues.
  • Open, document, and track vendor support cases with clear reproduction steps, impact statements, and supporting evidence.
  • Monitor open cases through resolution, follow up on aging items, and escalate when cases stall or impact expands.
  • Maintain records of platform defects, enhancement requests, known issues, and documented workarounds.
  • Support vendor meetings by preparing agendas, capturing notes, and tracking action items to completion.
  • Assist with license, user count, and entitlement reviews for the CCaaS platform and related supported tools.
  • Maintain accurate internal documentation of platform configuration, routing logic, and operational processes so settings and decisions are traceable.

 

  1. IVR and Call Routing Support
  • Support IVR script development by preparing call flow requirements, documenting menu structures and routing logic, and making defined script updates under the direction and review of the Operational Readiness Manager.
  • Assist with routing configuration tasks including menu options, DNIS assignments, department routing, transfer paths, and business hour logic.
  • Coordinate prompt recording requests, upload and verify audio files, and confirm prompt accuracy across client environments.
  • Test IVR changes in a development environment prior to production deployment and document test results.
  • Maintain IVR documentation, including call flow diagrams and plain language journey documentation for internal and client audiences.
  • Support reconciliation between development and production script sets by comparing configurations and flagging discrepancies for correction.

 

  1. Virtual Agent, Conversational AI, and Agent Assist Support
  • Support virtual agent development on the conversational AI platform (Cognigy.ai) by maintaining intents, utterances, and responses, and making defined configuration updates under the direction and review of the Operational Readiness Manager.
  • Support knowledge source configuration and upkeep, including tagging, labeling, and filtering, so the virtual agent retrieves accurate, current, and approved content.
  • Structure and format operational content so it can be retrieved correctly by conversational AI and agent assist tools, and flag content that is unclear, outdated, or likely to produce poor retrieval.
  • Build and execute test utterance libraries to validate virtual agent behavior before and after changes go live.
  • Review virtual agent and agent assist outputs for accuracy, consistency, and alignment with approved processes, and escalate concerns to the Operational Readiness Manager.
  • Assist with preparation and testing of agent assist resources, including knowledge cards and suggested responses.
  • Document defects, missed intents, and containment gaps, and track them through resolution with the appropriate technical or vendor teams.
  • Assist with virtual agent updates required by product changes, policy changes, or new client onboarding.
  • Support user acceptance testing cycles and compile results for review.

 

  1. Digital Forms and Document Administration
  • Build, configure, test, and maintain electronic signature forms (DocuSign) and client facing web forms across financial institution clients.
  • Translate client provided form requirements into functional builds, including field logic, conditional routing, validation rules, and recipient workflows.
  • Maintain form libraries, templates, and standard data sets used across clients.
  • Test forms end to end prior to release and validate submissions route correctly to the intended destinations.
  • Troubleshoot form errors, submission failures, and routing issues reported by clients or agents.
  • Create client facing navigation guides and supporting documentation for forms and digital tools.

 

  1. Knowledge Content Maintenance
  • Create, update, and maintain knowledge articles, procedures, job aids, and troubleshooting guides following the content standards, formatting, and taxonomy defined by the Operational Readiness Manager.
  • Collaborate with cross functional teams and subject matter experts to gather and organize information so content is accurate, current, and usable by agents.
  • Conduct regular content reviews to identify outdated, duplicated, or incomplete documentation, and coordinate corrections with process owners.
  • Apply tagging and categorization consistently so content is findable by agents and retrievable by supported tools.
  • Move content through established review and approval workflows and track items pending approval.
  • Flag content that is unclear, conflicting, or noncompliant with organizational policies, privacy laws, or security standards for resolution.
  • Monitor changes to Nymbus platforms and supported client systems, assess downstream impact to DXC processes, and update affected knowledge content so agent guidance stays accurate after a release.

 

  1. New Client Implementation Support
  • Support the implementation of new financial institution clients onto the CCaaS platform.
  • Work from client requirements provided by the Operational Readiness Manager and translate them into platform configuration, routing, forms, and supporting content.
  • Build the operational assets required for launch, including electronic and web forms, knowledge content, and agent documentation, and assist with routing, IVR, and virtual agent configuration.
  • Coordinate with Project Management Operations, client services, and technical teams on internal implementation tasks, dependencies, and timelines.
  • Participate in readiness testing and validation prior to go live and document results for review.
  • Prepare client facing training materials, navigation guides, and documentation for review and delivery by the Operational Readiness Manager.
  • Assist with post launch support, issue resolution, and stabilization activities.

 

  1. Reporting and Data Support
  • Build, maintain, and refresh recurring operational reporting, including call volume, IVR selection and containment, virtual agent performance, form submission activity, and platform usage.
  • Produce recurring reports on an established cadence and deliver them to the Operational Readiness Manager and internal stakeholders for distribution.
  • Build and maintain reporting views, dashboards, and data extracts requested by the Operational Readiness Manager, DXC leadership, and client services.
  • Pull and prepare interaction analytics data to support reviews of contact drivers, escalation reasons, and containment performance.
  • Validate report accuracy, reconcile discrepancies between systems, and correct data quality issues at the source where possible.
  • Flag anomalies, unexpected trends, and recurring issues observed in the data to the Operational Readiness Manager for review and interpretation.
  • Support ad hoc data and reporting requests routed through the Operational Readiness Manager, leadership, and client services, including requests originating from financial institution clients.

 

  1. Additional Responsibilities

Perform other duties as assigned by management to contribute to the overall success and efficiency of the team and organization.

 

QUALIFICATIONS:

Required

  • Three or more years of experience in contact center operations, operational support, systems administration, business analysis, or a closely related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
  • One to two years of experience in a banking, credit union, or financial services environment, with working familiarity of banking products, terminology, and customer service processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to configure, test, and troubleshoot business systems or applications.
  • Strong writing, editing, and documentation skills, with the ability to explain technical processes in plain language.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities and deadlines.
  • High attention to detail and a disciplined approach to testing and validation before changes reach production.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills, including the ability to research an issue, isolate root cause, and document findings.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across operations, technology, client services, training, leadership, and vendor teams.
  • Comfort working independently in a remote, fast paced environment. 

 

Preferred

  • Experience administering a CCaaS or contact center platform, such as NICE CXone, Genesys, Five9, or Talkdesk.
  • Experience with IVR scripting, call routing configuration, or telephony administration.
  • Experience configuring or supporting conversational AI or virtual agent platforms, such as Cognigy, or similar chatbot tooling.
  • Experience building electronic signature workflows or digital forms, such as DocuSign, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with knowledge management platforms and content governance.
  • Experience reviewing interaction analytics, contact drivers, customer sentiment, or chatbot performance data.
  • Experience reviewing interaction analytics, customer sentiment, contact drivers, or chatbot and virtual agent performance.
  • Experience testing conversational AI flows, generated responses, or digital support experiences.
  • Familiarity with reporting and data tools, such as spreadsheets, dashboards, or scripting for automation.
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, or similar ticketing and documentation tools.  

 

OUR HIRING COMMITMENTS  

As an AI-first company, we embrace leveraging the power of AI tools throughout our hiring process. Nymbus remains committed to the importance of finding the right match for our teams and candidates alike. While we are excited about the AI tools at our disposal today, including the use of AI Video Interview tools, we remain committed to the human touch and oversight throughout the process.
