Title: Contract Technical Writer
Description:
The Company

Sendbird is on a mission to build the AI workforce of tomorrow. For over a decade, we built the infrastructure behind conversations—chat, voice, video, messaging APIs—and became the #1 CPaaS platform for in-app communications. 4,000+ brands trust us. 7 billion messages flow through our platform every month. 300 million monthly active users.
We powered conversations for DoorDash, Match Group, Noom, Yahoo Sports, Rakuten, and thousands of others. We were good at what we did. Really good.
We also saw it early: AI would fundamentally reshape how businesses talk to customers. The infrastructure we'd spent a decade building would become commoditized. The value would move up the stack—into intelligence, into experience, into outcomes.
We had a choice: protect what we built, or reinvent ourselves.
We chose reinvention.
In December 2024, we made the full strategic pivot to AI-first customer experience. By February 2025, we'd launched our AI agent for enterprise CX—built on a decade of conversation data, now with intelligence on top. And in November 2025, we rebranded to delight.ai.
The name says it all. AI's real promise isn't efficiency or cost savings. It's giving customers back something they lost—the feeling of being truly understood and cared for. Not satisfied. Delighted

The Product

Delight.ai is the AI concierge for customer experience. Most AI agents forget you the moment the conversation ends. Ours doesn't. Delight.ai builds memory over time, learns preferences, and connects context across every channel without losing the thread. We're building AI that makes customers feel understood, seen, and remembered.

The Role

The Technical Writing team at Sendbird empowers developers to build successful businesses on our platform by delivering high-quality content — from documentation and user guides to tutorials, UI text, and beyond. As a Technical/UX Writer, you'll be at the center of the developer experience, transforming complex technical concepts into content that is clear, concise, and actionable.

You might be this person if

  • You quickly spot friction in the user experience — whether it's a confusing UI label, unclear documentation, or a workflow that loses developers halfway through — and you can articulate exactly what's wrong and why.
  • You're a critical thinker who questions the obvious and finds a better path when the conventional one doesn't work.
  • You're genuinely curious about AI — not just as a trend, but as a tool you actively use to work faster and smarter. Sendbird encourages all members to tap into the most advanced tools available.
  • You thrive in cross-functional work. You'll collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and UX designers to create content that meets real customer needs.
  • You take ownership. You don't wait to be told what needs fixing — you spot it, flag it, and drive it forward.
  • You're not afraid to ask questions. When you need context, resources, or a second opinion, you seek them out — proactively and without hesitation.

What you'll actually do

  • Create content: Develop and maintain high-quality documentation, user guides, and UI text strings for Sendbird's products, ensuring clarity and accuracy.
  • Write UX copy: Craft button labels, error messages, onboarding flows, and tooltips that guide users with minimal friction.
  • Improve content: Build an effective feedback loop and integrate customer insights into our content.
  • Work with AI: Use AI tools actively in your writing workflow — to draft, restructure, automate, and iterate — while applying your own judgment to every output.
  • Stay current: Research competitor products, B2B trends, and developer communities to keep our content competitive and relevant.

You need to have

  • Experience: 0–2 years in technical writing, UX writing, content design, or a related field.
  • Content writing sense: You notice when content does not deliver its message effectively  — and you can explain why. This is foundational to how we work.
  • AI proficiency: You've used AI tools in real writing or content work. You know how to direct them with purpose, and you treat their output as a first draft.
  • Writing and communication: Fluent in English and Korean, both written and verbal.
  • Collaborative tools: Familiar with Git, GitBook, Confluence, Jira, Figma, or similar tools.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • Contract Period : 6month

 Added value

  • Background in Computer Science, Technical Writing, or a related field.
  • Experience with AI or SaaS product development.
  • Familiarity with API, SDK, or any programming languages such as Swift, Kotlin, or JavaScript.

 

Our KR benefits include (but are not limited to)

  • Be Your Best Self: 3.9 million won (prorated by start date) for expenses ranging from professional development classes and training, to personality assessments, to gym memberships, to books, to fitness classes, to mental health services, to massages
  • Annual cash-equivalent special welfare points of 200,000 KRW for Seollal and Chuseok holidays each
  • Learn a Language benefit - up to 3.6 million won per year towards language lessons 
  • Weekly team lunch
  • Monthly team building cost
  • Partial support for commuting costs
  • Free parking at the Seolleung office
  • Group insurance support that covers employees, spouses, and children
  • Medical checkup support, including MRI and genetic testing - for the employee and one family member
  • Seven additional paid holidays in addition to annual leave (Boost leave, Birthday leave, etc.)
  • Support for the latest work devices, such as MacBook Pro (special support options for each job position)
  • Unlimited snack bar filled with snacks, beverages, and instant noodles every day
  • 12-week paid parental leave support (available for both mothers and fathers)
  • Other support programs for congratulations and condolences

 

Flexible Work Policy

We offer a flexible work schedule at Sendbird.  We also value collaboration and relationship building.  With those values in mind, we require all employees to gather with their team in the office three days per week as a minimum.  Some of our roles require a more frequent in-office schedule.  Please work with your manager to understand the office time requirements for your position.

What diversity and inclusion mean to us

There is no such thing as a perfect candidate and the best employees come from a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and skill sets. Sendbird is a place where everyone can learn and grow. We respect, promote, and encourage diversity for equal employment opportunities and encourage you to apply if this role excites you.

Why Sendbird

We spent a decade building the conversation infrastructure that the world runs on. Now we're putting intelligence on top of it. You won't be joining a company still figuring out its AI strategy. You'll be joining one that has already made the bet, shipped the product, and is moving fast to lead the category. If you want to build something that matters, with a team that knows how, this is it.

Title: Technical Writer II
Description:
Clear Creek Federal is part of the Seneca Nation Group (SNG) portfolio of companies. SNG is Seneca Holdings' federal government contracting business that meets mission-critical needs of federal civilian, defense, and intelligence community customers. Our portfolio comprises multiple subsidiaries that participate in the Small Business Administration 8(a) program. To learn more about SNG, visit the website and follow us on LinkedIn.

Our team of talented individuals is what makes us successful. To support our team, we provide a balanced mix of benefits and programs. Your total rewards package includes competitive pay, benefits, and perks, flexible work-life balance, professional development opportunities, and performance and recognition programs. We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life, and disability, voluntary benefit programs (critical illness, hospital, and accident), health savings and flexible spending accounts, and retirement 401K plan. One of our fundamental principles is to offer competitive health and welfare benefits to our team members, providing coverage and care for you and your family. Full-time employees working at least 30 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in our benefits and paid leave programs.  We pride ourselves on our collaborative work environment and culture, which embraces our mission of providing financial and non-financial benefits back to the members of the Seneca Nation.

About the Program

The U.S. Army Communications-Electronics Command (CECOM) Software Engineering Center, Intelligence Electromagnetic Warfare and Sensors (IEW&S) Directorate, operates the Army Reprogramming Analysis Team (ARAT) at Aberdeen Proving Ground. ARAT builds, tests, and distributes mission software for fielded electromagnetic warfare systems, including the AN/APR-39 radar warning receiver family, the AN/APR-48A/B Modernized Radar Frequency Interferometer, the Aircraft Gateway Processor on the AH-64, and the AN/VLQ-12 CREW Duke. ARAT targets its mission software products to 14 geographic areas of responsibility across six combatant commands.

The ARAT Innovation Initiatives effort modernizes that infrastructure: browser-based threat modeling in the Signal Modeling Framework, automated RF hardware-in-the-loop testing through the Unified Test Automation Suite and software-defined radios, an automated Air/Terrestrial Testbed, test data warehousing, automated mission data product generation, and the ASPEN software distribution portal across NIPR, SIPR, and JWICS. Work is executed in Agile sprints with DevSecOps practices in a Government-approved GitLab environment.

Position Summary

The Technical Writer produces the software and program documentation the contract requires, including the System User's Manual for directed efforts, and the Help content delivered inside each software installation package. The role prepares and edits the CDRL deliverables - trip reports, presentation material, Quarterly Management Review packages, meeting minutes, Monthly Status Reports, the Software Version Description, and the Completion Summary Report - to the standard that no substantive Government correction is required. It authors in Markdown within the Government-approved GitLab repository, maintaining documentation as code alongside the software baseline, and applies correct CUI marking to draft and delivered material.

Key Responsibilities

  • Produce the System User's Manual for directed efforts, and the Help content delivered inside each software installation package.
  • Prepare and edit the CDRL deliverables, including trip reports, presentation material, Quarterly Management Review packages, meeting minutes, Monthly Status Reports, the Software Version Description, and the Completion Summary Report.
  • Meet the standard that deliverables require no substantive Government correction.
  • Author in Markdown within the Government-approved GitLab repository, maintaining documentation as code alongside the software baseline.
  • Apply correct CUI marking to draft and delivered material and maintain document baseline discipline.
  • Supervise and review the documentation work of other contributors.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, or a related technical discipline.
  • 4 to 8 years of relevant professional experience in technical documentation.
  • Active DoD Secret clearance at time of application.
  • Position-specific training beyond the common set: Records management and CUI marking discipline; the writer handles CUI draft deliverables. Derivative Classification where the writer prepares classified documentation.
  • Ability to travel to Aberdeen Proving Ground, Maryland for reviews and integration events. Contractor location carries flexibility for this position.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Society for Technical Communication (STC) Certified Professional Technical Communicator (CPTC) Foundation.
  • API/technical documentation certification.
  • Microsoft Office Specialist (Word Expert).
  • Experience with docs-as-code workflows using MkDocs, Sphinx, or Hugo.

Technical Skills and Tools

Markdown and docs-as-code authoring; GitLab Wiki, Pages, and merge-request documentation workflow; System User's Manual and Help content development; CDRL preparation and editing (DI-ADMN-81308A, DI-ADMN-81373, DI-ADMN-81250C, DI-MGMT-80368A, DI-IPSC-81442, DI-SESS-81000); static site generators (MkDocs, Sphinx, Hugo); technical editing and style consistency; CUI marking and handling; version control and document baseline discipline; Microsoft Word and Adobe Acrobat production; graphics and diagram preparation.

Vendor and tool training that carries weight: Markdown and docs-as-code authoring; GitLab Wiki, Pages, and merge-request documentation workflow; static site generators (MkDocs, Sphinx, or Hugo); DocBook/DITA familiarity; Microsoft Word and Adobe Acrobat for CDRL production.

Security and Training Requirements

  • An active DoD clearance at the level shown above is required. Secret is the floor across this contract.
  • A signed non-disclosure agreement is required before start of performance.
  • Common Access Card issuance runs approximately 24 hours; full network and facility access typically takes three to four business days after in-processing.
  • Every position carries the universal DoD and Army training set, completed at start of performance and refreshed on the Army cycle: DoD Cyber Awareness Challenge, Threat Awareness and Reporting Program (TARP), annual security refresher, insider threat awareness, controlled unclassified information handling, Antiterrorism Level I, iWATCH briefing, ATCTS registration, and installation access processing.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including, but not limited to, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leave of absence, compensation and training. The Company also prohibits retaliation against any employee who exercises his or her rights under applicable anti-discrimination laws. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Company does give hiring preference to Seneca or Native individuals. Veterans with expertise in these areas are highly encouraged to apply.

Title: Content Editor, Tech
Description:
Hi, we're TechnologyAdvice.

Headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, TechnologyAdvice helps millions of B2B technology buyers make smarter decisions by providing trusted research, practical guidance, and connections to the world's leading technology brands. Our work spans 30+ media brands and 50+ newsletters, supported by a global team across the United States, United Kingdom, Singapore, Australia, and the Philippines.

We're a remote-first company that values curiosity, collaboration, and growth. We invest in our people, embrace AI and new technologies to improve how we work, and create opportunities for team members to build meaningful careers. Many of our leaders have grown from within, including our CEO, who started here as an intern.

We believe great work happens when people feel connected. Through company all-hands, team events, Slack communities, learning sessions, and in-person gatherings, we create intentional opportunities for our global team to collaborate, build relationships, and celebrate successes together.

All positions are open to remote work unless otherwise specified in the requirements below. 

The opportunity

We’re hiring a Content Editor to support DZone’s editorial and contributor operations across both site and commercial content programs.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong editorial instincts with technical curiosity and excellent organizational skills. You will help manage and publish technical content for DZone’s developer audience while also coordinating contributor-driven commercial projects from kickoff through completion.

You will work closely with editorial, audience, sales, and contributor stakeholders to ensure content is accurate, engaging, timely, and aligned with DZone’s standards.

This requires excellent copyediting skills, strong project management abilities, comfort working with technical subject matter, and the ability to balance multiple priorities in a fast-moving publishing environment.

Employment Level: Mid-level

Employment Type: Full-time

Location: Philippines 

Working Hours: 9pm to 6am PHT (APR-OCT) or 10pm to 7am PHT (NOV-MAR)

What you'll do

Site Content and Community

  • Select, copyedit, and prepare technical site content for publication on DZone.
  • Research trends in the SDLC and stay up to date with the latest innovations to support article planning, content strategies, newsletters, and community initiatives.
  • Update site pages daily with fresh content and help ensure published content is timely, relevant, and aligned with editorial standards.
  • Monitor support and editor inboxes, answer inquiries, delete spam, and escalate issues to the appropriate departments.
  • Work with appropriate stakeholders to suggest site articles, community content, and other relevant editorial content to be featured in newsletters.
  • Build and maintain relationships with contributors, authors, and community members.
  • Support community-focused editorial initiatives, contributor engagement, and other programming that strengthen the DZone audience.
  • Assist with other team projects and initiatives as needed.

Commercial Content

  • Recommend contributors for relevant Commercial Content opportunities and lead contributor outreach.
  • Manage contributor-driven Commercial Content projects from kickoff through completion.
  • Vet, commission, onboard, and coordinate with contributors throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Prepare and send contributor-facing materials, including project briefs, authorship templates, launch emails, and related communications.
  • Manage editorial reviews and provide clear feedback to contributors; review outlines and drafts to ensure content aligns with project goals, audience needs, and editorial expectations.
  • Track contributor outreach, project status, deadlines, revisions, and completion details in the appropriate systems.
  • Maintain contributor records, project documentation, content versions, and related files in the correct storage locations.
  • Coordinate project closeout, including final approvals and contributor offboarding processes.

Who you are

  • At least 2 years of experience in technical editing for web channels or prior experience with a publishing company, preferably within the technology field.
  • A degree in English, Technical Writing, Publishing, or a related field.
  • A degree in or experience with software engineering, software development, or another technical discipline is preferred.
  • Basic HTML knowledge is a plus.
  • Excellent copyediting and proofreading skills, with strong command of American English spelling, grammar, punctuation, and style.

Title: Engineering Manager, Developer Experience
Description:
Alloy is where you belong!

Alloy is the AI-powered identity and fraud prevention platform that accelerates onboarding, stops fraud, and scales compliance across the customer lifecycle so financial organizations can grow without limits. More than 900 of the world's leading financial institutions and fintechs trust Alloy for smarter risk management that drives growth.

Through our values: Be Bold, Go Fast, Collaborate, and Celebrate Our Differences, we are creating a workplace where you can grow, thrive, and belong. See how we’ve been continuously recognized and named one of Inc. Magazine’s Best Workplaces, Forbes America’s Best Startup Employers, Best Fintech to Work for by American Banker, year after year.

Check out our investors and read more about us here.

About the team

We are seeking an experienced Engineering Manager to lead our Developer Experience team within the Connection organization. This team owns Alloy's external-facing integration surface - the APIs, webhooks, and tooling that developers and partners use to connect with Alloy and build on top of our platform.

In this role, you will lead a team responsible for the systems and experiences that make Alloy easy to integrate with: our Events API, Outgoing Webhooks Service, partnership data feeds, external developer documentation, and the integrations that power Alloy's channel partner ecosystem. You will own the technical and strategic vision for how data flows in and out of Alloy at scale, and how external developers experience the platform - from first API call to production.

Alloy operates in a hybrid-work environment. We look to foster collaboration and community by having our local employees onsite three days a week.

What you'll be doing

The Engineering Manager's primary responsibility is their team. You will balance three key areas: recruiting and growing great engineers, supporting each person's development, and partnering with product and stakeholders to ship high-quality, high-impact work.

As the Engineering Manager, you will:

  • Lead, develop, and mentor a team of engineers through weekly 1:1s, career conversations, and hands-on technical guidance.
  • Own the roadmap and delivery for Alloy's developer-facing infrastructure — APIs, webhooks, data ingestion, and outbound data flows - ensuring reliability, scalability, and a great developer experience.
  • Partner closely with product, design, partnerships, and customer-facing teams to shape what gets built and why.
  • Drive technical strategy for the team's systems, including API design standards, event delivery guarantees, and integration patterns used by external developers.
  • Track and improve engineering health using DORA metrics and team-level KPIs; establish release and monitoring standards that keep quality high.
  • Recruit and hire strong engineers; own onboarding and ramp for new team members.
  • Communicate clearly across the organization — surface risks, resolve blockers, and keep stakeholders aligned on progress and trade-offs.

Who we’re looking for

We are looking for an Engineering Manager who has built and led teams working on developer-facing products, APIs, or platform infrastructure. An ideal candidate has::

  • 8+ years in engineering with at least 3 years in an engineering leadership role.
  • A strong background in developer experience, API platform engineering, or developer tooling - you have shipped products that external developers integrate with and build on top of.
  • Deep familiarity with API design and HTTP/event-based integration patterns (REST, webhooks, async messaging); you can credibly lead technical discussions on API contract design, delivery guarantees, and integration reliability.
  • A track record of building and shipping high-quality systems at scale, with clear accountability for outcomes.
  • Technical fluency in modern backend stacks - strong with TypeScript/Node.js; comfortable reviewing code, debugging production issues, and contributing to architectural decisions.
  • Experience working with external partners or customers on integration work; you understand what makes a platform easy (or hard) to integrate with.
  • Experience leading sprint planning, goal-based project tracking, and cross-functional delivery.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to translate technical complexity for non-technical stakeholders and advocate for the team.
  • Experience recruiting, hiring, and onboarding engineers.
  • A servant-leader mindset - you lead by removing obstacles, pointing people in the right direction, and investing in the people around you.
  • Must be local to New York City and attend the office 3-4 days per week.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in high-growth product companies or startups.
  • Experience in fintech, financial services, or other regulated industries.

We're a lean team, so your impact will be felt immediately, and opportunities will grow as the company scales up. If this all sounds like a good fit for you, why not join us?

Title: Technical Program Manager, CX Intelligence & AI
Description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.

As the Technical Program Manager for CX Intelligence & AI (CXI), you'll be the embedded program management owner for all of CX, driving cross-functional execution across CX Ops, CX Programs, Product/Engineering, and Analytics. CXI is responsible for transforming Coinbase Customer Support from a reactive operations center into a highly effective, AI-powered support experience that is better for customers and more efficient for Coinbase. You'll create strategies for challenges where the solution is not yet well understood, independently plan programs with dependencies across product groups, and execute complex initiatives that require synchronizing timelines across multiple teams. This role is the connective tissue between CXI's intelligence layer and the engineering and product teams that build the AI infrastructure, and you will own overall project management, comms, status updates, key milestone dates, and cross-functional deliverables.

What you'll do:

  • Define a strategic roadmap and partner with Engineering to deliver high-priority initiatives and innovative solutions to CX challenges, while executing ongoing and annual roadmapping for priority programs across multiple product areas and holding the line on quality across product and operational areas.
  • Own a large portfolio of agent tooling and SaaS initiatives spanning AI automation, customer/agent insights, analytics infrastructure, and support channel strategy, including evaluating external vendors for new AI automation solutions to leverage as part of the tooling stack.
  • Independently uncover CX and customer opportunities where neither the problem nor the solution is well understood, and drive alignment with CX and Engineering leadership to shift resources, launch new projects, or cancel existing initiatives by leveraging frameworks and presenting tradeoffs to drive the right business priorities.
  • Own opportunity sizing, define north-star success metrics, and set quarterly targets for shared KRs in partnership with EAA product managers, while managing the source of truth for OKR performance and program reporting to leadership (WBR/QBR).
  • Drive business process documentation to ensure proper change management and rollout of tooling and automation changes across CX.
  • Innovate with technology and drive AI-first solutions across all responsibilities, continuously identifying opportunities to leverage automation and emerging AI capabilities to improve CX outcomes.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 10+ years of experience in technical program management, product/program management, strategy, or related roles within complex, scaled technology environments, preferably supporting CX engineering teams, with prior experience building or materially transforming a CX function at a product-led tech company where automation and AI were central to the roadmap.
  • Proven track record independently uncovering business and customer challenges where neither the problem nor the solution is well understood, creating strategies that span engineering teams, and demonstrated ability to make the call or escalate the need to shift resources, launch new projects, or cancel existing programs, including advising L8+/VP leadership on optimal execution paths and managing push-back.
  • Exceptional program management and execution discipline with the ability to size work, sequence dependencies, manage risk, and ship complex initiatives on time with quantified impact, including demonstrated success owning cross-functional, cross-org program portfolios with high ambiguity and external dependencies (regulatory, vendor, multi-product launches).
  • Fluency with AI/ML systems, automation platforms, data pipelines, and CX technologies, with the ability to leverage technical depth in your area and technical breadth across Coinbase to innovate, improve upon, and simplify technology solutions, combined with comfort working with analytics partners and BI tools (e.g., Looker, Snowflake) to define metrics, interpret trends, and make tradeoffs grounded in data.
  • Experience partnering deeply with Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Operations to translate customer and operational insights into roadmap changes and systemic improvements, with a background spanning multiple CX disciplines (VoC/insights, AI/ML, analytics, QA, content/knowledge management, experimentation, or workforce management) and comfort rotating across them, ideally within fintech, financial services, or regulated industries, with familiarity with Coinbase's products, customer segments, and risk surface or the curiosity to rapidly build that knowledge.
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

 

  • Position ID: P77126

Title: Manager, Documentation & Content
Description:
Shape the content experience behind every great product experience

What if the right documentation could make every Coveo product easier to understand, implement, and use? As Manager, Documentation & Content, you’ll lead an experienced team of eight technical writers responsible for one of Coveo’s most visible product surfaces: our documentation and product content.

Your focus will be on people and delivery leadership: developing writers, setting clear priorities, managing capacity and tradeoffs, and strengthening partnerships across Product and Engineering. You’ll also help evolve our approach to user experience content and continuously improve the documentation experience.

As our Manager, Documentation & Content, you will:

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of eight technical writers, setting clear expectations, providing regular feedback, and creating meaningful growth and ownership opportunities.
  • Own documentation delivery across Product, including intake, prioritization, capacity planning, and the proactive management of risks and tradeoffs.
  • Build strong partnerships across Product and Engineering, ensuring writers are involved at the right time and documentation commitments and priorities are clear.
  • Establish a sustainable user experience content practice encompassing interface copy, terminology, in-product guidance, and other product content in partnership with Product Design and Product Management.
  • Maintain practical standards for documentation quality and consistency while empowering writers to take ownership of their respective content areas.
  • Drive focused improvements to the documentation experience, including information architecture, navigation, content structure, and tooling, using customer feedback, analytics, search behavior, and artificial intelligence (AI) where they meaningfully improve quality or efficiency.

Here is what will qualify you for the role:

  • Experience managing and developing a team of technical writers or content professionals, including coaching, feedback, performance management, and career development.
  • Experience leading documentation for technical products used by developers, administrators, implementers, or other technical audiences.
  • Strong operational judgment and experience managing competing priorities, capacity, stakeholder needs, and delivery tradeoffs.
  • Strong documentation craft, editorial judgment, and communication skills, with the ability to bring structure to ambiguity and build productive cross-functional relationships.

What will make you stand out:

  • Experience supporting user experience writing, terminology, in-product guidance, or other forms of product content.
  • Familiarity with documentation-as-code practices and modern documentation publishing workflows.
  • Experience improving information architecture, navigation, findability, or other aspects of a documentation experience.
  • Experience working with enterprise cloud solutions, developer platforms, application programming interfaces (APIs), software development kits (SDKs), or similarly technical products.

Title: T3 Content and Technical Writer
Description:
Build the Future with Us — EquipmentShare is Hiring a T3 Content and Technical Writer

At EquipmentShare, we’re not just filling a role — we’re assembling the best team on the planet to build something that’s never been built before. We’re on a mission to transform an industry that’s been stuck in the past by empowering contractors and communities through innovative technology, real-time support, and a team that truly cares.

We’re hiring a T3 Content and Technical Writer at our Corporate Headquarters in Columbia, MO and we’re looking for someone who’s ready to grow with us, bring energy and drive to their work, and help us build the future of construction. 

The T3 Content and Technical Writer brings creativity and precision to their work, helping tell the T3 story through clear, engaging, and impactful content. This role develops and supports customer-facing communications, digital content, technical documentation, and knowledge resources to help customers and employees use T3 successfully. By partnering with cross-functional stakeholders, this role helps create, maintain, and improve content while ensuring T3’s voice remains consistent across customer and employee touchpoints

Primary Responsibilities

  • Perform job duties in accordance with EquipmentShare’s vision, mission, and values.
  • Develop, contribute, revise, and maintain customer-facing communications, sales enablement resources, technical documentation, knowledge base articles, SOPs, playbooks, user guides, training materials, and operational documentation.
  • Develop content that supports customer education, employee enablement, sales enablement, product adoption, and business operations.
  • Coordinate with Product, Marketing, and other stakeholders to align messaging and improve the overall knowledge experience.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams and subject matter experts to develop, review, coordinate, and publish content that supports customer education, training, sales enablement, and product adoption.
  • Translate technical, operational, and product information into clear, accurate, and engaging content for diverse audiences.
  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate content creation, editing, organization, and maintenance while ensuring accuracy, quality, and consistency.
  • Help establish and maintain documentation standards, templates, style guides, and governance practices to ensure consistent, high-quality content.
  • Review, edit, and continuously improve content to ensure accuracy, consistency, accessibility, branding, and alignment with business objectives.
  • Partner with Product and other stakeholders to ensure customer communications, documentation, and training resources reflect product enhancements, business initiatives, and process changes.
  • Create visual content, including screenshots, diagrams, workflow maps, videos, and other supporting resources, to enhance understanding.
  • Analyze stakeholder feedback, content usage, and support trends to identify content gaps and continuously improve documentation and knowledge resources.

Why EquipmentShare?

Because we do things differently — and we think you’ll feel it from day one. We’re a people-first company powered by cutting-edge technology. That means our proprietary T3 platform doesn’t just run our business — it also makes your job easier, safer, and more connected. Whether you’re behind the wheel, under the hood, leading a branch, or closing deals — tech supports you, and you drive us forward.

We’re a team of problem-solvers, go-getters, and builders. And we’re looking for teammates who take pride in doing meaningful work and want to be part of building something special.

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation

  • Full medical, dental, and vision coverage for full-time employees

  • Generous PTO + paid holidays

  • 401(k) + company match

  • Gym membership stipend + wellness programs (earn PTO and prizes!)

  • Company events, food truck nights

  • 16 hours of paid volunteer time per year — give back to the community you call home

  • Career advancement, leadership training, and professional development opportunities

About You

You want to be part of a team that’s not just changing an industry for the sake of change — we’re transforming it to make it safer, more secure, and more productive. You bring grit, heart, and humility to your work, and you’re excited about the opportunity to grow within a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

We’re looking for people who:

  • See challenges as opportunities

  • Embrace change and continuous improvement

  • Bring energy, effort, and optimism every day

Skills & Qualifications 

    • Exemplary written and verbal communication skills with a talent for creating clear, engaging, and audience-appropriate content.
    • Strong technical writing, editing, proofreading, and quality assurance skills with exceptional attention to detail.
    • Demonstrated proficiency in developing sales enablement resources, customer-facing communications, technical documentation, knowledge base content, training materials, and operational documentation.
    • Skilled at translating complex technical and operational information into user-friendly documentation and communications.
    • Proven collaboration skills with cross-functional teams and subject matter experts.
    • Strong understanding of content strategy, knowledge management, and documentation best practices.
    • Continuous learning mindset with an interest in emerging AI tools and technologies, and the ability to leverage AI to research, create, refine, and maintain high-quality content.
    • Excellent organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
    • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills to identify content gaps, improve documentation, and recommend process improvements.
    • Customer-focused mindset with a passion for creating content that enhances the customer and employee experience.e

     

    Education and Experience: 

    • Bachelor's degree in Communications, English, Journalism, Marketing, Technical Writing, or related field preferred.
    • At least 3 years of experience in content development, technical writing, communications, customer education, or a related field.
    • Experience creating customer-facing communications, technical documentation, knowledge base content, training materials, or operational documentation.
    • Experience working with content management systems (CMS), knowledge base platforms, learning management systems (LMS), or documentation tools preferred.
    • Experience in SaaS, technology, or construction/fleet management industries is preferred.

     

    Physical Requirements: 

    • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer

A Workplace For All

At EquipmentShare, we believe the best solutions come from a team that reflects the world around us. Our initiative — A Workplace For All — is rooted in the belief that we must work together to solve some of the toughest problems in construction. That means attracting, developing, and retaining great people from all walks of life.

We value different backgrounds, talents, and perspectives. We want you to feel like you belong here — because you do.

Title: Staff Technical Writer
Description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About The Role

We are looking for a passionate and motivated Staff Technical Writer to join our Product Documentation team as we support the company in achieving top-priority objectives & key results

Documentation at dbt is both a community asset and a foundational product surface. The Documentation team accelerates product adoption and user success by helping data practitioners learn, explore, and confidently use dbt.

We operate using a docs-as-code and docs-as-a-product approach within an open-source model, partnering closely with Engineering, Product, Developer Experience, and customer-facing teams. By balancing deep product knowledge with a beginner’s lens, we not only create accurate, easy-to-read documentation for humans and bots alike, but also surface insights that drive product improvements.

In this role, you’ll help new users reach their “a-ha” moment faster, support experienced practitioners as they expand into new areas of the ecosystem, and uphold the clarity, accuracy, and trust that our community depends on.

If you are looking for an exciting opportunity at a collaborative, dynamic and fast-growing company, this role could be for you!

What You'll Do

New feature writing for Product - 45%

  • Consistently creates effective docs plans for new feature writing projects
  • Starts conversations in key places, and involves stakeholders to keep everyone well-informed and focused on a world-class customer experience
  • Raises issues or suggests improvements to new features that advocate for user needs

Docs projects writing - 20%

  • Identifies and advocates for medium to large docs projects
  • Mentors less-senior writers on how to manage their time spent in docs-driven projects alongside new feature ships
  • Independently prioritizes the highest impact work beyond new feature ships

Title: Documentation Engineer II
Description:
Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond.

Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact.

 

WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU

You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits:

  • Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…)
  • Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding
  • Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays
  • Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material
  • The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers
  • As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules
  • An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals

JOB SUMMARY

As a Documentation Engineer II, you will be responsible for the creation and maintenance of documentation related to company products, processes, and training materials. This role involves collaborating with various teams to ensure that information is accurate, accessible, and effectively supports internal and external users.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

  • Become a Storyblok and headless CMS authority, helping developers, partner agencies, and customers to understand Storyblok and its capabilities, implement a headless architecture on their projects easily, and get the best out of Storyblok’s features.
  • Help developers understand and get value out of Storyblok by creating and maintaining developer tutorials, developer guides, FAQ entries, and API documentation.
  • Write sample applications, prototypes, and code samples to showcase the power and flexibility of Storyblok and the headless approach to content management.
  • Helping teammates overcome obstacles, resolving blockers, and completing work tasks.
  • Seeking guidance to increase your own experience. Sometimes mentoring teammates in an open, respectful, flexible, and empathetic manner.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • 5+ years of experience in web development.
  • Proven experience in technical writing and documentation.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field or equivalent experience.
  • Experience with CMS in general; experience with Headless CMS is a plus.
  • Thorough knowledge of consuming RESTful APIs. GraphQL APIs is a plus.
  • Working knowledge of at least one of the modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., Vue, React, Next, Nuxt, Astro, or Svelte) along with its fundamental principles.
  • Working knowledge of Git.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Good problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.
  • High attention to detail.
  • Continuous learning mindset to stay updated on industry trends and best practices in documentation.
  • Ability to learn and document technical topics efficiently and comprehensively.
  • Ability to assume the users’ perspective to convey technical information clearly.
  • Ability to work independently with little direct supervision.
  • Demonstrates AI literacy, with the ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking.

MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS

Remote (home) work opportunity or funded by Storyblok co-working space

GENERAL TERMS

We strive to create a hiring environment in which all people feel they are equally respected and valued, irrespective of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, religion, citizenship or any other characteristic. Title: Documentation Engineer
Description:
ABOUT THE TEAM:

The Developer Experience (DevX) team supports customers integrating and using Talon.One. The team is responsible for the product docs, developer docs, in-product UX copy, and the technical infrastructure behind the docs platform. Our primary audience spans two groups: marketing users operating the product (campaign managers, loyalty managers), and backend engineers integrating our APIs.

We use the docs-as-code approach. The content lives in GitHub and the documentation website runs on Docusaurus. The API reference is generated from OpenAPI specifications.

We are looking for a Documentation Engineer to help us extend our documentation platform and write new documentation for our customers. You will sit within the DevX team and work with Product teams. You write code and build tooling, and you also write documentation: reference content, integration guides, and developer-facing copy that no automation can produce to the right standard.

 

 

ONCE YOU ARE HERE YOU WILL:

  • Write reference documentation, integration guides, tutorials, and product documentation
  • Work in tandem with our current documentation engineer to find new ideas and solutions to current challenges
  • Co-own the pipeline from OpenAPI spec to published API reference: validation, transformation, and deployment
  • Build and maintain the scripts and CI jobs
  • Reduce manual work for the technical writing team through tooling and process improvements
  • Make deliberate decisions about how documentation is structured for AI agent consumption, not only human readers
  • Contribute to OpenAPI spec quality by working with writers and engineers on field naming, example coverage, and schema structure

 

WHAT WE NEED YOU TO BRING TO THE TABLE:

  • Developer empathy. You approach and write docs to increase an integrating engineer’s efficiency. You can produce clear, accurate content, not just tooling around it
  • You can write code without AI as a crutch. You write scripts, debug error output, and ship working solutions independently
  • Comfort with JavaScript/TypeScript. Our tooling uses it throughout
  • Fluency with CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience working with or reading OpenAPI 3.x specifications
  • Clear understanding of what makes documentation machine-readable, not only human-readable
  • Practical experience with AI tools, especially Claude. You use them daily and know how to prompt for useful output
  • A preference for correctness over volume. You know when to automate and when automation produces noise

 

OUR TECHNOLOGY:

  • Docusaurus for the docs site
  • GitHub and GitHub Actions for content workflows and CI
  • Scalar for API reference rendering
  • OpenAPI 3.x as the single source of truth for API docs
  • JavaScript/TypeScript for tooling and site customization
  • Claude for AI-assisted workflows

 

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU:
  • 90+ team of engineers, product managers and product designers in Berlin
  • Leaders with 8+ years of experience building our promotions engine
  • €1,000 annual learning budget and free German language courses to boost your skills
  • 30 days of annual leave, plus extra paid days for your birthday and moving day
  • Home office setup budget, a monthly home office allowance
  • Freedom to work from abroad for up to 90 days worldwide!
  • Mental health support with nilo.health and a discounted Urban Sports Club membership
  • 20% company subsidy on your pension contributions
  • Subsidised BVG public transport ticket and a dog-friendly Berlin office where your furry friend is welcome
  • Lease your ideal bike through BusinessBike

WHY YOU SHOULD WORK FOR US:

  • The right attitude: modern methods and a diverse, creative workspace with an open and international culture
  • Everyone for the product: Together we create a flexible, highly scalable product with state-of-the-art technologies. We can only succeed if everyone works as a team
  • Healthy Growth: Growing our company means growing everyone in the team. We love to share knowledge and learn
  • A great environment: Flexible and family-friendly environment, bright and easily accessible offices, modern software and hardware
  • High flexibility degree: Prefer to work early or late at night? Do you have to pick up your children from kindergarten? Do you prefer working abroad? We believe in results and motivated employees

Description:
Who We Are

VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore. 

VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. 

For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on LinkedIn #WeAreVML.

VML is in search of a PROGRAM MANAGER  – DIGITAL (Website, Platforms)

What you’ll do: 

  • Lead and manage website development projects and content initiatives, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams (designers, developers, content strategists, SEO specialists, marketing). Own project roadmaps, budgets, and resource allocation.
  • Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables, breaking down complex projects into manageable tasks and sprints. Develop and manage detailed project plans and timelines.
  • Proactively identify and mitigate potential roadblocks, ensuring projects stay on track, within budget, and meet quality standards. Implement project management best practices and optimize workflows.
  • Facilitate communication and collaboration between stakeholders, providing regular updates, reporting on project status, and managing expectations. Lead project meetings and presentations.
  • Oversee quality assurance throughout the website development and content creation process, establishing and enforcing quality standards and best practices.
  • Develop and manage content calendars and workflows, ensuring timely publication of high-quality, SEO-optimized content. Establish and maintain content style guides and governance processes.
  • Mentor and guide junior team members, providing support and fostering a collaborative team environment.

Who you are: 

  • Strategic thinker and problem-solver: Able to translate business goals into effective website and content strategies. Proactively identify and resolve challenges.
  • Excellent communicator and collaborator: Clearly communicate technical and non-technical information to various stakeholders. Facilitate cross-functional collaboration and build consensus.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented: Maintain meticulous organization and attention to detail in all aspects of project management.
  • Proactive and results-driven: Take initiative, anticipate needs, and drive projects to successful completion. Focus on delivering measurable results.
  • Expert in project management methodologies and tools: Deep understanding of Agile and Waterfall methodologies. Expert-level proficiency in project management platforms (e.g., Asana, Trello, Monday.com) and content management systems (CMS).
  • Technical understanding and web development lifecycle knowledge: Solid understanding of web design principles, development processes, content strategy best practices, and SEO.

What you’ll need: 

  • 5-7 years of experience in web project management or content management: Demonstrated experience leading and managing complex website development projects, content creation workflows, and content migrations.
  • Proven track record of successful website launches and content initiatives: Provide examples of successfully completed projects, highlighting key achievements, results, and contributions.
  • Deep understanding of website development lifecycle, content strategy, and SEO: Demonstrate expertise in web design principles, development processes, content strategy best practices, information architecture, and SEO.
  • Technical proficiency: Strong familiarity with CMS platforms (e.g., WordPress, Drupal, AEM), HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and website analytics tools. Experience with website accessibility standards (WCAG) is highly preferred.
  • Strong analytical skills: Ability to analyze website data, identify trends, and make data-driven recommendations to improve website performance and content engagement.
  • Client management experience (if applicable): Experience building and maintaining strong client relationships, presenting project updates, and managing client expectations.
  • Agency experience (a plus): Experience working within an agency environment or a similar collaborative setting.

Title: Technical Writer
Description:
Come join the organization that is redefining security for the AI era. As one of the fastest-growing startups ever, we enable teams to secure cloud and AI applications by connecting code, cloud, and runtime into a single shared context. Trusted by security teams all over the world, we have a proven track record of success and a culture that values world-class talent. Our Wizards from all over the globe work together to protect the infrastructure of our customers, including over 65% of the Fortune 100, who trust us to scan and secure over 230 billion files daily. We’re honored to be a leading player in a massive and growing market, and we continue to look for exceptional Wizards who are eager to make a significant impact on our team. At Wiz, you’ll have the freedom to think creatively, dream big, and use your full range of skills to contribute to our momentous growth. Come join our team and help us create secure cloud environments that allow even the best companies to move faster, all while having some fun!

Minimum qualifications

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in cybersecurity, cloud computing, and/or B2B SaaS.

We’re looking for a Technical Writer to join our Product team and help spread the power of Wiz. If you believe in the power of clear communication, have a sharp eye for detail, and want to be part of a strong, can-do team - we’d love to have you with us!

Title: Technical Writer Intern
Description:
About Zipline

Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products. 

Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.

 

About You and The Role  

The Technical Writing team builds and maintains a dependable documentation system that supports safe, effective work across Zipline’s products and operations.

We partner with engineering, operations, and support to translate complex technical and operational information into clear manuals, procedures, guides, references, onboarding materials, and troubleshooting content.

Our work spans the full documentation lifecycle, from understanding user needs and how systems operate to organizing, editing, reviewing, and publishing content.

We set a high bar for accuracy, clarity, consistency, usability, and timeliness while making it easier for people to find the right information at the right time.

What You'll Do  

  • Documentation Quality: Help review and improve manuals, procedures, guides, and other content for clarity, accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, and usability.
  • Training and Guide Refresh: Update materials to reflect current product behavior, use timeless language, and broaden content for the audiences and products it serves.
  • Information Architecture: Improve site navigation and content structure around user tasks and workflows so readers can reach the right information more easily.
  • Troubleshooting Guide Structure: Reorganize troubleshooting pages so context, prerequisites, and supporting information lead clearly into step-by-step guidance.
  • Contributor Onboarding: Simplify onboarding documentation by clarifying prerequisites, setup, contribution guidelines, review expectations, and the path from a proposed change to published content.
  • Technical Understanding: Read technical source material, ask questions about how systems and processes operate, and help identify documentation gaps or opportunities for improvement.
  • Review and Collaboration: Work with technical writers, engineers, and operations partners to validate accuracy, check clarity and page flow, and incorporate feedback.

What You'll Bring 

  • Educational Background: Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in English, Rhetoric and Composition, Technical or Professional Writing, Journalism, Communications, Information Science, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Writing and Editing: Strong editing and writing skills, with the ability to make documentation accurate, clear, specific, complete, and concise.
  • Technical Communication: Ability to explain technical concepts to people with different levels of technical familiarity.
  • Technical Curiosity: Interest in learning how software, hardware, and operational systems work, and willingness to learn from technical source material.
  • Organization and Information Design: Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, including the ability to structure complex information, evaluate priorities, and manage multiple documentation tasks.
  • Logical and Creative Thinking: Ability to think logically and creatively about how information should be structured for different audiences and tasks.
  • Collaboration and Independence: Collaborative, self-directed, and comfortable receiving feedback while making progress on defined projects

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Experience with version-controlled documentation workflows or content management systems.
  • Experience creating documentation for software, hardware, operations, or other complex technical domains.
  • Experience using AI tools to draft, edit, or review content, with an interest in developing responsible editorial workflows.
  • Interest in robotics, aviation, logistics, service operations, or other technical products.

 

What Else You Need to Know

Title: Service Engineer - Service Enablement
Description:
AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today’s five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.

Position Overview

We are seeking a talented and motivated Service Engineer to join the Service Enablement team, owning the RF and system-level correctness of every satellite service pass — from beamforming configuration through link budget validation to post-pass RF/RAN analysis. This role sits at the intersection of RF systems engineering, satellite payload configuration, and ground segment operations, responsible for configuring, validating, and troubleshooting satellite RF configuration against link budget and RF chain requirements, and for tracing anomalies back through telemetry, IQ captures, and LTE/RAN counters to root cause. This person works across ground station sites applying consistent, version-controlled configuration practices, and acts as a Service Enablement feature owner — defining acceptance criteria and KPIs for network/RF features, leading readiness reviews, planning validation from lab through in-orbit test (IOT) to production, and ensuring a clean technical handover to Operations, Service Delivery, and Service Assurance. 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead in-orbit testing and LTE end-to-end validation across the satellite payload, gateway RF chain, and RAN domains.
  • Own technical validation of satellite and gateway configuration files, digital beamforming scaling, DSA settings, frequency plans, ADC/DAC scale factors, and AGC loop parameters against per-pass link budget targets.
  • Perform RF and link budget analysis for LEO service passes, including FSPL vs. elevation-angle-dependent scan loss, EIRP and G/T budgeting, and beam pattern and pointing accuracy.
  • Analyze IQ domain captures to diagnose signal quality, calibration convergence, harmonic/interference effects, and beamforming performance.
  • Troubleshoot RF, RAN, payload, and gateway issues impacting LTE performance, mobility, handovers, multibeam operation, and customer experience, using telemetry, RF measurements, and RAN counters.
  • Define feature acceptance criteria, RF/RAN KPIs, validation plans, rollout strategies, and production readiness success metrics.
  • Lead cross-functional technical reviews, coordinating feature execution with R&D, Operations, Service Delivery, Service Assurance, and test teams.
  • Build and maintain custom diagnostic and visualization tooling (RF/telemetry dashboards, beam and spectrum visualizers, IQ analyzers) to accelerate pass analysis and troubleshooting.
  • Drive technical reporting, documentation, KPI reviews, readiness assessments, and production handover packages for management and stakeholders. 

Qualifications 

Education:

B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, RF Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in RF engineering, RAN, satellite communications, or wireless systems validation environments.
  • Practical understanding of link budget analysis for wireless links, free space path loss, elevation-angle-dependent scan loss, EIRP, G/T, interference mitigation, and RF measurement techniques.
  • Experience with IQ domain/DSP signal analysis, including spectrogram or FFT-based inspection, power-vs-time analysis, and identifying harmonic or co-channel interference.
  • Deep knowledge of LTE/RAN technologies.
  • Scripting/automation experience (Python, Lua, MATLAB) for configuration validation, telemetry parsing, and building custom analysis tools.
  • Proven ability to analyze test results, identify root causes, implement corrective actions, and drive issue resolution across multiple engineering teams.
  • Experience leading feature validation, production readiness, rollout planning, technical reviews, and operational handover activities.
  • Strong technical leadership and cross-functional collaboration skills, working effectively with R&D, Operations, Service Delivery, Service Assurance, and customer-facing teams. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

Soft Skills:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to technical detail.
  • Ability to work independently while coordinating with multiple engineering and operations owners.
  • Strong communication skills, including clear technical writing, concise issue summaries, and stakeholder-ready presentations.
  • Comfortable leading technical discussions, readiness reviews, and cross-functional alignment for features and service validation.
  • Comfortable operating in fast-paced test campaigns with changing priorities and cross-time-zone coordination.
  • Team player with an ownership mindset and the ability to drive issues from investigation to closure. 

Technology Stack:

  • Link budget analysis tools and RF measurement equipment.
  • IQ domain/DSP signal analysis tooling, including spectrogram and FFT-based inspection.
  • Python, Lua, and MATLAB for configuration validation, telemetry parsing, and custom analysis tooling.
  • Telemetry and LTE/RAN counter systems for cross-domain root-cause analysis.
  • Custom diagnostic and visualization tooling, including RF/telemetry dashboards, beam and spectrum visualizers, and IQ analyzers. 

Physical Requirements 

  • Ability to lift up to 25 lbs.
  • Ability to use a computer for extended periods.
  • Ability to work in an office and lab environment, including hands-on work with RF test equipment and ground station systems.
  • Ability to travel to ground station sites to support configuration, validation, and troubleshooting activities as needed.

Title: Lead Engineer, Computational Knowledge Graph
Description:
Who We Are & Why Join Us

Avathon is the leading Industrial AI autonomy platform, helping customers across heavy industries -- energy, mining, manufacturing, aerospace, defense, and logistics -- accelerate the journey toward autonomous operations. Our platform is built on a Computational Knowledge Graph foundation that contextualizes and connects operational data across siloed systems, bringing together time series, structured, unstructured, and machine vision data to power AI-driven applications in asset performance management, supply chain intelligence, visual AI, and global trade management. With capabilities spanning digital twins, normal behavior modeling, natural language processing, and computer vision, Avathon delivers real-time predictive intelligence and agentic decision-making at industrial scale.

Cutting-Edge AI Innovation -- Join a team at the forefront of AI, developing groundbreaking solutions that shape the future. High-Growth Environment -- Thrive in a fast-scaling startup where agility, collaboration, and rapid professional growth are the norm. Meaningful Impact -- Work on AI-driven projects that drive real change across industries and improve lives.

Learn more at: avathon.com

 

About Neon -- Our Computational Knowledge Graph Platform

Neon is Avathon's proprietary Computational Knowledge Graph (CKG) platform that combines:

  1. Knowledge Graph -- A network of connected facts, entities, and relationships
  2. Computation Graph -- Complex analytics and computations defined on top of the knowledge graph

Neon powers decision-intelligence applications across supply chain, manufacturing, and energy domains. It enables multi-hop graph traversals, nested data operations, real-time analytics, and seamless integration with ML/AI pipelines.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced CKG Lead Engineer to help design, develop, and scale our Neon platform. In this role, you will work on the full-stack development of our knowledge graph platform, from ontology design and schema modeling to query optimization and Python integration. You will collaborate with data scientists, product managers, and customers to build solutions that leverage Neon's unique computational capabilities. This is a mid-senior level position (5-7 years experience) that combines technical leadership with hands-on development.

You Will

  • Design and implement knowledge graph schemas, ontologies, and data models for complex domains (supply chain, manufacturing BOM, logistics)
  • Develop and optimize IQL (Intermediate Query Language) queries for multi-hop graph traversals, joins, and aggregations
  • Build data ingestion pipelines to populate and maintain knowledge graphs from diverse data sources
  • Implement computational functions and analytics on top of the knowledge graph
  • Integrate Neon with Python/NumPy for advanced analytics and ML model integration
  • Design and build APIs to expose knowledge graph capabilities to downstream applications
  • Optimize query performance for large-scale datasets (1M+ records)
  • Collaborate with product and data science teams to translate business requirements into graph solutions
  • Mentor team members on IQL, graph modeling, and Neon best practices
  • Contribute to platform roadmap and architectural decisions

You'll Have

  • 5-7 years of software engineering experience, with at least 2 years working with graph technologies or knowledge graphs
  • Strong proficiency in Python programming
  • Experience with graph databases or knowledge graph platforms (Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, TigerGraph, or similar)
  • Understanding of ontology design, schema modeling, and graph data structures
  • Experience with SQL and query optimization
  • Familiarity with REST APIs and web services architecture
  • Experience with cloud platforms (GCP preferred, AWS or Azure acceptable)
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to translate complex business requirements into technical solutions
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work with cross-functional teams
  • BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with RDF, SPARQL, or semantic web technologies
  • Knowledge of NLP/NER pipelines for entity extraction and relationship mining
  • Experience with ML model integration and MLOps
  • Familiarity with supply chain, manufacturing, or BOM data structures
  • Experience with time series data and IoT integration
  • Knowledge of graph algorithms (shortest path, centrality, community detection)
  • Experience with data visualization for graph structures
  • Contributions to open-source graph or knowledge management projects

Key Technologies

Category Technologies
Languages Python (primary), Scala, IQL
Graph Platforms Neon/Maana (proprietary), Neo4j concepts
Cloud GCP (primary), AWS, Azure
Data SQL, NoSQL, Time Series DBs
APIs REST, GraphQL concepts
ML Integration TensorFlow, PyTorch, NumPy
CI/CD Travis CI, Jenkins

Interview Process
