Title: Content Operations Manager - Center Of Excellence
Description:
Groupon connects 42 million customers with local experiences - restaurants, events, wellness and travel - and the million-plus merchants who deliver them. Our mission is to get people offline and into the real world at prices that make it possible. We're an AI-native company in the middle of a platform transformation, moving from a deals marketplace to an experience discovery platform that works for customers and merchants at the same time.

 

Groupon is building a Center of Excellence in Bengaluru, and we need Content Operations Managers who own quality end-to-end. AI now writes the first draft — your job is to be the judgment layer that makes it excellent, accurate, and trustworthy. You'll QA AI-generated content, hand-craft the marquee deals that carry the brand, and fix content escalations rather than just flagging them. If you've got a sharp editorial eye, work fluently alongside AI tools, and take ownership all the way to publish — this role is for you.

What You'll Do

  • QA and proofread AI-drafted content before it goes live, correcting issues in place
  • Give structured feedback that helps our AI content tools improve week over week
  • Hand-craft marquee, high-value deals (think Disneyland, Starbucks) end-to-end
  • Own content escalations from Sales, Merchant Service, and Customer Service — fix titles, descriptions, images, and fine print directly
  • Run the language-quality queue and hold the bar for language standards
  • Take on redemption, merchant-service admin, and content-specialist tasks as they consolidate into the team
  • Turn recurring content issues into policy, SOP, or AI-prompt improvements
  • Help decide which tasks get automated next
  • Keep every piece of content on-brand, accurate, and transparent
  • Partner across Sales, Merchant Service, Customer Service, Design, and Product
  • Track and share quality signals and trends for leadership

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, or a related field; advanced English (C1–C2)
  • Proven senior experience in content, editorial, or content QA — high volume, accuracy-focused
  • Exceptional editing and proofreading skills with a strong sense of house style
  • End-to-end ownership — you fix it, not just flag it
  • A root-cause mindset for recurring defects
  • Comfort tracking defect types, escalation volume, and turnaround time
  • Fluency (or a fast ramp-up) with AI content tools, and willingness to help calibrate them
  • Working knowledge of HTML and Markdown; comfort with visual-template changes
  • Adaptability in a fast-changing, high-automation environment

Must Have

  • Availability aligned with United States shift hours

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Groupon's markets and deal lifecycle

 

 

Groupon is an AI-First Company
We’re committed to building smarter, faster, and more innovative ways of working and AI plays a key role in how we get there. We encourage candidates to leverage AI tools during the hiring process where it adds value, and we’re always keen to hear how technology improves the way you work. If you’re passionate about AI or curious to explore how it can elevate your role you’ll be right at home here.

Groupon’s purpose is to build strong communities through thriving small businesses. To learn more about the world’s largest local e-commerce marketplace, click here. You can also find out more about us in the latest Groupon news as well as learning about our DEI approach. If all of this sounds like something that’s a great fit for you, then click apply and join us on a mission to become the ultimate destination for local experiences and services.

Beware of Recruitment Fraud: Groupon follows a merit-based recruitment process without charging job seekers any fees. We've noticed an increase in recruitment fraud, including fake job postings and fraudulent interviews and job offers aimed at stealing personal information or money. Be cautious of individuals falsely representing Groupon's Talent Acquisition team with fake job offers. If you encounter any suspicious job offers or interview calls demanding money, recognize these as scams. Groupon is not responsible for losses from such dealings. For legitimate job openings (and a sneak peek into life at Groupon), always check our official career website at Groupon Careers

Title: Enablement & Quality Manager - Customer Support | Remote, South Africa
Description:
At Workwize, we’re helping IT teams to easily equip their remote and global teams with all necessary IT equipment. Our automated SaaS platform simplifies hardware deployment, management, and retrieval with fast, reliable deliveries in 100+ countries.

With 50.000 users and 120.000 devices under management, we’re solving hybrid work challenges like laptop deliveries, returns and equipment tracking, allowing IT teams to focus less on manual hassles and more on strategic initiatives.

Join our team to help shape the future of global collaboration. At Workwize, your work will make a real impact in building smarter, more connected workplaces worldwide.

LinkedIn has also recognized Workwize as one of the Top 10 Startups for 2025 in the Netherlands!

Role Overview

Workwize is hiring its first Enablement & Quality Manager for Customer Support, a greenfield role where you'll build the function from the ground up rather than step into one that already exists.

You'll define how our support agents grow into this role, and build the way we measure that growth. That means designing a structured onboarding process to replace ad hoc, live-queue ramping, and building a quality function from the ground up. It's yours to shape from day one!

You'll get to work on a real, complicated product: global hardware logistics. You'll have a direct line to the function head, with a clear path to take on more ownership of the quality system.

Key Responsibilities

  • Learn the job on the queue and with every team lead, document the current onboarding process, and establish a baseline ramp measurement
  • Design and launch a structured onboarding programme, and restructure the knowledge base so it's maintainable long-term
  • Own the quality system end-to-end (sampling methodology, calibration sessions, scoring consistency, and trend reporting) and feed early trends back into the curriculum
  • Partner with the function head to keep the system aligned to their rubric and definition of "good." You build the system, they set the standard
  • Surface calibrated quality trends that team leads use to coach agents and drive individual improvement. You own the system, not the performance conversations it feeds
  • Own time-to-productivity and keep improving it, while keeping the knowledge base alive and current

Experience

  • Built a curriculum yourself, not just delivered one: You can show us the artefact (a ramp plan, knowledge-base architecture, or certification path) and explain the decisions behind it
  • Owned time-to-productivity as a number: You can walk us through a baseline, a method, and a result
  • Frontline credibility: You've worked a support queue, or equivalent hands-on experience
  • Supported a team at roughly this scale in a complex product environment

Nice to have

  • Stood up a QA scorecard and run calibration sessions
  • Used AI tooling for enablement (assisted authoring, automated QA sampling, or self-serve answers)
  • Owned an LMS or knowledge platform as a means, not an identity
  • Supported a distributed team across EU and US hours
  • Formal L&D qualifications are welcome but not required. Evidence of what you've built matters more

Technical Skills

  • Instructional Design: You understand chunking, practice over presentation, assessment that proves capability, and spaced reinforcement, whether that comes from formal training or hands-on experience
  • Content Operations: Comfortable setting a review cadence, assigning ownership per article, tracking what's gone stale, and raising maintenance needs before they become a problem
  • Measurement: Able to define a ramp metric, establish a baseline, and assess whether a change actually moved it
  • Quality Systems: Experience with sampling design, calibration, scoring consistency, and trend reporting, gained in any environment
  • Tooling: Familiarity with knowledge base and LMS platforms; experience with AI-assisted authoring or QA sampling is a plus
  • Domain Expertise: Able to get up to speed on a complex product quickly and teach it within weeks

Soft Skills

  • Influence Without Authority: Comfortable getting team leads on board to release agents for training and reinforce it afterward, even without direct authority over them
  • Credibility With Agents: Teaches rather than enforces, respecting that performance conversations belong to team leads
  • Intellectual Honesty: Willing to measure the impact of your own training honestly, including where it falls short, rather than managing around the results

Our Team

Becoming part of Workwize means making an impact. We make sure that we will contribute to the change in the way of working. For us it is also important that we make an impact on our employees, that they feel challenged and at ease. We consist of a rapidly growing and ambitious team with all different backgrounds: entrepreneurs, operational specialists, developers, sales gurus, you'll find them all at Workwize, and we're always on the lookout for the next original idea to reach more customers and create the best value for them.

We are looking forward to meeting you!

Title: Director, Product Development and Content Strategy
Description:
The Director, Product Development and Content Strategy, oversees the execution and management of ACOG's product development portfolio. This role is responsible for product lifecycle management, licensing and permissions operations, sales/fulfillment and distribution activities, and the implementation of initiatives that support organizational revenue and relevance growth and member value. The Director will maintain continuous evolution to product strategy considering industry trends, emerging solutions, new insights and changing customer and business needs, and use data to validate outcomes, drive insights, and manage the business both tactically and strategically. The Director will partner with the Senior Director, Product Development and Publishing, and executive leadership to establish short- and long-term product portfolio strategy. The Director will also coordinate with the Editorial team and other ACOG departments to define product vision, including actively seeking out new opportunities to further that vision. This role will work closely with the Editorial, Journals, and Marketing and Communications teams to deliver on content strategy initiatives and related products and outputs that further ACOG’s mission.

Note: This position is considered Hybrid and will need to commute to ACOG's office located in Washington, D.C.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • This position does have direct supervisory responsibilities and includes serving as a coach and mentor for the team.

Duties/Responsibilities:

  • In consultation with the Senior Director, Publishing and Product Development, define and lead growth strategies for ACOG’s clinical, educational, and consumer products. Ensure opportunities are aligned with organizational mission and business
  • Advise leadership on product opportunities. Develop business and financial models to generate business case for action. Set strategy and plans for product launch and market
  • Implement and manage product roadmaps. Inform and engage managerial and executive stakeholders to build alignment within the organization and with external
  • Oversee day-to-day traditional rights, licensing, and permissions workflows. Develop recommendations for strategy and process
  • Identify, evaluate, and support AI-related licensing and partnership opportunities, including content licensing for machine learning, data-driven products, and emerging digital platforms, assessing AI opportunities for fit with ACOG’s mission and goals.
  • Manage external fulfillment and distribution relationships. Develop and implement recommendations for strategy and process
  • Partner with Director, Brand and Content Design and the Editorial, Product Development, and Marketing and Communications team to oversee content strategy and revenue growth for ACOG’s consumer book portfolio and Every Stage Health web site.
  • Manage and facilitate ACOG Committees that support product development
  • Contribute to ACOG’s management and leadership initiatives, supporting work culture improvements and organizational
  • Provide leadership, direction, and management of staff, including fostering a welcoming and inclusive environment through supervising staff, providing feedback, coaching, support, mentoring, performance management, and training and development opportunities as appropriate. Make recommendations for organizational changes in response to portfolio and department growth.
  • Perform other duties as

Required Skills/Abilities:

  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • 7 – 10 years of product management experience, preferably at a medical society and/or in professional education.
  • Minimum of 3 years of supervisory experience.
  • Must have extensive complex budget management experience.
  • Strong business acumen to convey recommendations and influence leadership.
  • Excellent data synthesis skills to critically analyze and interpret market research and other data, to cultivate insights, and to apply those insights to develop business cases and plans.
  • Able to work with senior management across functions on complex projects and issues.
  • Effectively builds business cases and advocates for investment in new products/programs.
  • Deep understanding of publishing and content business models, sales strategies, and workflows.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software.
  • Demonstrated ability to meet tight deadlines and work under pressure. Strong leadership, staff management and team development, and project management skills and attention to detail required.
Salary Range
$120,000—$135,000 USD

Our Perks

Paid Parental Leave – Breastfeeding Friendly Workplace –  Flexible work schedule –  Commuting Allowance – Generous Paid Time Off – Holiday Pay – Life Insurance – Community Volunteering Opportunities – Generous 401(k) Company Contributions – Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance – Learning Opportunities and Tuition Reimbursement – Company-Sponsored Team Outings – and more!

Title: Senior Software Engineer, Knowledge Engineer
Description:
This is Adyen

Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition. 

For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

Documentation Tooling Team

The Documentation Tooling Team is responsible for building the systems and foundations that improve how technical knowledge is created, structured, and delivered across Adyen’s developer ecosystem. You will work on core challenges related to content quality, freshness, consistency, scalability and the ability to make information usable both for people and agents.

In this role, you will build the next generation of Adyen’s knowledge platform. This platform turns static documentation into structured, queryable knowledge.This includes structuring content, connecting content from multiple sources and building interfaces that make technical documentation accessible across products and tools as knowledge. Your work will power reliable, contextual and efficient access to information for customers, developers, AI agents and internal teams.

The team is a strategic part of the Developer Experience group within the Customer Experience solution. Our mission is to provide clear, accurate, and accessible knowledge that supports customers throughout their integration journey and helps them move quickly with confidence.

Core Focus Area

  • Content Architecture: Design scalable graph schemas, ontologies, and metadata models that support consistency, reuse, and discoverability across documentation.
  • Serverless Pipeline Orchestration: Own, configure, and optimize robust AWS serverless pipelines to ingest and process documentation from distributed sources.
  • Knowledge Systems Design: Design structured knowledge representations that allow information to be connected, navigated and queried programmatically.
  • APIs for Knowledge & AI Access: Build high-performance retrieval interfaces optimized for developer environments and AI agents.
  • Instrumentation and Quality: Implement automated controls and validation rules to detect documentation drift and ensure the long-term integrity of the knowledge platform.

What You’ll Do

  • Implement and deliver the next generation of Adyen’s Knowledge platform, establishing the foundation for intelligent and contextual knowledge delivery via AI native interfaces.
  • Design, configure and orchestrate serverless pipelines in AWS to ingest content from headless CMS and Git repositories.
  • Define the graph schemas, ontologies, and write highly optimized, idempotent queries to update and query the graph database.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally working closely with technical writers, product managers, and engineering teams, as well as a dedicated cloud team to ensure secure, resilient infrastructure deployments.
  • Contribute to engineering excellence through code reviews, mentor engineers, fostering a culture of excellence and performance.

Who You Are

  • You have deep production experience with Python and are proficient in designing serverless orchestrations using AWS Step Functions and AWS Lambda.
  • You are experienced with graph databases, specifically Neo4j and the Cypher query language, and understand how to build and evolve data ontologies.
  • You have experience building robust content-ingestion or ETL pipelines to extract and transform unstructured content (from sources like Git or Headless CMS) into graph databases.
  • You have experience designing performant APIs for complex retrieval. Knowledge of GraphRAG patterns or vector embedding integration (e.g., via Amazon Bedrock) is a strong plus.
  • You have a solid grasp of Infrastructure-as-Code (Pulumi) to manage your serverless pipelines, and you understand how to collaborate with cloud platform teams managing container workloads (Amazon EKS/Kubernetes).
  • You're an excellent communicator, able to translate strategy into technical initiatives and represent technical points of view to both engineering and writing audiences.

Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments 

Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen. 

Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!

What’s next?

Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here. Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.

This role is based out of our Amsterdam office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.

Title: Operations Enablement Manager
Description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Operations team
The Operations team delivers seamless customer experiences and enables new product capabilities while ensuring operational excellence. The team owns strategy, planning, technical execution, customer service, fraud operations, process design, quality, training, and program management. We drive efficiency, resolve issues quickly, and scale operations as the business grows. Our goal is to deliver seamless support while maintaining high standards and reducing risk.

About the role
Affirm is seeking a people leader to drive scalable, compliant, and high-quality servicing experiences across our Operations organization. In this role, you will define and execute strategies that enable our servicing operations to scale efficiently while delivering exceptional outcomes for customers and merchants. You will set the vision for operational readiness, ensuring people, processes, and enablement systems evolve in alignment with Affirm’s servicing strategy across multiple domains and programs. 

As a manager within the Operations Enablement team, you will own team-level strategy and lead a high-performing team responsible for delivering a portfolio of cross-functional initiatives tied to strategic priorities. You will be accountable for execution across timelines and dependencies, with clear ownership of measurable business impact. 

This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, Compliance, and vendor teams to ensure readiness for business and regulatory change. As a connective leader, you will translate strategy into action, driving adoption and outcomes through strong people leadership and disciplined delivery. We are looking for a hands-on, data-driven leader who thrives in complex, regulated environments and is passionate about building durable, high-quality servicing experiences at scale.

What you’ll do

  • Own Program & Team Performance: Lead and manage a team responsible for delivering complex, cross-functional programs and initiatives, ensuring alignment with servicing strategy, OKRs, and long-term business priorities.

  • Define Program Roadmaps: Develop clear program roadmaps and execution plans, tracking progress against KPIs, timelines, budgets, dependencies, and risks.

  • Partner for Impact: Collaborate closely with senior leaders and cross-functional partners across Product, Engineering, and Operations to align priorities and deliver measurable business outcomes.

  • Drive Stakeholder Engagement: Establish strong stakeholder engagement and governance practices, delivering clear, polished, and executive-ready communications on program status, outcomes, risks, and impact.

Title: Director/ Senior Director - Enablement Functions (Bangkok Based, Relocation Provided)
Description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.  

 

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

 

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Agoda is a leading global online travel platform connecting millions of travellers with accommodation, flights, and activities across 2 million+ properties in 200+ countries. As part of Booking Holdings, the world's largest online travel group, we combine the agility of a tech startup with global scale, investing heavily in data science, machine learning, and product innovation to make travel easier for everyone. 

The Opportunity 

Agoda's Customer Experience Group (CEG) is a large, globally distributed operation serving millions of customers through thousands of agents across owned sites and BPO partners. This role leads the Enablement Team Engine at the heart of CEG, the three interconnected functions that detect performance gaps, build capability, and drive adoption at scale. Talent Development, Quality Assurance and Change & Communications teams are all part of this function.  

With generative AI reshaping how we learn and work, QA automation raising the bar on insight quality, and major platform migrations underway in 2026, this is a pivotal moment to shape how 3,000+ agents and leaders grow, perform, and change.  

What You'll Do:

Strategic Leadership 

  • Set the vision and multi-year roadmap for Talent Development, Quality Assurance, and Change & Communications, ensuring they operate as one integrated Enablement engine aligned to CEG business priorities and OKRs. 
  • Champion the adoption of generative AI across learning, QA, and communications workflows, and lead the function through significant platform migrations and operational transformation. 

Talent Development 

  • Own the end-to-end learning architecture, onboarding, continuous learning, leadership development, and specialised upskilling, and drive measurable capability uplift using data from QA and operations to iterate fast. 
  • Embed coaching frameworks that empower leaders to develop their teams day-to-day, and partner with HR, Operations, and Product to build capability ahead of demand. 

Quality Assurance 

  • Lead a QA function that goes beyond scoring, build frameworks that generate actionable behavioural and performance insights, drive automation at scale, and establish calibration processes that ensure consistency across owned sites and BPO partners. 
  • Use root-cause analysis to influence process, product, and policy decisions upstream, not just to report scores. 

Change & Communications 

  • Lead CEG's change management capability for major transformations, build structured frameworks covering impact assessment, adoption tracking, and resistance management as standard practice across the organisation. 
  • Own CEG's internal communications strategy: leadership messaging, channel management, engagement programmes, and knowledge architecture that keeps a distributed global workforce informed and aligned. 

People Leadership 

  • Lead, develop, and inspire a team of 140 across three sub-functions, coaching direct reports to operate with strategic independence and building a high-performance culture with clear accountability at every level. 
  • Drive team engagement and retention; advocate actively for your people's growth and next career moves. 

Stakeholder Engagement 

  • Act as a trusted partner to CEG Operations, HR, Product, and Technology leadership, translating Enablement outputs into business impact and representing the function at senior leadership level. 
  • Manage BPO partner relationships to ensure Enablement standards are consistently embedded beyond Agoda's owned sites. 

What We're Looking For:

Required Experience 

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in Learning & Development, Quality, or Organisational Effectiveness, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role managing multi-functional teams. 
  • Demonstrated track record leading at least two of the three disciplines (TD, QA, Change & Communications) in a large, complex, customer-facing environment. 
  • Experience designing and scaling learning programmes, QA frameworks, or change initiatives in a contact centre, BPO-managed, or global operations context. 
  • Strong data orientation, you use metrics to make decisions, evaluate impact, and challenge assumptions, not just to report activity. 
  • Proven ability to lead through ambiguity and deliver in a high-velocity, iterative environment; comfortable with fast change and imperfect information. 
  • Excellent communication and influencing skills, able to engage credibly at C-suite level and on the contact centre floor. 
  • Experience managing or partnering with BPO / outsourced operations is strongly preferred. 

Preferred / Nice-to-Haves 

  • Experience with generative AI tools applied to learning design, QA automation, or communications.
  • Background in travel tech, e-commerce, or other high-volume digital consumer businesses.
  • Familiarity with knowledge management systems and content governance in large-scale operations. 

Why Agoda 

  • Scale that matters, your work shapes the capability and performance of thousands of customer-facing professionals across a global operation.
  • A data-first, fast-iteration culture where ideas are tested, results are measured, and good work is recognized, no politics, no bureaucracy for its own sake.
  • Access to the resources, best practices, and talent networks of Booking Holdings, one of the world's leading technology companies.
  • A genuinely diverse, collaborative team spanning dozens of nationalities, with a Bangkok Operational HQ that is a hub of energy, innovation, and opportunity.
  • Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and real scope to grow into broader CEG, Agoda or Booking Holdings leadership.

Title: Senior GTM Enablement Specialist ll
Description:
Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior ll GTM Enablement Specialist to join our team in Manila, Philippines. In this role, you will help drive and evolve our end-to-end enablement program, with a primary focus on new hire onboarding, content development, and ongoing education for our Support organization. You will lead in-person facilitation, partner closely with local operations teams, collaborate with enablement peers, and make data-driven recommendations to improve performance and support key business goals. 

This role is ideal for someone who is both a strong facilitator and a thoughtful program builder. You thrive in fast-paced environments, understand the nuances of SaaS support, and know how to translate performance metrics into targeted enablement strategies.

 

Responsibilities

Lead New Hire Onboarding (Manila, Philippines)
• Own the strategy, execution, and measurement of our 6-week onboarding program for new support hires
• Facilitate in-person onboarding experiences, ensuring sessions are engaging, relevant, and role-specific
• Maintain and continuously iterate onboarding documentation, checklists, and training resources
• Design onboarding certification processes and track ramp milestones to measure readiness and success

Ongoing Enablement facilitation designed
• Collaborate with the GTM Support Enablement Manager to identify enablement needs based on CSAT, QA, ticket/chat metrics, and product changes
• Co-develop ongoing training initiatives across key areas like tools, workflows, tone/quality, product updates, and customer experience best practices
• Create feedback loops and reporting mechanisms to ensure program effectiveness

Build Scalable Programs
• Design scalable learning paths for new hires and tenured agents, including live training, async/self-paced content, and certification tracks
• Use enablement tools (e.g., LMS, content hubs, feedback surveys, Maestro) to deliver, track, and refine training at scale
• Work cross-functionally with QA, Product, Support Ops, and L&D to align training with business goals

Measure and Iterate
• Define and manage success metrics for enablement programs (e.g., time to productivity, QA scores, CSAT, and knowledge assessments)
• Analyze qualitative and quantitative feedback to improve program structure, delivery, and outcomes
• Champion a culture of learning and continuous improvement within the support organization

 
Qualifications
  • 6+ years of experience in customer support, enablement, or training roles, with direct ownership of onboarding and learning programs
  • SaaS industry experience required
  • Proven ability to lead live in-person facilitation and instructional delivery, ideally with experience onboarding support agents or specialists
  • Strategic thinker with a track record of building programs that are data-informed and results-oriented
  • Strong experience using enablement or learning tools (e.g., LMS, Google Suite, Notion, survey tools, feedback dashboards)
  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills
  • Bonus: Familiarity with salesforce.com, Apollo.io, Maestro, Intercom systems

We are AI Native

Apollo.io is an AI-native company built on a culture of continuous improvement. We’re on the front lines of driving productivity for our customers—and we expect the same mindset from our team. If you're energized by finding smarter, faster ways to get things done using AI and automation, you'll thrive here.

Why You’ll Love Working at Apollo

At Apollo, we’re driven by a shared mission: to help our customers unlock their full revenue potential. That’s why we take extreme ownership of our work, move with focus and urgency, and learn voraciously to stay ahead.

We invest deeply in your growth, ensuring you have the resources, support, and autonomy to own your role and make a real impact. Collaboration is at our core—we’re all for one, meaning you’ll have a team across departments ready to help you succeed. We encourage bold ideas and courageous action, giving you the freedom to experiment, take smart risks, and drive big wins.

If you’re looking for a place where your work matters, where you can push boundaries, and where your career can thrive—Apollo is the place for you. 

Learn more here!

Title: Employee Enablement and Training Program Manager
Description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

We're seeking a creative, people-centered builder to transform how employees across Axon's Service, Support, & Training organization ramp, reach proficiency, and develop throughout their careers.

As an Employee Enablement and Training Program Manager for our Professional Services organization, you'll build and run a scalable onboarding and development program for the teams you support. You'll define what great readiness looks like and turn that into practical learning experiences, tools, and operating rhythms that managers and subject matter experts can sustain — starting with the highest-impact needs and scaling what works.

The ideal candidate has successfully launched an onboarding, enablement, and/or employee readiness program, loves developing people, moves quickly from ideas to execution, and brings creativity and experimentation to how employees learn, practice, and grow.

What You'll Do

Location: Scottsdale, AZ HQ; Travel 0%-30%
Reports to: Senior Manager, Operations
Direct Reports: 0

Onboarding & Role Readiness

  • Design, launch, and continuously improve onboarding and readiness programs for the teams you support.
  •  Partner with managers and SMEs to define what employees need to know and do, then build role-specific readiness roadmaps with clear learning, hands-on practice, and proficiency milestones.
  • Build reusable frameworks and tools that keep programs consistent while flexing to each team's needs.
  • Run structured check-ins through employees' first six months to reinforce learning, assess readiness, and close gaps.
  • Equip managers and SMEs with the guidance and tools they need to coach employees and validate proficiency on the job.

Ever-boarding & Employee Development

  • Build a plan for ongoing learning and skill development for the teams you support.
  • Partner with managers and SMEs to define role-specific skill and competency expectations.
  • Translate identified skill gaps into learning paths, refreshers, and practice opportunities.
  • Create engaging learning experiences — live sessions, shadowing, scenario practice, and recorded content.

Program Management & Continuous Improvement

  • Turn ambiguous team needs into clear, prioritized programs, and build iteratively.
  • Facilitate working sessions with managers, SMEs, and employees to define performance expectations.
  • Set success measures for learning effectiveness, proficiency, and time to readiness; use feedback and data to improve programs.
  • Use technology and AI-powered tools to make learning more personalized and efficient.

What You Bring

Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3-5 years of experience in onboarding, employee enablement, learning and development, or program management.
  • Demonstrated experience taking at least one onboarding or readiness program from design through launch, adoption, and measurement.
  • Strong program management and facilitation skills, with the ability to move quickly from planning to execution.
  • Ability to build competency frameworks, learning paths, and clear documentation.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to define success measures and use data to improve programs.
  • Experience with learning platforms, collaboration tools, or AI-powered tools is a plus.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Approach

  • Builder mindset — you're energized by creating something that doesn't exist yet and know how to turn ambiguity into action.
  • People-centered — you design around how employees actually learn, practice, work, and grow.
  • Creative — you challenge traditional approaches and find engaging ways to build knowledge, skills, and confidence.
  • Bias for action — you move quickly, test ideas, learn from results, and iterate rather than waiting for perfect solutions.
  • Curious — you immerse yourself in the work and learn directly from the people doing it.
  • Scalable thinker — you balance the unique needs of individual teams with the need for organizational consistency and sustainable solutions.
  • Collaborative and influential — you build trust, create shared ownership, and drive progress across teams without relying on direct authority.

Benefits that Benefit You

  • Competitive salary and 401k with employer match
  • Discretionary paid time off
  • Paid parental leave for all
  • Medical, Dental, Vision plans
  • Fitness Programs
  • Emotional & Mental Wellness support
  • Learning & Development programs
  • And yes, we have snacks in our offices

Title: Knowledge Manager
Location: Fort Eustis, Virginia, United States; Fort Leavenworth, Kansas, United States
Description:
Barbaricum is a rapidly growing government contractor providing leading-edge support to federal customers, with a particular focus on Defense and National Security mission sets. We leverage more than 17 years of support to stakeholders across the federal government, with established and growing capabilities across Intelligence, Analytics, Engineering, Mission Support, and Communications disciplines. Founded in 2008, our mission is to transform the way our customers approach constantly changing and complex problem sets by bringing to bear the latest in technology and the highest caliber of talent.

Headquartered in Washington, DC's historic Dupont Circle neighborhood, Barbaricum also has a corporate presence in Tampa, FL, Bedford, IN, and Dayton, OH, with team members across the United States and around the world. As a leader in our space, we partner with firms in the private sector, academic institutions, and industry associations with a goal of continually building our expertise and capabilities for the benefit of our employees and the customers we support. Through all of this, we have built a vibrant corporate culture diverse in expertise and perspectives with a focus on collaboration and innovation. Our teams are at the frontier of the Nation's most complex and rewarding challenges. Join our team.

Barbaricum is seeking a Knowledge Manager to support TRADOC G2 operations at Fort Eustis, VA, optimizing knowledge-sharing, collaboration, and data management across mission-critical operations. This role involves developing and maintaining knowledge repositories, streamlining information workflows, and enhancing data accessibility for decision-makers. The selected candidate will implement knowledge management strategies, facilitate cross-functional coordination, and ensure compliance with DoD data governance policies, enabling efficient access to mission-essential intelligence, training materials, and operational resources.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement knowledge management strategies to support TRADOC operations.
  • Maintain and update knowledge repositories and databases.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to identify and address knowledge gaps.

Title: Manager, Technical Training and Enablement
Description:
Bevi is on a mission to transform how beverages are delivered and consumed. Our connected beverage platform eliminates the need for single-use bottles and cans, making it easy, fun, and sustainable to stay hydrated. As the category leader in IoT-enabled beverage technology, we're building a future where Bevi machines are everywhere people live, work, and connect. We've raised over $160M in venture capital, serve thousands of customers across the US, Canada, UK and Ireland, and we've been rapidly growing year over year, saving over 1 billion bottles from waste. In addition to driving hypergrowth with our current product line, Bevi is heavily investing in new product development.

This role exists to ensure excellent Bevi client and partner experiences, delivered through excellent training, an excellent Bevi Help Center, and the clear processes and documentation behind them. You own that full system: how partners and internal technical teams learn to install, service, and sell our platform, and how well-equipped they are to deliver for the customer.

You lead a small, high-output team (an Instructional Designer and a Technical Content Manager) and own the enablement engine end to end: training, documentation, the Bevi Help Center (internal SOPs and Partner-facing technical content), and the LMS. You will build and scale both e-learning and in-person programs, partner closely with Sales, our partners, and Product and Engineering on new product introductions (NPI), and continually rethink how this function should work, using AI to drive efficiency and shape where it goes next. This is a hands-on role.

Your Day to Day

  • Team: Lead and develop the Instructional Designer and Technical Content Manager; set priorities and hold a high bar on quality and speed.
  • Training: Own onboarding and ongoing curricula for partner and internal/technical audiences (e-learning and in-person), including modules, tests, milestones, and readiness assessment. Onboard, upskill, and coach partner technicians, branch managers, and operations managers to drive efficiency in the field and technical proficiency.
  • Documentation and Help Center: Own the intake, accuracy, and upkeep of technical documentation, specs, and the Bevi Help Center, so clients, field teams, and partners always have the right guidance.
  • LMS: Administer the Learning Management System (e.g., Absorb) and authoring tools (e.g., Articulate or similar): users, content, content effectiveness, reporting, and completion tracking.
  • Cross-functional and NPI: Run a regular cadence with Sales, partners, and Product and Engineering to capture process guidance and turn new products and changes into training and docs on time. Drive communication and gain buy-in across the business and with partners.
  • Process and scale: Continuously improve how training, documentation, and the Help Center are built and managed; use AI to drive efficiency, measure effectiveness, and build structures that scale with our partner network.

Requirements

  • Experience building and running technical training or enablement programs, ideally across both internal teams and external partners or channel networks.
  • People leadership experience, or clear readiness to manage and develop a small team.
  • Working knowledge of LMS and authoring platforms (e.g., Absorb, Articulate), plus Salesforce, Zendesk, Google Workspace, and Atlassian (Confluence, Jira).
  • Ability to teach different learning styles across formats: verbal, written, video, and e-learning.
  • Excellent cross-functional communicator who gains buy-in, aligns stakeholders, and keeps a program moving.
  • A process builder who uses AI to find efficiency and rethink how training and documentation should work in the future.

Title: Knowledge Graph Software Engineer  - Clearance Required
Description:
About the Team

Here at BTI360, we’ve built a culture that’s passionate about developing software engineers. Software doesn't build itself. People do. In fact, teams of people do. That's why our primary focus is on developing better craftsmen, better teammates, and better technical leaders. By putting people first, we're not just giving our teammates more opportunities to grow, we're also raising the bar of the software we ship. BTI360 previously has been voted 10 years in a row as a TOP Place to Work by the Washington Business Journal.

BTI360 is seeking an Knowledge Graph Software Engineer who is passionate about transforming raw data into meaningful insights that drive strategic decision‑making. In this role, you’ll work closely with our engineers and mission teams to tackle complex business problems using emerging AI technologies — specifically by extracting and linking critical entities to build and curate scalable graph databases and knowledge bases. This role sits at the intersection of backend software engineering, knowledge representation, and applied AI.

 

What you will do in this role:

As a Knowledge Graph Software Engineer at BTI360, you will:

  • Lead end-to-end knowledge graph and knowledge base development efforts from problem definition to production, designing pipelines that extract, normalize, link, and organize information into scalable graph-based systems. 
  • Design and evaluate extraction and resolution workflows using sound methodologies and fit-for-purpose metrics to assess entity extraction, linking, relationship quality, and overall knowledge base completeness and accuracy. 
  • Translate business requirements into quantitative problems and communicate technical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders through reports, presentations, and direct customer engagement. 
  • Drive technical decision-making for schema design, ontology alignment, extraction approaches, and graph architecture based on mission needs, data quality, and long-term maintainability. 
  • Stay current with advances in knowledge representation and information extraction and introduce practical techniques, tools, and frameworks that improve graph construction, curation, and analytic value. 
  • Apply analytical and statistical methods to validate extracted insights, measure data quality, and support confident decision-making from structured and unstructured sources. 
  • Develop reports and whitepapers that evaluate solution alternatives based on impact, cost, technical feasibility, and alignment with strategic goals. 
  • Collaborate across teams to align on strategy, provide data science expertise, and contribute to proposals and strategic initiatives.  
  • Mentor junior data scientists by providing technical guidance, defining project direction, and sharing best practices in graph-oriented data modeling, extraction workflows, and knowledge base stewardship. 

The ideal candidate should possess the following skills:

  • Active Security Clearance (Secret or higher) or the ability to obtain one
  • Hands-on experience with graph databases such as Amazon Neptune, Neo4j, or related graph technologies.
  • Experience with source control (e.g. Git) and CI/CD pipeline tools such as AWS CodeBuild (preferred), Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions
  • Experience designing and implementing scalable, maintainable, and OOP based software in a containerized cloud environment (AWS preferred) leveraging foundational services for computing, identity management, and networking.
  • Experience developing backend services using Java and the Spring/Spring Boot framework (or similar relevant Java framework)
  • Experience with testing frameworks such as Junit (preferred), Mockito, or Spring Runner
  • Familiarity with API standards such as REST and HTTP, message-driven architectures, persistent storage layers, and distributed systems
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills necessary to perform job duties and collaborate with team members
  • Candidates must maintain a primary residence within a two hour drive of Herndon, VA to support onsite collaboration as needed.

Desired skills:

  • Familiarity with monitoring and observability stacks such as Prometheus/Grafana (preferred), CloudWatch, or ELK/EFK
  • Contributions to open-source libraries or community projects or personal projects
  • Experience with search technologies such as OpenSearch (preferred), Elasticsearch, or Solr
  • Experience working with streaming or event-driven architectures such as SNS/SQS (preferred), Kafka, Kinesis, AWS Step Functions, or Event Bridge
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform) and how to leverage DevSecOps pipelines to deliver code
  • Exposure to additional programming languages including shell scripting languages (e.g. Python, NodeJS, C#, Bash, PowerShell)
  • Exposure to modern AI-assisted software development workflows, including agentic development frameworks and LLM tooling
  • Familiarity with monitoring and observability stacks including OpenTelemetry, Splunk (preferred), Prometheus/Grafana, or CloudWatch

The base salary pay range for this role is $125,900 - $247,900. This range reflects base compensation only and does not include benefits, bonuses, or additional pay incentives associated with the opportunity.

BTI360 benefits for full-time teammates

  • Fully paid healthcare premiums
  • Competitive salaries and performance bonuses
  • Career development and in-house training 
  • Tuition Reimbursement 
  • Up to 5 weeks PTO plus 2 weeks of federal holidays 
  • 401K dollar for dollar matching up to 6% annually - vested immediately on day 1  
  • Giving Back: Serving communities locally and across the globe
  • Social Events (happy hours, golf tournament, BTI360 Family Festival and more)

Commitment to Fairness and Inclusion

At BTI360, we believe that unlocking the potential of others is not just a mission—it's the heart of our culture. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where every individual can grow each day, lead with humility, and do the right thing. Our core values guide us in developing software that makes a difference, primarily serving national security customers in the Washington, DC metropolitan area.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. We celebrate fairness and are dedicated to creating an environment of mutual respect and inclusion where everyone can bring their true selves to work.

Join us in a workplace where your contributions are valued, your growth is encouraged, and your potential is unlocked. Together, we develop great software fast and deliver exceptional solutions for our customers.

Title: AI Strategy & Enterprise Enablement Analyst
Description:
Position Overview:

Cadwell Industries is seeking an AI Solutions and Automation Analyst to build, deploy, and maintain the AI agents and automated workflows that improve productivity across our business functions. This role is the primary builder within Cadwell’s AI Center of Excellence, translating prioritized business problems into working solutions, then documenting and supporting them so they remain reliable long after launch.The position reports to the Manager, AI Strategy and Enterprise Enablement, who sets governance direction and enterprise priorities. This role carries the technical execution, participates directly in governance decisions, and maintains the shared documentation that allows either party to cover the other’s portfolio without loss of continuity. The successful candidate is a hands-on builder who is equally comfortable writing Python, mapping a support workflow with a department head, and explaining a risk control to an executive.

Key Responsibilities:

AI Solution Development and Automation
  • Design, build, test, and deploy AI agents and automated workflows against prioritized business use cases.
  • Integrate AI solutions with existing enterprise systems, including CRM, ERP, and internal data sources, using APIs, low code platforms, and agent orchestration tools.
  • Build and maintain prompt libraries, agent configurations, and reusable components for organizational reuse.
  • Evaluate AI platforms and tools alongside IT, contributing technical assessments on capability, security posture, cost, and integration fit.
  • Monitor deployed solutions for accuracy, drift, cost, and failure conditions, and remediate issues as the technical owner.
  • Own the operational foundation for AI work, including repository structure, environment separation, access management, and tool and license administration for the AI Center of Excellence.
Enterprise AI Enablement
  • Conduct workflow analyses with assigned business functions to identify where AI agents improve efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.
  • Serve as primary AI Center of Excellence contact for assigned functions, which may include Support, Implementation, Sales, Operations, Human Resources, Marketing, and Finance and Accounting.
  • Design and execute pilot programs and phased rollouts, including success criteria, test plans, and rollback conditions.
  • Build and report ROI measurement for deployed solutions, including baseline capture before launch, with pilot programs targeting at least a twenty percent reduction in manual effort or cycle time in the processes they address.
  • Partner with process owners on change management so that solutions are adopted rather than merely delivered.
Governance Participation and Operational Continuity
  • Co-author AI policies and governance artifacts covering ethical use, regulatory compliance, data privacy, and cybersecurity alignment.
  • Own AI use case intake, initial risk review, and application of the prioritization framework for assigned functions, with the Manager, AI Strategy and Enterprise Enablement as approver.
  • Implement human in the loop oversight and risk controls within every solution built, and document where those controls sit.
  • Operate strictly within Cadwell internal business processes, maintaining clear separation between AI Center of Excellence work and regulated product development, including the design controls and quality system that govern Cadwell products.
  • Define and enforce approved data classes for AI tools, ensuring that protected health information and regulated product data do not enter unapproved systems.
  • Serve as named alternate in Cadwell’s AI governance forum, and present to executive leadership on a defined cadence.
  • Maintain the AI Center of Excellence continuity assets as a standing accountability: the enterprise AI use case inventory, the AI tool and model register, the governance decision log, and runbooks for every automation in production.
  • Maintain documented coverage of this portfolio, and cross train on the portfolio held by the Manager, AI Strategy and Enterprise Enablement, so that either party can carry the work of the other without loss of continuity.
Adoption, Training, and Advisory
  • Contribute to AI adoption playbooks, internal prompting guidelines, and training materials.
  • Deliver hands on enablement sessions to business teams on approved tools and workflows.
  • Advise internal stakeholders on practical AI application, current tool capability, and known limitations.
Qualifications:

Education:

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Information Systems, Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare Informatics, Business Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Required Experience:

  • Two to five years of experience in software development, data analytics, automation, digital transformation, or business process optimization.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Python, with work samples or a portfolio of built solutions.
  • Hands on experience with generative AI platforms and large language model APIs.
  • Working experience with at least one AI agent framework, workflow automation platform, or agent orchestration tool.
  • Proficiency in SQL, and working familiarity with a visualization tool such as Power BI or Tableau.
  • Experience integrating systems through APIs.
  • Demonstrated ability to work directly with business stakeholders to define requirements and deliver against them.
  • Experience deploying and securing applications on a major cloud platform (GCP, AWS), including service configuration, secrets management, and identity/access controls.

Preferred Experience:

  • Experience in medical device, healthcare technology, or another regulated industry.
  • Exposure to AI governance, model risk management, or responsible AI frameworks.
  • Familiarity with CRM and ERP data models, with Salesforce and Infor Syteline experience preferred.
  • Understanding of cybersecurity and data privacy considerations in AI deployment.
  • Experience producing technical documentation intended for handoff.
  • Certifications in AI, machine learning, or AI governance and ethics.

Core Competencies:

  • Builder orientation with bias toward working solutions over analysis.
  • Systems level thinking and business process mapping capability.
  • Ability to translate technical concepts into executive level insight.
  • Documentation discipline, treating written handoff quality as part of the deliverable.
  • Sound ethical judgment and regulatory awareness.
  • Data literacy and analytical rigor in interpreting AI performance metrics.
  • Collaborative posture across functions with varying levels of technical fluency.

Travel and Work Requirements:

This position is remote, with a minimum of one week onsite each quarter at our corporate office. Additional travel as business needs require.

If you are interested in applying for employment and need special assistance or an accommodation to apply for a posted position, contact our Human Resources department at careers@cadwell.com.

Salary Range
$95,000—$130,000 USD

Title: Sales Enablement Manager
Description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Sales Enablement leader to architect the growth journey for our global sales organization. At Canonical, sales enablement isn't just about onboarding; it’s about ensuring our teams can articulate the complex value of Ubuntu, OpenStack, and AI infrastructure to the world’s most sophisticated tech leaders. You will act as a trusted partner to identify, scope, and implement tooling and workflow improvements that drive efficiency and reduce friction in the sales process. You will sit at the intersection of Product, Marketing, and Sales, transforming high-level strategy into actionable field excellence.

If you are an experienced leader ready to lead global strategy, you will find a high-performance environment that challenges you. You will work with Sales Leadership to identify performance gaps, reduce ramp time, improve productivity and increase win rates. This is a high-visibility role where you will ensure our "distributed-first" workforce remains the sharpest in the industry.

Location: These are EMEA-based remote roles.

The role entails

  • Lead enablement programs to drive continuous improvement in sales productivity and ramp time
  • Lead the design and execution of global sales enablement strategies to drive revenue growth 
  • Provide coaching and mentoring that incorporates sales strategy, process and proven sales methodology
  • Drive the creation of advanced sales plays and competitive intelligence resources for enterprise markets
  • Collaborate and align cross-functionally with Sales, Revenue Operations, Product, Marketing, and all GTM teams to ensure enablement strategy supports broader organizational objectives
  • Own the end-to-end sales onboarding experience, ensuring new hires reach peak productivity rapidly
  • Identify and deliver training needs for Sales teams for continuous improvements
  • Collaborate with Product Management and Marketing to translate technical roadmaps into value-based sales narratives
  • Manage the sales enablement tech stack (CRM, LMS, etc.) to ensure tools are optimizing, not hindering, the sales process through right-time right-place delivery
  • Provide a framework to relevant teams to develop and maintain high-quality sales assets, including discovery guides, pitch decks, and battlecards
  • Facilitate live and virtual training sessions on advanced product features and sales techniques
  • Coordinate the logistics for global sales training events and twice-yearly "sprint" weeks
  • Monitor, report and act on the adoption and effectiveness of enablement initiatives using data-driven insights
  • Support the senior team in preparing reports for leadership and auditing sales documentation for accuracy

What we are looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Demonstrated experience coaching sales leaders and diagnosing business challenges to drive organizational improvement
  • Proficiency in a modern sales methodology such as MEDDPICC – able to coach leaders and sellers using this methodology
  • Ability to align and influence others, establish direction, achieve consensus, and execute
  • Experience building enablement programs from the ground up in emerging or high-growth markets
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Leadership and commitment to skills development and mentorship
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organization
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills

  • Experience in sales enablement, technical training, or sales operations (level-dependent)
  • Proficiency with Salesforce, modern LMS platforms and project management tools (e.g. Jira)
  • Basic knowledge of cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Canopy, Draper, UT

Title: Senior Director, Content Strategy & Corporate Communications
Description:
ConnectWise is an industry and Global leading software company with over 3,000 colleagues in North America, EMEA and APAC. As a community-driven software company dedicated to the success of technology solution providers, our suite helps over 45,000 of our partners manage their businesses better, sell more efficiently, automate service delivery, and remotely control technology so they can consistently deliver amazing customer experiences.

Our company is powered by our connections, our colleagues, and our community. And, we accept all kinds.

Game-changers, innovators, culture-lovers—and humankind.

We invite discovery and debate. We recognize key moments as milestones.

We see you and value you for your unique contributions. Our inclusive, positive culture lays the foundation to ensure every colleague is valued for their perspectives and skills, giving you the choice of how YOU make a difference.

Curious? Read this opportunity to learn how YOU can make a difference at ConnectWise!

 

 

The Senior Director of Content Strategy & Corporate Communications is responsible for leading a combined Content and Corporate Communications function focused on translating ConnectWise business priorities into a clear, consistent, measurable content and communications engine. This role leads narrative evolution and governance, content strategy, editorial direction, executive communications and thought leadership, public relations, internal and partner communications, social and community engagement, reputation reporting, crisis communications readiness, and communications operations. 

Reporting to the VP, Brand, this leader manages a multidisciplinary team of content and communications professionals and builds the operating model, tools, reporting, AI-enabled workflows, and governance needed to improve quality, speed, consistency, stakeholder alignment, reputation visibility, partner experience, and measurable business impact at scale. 

This is a hands-on Senior Director role that combines strategic leadership with practical editorial, communications, people leadership, and operating model ownership. The role is supported by a team of specialized owners across PR, internal communications, partner/email communications, social media, content calendar and asset lifecycle operations, experiential content, editorial production, and blog/content execution. 
 

Essential Duties & Responsibilities: 

  • Leads the Content Strategy & Corporate Communications function spanning narrative governance, blog and asset strategy, event content partnership, executive thought leadership, PR/media relations, partner communications, internal communications, social media and third-party community engagement, crisis communications, reputation analytics, content operations, and editorial standards. 
  • Owns short- to long-term execution of the content and communications strategy, operating plan, and roadmap aligned to ConnectWise priorities, the brand narrative, ConnectWise Platform differentiation, PSA, AI/automation, CW Agentic, product launches, partner experience, pipeline quality, renewal durability, and revenue growth priorities. Aligns stakeholders on objectives, audiences, messaging, timing, review cycles, approvals, content reuse, and execution plans. 
  • Evolves and governs the ConnectWise narrative, ensuring consistent messaging across brand, product, partner, event, executive, demand generation, social, PR, internal, and sales/partner enablement content. 
  • Provides editorial direction for priority content including blogs, long-form assets, executive thought leadership, event content, partner-facing communications, internal updates, media materials, and reputation-sensitive messaging. 
  • Oversees the Content Team Lead and Content Marketing Specialist to ensure content calendars, briefs, asset lifecycles, blog promotion plans, activation, and performance tracking are disciplined and aligned to business priorities. 
  • Oversees the Senior Manager, Public Relations & Communications to ensure PR, partner communications, email communications, internal communications, agency coordination, media engagement, and risk/escalation processes are strategically aligned and well executed. 
  • Oversees the Social Media Manager to ensure owned social channels, employee advocacy, executive social content, social reporting, and online engagement align to company narrative, partner experience, and reputation goals. 
  • Oversees the Senior Experiential Content Manager to ensure event content, track strategy, speaker bureau operations, executive speaking opportunities, session narratives, and post-event content repurposing support brand priorities, product priorities, partner needs, and business outcomes. 
  • Oversees the Content Production & Editorial Manager to ensure style governance, copyediting, proofing, editorial quality control, contractor management, and copy standards improve consistency across the team. 
  • Leads executive communications and thought leadership strategy in partnership with executives, VP of Brand, Corporate Communications and Content team, PR agency partners, and other stakeholders, ensuring each piece reflects the appropriate defined executive voice and advances priority narratives. 
  • Owns reporting and analysis across content performance, Share of Voice, sentiment, reach, engagement, message pull-through, media quality, social/community insights, executive visibility, partner/internal communications engagement, and operational health. 
  • Leads crisis communications strategy, readiness, monitoring, escalation model, approvals, execution, and post-incident learning in partnership with Security, Legal, Product, Partner Experience, Support, People/HR, and executive stakeholders. 
  • Owns the operating model for monitoring and automation of reputation signals across media, social channels, Reddit, online communities, and other third-party discussion forums, with a clear decision matrix and escalation paths. 
  • Builds and optimizes tools, dashboards, AI-enabled workflows, automation, templates, playbooks, intake processes, governance, review cycles, and measurement cadences that improve speed, consistency, insight quality, and team scalability. 
  • Leads, prioritizes, mentors, and coaches team members; clarifies roles, responsibilities, goals, development plans, decision rights, operating cadences, and success measures as the restructured team matures. 
     

Knowledge, Skills, and/or Abilities Required: 

  • Mature, level-headed, strategic, proactive, thorough, collaborative, resilient, and able to exercise sound judgment in high-pressure and ambiguous situations. 
  • Exceptional leadership, coaching, stakeholder management, customer/partner orientation, cross-functional collaboration, and executive influence skills. 
  • Executive presence well-suited for advising senior leaders, interacting with agencies and media, and representing the function in internal and external-facing situations. 
  • Strong editorial judgment and ability to translate complex technical, product, platform, AI, partner, operational, and reputational topics into clear and audience-relevant content and communications. 
  • Excellent writing, editing, presentation, and verbal communication skills, including the ability to shape executive voices, message sensitive topics, and improve content quality without creating unnecessary friction. 
  • Ability to build and govern narratives, messaging frameworks, editorial standards, style guidance, content workflows, communications playbooks, review cycles, and approval processes. 
  • Strong analytical capability and comfort using data to evaluate content and communications performance, identify risks/opportunities, and guide recommendations. 
  • Deep understanding of PR, media relations, crisis/issues management, internal communications, partner/customer communications, executive communications, content strategy, social/community engagement, and reputation management. 
  • Moderate to high fluency in strategically using AI tools as part of daily workflow, with the expectation to continue building skills and optimizing processes for self and across the team. 
  • Familiarity with content management, project management (Asana, Monday), media monitoring, social listening, email communications, intranet/content management (SharePoint, DAM platforms), SEO/content optimization, marketing automation/CRM, analytics, and dashboard/reporting tools. 
  • Ability to work constructively and independently under stress and pressure in a fast-paced, multi-tasking environment with competing priorities and sensitive business needs. 
  • Strong organizational skills, tact, discretion, emotional intelligence, practical judgment, and exemplary interpersonal skills. 
     

Educational/Vocational/Previous Experience Recommendations: 

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent business experience. 
  • 10+ years of relevant content strategy, corporate communications, public relations, executive communications, internal communications, editorial, brand, product marketing, integrated marketing, content operations, or related experience; SaaS experience preferred. 
  • 4+ years of people management experience, including experience leading a small to medium multidisciplinary team; experience managing or mentoring a people manager/second-line leader preferred. 
  • Experience in B2B SaaS, cybersecurity, IT management, managed services, enterprise software, MSP/managed services, or partner/channel-led businesses preferred. 
  • Proven experience advising executives, managing agencies/vendors, and partnering cross-functionally across Marketing, Product, Sales, People/HR, Legal, Security, Customer Success, Partner Experience, Support, and Events organizations. 
  • Experience creating and governing content and communications across blogs, long-form assets, executive thought leadership, PR/media relations, crisis communications, social, internal communications, partner-facing materials, campaign content, events, and sales/partner enablement. 
  • Successful track record of leading teams to strong outcomes while improving tools, workflows, reporting, editorial standards, communications readiness, and operating rhythm. Writing samples required. 
     

Working Conditions: 

  • Remote, U.S.-based role; Eastern Time core working hours preferred. 
  • Approximately 15% travel may be required for team meetings, executive meetings, ConnectWise events, industry events, and media or speaking opportunities. 
  • May require availability outside normal business hours for time-sensitive communications, crisis response, executive communications, events, launches, or regional needs.
