Title: Enablement Business Partner
Description:
Who we are:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About the Role:

Motive’s Enablement team plays a critical role in the strategic implementation of key business initiatives, ensuring our frontline teams are equipped to win. We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented Enablement Business Partner, to develop and execute enablement efforts across a portfolio of teams in our Enterprise business segment.

This is an individual contributor role responsible for the qualification, design, delivery and measurement of impactful enablement interventions and resources that equip our GTM teams with the knowledge, skills, and tools they need to exceed their goals. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of sales dynamics across direct and channel motions, experience in a quota-carrying role, and demonstrated success in enabling large, global teams to achieve measurable results.

What You'll Do:

  • Field Enablement Execution: Designs and implements enablement strategy aligned with Motive's global sales objectives. This includes adapting existing programs and creating new solutions to address the specific needs of the Enterprise team.
  • Domain Expertise: Understanding and experience working with different sales motions (Direct vs Channel Sales) and different roles within a sales ecosystem (Business Development, Account Executives, Account Managers) and their unique needs to develop tailored enablement initiatives that directly connect to specific business goals.
  • Proactive Field Intelligence: Collect and synthesize field intelligence through call listening, individual and small group interviews with reps, conversational intelligence, and partnership with teams such as AI Operations and QA. Leverage insights to refine enablement solutions and recommend interventions that close gaps or multiply successes.
  • Peer Collaboration: Partner closely with a team of global enablement professionals, including peers who support Enterprise field enablement, fostering collaborative relationships, resource sharing, and continuous learning.
  • Program Management & Execution: Own the end-to-end lifecycle of enablement initiatives, ensuring effective planning, documentation, execution, and measurement of work. 
  • AI Solution Development: Create new enablement solutions and adapt existing resources as needed for your segment, including AI tools, sales playbooks, product updates, competitive intelligence, and best practices for upselling/cross-selling, ensuring relevance and accuracy to the sales motion.
  • Coaching & Facilitation: Leads large-scale live training and small-group coaching sessions with high-energy, authenticity, and a positive spirit. We’re looking for someone who can go beyond a slide deck and create an engaging, interactive, and motivating environment for GTM teams

What We're Looking For:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 3+ years of experience in sales enablement or a related role within a high-growth, B2B SaaS organization, with a strong preference for experience in international markets.
  • Proven track record of building and scaling enablement programs across multiple organizations and regions.
  • Experience building enablement solutions with AI technology (e.g., Glean, Claude, Gemini, etc.). 
  • Certified in at least one sales methodology (e.g., Challenger Sale, Force Management, Solution Selling, Value Selling)
  • Strong understanding of adult learning principles and instructional design methodologies, with the ability to create engaging and effective learning experiences for a global audience.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, facilitation, coaching, and influencing skills, with the ability to build strong relationships and influence stakeholders at all levels, across different cultures.
  • Demonstrated history of customer-first, results-orientation, ownership, and a proactive approach to problem-solving in a fast-paced, ambiguous, and entrepreneurial environment.
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce) and sales engagement tools used by global teams

Title: AI Engineer, Internal Enablement & Productivity
Description:
Company Description

Govini transforms Defense Acquisition from an outdated manual process to a software-driven strategic advantage for the United States. Our flagship product, Ark, supports Supply Chain, Science & Technology, Production, Sustainment, Logistics, and Modernization teams with AI-enabled Applications and best-in-class data to more rapidly imagine, develop, and field the capabilities we need. Today, the national security community and every branch of the military rely on Govini to enable faster and more informed Acquisition decisions.

Job Description

 

We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to join our AI Enablement team, focused on rapidly increasing internal employee productivity and operational efficiency across the company by scaling robust AI integrations and agentic workflows.  This role will be central to designing and deploying agents to handle complex, end-to-end tasks, driving measurable improvements in how our core teams (e.g., Product, Engineering, Operations, and Customer Success) work. This strategic and execution-focused role will lead our internal AI Enablement roadmap, initially focusing deeply on improving core departments (e.g., Sales, Marketing, Product, Engineering, Operations, and Customer Success) through agentic automation.

You'll leverage best-in-class AI tools and AI agents (e.g. Gemini and other LLMs) to dramatically increase employee productivity, drive down operational costs, and enable our teams to deliver faster, better outcomes at scale. Your goal is to build our foundation for an AI-enabled future, implementing AI-driven workflows and agents throughout the organization, starting with internal operations and coupling workflows across key functions like GTM.

To do this job well, we are looking for someone who can demonstrate project(s) built on LLMs that showcases your skill at reliably automating complex tasks.
  • Experience integrating and working with LLMs, with a strong understanding of their capabilities and limitations
  • Experience integrating and working with agent frameworks (e.g. Claude Agent SDK, Google Anti-Gravity,  OpenAI Agent SDK)
  • Experience building observability, evaluation, and feedback loops for agent behavior (telemetry, prompt evaluation, regression testing, and reliability metrics).
  • Experience working in highly ambiguous environments, and operate with urgency
  • Startup experience, particularly in scaling products from zero to one

Strong Candidates have:

  • Deep experience leveraging agents across applications and business workflows to drive meaningful impact
  • Experience designing and deploying complex agentic systems using LLMs (e.g. deep research)
  • Hands-on work with multi-agent coordination, routing, and tool orchestration

This role is a full-time position located out of our office in Arlington, VA or Pittsburgh, PA.  This role may require up to 25% travel.


Scope of Responsibilities
  • Designs and builds multi-agent systems with tool use, memory, routing, and planning to automate internal business processes and enhance employee capabilities.
  • Develops Agent Skills and tools as modular, composable services that interact with backend systems, models, and data processing to increase internal team velocity.
  • Contribute to the technical architecture and engineering standards for internal agentic systems, ensuring scalability, reliability, and maintainability across the organization.
  • Assist with automated evaluation of agents, skills, and prompts across the entire product lifecycle to ensure reliable internal tools.
  • Partner with internal Product, Engineering, GTM, and Operations teams to identify and implement AI-driven solutions to optimize their workflows and reduce operational costs.

How We Define Success (Key Metrics)Internal Team Enablement (Operations, Customer Success, Engineering)

  • Operational Cost Savings: Reduce operational expenses for targeted teams through workflow automation via AI agents.
  • Employee Productivity: Achieve measurable increases in internal team capacity and velocity through AI-driven workflows and tools.
  • Internal Adoption Rate: Achieve a high adoption rate of new AI agents and enablement tools within key departments within the first 90 days.
  • Accelerated Development: Reduce feature development timelines through AI-assisted coding, documentation, and testing tools.

Qualifications

  • U.S. Citizenship is required

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor's, Master’s, or Doctorate in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, or a related field
  • Minimum 3 years of experience building and deploying ML or LLM-powered systems in production environments
  • Practical experience in building, developing, and productionizing machine learning systems
  • Advanced software skills in Python and other programming languages
  • Experience with common LLM algorithms and implementations, including coding agents (e.g. Claude Code and GenAI coding best practices).
  • Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure (e.g. AWS, GCP)
  • A strong desire to learn and investigate new technologies
  • Familiarity with Git source control management
  • Ability to work collaboratively with little supervision
  • A burning desire to work in a challenging fast-paced tech environment
  • A burning desire to work in a challenging fast-paced tech environment

Desired Skills:

  • Current possession of a U.S. security clearance, or the ability to obtain one with our sponsorship
  • Experience in or exposure to the nuances of a startup or other entrepreneurial environment
  • Experience with modern front-end frameworks (e.g., React, Next.js, or similar) and API-driven UI architectures

Job Description

We are seeking an exceptional and experienced Senior Content Operations team member, a role for someone who shares our passion and obsession with quality. You will be a core member of our Product and Engineering team dedicated to helping our clients replace time-consuming, manual processes to achieve informed, real-time decisions about government markets, competitors, and agency relationships. The ideal candidate is a hands-on analyst with large dataset experience. You must also possess strong interpersonal skills to work cross-functionally across internal teams and with Govini platform Subject Matter Experts (SMEs).

You will support the Content Analyst Manager in overseeing two offshore teams across split shifts, ensuring the delivery of high-quality, fast-turn validation and QA. This role involves assisting with day-to-day team management, workload prioritization, and performance support while maintaining high-confidence accuracy across every data point. You will own feedback loops and process improvements—leveraging technical skills to reduce rework, improve scalability, and strengthen overall execution—while reporting progress, risks, and outcomes directly to the Content Analyst Manager.

This role is a full-time position located out of our office in Pittsburgh, PA. 

This role may require up to 10% travel

Scope of Responsibilities

The Senior Team member you will manage and provide leadership for two offshore teams, overseeing daily workflow, assignments, prioritization, throughput, and SLA delivery. This includes consistent coaching (calibrations, feedback, 1:1s/lead check-ins) to maintain morale and accountability across different cultures and hours, as well as escalating risks, resourcing gaps, and performance concerns to the Content Analyst Manager.

The role also involves overseeing manual QA and validation, especially for high-volume checks with quick turnaround. Key responsibilities include triaging requests, prioritizing workloads, meeting SLAs, establishing feedback loops to reduce errors and improve accuracy, and documenting issues and resolutions to enhance future execution. Daily/weekly status updates on volume, trends, and blockers are required.

Further responsibilities encompass maintaining and improving SOPs, QA guidelines, and validation standards; tracking key performance metrics and risks; leading calibration and review routines; and supporting performance coaching and skill development.

Qualifications

  • U.S. Citizenship is required
Required Skills:
  • 3+ years of experience in content operations, data operations, research operations, data QA/validation, or similar roles supporting structured data workflows
  • 1–3+ years experience leading analysts or data QA teams (including offshore and/or shift-based coverage preferred)
  • Proven ability to manage high-volume validation work with tight SLAs, competing priorities, and frequent context switching
  • SQL and Python experience
  • Experience working with structured datasets, logs, and validation outputs to identify root causes and reduce rework
  • Familiarity with data QA concepts (sampling methods, error categorization, trend tracking, and continuous improvement loops).
  • Demonstrated success in coaching teams, improving performance, and maintaining high-quality standards
  • Strong judgment and attention to detail when validating complex relationships and resolving ambiguous cases
  • Excellent written communication — able to document decisions with clear reasoning and auditable source support
  • Ability to prioritize, triage, and execute quickly while maintaining consistent quality
  • Strong stakeholder communication skills and the ability to coordinate across multiple workstreams
  • Comfortable operating in a “supporting leader” capacity and reporting outcomes, blockers, and risks upward
Desired Skills:
  • Current possession of a U.S. security clearance, or the ability to obtain one with our sponsorship
  • Experience in or exposure to the nuances of a startup or other entrepreneurial environment
  • Ability to translate operational problems into simple technical solutions (query-based checks, automated sampling, error flagging, process instrumentation)
We firmly believe that past performance is the best indicator of future performance.  If you thrive while building solutions to complex problems, are a self-starter, and are passionate about making an impact in global security, we’re eager to hear from you.

Title: Director of GTM Enablement
Description:
Company Description

Govini transforms Defense Acquisition from an outdated manual process to a software-driven strategic advantage for the United States. Our flagship product, Ark, supports Supply Chain, Science & Technology, Production, Sustainment, Logistics, and Modernization teams with AI-enabled Applications and best-in-class data. Today, the national security community and every branch of the military rely on Govini to enable faster and more informed Acquisition decisions.

Job Description

We are looking for a strategic, hands-on Director of GTM Enablement to build and lead our enablement function across the full customer lifecycle - Sales, Delivery, and Customer Success. You will own the systems, content, and coaching that turn new hires into productive sellers, equip Engagement Managers and Implementation Engineers to deliver lasting outcomes, and arm Sales and Customer Success to win, renew, and expand. You are the connective tissue between Sales, Delivery, Marketing, Product, and Sales/Delivery Operations.
 
You understand that enablement is a revenue function, not a training function. Outcomes -  ramp time, win rate, time-to-value, NRR - are the metrics that matter, and you can build the programs that move them. You are equally comfortable designing a 30/60/90 ramp plan, facilitating a methods workshop, coaching an Engagement Manager, or briefing Sales leadership on enablement ROI.
 
This role is based in our Arlington, VA office, with up to 25% travel across our commercial and federal markets.

Scope of Responsibilities

Onboarding, Training Support  & Coaching

  • Implement and reinforce our standard sales qualification methodology (SPICED) across the GTM organization 
  • Design the manager coaching cadence and skills-based development framework for both Sales and Delivery leaders
  • Support SL&D in role-based onboarding and certification programs for Sales, EMs, IEs
  • Support SL&D in Ark product deep-dive certification for Delivery (EMs/IEs) and ongoing product/competitive training for Sales

Content & Equipping

  • Own the centralized GTM content library -  taxonomy, governance, and discoverability - and the playbooks, talk tracks, battle cards, and competitive intelligence that live in it
  • Own the delivery playbook and customer-facing templates (kickoff decks, QBR/EBR frameworks, status reports) in partnership with Delivery Leadership

Sales-to-Delivery & Customer Lifecycle

  • Own the Sales-to-Delivery handoff playbook, internal kickoff standards, and customer-context transfer requirements, plus a handoff quality scorecard that feeds back into the program
  • Build renewal, expansion, and adoption playbooks that connect Delivery success to revenue growth; partner with Delivery and CS on customer health and time-to-value

Strategy, Measurement & Alignment

  • Set enablement strategy and OKRs tied directly to revenue outcomes; lead GTM launch readiness for new Ark capabilities
  • Report enablement impact in revenue language - win rate, ramp, attainment, content usage, NRR - not training activity

Qualifications

  • U.S. Citizenship is required
  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution

Required Skills:

  • 10+ years of GTM enablement experience, including 5+ years leading enablement programs in B2B/B2G SaaS or enterprise software
  • Built onboarding, ramp, and certification programs from scratch with measurable impact on time-to-first-deal and ramp time
  • Hands-on experience rolling out and reinforcing a standard sales methodology (SPICED, MEDDPICC, Challenger, or equivalent) across a multi-role GTM organization
  • Track record of building enablement that crosses the Sales-to-Delivery line - not just sales-side training
  • Fluency with modern GTM tools spanning sales, delivery, training, & enablement e.g. CRM (Salesforce or similar), CS Platform (Planhat or similar), LMS (Articulate 360 or similar).
  • Ability to measure and report enablement impact in revenue language to executive audiences
  • Self-starter with an owner mentality and bias for action; credible with a new AE, an Engagement Manager, and Sales Leadership

Desired Skills:

  • Experience supporting DoD, federal civilian, or national security customers
  • Prior experience enabling GTM teams across both commercial and public sector motions
  • Experience leveraging AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, NotebookLM) to accelerate content development and personalize learning
  • Career-pathing experience (e.g., AE-to-VP programs) and coaching certification (ATD, Bossed UP, or equivalent)
  • Startup or other entrepreneurial environment experience

Title: Legal Knowledge & Research Manager
Description:
Harbor is seeking a Legal Knowledge & Research Manager for its Library and Research department. This role will manage a full-service client relationship for a large law client as the primary responsibility, including management of research quality, stakeholder communications, short-term and long-term goal planning and support, and library operations/financial management,

This full-time, fully remote role offers the opportunity to lead client-facing library services while guiding a high-performing team to deliver the exceptional service using innovative legal technology solutions.  The primary schedule is Monday - Friday.  This is a remote position that can be worked from anywhere in the United States.

Responsibilities:  

Client Engagement & Outreach 

  • Build strong relationships with attorneys and Client stakeholders to anticipate research needs and proactively deliver value. 
  • Lead research outreach initiatives tailored to specific Client practice groups or departments. 
  • Occasionally deliver direct research findings, competitive intelligence, or market insights to Clients and Client leadership. 

Team Leadership:  

  • Supervise and provide guidance to department staff, including training, and conducting performance evaluations.  
  • Foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment, promoting teamwork and professional development.  
  • Delegate tasks effectively, ensuring efficient workflow and timely completion of projects 

Research Leadership & Team Development 

  • Lead, mentor, and supervise a team of research professionals, providing direction, coaching, and performance feedback. 
  • Foster a collaborative, client-centered research culture that emphasizes analytical rigor, responsiveness, and continuous professional growth. 
  • Promote the adoption of best practices in legal research methodology, knowledge synthesis, and information delivery. 
  • Oversee and guide complex legal, regulatory, and business research and intelligence activities in support of Client attorneys and practice groups. 
  • Ensure research deliverables are timely, accurate, practice relevant, and aligned with Client priorities and risk tolerance. 

Digital Research & Knowledge Enablement 

  • Guide the organization, access, and governance of digital research resources to support efficient information retrieval and reuse. 
  • Collaborate with knowledge management, practice innovation, and IT teams to align research tools with attorney workflows. 
  • Ensure compliance with copyright, licensing, and ethical research standards across all research and intelligence activities. 
  • Evaluate and recommend new technologies, tools, resources, and platforms to enhance access and usability of digital resources. 

Emerging Technology & Innovation 

  • Champion the evaluation, rollout, and adoption of AI‑powered legal research, analytics, and intelligence tools. 
  • Partner with IT and business services to assess emerging legal technologies that enhance research quality, speed, and insight generation. 
  • Stay informed on trends in legal technology, generative and agentic AI, data analytics, and information services, advising Clients on implications and opportunities. 

Operations Management 

  • Provide strategic oversight of the Client’s integrated library system (ILS), related digital platforms, and department technology operations to ensure reliable, efficient service delivery.  
  • Supervise library resource acquisition and processing functions, including physical and electronic resources, with particular attention to effective electronic-resource management. 
  • Oversee relationships with vendors and coordinate with IT and other stakeholders to address system needs, resolve escalated issues, and support the ongoing performance and improvement of department systems. 

Budgeting and Reporting 

  • Manage resource costs within budget and prepare annual budgets aligned with Client expectations.  
  • Assist with the negotiation of renewals and new contracts, leveraging attorney usage and feedback to drive cost discussions. 

Project & Initiative Management 

  • Lead and contribute to research centric initiatives, such as research workflow optimization, tool implementations, analytics projects, and service enhancements. 
  • Develop project plans, timelines, and success metrics to ensure alignment with Client goals. 
  • Communicate project progress, risks, and outcomes clearly to stakeholders. 

Qualifications: 

  • Master’s degree in Library and Information Science (MLIS) or equivalent, required. 
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience providing legal research, competitive intelligence, or knowledge services in a law firm, professional services, or corporate environment. 
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience managing or leading a research team or function. 
  • Deep familiarity with legal research platforms such as Westlaw, LexisNexis, Bloomberg Law, and related analytics tools. 
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex research into practical, attorney focused insights. 
  • Experience managing vendor relationships, research budgets, and data driven decision-making. 
  • Familiarity with emerging legal technologies and trends, including generative or agentic AI applications in legal research (experience using or training on these tools preferred). 
  • Strong project management, organizational, and prioritization skills. 
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage credibly with attorneys, clients, and senior stakeholders. 
  • Analytical mindset with strong problem solving skills and attention to detail. 

About Us:

Harbor is the preeminent provider of expert services across strategy, legal technology, operations, and intelligence. Our globally integrated team of 900+ strategists, technologists, and specialists navigate alongside our clients – leading law firms, corporations, and their law departments – to provide essential resources and invaluable insights. Anchored in a rich heritage of deep knowledge, steadfast relationships, and mutual respect, our unwavering dedication lies in shaping the future of the legal industry and fostering enduring partnerships within our community and ecosystem.

1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access. We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. Title: Development Enablement Specialist
Description:
Job Title: Development Enablement Specialist

Location: Remote

About the Role

Horace Mann is building a structured framework for how software gets developed across the organization, inside IT, across business units, and increasingly with the help of AI. This role stands it up. You'll own the training program, the governance processes, and the day-to-day technical support that lets developers at every level build with confidence and in compliance.

This is a builder role in the truest sense: you'll start with a blank page and end with a functioning program: curriculum, documentation, intake workflows, and a support practice that developers actually want to use.

What You'll Do

In the first six months, you'll primarily be building:

  • Design and develop the tiered developer training program: four cumulative builder tiers (Personal Productivity through Enterprise Solution Lead) plus trigger-based add-on modules covering AI/LLM use, sensitive data handling, privileged access, third-party integrations, and business ownership
  • Document the risk overlay framework: clear, practitioner-facing guidance on what each overlay means, when it applies, and what a developer needs to do differently as a result
  • Build the solution intake and classification process: the workflow that takes a new solution from idea to assigned tier, applied overlays, and approved build path
  • Establish the ongoing compliance model: how training completion is tracked, how access is gated, and how attestations are renewed over time
  • Document development tooling standards and permitted integration catalogs so builders have a single reference for approved tools, registries, and external connections

On an ongoing basis:

  • Provide technical assistance to developers across IT and the business: helping with technical issues both hands-on and through coordination with subject matter experts.
  • Serve as the first point of contact when a developer hits a process or tooling question: triage, resolve, or route to the right team
  • Conduct training sessions, maintain training content as the framework evolves, and track completion against access requirements
  • Execute and maintain intake and compliance processes: solution intake, developer tools, approved packages, and attestations
  • Work with Security, Architecture, Governance, and Data teams to keep overlay documentation and intake processes current as policies and tools change
  • Identify patterns in support requests and use them to improve training content, documentation, and tooling defaults

What You'll Bring

  • Familiarity with modern software development practices: Git, CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred), package management, secrets management, and deployment fundamentals
  • Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to audiences with varying levels of experience, from seasoned engineers to first-time business builders
  • Experience designing or delivering technical training, documentation, or enablement programs
  • Comfort working across teams — you'll partner with Security, Architecture, Governance, and business stakeholders regularly
  • Familiarity with AI development tools and platforms (experience with Claude, GitHub Copilot, or similar is a plus)
  • Strong organizational instincts — you'll be managing curriculum, process documentation, a support queue, and compliance tracking simultaneously

Why This Role Matters

Development is no longer confined to IT. AI assistants, low-code tools, and automation platforms have made builders out of people who wouldn't have called themselves developers two years ago. This role exists to make sure that expansion goes well, that the people building solutions have the skills and support they need, that the guardrails are clear and accessible rather than buried in policy documents, and that IT can say “yes” to more development, faster, because the foundation is solid.

Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of experience in technical training, instructional design, software development, or a related field.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.
  • Familiarity with modern software development practices and technologies, including the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), Git, CI/CD, and AI-assisted development tools.
  • Experience developing and delivering technical training or enablement content.
  • Ability to translate technical concepts into clear, practical guidance for audiences with varying levels of technical expertise.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with management, business partners, technical teams, associates, and external resources.
  • Strong organizational and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify and document issues, risks, and dependencies.

 

Salary Range: $76,600.00 - $106,450.00

  • Salary is commensurate to experience, location, etc.

Horace Mann was founded in 1945 by two Springfield, Illinois, teachers who saw a need for quality, affordable auto insurance for teachers. Since then, we’ve broadened our mission to helping all educators protect what they have today and prepare for a successful tomorrow.  And with our broadened mission has come corporate growth:  We serve more than 4,100 school districts nationwide, we’re publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange (symbol: HMN) and we have more than $12 billion in assets.

We’re motivated by the fact that educators take care of our children’s future, and we believe they deserve someone to look after theirs.  We help educators identify their financial goals and develop plans to achieve them.  This includes insurance to protect what they have today and financial products to help them prepare for their future. Our tailored offerings include special rates and benefits for educators.

Title: Event Content Strategist- Vice President
Location: New York, New York, United States
Description:
About the Role

iCapital is seeking an Event Content Strategist Vice President to join the Global Events team. This role will be responsible for shaping and driving the content strategy across iCapital's US portfolio of proprietary and sponsored conferences. Reporting to the Global Head of Events, this individual will sit at the intersection of event strategy, agenda development, speaker management, and audience engagement. This role ensures every event tells a compelling and cohesive story that aligns with iCapital's business priorities, market positioning, and evolving industry trends.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and lead event content strategy, programming, and execution across iCapital’s US event portfolio.
  • Partner with the Brand, Product and Channel Marketing, Sales, Product, Investment Strategy teams, and senior leadership to identify key themes, trends, and thought leadership opportunities, ensuring content remains relevant, differentiated, and aligned with business objectives, industry developments, and client interests.
  • Establish content measurement frameworks to evaluate event effectiveness, audience engagement, and content pull-through across marketing channels, leveraging insights to inform future programming and extend the value of event content.
  • Own the end-to-end speaker journey across US events, including outreach, confirmation, content development, presentation reviews, rehearsals, briefing materials, production coordination, onsite support, post-event follow-up, and management of key communications and deadlines.
  • Partner closely with Product and Channel Marketing, Creative, Brand, Communications, Legal, Compliance, executive offices, and agency partners to coordinate content-related workstreams, ensuring alignment, accountability, and successful execution across stakeholders.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to executives, clients, sponsors, and external speakers on content strategy, messaging, and event participation.
  • Partner with the Sponsorship team to maximize sponsor participation through speaking opportunities, panel discussions, thought leadership sessions, and content activations that align with sponsor expertise and business objectives.
  • Build scalable content and speaker management processes, including playbooks, timelines, and frameworks that improve efficiency, consistency, and execution across events.
  • Track agenda performance, speaker effectiveness, and audience engagement metrics, delivering post-event insights and recommendations to drive continuous improvement and inform future event strategy.

Qualifications

  • 8–12+ years of experience in event content strategy, conference programming, communications, marketing, or related fields
  • Proven experience developing content programs for large-scale conferences, executive forums, or thought leadership events
  • Comfortable developing overarching content frameworks, partnering with senior stakeholders on messaging, managing executive and external speakers, and driving the detailed processes that turn event agendas into impactful live experiences
  • Deep understanding of wealth management, alternative investments, and asset management is strongly preferred
  • Experience working with executive leaders and external speakers
  • Exceptional project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills
  • Able to travel domestically as needed

 

Benefits

The base salary range for this role is $150,000 to $165,000.  iCapital offers a compensation package which includes salary, equity for all full-time employees, and an annual performance bonus. Employees also receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes an employer matched retirement plan, generously subsidized healthcare with 100% employer paid dental, vision, telemedicine, and virtual mental health counseling, parental leave, and unlimited paid time off (PTO).

 

We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office Monday-Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on Friday.

Title: AI Enablement Engineer, IT
Description:
Company Overview

ID.me is the next-generation digital identity wallet that simplifies how individuals securely prove their identity online. Consumers can verify their identity with ID.me once and seamlessly login across websites without having to create a new login and verify their identity again. Over 152 million users experience streamlined login and identity verification with ID.me at 20 federal agencies, 45 state government agencies, and 70+ healthcare organizations. More than 600+ consumer brands use ID.me to verify communities and user segments to honor service and build more authentic relationships. ID.me’s technology meets the federal standards for consumer authentication set by the Commerce Department and is approved as a NIST 800-63-3 IAL2 / AAL2 credential service provider by the Kantara Initiative. Title: Sales Enablement Manager
Description:
About Inspira Education

Inspira Education Group is one of the fastest-growing edtech startups in the US. We started with a simple mission to democratize access to high-quality coaching so that every student in the world has an equal opportunity to access the best opportunities. 

As the world’s leading network of top admissions coaches in medical, legal, business, and college studies, we’re building software and services in one place—disrupting long-entrenched application processes with products and experiences that strive to provide an equal platform for candidates from diverse backgrounds worldwide. 

As one of the fastest-growing edtech firms in the world, we are backed by some of the leading venture capital firms and investors in the world, including Zeev Ventures, Quiet Capital, Craft Ventures and Jeff Fluhr (Founder of Stubhub).

About the Role

We're looking for a strategic and collaborative Sales Enablement Manager to help scale our go-to-market organization. In this role, you'll partner across Sales, Product, Product Marketing, Revenue Operations, Customer Experience, Recruiting, and Learning & Development to ensure our customer-facing teams have the knowledge, tools, processes, and content they need to deliver an exceptional customer experience and drive business results.

You'll serve as the connective tissue across our GTM organization—translating strategy into execution, identifying performance gaps, enabling successful product launches, and creating scalable programs that improve sales effectiveness and customer outcomes.

If you enjoy solving sales challenges, influencing cross-functional teams, and building programs that have measurable impact, we'd love to meet you.

 

What You'll Do

Sales Enablement & Training

  • Design, build, and continuously improve onboarding programs to accelerate new-hire ramp time.
  • Develop ongoing training programs that strengthen product knowledge, consultative selling, objection handling, and customer experience.
  • Create certifications, learning paths, coaching resources, and sales enablement programs.
  • Analyze sales performance trends and identify opportunities for targeted enablement initiatives.

Data & Feedback Loop

  • Analyze conversion, win/loss, and retention data to identify what's working and feed it back into training
  • Review call recordings and customer interactions to surface best practices from top performers and turn them into repeatable playbooks
  • Track and report on enablement-specific metrics and their downstream impact on conversion or win rate

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with Product Marketing to translate positioning, messaging, and competitive insights into practical sales playbooks, talk tracks, FAQs, and customer-facing resources.
  • Collaborate with Product Management to prepare customer-facing teams for product launches by developing training, enablement content, and readiness plans.
  • Work closely with Marketing to ensure campaign messaging is consistently reflected throughout the customer journey.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations to support CRM adoption, process improvements, sales workflows, and operational readiness.
  • Collaborate with Customer Experience and Customer Success teams to improve onboarding, retention, upsell, and support experiences.
  • Gather frontline feedback and communicate customer insights back to Product, Marketing, and Sales Leadership to continuously improve our GTM strategy.

Content & Communication

  • Create and refine high-converting playbooks, call scripts, objection-handling guides, and cross-sell/upsell matrices for the sales team.
  • Own the organization and maintenance of sales enablement content, including playbooks, product documentation, competitive battle cards, sales presentations, and knowledge resources.
  • Ensure customer-facing teams have easy access to current, accurate, and actionable enablement materials.
  • Package customer proof points, case studies, and FAQs into reusable assets teams can pull from in the moment
  • Develop scalable communication plans for product launches, process updates, and organizational changes.

Tools & Process

  • Own or co-own enablement tooling (e.g., CRM/helpdesk macros, content/asset libraries, call recording platforms) so teams can find the right resource in seconds, not minutes
  • Partner with RevOps to keep CRM data clean and process consistent across teams

 

What You'll Bring

  • Prior experience carrying an individual sales quota or serving in a consultative customer-facing role (Sales, Business Development, Account Management, Customer Success, Retail Leadership, or similar). You understand firsthand what it takes to build trust with customers, navigate objections, and operate in a performance-driven environment.
  • 3+ years of experience in a customer-facing revenue role and/or Sales Enablement, Revenue Enablement, Sales Operations, Product Marketing, or a related GTM function.
  • Experience designing and scaling enablement programs that improve onboarding, sales readiness, product adoption, or customer experience.
  • Proven ability to build trusted partnerships across Sales, Product, Product Marketing, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Customer Experience, and executive leadership.
  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts and influence audiences ranging from frontline employees to senior leaders.
  • An analytical mindset with experience using performance metrics, customer feedback, and business insights to identify opportunities and measure the impact of enablement initiatives.
  • A builder's mentality—you enjoy creating scalable programs, playbooks, and processes that help teams perform at their best.
  • High emotional intelligence and credibility. You listen before prescribing solutions, seek to understand the realities of frontline teams, and earn trust through empathy, collaboration, and thoughtful execution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a direct-to-consumer, retail, consumer technology, marketplace, or high-growth environment.
  • Experience supporting product launches and go-to-market initiatives across multiple customer-facing teams.
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar), learning management systems, and enablement tools such as Gong, Highspot, Seismic, WorkRamp, or similar platforms.
  • Experience coaching managers or facilitating leadership development programs.

 

Success in This Role

After your first 60-days, you will have:

  • Built scalable onboarding and ongoing enablement programs that improve sales readiness and consistency.
  • Successfully enabled multiple product launches across customer-facing teams.
  • Established trusted partnerships across Sales, Product, Marketing, Revenue Operations, and Customer Experience.
  • Increased adoption of key sales processes, tools, and messaging.
  • Demonstrated measurable improvements in ramp time, productivity, customer experience, or sales effectiveness.
  • Become a strategic partner who helps connect business strategy with frontline execution.

 

Why This Role Matters

Our customers experience our brand through every interaction with our teams. This role helps ensure those interactions are consistent, informed, and customer-centric. By connecting strategy with execution and enabling our teams to perform at their best, you'll play a critical role in helping us scale our business while delivering an outstanding customer experience.

 

Why You'll Love Inspira

  • Amazing people with a great vision and values
  • Mission-driven team culture focused on student success
  • Your work directly impacts the lives and careers of students across the globe
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance, base plans 100% employer paid
  • Pre-tax benefits (FSA, DCFSA, HSA, Commuter)
  • Flexible paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays
  • 401(k) with company match

 

For more information about our company, please visit our website: Inspira Education Group.  

Inspira Education Group does not discriminate based on race, sex, color, religion, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other reason prohibited by law in providing employment opportunities and benefits.

Title: Director, Provider Enablement and Success
Description:
Interwell Health is a kidney care management company that partners with physicians on its mission to reimagine healthcare—with the expertise, scale, compassion, and vision to set the standard for the industry and help patients live their best lives. We are on a mission to help people and we know the work we do changes their lives. If there is a better way, we will create it. So, if our mission speaks to you, join us!

The Director, Provider Enablement is a newly created leadership role responsible for overseeing Acumen® Support and Training functions and advancing the operational maturity of the provider enablement organization. Reporting to the VP, Provider Operations & Strategy, this leader will ensure provider customers are successfully onboarded, trained, supported, and enabled to maximize value from Interwell Acumen™, the leading nephrology-specific Epic Connect EHR. This role owns the strategy and execution of support, training, customer communications, and self-service programs, while driving operational excellence, customer adoption, performance metrics, and continuous improvement. Working closely with Product, Implementations, Account Management, and Epic Applications teams, the Director will translate customer feedback into scalable solutions that enhance the customer experience and improve outcomes 

If you're someone who enjoys creating structure, building scalable customer programs, partnering closely with product teams, and driving measurable customer outcomes within a healthcare technology environment, this is a role with a lot of visibility, influence, and opportunity to shape the future state of the function. 

What You'll Do: 

Provider Enablement Strategy & Operations 

  • Lead Customer Support, Learning, and Enablement Operations to deliver effective support, training, communications, and self-service resources across the customer lifecycle. 
  • Set operational goals, priorities, service standards, and success metrics aligned to customer outcomes and organizational objectives. 
  • Establish consistent operating rhythms, accountability mechanisms, and reporting across support, learning, release readiness, knowledge management, and adoption activities. 
  • Drive improvements that increase team effectiveness, customer experience, scalability, and operational discipline. 
  • Champion the strategic use of generative AI, identifying opportunities to improve operational efficiency, enhance customer communications and learning programs, streamline workflows, and scale support and enablement capabilities. 

Customer Success, Adoption & Onboarding 

  • Own customer enablement outcomes, including NPS, support SLA performance, training effectiveness, feature adoption, customer engagement, and self-service utilization. 
  • Partner with Implementations to ensure new customers are trained, prepared, and enabled to use Interwell Acumen effectively. 
  • Develop programs that improve the adoption of key workflows, features, and best practices across the customer base. 
  • Monitor customer health indicators and adoption trends to identify risks, barriers, and opportunities for improvement. 

Voice of Customer & Continuous Improvement 

  • Establish a Voice of Customer program that incorporates support trends, customer feedback, NPS results, adoption metrics, training insights, and stakeholder input. 
  • Translate customer insights into clear recommendations to improve product experience, workflows, documentation, training, communications, and support processes. 
  • Partner with Product, Epic Applications, and other stakeholders to prioritize and execute customer-driven improvements. 
  • Lead initiatives that reduce avoidable support volume, strengthen self-service capabilities, and improve customer outcomes at scale. 

Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership 

  • Lead, coach, and develop the Provider Enablement team, fostering accountability, customer focus, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 
  • Serve as the escalation point for significant customer experience issues, adoption challenges, and operational risks. 
  • Build strong partnerships with Product, Development, Epic Applications, Implementations, Account Management, Marketing, and other stakeholders. 
  • Communicate customer experience trends, operational performance, risks, and recommendations through regular reporting and business reviews. 

What You’ll Need 

  • Bachelor’s degree  
  • 10+ years of experience in customer success, customer support, customer enablement, or related functions in a healthcare technology environment. 
  • 5+ years of experience leading managers and customer-facing teams. 
  • Prior Epic experience required, including experience in applications, training, support, implementation, operations, analytics, or customer success functions. 
  • Demonstrated customer-facing experience, particularly with healthcare provider organizations. 
  • Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional operational improvement initiatives and organizational change efforts. 
  • Demonstrated experience leveraging generative AI tools to improve operational efficiency, enhance customer-facing programs, and scale team effectiveness. 
  • Experience developing KPIs, operational reporting, executive dashboards, or business performance reviews. 
  • Strong coaching, performance management, prioritization, and organizational development skills. 
  • Ability to establish practical operating models, performance routines, service standards, and scalable processes. 
  • Strong ability to influence cross-functional partners, especially technical, product, implementation, and customer-facing teams. 
  • Excellent written, verbal, executive communication, facilitation, and change management skills. 
  • Ability to translate customer needs and operational trends into clear priorities and coordinated execution. 
  • Ability to interpret support data, customer feedback, adoption trends, training insights, and operational metrics to identify actionable opportunities. 
  • Up to 20% travel, typically for customer meetings, internal team meetings, or onsite business needs. 

Preferred 

  • Experience supporting Epic Community Connect environments. 
  • Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud, LMS platforms, or knowledge management systems. 
  • Experience with customer onboarding, Voice of Customer programs, NPS programs, or customer advisory boards. 

Our mission is to reinvent healthcare to help patients live their best lives, and we proudly live our mission-driven values: 

  • We care deeply about the people we serve.
  • We are better when we work together.
  • Humility is a source of our strength.  
  • We bring joy to our work.
  • We deliver on our promises. 

We are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion throughout our recruiting practices. Everyone is welcome and included. We value our differences and learn from each other. Our team members come in all shapes, colors, and sizes. No matter how you identify your lifestyle, creed, or fandom, we value everyone's unique journey.

You’ll build strong working relationships with customer-facing teams, Epic Applications, Product, Development, Training, Customer Success Operations, Account Management, and other internal partners. You’ll promote a customer-first, solution-oriented support culture grounded in accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. While Epic experience is beneficial, success in this role is primarily driven by strong customer support leadership, operational excellence, sound customer service judgment, and a proven ability to use performance metrics to improve team outcomes. 

What You’ll Do: 

Team Leadership & People Management 

  • Supervise, coach, and develop a team of Support Analysts responsible for direct customer-facing help desk support. 
  • Set clear expectations and drive accountability to responsiveness, customer communication, documentation quality, resolution accuracy, productivity, teamwork, and professional conduct. 
  • Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, coaching conversations, and skill assessments to support team member development
  • Manage team scheduling, workload distribution, coverage planning, and queue assignments to support service levels and customer needs. 
  • Oversee onboarding and role readiness for new Support Analysts, including support tools, support workflows, customer communication expectations, ticket documentation standards, and escalation processes. 
  • Identify team skill gaps and partner with Training Specialists, Customer Success Operations, Epic Applications, and other subject matter experts to support ongoing learning and performance improvement. 
  • Ensure the team is prepared for new features, workflow changes, support process updates, and targeted customer adoption programs. 

Support Operations & Ticket Triage 

  • Oversee daily support operations across phone, email, web form, and ticket queues to ensure customer issues are triaged, routed, responded to, and resolved accurately and timely. 
  • Establish, document, monitor, and refine ticket triage processes so issues are categorized correctly and directed to the right internal owner or resolution path. 
  • Serve as the primary internal escalation coordinator when Support Analysts cannot resolve an issue independently, including facilitating ticket transfers to Epic Applications, Product, Development, Training, Account Management, or other teams as needed. 
  • Ensure support documentation, case notes, handoffs, and resolution details are complete, accurate, and usable for follow-up, reporting, and continuous improvement. 
  • Partner with Customer Success Operations and Training to ensure support trends and common customer issues are reflected in internal knowledge resources, training materials, and adoption priorities. 

Quality, Process Improvement & Operational Discipline 

  • Define, document, communicate, and maintain SLAs, SLOs, and operational expectations for the Customer Support team in partnership with the Director. 
  • Track and report on team and individual performance metrics, including response time, resolution time, backlog, aging tickets, reopened tickets, escalation volume, quality, productivity, and customer satisfaction indicators. 
  • Use support data to identify trends, root causes, workflow breakdowns, customer friction points, training needs, and opportunities to improve support operations. 
  • Continuously monitor queue health and team performance to ensure quality, productivity, and timely resolution remain visible and actively managed. 
  • Lead continuous improvement efforts to address process gaps, improve support quality, resolution accuracy, case handling efficiency, customer experience, and internal handoff effectiveness. 
  • Establish and maintain quality review practices for support interactions, ticket documentation, escalation handoffs, and resolution outcomes. 
  • Partner with the Director and cross-functional teams to improve workflows, tools, templates, documentation, and operating rhythms. 
  • Develop and maintain team-level SOPs, queue management practices, escalation playbooks, and performance routines that enable consistent support execution. 

Customer & Stakeholder Engagement 

  • Serve as a point of contact for high-priority, complex, or escalated customer support issues and ensure timely, professional communication on case status and next steps. 
  • Ensure escalation paths, internal ownership, and ticket transfer expectations are clear across teams. 
  • Represent the Support team in cross-functional discussions related to customer issues, product changes, release readiness, support trends, and adoption initiatives. 
  • Lead or participate in operational projects that improve support team performance, customer experience, support tools, queue workflows, reporting, or escalation management. 
  • Support testing, validation, rollout, and team readiness for new support tools, applications, processes, or workflows. 
  • Partner with the Director to align support operations with broader Training, Support, and Customer Success priorities. 

What You’ll Need 

  • Bachelor’s degree required. 
  • 5+ years of experience in customer support, technical support, application/software support, SaaS support, healthcare technology support, or related customer service operations. 
  • 3+ years of experience leading or managing a frontline support, help desk, technical support, or customer service team.  
  • Strong coaching and performance management skills 
  • Demonstrated experience setting, tracking, and improving SLAs, support metrics, queue performance, or operational service standards. 
  • Strong customer service judgment, including the ability to handle escalated customer issues professionally and determine when issues require additional internal support.  
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including clear customer updates and effective cross-functional coordination. 
  • Proven operational discipline, with experience defining service standards, monitoring performance, improving workflows, and holding teams accountable to measurable expectations.  
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret support metrics, identify trends, diagnose operational issues, and drive data-informed improvements. 
  • Technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn healthcare software, EHR workflows, support tools, and internal operating processes.  
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, remote work environment. 
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and support/ticketing, reporting, or customer service tools. 

Preferred

  • Experience in healthcare IT, physician practice operations, revenue cycle, clinical operations, or customer success operations.

Title: YouTube Content Strategist
Description:
Location: In-Office
Compensation: $80,000 - $100,000 CAD Base Salary + $18,000 variable

About Martell Group

The Martell Group exists to build people, brands, and ventures that create meaningful impact. Across our four companies, we combine audience, operators, and execution to launch scalable products and empower ambitious leaders in Media, B2B SaaS, and AI.

Founded by serial entrepreneur and investor Dan Martell (investor in Udemy, Intercom, and Unbounce), we’re building a company that values leadership, growth, and simplicity, and we’re looking for people who live those values too.

Our goal is to attract world-class talent and align people where their impact is greatest. When you apply to Martell Group, you’ll automatically be considered for all open roles across our companies, not just the one you applied for.

Why you shouldn't work here – Radical Transparency from our CEO

About the Role

 

We are looking for an experienced YouTube Content Strategist to lead the creative strategy behind a world-class YouTube channel. This is not an execution-only role. We need someone who deeply understands YouTube storytelling, audience psychology, content analytics, and channel growth, and can confidently tell us what needs to change in order to reach the next level.

You will be responsible for developing high-performing video concepts, analyzing channel performance, writing compelling scripts, and building a content strategy designed to generate millions of views while driving business growth. You should have a proven understanding of what makes viewers click, watch, engage, and return.

The ideal candidate has significant experience with YouTube content creation and understands the difference between creating videos and building a successful channel. This person will become a key creative partner to Dan, helping shape content strategy, improve storytelling, and potentially participate in content production and filming.

Candidates with backgrounds in film production, directing, documentary filmmaking, scriptwriting, or other storytelling-focused disciplines are strongly encouraged to apply.

Responsibilities

 

Content Strategy & Channel Growth

  • Develop and execute a long-term YouTube content strategy aligned with audience growth and business objectives.
  • Identify high-potential content opportunities capable of generating significant viewership and engagement.
  • Research trends, competitors, audience interests, and emerging opportunities within the YouTube ecosystem.
  • Build content roadmaps and publishing strategies that support sustainable channel growth.

Ideation & Creative Development

  • Generate original video concepts with strong viral and evergreen potential.
  • Develop video ideas designed to achieve high click-through rates, audience retention, and viewer engagement.
  • Create content frameworks that balance entertainment, education, storytelling, and business goals.
  • Lead brainstorming sessions and continuously test new content formats and creative approaches.

Scriptwriting & Storytelling

  • Write and refine compelling video scripts, outlines, and story structures.
  • Craft strong hooks, narrative arcs, pacing strategies, and calls-to-action.
  • Ensure every piece of content is optimized to maximize audience retention and watch time.
  • Elevate the overall storytelling quality of the channel.

Analytics & Optimization

  • Analyze channel performance, audience behavior, and video-level analytics.
  • Use data to identify growth opportunities and improve future content performance.
  • Monitor key metrics including click-through rate, retention, watch time, subscriber conversion, and audience engagement.
  • Translate insights into actionable recommendations for content, packaging, and production improvements.

Creative Leadership

  • Act as a strategic advisor on all YouTube content decisions.
  • Provide recommendations on what content, messaging, and formats should evolve as the channel grows.
  • Collaborate closely with Dan and the broader content team to improve content quality and performance.
  • Potentially assist with filming, directing, or content production as needed.

 

Qualifications

Required

 

  • 3+ years of experience developing, producing, or managing YouTube content with demonstrated results.
  • Strong understanding of YouTube analytics, audience retention, click-through optimization, and channel growth strategies.
  • Proven experience writing scripts and developing high-performing video concepts.
  • Exceptional storytelling instincts and understanding of audience psychology.
  • Ability to identify trends while balancing evergreen content opportunities.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to turn data into strategic recommendations.
  • Excellent communication and creative leadership abilities.

 

Preferred

 

  • Experience working with creator brands, personal brands, media companies, or educational content channels.
  • Background in film production, directing, screenwriting, documentary production, journalism, or related storytelling fields.
  • Experience helping grow a YouTube channel from early-stage to significant audience scale.
  • Familiarity with production workflows, filming, and creative direction.
  • Personal content creation experience or successful management of a YouTube channel is considered a strong asset.

Title: Vice President, Wealth Enablement
Description:
Why Work at Mercer Advisors?

For more than 40 years, Mercer Advisors has been helping families amplify and simplify their financial lives by integrating financial planning, investment management, business management, tax, estate, insurance, and more, all managed by a single team. We deliver the kind of comprehensive care once reserved for only the wealthiest households.

Today, we serve over 42,800+ families across 110+ cities across the U.S. Ranked the #1 RIA Firm in the nation by Barron’s for two consecutive years, Mercer Advisors is an independent fiduciary legally bound to act in our clients’ best interests — always.*

Mercer Advisors offers a workplace that stands apart in the financial industry. More than half of our employees and client-facing professionals are women, reflecting the clients we serve. With a flexible, national footprint, we build our teams around exceptional talent — wherever they are.

Join us and help families amplify and simplify their financial lives with confidence.

* Mercer Advisors was ranked #1 for RIA firms with up to $70 billion in assets. The Barron’s top RIA ranking is based on a combination of metrics – including size, growth, service quality, technology, succession planning and others. No fee was paid for participation in the ranking, however, Mercer Advisors has paid a fee to Barron’s to use the ranking in marketing. Please see important information about the ranking criteria methodology here.

 

Job Summary:

Wealth Enablement ensures every client-facing team member feels supported and knows what to do, when, and why when serving clients.  The VP will centralize content strategy, lead curriculum development, and drive solution adoption for a more consistent, proactive client experience.  The VP will lead the Enablement function to build scalable, AI-enabled training and content infrastructure across Wealth Management and Wealth Solutions. This leader will set strategy, build the team, and drive behavioral change and adoption at scale — bridging corporate functions and the field. 

 

Essential Job Functions for this role include:

Content Strategy & Curriculum Ownership 

  • Own the centralized content strategy across all client-facing cohorts — Wealth Management (advisors and client service) and Wealth Solutions (Tax, Estate, Financial Planning, Emerging Solutions). 
  • Maintain curriculum architecture that separates the CS (Relationship Manager and Service Operations Associate)/Advisor and WM/WS tracks, tailoring content to each audience's complexity and behavioral needs. 
  • Create high-quality, scalable advisor playbooks, onboarding frameworks, and field-facing tools that equip advisors to deliver better client outcomes — evolving from episodic content to a centralized, maintained system. 
  • Partner with Relationship Expansion so advisor-facing content is built for field delivery, not just housed centrally. 

Advisor Adoption & Behavioral Change 

  • Lead the function's evolution from a generalist support model to a specialized team that drives measurable behavioral change and builds advising capabilities across advisor teams. 
  • Use our product pilot and launch methodology to serve as the field advocate for new technology, tools, and solutions — including AI-powered capabilities — before and during rollout. 
  • Define growth gearing ratios (FTE per cohort size) and build the organizational infrastructure to scale onboarding and ongoing enablement as Mercer grows through M&A. 
  • In partnership with Partner Success, build on-demand support capacity for acquisition integrations so newly joined advisor teams are onboarded rapidly and effectively. 

Team Leadership & Organizational Build-Out 

  • Build and lead a structured Enablement team organized across Wealth Management and Wealth Solutions — ultimately with dedicated Directors and FTE support for each. 
  • Recruit for skills that match each cohort's complexity, replacing a generalist model with domain-specific expertise that can credibly engage and influence advisors. 
  • Use team operating rhythms, performance telemetry, and accountability frameworks to measure content effectiveness, field adoption, and client impact. 
  • Serve as the long-term architect of Mercer University — the 3-year horizon vision for Mercer's internal learning and development infrastructure. 

Cross-Functional Partnership 

  • Partner closely with Relationship Expansion to ensure Enablement content is deployable by field leaders and embedded in advisor meeting cadences. 
  • Work alongside Segment Delivery to align accreditation and training programs with segment-specific delivery models (Ascend, Regis, Custom Wealth, WealthPath). 
  • Serve as a business-to-technology bridge — advocating for advisor needs in product design so what's built drives the right field outcomes. 

 

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

 

  • 10+ years of experience in enablement, learning & development, or field effectiveness roles within wealth management, financial services, or a complex, field-oriented professional services organization. 
  • Demonstrated success building or scaling centralized enablement functions — not just managing existing L&D programs, but architecting new ones from the ground up. 
  • Track record of driving measurable advisor or field sales behavioral change, with evidence of adoption outcomes and performance improvement. 
  • Experience managing and developing teams of content creators, trainers, and program managers, ideally using AI to accelerate their output. 
  • Familiarity with the complexity of a post-M&A integration environment and the enablement demands it creates. 
  • Ideally, the candidate will have a CFP and / or previous experience directly serving clients. 
  • Strategic thinker who can translate business priorities (NRR, retention, 'One Mercer' delivery) into curriculum design and behavioral change programs that strengthen the client experience. 
  • Strong cross-functional collaborator who builds influence without direct authority across Relationship Expansion, Segment Delivery, Operations, and Technology. 
  • Data-informed approach — uses telemetry, adoption metrics, and field feedback to iterate and improve content and delivery systems. 
  • AI-fluent — well-versed in AI tools and able to apply them to accelerate content creation, personalize learning, and scale enablement, while championing responsible adoption across the field. 
  • Exceptional communicator and executive presence — able to represent Enablement to senior leadership and serve as a credible spokesperson for field needs in the product design process.

Job Summary:

The Content Operations Specialist plays an important role in supporting the Content team within the Marketing department. This position is responsible for managing key operational processes, coordinating workflows, supporting webinar logistics, facilitating employee onboarding activities, overseeing vendor relationships, and helping ensure requests move efficiently through the team's project management systems.

This is not a traditional marketing role. While experience working with marketing teams is helpful, success in this position is driven more by operational excellence, workflow management, organization, problem-solving, and process improvement than by marketing expertise.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. They are naturally curious, process-minded, and able to work independently with minimal direction. In addition to managing day-to-day responsibilities, this individual should be able to identify workflow inefficiencies, recommend practical improvements, and leverage technology and AI tools to help the team work more effectively. Success in this role requires strong communication skills, sound judgment, attention to detail, and a commitment to delivering excellent service to internal stakeholders.

 

Essential Job Functions for this role include:

 

Workflow & Project Operations

  • Manage incoming project requests and workflows through Monday.com.
  • Ensure projects are accurately entered, assigned, prioritized, and tracked through completion.
  • Monitor project progress and communicate with stakeholders to help keep work moving efficiently.
  • Coordinate marketing-related activities associated with office relocations, openings, and closures, including client communications, website updates, project timelines, and stakeholder coordination.
  • Identify opportunities to improve workflow visibility, streamline processes, and automate manual tasks.
  • Leverage AI and technology tools to improve efficiency, consistency, and productivity across the Content team.
  • Support operational initiatives and special projects as needed.

Webinar Coordination

  • Coordinate logistics for client and prospect webinars, including scheduling, registration management, rehearsal support, event execution, and reporting.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders and presenters to ensure a consistent and professional webinar experience.
  • Recommend practical improvements to webinar processes, templates, and workflows to increase efficiency and scalability.
  • Track webinar metrics and assist with post-event reporting and follow-up activities.

Vendor & Program Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for designated marketing vendors, including the firm's print-on-demand partner.
  • Manage communications and day-to-day coordination with vendors to ensure projects and requests are completed accurately and on time.
  • Coordinate employee information updates and program administration activities.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify vendor-related processes, improve communication, and enhance the overall user experience.
  • Maintain documentation and support continuous improvement of vendor workflows.

  • Facilitate marketing onboarding activities for new employees, including training and resource coordination.
  • Manage employee bio, headshot, credential, and profile updates.
  • Coordinate user access requests and support requests related to marketing technologies.
  • Assist with employee onboarding and offboarding activities.
  • Identify opportunities to improve onboarding resources, documentation, and processes.

Department Support

  • Manage shared marketing inboxes and ensure requests are addressed in a timely manner.
  • Support ticket intake and routing processes.
  • Maintain process documentation and team resources.
  • Provide operational support for various Content team initiatives and projects.
