  • Develop deep technical and functional expertise across the Talkdesk platform, focusing on Talkdesk AI, Voice Evolution, Advanced Dialer, and omnichannel routing.
  • Translate complex platform capabilities into actionable, persona-based learning programs and technical guides for administrators, operations leaders, and end-users.
  • Lead dynamic instructor-led (live and virtual) training sessions, workshops, and hands-on technical enablement engagements for customers and partners.
  • Act as a key subject matter expert on the strategic application of Talkdesk AI to solve enterprise customer challenges.

Implementation & Solution Guidance

  • Lead enablement workstreams during complex customer implementations, including gathering requirements, designing workflow prototypes, and delivering user acceptance testing (UAT) frameworks.
  • Act as an expert problem-solver for technical enablement inquiries, integration patterns, and platform configuration questions.
  • Assist customers in aligning their operational goals with Talkdesk’s product functionality, architecture, and implementation methodologies.
  • Serve as a critical feedback loop to Product and Engineering, translating insights from customer engagements into actionable recommendations.

Operationalize Customer Enablement & Excellence

  • Build, refine, and scale repeatable customer enablement frameworks that accelerate post-go-live adoption and minimize time-to-first-value.
  • Partner with technical writing and curriculum design teams to produce high-impact enablement toolkits, admin guides, UAT scripts, interactive modules, and best-practice documentation.
  • Identify process bottlenecks in implementation and enablement delivery, introducing innovative solutions, reusable templates, and automated workflows to increase delivery efficiency.
  • Mentor junior team members and partner resources, conducting knowledge transfer sessions to establish consistent enablement delivery standards globally.
  • Define and champion the standards for technical enablement delivery, ensuring a globally consistent and scalable approach to customer onboarding.

Enablement Tooling, Insights & Reporting

  • Leverage Learning Management Systems (LMS), content management platforms, and CRM integration tools (e.g., Salesforce, Zendesk) to maintain a unified source of truth for enablement resources and certifications.
  • Track project hours, resource utilization, and client engagement metrics to assist leadership with long-term capacity planning and resource forecasting.
  • Establish metrics to evaluate training effectiveness, tracking key performance indicators such as customer product mastery, certification completion, time-to-productivity, and platform utilization.
  • Synthesize qualitative and quantitative feedback from customer enablement engagements to generate actionable insights for continuous program refinement.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence

  • Act as the primary liaison between frontline customers, internal delivery teams, and Product/Engineering organizations, channeling customer feedback, feature requests, and usability insights directly into product roadmaps.
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Product Marketing on New Product Introductions (NPI) to ensure field enablement and customer-facing materials are fully aligned prior to feature rollouts.
  • Collaborate with Sales Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Success, and Support teams to ensure seamless handoffs, consistent messaging, and aligned customer goals throughout the customer lifecycle.

Requirements

Experience & Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical or business discipline, or equivalent hands-on technical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in Technical Consulting, Professional Services, Customer Enablement, or Solutions Architecture in an enterprise SaaS environment.
  • Direct experience with Cloud Contact Center (CCaaS), Customer Experience (CX) platforms, or Enterprise Telephony.

Technical Acumen

  • Hands-on familiarity with contact center concepts (routing, dialers, workforce management, QA, AI/automation, analytics).
  • Experience with enterprise CRM integrations (Salesforce, Zendesk, ServiceNow) and foundational integration patterns (APIs, webhooks, middleware).
  • Proven ability to learn, digest, and communicate emerging technologies, including Generative AI and automated workflow engines.

Professional Skills

  • Consultative Mindset: Ability to translate complex technical architectures into clear, business-focused narratives for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Facilitation & Presentation: Outstanding verbal, written, and presentation skills with demonstrated experience delivering engaging technical workshops and executive briefings.
  • Organization & Execution: Highly organized self-starter with strong project management capabilities, meticulous attention to detail, and a track record of driving cross-functional outcomes.

Preferred / Nice to Have

  • Experience in hyper-growth, global enterprise SaaS organizations.
  • Exposure to vertical contact center implementations (Healthcare & Life Sciences, Financial Services & Insurance, or Retail/E-commerce).
  • Professional certifications in Instructional Design, CCaaS platforms, or Agile/Project Management methodologies.

Title: Acquisition Manager, Enablement
Location: New York, New York, United States
Description:
Who We Are

The Farmer’s Dog was born from a mission to change the landscape of pet health, providing dogs and their humans with honest, smart, and simple care. We’re starting by radically improving the $90 billion pet food industry, replacing bags of highly-processed pellets with a personalized subscription service that sends complete and balanced, freshly-made dog food directly to customers’ doors. Our ultimate goal is to create innovative, delightful and personalized experiences across all aspects of pet care, and we believe our direct-to-consumer business model, holistic approach to growth, and dynamic culture uniquely position us to shepherd this backwards industry into the future.

To date, The Farmer’s Dog has delivered over 1 billion meals nationwide and raised over $150M in funding to help us build a company as healthy as the dogs who are eating those meals. Join us as we continue to develop ways of bringing peace of mind to customers, health to their companions, and much-needed change to the way people feed and care for their pets.

#LongLiveDogs

What We Stand For and Where You’ll Come In

The Manager, Acquisition Enablement is a hands-on media practitioner who keeps TFD's acquisition program running with precision. You own the integrity of our media plan and forecast across channels, maintain the measurement infrastructure that channel owners depend on, and serve as the connective tissue between Paid Social, Paid Search, Partnerships, Media, and our Data & Analytics team. Reporting into our Acquisition Lead within Product Marketing, you'll ensure day-to-day performance stays on track against CAC and growth targets while partnering with senior media leadership to execute against the broader program strategy.

One Team: We don’t think of ourselves as “Acquisition Marketers”, “Engineers”, “Data Analysts”, or “Product Managers”. Beyond denoting skill sets and areas of expertise, we don’t think departments matter. We’d rather align ourselves to the goals we’re working to achieve and make sure we have necessary subject matter expertise to drive meaningful impact. We strive to orient ourselves around customer problems TOGETHER – getting the right people, with the right context, in the right rooms/Zooms to solve problems holistically.

We are skeptical about everything and precious about nothing:  Ideas can and should come from anywhere, and we aren’t tied to our own. We proactively source input. We talk to our customers and leads regularly and are quick to change course if we know there’s a better or more impactful way to solve problems.

We consider the customer journey in all of our decisions:  We know that no interaction exists in a silo and therefore understand how important every single one is.  We ensure our strategy sets prospective and new customers up for success and drives long-term retention.  We answer questions and address problems early and proactively.  We understand the value of different channels, initiatives, and messages and know how to articulate impact and advocate for prioritization holistically.

We Execute For Impact: We don’t subscribe to “best practices” or “industry KPIs”. We’re uninterested in how we compare to “benchmarks”; instead we orient ourselves around being the best we can possibly be. Similarly, we don’t subscribe to rigid or classical expectations of roles – i.e. acquisition is hyper-focused on improving customer retention and experience.

We Are Focused and Work Without Assumption: We are not beholden to ideas. We have goals and believe everything beyond that is a series of hypotheses to validate. To that end, we seek to work in sequence and not in parallel. We constantly ask ourselves, “what’s the most important hypothesis I should be working on right now? How do I confirm or reject that hypothesis as fast as possible?”. We rarely have timelines/deadlines and are constantly taking in new information and adjusting our priorities accordingly. We don’t expect to be perfect the first time.

How You'll Make An Impact

  • Own the maintenance and integrity of TFD's acquisition media plan and forecast across channels — keeping spend, pacing, and projections current as channel owners execute against CAC and growth targets.
  • Support go-to-market planning in partnership with Product Marketing, helping to translate launch and campaign moments into channel-level media plans and ensuring measurement is in place from day one.
  • Serve as the connective tissue between channel owners (Paid Social, Paid Search, Partnerships, Media, Owned Channels) and our Data & Analytics team, ensuring everyone is working from a shared, trusted view of performance.
  • Lead the implementation and ongoing governance of measurement infrastructure — pixels, UTMs, taxonomy, and tagging standards — so that every channel is tracked consistently and reporting is reliable.
  • Build and maintain acquisition reporting frameworks that surface actionable insights to channel owners and senior media leadership on a regular cadence, translating data into clear recommendations.
  • Partner with Data & Analytics to design and evolve our growth measurement architecture — including incrementality testing, attribution models, and CAC/LTV reporting — as our channel mix and media complexity grow.

Title: Senior Enablement Analyst
Description:
Senior Enablement Analyst

Truveta is the world’s first health provider led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta’ s ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a special combination of health, software and big data experience who share our company values.

Truveta was born in the Pacific Northwest, but we have employees who live across the country.  Our team enjoys the flexibility of a hybrid model and working from anywhere.  In person attendance is required at least once per year for an onsite meeting. 

For overall team productivity, we optimize meeting hours in the pacific time zone. We avoid scheduling recurring meetings that start after 3pm PT, however, ad hoc meetings occur between 8am-6pm Pacific time. #LI-remote

Who We Need 

Truveta is rapidly building a talented and diverse team to tackle complex health and technical challenges. Beyond core capabilities, we are seeking problem solvers, passionate and collaborative teammates, and those willing to roll up their sleeves while making a difference. If you are interested in the opportunity to pursue purposeful work, join a mission-driven team, and build a rewarding career while having fun, Truveta may be the perfect fit for you.   

This Opportunity 

The Enablement Analyst helps customers translate complex data products into practical, high-value workflows. This role partners closely with customer teams, solution engineers, product, and support to create clear, usable enablement materials that help customers understand the data model, create omni-modal patient journeys, and build successful analytics and machine learning use cases. 

The ideal candidate combines strong technical fluency with clear communication and customer empathy. They can explain complex data concepts in a simple way, create documentation and notebooks that are easy to follow, and proactively identify where customers may need guidance to move from data access to insights. 

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop customer-facing enablement content, including notebooks, guides, FAQs, slide decks, and walkthroughs.  
  • Facilitate large exports of omni-model data to customer environments.  
  • Help customers understand the data model, including clinical, administrative, notes, and imaging tables and how they relate to one another.  
  • Explain de-identification concepts, quasi-identifiers, and privacy considerations in a way that is practical for customer workflows.  
  • Support customers using data for analytics, patient journey analysis, and predictive modeling using machine learning.  
  • Create examples and best-practice materials that show how to structure cohorts, link tables, and validate outputs.  
  • Partner with internal teams to identify common customer questions, gaps, and opportunities for improved documentation.  
  • Translate technical product behavior into clear customer messaging, especially around profiles, date handling, suppression logic, and ML readiness.  
  • Monitor customer needs and recommend enablement strategies that improve adoption and reduce friction.  
  • Contribute to a scalable library of reusable enablement assets for technical users.  
  • Contribute to internal customer analytics assets, creating dashboards, models, forecasting to support post sales operations and enablement (Customer Health Score, Platform Adoption, ect...) 

What Success Looks Like

  • Customers can confidently navigate the data model and build analyses and predictive models with less support.  
  • Enablement materials are clear, accurate, and easy to reuse.  
  • Customers understand how to use retrospective, privacy-preserving, EHR data appropriately in ML and analytics workflows.  
  • Common support questions decline as documentation and examples improve.  
  • Internal teams have a strong partner who can turn technically complex documentation into customer-ready guidance.  

Qualifications

  • Experience in customer enablement, solutions consulting, analytics, or data science.  
  • Strong ability to explain complex technical concepts in plain language.  
  • Familiarity with healthcare data, EHR data, and images strongly preferred.  
  • Comfort working with notebooks, data dictionaries, SQL, Python, or similar analytical tools.  
  • Experience supporting technical customers in building analytics or ML workflows using omni-modal data.  
  • Strong collaboration, organization, and communication skills.  

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with patient journey analysis, clinical data modeling, or omni-modal data.  
  • Familiarity with imaging metadata and how it connects to clinical records.  
  • Background in supporting enterprise or strategic customers with technical enablement.  
  • Experience creating customer-facing materials for highly technical audiences.  

Ideal traits 

  • Customer-first mindset  
  • Clear and concise communicator  
  • Detail-oriented and reliable  
  • Comfortable with ambiguity  
  • Able to turn technical complexity into practical guidance  
  • Proactive about identifying customer blockers before they become problems 

Why Truveta?   

Be a part of building something special. Now is the perfect time to join Truveta. We have strong, established leadership with decades of success. We are well-funded. We are building a culture that prioritizes people and their passions across personal, professional and everything in between. Join us as we build an amazing company together.  

We Offer:

  • Interesting and meaningful work for every career stage
  • Great benefits package
  • Comprehensive benefits with strong medical, dental and vision insurance plans
  • 401K plan
  • Professional development & training opportunities for continuous learning
  • Work/life autonomy via flexible work hours and flexible paid time off
  • Generous parental leave
  • Regular team activities (virtual and in-person)

Title: Continuous Enablement Architect
Description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

About the Role

As a Continuous Enablement Architect on the Solutions Engineering (SE) Enablement team, you will drive post-onboarding technical mastery, continuous learning, and field readiness across Verkada’s global Sales Engineering organization. In this role, you will serve as the primary bridge between Product Management and the field, designing rigorous technical certifications and maintaining hands-on lab environments that empower SEs to effectively demonstrate Verkada’s unified physical security platform.

What You'll Do

  • Product Management Collaboration & NPI: Build deep partnerships with Product Management, Product Marketing, and Engineering to lead New Product Introduction (NPI) enablement strategies. Translate product roadmaps, beta releases, and technical feature updates into actionable field messaging, technical guides, and demo workflows before launch.
  • SE Certification Programs: Design, implement, and govern multi-tiered technical certification frameworks for the global SE team. Develop hands-on practical exams, live troubleshooting scenarios, and technical assessments to validate field competency across Verkada’s core platform (Command, Cameras, Access Control, Environmental Sensors, Alarms, Workplace, and Intercom).
  • Continuous Technical Learning: Design and execute ongoing enablement initiatives, recurring technical deep-dives, competitive differentiation workshops, and advanced skill-refresher programs to maintain field excellence as the platform rapidly evolves.
  • Enablement Analytics & Impact Measurement: Establish metrics to track the effectiveness of enablement programs, such as correlation between certification scores, demo performance, and sales win rates. Regularly report on field readiness gaps and program ROI to leadership.
  • Field Feedback Loop Optimization: Serve as the structured voice-of-the-customer (VoC) for the SE team by gathering, synthesizing, and reporting field-based product feedback and common customer objections back to Product Management and Engineering, ensuring that field insights influence the product roadmap.
  • Scalable Enablement Content Strategy: Partner with the Content Management Lead to ensure the "single source of truth" repository for technical enablement assets (documentation, video training, demo scripts) remains accurate and up-to-date, providing them with the necessary technical insights and validation to keep content aligned with product releases and prevent stale information from circulating in the field.
  • Global Community & Peer-to-Peer Knowledge Sharing: Foster a culture of internal expertise by facilitating community-led knowledge sharing, such as "SE-led" webinar series or regional champion programs, to scale technical knowledge beyond centrally created training materials.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of combined experience in Solutions/Sales Engineering, Technical Enablement, or Technical Architecture within enterprise SaaS, IoT, hardware, or networking industries.
  • Proven track record of establishing formal cross-functional enablement pipelines with Product Management and Engineering teams for NPI rollout.
  • Direct experience designing and managing physical/virtual hardware-software technical labs, testbeds, or enterprise demo environments.
  • Demonstrated capability in building structured technical certification curricula, evaluation rubrics, and skills-validation frameworks.
  • Strong technical foundation in cloud networking, IoT architecture, physical security systems, REST APIs, and enterprise IT infrastructure.
  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical specs into compelling field-ready enablement materials.

US Employee Benefits

Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:

  • Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs - Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans
  • Nationwide medical, vision and dental coverage
  • Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) with tax saving options
  • Expanded mental health support
  • Paid parental leave policy & fertility benefits
  • Time off to relax and recharge through our paid holidays, firmwide extended holidays, flexible PTO and personal sick time
  • Professional development stipend
  • Wellness/fitness benefits
  • Healthy lunches provided daily
  • Commuter benefits

Additional Information

  • You must be independently authorized to work in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this role, at this time

  • This role requires that you be based out of Verkada HQ in San Mateo, CA and on-site 5 days a week. Occasional travel to partner locations, regional offices, and industry events is expected.

Annual Pay Range

At Verkada, we want to attract and retain the best employees, and compensate them in a way that appropriately and fairly values their individual contribution to the company. With that in mind, we carefully consider a number of factors to determine the appropriate starting pay for an employee, including their primary work location and an assessment of a candidate's skills and experience, as well as market demands and internal parity. A Verkada employee may be eligible for additional forms of compensation, depending on their role, including sales incentives, discretionary bonuses, and/or equity in the company in the form of restricted stock units (RSUs)

Description:

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.

Junior Content Specialist/Content Engineer wanted to join our Content Services team!

The opportunity

In this role you will be responsible for creating, editing and managing digital content across enterprise Content Management Systems and Digital Asset Management platforms. You will work closely with cross-functional project teams, authors and client stakeholders to ensure high quality, consistency, and timely delivery of web content.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Create, edit and maintain content pages and web structures using CMS platforms according to established guidelines and WYSIWYG/HTML editors.
  • Upload, organize and tag digital assets in DAM platforms. Perform basic cropping, resizing and format or compression optimization using DAM capabilities or approved image-editing tools.
  • Use Figma at a basic level to make minor edits to existing designs, prepare simple layouts, and export assets in web-ready formats.
  • Support content migration from legacy platforms to current systems. Conduct visual and technical QA checks against style guides, SEO guidelines and formatting standards.
  • Investigate and resolve common content display and formatting issues; assist end users and authors with platform-related questions.
  • Write and maintain clear authoring guides, process documentation and knowledge-base articles for authors and internal teams.
  • Participate in daily stand-ups, client showcases and collaborate with marketing teams, developers and project managers.
  • Utilize basic AI/Generative AI tools to assist in content categorization, summarization, quality checking and task efficiency.

 

What you should have

  • Strong technical aptitude spanning web technologies, content architecture, and web application workflows. Understanding of fundamental web principles.
  • Knowledge of HTML, CSS, web page structure, metadata, hyperlinks, and basic responsive design.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Familiarity with image-editing tools for cropping, resizing, simple adjustments and web optimization. Experience with Figma is a plus for basic asset preparation and layout work.
  • Methodical approach to repetitive, high-volume content entry and quality assurance checks.
  • Professional English proficiency (B2 level or higher, written and spoken) with the ability to ask clear questions and communicate issues effectively.
  • Eager to learn, proactive, open to feedback and comfortable working both independently and as part of a collaborative team.

 

Bonus points if you have

  • Basic understanding of SEO metadata and core web accessibility principles, including alternative text, heading hierarchy and descriptive links.
  • Experience with Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence) and Microsoft SharePoint/Teams.
  • Experience with (or a real interest in) digital content in the automotive industry.
  • Knowledge of Adobe Experience Manager will be a huge plus.
  • Relevant certifications or training (e.g., HTML/CSS Fundamentals, CMS Site Author certifications such as AEM Site Author or Contentful Content Manager).
  • Education or background in IT, Digital Media, Computer Science or Communications.
  • Hands-on experience navigating and managing content within one or more CMS platforms (e.g., AEM, Sitecore, WordPress, Contentful, Drupal). Basic understanding of Digital Asset Management workflows, including asset upload, organization, tagging and metadata.

 

What we can offer you

We offer gross hourly rate 42 - 54 PLN on Mandate contract based your skills and experience.

 

Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we’ll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We’ll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.

Our culture thrives on our core values, designed for impact-driven individuals: Heart, Brains and Courage.

We lead with Heart, fostering empathy and trust where genuine connections and human-centric work flourish.
We empower your Brains for innovation, valuing relentless curiosity and collaborative intelligence to solve complex challenges.
And we champion Courage, inspiring you to speak up, embrace experimentation, and advocate for bold solutions that push our thinking to be better than yesterday.

Learn more about us on our LinkedIn page, visit our YouTube channel and follow us on Instagram WPP Poland.

Description:
About WPP Media

Director, Strategic Partnerships, Agency & Client Enablement

About WPP Media

WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, AI, Data, People and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit www.wppmedia.com

The UK is the largest market within the WPP Media EMEA region, with over 4,500 people employed within the WPP Media ecosystem. Marquee UK key clients include the likes of Amazon, UK Government, BT, Tesco, Coca Cola, Bayer, Dell, Unilever, M&S, Ford, Nestle, Mazda, Danone and Colgate. We have a bold ambition: to make WPP Media UK the undisputed leader in our industry. We are evolving our business operating model, our ways of working and placing data, technology and AI at the heart of everything we do for our people and our clients. 

ONE WPP – Vision '30

Join us in shaping the future of our industry with Vision '30 – our ambitious strategy to lead in the AI era. We are revolutionizing our business to unlock limitless growth opportunities for our clients and ourselves, built on four core priorities:

  1. Collaboration: Foster unprecedented levels of data collaboration across WPP and partners through WPP Open, turning every channel into a smarter opportunity.
  2. Data & Technology: Leverage our AI-powered Open Intelligence solution, connecting vast data to uncover unique insights, deliver predictive performance and superior brand experiences through our globally consistent DPAM process.
  3. Innovation: Drive true innovation by generating intelligence from trillions of privacy-by-default data points, focusing on the 'why' behind customer behaviour to create unparalleled competitive advantages.
  4. People: Developing future-ready talent involves evolving our focus from traditional media planning to strategic business outcomes, advanced technology and real-time measurable results, as AI increasingly automates media investment by 2030

We empower ambitious experts to deliver extraordinary work by challenging ordinary thinking. If you are passionate about an AI-driven future, thrive in a collaborative and data-centric environment, and are driven to deliver unparalleled growth, we invite you to be part of our transformative journey.

WPP Media is a single client centric company with a portfolio of go to market brands. Wavemaker, EssenceMediacom, Mindshare and T&P are our agency teams, these house multiple local and global clients.  In addition, we have a number of client specific brands built to service specific clients. These include OpenDoor (Amazon), MFG (Google), OpenMind (Nestle), OpenConnect (BT/EE) and Media Futures Group (Google).  All of these teams are supported by consistent capabilities, enterprise level tools and systems and our market leading OPEN platform.   

Role Summary and Impact

The Director is a key management role within WPP Media, responsible for leading a defined area of the business and ensuring operational excellence through effective planning, execution and team leadership. They translate broader functional priorities into practical action, delivering results through others and driving improvements across processes, client service and commercial performance. This role requires strong leadership, sound judgment and the ability to manage complexity within a clearly defined area of responsibility.

Capability Description 

As the Director of Strategic Partnerships – Agency & Client Enablement, you will lead the development and delivery of programmes that help agency and client teams understand, access and activate the capabilities of WPP Media's most strategic partners. Working across media, technology and data partners, you will ensure that partner innovation is translated into practical opportunities that drive client outcomes, commercial growth and competitive advantage.

This role will focus on the planning and execution of enablement activity, including communications, learning programmes, partner capability positioning, events, community engagement and adoption initiatives. You will work closely with agency, client, product, commercial and partnership teams to increase awareness, understanding and utilisation of partner capabilities across the business, ensuring that teams are equipped to identify and unlock value for clients.

You will act as the bridge between partner capability and business adoption, identifying opportunities to drive greater engagement, increase activation and improve the overall value delivered through WPP Media's partner ecosystem. Success in this role will be measured by the effective translation of partner investment and innovation into meaningful client outcomes, commercial growth and competitive advantage for WPP Media.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Agency and Client Enablement

  • Own the delivery of enablement programmes for a defined portfolio of strategic partners and capabilities across WPP Media.
    • Translate partner capabilities into clear agency-facing activation plans, communications, learning programmes and engagement opportunities.
    • Monitor adoption and engagement across agency teams, identifying barriers and opportunities to increase utilisation.
    • Develop a deep understanding of your partner portfolio and the client challenges those capabilities are designed to solve.

Enablement Programme Management

  • Lead the governance and delivery of enablement activity for assigned partners and strategic initiatives.
    • Manage annual enablement plans, including communications, training, events, accreditation programmes and stakeholder engagement activity.
    • Maintain clear visibility of milestones, dependencies, risks and opportunities across enablement programmes.
    • Ensure stakeholders receive timely updates, reporting and recommendations to support decision-making and prioritisation.
    • Monitor progress against agreed actions, proactively resolving blockers and driving delivery.

Adoption, Value and Growth

  • Track adoption and business impact across assigned partner programmes.
    • Identify opportunities to increase awareness, engagement and activation of partner capabilities across agency and client teams.
    • Work closely with client, agency, product and partnership teams to connect partner capabilities to commercial opportunities and client outcomes.
    • Capture and share success stories, case studies and best practice to support broader adoption across WPP Media.
    • Support new business and strategic client opportunities by showcasing relevant partner capabilities and value propositions.

Enablement Communications and Engagement

  • Develop and deliver engaging communications that help agency teams understand and access partner capabilities.
    • Create and maintain enablement resources including playbooks, guides, training materials and capability documentation.
    • Support the planning and delivery of events, workshops, roadshows and learning initiatives.
    • Foster strong relationships across agency, product, commercial and partner teams to build engagement and advocacy.
  • Lead partner engagement initiatives that showcase WPP Media's capabilities, priorities and strategic agenda, strengthening relationships and driving deeper collaboration across the partner ecosystem.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Experience in enablement, client leadership, planning, strategy, partnerships, product marketing, capability development or client-facing roles within media, advertising or technology sectors.
  • Strong understanding of how agencies operate and how media, technology and platform capabilities are brought to market.
  • Experience delivering cross-functional programmes, learning initiatives, communications or adoption-focused projects.
  • Strong relationship management skills with the ability to work effectively across internal and external stakeholders.
  • Excellent organisational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong communication, presentation and storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for different audiences.
  • Commercial awareness and an understanding of how partner capabilities create value for clients and the business.
  • Ability to influence and collaborate without direct authority.
  • Experience working with media, data, technology or platform partners would be beneficial.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive engagement, adoption or behavioural change within complex organisations.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to high-quality execution.
  • Comfortable operating within defined frameworks while identifying opportunities to improve processes, programmes and outcomes.

Measures of Success

Within 6 Months: Gain a comprehensive understanding of WPP Media and our broader business strategy, plus you will have started to think about incorporating Vision '30 into your operational roadmap and key initiatives. Understand our business challenges and be able to articulate those beyond your immediate remit (macro level, country level, departmental level). Your team will acknowledge clear direction and support plus initial stakeholder feedback should reflect proactive engagement. A key measurable is that you should have also initiated discussions and actions to begin improving processes within your business area leveraging data/AI thinking, where relevant.

Within 12 Months: Demonstrate consistent delivery across strategic partnership activity, showing the impact of your leadership on operational performance and stakeholder engagement. You’ll receive positive feedback from internal and external stakeholders on the quality of coordination, delivery and commercial support, alongside positive 360-degree feedback on your leadership and contribution to WPP Media and Vision '30. You will have improved team ways of working, supported stronger partnership outcomes and contributed to client growth, partner activation or new business activity aligned to Vision '30 capabilities. Maintain strong stakeholder confidence and demonstrate effective team development.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

  • Professional experience with paid media, digital advertising, marketing data, media analytics, ad technology, or agency reporting environments.

About the role: We are looking for a hybrid Social Media Strategist and Operator (hands on) who can bring both strategic vision and hands-on execution. You will act as the "Creative Director" for social—owning the big-picture strategy, content calendar, and organic growth while guiding our in-house designer and video editors. While you will have design and video support, you must be resourceful and capable of jumping into execution (copywriting, basic design, AI prompt engineering, posting) when needed. This role blends content strategy, digital PR/outreach, brand building, and light paid media oversight to expand our reach among high-net-worth families, drive workshop registrations, and build a pipeline for future investors. Key Responsibilities Social Strategy & Creative Direction: Own the content strategy, social calendar, and execution across both brands ( Wilkinson and Thriving Families ). Direct in-house graphic designers and video editors with clear briefs and visual vision; maintain high quality-control standards before content goes live. Research industry trends and competitors to design scroll-stopping content tailored to mature, high-net-worth audiences. Top-of-Funnel Growth / Paid Media Strategy: Manage paid social media campaigns focused on top-of-funnel brand awareness (driving book giveaways and workshop registrations for Thriving Families rather than direct investment lead gen). Setup, test, and optimize Meta/social advertising settings to reach high-net-worth families. Utilize AI tools, custom prompts, and retargeting strategies to keep content pipelines full and cost-effective. Digital PR & Community Outreach: Adopt a proactive Digital PR mindset : identify and reach out to relevant influencers, partner brands, and communities via DMs and digital channels to expand brand reach. Oversee community health across platforms—engaging thoughtfully in comments and DMs to build genuine relationships with followers. Content Production & AI Utilization: Write polished, intelligent copy tailored to a 40–70 year old demographic (zero fluff, no excessive emojis, clear value). Leverage AI workflows (ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, etc.) to streamline research, drafting, scheduling, and repurposing content at scale. Manage compliance approvals for investment-related content. Requirements Experience: 4–5+ years running social media strategy, content creation, and growth for a brand, creator, or agency. Strategic & Operational Hybrid: Ability to think like a Head of Content (strategy, messaging, audience profiling) while staying hands-on with platform settings, AI tools, and copy. English Fluency: Excellent written and spoken English with strong business maturity, clear tone, and minimal accent for high-level partner communication. Audience Fit: Deep understanding of how to communicate with mature, high-net-worth demographics (aged 40–70). Technical & Platform Mastery: Deep, up-to-date knowledge of Meta’s business tools, LinkedIn, YouTube, and paid media setups. Detail & Visual Standards: Exceptional eye for detail—ensuring zero graphical, factual, or contextual errors before publishing. Communication: Fast, constant communication via Slack, email, and calendar RSVPs with low-ego, ownership-driven execution. Preferred Qualifications Prior experience managing social media in real estate, private equity, finance, or publishing/coaching. Familiarity with directing remote designers or using tools like Canva, CapCut, or Adobe Suite when quick edits are required. Proven track record using paid social to drive top-of-funnel events (workshops, book funnels, community building). Strong experience building digital PR/influencer relationships through digital outreach. #LI-NC1

Title: Client Enablement Associate
Description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale. Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us. Attributes We Value We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles . You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor. You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next. About the team The Operations team at Airwallex ensures the smooth and efficient functioning of our services and processes. We focus on optimising workflows, improving operational efficiency, and delivering exceptional customer support. By streamlining operations and implementing best practices, we help drive the company's growth and maintain high service standards. Our team is dedicated to providing a seamless experience for our customers and supporting Airwallex's mission to empower businesses globally. What you'll do You will join the Client Enablement (CE) team, working to build a seamless customer product onboarding and configuration experience for Airwallex customers across the EMEA and globally. In this role, you will work with various internal stakeholders to ensure client accounts are ready for transaction and that client transactions can be processed smoothly in production environments. You will partner closely with Commercial, Solution Engineering, and Product teams to configure pricing and account capabilities, while identifying opportunities to improve the onboarding experience at scale. The CE team is small but business critical, and you will play a key role in providing a positive initial experience with the platform as the EMEA business continues to grow. Responsibilities: Be a key source of knowledge on Airwallex configuration topics across product domains for both pricing and capability configuration details. Work with account executives to amend Airwallex account pricings per the commercial team's request. Co-work with solution engineers globally to gather, validate, and apply configuration requests to enable capabilities suiting client business and technical needs. Collaborate closely with commercial, operations, and product teams to gather, evaluate, and summarise improvement opportunities within platform client onboarding processes. Develop and manage on-shore functional programs and projects that enable EMEA operational and organisational goals. Maintain and update customer account settings and pricing throughout the lifecycle of their relationship with Airwallex, ensuring accuracy and consistency across configurations. Who you are We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory. Minimum qualifications: A minimum of 5 years of professional experience in the payment industry or operations at a technology company. Ability to rapidly understand new products and demonstrate adaptive problem-solving skills. Strong communication skills and customer service consciousness. Attention to detail with strong follow-up and good judgment. A strong team player who thrives working in close collaboration with other teams across time zones. Preferred qualifications: Bachelor's degree or above in Business Administration, Information Sciences, or equivalent. Familiarity with reading and parsing JSON formatting, or comfort working with API documentation and sandbox environments. Experience with analytical tools such as Excel, Looker, BigQuery, SQL, or similar data and visualisation platforms. Ability to move fast and grow in dynamic, collaborative, and ambiguous startup-like environments, with a willingness to take ownership and champion craftsmanship in your work. All official communication will come from an @ airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary. Equal opportunity Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. Title: Member Experience Operations, Content Strategy
Description: About Base Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time. About the Role This is not a traditional content role. You'll sit at the intersection of copywriting, lifecycle strategy, and member education—owning the post-sale experience from the moment someone signs with Base through years of membership. Our members make a meaningful commitment when they join Base. Your job is to make sure they never regret it. That means getting ahead of their questions before they have them, guiding them through onboarding and installation with clarity, and continuously deepening their understanding of and engagement with their Base system. You'll own the Help Center, all automated communications sequences, and every word members read in the app and dashboard. If you've worked in support, customer success, or member experience and you're tired of solving the same problem one ticket at a time — this role lets you fix it for everyone, permanently. Writing is part of the job, not the whole job. If you love writing, operations, systems thinking, and building something category-defining from the ground up, this role is for you. Done well, this role directly reduces contact volume, increases net promoter score, drives app engagement, and keeps members for life. What You'll Do Build, maintain, and continuously improve a self-serve knowledge base that answers member questions proactively and reduces inbound contact volume. Design and manage lifecycle communication flows across email, SMS, and push notifications for post-sale onboarding, installation milestones, and ongoing member engagement. Own all in-product content—tooltips, notifications, explanations, and educational prompts—ensuring members always know what's happening with their system and why it matters. Translate complex energy concepts into clear, friendly language that any homeowner can understand. Map the full post-sale member journey and identify moments where proactive communication can reduce friction, answer questions, and build confidence. Build, test, and optimize lifecycle sequences in CRM and automation platforms, using data to continuously improve performance. Collaborate with Member Experience, Design, Ops, and Engineering to ensure content reflects real member behavior and product reality. What You'll Bring 3–7+ years in customer support, customer experience, content strategy, communication, customer education, or a similar function at a fast-paced consumer company. Direct experience owning a customer's end-to-end experience — you know where things break down because you've seen it firsthand, not just measured it in a dashboard. Exceptional copywriting skills—you make complicated things simple and dry things interesting. Hands-on experience building and optimizing lifecycle journeys in various tools. A data-driven mindset: you define success metrics before you start, and you know how to measure what's working. Strong organizational instincts—you can manage a content backlog, have clear version control and change logs, maintain a Help Center, and run multiple active sequences without dropping anything. Ability to operate cross-functionally and hold a high bar for quality across every member touchpoint. Comfort being both strategic and hands-on—you're just as comfortable auditing a comms sequence as you are presenting a content strategy to leadership. About the Team The Member Experience team is the face of Base to our members—and the voice of our members back to Base. We’re deeply customer-obsessed and uniquely cross-functional, with a strong understanding of what every team does and how it all connects. By seeing firsthand what’s working well and what should be improved, we surface insights that help inform what the business builds and prioritizes next. Every day brings a new challenge, balancing high ownership and accountability with constant collaboration and support from the team. Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive. Our Values First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules. Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing. Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset. Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results. Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information. Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in. Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things. Do the best work of your life at Base.

Title: Field Enablement Manager (Enablement Program and Platform Manager)
Description: We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era. When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done. Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma. We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today. ROLE OVERVIEW Over the coming years, biotech will fundamentally rewrite the way we live. Gene editing and cell therapy are dramatically changing how we treat cancer and other major illnesses. Biofuels and biomaterials are transforming the cars we drive, the clothes we wear, and the makeup of everyday objects. Crop science and synthetic biology are producing sustainable and ethical food. Benchling’s mission is to accelerate the research that propels us towards this reality, and magnify its impact, through modern software. Every day, scientists around the world use Benchling’s applications, platform, & analytics in their efforts to solve humanity’s most pressing problems. For these scientists, Benchling is the central technology they use to conduct their research. Our customers include pharmaceutical giants, leading biotechs, and the world’s most renowned research institutes. Benchling is looking for a Field Enablement Manager, focused on enablement program and platform management, to own our Docebo LMS end-to-end and build the onboarding curriculum that enables our customer-facing teams to deliver at a high level. This role has hybrid responsibilities: part platform administrator, part learning program contributor. You will ensure the LMS is healthy, well-architected, and driving measurable outcomes, while also designing and maintaining content, learning paths, and certification programs across our internal and external consumers. This role is a key contributor to Benchling's broader knowledge infrastructure investments, including our AI knowledge management initiatives. RESPONSIBILITIES Own all Docebo administration: global settings, user provisioning, group management, report configuration, integrations, and platform health, etc. Design and maintain the LMS content architecture across our three personas (internal, customer, partners): learning plans, certification tracks, course libraries, learner UX, etc. Build and maintain dashboards and reporting to track completion rates, certification attainment, and program effectiveness Develop scalable onboarding and continuous learning programs for CX roles including Professional Services, Customer Success, and Support Author courses, assessments, job aids, and certification programs Partner with subject matter experts across CX to translate complex product and process knowledge into engaging training content Refine and execute on governance processes for eLearning content lifecycle management: creation, review cadences, version control, and deprecation Collaborate with Benchling colleagues across the Knowledge & Digital Experience program to align LMS content strategy with Benchling's broader knowledge ecosystem QUALIFICATIONS 3+ years of experience in learning & development, instructional design, or enablement within a B2B SaaS company 2+ years of hands-on LMS administration experience; Docebo strongly preferred BS or M.Sc. in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Genetics, or similar life science field Life science background or experience enabling teams serving scientific industries Strong content development skills; can author or direct the creation of clear, engaging enablement materials without always having deep domain expertise Demonstrated ability to design and build end-to-end curriculum, not just maintain content, including learning paths, assessments, and certifications Experience with eLearning authoring tools (e.g., Articulate Rise 360, or similar) and assessment tools (e.g. Skillable, Questionmark, or similar) Strong project management skills; can own a program from scoping through launch and iteration Experience building learning metrics and using data to improve program effectiveness Familiarity with KCS methodology or knowledge management best practices, a plus HOW WE WORK We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 3 days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday). #LI-Hybrid #BI-Hybrid Benchling welcomes everyone. We believe diversity enriches our team so we hire people with a wide range of identities, backgrounds, and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. That means we don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including but not limited to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Title: Senior Operations Strategy & Enablement Manager
Description: ABOUT BESTOW Life insurance is one of the world's most important products. It's also one of the hardest to build, distribute, and modernize. Bestow exists to change that. Bestow is a leading vertical technology platform serving some of the largest and most innovative life insurers. Our platform unifies the fragmented, legacy value chain, enabling carriers to launch products in weeks instead of years. Carriers choose us to scale and operate at unprecedented speed, powered by AI and automation. Bestow isn't selling policies. We're building the infrastructure that helps an entire industry move faster, reach more people, and deliver on its promise. Backed by leading investors (Goldman Sachs, Hedosophia, NEA, Valar, 8VC) and trusted by major carriers, Bestow is powered by a team that moves with precision, purpose, and heart. If you want to help reimagine a centuries-old industry with lasting impact, join us. Bestow offers flexible remote/hybrid work, meaningful benefits, equity, and substantial growth opportunities. Bestow uses E-Verify to confirm the employment eligibility of all newly hired employees. To learn more about E-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, please visit E-Verify.gov . ABOUT THE TEAM Bestow's TPA Operations Team comprises the Customer Experience (CX), Customer Experience Operations (CXO), and New Business & Underwriting Support (CM) teams and is dedicated to providing outstanding customer experiences through our omni-channel platform. We own the systems, processes, and performance mechanisms that allow Bestow to serve customers and carrier partners at scale, and we are responsible for making that experience faster, smarter, and more efficient. We sit at the center of Product, Engineering and our outsourced partners, translating priorities into working systems and turning day-to-day operational reality into insight the business acts on. We are a team of 160 people and a high-trust team, which means the work is highly visible and ownership is real. This role reports directly to the VP of TPA Services, and is open to hybrid in our Dallas office or Remote (US). #LIREMOTE. WHAT YOU'LL DO We are seeking a highly organized, technically fluent Sr. Operations Manager to serve as the operational right hand to our operations leadership - the person who turns intent into execution. This role is built for someone who thrives on breadth: one day building the reporting that explains what is happening, the next configuring the systems that change it, the next driving a cross-functional initiative to completion because you were the one who followed up. You will be trusted with high-stakes, ambiguous work where the path forward is not always defined, and judged on velocity, follow-through, and the quality of your thinking. Key responsibilities include: Operational Insight & Reporting Performance Visibility: Own the reporting layer for the operation — build and maintain the dashboards, trending analyses, and performance reviews that leadership uses to make decisions. Diagnostic Analysis: Move past "what happened" to "why," using data to isolate root causes in efficiency, capacity, quality, and customer outcomes, and translate findings into specific recommendations. Capacity & Efficiency: Partner with workforce planning on forecasting, staffing, and productivity analysis; identify and close the gap between planned and realized capacity. Systems Ownership & Configuration Platform Administration : Serve as a hands-on administrator for our operational and telephony systems — routing, skilling, queue design, IVR and self-service flows, and user configuration. Change Execution: Scope, configure, test, and deploy system changes with an eye toward reliability; document what changed and why, and validate impact after the fact. Technical Partnership: Work directly with Engineering and Product to unblock dependencies, define requirements in terms they can build against, and represent operational reality in technical decisions. Process Improvement & Program Execution End-to-End Implementation: Own improvement initiatives from problem definition through rollout and measurement — including the unglamorous middle where most initiatives stall. Follow-Through Mechanism: Be the accountability layer across partner and planning forums: capture commitments, track them to closure, surface slippage early, and escalate with a recommendation rather than a question. Roadmap Advocacy: Maintain a clear line of sight into the product and engineering roadmap on behalf of the operation — know what is committed, what has been deprioritized, and what that means for us before it becomes a surprise. Enablement & Scaled Delivery: Working with partners and vendors directly to scale tools and operations. Frontline Impact: Define success criteria for operational changes and partner with training and quality teams to ensure changes land with the people doing the work. Leadership & Influence: Set direction for cross-functional working groups, mentor teammates and analysts, and raise the operational bar without relying on formal authority. Title: Partner Enablement Specialist
Description: Our Story Campfire is a next-gen core accounting platform built for modern mid-market finance teams. We help them close fast and scale even faster. Our platform replaces outdated legacy ERPs and manual accounting processes with automation-driven solutions that simplify and accelerate finance workflows. In the past year alone, we have grown 10x, driven by strong customer demand and a product that delivers real results for accounting & finance teams. We are scaling quickly and building the future of finance by giving teams the clarity, control, and strategic visibility they need to lead with confidence. Role Overview As Partner Enablement Specialist, your mission is to make sure every external implementation partner can deliver the Campfire standard as reliably as our internal team does. You'll take the training curriculum and standards developed for internal onboarding and adapt them for an external audience — building the certification bootcamps, materials, and ongoing support that keep partners accurate, confident, and self-sufficient. This is a hands-on, execution-focused role: you're not designing the overall onboarding architecture, you're the person who makes sure partners actually learn it, pass it, and keep up with it as the product evolves. Key Responsibilities Partner Bootcamp Delivery Run scheduled Partner Bootcamps, adapting the internal onboarding curriculum into partner-facing training sessions, workshops, and materials. Own the partner certification process: administer assessments, track completion, and issue certifications against the rubrics defined by the Product Enablement Manager. Maintain a partner-facing knowledge base (guides, FAQs, troubleshooting docs) that mirrors internal SOPs but is tailored for external use. Partner Readiness & Support Serve as the first point of contact for partner questions during and after certification. Monitor partner-led implementations for early signs of drift from the Campfire standard, and flag recurring issues back to the Product Enablement Manager. Collect partner feedback on training gaps, confusing configurations, or product friction, and route it upstream. Content Maintenance Keep partner training materials in sync as product changes roll out — update decks, scripts, and guides in real-time under the direction of the Product Enablement Manager. Help build out video modules and self-serve certification paths as the partner program scales. Cross-Functional Coordination Partner with the Head of Solution Consulting Partnerships and the Accounting Partnerships Lead to coordinate bootcamp logistics — aligning on scheduling, partner cohorts, and readiness timelines for each partnership track. Work with the Accounting Partnerships Lead to ensure bootcamp content reflects the specific configurations and workflows accounting partners need to certify on. Work with the Head of Solution Consulting Partnerships to align solution consulting partner training with evolving deal and implementation requirements. Requirements 1–3 years of experience in implementation, customer success, or training/enablement — ideally with some direct Campfire product exposure. Strong communicator who can explain technical configuration steps clearly to an external audience with less context than an internal hire. Organized and detail-oriented: comfortable owning a certification pipeline and tracking who's where in it. Comfortable running live sessions (bootcamps, workshops) as well as producing written/video materials. This is an execution and delivery role, not a design-from-scratch role — success means faithfully scaling what's already been built, not reinventing it.

Title: AI Enablement Engineer
Description: Coder is looking for an AI Enablement Engineer to help execute our Smart AI roadmap and make AI and vibe coding easier across the company. You’ll work directly with employees to understand what they’re trying to build, answer questions about Smart AI best practices, and remove the technical or process barriers getting in their way. You’ll also turn those needs into shipped improvements. That means building and refining Smart AI journeys, reusable skills, paved paths, and infrastructure enhancements, while partnering closely with the Smart AI Program lead on roadmap execution. You’ll also teach through office hours and sessions, but most of your time will be spent listening, building, troubleshooting, and improving the system around our internal AI community. What you’ll do here Act as a hands-on technical partner for Coder employees using Smart AI, helping them understand best practices, choose the right approach, and work through blockers. Meet with employees across the company to understand their needs, requirements, workflows, and impediments as they build with AI. Answer questions in Slack, meetings, and working sessions about Smart AI tools, models, prompts, harnesses, development environments, and recommended patterns. Identify recurring needs across our internal AI community and translate them into clear requirements for the Smart AI roadmap. Execute against the existing Smart AI roadmap by building and improving reusable journeys, skills, templates, system instructions, and other paved paths. Contribute directly to infrastructure enhancements that make internal AI development easier, more reliable, and more consistent. Build alongside users when useful, using tools like Claude Code and other AI-assisted development workflows to prototype solutions and validate new approaches. Help improve the dedicated development environment employees use for vibe coding, including integrations, connectors, APIs, model access, and supporting infrastructure. Turn one-off questions into reusable solutions when a pattern emerges, so the next employee can start from a better place. Partner closely with the Smart AI Program lead to connect day-to-day employee feedback with roadmap priorities and execution. Host office hours, workshops, lunch and learns, and other enablement sessions that help employees build confidence and develop stronger AI working habits. Create clear guidance, examples, and documentation for Smart AI capabilities as new journeys, skills, tools, and best practices are introduced. What we’re looking for 3+ years of experience working in technology, preferably in a startup environment. An engineering background or meaningful hands-on experience building with tools like Claude Code. You understand how software is built, orchestrated, and deployed. The ability to learn new tools and technologies quickly through independent study and experimentation. A high degree of empathy for users, especially those working with cutting-edge technology for the first time. A proven ability to identify user roadblocks and create practical solutions that remove them. A tinkering mindset. You look for ways to improve, automate, and simplify, then act on them. PM-like pattern recognition. You can spot recurring signals in user feedback and requests, then turn them into clear, repeatable golden paths. Strong communication skills across technical ability levels. You can explain how something works, help someone debug it, and adjust your approach based on the person in front of you. Comfort moving between requirement gathering and implementation. You can understand the problem, define what good looks like, then help build the solution. The judgment to distinguish a one-off user issue from a systems problem worth solving for everyone. Bonus tacos if you have An entrepreneurial mindset and a habit of finding useful things to create, test, and build. Familiarity with Coder or other remote development environment tools, including Gitpod, DevPod, or GitHub Codespaces. Experience in business analysis, learning and development, or developer relations. Experience supporting an internal developer platform, AI enablement program, developer community, or technical center of excellence. Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP), API integrations, or connecting AI tools to systems like Slack, GitHub, Salesforce, or internal databases. Experience creating technical workshops, documentation, examples, or enablement programs for users with different levels of technical experience. About Coder Coder is the leading platform for AI development Infrastructure, enabling enterprises to securely run human and AI-driven development workflows in consistent, governed environments. Coder provides self-hosted, agent-ready workspaces that unify developer productivity and platform governance. With Coder, enterprises can confidently evolve from human-only development to AI-assisted and autonomous workflows, without sacrificing security, compliance, or performance. Learn more at coder.com .
