Title: Senior Director, AI and Data Science (Drug Discovery and R&D Enablement)
Description: Role Summary Lexeo is at an inflection point where AI and advanced analytics can materially accelerate decision-making across discovery, development, and operational execution. This Sr. Director will set direction and deliver applied AI/ML solutions across internal workflows and externally facing outputs, ranging from R&D insights to partner-ready analyses, while partnering closely with scientific teams and, when needed, external vendors/partners to solve real problems. This role is intentionally hands-on and outcome-driven: a leader who can build, validate, and operationalize models using real-world biopharma data to raise the signal-to-noise ratio in small or unstructured datasets (including synthetic control arm approaches where appropriate). Key Responsibilities AI/ML Strategy + Delivery Define and execute Lexeo’s applied AI/ML roadmap across discovery and development, prioritizing use cases that improve speed, quality, and decision confidence. Deliver solutions that are internal-only (e.g., scientific decision support, operational forecasting) and those that are generated internally but external-facing (e.g., partner-ready analyses (regulatory dossiers, briefing books, protocols etc.), validated dashboards, and decision materials). Establish best practices for model lifecycle management (validation, documentation, monitoring, retraining), especially where outputs influence scientific decisions or regulated workflows. Advanced Analytics + Predictive Modeling Lead development and selection of appropriate ML approaches (e.g., XGBoost, Random Forest, SVMs, and other advanced models) based on problem framing, data constraints, interpretability needs, and deployment context. Build and oversee predictive analytics using real-world data, including robust evaluation design, bias/variance trade-offs, and performance monitoring. Small Data Excellence + Synthetic Controls Apply techniques to amplify signal-to-noise in smaller datasets (e.g., regularization, Bayesian methods, hierarchical modeling, augmentation, multimodal integration, careful feature engineering, uncertainty quantification). Guide strategy for synthetic control arms and comparable approaches (as appropriate), ensuring methodological rigor, transparency, and fit-for-purpose use in decision-making. Drug Discovery / Translational Partnership Translate drug discovery and translational questions into testable analytical hypotheses; partner with bench scientists to design data capture that enables strong modeling. S erve as a bridge between scientific teams and data/engineering, ensuring solutions are scientifically credible and operationally adoptable . Cross-functional Enablement + Platform Integration Partner with stakeholders across R&D, CMC, Clinical, Safety, and IT/Security to implement scalable data pipelines and AI-enabled workflows. Contribute leadership to current and emerging initiatives such as AI workflow automation/database buildouts and analytics agents that leverage enterprise platforms (examples already in motion include CMC AI automation, MaxisAI clinical database/AI efforts, and AI work to ingest historical data into Dataverse/Fabric for agent-based analysis; integration work such as a Benchling AI API initiative may also be in scope depending on priorities). External Partner/Vendor Leadership Liaise with external partners to evaluate tools, define statements of work, and deliver solutions—while ensuring knowledge transfer and sustainable internal ownership. Operational Excellence Improve internal processes through automation and analytics, focusing on measurable impact (cycle time, error reduction, throughput, decision latency). Establish practical governance for data quality, documentation, and fit-for-use standards aligned with the realities of biopharma environments (including where regulated practices apply). What Success Looks like (First 6-12 Months) A prioritized AI/analytics roadmap tied to measurable R&D outcomes; clear ownership and delivery cadence. 2–4 production-grade analytics solutions adopted by teams (internal and/or external-facing outputs as needed). A repeatable approach for small datasets and high-noise signals; documented modeling standards and review practices. Strong partner engagement model: vendors/partners used strategically, with internal capability building and durable outcomes. Required Skills and Qualifications Advanced degree in a quantitative or scientific discipline (PhD strongly preferred; MS with exceptional experience considered). 1 0+ years of relevant experience across applied data science/ML in life sciences/biopharma (or adjacent domain with direct drug discovery translation), including 5+ years leading teams and influencing senior stakeholders. Deep familiarity with advanced ML methods (including XGBoost, Random Forest, SVMs) and the judgment to select and justify the right tool for the job. Demonstrated experience building predictive models with real-world, imperfect datasets and delivering them into production or decision workflows. Proven ability to improve processes and operationalize analytics—moving beyond prototypes to adoption. Strong cross-functional communication: can partner with scientists, engineers, and executives; can explain model performance and limitations clearly. Preferred Skills and Qualifications Direct experience in drug discovery, translational research, and/or R&D decision support (target ID/validation, MoA, biomarker strategy, preclinical data integration). Experience with small data strategies, causality-aware thinking, and synthetic control arms or closely related methodologies. Experience operating in regulated/quality-sensitive environments and building documentation practices that scale (particularly relevant where validation and traceability are required). Familiarity with enterprise data platforms and modern analytics stacks (lakehouse/warehouse patterns, feature stores, MLOps, model monitoring). About Lexeo Lexeo Therapeutics is a New York City-based, clinical stage company dedicated to reshaping the path of genetic disease. By advancing pioneering science, Lexeo seeks to set a new standard in the treatment of cardiovascular and neurological genetic diseases, charting the path to patient outcomes once thought out of reach. The Company is advancing a portfolio of therapeutic candidates designed to address the underlying genetic causes of disease, including LX2006 for Friedreich ataxia (FA), LX2020 for plakophilin-2 (PKP2) arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy, and others in devastating diseases with high unmet need. Our work culture is a hybrid model with 2 days/week in the New York City office and 3 days working from home. Lexeo Therapeutics is an EEO employer committed to an exciting, diverse, and enriching work environment.

Title: AI Content Strategist
Description: About PackageX PackageX is building the Physical Logistics Execution Platform for enterprise teams operating across manufacturing sites, distribution centers, warehouses, retail locations, and logistics-heavy environments. Our platform uses Vision AI, workflow automation, mobile execution, and integrations to help companies digitize, execute, and verify physical operations at the point of work, creating trusted evidence of what happened across their operations. Our operating model is simple: Execution. Verification. Evidence. This isn’t just an SEO writing role, you’ll also be expected to dig into complex topics and turn them into strong TL articles and content. You don’t need to know our space on day one. What matters is that you can understand it quickly, ask the right questions, do the research, and run with it. If you’re curious, resourceful, and someone who figures things out, you’ll do well here. This role goes beyond traditional content writing. You will help build PackageX’s authority around AI, logistics, supply chain, warehouse operations, and the future of physical AI. You’ll identify high-value topics, develop content strategies, leverage AI tools to increase content velocity, and create content that performs across both traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered discovery platforms. The ideal candidate is curious, highly driven, comfortable working independently, and excited by the opportunity to operate in a fast-moving startup environment. You Will Develop and execute a content strategy aligned with PackageX’s business goals, ICP, product positioning, and growth priorities. Research and create high-quality content around AI, physical AI, logistics, supply chain, warehousing, inventory, fulfillment, and enterprise technology. Produce a high volume of content, including SEO articles, thought-leadership pieces, product-led content, industry reports, guides, landing pages, and other strategic content assets. Develop content strategies around target keywords, search intent, customer pain points, industry trends, and content gaps. Optimize content for traditional search (SEO) as well as emerging AI-powered search and discovery experiences (GEO/AEO). Leverage AI tools and workflows to accelerate research, ideation, drafting, optimization, and content production while maintaining a high standard of originality and quality. Partner with SEO, marketing, product, sales, and subject-matter experts to translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling content. Identify opportunities to establish PackageX as a thought leader in AI-powered logistics and physical AI. Conduct in-depth research and develop original perspectives on industry trends, technologies, customer challenges, and competitive developments. Create compelling headlines, narratives, and messaging that resonate with logistics, supply chain, operations, and technology audiences. Regularly audit and optimize existing content to improve search visibility, rankings, engagement, readability, conversions, and overall content performance. Monitor content performance using metrics such as organic traffic, keyword rankings, search visibility, backlinks, engagement, conversions, and AI/search discoverability. Identify content gaps and recommend new opportunities based on customer needs, market trends, search behavior, and business priorities. Build repeatable content processes and frameworks that enable the team to produce high-quality content at scale. Stay current on developments in generative AI, AI search, SEO, content marketing, logistics technology, and B2B SaaS. We’re Looking For Someone Who Has Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, or a related field. Proven experience in B2B SaaS content strategy, content marketing, SEO, or technical content writing. Strong understanding of SEO principles, search intent, keyword research, content optimization, and organic growth. Familiarity with Generative AI, AI-powered search, GEO/AEO, and AI-assisted content workflows. Excellent writing, editing, research, and storytelling skills. Experience creating content for technical, enterprise, SaaS, logistics, supply chain, or technology audiences. Ability to understand complex products and turn them into simple, engaging narratives. Experience working with content management systems (CMS) and SEO/content tools. A strong portfolio of published content, strategic content projects, or thought leadership. Data-driven mindset with the ability to use content performance metrics to make decisions. Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment. Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. High degree of ownership, curiosity, and attention to detail. What Will Set You Apart Experience writing about AI, computer vision, robotics, automation, logistics technology, or enterprise software. Experience building content strategies for a startup or high-growth SaaS company. Hands-on experience with AI-native content creation and research workflows. Understanding of how LLMs and AI search engines influence content discovery and brand visibility. Experience developing thought leadership and category-creation content. Strong understanding of B2B buyer journeys, enterprise audiences, and product-led growth. Ability to turn proprietary insights, customer stories, product knowledge, and industry data into differentiated content. Experience using analytics and SEO platforms to identify opportunities and measure content ROI. A builder mentality, you enjoy creating systems, experimenting, learning quickly, and improving continuously. What can you expect from the application process? All applications will be looked at by the People team, who will reach out to shortlisted candidates. Across various interview rounds, you'll speak with the hiring manager and other functional heads. We want to have an open discussion about your work and how we can be a great fit. The process may also involve an assessment or presentation relevant to the role. You can expect an offer after three rounds of interviews. All offers are subject to satisfactory reference and background checks.

Title: Content Strategist, Contract (CA)
Description: At PointClickCare our mission is simple: to help providers deliver exceptional care. And that starts with our people. As a leading health tech company that’s founder-led and privately held, we empower our employees to push boundaries, innovate, and shape the future of healthcare. With the largest long-term and post-acute care dataset and a Marketplace of 400+ integrated partners, our platform serves over 30,000 provider organizations, making a real difference in millions of lives. We also reinvest a significant percentage of our revenue back into research and development, ensuring our employees have the resources to innovate and make a lasting impact. Recognized by Forbes as a top private cloud company and honored as one of Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, we offer flexibility, growth opportunities, and meaningful work. At PointClickCare, we empower our people to be the architects of a smarter healthcare future; one that is human-first and accelerated by AI to create meaningful and lasting change. Employees harness AI as a catalyst for creativity, productivity, and thoughtful decision-making. By integrating AI tools into our daily workflows, collaboration is enhanced, outcomes are improved, and every team member has the proficiency to maximize their impact. It all starts with our hiring practices where we uncover AI expertise that complements our mission, and we continue to invest in training and development to nurture innovation throughout the employee journey. Join us in redefining healthcare — so it doesn’t just survive, it thrives. To learn more about PointClickCare, check out Life at PointClickCare and connect with us on Glassdoor and LinkedIn. Key Responsibilities: Own the Owned Brand Content Strategy: Develop, manage, and execute the strategy across PointClickCare's owned channels, including the blog, podcast, web, and long and short form content, ensuring a consistent brand voice and point of view. Execute at a High Standard: Move seamlessly from strategy to production. Plan editorial calendars, write and edit content, manage production workflows, and ship consistently against deadlines. Translate GTM into Brand: Partner with all marketing pods to translate PMM and GTM strategy into brand content strategy, ensuring owned content supports top of funnel thought leadership objectives and business priorities. Lead Owned Media Thought Leadership: Develop and execute thought leadership content for PointClickCare executives and subject matter experts across owned media channels, translating their expertise into compelling, differentiated content for the blog, podcast, and other owned formats where needed. Drive Content Distribution: Develop channel and distribution strategies that extend the reach and impact of owned content, partnering with demand, social, web, and other teams to ensure content reaches priority audiences. Manage Agency Partnership Brand Programs: Serve as the day-to-day executional lead on brand-related agency programs, managing deliverables and deadlines. Cross-Pod Collaboration: Interface with product marketing, demand generation, and growth to align content with campaign priorities and audience needs, acting as the connective tissue between brand and the pods. Measure and Optimize: Track content performance across owned channels, report on key metrics, and use insights to refine the strategy and editorial mix. Content Frameworks and Best Practices: Establish guidelines for brand storytelling, content positioning, and channel strategy that raise the bar for content across the organization. Own SUMMIT Content Strategy and Support Event Deliverables: Lead the owned content strategy for PointClickCare’s annual SUMMIT conference, developing the editorial approach and content plan across pre-event, onsite, and post-event channels, including podcast, blog, and paid media content. Support the development and review of attendee-facing deliverables, including registration and SUMMIT website copy, session titles and descriptions, presentation editing, booth messaging, wayfinding, hype videos, and other event content to ensure a cohesive and engaging experience. Support Employer Brand Content Strategy: Partner with People, Talent Acquisition, HR, and other key stakeholders to support the employer brand content strategy. Develop and edit employee stories, recruitment campaign content, careers-focused web content, and other materials that bring PointClickCare’s culture and employee experience to life while maintaining a consistent brand voice Required Skills & Qualifications: Proven experience in content strategy with a strong executional track record: this role requires someone who builds the plan and delivers the work. Hands-on experience managing owned channels such as blogs, podcasts, and web content, including editorial planning, writing, editing, and production. Experience managing agency partners and external content programs. Strong understanding of how brand content supports top of funnel demand and thought leadership, with the ability to translate PMM and GTM strategy into brand storytelling. Ability to analyze content performance metrics and translate insights into actionable improvements. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, comfortable embedding with multiple teams and pods simultaneously. Title: Manager, Technology and Cyber Awareness, Training and Enablement
Department: Office of the Chief Information Officer
Description: Planned Parenthood is the nation’s leading provider and advocate of high-quality, affordable sexual and reproductive health care for all people, as well as the nation’s largest provider of sex education. Planned Parenthood organizations serve all people with care and compassion, with respect, and without judgment, striving to create equitable access to health care. Through health centers, programs in schools and communities, and online resources, Planned Parenthood is a trusted source of reliable education and information that allows people to make informed health decisions. We do all this because we care passionately about helping people lead healthier lives. Planned Parenthood Federation of America (PPFA) is a 501(c)(3) charitable organization that supports the independently incorporated Planned Parenthood affiliates, which operate non-profit health centers across the U.S. PPFA also works to educate the public on and advocate for issues of sexual and reproductive health. Formed as the advocacy and political arm of Planned Parenthood Federation of America, Planned Parenthood Action Fund is a separate non-profit membership organization tax-exempt under section 501(c)(4). The Action Fund engages in educational, advocacy, and limited electoral activity, including grassroots organizing, legislative advocacy, and voter education in furtherance of the Planned Parenthood mission. Planned Parenthood Federation of America (PPFA) and Planned Parenthood Action Fund seek a Manager, Technology & Cyber Awareness, Training and Enablement to support enterprise technology adoption, cybersecurity awareness, workforce readiness, learning operations, knowledge management, and responsible AI enablement initiatives. Reporting to the Director, Tech & Cyber Awareness, Training and Enablement, this role serves as a key operational partner supporting the successful delivery of technology, cybersecurity, and AI adoption programs across the National Office. Purpose: The Manager, Technology & Cyber Awareness, Training and Enablement is responsible for managing the day-to-day operational execution of PPFA's enterprise technology enablement programs, including technology adoption, cybersecurity awareness, workforce readiness, learning operations, knowledge management, communications, and responsible AI enablement initiatives. This role serves as the operational lead for multiple enablement workstreams and is responsible for coordinating activities across stakeholders, managing recurring program functions, maintaining critical learning and knowledge resources, and ensuring the consistent delivery of awareness, training, communications, and adoption services that support organizational readiness and successful technology adoption. The Manager establishes and maintains operational processes, coordinates priorities across multiple initiatives, identifies opportunities for continuous improvement, and helps ensure technology, cybersecurity, and responsible AI programs are delivered effectively, consistently, and at scale. Working closely with the Director, Tech & Cyber Awareness, Training and Enablement, the Manager helps translate strategic priorities into operational plans, manages day-to-day program execution, and supports the successful adoption of enterprise technologies across the National Office. Delivery: The Manager will be responsible for managing the operational execution of PPFA's enterprise technology enablement programs through the following core functions: Leading Learning & Workforce Enablement through the delivery and administration of technology, cybersecurity, and responsible AI learning programs. Advancing Responsible AI & Cybersecurity Awareness by managing awareness, education, workforce engagement, and supporting responsible AI and cybersecurity initiatives. Managing Knowledge & Digital Resources by maintaining technology, cybersecurity, and AI content across intranet sites, knowledge resources, and self-service documentation. Driving Communications & Change Management by planning and executing communications that support technology, cybersecurity, AI, and enterprise change initiatives. Supporting Onboarding & Employee Readiness by coordinating technology and cybersecurity onboarding resources, orientation, and workforce readiness. Managing Program Operations by coordinating planning, reporting, stakeholder engagement, and continuous improvement across technology enablement programs. Supporting TSS Team Operations through internal communications, team engagement, and knowledge sharing. Other duties and responsibilities as assigned. Engagement: Serve as a key operational partner to the Director, Tech & Cyber Awareness, Training and Enablement, translating strategic priorities into operational plans and deliverables. Lead coordination efforts across stakeholders supporting technology adoption, workforce readiness, responsible AI enablement, and awareness initiatives. Build and maintain collaborative relationships with Technology Strategy & Services, Information Security, PC&E, Communications, and other National Office teams. Influence stakeholders across multiple departments to ensure timely completion of training, communications, knowledge management, and adoption activities. Coordinate with subject matter experts across Technology, Information Security, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, Operations, and HR to support enterprise enablement efforts. Facilitate stakeholder engagement activities that support successful technology adoption and organizational readiness. Recommend improvements to enablement programs, operational processes, communications approaches, and resource delivery models. Represent TSS in onboarding, awareness, training, and enablement activities and serve as a trusted operational resource for staff navigating technology and AI-related changes. Foster a collaborative, service-oriented approach that promotes engagement, trust, and organizational readiness across the enterprise. Knowledge, Skills and Abilities (KSAs): Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business, Communications, Education, Organizational Development, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. 3–5 years of experience in technology and cybersecurity enablement, learning operations, workforce readiness, communications, knowledge management, organizational change management, training, or related functions. Experience managing operational workstreams, coordinating priorities, and driving execution across multiple initiatives. Demonstrated ability to coordinate cross-functional activities involving multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and recurring deliverables. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, accessible, and actionable content. Experience administering learning programs and learning management systems, including content management, reporting, learner communications, and program operations. Experience managing intranet content, knowledge repositories, resource libraries, and self-service information resources. Demonstrated ability to establish operational processes, maintain governance standards, and improve program effectiveness. Experience supporting workforce adoption of technology, cybersecurity awareness programs, responsible AI education initiatives, or organizational change efforts. Ability to analyze participation, engagement, and adoption metrics and use insights to recommend improvements. Strong organizational and project coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously. Experience influencing stakeholders and coordinating work across teams without direct authority Familiarity with organizational change management, technology adoption methodologies, employee engagement strategies, or workforce enablement programs. Familiarity with emerging technologies, including generative AI tools and AI-enabled workplace technologies. Strong customer service orientation and commitment to creating positive employee experiences. Ability to exercise sound judgment, maintain confidentiality, and manage sensitive information appropriately. Commitment to accessibility, inclusive communication practices, continuous learning, and PPFA's values around privacy, security, diversity, equity, and responsible technology use. Travel: Travel 0-10%, as needed. Planned Parenthood's cultural ethos, "In This Together", reflects our commitment to building a workplace culture that fosters belonging, promotes learning throughout the employee lifecycle, and recognizes individual contributions to our mission. Planned Parenthood Federation of America participates in the E-Verify program. Planned Parenthood Federation of America is an equal employment opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a non-discriminatory work environment, and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Planned Parenthood Federation of America is committed to creating a dynamic work environment that values diversity and inclusion, respect and integrity, customer focus, and innovation.

Title: Associate Director, Data & Information Architecture
Description: Who we are REGENXBIO is an exceptional place to work. You'll have the opportunity to collaborate with some of the best and the brightest people, touch amazing science, and be a part of extraordinary plans. Our core values: Trust, Accountability, Perseverance, and Innovation drive everything we do. We aim to bring these values to life every day with all that we do, and we believe that what we do matters - to patients, to their families, and to their communities. The opportunity: As Associate Director, Data & Information Architecture, you’ll be responsible for designing and executing the enterprise data architecture strategy that enables REGENXBIO’s commercial growth. Working closely with business & IT leadership, you’ll build and lead a secure, scalable commercial data warehouse; integrate internal and third-party data; establish master and reference data standards; and partner across Commercial, Medical, Legal, and IT to deliver trusted analytics with clear lineage, quality, and privacy controls. This is a “build and scale” role focused on enabling growth: ensuring systems and data support the next phase of the business. Please note that this role requires a part-time onsite presence. During the first 3–4 months, while project activities are ramping up, the position is expected to be onsite approximately 50% of the time. The onsite requirement is anticipated to decrease thereafter, with the longer-term arrangement to be discussed based on project and business needs. What you'll be doing: Oversee data pipelines and system-to-system data flows ensuring reliable and scalable infrastructure. Help define and maintain the target commercial data architecture for sales, CRM, payer, patient-support, and claims-linked analytics. Own the ERP (Oracle Cloud) data model and become an expert on ERP Business Process functions including but not limited to Procurement, Planning, Inventory, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing; be able to extract and integrated data from those functions. Identify the company’s internal and external data sources, lead the design and operation of a data warehouse and its landing, harmonized, conformed, and semantic layers. Serve as design authority for commercial-data initiatives and chair architectural review, model review, and commercial-data governance forums. Translate commercial priorities into quarterly roadmaps, objectives and key results, release plans, and measurable business outcomes. Collaborate with others on the team and with Business stakeholders in gathering requirements, designing systems, and demonstrating and reviewing databases. Establish scalable processes for system governance, data integrity, and ongoing optimization Document designs and database architecture, adhere to Change Management and Validation processes, use source code control repositories (ie; Git), conduct code reviews, eventually implement continuous integration and design with constant attention on security and keeping applications safe from penetrable threats. Determine the requirements for new databases occasionally create and publish reports. Audit database regularly to maintain quality It is imperative that REGENXBIO employees embody our core values by working collaboratively, building strong relationships, and using clear communication to meet shared objectives. What we're looking for: We set our employees up for success. To be successful in this role and help us achieve our goals, we are looking for someone with the following skills and qualifications: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, CIS, Mathematics, Life Science or equivalent required. Minimum of 12 years of database architecture/engineering or Enterprise Data experience ideally in Oracle, SQL Server or equivalent. Deep experience designing and operating enterprise data warehouses and dimensional models for analytics. Strong command of SQL, data modeling, ELT/ETL design, orchestration, metadata, and business intelligence semantic modeling. Hands-on experience integrating multiple commercial-data domains, including some combination of CRM/sales, marketing, payer, patient-support, specialty pharmacy, and claims data. Strong understanding of the operation of an ERP system. Exposure to or participation in Agile/Scrum and traditional waterfall SDLC experience. Outstanding interpersonal skills, a can-do and team player attitude, excellent, clear written and verbal communication skills, and keen attention to detail. Ability to work effectively in a high demand, fast-paced, and evolving environment, work on multiple projects at a time. Must be willing to be onsite in our Rockville office on a semi-regular basis Why should you apply? By joining REGENXBIO, you will have the opportunity to be a part of a growing company and incredible team passionate about developing novel AAV gene therapy products to our patients. In addition, professional development is important to us. By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to be exposed to challenging projects and development resources to help you grow personally and professionally. We are proud to offer a comprehensive rewards package which includes a market-competitive base salary, an annual performance-based bonus program, stock grants at all levels, and benefits such as health, dental, and vision insurance, retirement plan with 401(k) match, summer hours, and more! The estimated compensation range for this role is $186,000 to $251,000 annually. The actual salary offered to the final candidate depends on a number of factors such as relevant work experience, skills, education, and years of experience.

Title: Director, Global Partner Enablement
Description: About Us Sophos is a cybersecurity leader defending 600,000 organizations globally with an AI-driven platform and expert-led services. Sophos meets organizations wherever they are in their security maturity and grows with them to defeat cyberattacks. Its solutions combine machine learning, automation, and real-time threat intelligence with frontline human expertise from Sophos X-Ops to deliver advanced, 24/7 threat monitoring, detection, and response. Sophos offers industry-leading managed detection and response (MDR) alongside a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity technologies — including endpoint, network, email, and cloud security, extended detection and response (XDR), identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and next-gen SIEM. Together with expert advisory services, these capabilities help organizations proactively reduce risk and respond faster, with the visibility and scalability needed to stay ahead of evolving threats. Sophos goes to market with a global partner ecosystem, including Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), resellers and distributors, marketplace integrations, and cyber risk partners, giving organizations the flexibility to choose trusted relationships when securing their business. Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at www.sophos.com. Role Summary The Director of Global Partner Enablement is responsible for defining and scaling a global enablement strategy that drives partner preference, pipeline growth, and customer security outcomes across Sophos’ go-to-market model. This role ensures that partners—including VARs, MSPs, MSSPs, and distributors—are fully enabled to sell, deploy, manage, and expand Sophos solutions globally. This leader combines deep channel expertise, practical AI fluency, modern learning approaches, and strong field execution. They will translate Sophos’ cybersecurity strategy into role-based, lifecycle-driven enablement that accelerates partner time-to-value and long-term commercial success. The ability to use AI tools in a builder capacity will be critical to success in this role. This leader will use AI to scale partner curriculum and content production and establish repeatable processes for sourcing accurate technical content. As part of the Global Go-to-Market Enablement team, this leader will partner closely with Global Channel, Regional Partner Leaders, Sales, and Marketing leadership to embed enablement into field execution. The role will also be accountable for delivering against specific AI-related OKRs established for the position. What You Will Do Execute a Partner-First GTM Enablement Strategy Define and execute a global partner enablement strategy aligned to Sophos’ GTM model, partner program tiers, and regional growth priorities. Ensure enablement supports key Sophos motions, including MSP/MSSP managed security services, solution selling, renewals, and expansion. Lead change management initiatives that evolve partner behaviors in support of new GTM motions, platform adoption, and services-led selling. Deliver Role-Based Partner Learning and Readiness Programs Design and scale role-specific partner learning journeys across sales, technical pre-sales, implementation, managed services, customer success, and renewals. Guide partners from onboarding through advanced competency and specialization, aligned to Sophos certifications, accreditations, and partner program requirements. Apply adult learning principles, instructional design best practices, and skills-based frameworks to ensure learning drives behavior change and performance. Maintain content lifecycle governance to ensure enablement stays current with product releases, platform evolution, and threat landscape changes. Support MSP / MSSP Enablement and Field Execution Ensure enablement directly supports MSP and MSSP business models, including recurring revenue motions, operational efficiency, and service differentiation. Establish global enablement standards, frameworks, and governance while enabling regional flexibility based on market needs. Collaborate with Regional Enablement and Field teams to support GTM launches, sales plays, campaigns, and priority partners. Coordinate delivery of enablement such as workshops, simulations, solution playbooks, and technical labs that reinforce real-world execution. Act as an executive escalation point for strategic partner enablement needs. Define and Track Enablement Success Metrics Ensure success metrics are tied to Sophos business outcomes, including partner ramp time, certification attainment, pipeline contribution, deal velocity, adoption, renewal rates, and expansion. Leverage CRM, partner performance data, and field insights to identify skill gaps and optimize enablement investments. Provide executive-ready reporting that demonstrates enablement impact on partner success and revenue growth. Drive Content Strategy with Cross-Functional Leadership Oversee the global partner enablement content strategy, including onboarding programs, solution and security playbooks, labs, partner toolkits, and just-in-time resources. Serve as a cross-functional leader working closely with Product Marketing, Product Management, Partner Programs, Sales, and Channel to ensure alignment and consistency. Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing global partner enablement team (direct and/or dotted-line), operating effectively in a matrixed environment. Lead AI-Powered Partner Enablement Use generative AI and prompt-driven workflows to scale partner curriculum, technical content, playbooks, labs, and self-service resources while maintaining appropriate human review. Establish repeatable processes for sourcing, reviewing, governing, and publishing accurate technical content from Sales Engineers, Product, Product Marketing, and other SMEs. Use platform data and partner feedback to improve content quality, production speed, adoption, and partner readiness. What You Will Bring 10+ years of experience in partner enablement, channel sales, customer success enablement, or learning and development within cybersecurity or enterprise SaaS. Deep hands-on experience enabling global channel partners across Americas, EMEA, and APJ, with strong understanding of MSP, MSSP, VAR, and distributor models. Proven success designing and executing role-based, GTM-aligned learning programs that drive measurable partner performance. Experience working closely with Sales, Channel, and Customer Success leaders in a partner-first organization. Data-driven mindset with the ability to define KPIs, analyze performance, and demonstrate enablement ROI. Exceptional executive communication, facilitation, and stakeholder influence skills. Practical AI fluency, including generative AI, prompt design, content transformation, and quality-review workflows. Experience building AI-assisted enablement and technical content processes that balance speed, accuracy, governance, source traceability, and human judgment. Preferred Qualifications: Experience supporting or scaling MSP/MSSP-centric GTM motions. Familiarity with Sophos-style partner programs, certifications, and security solutions. Title: Senior Developer Advocate, AI Content & Community
Description:
SambaNova is a leader in next-generation AI infrastructure, delivering a full-stack inference platform for customers worldwide. At the core of SambaNova's technology is the RDU (Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit) — a chip built on a dataflow architecture rather than the traditional GPU model. Its decode performance is especially strong for agentic workloads like multi-turn agents, code generation, and long-running applications. RDUs are packaged into SambaRack, rack-scale hardware that lets customers deploy state-of-the-art models with better performance, greater energy efficiency, and faster time to value.

SambaNova is hiring a Senior Developer Advocate, AI Content & Community to make its technology visible, useful, and compelling to AI builders. This role will combine hands-on development with the reach and instincts of a trusted creator: building standout demos, showing developers what is possible, and working with influential voices across the developer ecosystem to amplify SambaNova’s technology.

 

About the Role

 

This is a builder-and-influencer role centered on working demos and developer credibility. You will use SambaCloud and the broader SambaNova platform to create agentic AI demos, applications, code, tutorials, videos, and live experiences that developers want to try and share. You will also cultivate relationships with technical creators, open-source contributors, community leaders, and developer influencers, turning product capabilities and ecosystem integrations into credible moments of discovery. The right candidate can prototype quickly, explain the technology clearly, perform naturally on camera or onstage, and convert one strong demo into content that travels across repositories, social channels, livestreams, workshops, and events.

 

Responsibilities

 

  • Build polished agentic AI applications, reference demos, and repeatable developer workflows that showcase what developers can create with SambaCloud
  • Own a steady demo pipeline from concept and prototype through testing, packaging, documentation, recording, live delivery, and reuse by the field and community
  • Create original developer content across code repositories, videos, livestreams, tutorials, blog posts, social posts, and other developer-native formats
  • Serve as an authentic public voice for SambaNova across GitHub, YouTube, X, LinkedIn, community forums, meetups, hackathons, and conferences
  • Develop relationships with developer influencers, technical creators, open-source maintainers, and community leaders who can extend the reach and credibility of SambaNova’s work
  • Co-create demos, technical content, events, and social moments with creators and ecosystem partners
  • Translate inference, model serving, agent workflows, and platform capabilities into practical examples without sacrificing technical substance
  • Turn product launches, integrations, benchmarks, and technical proof points into compelling demos and developer stories
  • Engage directly with developers, answer questions, gather feedback, and bring recurring friction and feature requests back to Product and Engineering
  • Partner with Developer Relations, Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Design, and Partner teams to align demos and content with priority use cases and launches
  • Measure demo usage, developer activation, creator participation, social reach, engagement, community growth, and qualitative feedback; use those insights to improve the program

 

What We’re Looking For

 

  • 5+ years of experience in developer advocacy, software engineering, technical content creation, developer marketing, or a combination of these disciplines
  • Hands-on experience building with Python, APIs, large language models, and contemporary agent or orchestration frameworks
  • A substantial public portfolio of working demos, repositories, tutorials, talks, videos, livestreams, or substantive social content
  • A demonstrated ability to earn attention and engage a technical audience through developer communities and social platforms
  • Strong on-camera, live presentation, writing, and technical storytelling skills
  • Fluency in the AI developer ecosystem and genuine curiosity about new models, agent patterns, tools, and infrastructure tradeoffs
  • Ability to prototype quickly, troubleshoot live demos, learn in public, and respond constructively to technical feedback
  • Comfort owning an editorial and demo calendar and shipping consistently in a fast-moving environment

 

Preferred Qualifications

 

  • Experience creating agentic AI demos, multimodal applications, or production-oriented reference implementations
  • Familiarity with OpenAI-compatible APIs, model evaluation, prompt caching, retrieval, tool use, and inference performance concepts
  • An established network or engaged presence among AI developers, technical creators, open-source projects, or developer communities
  • A track record of successful collaborations with developer influencers, technology partners, creators, or open-source maintainers
  • Experience hosting workshops, hackathons, meetups, panels, livestreams, or conference sessions
  • Video production or editing skills and an instinct for adapting one technical demo to multiple channels without turning it into hype

 

Why This Role Matters

 

Developers trust working code, useful demos, and respected voices more than claims. This role will make SambaNova tangible to builders, create demonstrations that prove what the platform can do, and mobilize the developer influencers and communities that can carry those stories across the AI ecosystem.

Base Salary Range:

Base Pay Range
$196,000—$240,000 USD

Submission Guidelines
Please note that in order to be considered an applicant for any position at SambaNova Systems, you must submit an application form for each position for which you believe you are qualified. 

EEO Policy
SambaNova Systems is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard basis of age (40 and over), color, disability, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, national origin/ancestry, race, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding), sexual orientation, and any other applicable status protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Benefits Summary for US-Based, Full-Time Employment Positions
SambaNova offers a competitive total rewards package, including the base salary, plus equity and benefits. We cover 95% premium coverage for employee medical insurance, and 77% premium coverage for dependents and offer a Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contribution. We also offer Dental, Vision, Short/Long term Disability, Basic Life, Voluntary Life, and AD&D insurance plans in addition to Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options like Health Care, Limited Purpose, and Dependent Care. Our library of well-being benefits available to you and your dependents includes a full subscription to Headspace, Gympass+ membership with access to physical gyms, One Medical membership, counseling services with an Employee Assistance Program, and much more.

Title: Product Sales Enablement Business Partner
Description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Global Sales Enablement is responsible for driving productivity and effectiveness across Stripe's go-to-market organization. Our team designs and runs programs that equip account teams with the skills, knowledge, and tools they need to excel—covering Stripe's product suite, sales processes, and selling skills. We support user-facing go-to-market teams and their managers across the globe.

This role supports Stripe's product account executives—a specialist sales motion built around deep expertise across three product pillars—Revenue, Money Management, and Payments. Product account executives own end-to-end pipeline for specific product areas, working in close coordination with core account executives who anchor the customer relationship. Each team operates with a distinct product set, buyer profile, and sales motion, meaning their enablement needs vary significantly and demand a dedicated, expert partner.

What you’ll do

You'll act as a true strategic partner to product account executive leadership—proposing programs, staying deeply embedded with Product and Product Operations to anticipate what the field needs ahead of each launch, and building the systems that let enablement scale as the organization grows.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with product sales leadership to define and execute a strategic vision for enablement across Stripe's product sales organization
  • Scope, build, and continuously improve onboarding and ongoing training programs tailored to the unique requirements of each product sales role
  • Stay embedded with Product and Product Operations teams to understand Stripe's evolving product suite, anticipate upcoming releases, and ensure the field is ready before launch
  • Create and facilitate enablement content in partnership with subject matter experts, translating technical product knowledge and solution architectures into practical, scalable resources
  • Identify skill and knowledge gaps across product sales teams, then design programs that drive measurable improvements in productivity, expertise, and revenue
  • Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders and executives to align learning experiences with business goals and performance outcomes
  • Track enablement impact and use data to make informed decisions about where to invest next

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in sales enablement, with a focus on specialist or technical sales roles at a global technology or high-growth company
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical concepts into accessible content for a sales audience
  • Proven track record of designing and delivering enablement programs that produce measurable improvements in sales performance
  • Strong project management and communication skills, with experience presenting to and influencing senior executives as well as technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Demonstrated ability to operate cross-functionally and build productive relationships across a large organization

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience operating in a global, virtual environment across multiple time zones
  • Background in content creation, curation, or knowledge management platforms
  • Experience navigating ambiguity and building scalable solutions in a fast-changing environment

Title: Program Manager, Risk Operations GTM Enablement
Description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Risk PMO team protects Stripe’s revenue and drives cross-functional strategy for company-level and org-level priorities. As Stripe operates across an increasingly complex and fast-moving global regulatory environment, one of our most important functions is ensuring that our largest, most strategic users can grow with us—compliantly, confidently, and at speed.

We sit at the intersection of Legal, Compliance, Engineering, Product, Data Science, and GTM—serving as the bridge between teams coordinating massive programs with global, wide-reaching impact. We build durable systems that enable strong collaboration across functions and seamless experiences for our users.

If you're energized by high-stakes, ambiguous problems and thrive on building programs from scratch in environments where the rules are still being written—we want to hear from you.

What you’ll do

You will define, own, and execute program strategies for large-scale regulatory initiatives, operating with significant autonomy across a portfolio of global projects.

This is a highly visible, senior individual contributor (IC) role. While you will influence senior leadership and set strategic direction, you are also the primary driver of execution. You will need to zoom out to design the long-term vision, and zoom in to manage the details—building templates, tracking deliverables, writing documentation, and directly unblocking cross-functional teams.

Responsibilities

  • Own and execute high-stakes global programs end-to-end, from initial strategy and scoping to project planning, day-to-day tracking, and change management
  • Drive step-change improvements in our operational processes, rolling up your sleeves to build systems and workflows that directly improve business outcomes and top-line metrics 
  • Bridge compliance and commercial strategy by partnering with GTM and account leadership to turn complex regulatory requirements into a competitive advantage that builds deep user trust
  • Build and run operating models across diverse cross-functional teams (including Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, and Compliance), keeping highly distributed workstreams aligned and accountable 
  • Serve as a trusted advisor by preparing strategic reviews for senior stakeholders and managing critical escalations 
  • Translate user friction into program evolution by establishing structured, data-driven approaches to gather user feedback and turning those insights into actionable product and operational improvements 
  • Diagnose and resolve systemic operational gaps before they impact our users, building self-healing processes and scalable internal infrastructure
  • Champion Stripe’s Operating Principles by fostering a high-performance culture that values rigorous thinking, rapid execution, and putting users first

Who you are

You are a highly strategic operator, a masterful communicator, and a systems thinker with operational grit. You thrive in the gray area, possessing the ability to translate ambiguous global challenges into elegant, structured, and highly actionable operational frameworks. 

You are a natural leader who leads by influence and by example. You have a deep empathy for the user, an unyielding bias toward action, and you take pride in the craft of execution. No problem is too complex for you to deconstruct, and no detail is too small if it impacts the user experience.

Minimum requirements

  • 6+ years of experience in Program Management, Strategy & Operations, Management Consulting, or Go-to-Market (GTM) Strategy in a fast-paced, high-growth environment 
  • Hands-on execution track record: Proven ability to work independently as an individual contributor, managing complex, multi-stakeholder project plans and deliverables from inception to completion 
  • Exceptional communication & storytelling: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; a proven ability to distill highly complex, technical, or regulatory topics into clear, succinct, and persuasive narratives to external and senior audiences 
  • Systems and infrastructure builder: Deep experience designing, launching, and scaling complex cross-functional operating models, feedback loops, and PMO frameworks 
  • Growth mindset: A high willingness to learn, adapt quickly to changing environments, and actively seek and act on feedback to continuously improve

Preferred qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in high-growth technology or fintech environments 
  • Deep cross-functional partnership: Prior experience working alongside Engineering, Product, Legal, Compliance, and GTM/Sales 
  • Data fluency: Experience leveraging data visualization tools and analytical frameworks to back up strategic decisions and measure program success

Title: Director, Content Strategy & Organic Marketing
Description:
The opportunity

Unity (NYSE: U) is dedicated to creating immersive and engaging experiences for developers, creators and players worldwide. We're looking for a Director, Content Strategy & Organic Marketing to lead our content function at a moment when the way people discover and consume information is fundamentally changing. This is a role for a content leader who thinks in systems as much as in stories. You'll be responsible for building and running the team, processes, and infrastructure that turn content strategy into published work that drives organic growth — across Unity's core game development and creator tools, and our expanding consumer and prosumer market. You'll partner closely with our AI SEO specialist, who owns keyword research and LLM optimization strategy, and with peers across Product Marketing, Integrated Marketing, Comms, and Brand Studio. Your job is to take that strategy and build the operation that executes on it: with quality, at scale, and with clear accountability for results. This is a director-level role leading a team, reporting into the Sr. Director, GTM Marketing. You'll have real scope to define how this function works, and real accountability for the results it delivers.

What you'll be doing

  • Build and lead a high-output content team spanning writers, editors, and content ops — setting direction, workflows, and quality standards
  • Define content strategies for integrated marketing and demand generation campaigns in close partnership with Product Marketing and Integrated Marketing
  • Partner with our AI SEO specialist to translate keyword research and LLM optimization signals into a prioritized content roadmap and production plan
  • Own the content production infrastructure: editorial calendars, briefing systems, review workflows, publishing pipelines, and QA standards that scale output without sacrificing quality
  • Explore and implement AI tools and automation workflows (Claude Cowork, Jasper) to increase throughput while maintaining brand voice and accuracy
  • Oversee production of high-quality content across formats — articles, ebooks, videos, webinars, social posts, and marketing collateral — in service of company goals
  • Collaborate with Comms, Brand Studio, and other marketing teams to align content with key campaigns and ensure consistency across channels
  • Partner with customers, and industry professionals to create authentic content that highlights Unity's features, industry use cases, ads and monetization offerings, and community engagement
  • Serve as a trusted partner and advisor to leadership across Unity's Ads, Game Development, Industry and AI businesses
  • Utilize data analytics to inform content strategy, monitor performance, and optimize engagement across platforms — providing regular reporting and insights to senior leadership

What we're looking for

  • At least seven (7) years of experience in content marketing, with at least three (3) years in the gaming industry or a closely adjacent developer tools or prosumer SaaS environment
  • Demonstrated experience building content programs at scale — not just campaigns, but repeatable systems and infrastructure in B2B and B2C
  • Strong understanding of demand generation and integrated marketing, with experience creating content strategy that supports pipeline goals and executes across formats
  • Fluency in AI SEO and LLM optimization — enough to be a strong partner to our SEO specialist and make informed editorial decisions based on their guidance

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted content workflows — you've used automation tools and AI writing systems, and know how to apply them thoughtfully at scale
  • A history of leading and developing multi-disciplinary content teams — writers, editors, strategists, and ops-focused roles
  • Strong analytical instincts — you set measurable goals, track performance, and use data to make decisions about what to build next
  • Excellent writing, editing, and storytelling skills, with a portfolio that demonstrates content depth and strategic range

Title: Platform Engineer, AI Enablement
Description:
About us   

Founded in 2017, Wayve is the leading developer of Embodied AI technology.  Our advanced AI software and foundation models enable vehicles to perceive, understand, and navigate any complex environment, enhancing the usability and safety of automated driving systems.

Our vision is to create autonomy that propels the world forward.  Our intelligent, mapless, and hardware-agnostic AI products are designed for automakers, accelerating the transition from assisted to automated driving. 

In our fast-paced environment big problems ignite us—we embrace uncertainty, leaning into complex challenges to unlock groundbreaking solutions. We aim high and stay humble in our pursuit of excellence, constantly learning and evolving as we pave the way for a smarter, safer future.

At Wayve, your contributions matter.  We value diversity, embrace new perspectives, and foster an inclusive work environment; we back each other to deliver impact.  

Make Wayve the experience that defines your career!  

The role

As a Platform Engineer on Wayve’s AI Enablement team, you’ll build the infrastructure that gives people across the company safe, reliable, and cost-effective access to language models and AI agents.

You’ll help create a governed model-access layer and a secure production environment for agentic workflows, with safety, observability, and operational excellence built in from the start. Your work will span the full lifecycle—from defining problems and designing systems to implementation, deployment, and ongoing operation.

Working closely with Security, IT, and engineering teams, you’ll deliver platform capabilities that scale with the pace of AI adoption at Wayve. You’ll also support teams building agentic workflows, turning successful approaches into reusable patterns and helping colleagues understand what’s possible with the platform.

This is an opportunity to join an early platform team and shape how an AI company puts AI tools to work responsibly. Your technical decisions will influence infrastructure used across Wayve, giving you ownership, visibility, and impact beyond a typical infrastructure role.

Key responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate infrastructure that enables safe and cost-effective access to AI models and tools.
  • Build the runtime, services, and developer tooling used to run agentic workflows in production.
  • Create observability across cost, performance, reliability, and usage through metrics, tracing, and logging.
  • Implement governance and safety controls that make AI use secure, compliant, and auditable.
  • Develop reusable platform primitives, integrations, and guardrails that reduce one-off solutions.
  • Contribute to standards and best practices for designing, building, and deploying agents.
  • Automate infrastructure and deployment processes to keep the platform reliable and scalable.
  • Partner with Security, IT, and engineering teams on platform integration, policy, and rollout.
  • Help teams adopt the platform by troubleshooting issues, documenting patterns, and sharing what works.
  • Educate colleagues on the AI platforms and tools available to them and how to use them effectively.
  • Own projects end to end and improve the platform based on real-world usage and feedback.
  • Participate in the team’s on-call rotation, providing out-of-hours support for critical systems when required.

About you

You’re a hands-on engineer who enjoys building reliable platforms for other teams. You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, taking ownership across the full delivery lifecycle, and collaborating with technical and non-technical partners. You combine strong engineering fundamentals with curiosity about the fast-evolving AI tooling ecosystem.

Essential skills and experience

  • 3+ years of software engineering experience building APIs, services, and developer tooling.
  • Strong system-design fundamentals and experience making infrastructure decisions that affect multiple teams.
  • Experience building and operating platforms or infrastructure used by other engineering teams.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, and infrastructure as code.
  • Familiarity with LLM APIs and the surrounding ecosystem, including model providers, gateways, MCP, agent frameworks, and retrieval-augmented generation.
  • Experience building observability into distributed systems using metrics, tracing, and logging.
  • A security-conscious approach, including experience with authentication, authorization, and auditability.
  • A strong sense of ownership and comfort working in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment.
  • Clear communication and documentation skills that enable other teams to self-serve.

Desirable skills and experience

  • Experience operating an LLM gateway or model-routing layer in production, including cost controls and budget enforcement.
  • Experience with agent orchestration frameworks or tool-calling protocols such as MCP.
  • Exposure to AI governance, model risk management, or responsible AI practices.
  • Experience working in an organisation with a strong safety culture, ideally in autonomy, robotics, or another safety-critical field.

We’d love to hear from you—you might be just what we’re looking for, whether in this role or another.

✨ Let’s give businesses more time for what matters.

Make your impact within a rapidly growing Fintech Company

Customer Experience (CX) is a group of bold, goal-oriented, fast-moving and customer-obsessed individuals who care deeply for each other’s success, growth, and development. We take fierce pride in the opportunity our CX team has to positively impact customers’ businesses and their lives. We appreciate and celebrate our past but we are constructively dissatisfied about the opportunities we have in hand and the future we need to build. We are now writing the next chapter of our customer experience journey—CX 2.0—bringing the best of our customer-obsessed frontline associates and humanized digital experiences together for an effortless, seamless experience for our customers.

As a Staff CX Service Enablement Specialist on the CX Operations team, you will own the design, optimization, and governance of the service processes and workflows that power BILL’s customer experience at scale. Where the Senior-level role on this team focuses on administering tools and supporting day-to-day system operations, this Staff-level position takes a broader view—driving end-to-end process strategy, leading cross-functional improvement initiatives, and shaping the operational foundation of CX 2.0. You will partner directly with CX leadership, IT BizTech, Insights & Analytics, Workforce Management, and Enterprise Risk Management to turn operational complexity into streamlined, measurable outcomes.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the end-to-end design, documentation, and continuous improvement of service workflows across CX channels, ensuring processes scale with organizational growth and CX 2.0 priorities.
  • Lead process improvement initiatives by mapping current-state workflows, diagnosing friction points through data analysis, and building optimized future-state processes with clear success metrics.
  • Serve as the process design authority for CX systems and tools—including Salesforce Service Cloud, Five9, Amazon Connect, MaestroQA, and Calabrio—ensuring tool configurations align with operational workflows and agent enablement goals.

  • Define and track KPIs that measure process effectiveness, tool adoption, and enablement impact at the individual, segment, and organizational level.
  • Drive change management for new and updated workflows, including stakeholder alignment, communication plans, and coordination with enablement and training partners.
  • Evaluate emerging CX technologies and AI-powered contact center tools, building business cases for adoption that advance the CX 2.0 roadmap.
  • Mentor and guide junior Service Enablement team members, contributing to team development and knowledge sharing.

We’d love to chat if you have:

  • Deep experience with CRM and contact center platforms such as Salesforce Service Cloud, Five9, Amazon Connect, MaestroQA, Calabrio, or similar tools—not just as an administrator, but as someone who connects tool capability to process strategy.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-functional process improvement projects from discovery through implementation and measurement.
  • Strong analytical skills with proficiency in tools such as Tableau, Excel, and Google Sheets to diagnose operational issues, build business cases, and quantify the impact of changes.
  • Experience creating service documentation at scale, including SOPs, workflow diagrams, business requirements documents, and agent-facing knowledge content.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with a track record of influencing without authority across CX, IT, analytics, and operations teams.
  • Experience developing and implementing processes and operating rhythms in an agile, fast-paced environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, economics, or a quantitative discipline, or equivalent experience.
  • Basic hands-on experience using Claude or other AI assistants, along with a curiosity to continually learn and integrate new workflows.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience with AI-powered contact center tools and automation strategy.
  • Background in user acceptance testing (UAT) case creation and execution for CX platform implementations.

Title: Senior Director, Content Operations Lead (US)
Location: New York, New York, United States; Remote
Description:
Code and Theory is hiring a Content Operations Lead to join our Enterprise Transformation team. This role is responsible for standing up and running scaled content services for enterprise clients — from initial service model design through go-live, stabilization, and handover to the client organization.

Depending on the client engagement, this role may operate in a forward-deployed capacity, embedded inside a client team, working alongside their production leads, creative teams, agencies, and platform owners to redesign and run content operations in real time. That means participating in the intake queue, the production schedule, and the review cycle directly, and rewriting the process while live work moves through it.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Map the full content lifecycle end-to-end and the organizational model underneath it
  • Diagnose where the current model breaks and capacity that cannot absorb peak
  • Design the target-state service model and the decision rights that govern all of it
  • Define the governance layer so that compliance can say yes at speed rather than at the end
  • Establish the measurement framework before go-live, with baselines set for cycle time, first-pass approval rate, reuse rate, cost per asset, and on-time delivery
  • Build the activation plan with named owners against every dependency
  • Stand up the service model so the operating infrastructure is working before volume arrives
  • Resource and onboard the team
  • Run the cutover
  • Stabilize the service post-launch through office hours, support, performance monitoring against baselined SLAs and KPIs, model refinement, and a transition close-out that documents what remains open
  • Redesign the operating model around AI-native capability
  • Define the new ways of working, reshape workflows, roles, decision rights and handoffs around them
  • Collaborate with engineers and creative technologists to stand up the content stack, both out of the box and custom built
  • Codify standards, brand compliance, legal review for machine-consumption
  • Prototype to accelerate delivery, using prompts, prototypes and lightweight internal tools to prove patterns quickly before scaling them through engineering
  • Own VP-to-C-suite relationships across CMO, CCO, content operations lead, and platform owner, and the cross-functional teams that intersect to ship the work
  • Translate between the CMO's brand and growth agenda, production's capacity and craft constraints
  • Lead the delivery pod, including casting, offshore and partner capacity management
  • Shape commercial strategy
  • Run the workshops and steering reviews
  • Convert proven engagements into reusable accelerators, methods, and offerings
  • Develop thought leadership and case studies that earn the next engagement
  • Shape partnerships with platform and ecosystem players (Adobe, Pencil, Typeface) and contribute to joint go-to-market plays
  • Set the bar for what full-stack, AI-fluent, embedded delivery looks like in the content operations domain

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • 10-15 years across content operations, creative production, marketing operations, consulting, or transformation delivery with meaningful time spent both advising and operating
  • Deep fluency in how content actually gets made at enterprise scale
  • A track record of shipping in enterprise environments
  • A history of building pipelines, methods, or production capabilities that outlived the engagement that created them
  • Commercial instinct to shape scopes, build capacity models, defend margin, and grow accounts through proof-driven expansion
  •  A background that bridges creative production or studio operations and consulting or transformation work
  • Direct experience standing up a service, studio, shared service center, or production pod from design through go-live and stabilization
  • Working command of the transition lifecycle and the entry and exit criteria at each gate
  • Hands-on experience with the unglamorous half, including resourcing, knowledge transfer, readiness testing, phased ramp, SLA baselining, and transition close-out
  • Proven record driving adoption in an organization that did not want the change
  • A bias toward shipping
  • Ability to decompose a content workflow into demand, capacity, quality gates, automation, and human-in-the-loop steps that hold up under volume
  • Accountability to outcomes
  • Comfort in ambiguity 
  • Bachelor's Degree

NICE TO HAVE

  • Willingness to travel within the US (20-30%)

ABOUT US

Born in 2001, Code and Theory is a digital-first creative agency that sits at the center of creativity and technology. We pride ourselves on not only solving consumer and business problems, but also helping to establish new capabilities for our clients. With a global client roster of Fortune 100s and start-ups alike, we crave the hardest problems to solve. We have teams distributed across North America, South America, Europe, and Asia. Morgan Chase, Lenovo, Marriott, Mars, Microsoft, Thomson Reuters, and TikTok.
