Title: Associate Program Manager
Description:
Title: Associate Program Manager

Location: Dallas, TX

Reports To: VP, Program Underwriting

About Hippo: 

Hippo was built on a promise: make homeownership effortless. Nearly a decade later, that mission still drives us. We use technology and data to help our customers stay ahead of problems and protect what matters most.  

Today, that same tech-native approach powers our work beyond homeowners. Hippo operates as a diversified carrier platform, partnering with MGAs to deliver tailored program solutions that help them grow and deliver better customer experiences. Behind that work is a team that values ownership, curiosity, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 

If you're energized by building what's next, we'd love to meet you. 

About The Role:

The Associate Program Manager plays a foundational role in the underwriting operations of Spinnaker's Partner Programs business – the fronting platform through which Spinnaker partners with managing general agents (MGAs) to write business nationally. Reporting to the VP, Underwriting, Partner Programs and partnering closely with underwriting and program management professionals across the portfolio, this role ensures the compliance, reporting, and documentation accuracy that keep each program running smoothly and audit-ready, while developing the underwriting judgment required to evaluate MGA-written business directly. 

What You'll Do:

  • State filing and program onboarding: Assist with state filing review and tracking across the VP's portfolio, compiling documentation for the senior program manager’s sign-off ahead of new program launches and renewals, and maintaining onboarding checklists so new MGA partner programs move through Spinnaker's launch process without missed regulatory steps
  • Deal-terms accuracy: Review deal-specific business terms and documentation for accuracy and completeness ahead of the senior program manager’s sign-off, flagging discrepancies between the negotiated terms and what's reflected in program documentation
  • Renewal support: Compile performance data, loss history, and program documentation to support the renewal strategy planning, in collaboration with Finance and Operations
  • Strategic objective tracking: Compile and maintain tracking of assigned program performance against the strategic objectives set by the CEO and senior leadership team, giving the program management team current data to report progress and flag emerging risks to those objectives
  • Reinsurer and treaty reporting: Prepare Spinnaker's monthly reinsurer reporting packages for each assigned program, pulling data from underwriting and claims systems so the program managers and Finance can validate ceded premium, loss activity, and treaty compliance before it goes out to reinsurance partners
  • Account reconciliation: Support reconciliation of account balances due to and from Spinnaker's MGA partners and reinsurers, flagging discrepancies for review so cash settlements and treaty accounts stay current across the assigned program book
  • Claims and IBNR reporting: Compile claims and treaty reporting inputs, including preliminary IBNR data pulls coordinated with Spinnaker's Claims TPA relationships, for the leadership review ahead of quarterly reserve and reporting cycles
  • Underwriting guideline and audit support: Gather and organize underwriting guideline documentation for assigned MGA programs, and conduct first-pass data validation ahead of the underwriting audits of program administrators
  • Audit findings tracking: Track and log program administrator/MGA audit findings and remediation status, maintaining records for ongoing program oversight
  • Contract administration: Support loading of signed reinsurance agreements into Spinnaker's contract database (Lexion), and maintain program files and documentation in line with Hippo's recordkeeping standards
  • New business support: Participate in new business development support work as directed, including gathering data on prospective MGA partners under consideration for the partner programs portfolio 

Must Haves:

  • Bachelor's degree preferred, or equivalent experience
  • Three or more years of Property and Casualty insurance experience in an underwriting, operations, or compliance-support capacity
  • Strong attention to detail and comfort working with structured data (spreadsheets, reporting templates, filing systems)
  • Ability to follow defined processes precisely while proactively flagging exceptions or discrepancies
  • Clear written communication for internal reporting and documentation
  • Exposure to program business, MGA relationships, or fronting structures is a plus
  • Familiarity with underwriting and/ or reinsurance reporting concepts (bordereaux, treaty accounts) is a plus
  • Experience with contract management systems (e.g., Lexion) or underwriting/rating systems is a plus 

Benefits and Perks

Hippo treats its team members with the same level of dedication and care as we do our customers, which is why we’re fortunate to provide all of our Hippos with:

  • Healthy Hippos Benefits - Multiple medical plans to choose from and 100% employer covered dental & vision plans for our team members and their families. We also offer a 401(k)-retirement plan, short & long-term disability, employer-paid life insurance, Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) for health and dependent care, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Equity - This position is eligible for equity compensation 
  • Training and Career Growth - Training and internal career growth opportunities
  • Flexible Time Off - You know when and how you should recharge
  • Little Hippos Program - We offer 12 weeks of parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers
  • Hippo Habitat - Snacks and drinks available for onsite employees 

The Morristown, NJ base pay range for this role is $85,000 - $140,000. Exact compensation may vary based on several job-related factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to: skill set, experience, education/training, location, business needs and market demands.

Hippo is an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to building a team culture that celebrates diversity and inclusion.

Title: Senior Manager, Data Governance
Description:
Who We Are

At Justworks, you’ll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people.

We’re helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We’re data-driven and never stop iterating. If you’d like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we’d love to hear from you.

We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team.

Our Values

If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in.

Department

Data & Analytics 

Who You Are

You are a data leader who understands that trustworthy analytics doesn’t happen by accident — it has to be built, maintained, and governed. You think in programs, not tickets. You’re energized by the challenge of setting standards that actually stick, and you know that getting adoption requires credibility, relationship-building, and a genuine understanding of what teams need from their data.

You’re as comfortable writing SQL and reviewing dbt models as you are facilitating a stakeholder alignment meeting or coaching an IC through ambiguity. You see AI tooling not as a novelty but as a practical lever for scaling work that would otherwise be prohibitively manual, and you’re already using it that way.

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Manager, Data Governance to lead Justworks’ nascent Data Governance team. This is a player-coach role: you will manage a growing team of ICs while owning the programs, standards, and cross-functional relationships that make self-serve analytics at Justworks actually work. Your team’s mandate is to set and enforce the conditions under which analytics assets are defined, certified, documented, and trusted before they reach the business. This work is initiative-driven rather than request-response, and it requires someone who can prioritize without a defined ticket queue, build standards that engineers and analysts will adopt, and make the case for governance to stakeholders who may not have asked for it yet.

Your Success Profile

What You Will Work On

  • Lead and develop the Data Governance team — currently two ICs (a Senior Analytics Engineer and a Data Governance Analyst), with further growth anticipated this year — through clear priorities, coaching, and recognition.
  • Own the foundational governance buildout: metadata standards and taxonomy, business domain framework, glossary migration and enrichment, data profiling governance, and model conformance for silver- and gold-layer assets.
  • Run the ongoing governance programs: asset certification and re-certification, data quality observability, glossary and metrics-catalog freshness, standards enforcement and audit, new asset intake and review, and stakeholder education and adoption.
  • Own the data catalog (Atlan) — ensuring the continued accuracy, completeness, and hygiene of asset metadata, glossary terms, and data products; and driving adoption of Atlan as the primary way stakeholders engage with certified data across Justworks.
  • Set and enforce certification standards: Governance holds the right to withhold or revoke certification on assets that fail to meet the standard. You’ll exercise that authority credibly and collaboratively.
  • Serve as a key subject matter expert for Data & Analytics and cross-functional stakeholders: arbitrate metric and definition differences, and drive company-wide adoption of best practices.
  • Drive an AI-native way of working and thinking: accelerate our data governance maturity by leveraging AI for unifying information, enriching metadata, automating governance work and more.
  • Contribute to the data governance strategy and roadmap in partnership with Data & Analytics leadership.

How You Will Do Your Work

In the Manager, Data Governance role, how results are achieved is paramount for your success and ultimately results in our success as an organization. Your foundational knowledge, skills, abilities, and personal attributes are anchored in the following competencies:

  • Plans & Aligns — Translates governance strategy into a prioritized, executable roadmap; communicates clearly about progress, tradeoffs, and urgency; ensures the team’s work is always connected to measurable business outcomes.
  • Balances Stakeholders — Understands that governance works by earning trust, not mandating compliance. Develops standards in partnership with affected teams, acts fairly under conflicting demands, and maintains relationships even when decisions are hard.
  • Influence and Leadership — Builds credibility with engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders alike. Fosters a culture of knowledge-sharing, continuous improvement, and proactive thinking about data trust across the organization.
  • Manages Complexity — Navigates a work environment that blends technical depth, program ownership, and cross-functional coordination. Turns ambiguous mandates into concrete, actionable programs.
  • Displays good Judgment — Knows when to enforce a standard and when to build consensus first. Asks questions before acting, applies critical thinking, and takes ownership of outcomes.
  • Teamwork & Communication — Bridges technical and non-technical audiences. Translates governance concepts into business value, and business requirements into engineering standards.
  • Skills and Knowledge — Maintains hands-on fluency in the technical stack (SQL, dbt, dimensional modeling) and actively develops expertise in evolving areas: AI tooling, data observability, and governance tooling.

In addition, all Justworkers focus on aligning their behaviors to our core values known as COGIS. It stands for:

  • Camaraderie — Day to day you can be seen working together toward a higher purpose. You like to have fun. You’re an active listener, treat people respectfully, and have a strong desire to know and help others.
  • Openness — Your default is to be open. You’re willing to share information, understand other perspectives, and consider new possibilities. You’re curious, ask open questions, and are receptive to thoughts and feedback from others.
  • Grit — You demonstrate grit by having the courage to commit and persevere. You’re committed, earnest, and dive in to get the job done well with a positive attitude.
  • Integrity — Simply put, do what you say and say what you’ll do. You’re honest and forthright, have a strong moral compass, and strive to match your words with your actions while leading by example.
  • Simplicity — Be like Einstein: “Everything should be made as simple as possible, but no simpler.”

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in a data role such as analytics engineering, data engineering, or data governance, with hands-on experience in SQL and dbt.
  • 3+ years in people management, with a demonstrated track record of developing ICs and managing team delivery.
  • Experience owning data governance, data quality, or data standards programs — not just contributing to them.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL; working experience with dbt and dimensional modeling sufficient to define standards and review model conformance.
  • Demonstrated experience with managing data catalogs or data governance tooling (Atlan, Alation, Collibra, or similar).
  • Hands-on fluency with AI tooling as a productivity and automation lever; ability to apply it within the context of metadata management, documentation, and governance workflows.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to drive alignment across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong program ownership mindset: comfortable prioritizing proactively, operating without a defined ticket queue, and driving initiatives that span teams and timelines.
  • Experience working in a startup or high-growth environment where programs had to be built from scratch is preferred.

The base wage range for this position based in our New York City Office is targeted at $166,000.00 - $214,000.00 per year.

Title: Senior Marketing Manager, Brand & Content
Description:
About OpenSesame

OpenSesame is transforming workforce development with an AI-powered marketplace of skill-building courses and learning pathways. We help organizations build skills and stay compliant through a high-quality content catalog, seamless LMS/LXP integrations, and advanced capabilities like skills-based curation and multilingual content creation. More than 2,000 companies, including 150+ of the Global 2000, rely on OpenSesame to develop the world's most productive and admired workforces.
Learn more: www.opensesame.com/about

About the Role

OpenSesame is entering its next phase of growth, and how we show up in the market has never been more important. We are strengthening our brand discipline, sharpening how we communicate, and building a more scalable content and creative engine.

As Senior Marketing Manager, Brand & Creative, you will be the steward of the OpenSesame brand across both visuals and words. You will ensure our brand shows up consistently, clearly, and credibly across customer-facing content, campaigns, PR, sales materials, and internal requests.

This is not a graphic design role or a traditional creative director role. You will lead the people, processes, standards, and AI-enabled workflows that bring the brand to life. You will manage a small team of designers, copywriters, and contractors, while helping the broader organization use approved brand tools and AI agents to create stronger, more consistent work at scale.

You will partner closely with Product Marketing, which owns the corporate messaging framework, positioning, and product narrative, and with the Growth team, which owns demand generation, campaign execution, website performance, and funnel outcomes. Your role is to translate strategy into high-quality content and creative that supports market awareness, sales effectiveness, and pipeline growth. This position reports directly to the CMO. 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Brand Stewardship: Serve as the steward of the OpenSesame brand across visual identity, voice, and creative execution. Monitor market trends, competitors, and customer expectations to ensure our brand remains relevant, differentiated, and consistently represented across every customer touchpoint.
  • Content & Editorial Strategy: Own the editorial calendar and content strategy, developing thought leadership, executive communications, customer stories, PR, and marketing content that strengthens brand awareness and supports business growth.
  • Creative Operations & Team Leadership: Lead the creative team of designers, copywriters, and contractors while managing the marketing request queue to ensure high-quality work is prioritized, delivered efficiently, and aligned to business objectives.
  • AI-Enabled Marketing: Implement AI-enabled tools, workflows, and agents that help the team and broader organization create high-quality, brand-aligned assets more efficiently and at greater scale.
  • Growth Partnership: Partner with the Growth team to develop compelling creative concepts and content that supports campaigns, demand generation, customer expansion, and sales enablement.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Marketing, Growth, Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Executive Leadership to translate strategy into compelling market-facing experiences and ensure consistent brand execution across the business.

Performance Objectives

First 30 Days: Learn Quickly, Build Relationships, Deliver an Action Plan

  • Complete a brand audit and identify the top five opportunities to improve consistency, quality, and market impact.
  • Deliver a 90-day action plan outlining priorities for brand governance, editorial strategy, creative operations, and AI enablement.
  • Establish relationships with key stakeholders across Growth, Product Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Product, and identify the highest-priority content and brand needs.
  • Take ownership of the marketing request queue, and all request submission channels, and implement immediate improvements to prioritization, visibility, and workflow.
  • Identify at least one AI-enabled workflow that can be implemented quickly to improve the speed or quality of content and creative production.
  • Begin contributing to active projects, demonstrating immediate ownership of content, creative, and brand decisions.

By the End of Q1: Put the Operating System in Place

  • Launch the new brand governance framework, including templates, standards, and review process, not only for the content and workflows your direct team owns, but for all of marketing and the entire organization.
  • Deliver a revised editorial strategy and annual content calendar.
  • Establish the operating model for creative requests and cross-functional intake.
  • Deliver a plan for AI-enabled content and creative workflows, implementing at least three.
  • Launch or refresh priority brand assets in support of Growth campaigns and Product Marketing initiatives.
  • Define and begin reporting on brand index, share of voice, and content contribution to SALs and opportunities.

First 6 Months: Improve How Marketing Operates and Identify Signs of Improved Brand Sentiment

  • Establish a mature brand governance program that improves consistency across campaigns, sales enablement, product marketing, PR, social, events, and customer communications.
  • Build a scalable content operation that consistently delivers high-quality assets aligned to company priorities and quarterly campaigns.
  • Implement AI-enabled workflows that measurably improve the speed, quality, and efficiency of content and creative production.
  • Strengthen OpenSesame's external presence through thought leadership, executive bylines, PR, and earned media opportunities.
  • Improve collaboration and service levels across Marketing by creating a predictable intake, prioritization, and delivery process for creative and content requests.
  • Establish reporting and regular reviews for brand index, share of voice, content contribution to SALs and opportunities, and creative team performance.

By the End of Year 1: Showcase Notable Improvements in Brand Sentiment for OpenSesame

  • Establish OpenSesame as a more recognizable, differentiated, and trusted brand within the enterprise learning market.
  • Demonstrate measurable improvement in brand index, share of voice, and content contribution to pipeline, including SALs and opportunities.
  • Build a creative and content organization that scales through strong leadership, disciplined processes, and AI-enabled execution.
  • Create a repeatable operating model that enables Marketing to respond quickly to business priorities while maintaining a consistently high standard of creative and brand execution.
  • Position the Brand & Creative function as a strategic partner to Growth, Product Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Executive Leadership, helping translate business strategy into compelling market experiences.

You might notice we don’t have the typical list of requirements and buzzwords here. That’s intentional.

We’re looking for proven examples from your career that show you can do this job, that you’ve built systems, driven alignment, and created impact at scale. When you look back a year from now, you’ll know you’ve made OpenSesame better, faster, and stronger because of your leadership.

Although it should go without saying (but it doesn’t), OpenSesame is an equal opportunity employer and we strive to create a welcoming, inclusive environment that celebrates diversity.

We use AI. For real. Every team at OpenSesame works with AI tools daily, not as a buzzword, but as practice. You'll build fluency that most companies are still talking about adopting, with hands-on training and clear guardrails to experiment responsibly. AI amplifies your creativity and judgment. It doesn't replace them. The skills you build here travel with you.

Location: This position can be based anywhere in the US. We operate as a remote-first company, and invest in mandatory all-company meetings several times a year in addition to required team travel as necessary.

Performance Driven: We're looking for self-starters with a track record of delivering excellent results, but we're highly selective about who we hire. We don't focus on typical job requirements, instead, we're interested in specific examples from your past experiences. All positions can be based anywhere in the US, and require up to 15 days of travel per year, with senior management and leadership teams requiring up to 35 days.

Compensation: The pay range for this position is generally between $135,000 and $165,000, depending on experience. At OpenSesame, we offer a comprehensive benefits package to employees upon hire, including professional development, ISOs, health insurance, 401(k) matching, and paid time off. 

Benefits: Benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible PTO, 401(k) matching, incentive stock options, volunteer time off, Employee Resource Groups, and a generous professional development program with dedicated annual time off for learning and growth.

Equal Employment Opportunity: OpenSesame is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer that values and welcomes diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of various legally protected characteristics, including criminal history, and strive to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. We prioritize safety and security and may use your information accordingly, and you can contact us for assistance or accommodations during the job application process. 

Pay Transparency: At OpenSesame, we prioritize pay transparency, fairness, and equity to create a positive and inclusive work environment, regularly reviewing our compensation practices to align with our values and goals. We provide competitive and fair compensation to our employees based on their skills, experience, and performance.

CPRA (California Candidates): When you submit your application, OpenSesame may collect and use your personal information in accordance with our privacy policy and the CPRA. This may include personal details and employment history, and will only be used for employment-related purposes. We may share this information with third-party service providers, but we will not sell it to third parties. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact us, and for more information on your rights under the CPRA, refer to our privacy policy or the California Attorney General's website.

We Care About Your Security: We’ve been made aware of a phishing scam involving individuals impersonating OpenSesame recruiters. All legitimate communication from our team will come from @opensesame.com email addresses. If you receive a suspicious message, please contact us directly at careers@opensesame.com. Your security matters to us, thank you for staying vigilant.

Title: Technical Program Manager
Description:
Parallel Systems is pioneering autonomous battery-electric rail vehicles designed to transform freight transportation by shifting portions of the $900 billion U.S. trucking industry onto rail. Our innovative technology offers cleaner, safer, and more efficient logistics solutions. Join our dynamic team and help shape a smarter, greener future for global freight.

Technical Program Manager   

Parallel Systems is looking for a Technical Program Manager to lead execution across our vehicle hardware, autonomy systems, and enterprise software. This is the first TPM hire at the company - a critical role responsible for keeping engineering efforts aligned as we develop and scale the next generation of autonomous rail vehicles.  

You’ll work cross-functionally with mechanical, electrical, firmware, and software teams to track progress, manage timelines, surface risks, and ensure seamless integration across all parts of the system. From tracking hardware builds and test cycles to coordinating software and firmware dependencies, you’ll drive programs that sit at the heart of our product roadmap.  

This role demands strong communication, technical depth, organizational rigor, attention to detail, and a bias for action. You should thrive in fast-paced environments, be comfortable in the details of physical systems, and bring structure to complex, multi-disciplinary development efforts.  

Responsibilities  

  • Work with leadership to own and manage the integrated master schedule (IMS) that owns the hardware, software, and product deliveries  
  • Coordinate timelines, priorities, and deliverables across hardware, firmware, and software teams for both current and next generation platforms  
  • Track milestones, manage risks, and drive resolution on blockers  
  • Ensure alignment on requirements between engineering, product, and customer teams  
  • Facilitate regular syncs, status reporting, and planning sessions  
  • Create and maintain documentation to support clear visibility and execution at all levels  
  • Support development and integration of new vehicle generations, enterprise software upgrades, and firmware iterations  

What Success Looks Like  

  • After 30 Days: You’ve ramped up on our development processes, tools, and teams, and established a clear understanding of the current vehicle and software stack. You own and maintain the cross-functional integrated master schedule (IMS). You’ve begun managing active programs and created an execution dashboard with forward-looking key timelines.  
  • After 60 Days: You’re driving weekly program updates across hardware, software, and firmware teams, surfacing cross-functional risks and pushing clarity on critical path items. You’ve led coordination on at least one major cross-functional release, with a clear post-mortem process in place. You’ve introduced process improvements that enhance visibility and delivery speed. 
  • After 90 Days: You’re seen as a go-to partner for program planning and execution across the company. You’ve identified and mitigated future risks for the company across critical path items.   

Basic Qualifications  

  • 5+ years of experience in technical program management or engineering program roles  
  • Strong technical background with experience working closely with hardware and software teams  
  • Experience with product development lifecycles or NPI processes 
  • Proven track record of delivering complex, cross-functional programs on time and budget  
  • Exceptional organizational and communication skills  
  • Experience with program tracking tools like Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, etc. 
  • Ability to manage ambiguity and drive clarity in a high-growth startup environment  

Preferred Qualifications  

  • Experience in transportation, robotics, or hardware/software integrated systems  
  • Experience working with enterprise software platforms or freight industry tools

Title: Identity & Privileged Governance Analyst
Description:
A CAreer with point72’s technology TEAM

As Point72 reimagines the future of investing, our Technology team is constantly evolving our firm’s IT infrastructure and engineering capabilities, positioning us at the forefront of a rapidly evolving technology landscape. We’re a team of experts who experiment and work to discover new ways to harness open-source solutions, modern cloud architectures, and sophisticated Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions, while embracing enterprise agile methodologies. Our commitment to building and innovating in the AI space provides the framework intended to drive smarter decision making and enhance how we build and operate our platforms and applications. 
 

As a member of Point72’s Technology team, we encourage and support your professional development from day one—helping you advance your technical skills, contribute innovative ideas, and satisfy your own intellectual curiosity—all while delivering real business impact for our multi-billion-dollar global business. 

 

What you’ll do

We are seeking an Identity & Privileged Governance Analyst to join our Information Security team, supporting identity and privileged access governance, monitoring, and remediation initiatives across the firm. Specifically, you will:

  • Support identity and privileged access governance, hygiene, and remediation activities, with a focus on service account management.
  • Monitor identity and privileged access controls, identify gaps, risks, and exceptions, and drive remediation to completion.
  • Develop, maintain, and enforce identity and privileged access policies, standards, and control requirements.
  • Coordinate and facilitate working sessions to deliver remediation, audit, and control initiatives.
  • Collaborate with application, engineering, and platform teams to map and govern access models within the firm’s Identity Governance & Administration solution.
  • Manage and respond to identity and privileged access requests and inquiries via shared mailboxes and ticketing systems.
  • Communicate IAM and PAM requirements, standards, and expectations effectively to technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
  • Maintain accurate, audit‑ready documentation for IAM/PAM processes, access decisions, remediation activities, and control evidence.
  • Leverage AI tools and LLMs to automate repeatable tasks and improve efficiency.
  • Provide regular status updates and contribute to IAM/PAM program maturity by identifying trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.

 

What’s REQUIRED

  • 5+ years of experience in information security, IAM, PAM, or a related technology risk discipline.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of IAM and PAM concepts, controls, and risks, including service accounts and privileged credentials.
  • Hands‑on experience with PAM solutions (e.g., CyberArk or similar), Active Directory, privileged access models, and identity lifecycle management.
  • Experience supporting access remediation initiatives, control improvements, and governance efforts in an enterprise environment.
  • Familiarity with identity and privileged access policies, standards, and control frameworks, including audit support (evidence gathering, validation, and remediation tracking).
  • Ability to partner effectively with application, engineering, and platform teams to understand and govern access‑related processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools and LLMs (e.g., Claude or similar) to automate operational tasks and support IAM/PAM governance and remediation.
  • Strong communication, documentation, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and deliver audit‑ready outputs on time.
  • Commitment to the highest ethical standards

 

We take care of our people

We invest in our people, their careers, their health, and their well-being. When you work here, we provide:

  • Fully-paid health care benefits
  • Generous parental and family leave policies
  • Volunteer opportunities
  • Support for employee-led affinity groups representing women, people of color and the LGBT+ community
  • Mental and physical wellness programs
  • Tuition assistance
  • A 401(k) savings program with an employer match and more

 

About point72

Point72 is a leading global alternative investment firm led by Steven A. Cohen. Building on more than 30 years of investing experience, Point72 seeks to deliver superior returns for its investors through fundamental and systematic investing strategies across asset classes and geographies. We aim to attract and retain the industry’s brightest talent by cultivating an investor-led culture and committing to our people’s long-term growth. For more information, visit https://point72.com/.

Title: Senior EHS Program Manager
Location: Cape Canaveral, Florida, United States; Long Beach, California, United States; Mississippi, United States
Description:
At Relativity Space, we’re building rockets to serve today’s needs and tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

About the Team:

As a Senior EHS Program Manager, you will be instrumental in building and scaling Relativity's Environmental Health and Safety management systems across all sites and programs. This role requires a unique blend of strategic program development and technical systems expertise. You will lead the development of enterprise-wide EHS standards, policies, and procedures while simultaneously building and managing data systems that drive EHS insights and performance. Working cross-functionally with site EHS teams, Enterprise Applications, engineering, and operations, you will establish the infrastructure and systems that enable a world-class safety culture. This is a strategic role that combines deep EHS technical knowledge with modern data analytics and program management capabilities.

About the Role:

  • Further the development and implementation Relativity's EHS Management System aligned with ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 standards, including health and safety minimum standards, SOPs, specifications, and policies that apply across all sites and programs
  • Design, build, and manage EHS data systems and analytics platforms in coordination with the Enterprise Applications team:
    • Lead requirements definition and implementation of EHS data infrastructure using BigQuery, Confluence, Jira, Power BI, and other data warehouse systems
    • Develop dashboards, metrics, and reporting systems that provide actionable insights on EHS performance, trends, and risks
    • Leverage modern tools (including AI/ML capabilities) to enhance EHS data analysis and decision-making
  • Serve as the strategic lead for enterprise EHS program development, driving continuous improvement initiatives and ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements and industry best practices
  • Partner cross-functionally with site EHS teams, engineering, operations, and IT to implement scalable EHS programs, ensuring consistency while accommodating site-specific needs

About You:

  • Bachelor's degree in Environmental Health and Safety, Occupational Safety, Environmental Science, Engineering, or related technical field
  • 5+ years of progressive EHS experience with demonstrated expertise in developing and implementing ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 management systems
  • Experience with data analysis and business intelligence tools (SQL, BigQuery, Power BI, or similar platforms)
  • Proven experience developing enterprise-wide EHS policies, standards, and procedures in manufacturing or aerospace environments
  • Strong technical writing and program management skills with ability to influence across all organizational levels
  • Experience conducting risk assessments, audits, and managing complex EHS compliance requirements across multiple sites

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with modern data tools including AI/ML applications, data warehouses, and cloud analytics platforms
  • Professional certifications: CSP, CIH, CHMM, or ISO 45001/14001 Lead Auditor
  • Aerospace, defense, or advanced manufacturing experience
  • Experience implementing EHS management software or enterprise applications

Compensation is only one part of our total rewards package. Relativity Space offers competitive salary and equity, a generous PTO and sick leave policy, parental leave, an annual learning and development stipend, and more! To see some of the benefits & perks we offer, please visit here.

Title: Manager, Creator Community & Content
Description:
Who We Are:

BrandCycle is an influencer and affiliate marketing platform representing over 7,000 social media influencers, bloggers, and content creators. Our members have a combined following of more than 300 million on social media. Most of our influencers have been creating content to drive sales for years. They are savvy shoppers who cross-promote and achieve high ROI for brands. We work with over 700 top brands, including Target, lululemon, Michael Kors, Under Armour, Crocs, Kate Spade, and Converse. In 2021, BrandCycle was acquired by StackCommerce, a leader in commerce content for major digital media publishers. StackCommerce and BrandCycle are backed by TPG, a top private equity firm that is known for its growth equity and impact investing.

The Role:

We're hiring a Manager, Creator Community & Content to lead the growth and engagement of BrandCycle's creator community. You'll own the channels our creators live in - our Facebook Group, Instagram, email, and webinars - and the content that keeps creators active and earning with BrandCycle.  

This role blends community management with content strategy and a real revenue mandate. You'll decide what thousands of creators see and hear from us, and you'll measure it in creators activated, creators retained, and dollars earned. You'll also carry the voice of the creator across the company - into our messaging, campaigns, and product roadmap. It's a great opportunity to join a fast-growing company at a pivotal moment in our growth.

This is a 100% remote position, must be based in the U.S.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the numbers. Take ownership of the metrics that define success — creators activated, creators retained, and earnings growth.
  • Manage community channels. Actively respond to messages, moderate conversations, and share feedback with internal stakeholders.   
  • Educate and inspire the community. Build the always-on content that empowers creators to maximize their earnings on BrandCycle.  
  • Turn brand moments into creator earnings. Package campaigns into content creators can act on fast to maximize sales and revenue.
  • Be the voice of the creator. Act as a bridge between BrandCycle creators and internal teams, advocating for their needs and ensuring alignment with company goals.
  • Test and learn. Continuously explore innovative ways to enhance engagement and provide value to our creators. 

What You'll Bring:

  • 3-5 years of experience in social media, community management, and/or influencer marketing.
  • Experience managing social media groups or online communities.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills with the ability to engage, motivate, and support creators and influencers.
  • Hands-on experience working with content publishers, creators, or influencers. 
  • Proficiency in email marketing using Mailchimp, Hubspot, or similar platforms.   
  • Familiarity with design tools like Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or others.
  • Working knowledge of affiliate networks, creator platforms, and social platforms.
  • Familiarity with AI and automation tools, and a genuine desire to expand how you use them.

Who You Are:

Relationship-driven

  • Warm and relationship-driven; you are a person creators want to hear from.
  • Builds trust quickly and anticipates what creators need before they ask.
  • Balances fierce advocacy for the creator with what's right for the business.

Self-directed

  • Entrepreneurial and eager to grow within the role and the company.
  • An effective communicator in a remote environment, comfortable working independently with minimal supervision.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced startup and enjoys wearing many hats.
  • Brings mature, measured judgment and solves problems independently.

Goals-driven

  • Deadline-driven and composed under pressure.
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail.
  • Analytical, and energized by reaching and exceeding revenue goals.
  • Fluent in KPIs and the business metrics that measure success.
  • An eye for the next product, trend, or moment worth putting in front of creators.  

A fast learner

  • Genuinely interested in digital marketing and e-commerce, and up to speed on the latest trends.
  • Comfortable with, and excited by, new and emerging technology and media channels.

Compensation:

Our overall compensation and rewards package includes base pay, bonus or commission, and a variety of benefits. Base pay is determined within a range that allows you the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role.  The anticipated annualized salary range for this role is $75,000 - $95,000 (this range may be modified in the future based on changing market conditions).  Your initial base pay will be determined based on several factors, including demonstrated skills, relevant education or training, experience, qualifications, travel requirements, and job location.

Benefits + Perks:

As a company, we have a lot to offer for the right candidate:

  • Health Benefits: We offer medical, dental, vision, life, and short-term and long-term disability insurance.
  • 401K: Eligible on your first day of employment.
  • Super Flex Time: Run errands as needed, just get your stuff done.
  • Unlimited Vacation: Take time to unwind with unlimited PTO, plus an office closure between Christmas and New Year’s.
  • Generous Parental Leave Program: 12 weeks of paid pregnancy disability and baby bonding leave, as well as 4 weeks of paid paternity leave.
  • WFH Office: Home office stipend and internet dollars to set you up for success.
  • Events: Happy hours, team bonding budgets and culture events (even while remote!) and an annual company offsite.

BrandCycle/StackCommerce values a diverse workplace and strongly encourages people of color, LGBTQIA+, GNC, and NB individuals, people with disabilities, members of ethnic minorities, foreign-born residents, and veterans to apply. We respect and seek to empower each individual and support diverse cultures, perspectives, skills, and experiences within our workforce.

BrandCycle/StackCommerce is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will not be discriminated against because of race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, medical condition, or any protected category prohibited by local, state or federal laws.

Title: Senior Manager, Manufacturing Systems & Operations Readiness (Contractor)
Description:
Join our Mission to Protect Humankind!

Vaxcyte is a clinical-stage vaccine innovation company engineering high-fidelity vaccines to protect humankind from the consequences of bacterial diseases, which have serious and costly health consequences when left unchecked. Working to eradicate or treat bacterial infections such as invasive pneumococcal disease, Group A Strep, and Shigella is just the beginning. Our path to success is clear and well-defined, and Vaxcyte is set up to go the distance. 
 
WHAT we do is every bit as important as HOW we do it! Our work together is guided by four enduring core values:
 
*RETHINK CONVENTION: We bring creative and intellectual diversity to every facet of the work we do in order to innovate and re-innovate the way vaccines are delivered.
 
*AIM HIGH: We embody our collectively audacious goal to courageously make the most complex biologics ever attempted to protect humankind.
 
*LEAD WITH HEART: Everyone leads at Vaxcyte with a kindness-first, inclusive approach to collaboration and vigorous debate that advances our business objectives.
 
*MODEL EXCELLENCE:  The magnitude of our challenge requires our shared commitment to demonstrating integrity, accountability, equality and clarity across communications and decision making.

Summary:

As Vaxcyte’s products progress toward late-stage development and commercialization, the Manufacturing organization requires robust digital tools, structured project tracking, and disciplined readiness oversight to support commercial launch preparation and routine GMP manufacturing. This position will support the Manufacturing organization by developing, maintaining, and driving Smartsheet-based trackers, dashboards, action logs, and gap-assessment tools that enable clear visibility into commercial readiness, documentation status, manufacturing campaign preparation, risks, dependencies, and cross-functional deliverables.

Working closely across the Manufacturing team, MSAT, Process Development, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, Project Management, Business Development, and multiple CDMOs/CMOs, this position will help establish structure, transparency, and governance across operational readiness activities. The role will be accountable for supporting readiness gap assessments, tracking closure of actions, consolidating input from stakeholders, monitoring document and campaign readiness, supporting organizational maturation, and preparing clear status updates for Manufacturing leadership. In addition, the role will provide direct support to the Head of Manufacturing with meeting administration, governance routines, team event coordination, and follow-up management. The ideal candidate will combine strong project tracking and digital tool capabilities, particularly Smartsheet, with an understanding of GMP manufacturing operations, commercial readiness, organizational effectiveness, and cross-functional collaboration in a biologics or vaccine manufacturing environment. This position will report to the Executive Director Manufacturing of Vaxcyte Switzerland.

Ideal Candidate Profile:

The ideal candidate is a highly structured manufacturing systems and operations enablement professional with experience in GMP biotech or pharma environments, preferably biologics, vaccines, or external manufacturing. This person does not need to be a deep technical manufacturing expert, but must understand manufacturing operations, documentation, campaign readiness, and CMO/CDMO interfaces well enough to create clarity, structure, visibility, and follow-through across complex cross-functional work.

The strongest candidate will be highly skilled in Smartsheet and digital project tracking, able to build dashboards, trackers, action logs, readiness heatmaps, and reporting tools that translate complex information into clear management visibility. They will serve as an operational backbone for the Manufacturing organization by bringing digital discipline, governance, operating rhythm, meeting discipline, and proactive support to the Head of Manufacturing while helping the function mature its systems, routines, and ways of working.

Essential Functions:

  • Establish and Monitor manufacturing campaign readiness, including batch preparation milestones, documentation status, material readiness, open actions, and key decision points.
  • Coordinate and consolidate input from Manufacturing, MSAT, Quality, Supply Chain, Regulatory, Project Management, and CDMOs into integrated readiness views.
  • Work across the Manufacturing team and with multiple CDMOs/CMOs to create consistent ways of tracking readiness, actions, decisions, risks, dependencies, and deliverables.
  • Establish governance routines, readiness meetings, action follow-up, and escalation processes to ensure Manufacturing leadership has clear visibility on readiness status.
  • Develop, maintain, and continuously improve Smartsheet-based trackers, dashboards, action logs, and readiness tools to support Manufacturing commercial readiness.
  • Support structured commercial readiness gap assessments across manufacturing operations, documentation, campaign preparation, facility readiness, and CDMO deliverables.
  • Track readiness actions, owners, due dates, risks, dependencies, and escalation items to ensure timely closure and transparent progress reporting.
  • Prepare concise status updates, dashboards, heatmaps, and management reports highlighting progress, gaps, overdue actions, risks, and mitigation options.
  • Identify opportunities to improve tracking discipline, data structure, workflow automation, and visual management across Manufacturing readiness activities.
  • Support organizational maturation of the Manufacturing function by helping to establish fit-for-purpose processes, governance routines, operating rhythms, templates, trackers, and visual management tools.
  • Provide direct support to the Head of Manufacturing for meeting administration, agenda preparation, pre-read coordination, meeting minutes, action tracking, and follow-up management.
  • Support planning and coordination of Manufacturing team events, workshops, offsites, governance sessions, and cross-functional alignment meetings to strengthen team effectiveness and operating discipline.
  • Support tracking of planned and scheduled manufacturing activities at CDMOs to optimize resource utilization and ensure alignment with commercial readiness milestones.
  • Maintain visibility of GMP documentation readiness, including batch records, procedures, protocols, reports, and other manufacturing-related documents required for launch and routine operations.
  • Ensure tracking tools support compliance with GMP expectations, quality requirements, safety expectations, and relevant internal governance standards.

Requirements: 

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in life sciences, engineering, operations, project management, business administration, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in GMP manufacturing, external manufacturing, operations readiness, manufacturing systems, PMO, business operations, or manufacturing support within biotech or pharma.
  • Experience in vaccine, biologics, microbial, sterile, or complex large-molecule manufacturing environments.
  • Deep Experience supporting commercial readiness, launch preparation, operational readiness, gap assessments, document readiness, manufacturing campaign tracking, or governance routines in a regulated environment.
  • Expertise in operational excellence, Lean, visual management, process improvement, or organizational effectiveness practices.
  • Advanced hands-on experience with Smartsheet, including trackers, dashboards, reports, automated workflows, action logs, cross-sheet references, and cross-functional project tracking tools.
  • Strong digital tool capability and ability to translate complex readiness, documentation, campaign, and stakeholder information into clear, structured, and actionable tracking systems.
  • Good understanding of GMP manufacturing operations, batch and campaign readiness, documentation requirements, quality expectations, and cross-functional dependencies.
  • Proven ability to work effectively across Manufacturing, MSAT, Quality, Supply Chain, Regulatory, Project Management, and external CDMOs/CMOs, creating alignment, structure, and follow-through across multiple stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting organizational maturation, including establishment of governance routines, templates, operating rhythms, process discipline, decision logs, action tracking, and team effectiveness practices.
  • Ability to support senior Manufacturing leadership with meeting administration, agenda management, pre-read coordination, minutes, decision logs, action follow-up, workshop preparation, and team event coordination.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, prioritization capability, discretion, and ability to manage multiple workstreams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to prepare concise status updates, dashboards, heatmaps, visual summaries, and escalation materials for Manufacturing leadership.
  • Experience coordinating workshops, governance meetings, offsites, team events, or operating model improvements in a growing organization.
Reports to: Executive Director, Operations 
 
Location: Visp, Switzerland 
 
Work Arrangement: (may be adjusted based on business needs, job responsibilities, or changes to company policy): 
Hybrid 
 
Expected Contract Length: 1 year 
 
 

Equal Opportunity

We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.

Recruitment Fraud Notice

Please be aware of fraud or scams from individuals, organizations and/or internet sites claiming to represent Vaxcyte in recruitment activities. Vaxcyte has an established recruitment process for all positions prior to issuing an offer for employment and we will never extend unsolicited employment offers or ask candidates to provide financial or sensitive personal information as part of the application process. All legitimate communication from Vaxcyte will come from an official @vaxcyte.com email address. Qualified and interested candidates should apply to current openings at vaxcyte.com/careers.

Title: Manager, People Data Governance
Description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most by challenging norms and fixing the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7/365, and created an ER experience that focuses on what our pets and pet parents really need. We’ve done the same for our people (VEGgies), finding a way to say YES so they are empowered to achieve great things, grow in unexpected ways, and find a place where they truly belong.

 

We’re rethinking emergency care from every angle—from how we run our hospitals to how we support the people working inside them. That’s where our headquarters team comes in. Whether building technology to make our hospitals more efficient, recruiting and growing incredible VEGgies, or bringing our brand to life through marketing, our VQ (VEG Headquarters) team makes it all possible—ensuring our hospitals and people have everything they need to help pets and their families.

 

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

 

THE JOB

At VEG, we find a way to say YES—so you can bring that mindset to how we build the People data systems that VEG runs on. VEG is scaling a hospital network where workforce decisions directly affect our ability to help people and their pets when they need it most, and this role makes those decisions clearer, faster, and more trusted. As Manager, People Data Governance, you'll build the foundation for scalable people data across our organization. This is a foundational role with real impact: you'll create the single source of truth that enables our leaders to say YES to smarter, faster decisions. If you're energized by building from the ground up, partnering across teams, and making data work for people—not the other way around—we want you on our team.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Define and enforce people data governance standards by establishing consistent metric definitions, naming conventions, and data attributes across core HR domains, including headcount, turnover, DEI, recruiting, and internal mobility.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable data standards by maintaining the people data dictionary, data hierarchy, business definitions, and documentation that support consistent reporting across People processes.
  • Own people master data quality by leading data audits, resolving data issues, validating organizational hierarchies, evaluating system changes, and ensuring the accuracy and integrity of workforce data.
  • Partner with Solutions & Insights, HRBPs, COEs, Finance, and IT/Data Engineering to define workforce data requirements, support cross-functional initiatives, and serve as the trusted advisor on people metrics and analytics.
  • Establish and administer people data governance practices for data access, security, privacy, and stewardship by partnering with HR, IT, Legal, and Information Security to protect sensitive workforce data, manage role-based access, and ensure compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Operationalize scalable people data capabilities by translating business processes into connected data models, defining reusable business logic and metric calculations, identifying automation opportunities, and enabling trusted reporting, self-service analytics, predictive insights, and responsible AI.

 

WHAT YOU NEED

  • 5+ years of experience in HR data management, people data governance, HRIS, or supporting people analytics with a demonstrated track record of improving data quality, establishing governance practices, and enabling data-driven decision making.
  • Knowledge of data governance, data stewardship, and data quality best practices, with an understanding of data privacy, security, and compliance requirements (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA).
  • Experience developing data standards, business definitions, documentation, or governance processes that improve the consistency and reliability of workforce data.
  • Hands-on experience with Workday reporting and workforce data management. Advanced proficiency in Google Workspace or Microsoft Office required; experience with Tableau, Snowflake, Cornerstone, Greenhouse, ServiceNow, or similar HR technologies preferred.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including root cause analysis, data validation, and issue resolution, with the ability to translate complex workforce data into clear, actionable insights for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and project management skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional partners and drive organizational adoption of data governance practices.
  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Information Systems, Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 

WHO YOU ARE

  • Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives
  • Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments
  • Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results 
  • Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

 

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

  • Competitive Compensation Including ($125,000 - $150,000) + bonus + benefits. 
  • Comprehensive health and wellness benefits that start on day one, and access to free therapy or counseling
  • Paid parental leave, up to 12 weeks at 100% of regular salary, and offering inclusive fertility and family-building care for all types of families
  • Unlimited PTO to use for vacation or sick days—however you need it! 
  • Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people.
  • And the little (big) things, like casual office attire, ability to bring your fur baby to work, cool VEG swag, food in the fridge for when you’re hungry and free lunches twice a week!!
  • Company laptop and a monthly cell phone reimbursement

 

BETTER TOGETHER: WHY IN-PERSON MATTERS AT VEG HQ 

Our hospitals thrive on in-person collaboration, and VQ is no different. Time in the office sparks stronger connections, meaningful conversations, and better results—all bringing our core values to life. We prioritize being present because our values are best achieved side by side. Plus, we make getting here easy with free parking and a shuttle from the White Plains Metro-North station.

 

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

 

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

Title: Global Presales Program Manager
Description:
About Boomi and What Makes Us Special

Are you ready to work at a fast-growing company where you can make a difference? Boomi, the data activation company for AI, powers the agentic enterprise by bringing data to life across the business. The award-winning Boomi Enterprise Platform is the active data foundation that delivers essential agentic infrastructure enabling organizations to drive agentic transformation and harness the power of AI with secure, scalable connectivity.  Trusted by over 30,000 customers and supported by a network of 800+ partners, Boomi helps organisations of all sizes achieve agility, efficiency, and innovation at scale. At Boomi, you’ll work with world-class people and industry-leading technology. We hire trailblazers with an entrepreneurial spirit who can solve challenging problems, make a real impact, and want to be part of building something big. If this sounds like a good fit for you, check out boomi.com  or visit our Boomi Careers page to learn more.

How You'll Make An Impact

  • Drive revenue growth by optimizing and creating Presales programs and initiatives to enhance the effectiveness and efficiency of the technical sales process. 

  • Ensure that Presales teams are equipped with the knowledge and resources needed to deliver exceptional customer experiences through enablement content and reusable assets sourced from the field. 

  • Identify and implement process improvements, tools and best practices to assist in streamlining Presales workflows and operations. 

  • Facilitate cross-functional collaboration between Presales, sales, marketing, product management, and other teams to break down silos, foster a culture of collaboration and teamwork and drive collective success and business growth.

  • Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices, to drive innovation within the Presales organization.

  • Assist the Director of Global Presales Strategies in creating data-driven insights to identify areas for improvement and optimization, in order to continuously refine strategies and initiatives to drive better results.

What You'll Do

  • Manage change requests for Presales technologies by working with stakeholders to understand requirements, implement, and track to resolution ensuring that any changes adhere to established governance standards, policies, and procedures.

  • Provide project management support for projects relating to new Presales programs, demo tools and improvement processes. (e.g. develop playbooks, process documentation, new product subject matter expert program maintenance, presentations, written communications).

  • Facilitate knowledge sharing through weekly webinars and curated, field sourced content to share best practices and reusable assets across Presales teams globally to drive consistency and excellence.

  • Create and maintain database of relevant materials and work with assigned SMEs on a scheduled basis to ensure accuracy

  • Create, maintain and socialize “Tiger Team” programs focused on the identification, socialization and continual education for field SMEs across different technologies.

  • Manage programs centered around collection of feedback from win/loss reviews, customer stories and lessons learned from a technical perspective

  • Socialize and improve current demo up level programs including enforcing standard demo methodologies using vetted content and focus on improvement of related soft skills.

  • Manage global skills matrix across Boomi core products, common competitors, commonly used apps/systems and coding including verification method improvements

  • Creation and maintenance of rotational programs for security, professional services, solution architecture, etc.  to improve technical knowledge of our field sellers

  • Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in Presales management, and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

The Experience You Bring

  • Bachelor's or Master’s degree in computer science, engineering, information technology, business, or related field.

  • 5+ years of experience in Project Management with a track record of developing and implementing successful strategies.

  • Demonstrated operational rigor and effective maximization of resources while paying attention to the details.

  • Hybrid analytical/creative mindset with the ability to leverage data and metrics to drive decision-making and continuous improvement using creative solutions.

  • Ability to collect and analyze data to prioritize properly and report on metrics to track progress and identify areas of improvement.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions.

  • Training and certifications in Project Management (PMP, MPM, PgMP or equivalent) Agile/Scrum, ITIL, Salesforce.com, Java, Power BI and/or AWS are a plus.

  • This is a US Based Remote role with preferred location in Philadelphia, Dallas, or Denver.

Title: Technical Program Manager, Release Management - C3 Agentic AI Platform
Description:
C3 AI (NYSE: AI), is the Enterprise AI application software company. C3 AI delivers a family of fully integrated products including the C3 Agentic AI Platform, an end-to-end platform for developing, deploying, and operating enterprise AI applications, C3 AI applications, a portfolio of industry-specific SaaS enterprise AI applications that enable the digital transformation of organizations globally, and C3 Generative AI, a suite of domain-specific generative AI offerings for the enterprise. Learn more at: C3 AI

We are hiring a Technical Program Manager to own release management for the C3 Agentic AI Platform. You will run the release train end to end: defining the release, holding the quality bar, driving the go/no-go decision, and shipping the product to production on the committed date.

The C3 Agentic AI Platform is the foundation of the C3 AI application suite, C3 Generative AI, and the C3 AI Integrated Development Studio. Every release you ship is inherited by dozens of enterprise applications and the customers running them in production. This is a hands-on, technical role — you will be in the branch plan, the release readiness evidence, the defect triage, and the deployment window itself, not reporting on them from a distance. You will work alongside platform engineering, product management, data science, quality engineering, and cloud operations, and you will be the single person accountable for release state at any moment. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Define release scope, cadence, and schedule for the C3 Agentic AI Platform, including branch cuts, code freeze, release candidates, GA, and patch and hotfix lines.
  • Maintain complete and current state on every item in the release: committed features, open dependencies, blocking defects, and the critical path to GA.
  • Identify release risks early, force the trade-off conversation between scope, schedule, and quality, and drive the decision to closure rather than escalating it upward undecided.
  • Own the release readiness checklist and its exit criteria across code quality, security, performance, scalability, and upgrade and migration paths.
  • Review the evidence submitted for each readiness task against our guidelines and reject what does not meet the bar.
  • Run the go/no-go with engineering and product leadership, with a documented recommendation and the data behind it.
  • Act as the primary point of contact through the deployment window: field deployment issues, own escalations, and execute rollback or contingency plans when needed.
  • Coordinate release communication to internal stakeholders, application teams, and customer-facing organizations before, during, and after deployment.
  • Drive release-related incidents to root cause with the owning teams and close the loop into the process.
  • Partner with release engineering and infrastructure teams to reduce manual steps in build, test, and deployment, and to shorten the path from code freeze to GA.
  • Onboard engineering teams onto release tooling and hold them to the process.
  • Instrument the release process and report on it: release predictability, cycle time from freeze to GA, escaped defect rate, hotfix volume, and readiness task turnaround.
  • Run release retrospectives, land the corrective actions, and cascade the resulting process changes across the engineering organization.
  • Maintain release documentation, release notes inputs, and the audit trail required by our quality processes.

Qualifications: 

  • Bachelor's or graduate degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 5+ years in technical program management, release management, or engineering program ownership for a commercial software product.
  • Demonstrated ownership of software releases end to end: defining release scope, managing dependencies and risk, scheduling, and shipping to production on a recurring cadence.
  • Working fluency with modern software delivery mechanics: source control and branching strategy, CI/CD, test automation, defect triage, and cloud deployment.
  • Strong understanding of AI and machine learning concepts and the technologies behind them.
  • Track record of creating a process and getting an organization to actually follow it.
  • Ability to hold a quality bar under schedule pressure, and the judgment to know when the bar should move and when it should not.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication with both engineering teams and senior leadership.
  • Proficiency with Agile, Scrum, or Kanban and the tooling around them (e.g. Jira).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Hands-on background in software engineering, quality engineering, or data science.
  • Experience releasing an enterprise platform or PaaS consumed by internal application teams as well as external customers.
  • Experience with multi-cloud or air-gapped deployment environments, and with compliance-constrained release processes (e.g. FedRAMP, SOC 2).
  • PMP, Agile, or Scrum certification.

 Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future company sponsorship. 

C3 AI provides excellent benefits, a competitive compensation package and generous equity plan. 

California Base Pay Range
$131,000—$190,000 USD

C3 AI is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristics, including disabled and veteran status.

Title: Principal Partner Program Manager - Datadog Partner Network Solution Provider Program
Location: Boston, Massachusetts, USA; Denver, Colorado, USA; New York, New York, USA; San Francisco, California, USA
Description:
Job Description

We're looking for an experienced Principal Partner Program Manager to own the Datadog Partner Network's solution provider program end to end, across Datadog's Channels & Alliances organization.

 

In this role, you'll be the program owner for Datadog's solution provider (reseller) partner program — setting program strategy, structure, tiering, and requirements, and driving the partner lifecycle from recruitment and onboarding through enablement and ongoing performance management. You'll also serve as the subject matter expert for partner pricing, helping shape how Datadog structures, operationalizes, and scales partner pricing across its ecosystem, and acting as the primary liaison between Channels & Alliances and Deal Desk on partner-specific pricing requirements and commercial frameworks.

You'll support both internal teams and external partners by providing guidance on program benefits, pricing models, deal structures, incentives, and commercial programs. You'll own enablement for the solution provider program more broadly, including pricing enablement, developing training content and onboarding programs that help Partner Sales Managers and partners confidently navigate the program and Datadog's evolving pricing landscape.

This is a highly cross-functional role that requires deep experience building and running reseller-focused partner programs, along with experience in partner commercial models and SaaS pricing, and the ability to translate program and pricing strategy into scalable processes, tools, and training.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture—the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You'll Do

Own the Datadog Partner Network solution provider program

  • Own the strategy, structure, and roadmap for the Datadog Partner Network's solution provider (reseller) program
  • Define and manage program tiers, requirements, and benefits for solution provider partners
  • Drive the end-to-end partner lifecycle — recruitment, onboarding, activation, and ongoing performance management — for solution provider partners
  • Serve as the Channels & Alliances subject matter expert for partner pricing, commercial frameworks, and deal strategy
  • Act as the primary liaison between Channels & Alliances and Deal Desk for partner-related pricing, discounting, incentives, and program requirements
  • Advise Partner Sales Managers (PSMs) and partners on program benefits, pricing models, deal structures, and commercial considerations
  • Support partner-facing conversations and help partners understand the solution provider program and Datadog's consumption-based pricing model
  • Partner with Deal Desk, Finance, Operations, Legal, and Leadership teams to evaluate and operationalize new program elements, partner pricing models, incentives, and commercial programs
  • Ensure solution provider program requirements, including partner-specific pricing, are reflected in company-wide processes, policies, systems, and tools
  • Develop scalable documentation, playbooks, FAQs, and resources that improve program and pricing consistency across the partner organization
  • Create and deliver onboarding and ongoing enablement programs for Partner Sales Managers and partners related to the solution provider program, pricing, deal strategy, and commercial programs

Who You Are

  • 8-10 years of experience building and scaling partner programs, with deep expertise in reseller or solution provider-focused programs, within a SaaS or technology company
  • Proven experience owning the full partner program lifecycle, including design, recruitment, onboarding, enablement, and performance management
  • Experience with partner commercial models, including pricing, incentives, rebates, discounts, and other program constructs
  • Direct experience working with Deal Desk or similar functions to support partner pricing, discounting frameworks, approvals, and complex deal structures
  • Strong understanding of SaaS pricing models, including experience supporting consumption-based or usage-based businesses
  • Experience serving as a trusted advisor on program and commercial strategy for partner-facing teams
  • Demonstrated ability to translate program and pricing strategy into scalable processes, tools, and enablement programs
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills

Bonus Points

  • Experience owning or contributing to partner program platforms, pricing calculators, quoting systems, CPQ tools, or commercial operations platforms
  • Experience building and delivering partner or pricing enablement programs at scale
  • Experience supporting global partner organizations and regional sales teams
  • Quantitative background in business, economics, finance, mathematics, analytics, engineering, or a related discipline
  • Background in SaaS and/or consumption-based software platforms

  • Proven ability to work independently and cross-functionally
