  • Working knowledge of SEO tactics
  • Familiarity with CAD modeling and 3D printing

Title: Sr. Technical Program Manager
Description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

About the role

Nebius is entering a strategic, multi-year partnership with Meta that spans infrastructure, capacity delivery, technical integration, commercial execution, and executive-level coordination. This partnership is business-critical and externally visible, with timelines, financial commitments, and reputational risk at the highest level.

The Head of Projects, Meta is the single-threaded owner for end-to-end program execution of the Meta partnership across Nebius. This role ensures that complex, cross-company initiatives are planned, sequenced, governed, and delivered, while translating Meta’s requirements into executable plans across Nebius engineering, infrastructure, and operations teams.

This is not a project manager role. It is a strategic TPM leadership role operating at the intersection of:

  • Executive stakeholders 
  • Hyperscale infrastructure delivery 
  • Deep technical programs 
  • Commercial and contractual obligations

Role Summary:

The Head of Projects, Meta will lead the programmatic execution of all initiatives tied to the Meta–Nebius partnership. They will operate as:

  • Primary program interface to Meta (peer to senior Meta TPMs / Directors) 
  • Internal orchestrator across infra, engineering, supply chain, finance, and legal 
  • Owner of delivery commitments, risks, dependencies, and escalations 
  • Architect of operating rhythm (governance, reviews, metrics, decision frameworks) 
  • They will define how work gets done, not just track it.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Program Ownership

Own the master program plan for all Meta-related initiatives across Nebius.  Translating partnership agreements and technical requirements into:

  • Multi-quarter roadmaps 
  • Dependency maps 
  • Delivery milestones 
  • Ensure alignment between commercial commitments and technical feasibility

2. Executive Stakeholder Management (Meta & Nebius)

  • Serve as the primary execution counterpart to senior Meta stakeholders 
  • Run joint governance forums (QBRs, exec reviews, escalation paths) 
  • Provide clear, credible updates to Nebius executive leadership 
  • Manage difficult trade-offs with confidence and authority

3. Complex Technical Program Leadership

Drive delivery across:

  • Large-scale infrastructure buildouts 
  • Capacity planning and deployment 
  • Systems integration and technical onboarding 
  • Partner deeply with engineering and infra leaders without duplicating their roles 
  • Anticipate second- and third-order technical and operational impacts

4. Risk, Dependency, and Escalation Management

  • Identify critical path risks early (technical, supply chain, regulatory, financial) 
  • Build mitigation plans and decision frameworks 
  • Escalate decisively and with solutions, not surprises 
  • Maintain Meta-level rigor in tracking, documentation, and accountability

5. Operating Model & Process Design

Define and implement:

  • Program governance structure 
  • Metrics and KPIs (delivery, readiness, risk) 
  • Decision-making and change-management processes 
  • Raise Nebius’s TPM maturity where needed to meet hyperscaler expectations

Leadership Without Direct Authority

  • Influence senior engineering, infra, and operations leaders 
  • Align multiple teams with competing priorities 
  • Act as a calm, credible leader in high-pressure situations

What Makes This Role Different from a Standard Technical Program Manager:

  • Owns external partnership execution, not just internal programs 
  • Operates at VP / GM interface level 
  • Balances technical depth, commercial awareness, and executive presence 
  • Is accountable for outcomes, not process compliance 
  • Requires judgment under ambiguity, not predefined playbooks

Ideal Background & Experience

  • 10+ years in Technical Program Management, Engineering Program Management, or equivalent 
  • Proven ownership of large, multi-year, multi-org technical programs

Experience working with or within:

  • Hyperscale's 
  • Cloud infrastructure providers 
  • Large-scale platforms or data centre ecosystems 
  • Direct experience interfacing with external partners or customers at senior levels 

Prior experience at or with:

  • Meta, Google, Amazon, Microsoft, Apple 
  • Cloud / infra providers (AWS, GCP, Azure, OCI) 
  • High-growth infra or AI platforms

Background in:

  • Infrastructure delivery 
  • Capacity planning 
  • Platform or systems integration 
  • Experience shaping new operating models, not just running existing ones

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

The Enterprise Data Solutions (EDS) team at Toast is on a mission to deliver a trusted, scalable, and governed data foundation that empowers every team at Toast to make decisions with speed and confidence. As Toast scales and AI becomes central to our product and operational strategy, EDS serves as the engine behind that ambition—building the infrastructure, governance frameworks, and data products every business function depends on.

As a Senior Data Governance Product Manager, you will be the primary operational executor within EDS's governance function. Reporting directly to the Director of Enterprise Data Governance, you will build and run the policies, processes, and programs that make Toast's data trustworthy, compliant, and discoverable every day.

This role is ideal for someone who is equally comfortable running a cross-functional workshop with business stakeholders and configuring metadata standards in a data catalog—combining strategic thinking with a strong bias toward execution.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

  • Drive Governance Program Operations: Manage and maintain the Data Domain Model, ensuring clear ownership assignments. Facilitate the Data Governance Council (agendas, action tracking, meeting facilitation), partner with Data Stewards across domains, and track program adoption metrics and maturity KPIs for leadership.
  • Execute Policy & Compliance Standards: Support the development, documentation, and roll-out of enterprise data policies. Monitor compliance, coordinate remediation with domain owners, maintain the policy register, and assemble governance documentation for audits and risk reviews.
  • Lead Business Glossary & Metadata Management: Own day-to-day operations of Toast's Business Glossary by facilitating definition workshops and certifying terms with domain owners. Partner with the data catalog team to enforce metadata standards, build onboarding guides, and run regular office hours to drive user adoption.
  • Advance Data Strategy & Maturity: Support the enterprise data strategy through stakeholder synthesis and executive materials. Coordinate data maturity assessments, synthesize outputs into actionable recommendations, and deliver training programs to raise data literacy across the company.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • Experience: 5+ years in data governance, data management, or analytics. Proven track record of supporting or implementing governance programs (stewardship models, policy execution, catalog rollouts) and driving adoption in fast-moving, complex environments.
  • Familiarity with data governance frameworks (e.g., DAMA DMBOK).
  • Working knowledge of modern data stack platforms (Snowflake, dbt, cloud data warehouses).
  • Hands-on experience with data catalog/metadata management tools (e.g., DataHub, Alation, Atlan).
  • Proficiency in SQL for governance reporting and data quality analysis.
  • Leadership & Program Management: Exceptional workshop facilitation and consensus-building skills. High degree of organization with a track record of managing multiple workstreams and executing independently.

What will help you stand out (Nonessential Skills/Nice to Haves):

  • Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP) certification (or active coursework).
  • Hands-on experience with data observability tools (e.g., Monte Carlo, Great Expectations).
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks (SOC 2, GDPR/CCPA, internal audit) or AI governance/responsible data practices.
  • Prior experience in B2B SaaS or restaurant technology.

Title: Director of Digital & Radio Content - Fort Collins
Description:
Director of Digital & Radio Content – Fort Collins

*This is a full-time, in-office opportunity. *

 

Where Creative Leadership Meets Local Impact:

Are you a strategic, people-first content leader with a passion for building winning brands and developing top-tier talent? At Townsquare Media Group, we’re looking for a Director of Digital & Radio Content to lead our MARKET market—overseeing strong local brands and driving audience growth across on-air, digital, social, and live platforms.

This is a full-time, in-office leadership role working closely and collaboratively with a talented local team. You’ll set the vision for local content, coach and develop market-leading talent, and play a hands-on role in creating compelling, clickable, and shareable content that resonates with the local community—while partnering closely with sales and leadership to drive revenue and impact.

 

Why Townsquare Media?

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted Fort Collins stations.

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

What You’ll Do:

As Director of Digital & Radio Content for Fort Collins, you’ll provide leadership, strategy, and creative direction for our local brands—ensuring excellence across on-air, online, and on-site experiences. This role blends high-level strategy with hands-on leadership and content creation. You will:

  • Establish and execute a clear, competitive vision for local content while maintaining ownership of the overall sound, content strategy, and brand execution across all stations to drive audience growth, market leadership, and business results.
  • Lead from the front as an active influencer, content creator, and brand ambassador, setting the standard for audience engagement while coaching team members to build meaningful connections across on-air, digital, social, and live platforms.
  • Recruit, develop, coach, and retain high-performing on-air, digital, and production talent, fostering a positive, collaborative, high-performance culture that drives market-leading results across all brands.
  • Partner closely with sales leadership and cross-functional teams to develop compelling, revenue-generating content, sponsorships, promotions, features, and events, creating innovative marketing solutions for clients while ensuring alignment across programming, sales, production, and market leadership.
  • Develop innovative, multi-platform content strategies that build highly engaged audience communities, drive ratings and digital growth, cultivate strong relationships throughout the market, and create revenue-generating partnerships across all channels.
  • Host a live, engaging on-air show on a regular, ongoing basis, preparing daily content that entertains, informs, and connects with the target audience
  • Create and publish a minimum of two original local articles per day for the station website and mobile app
  • Create and oversee compelling local content and digital storytelling across websites, mobile platforms, and social channels
  • Design and execute programming clocks, music strategy, and tactical plans to grow time spent listening, audience occasions, and digital reach
  • Oversee sound design, station imaging, and audio architecture—keeping content fresh, creative, and impactful
  • Creating and publishing original video content regularly, including social-first short-form video (Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) and longer-form segments that grow your personal on-screen brand
  • Prospecting and developing endorsement and influencer partnerships with local businesses, pitching yourself as a trusted community voice who can authentically promote products and services across on-air, video, and social platforms
  • Participating in person in high-visibility community events, client meetings, and business functions as a station ambassador who builds relationships that translate into revenue

 

What You’ll Bring:

  • Demonstrated success as a content leader with strong people management skills
  • 3+ years of management experience
  • Strategic mindset with a strong understanding of industry trends and audience behavior
  • On-air programming experience with deep knowledge of content creation and curation
  • Strong writing, communication, and storytelling skills across platforms
  • Familiarity with a wide range of digital assets, tools, and publishing workflows
  • Proven ability to lead in competitive markets and drive measurable results
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to connect content strategy to revenue outcomes
  • Sound judgment, creativity, and a strong desire to win
  • High School Diploma (required)
  • Valid driver's license, auto insurance, and vehicle (required)

 

What’s In It for You?

We know leadership roles come with high expectations—and we back that up with meaningful rewards:

  • Competitive salary + bonus program
  • 3 weeks PTO + 9 paid holidays
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, and Pet Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Company-provided laptop
  • Casual, high-energy work environment
  • Opportunities for upward mobility within a growing media organization
  • Company discounts
  • Volunteer Time Off—give back to your community
  • And much more…

Title: Quality & Training Program Manager, Mapping Operations
Description:

  • Create and maintain clear technical documentation. 
  •   Work with Technical Writers, Subject Matter Experts and Instructional Designers on the design and development of comprehensive training programs. 

You have:

  • Bachelor's Degree in technical or business discipline.
  • Overall 4+ years of work experience in a scaled operations set up, 2+ years of experience in the Quality and/ or Training functions. 
  • Proven collaboration and communications skills working with globally distributed teams and multiple stakeholders. 
  • Excellent data analysis skills, ability to derive insights and tell a story with data.    

We prefer:

  • Technical documentation and Training experience    
  • Worked in Mapping/ GIS, Ride-sharing, or in the supply chain domain

The team develops and promotes safety strategies and policies for autonomous vehicles for its work with regulatory authorities, lawmakers, law enforcement and public and non-profit organizations. Our Safety Team also helps advise on compliance with applicable environmental, health, and safety regulations.

In this hybrid role you will report into our Head of Enterprise Resilience.

You will:

  • Lead the design, development, execution, and evaluation of incident response exercises across the enterprise and with external operational and public safety partners (e.g., Departments of Emergency Management). 
  • Define and drive the incident readiness program's long-term exercise roadmap and strategy in alignment with Waymo's Safety Management System (SMS) and Homeland Security Exercise and Evaluation Program (HSEEP) methodologies, balancing exercise diversity, cross-functional stakeholder engagement, and operational scalability.
  • Lead the end-to-end design, configuration, and execution of technical functional exercises and operational drills driving evaluation of operator proficiency, workflow latency, and feature utilization within proprietary incident management platforms and tools.
  • Establish and standardize scalable, measurable, and repeatable documentation and evaluation frameworks across the full exercise lifecycle—from needs assessments and exercise scoping to After Action Reports (AARs) and leadership briefings.
  • Develop and oversee the identification, root cause analysis, tracking, assignment, and closure of corrective actions and mitigations resulting from readiness exercises to prevent recurrence and enhance overall safety performance.
  • Direct and support an extended workforce (xWF) team of exercise design specialists, ensuring operational excellence, continuous improvement, and aligned delivery on program milestones.

You have:

  • 10+ years of experience in designing, executing, and scaling incident readiness, crisis exercise, or business continuity exercise programs with a wide range of teams and within safety-critical or highly regulated private sector operational environments such as Automotive, Maritime, Financial, Utilities, Aviation, or similar sectors.
  • Demonstrated subject matter expertise in integrating HSEEP and other industry-standard exercise methodologies into enterprise-wide readiness programs.
  • Proven ability to establish operational relationships, communication channels, and joint exercise initiatives with regulatory authorities and public safety agencies (e.g., Departments of Emergency Management).
  • Demonstrated technical fluency and hands-on experience designing, configuring, and utilizing complex operational software, dispatch platforms, telematics dashboards, or proprietary incident management tooling before and during live exercises.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Emergency Management, Operations, Business, Business Continuity or a related technical/operational field (or equivalent practical experience).

We prefer:

  • Experience collaborating with procurement and vendor partners to ensure extended workforce (xWF) teams meet safety policy standards, operational quality, and project milestones.
  • Experience designing and facilitating incident response exercises and operational drills for autonomous vehicle (AV) operations, fleet networks, or safety-critical mobility systems.
  • Experience integrating technical failure modes, operational tooling resilience, and disaster recovery (DR) protocols into various exercise types.
  • Demonstrated experience preparing and delivering executive-level reporting, exercise findings and dashboards, and strategic readiness briefings for leadership and governance bodies.
  • Professional certifications such as Master Exercise Practitioner (MEP), Certified Emergency Manager (CEM), Certified Business Continuity Professional (CBCP), Associate Business Continuity Professional (ABCP) or FEMA ICS/NIMS (ICS 100, 200, 300, 400, 700, 800).

CoreWeave is building the world's largest AI infrastructure platform and our fleet is expanding at extraordinary speed. We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead the delivery of our compute fleet—the GPU and CPU infrastructure that powers customer workloads—from infrastructure handover through operational readiness. This role will translate business priorities and customer requirements into executable fleet delivery plans, then drive those plans from infrastructure handover through provisioning, validation, and acceptance into steady-state operations.

Partnering with teams across the business including Compute, Networking, Data Center, Fleet Operations, Product, Go-to-Market, and Capacity Planning teams, you will establish delivery scope, dependencies, readiness criteria, and achievable timelines. You will provide a clear view of what Fleet can deliver, surface gaps between requested and forecast availability, and drive the decisions and cross-team actions needed to close those gaps.

You will own Fleet’s contribution to broader infrastructure delivery programs and coordinate prioritized provisioning and transition programs supporting new and existing customers.

The Technical Program Manager will

  • Lead Fleet delivery programs from infrastructure handover through provisioning, validation, and operational acceptance, tracking upstream readiness dependencies before handover.

  • Establish provisioning, validation, and operational acceptance criteria with engineering and operations owners, including documentation and explicit ownership of accepted exceptions.
  • Define and use metrics for delivery throughput, time from handover to readiness, forecast accuracy, and capacity blocked by cause and age; reconcile discrepancies that affect delivery decisions.
  • Identify recurring bottlenecks and translate deployment lessons and upcoming requirements into prioritized improvements to Fleet tooling, automation, and processes.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in technical program management or related engineering delivery roles, with demonstrated success leading complex compute infrastructure deployment programs.
  • Technical understanding of server provisioning, networking dependencies, hardware/software integration, validation, and operational readiness in large-scale infrastructure environments.
  • Experience translating business and customer requirements into technical delivery plans with clear scope, dependencies, milestones, and acceptance criteria.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional execution, influence without direct authority, and drive prioritization and tradeoff decisions with engineering, operations, and business stakeholders.
  • Ability to independently investigate delivery data, reconcile conflicting sources, define meaningful metrics, and guide dashboard development to support planning and execution.
  • Experience establishing effective delivery processes in rapidly changing environments with incomplete data and evolving requirements.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain delivery feasibility, risks, and tradeoffs to technical teams and business leaders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience coordinating infrastructure deployment readiness for new GPU platforms or compute service offerings.
  • Familiarity with data center infrastructure dependencies, including power, cooling, and networking, and their impact on compute deployment.
  • Experience partnering with Product, Go-to-Market, and Capacity Planning teams to align infrastructure delivery with customer requirements and business priorities.
  • Experience defining provisioning, validation, and operational acceptance criteria, including documentation and ownership of outstanding issues.
  • Experience coordinating reprovisioning, hardware refreshes, or infrastructure transitions that support existing customers.
  • Experience using analytical tools or query languages, such as SQL, to investigate infrastructure data and improve delivery reporting.
  • Demonstrated success improving provisioning throughput, delivery predictability, or time to operational readiness through tooling, automation, or process changes.

Title: Technical Program Manager, Colocation Service Delivery & Management
Description:
At gFiber, we believe that great internet has the power to drive innovation, strengthen communities, enable the impossible, and do all the everyday things that make all of our world go round. And the job of creating better internet is never done - so we’re growing! Our team is committed to building a place where people who want to make a difference can grow their careers and find their spot to belong.

The application window will be open until at least September 27, 2026. This opportunity will remain online based on business needs which may be before or after the specified date.

This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.

 

Role Description

As our Technical Program Manager, Colocation Service Delivery & Management, you will be responsible for managing the delivery and ongoing capacity management of complex, large-scale network infrastructure services, purchased from third-party suppliers nationwide. 

Within the gFiber team, you’ll work cross functionally to drive the completion of complex projects with the technical operations market teams, network engineering and network acquisition teams. These projects can include assessing leased dark fiber, colocation and bandwidth requirements to support new capacity demands and understanding the terms of new contracts including delivery targets and other technical requirements. Additionally, you’ll work to refine and evolve our projects, as well as deploy new technologies to markets and communities across the US. Within your team, you’ll foster an environment of learning and growth, both directly and indirectly, helping those around you develop and hone their skills.

 

In this role, you’ll:

  • Manage third-party vendor infrastructure delivery through build, network connectivity, acceptance, and documentation including project tracking and preparation of technical drawings and scopes of work. 
  • Oversee kickoff and regular project status meetings, collaborating across teams and escalating up vendor management chains when delivery time lines are at risk.
  • Manage the quality of third-party leased Infrastructure documentation including accuracy and alignment between leased asset network inventory and commercial contract inventory.  
  • Identify opportunities to streamline processes to meet business needs and improve efficiency operationalizing solutions in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders and vendor partners.
  • Manage and augment portfolio to continue to meet the ongoing needs of the business.

 

At a minimum, we would like you to have:

  • BA/BS degree in engineering, computer science, or equivalent practical experience. 
  • 4 years of experience developing and managing network infrastructure programs, vendor management, and delivery of leased assets (including dark fiber, bandwidth services, and colocation space/power).
  • 2 years of experience with space/power projects including build-outs in data centers or third-party colocation facilities.
  • Experience leading project teams and/or vendor resources and defining/managing against success metrics.
  • Experience ordering and managing colocation space, including  AC & DC power consumption  

 

It’s preferred that you have:

  • Colocation subject matter expertise including planning, designing, engineering of data center and standalone colocation.
  • Experience with colocation capacity headroom management, including (AC and DC) power consumption analysis in alignment with evolving business requirements.
  • Capability to engineer colocation sites including necessary infrastructure supporting OSP to ISP pathways and RFE development in alignment with business requirements.
  • Experience with Central Office design practices, data center electrical and mechanical best practices, and space/power planning. 
  • Experience using project management and network inventory tools (e.g. Netcracker, ServiceNow, Sitetracker, and GSuite).
  • Experience working on highly visible, time-sensitive projects with multiple stakeholder groups that drive revenue and customer targets.
  • Contract negotiation and network acquisition experience

Title: Content Marketing Manager
Description:

With proprietary AI built on over a decade of real property data, Hover answers age-old questions like “What will it look like?” and “What will it cost?” Homeowners, contractors, and insurance professionals rely on Hover to get fully measured, accurate, and interactive 3D models of any property — all from a smartphone scan in minutes.

At Hover, we’re driven by curiosity, purpose, and a shared commitment to serving our customers, communities, and each other. We believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives and are proud to cultivate an inclusive, high-performance culture that inspires growth, accountability, and excellence. Backed by leading investors like Google Ventures and Menlo Ventures, and trusted by industry leaders including Travelers, State Farm, and Nationwide — we’re redefining how people understand and interact with their spaces.

Why Hover wants you

At Hover, we're redefining how homeowners, contractors, and insurance professionals understand and improve properties. 

As we continue to grow, we're looking for a Content Marketing Manager to lead the development of compelling content and integrated campaigns that educate SMB construction businesses discovering and evaluating Hover.

This is an opportunity to build a modern content engine from the ground up. This role owns content strategy for our self-serve, product-led business and you'll be responsible for developing a high-impact content strategy that supports business priorities.

You'll partner closely with Product Marketing, Enterprise Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Design to bring our story to life through thoughtful, high-impact content that fuels awareness, engagement, and monetization.

You will contribute by

  • Own Hover's content marketing strategy across long-form and short-form content, including website pages, blogs, digital resources, thought leadership, product content, email, and campaign assets.
  • Develop integrated marketing campaigns and corresponding content calendar that supports strategic initiatives, product launches, seasonal programs, and revenue goals.
  • Create compelling content that speaks to contractors and other key audiences throughout the buyer journey.
  • Partner with Product Marketing to translate product capabilities into clear, customer-centric messaging and content.
  • Partner within the Growth Marketing team on experimentation and prioritization so content is built against the highest-impact areas.
  • Manage the end-to-end content production process—including creative briefs, stakeholder reviews, publishing, and performance measurement.
  • Produce and contribute to the execution of a variety of content formats, like website content, blog articles, webinars, original research and industry reports, guides and templates, video.
  • Analyze campaign and content performance to identify opportunities for optimization and continuously improve organic website traffic, content engagement, self-serve signups, feature utilization, and monetization.
  • Stay current on content marketing, AI-assisted content creation, and B2B storytelling trends, bringing new ideas and best practices to the team.

Your background includes

  • 4–6 years of experience in Content Marketing, Campaign Marketing, Demand Generation, or Growth Marketing.
  • Demonstrated success developing content-driven marketing campaigns across multiple channels.
  • Strong writing, editing, and storytelling skills with the ability to adapt messaging for different audiences.
  • Experience managing editorial calendars and leading content production from concept through publication.
  • Experience creating B2B marketing content, including blogs, content libraries, landing pages, email campaigns, and webinars.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously.
  • Experience measuring content performance and using data to improve campaign effectiveness.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Sales, Design, Customer Success, and Growth Marketing.
  • Excellent communication skills and strong attention to detail.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with HubSpot or another marketing automation platform.
  • Experience working at a high-growth B2B SaaS company.
  • Experience marketing to technical buyers or industries such as construction, insurance, real estate, or vertical SaaS.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted content creation tools and modern content workflows.
  • Basic understanding of SEO best practices and how content supports organic growth.

Benefits

  • Compensation - Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a fast-growing company
  • Healthcare - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and dependents
  • Paid Time Off - Unlimited and flexible vacation policy 
  • Paid Family Leave - We support work/life balance and offer generous paid parental and new child bonding leave 
  • Mandatory Self-Care Days - A day set aside each month to allow employees to recharge 
  • Remote Wellbeing Resources - We provide recurring fitness classes, meditation/ mindfulness tools, virtual therapy, and family planning assistance 
  • Learning - We encourage continued education and will help cover the cost of management training, conferences, workshops, or certifications

Hybrid roles at Hover

Hover has Hubs in San Francisco and New York City, where we expect that all employees living within a 50-mile radius of our offices will come into their local Hover office at least three times a week to build rapport and foster organic connection. At this time, Hover is not considering fully remote roles.

OVERVIEW

The Developer Experience team at Instacart is the force multiplier for our 1000+ engineers. We define and build the platforms, tools, and practices that enable Instacart engineers to ship high-quality software faster — from AI-powered code review to build infrastructure, developer onboarding, and local development environments. Our success is measured in developer velocity: how quickly an engineer can take an idea from concept to production.

As a Staff Software Engineer on Developer Experience, you will lead the technical direction for the developer infrastructure that every Instacart engineer relies on. That spans local and remote development environments, CI pipelines and the feedback loop on every commit, pre-production environments that engineers and AI agents can trust, version-control infrastructure, and the AI-powered developer tooling woven through all of it. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You'll write code, set architectural direction, and partner across the org to move engineering-wide metrics on developer velocity, CI reliability, and the time it takes to get a change safely into production.

About the Job

  • Lead the technical direction for Instacart's local and remote development environments, including ephemeral environments, image-based provisioning, health checks, and the developer-facing ergonomics of the inner development loop.
  • Lead the technical direction for our CI pipeline infrastructure and the commit-to-feedback loop, CI reliability, failure diagnostics, flaky-test reduction, and shift-left validation.
  • Own the architecture and evolution of our pre-production environments, including staging stability, service-owner accountability models, and environments that let engineers and AI agents validate changes end-to-end in parallel.
  • Drive the reliability and resilience of our git infrastructure, git operations at monorepo scale, and implement disaster recovery plans.
  • Advance AI-powered developer tooling across the workflow, AI-assisted code review, agentic development workflows, and the platforms that let engineers run many AI sessions in parallel with humans on the loop.
  • Design and drive multi-quarter initiatives that measurably improve developer velocity, CI reliability, pre-production health, and the local development loop.
  • Own the developer experience metrics for the systems you lead: define what "good" looks like, instrument it, and use the data to prioritize investment.
  • Partner with infrastructure, platform, and product engineering teams to roll out platform changes with minimal disruption
  • Set the technical bar for the systems you own on reliability, performance, upgrade cadence, and developer ergonomics.
  • Mentor engineers in the team and the broader engineering org; grow the community of developer infrastructure experts at Instacart.
  • Represent the team in cross-org technical discussions on local development experience, CI/CD, pre-production, and AI-augmented development.

About You

  • A hands-on technical leader who is equally comfortable in a CI pipeline definition, a design doc, a vision document, and a cross-org migration plan.
  • Metrics-driven. You use build times, CI failure rates, pre-production pass rates, feedback-loop latency, and developer feedback to guide where to invest.
  • A multiplier. You make the engineers around you more effective through mentorship, clear technical writing, and pragmatic guidance.
  • Comfortable driving cross-team change. You can build consensus for a migration or a platform shift and see it through to adoption.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of software development experience.
  • Deep, hands-on experience operating CI/CD systems at scale (e.g., Buildkite, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, CircleCI), including pipeline design, reliability, and performance tuning for large engineering organizations.
  • Experience building or operating local/remote development environments or developer platforms (e.g., ephemeral environments, dev containers, internal PaaS), with a point of view on the inner development loop.
  • Track record of leading cross-team technical initiatives with measurable impact on developer velocity, CI reliability, pre-production stability, or feedback-loop time.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), containerization (Docker), and orchestration (ECS/Kubernetes or equivalent).
  • Experience with large monorepos and the git infrastructure challenges that come with them.
  • Strong technical leadership: driving direction, mentoring engineers, and influencing without direct authority.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience owning or evolving a developer environment platform used by a large engineering org.
  • Experience stabilizing pre-production / staging environments at scale, including establishing service-owner accountability and SLAs.
  • Experience with AI-powered developer tooling — AI code review, agentic coding workflows, or platforms that run async agentic work for engineers.
  • Experience defining and instrumenting developer productivity metrics (CI failure rate, feedback-loop time, pre-production pass rate, local dev loop).
  • Experience at high-growth companies operating developer infrastructure for large engineering organizations.

Title: Technical Lead, Developer Experience
Description:
Our everyday digital experiences are in the midst of a realtime revolution. Whether chatting alongside a livestreaming event, receiving realtime financial information, or working with colleagues in an online collaborative environment - consumers simply expect realtime digital experiences as standard. At Ably we’re not just witnessing this revolution, we’re powering it - at scale.

At the heart of our mission lies a commitment to putting developers first. Ably provides a suite of products to build, extend, and deliver powerful digital experiences in realtime, delivering billions of messages for millions of devices every day and supporting organizations like Harness, EA, Panasonic and HubSpot.

Working at Ably means helping to build the infrastructure and technology that will power and shape the future of the internet. The opportunity in front of us is immense. And we’d like your help.

About this role

As the Technical Lead for Developer Experience at Ably you will report directly to our CTO and co-own the DevEx vision and strategy, transforming our dashboard, documentation platform, and control plane into a world-class experience. You are a senior, hands-on engineer who’s passionate about building for developers like yourself; someone who’ll obsess over the developer journey and elevate the user experience of the Ably platform.

You’ll blend deep full-stack expertise with a strong product mindset and lead a team of five engineers where the feedback loop is immediate, because you and your team are the target users of the very ecosystem you are building.

Day to day you will

  • Obsess over developer experience. You’ll have broad responsibility for elevating how developers interact with Ably’s platform and services, partnering with the DevEx PM as a unified leadership team to deliver a developer experience that becomes a reference point for the industry.
  • Lead technical execution and vision. You’ll lead a team of five engineers building customer-facing web applications and own the technical architecture and design decisions for our dashboard, docs platform, marketing website, and billing UI.
  • Drive a product-first engineering culture. You’ll foster an environment where engineers are themselves principal stakeholders of product features, and obsess over customer outcomes. You’ll challenge the "feature factory" mentality and build a team that takes true ownership of the product.
  • Thrive in a rapid iteration environment. You’ll operate in a high-velocity workspace where PMs, customers, and engineers co-create features. You’ll lead the team in working full-stack to iterate, improve, and ship improvements quickly.
  • Champion AI-assisted development. You’ll be a catalyst for AI adoption across the team. You’ll leverage LLMs and AI tools to accelerate velocity without compromising on engineering integrity.
  • Guide engineering outcomes and quality. You’ll set and enforce high standards for code review, testing, and production readiness. You will participate in incident response and coordinate with the Infrastructure team on platform dependencies and deployments.
  • Mentor and grow the team. You’ll manage performance, career development, and hiring. You will hold the team accountable for delivery commitments while providing the mentorship needed to turn engineers into product-minded leaders.

We'd love to talk if you have

  • A natural empathy for developer customers because you are the target audience. You are genuinely excited about building developer tools and instinctively understand what good looks like. You're fluent in API design, documentation, and the nuances that differentiate a great developer journey.
  • Extensive experience leading teams at B2B SaaS or API-first companies. You have a track record of building product-minded engineering cultures where teams take initiative and ownership of product outcomes.
  • A strong software engineering background with expertise in React, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript, alongside backend experience in Ruby on Rails or Node.js. You're comfortable writing code and building prototypes using our APIs, and have built and shipped customer-facing web applications at scale.
  • An AI-first mindset. You champion the use of  LLMs and AI tools as productivity multipliers for the team. You see AI as an enabler for higher velocity and output, not a replacement for engineering judgment.
  • Experience at a startup or growth-stage company or adaptability to thrive in a fast-paced, agile environment with a focus on rapid iteration. To be effective in this role you’ll need excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Bonus points if you have

  • Experience delivering solutions used by software developers (developer tooling or APIs) or similar technical personas.
  • An understanding of pub/sub and familiarity with distributed systems and event based architectures.

What’s it like to work at Ably?

We’re tackling planet-scale problems and our ambitions are a testament to that. You’ll join a successful, deeply motivated and collaborative team that thrives on innovation, experimentation and autonomy. To get a sense of life at Ably, visit our careers page. You can also read about the origins of Ably's core values on our blog.

We believe in fostering a culture that's built on inclusivity and mutual respect among all team members, and we recognise that each individual is different and will want to be supported in their role in different ways. We provide a range of perks and benefits to aid folks' development and wellbeing, allowing them to be their best selves and do great work.

  • A remote-first and flexible work environment. UK-based teams come together in person once per month in our London hub (next to Old Street) and we get together as a company twice per year. Aside from that, you’re welcome to work wherever suits best for you.
  • Equity. We’re a growing start-up and we want all team to members to share in the success of the company through our EMI share options programme.
  • Enhanced holiday allowance. Our policy provides Ablyans with 28 days of paid annual leave (27 regular days, plus a day off to enjoy your birthday).
  • Enhanced parental leave package, so that you can take the time you need to get to know your new family member, rest and recover.
  • Home workstation budget of £500 on joining (and £150 p/a thereafter), so that your home office is set up to serve you well and that you have everything you need to work comfortably.
  • Personal learning and development budget of £1000 annually, and 5% L&D time during working hours to focus on improving your skillset.
  • Private healthcare with BUPA.
  • Medical cash plan to cover a range medical and dental costs.
  • Mental wellbeing coaching and counselling from Self Space.
  • Monthly wellbeing budget via Juno.
  • Life assurance and income protection.
  • Access to Tech & Cycle to Work schemes.
  • Weekly snack allowance for our end-of-week “Need To Know” meeting.
  • A fully-paid one-month sabbatical after five years with Ably.

Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging at Ably

We believe our differences as individuals is what makes us great. Our people are at the heart of what we do, and we encourage everyone to be their most authentic self at Ably: we see inclusivity and openness as fundamental to creating long-term success as an organization. We encourage applications from all backgrounds regardless of age, disability, gender, sexual orientation, parental status, race, religion, educational background or neurodiversity. Ably has an amazing opportunity ahead of us, and we want anyone to be able to contribute to that opportunity.

If you enjoy working as part of a technology company, value open source, and love solving hard problems - then we’d love to hear from you, regardless of whether you fit the job description exactly or not. If in doubt, drop us an email; we’d be more than happy to give you some advice on your application.

Title: Digital Content Creator (Video + Articles)
Description:
Hey there!
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences. 

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right? 

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience? 

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

Meet the Team

Secret Media Network is a digital media group focused on recommending perfect plans, discovering great places, sharing things to do and relevant breaking news in different cities around the world. Our family is composed of Secret Chicago, Secret LA, Secret NYC, Secret Miami, Secret Toronto, Secret London, Paris Secret, Madrid Secreto, and more!

 

About You

We’re looking for a creative and versatile Digital Content Creator to join our team in Santiago Secreto. This role sits at the intersection of social-first video content and editorial storytelling, with a strong focus on creating engaging video formats while ensuring that content can be adapted into high-quality, well-structured written articles.
You’ll primarily work on social and video formats, but you’ll also play a key role in reviewing, editing, and publishing written content that is accurate, engaging, and SEO-friendly.

Your responsibilities
 
Video & Social Content:
  • Create engaging, original social-first video content about city life, tips, trends, and culture.
  • Post these videos on Instagram & Facebook, following each platform's best practices to drive strong performance. In the future, we may add TikTok.
  • Confidently write video scripts and adapt ideas for different social platforms, but also produce unscripted video formats.
  • Stay up to date with social media trends and experiment with formats that drive reach and engagement.
  • Appear on camera when required and conduct interviews where relevant.
  • Manage social media profiles to reach new audiences.
  • Use performance insights to optimize content strategy and maintain a balanced editorial mix across formats and campaigns.
Editorial & Writing
• Adapt high-quality editorial and commercial articles from video and social media posts, ensuring accuracy, SEO best practices, and alignment with editorial guidelines.
• Occasionally, write articles from scratch.

Preferred Skills
We are seeking a creative and proactive content professional who:
  • Has native-level Spanish and intermediate English for internal communication.
  • Has proven experience producing professional video content for social media, including scripting, editing, and storytelling (portfolio required) for at least two years.
  • Is confident with social publishing tools, highly organized, and able to manage deadlines independently while collaborating with a team.
  • Is passionate about city life, culture, food, entertainment, and experimenting with new content formats.
  • Is comfortable shooting video and photos with digital cameras (Sony Alpha, GoPro, iPhone) and editing with CapCut, Instagram Edits, Photoshop, and Media Encoder (After Effects & Premiere Pro are a plus).
  • Understands color correction, sound editing, SEO, and digital analytics.
  • Can conduct interviews, present on camera, and adapt content for maximum engagement across platforms.

 

Why You’ll Love It Here

  • Attractive compensation package with room to grow.
  • Opportunity to make a real impact in a high-growth global category leader.
  • Professional and personal growth from day one with real responsibility.
  • 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences + free Candlelight voucher.
  • Private health, life & dental insurance: Zurich coverage fully covered by Fever.
  • Wellhub membership for gym and wellness access: 100% covered by Fever up to the Silver plan.
  • Language learning support: English and Spanish lessons.
  • Dynamic international team: a young, talented group creating a great work environment.

Application Process

For the path forward, here's what to expect:

  • A video call interview with our Talent team
  • A 60 min psychometric online test
  • An interview with our SMN team
  • A video editing test to showcase your expertise and knowledge
  • A conversation with our management team to explore alignment and potential

Elevate Your Video Production Journey with Us: Apply Now!

Title: Senior Content Designer
Description:
About Us:

Moniepoint Group is a financial technology company digitizing Africa’s real economy by building a financial ecosystem for businesses, providing them with all the payment, banking, credit and business management tools they need to succeed. At Moniepoint, we are a customer-focused community, dedicated to crafting solutions that redefine our industry. We have several products that provide essential services for businesses such as credit, overdrafts, bank integration, payment gateway, etc. We leverage artificial intelligence and data to make our decisions, but also have the technology and data-driven best practices used to support our businesses.

About this role:

As a Senior Content Designer, you take ownership of the quality and strategic direction of content across your squad or product area. You bring expert content design judgment, deep user insight, and a collaborative mindset to shape product experiences that are clear, inclusive, and emotionally engaging. You support junior content designers, influence cross-team content strategy, and play a vital role in driving alignment across product, design, and engineering. You display an exceptional grasp of design thinking and content design expertise and are comfortable delivering well-thought out ideas to senior stakeholders and driving content design strategy each day. 

What you’ll do 

  • You are responsible for end-to-end content design strategy and execution on a project, from discovery through delivery, launch, and ongoing iteration.
  • Partnering closely with product managers, product designers, and engineers to embed content strategy in product discovery and delivery, shaping scope, trade-offs, and sequencing.
  • Define for exceptional, accessible, and inclusive content that builds trust, clarity, and meaningful user engagement.
  • Comfortable wireframing and prototyping and delivering your work in Figma, with clear rationale, adhering to a design systems and content design principles.
  • Define content design strategy that aligns with business objectives and technical feasibility, ensuring content is not just clear but emotionally intelligent and on brand.
  • Craft high-quality content for complex product flows, interface text, microcopy, error messaging, help content, and documentation, setting the bar for tone, clarity, and consistency.
  • Take a strong role in qualitative and quantitative research methods (user interviews, usability tests, A/B experiments, content audits, analytics) using insight as a core design input.
  • Collaborate deeply, proactively shaping product direction, surfacing trade-offs, and influencing delivery approaches.
  • Drive the evolution of content design style guides, working closely with brand, marketing, and communications teams.
  • Design thoughtful content that enhances usability, emotional impact, and user satisfaction.
  • Balance speed and rigour with strong judgment on when to ship versus polish, especially on complex or fast-moving environments.
  • Support junior content designers on the team and supports in terms of stakeholder management. 
  • Lead alignment and collaboration across teams and stakeholders, clearly communicating content design rationale and facilitating strategic working sessions.
  • Set a high standard for product teams, fostering a culture of sound content design practices, constructive feedback, and shared accountability.
  • You are able to justify content design decisions to senior stakeholders with clear rationale and delivers work in a standardised format that you help to evolve. You are able to deliver multiple variations, informed by insights and can confidently explain the pros and cons of particular solutions.

What you need to succeed

  • 5+ years of experience working as a content designer. 
  • You are incredibly comfortable with the design aspect of content design – understanding this role is deeper than 'just words'.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills are a must for this role. 
  • You must be able to work in a fast-changing environment where processes are still being defined. 
  • Exceptional knowledge of content design principles and end-to-end product thinking. 
  • Experience with A/B testing, UX metrics, and data interpretation and the ability to drive your own research initiatives. 
  • Exceptional product intuition - understanding user needs, business constraints, and technical feasibility.
  • Good knowledge of Figma - how to collaborate, create prototypes, and work to produce agile solutions quickly, with little to no help. 
  • Experience using AI a plus. Great if you’ve built workflows/tools using AI. 
  • Excellent knowledge of working in cross-functional teams. Able to advocate for content design across various company areas and embed content design early in product planning. 
  • Actively contributes to a content design system, creating reusable patterns and components  
  • Experience in fintech or SaaS environments is a strong advantage.
  • Strong communication skills - able to explain the “why” behind your decisions 
  • Strong stakeholder management is a must for this role 

Recruitment Process

  • Application & portfolio review - we’re looking for exceptional content design case studies, showing examples of end-to-end product thinking, driven by research and illustrating impact. 
  • Recruiter conversation - light intro on your background, team experience, and motivations.
  • Leadership interview - deep dive into your skills and expertise with the lead content designer. 
  • Content design task and portfolio presentation - a short task to assess how you approach content design and you’ll present a case study from your portfolio

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

Title: Content & Communications Strategist
Description:
About us

Re-architecting Engineering for the Age of Intelligence

PhysicsX is the physics AI company for industrials. The company’s mission is to accelerate hardware innovation by overhauling what industrial engineering and manufacturing look like today. PhysicsX is building a new simulation software stack to deliver deep physics AI enablement across the entire engineering lifecycle. The company partners with leading organisations in aerospace & defence, automotive, semiconductors, materials, and energy & renewables, supporting them on some of their most critical and complex challenges. PhysicsX is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with offices in London, New York, and Singapore and an expanding presence in the Bay Area.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Content & Communications Strategist to join our Marketing & Communications team, reporting directly to the Head of Marketing & Communications. This is a rare opportunity to help shape the public voice of a fast-scaling, deeply technical company operating at the frontier of engineering and AI.

In this role, you’ll translate complex, high-value work into clear, compelling narratives across every channel where PX shows up — the website, social platforms, events, executive stages, partner channels, and internally. You’ll collaborate closely with engineers, product leaders, partner teams, leadership, and designers to turn our work into stories that build credibility, attract talent, and deepen customer engagement and confidence.

We're looking for someone who thrives at the intersection of storytelling, creative execution, and strategic alignment. You will operate as a core part of PX’s comms engine, helping build a scalable content operation and raising the creative bar across everything we publish.

We operate in a fast-moving, high-stakes environment where priorities can shift quickly and the path isn’t always linear. As we grow the team, you’ll be one of the core operators driving content delivery — which means real ownership, real impact, and real learning. If you thrive under pressure, enjoy solving problems on the fly, and like stretching beyond your comfort zone, you’ll feel at home at PX.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with the Head of Marketing & Communications to develop and maintain a unified editorial calendar across blog, website, social, events, and PR moments.
  • Write and edit high-quality content — blog posts, web pages, one-pagers, long-form thought leadership, scripts, and event materials — that reflects PX’s tone of voice and raises the signal across all channels.
  • Support the development of messaging and materials for executive and technical speaking engagements.
  • Lead PX’s voice on LinkedIn and Instagram, sourcing content, shaping narratives, and publishing a consistent drumbeat of high-signal updates, helping amplify key moments across product, platform, partnerships, and talent.
  • Ensure stylistic consistency and creative excellence across all digital touchpoints.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and external agencies on the creation of video content — storyboarding, scripting, production, and review.
  • Support internal communications and employer brand storytelling (#comms announcements, people-related updates, talent events, and recruiting content).
  • Partner with Talent to support employer brand storytelling, creating compelling content that attracts world-class engineers and researchers.
  • Work with partner organizations to produce and amplify joint content, case studies, and announcements.
  • Uphold and evolve PX’s tone of voice and editorial standards across all communications.
  • Track performance through comprehensive dashboards, gather qualitative and quantitative insights, and continuously refine what great looks like.

What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

  • Develop a PX-specific content strategy grounded in our positioning, technical domain, and target audiences, with clear priorities, themes, and a structured editorial plan.
  • Publish 4-6 high-quality blog posts that meet PX editorial standards (clear thesis, strong narrative, technically grounded, visually supported), supported by short-form video content for social amplification.
  • Own and maintain a clean, reliable editorial calendar used by the wider team.
  • Deliver event and executive materials end-to-end (slides, talking points, social), ensuring they're on-brand and engaging.
  • Build strong working relationships with engineers and technical stakeholders, proactively sourcing stories and insights.
  • Demonstrate clear understanding of PX’s positioning, customers, competitors, and technical domain.

About You

  • 5-6 years of experience in communications, marketing, or editorial roles (agency or in-house), ideally within B2B tech, AI, engineering, or deep-tech environments.
  • Exceptional writer and editor with the ability to distill technical concepts into accessible, incisive stories.
  • Strong narrative and tone of voice instincts — you know what makes a story compelling and how to adapt it for different audiences and formats, while staying true to the company/stakeholder tone of voice.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with engineers, designers, technical leaders, and commercial teams.
  • High-agency, proactive, and comfortable with ambiguity; you can drive projects forward with minimal oversight.
  • Strong judgment and discretion, able to handle sensitive information and high-stakes content.
  • You operate with high ownership and motivation — you don’t wait to be told what to do.
  • You don't compromise on quality or level of attention to detail, regardless of the format you're working with.
  • You are comfortable working at pace and flexing when needed.
  • You are excited to engage deeply with technical material, not just simplify it.
  • You can develop PX-specific content strategy grounded in our technical domain, customers, and positioning — not templated frameworks.
  • You demonstrate editorial judgment: identifying what’s new, what’s redundant, and what’s worth saying.

Bonus Points

  • Experience supporting executives with talks, presentations, and event materials.
  • Familiarity with visual design workflows (Figma, Adobe Suite) or working closely with design teams/agencies.
  • Experience working with or around video production.

This role is the right fit if:

  • You do your best work when you have ownership and room to shape things, rather than waiting for a fully formed brief.
  • You're genuinely comfortable — maybe even energized — by complex technical subject matter, and you know how to get up to speed fast.
  • You use AI as a tool to streamline projects and sharpen your thinking, not as a substitute for it.
  • You're flexible about how and when you work, and you take deadlines seriously.
  • You hold yourself to a high standard and actively look for ways to raise the bar on your own output.

What We Offer

Build what actually matters

Help shape an AI-native engineering company at a formative stage, tackling problems that genuinely matter for industry and society. This is work with real-world impact - and something you can be proud to stand behind.

Learn alongside exceptional people

Work with a high-caliber, collaborative team of engineers, scientists, and operators who care deeply about doing great work, and about helping each other get better. We come from diverse backgrounds, but we share a commitment to operating at the highest level and addressing some of the most complex challenges out there. If you’re ambitious, thoughtful, and driven by impact, you’ll feel at home.

Influence over hierarchy

We operate with a flat structure: good ideas win - wherever they come from. Questioning assumptions and challenging the status quo isn’t just welcomed, it’s expected.

Sustainable pace, long-term ambition

Building meaningful technology is a marathon, not a sprint. We believe in balancing focused, ambitious work with a life beyond it. Our hybrid model blends time together in our Shoreditch office with work-from-home days, giving you the flexibility to work sustainably while staying connected in person.

And it doesn’t stop there …

🚀 Equity options - share meaningfully in the company you’re helping to build.

🏦 10% employer pension contribution - because investing in future matters.

🍽️ Free office lunches - to keep you energised and focused.

👶 Enhanced parental leave - 3 months full pay paternity and 6 months full pay maternity leave, to provide extra flexibility during the moments that matter most.

🍼 YellowNest nursery scheme - to help working parents manage childcare costs.

☀️ 25 days of Annual Leave (+ Public Holidays) - because taking time to rest matters.

🏥 Private medical insurance - 100% employee cover, giving you complete peace of mind.

💪 Wellhub Subscription - gain access to thousands of gyms, classes and wellness apps, supporting both physical and mental wellbeing.

👀 Eye tests - because good work depends on good health.

📈 Personal development - dedicated support for learning, development, and leveling up over time.

💛 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) - confidential wellbeing support, available whenever you need it.

🚲 Bike2Work scheme and 🚆 Season ticket loan - to make getting to work easier and greener.

🚗 Octopus EV salary sacrifice - for a simpler, more sustainable way to drive electric.

🔎 Watch this space, we’re continuing to build this as we grow…

To help make a change, we sponsor bright women from disadvantaged backgrounds through their university degrees in science and mathematics.

Title: People Governance and Compliance Manager (m/f/d)
Description:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

The People Solutions team serves as the strategic engine room of Raisin’s People & Culture team by building a secure, data-driven, and compliant infrastructure that scales the organization. By bridging the gap between strategy and technology, the team optimizes HRIS systems to eliminate manual work, leverages analytics and AI to drive smarter business decisions, and acts as a compliance anchor managing audits, policies, and risk.


Your Responsibilities

  • You establish People policy and process standards by authoring, reviewing, and maintaining the global and local People policy frameworks, ensuring all documentation is logical, accessible, and structured according to company standards.
  • You look after AI-readiness and ethical governance in the People domain by reviewing existing policies and processes to ensure they are compliant with emerging AI regulations, address corresponding risks, and protect employee data privacy.
  • You partner with the wider People Solutions team to ensure that automated People processes and AI-driven tools have clear human-in-the-loop overrides and ethical safeguards.
  • You design, implement, and maintain a Risk and Controls Framework specifically for People processes that is in alignment with Raisin’s global compliance framework.
  • You track upcoming changes in employment law, data protection (e.g., GDPR, local privacy laws), and AI regulations and proactively update policies and process accordingly before they take effect.
  • You align closely with the People and Culture leadership and conduct regular spot-checks and internal mini-audits to ensure teams are executing People processes strictly according to documented standards.
  • You serve as the primary point of contact for all internal, external, and third-party People audits and governance-related reporting requests.
  • You manage and fulfill documentation requests from external supervisory bodies, labor ministries, and regulatory agencies.
  • You design and oversee in close collaboration with Raisin’s People and Culture leadership the implementation of Corrective Action Plans (CAPs) across the broader People team if audit gaps are identified.

Your Profile

  • You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Psychology,  Business Administration, Legal Studies, or a related field.
  • You have 5+ years of progressive experience in Human Resources, with at least 2–3 years focused explicitly on HR Compliance, HR Audit, or People Operations Governance.
  • You have strong People domain knowledge incl. People processes across the employee lifecycle.
  • You have direct experience drafting, structuring, and maintaining comprehensive HR policies, employee handbooks, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  • You have a deep understanding of regional employment standards, labor laws, and strict data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR) as well as strong foundational knowledge of emerging frameworks impacting HR technology, such as the EU AI Act.
  • You have strong communication skills and you feel comfortable collaborating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • You have the ability to "speak tech" and understand how data flows through an HRIS.
  • You have the ability to act as a bridge between rigid legal/audit teams and fast-moving People teams without causing friction.
  • You have a strong focus on data integrity, semantic clarity in documentation, and spotting subtle gaps in process controls.
  • You are fluent in English. Additionally, professional working proficiency in German is required to interpret local labor laws.

Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us!

At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.

As part of our team, you will benefit from:

  • Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year.
  • Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days.
  • A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%.
  • Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidize your membership with more than €20 per month. 
  • Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidize with €25 per month.
  • Love cycling? With JobRad, lease the bike of your choice and enjoy tax savings, plus Raisin covers your monthly insurance costs.
  • Hungry all the time? Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office.
  • You are moving from another country or city to join us? We may support your relocation.

Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy

We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.
