Title: Senior Data Governance & Responsible AI Lead
Description:
About Sand

Sand Technologies is a global Physical AI company using data and AI to make critical industries work better. We partner with governments, cities and enterprises to improve how essential systems operate across healthcare, water, energy, telecommunications and infrastructure.

Our work delivers proven real-world impact. We have built AI systems that help manage London’s water supply, supported telecom network planning across hundreds of cities, and developed digital healthcare platforms serving tens of millions of people across Africa. From intelligent command centers to AI-powered infrastructure platforms, we help organizations sense, analyze and act in complex environments.

Our people are ambitious, curious and relentlessly practical. Our teams work alongside clients in the field, solving hard problems and deploying solutions that last. With colleagues across Africa, Europe, the UK and the US, we operate across the full stack - from research and engineering to deployment and capability building.

Our mission is simple: to harness AI to solve humanity’s most pressing challenges.

About the role

Sand Technologies is seeking a Senior Data Governance & Responsible AI Lead to establish and operationalize the governance foundation for the Baltimore Intelligence Center. This role is critical to ensuring the city’s data and AI ecosystem is governed with clear ownership, trusted metrics, operational controls, visible lineage, responsible AI practices, and production-ready governance processes.

The successful candidate will lead governance implementation across the BIC program, working closely with city leadership, BCIT/security, legal stakeholders, platform engineering, data engineering, product teams, and agency data owners.

This is a hands-on leadership role focused on operationalizing governance — not simply defining policy. The role will be responsible for establishing governance workflows, stewardship practices, AI governance processes, metadata standards, KPI governance routines, auditability controls, and governance reporting required to support production intelligence products and long-term city ownership.

What you’ll do

Lead Operational Data Governance

  • Lead implementation and operationalization of the BIC governance framework across data, analytics, and AI products.
  • Establish governance workflows for data ownership, stewardship, approvals, escalation paths, and auditability.
  • Ensure governance processes are embedded into day-to-day delivery and operational decision-making.
  • Coordinate governance activities across city agencies, OPI leadership, and delivery teams.

Govern Source-System Readiness & Stewardship

  • Lead governance readiness processes for datasets entering the BIC platform.
  • Ensure priority datasets have named owners and stewards, approved access pathways, documented refresh cadences, lineage visibility, quality expectations, and operational governance controls prior to production use.
  • Partner with agency stakeholders and technical teams to resolve governance and operational readiness gaps.

Lead Metadata, Catalog & Lineage Governance

  • Establish governance standards for metadata, lineage, business glossary, and catalog completeness.
  • Support operational governance of enterprise metadata capabilities and data catalog processes.
  • Ensure lineage and ownership are visible across source systems, platform layers, semantic assets, and intelligence products.
  • Partner with engineering teams to improve transparency, traceability, and trust in the city’s data ecosystem.

Own KPI & Semantic Governance Processes

  • Lead governance processes for KPI definitions, semantic consistency, and business metric approval.
  • Ensure intelligence products use standardized and approved definitions across domains and agencies.
  • Partner with analytics, semantic-layer, and product teams to operationalize governance of business logic and reporting standards.
  • Ensure production KPIs are documented, reviewed, governed, and aligned to approved definitions.

Operationalize Responsible AI Governance

  • Lead governance workflows for AI-enabled use cases and intelligence products.
  • Manage governance processes including use-case intake, risk tiering, privacy and security review coordination, human-in-the-loop controls, logging and traceability expectations, and post-launch governance monitoring.
  • Help ensure AI-enabled products are governed with appropriate transparency, oversight, and operational controls.

Lead Governance Reporting, Quality & Audit Readiness

  • Establish governance reporting, operational scorecards, and governance review routines.
  • Partner with technical teams to define governance expectations for data quality, monitoring, and issue escalation.
  • Ensure governance processes support auditability, inspectability, and public-sector accountability requirements.
  • Support governance reviews for public-facing or operationally sensitive intelligence products.

Drive Capability Transfer & Sustainability

  • Develop governance playbooks, templates, SOPs, and operational documentation.
  • Partner with OPI staff to transition governance capabilities into sustainable city operations.
  • Help establish long-term governance routines that can operate independently following the initial implementation period.

Who you are

  • 8+ years of experience in data governance, information governance, analytics governance, enterprise data management, or related leadership roles.
  • Proven experience operationalizing governance in complex, cross-functional environments.
  • Strong knowledge of data ownership and stewardship, metadata and lineage, governance operating models, data quality, auditability, and governance controls.
  • Experience working with cloud-based data and analytics platforms.
  • Ability to work effectively across technical teams, business stakeholders, legal/security partners, and executive leadership.
  • Strong facilitation, stakeholder management, communication, and documentation skills.

Preferred experience

  • Experience in government, civic technology, public-sector, healthcare, infrastructure, transportation, or other regulated environments.
  • Experience with responsible AI governance, AI-enabled operational systems, or AI risk management practices.
  • Familiarity with metadata and catalog platforms such as OpenMetadata, Purview, Collibra, Alation, or similar technologies.
  • Working familiarity with governance and regulatory frameworks such as NIST, CJIS, HIPAA, SOC 2, or FedRAMP-related environments.
  • Experience supporting KPI governance, semantic governance, business glossary management, or enterprise reporting standards.

What Success looks like

Success in this role includes establishing governance practices that are operational, scalable, and sustainable across the Baltimore Intelligence Center.

By the end of the initial engagement, the program should have:

  • Operational governance processes embedded into delivery workflows.
  • Named ownership and stewardship for priority datasets.
  • Governed KPI and semantic review processes.
  • Operational AI governance and risk review workflows.
  • Visible metadata and lineage standards.
  • Governance scorecards and reporting routines.
  • Governance practices that city teams can sustain independently over time.

How we work

Due to the highly collaborative and internationally distributed nature of our work, successful candidates must be comfortable operating in small teams while contributing to larger, globally coordinated efforts. A strong sense of ownership, self-motivation and discipline in maintaining clear and consistent communication through virtual collaboration tools and video conferencing is essential.

Title: Marketing Specialist - Social Media & Content Creator
Description:
Ever imagined saying, “I helped launch the future of transportation”?

We’re rewriting the rules of urban mobility. At Vay, customers tap a button and a car arrives - with no one inside - powered by our world-first Remote Driving technology on real public streets.

We’re live in Las Vegas and scaling fast, powered by a strategic investment of up to $410 million from Grab. Our mission is simple: replace private car ownership with a faster, cleaner, door-to-door mobility model. If you want to build something real, visible, and genuinely transformative, you’ll feel right at home here.

Curious to experience Vay yourself? Use the code VAYCANDIDATE for $10 off your first trip in Las Vegas! Download the "Vay" app from the Apple or Google Play store & off you go! 

What’s happening at Vay

  • First to roll out vehicles in both Europe and the USA on public roads without a human being inside & currently the 2nd largest commercial, driverless car fleet in the Western World.
  • We've partnered with Kodiak to bring remote-driving technology to autonomous trucks in the US, showcasing our ability to integrate our system into heavy-duty commercial vehicles and expand the applications of our tech across the US.
  • We’ve completed 10’s of thousands of trips so far and are busy multiplying our Las Vegas fleet just to meet demand!
  • ...And soon we’ll be expanding across the US & Europe 🚀

At Vay, we're bringing remote driving to the real world — a genuinely new way to move that puts a professional driver safely in control of a car from afar. It's a bold idea, and telling that story well is one of the most powerful things we can do to earn public trust and grow.

That's where you come in. We're looking for a rare "player-coach" who can both set the direction of our social presence and roll up their sleeves to create the work — a hybrid of social strategist, graphic designer, and content creator in one person. You'll own our channels end-to-end: shaping strategy and the content calendar across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube/Shorts, and X; defining our voice and visual identity; and personally shooting, designing, writing, and shipping high-quality content — including on-site with our fleet in Las Vegas.

Social isn't a side channel for us — it's one of our most scalable ways to educate the public on remote driving and turn curiosity into app installs and rides. As we scale past 100K+ trips and expand our service, you'll be the single owner making sure our story is told consistently, on-brand, and at the quality our product deserves.

You're senior enough to lead the vision, and hands-on enough to make it real yourself.

What you’ll be driving

You’ll be the dedicated owner of Vay’s social and content strategy, combining creative direction with hands-on production:

  • Social strategy & direction: Own the social strategy, channel mix, and content calendar across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube/Shorts; define our voice and positioning; set growth targets for reach, engagement, and install/ride referrals.
  • Graphic design & motion: Produce on-brand graphics, motion, and templates for social, campaigns, and the app store, maintaining a consistent visual identity across everything we publish.
  • Content creation: Plan, shoot, and edit short-form video and photography — including on-site with the fleet in Las Vegas — and write copy that turns the remote-driving story into clear, engaging content.
  • Creative enablement & video production: Raise the creative-quality bar across the company, support video production for other teams, and enable content for additional platforms such as LinkedIn and X by partnering with the teams that own them.
  • Community management: Monitor, manage, and respond to social inboxes and comments daily.
  • Measurement & iteration: Track performance, report on organic acquisition impact, and double down on the formats that work.

What are we looking for

We’re looking for a hands-on creative who can set strategy and ship the work themselves:

  • 3+ years of relevant experience in social media and content creation, spanning both video and static formats.
  • Proven ability to plan, shoot, and edit short-form video and photography for social.
  • Strong design skills producing on-brand graphics, motion, and templates (portfolio required).
  • Experience owning social strategy, channel mix, and a content calendar across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube/Shorts.
  • Ability to translate complex or technical concepts into clear, engaging copy.
  • Comfortable raising the creative bar and supporting other teams’ video and content, not just producing your own.
  • Comfortable owning daily social inbox and comment engagement.
  • A measurement mindset — you track reach and engagement and tie content back to acquisition impact.

Nice to have

  • Experience marketing a category-defining, trust-sensitive product (mobility, AV, hardware, or similar).
  • A track record of growing an organic following from an early stage.
  • Comfortable being on camera and directing shoots on-site with a fleet.

Why choose Vay

💪A global team of smart, motivated people from 30+ countries who love tackling hard problems and turning bold ideas into reality.

🌍 Huge scope for impact in a fast paced environment

💰 ESOP stock options: A stake in Vay’s future - not just a salary.

🌴 FlexiblePaid Vacation Days

🎫 401(k) programme

🏥 Health, Dental & Vision Insurance 

🚗 All Vay team members receive 30% off their Vay rides

🏋️‍♂️ Wellness Hub free gym access & wellness app subscriptions

🛍️ Exclusive external discounts

✈️ Relocation financial assistance when relocating to Las Vegas 

🎊 Regular team events throughout the year

 

For more information on Vay’s physical demands, working environments and safety requirements, you can review this link. We’ll also cover anything specific to this role during the first interview.

We’d love to stay connected for future opportunities, so feel free to include your LinkedIn profile when you apply.

We welcome applications from all backgrounds and experiences. If you’re excited about shaping something truly groundbreaking, we’d be happy to hear from you.

Title: Talent Growth & Inclusion Program Manager (REMOTE WEST COAST)
Description:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

About the role 

The Talent Growth & Inclusion Program Manager sits at the center of how Veeam defines, communicates, and enables career growth. Working alongside the Senior Manager, Talent Growth & Inclusion, you'll build the career architecture that tells team members what good looks like at every level and run the two performance cycles each year where those expectations get put to work. 

This is a builder role. You'll create structure where there's ambiguity, then make that structure land: in Workday, in manager conversations, and in how people make real decisions about their careers. You'll operate with autonomy, bringing higher-impact decisions to your manager and setting your own path on the rest. 

What you'll do 

Career architecture (the anchor) 

  • Design and maintain career paths across all 150 career tracks — critical skills, behavioral expectations, and progression criteria at each level — making independent calls within an established framework and escalating only what genuinely needs it. 
  • Build durable relationships with subject matter experts across functions, and establish the governance rhythms that keep career content accurate as the business changes. 
  • Partner across People & Culture so career architecture actively feeds Recruiting, Onboarding, Performance & Feedback, Mobility, Workforce Planning, and Rewards — spotting the gaps and proposing solutions without waiting to be asked. 
  • Drive the operational buildout of internal mobility: process documentation, stakeholder enablement, and a continuous improvement cadence built on real feedback. 
  • Advise stakeholders on how career design decisions affect equitable outcomes across populations, functions, and regions. 

Performance cycle program management 

  • Project manage Veeam's twice-annual performance review cycles end to end — timeline, dependencies, readiness gates, escalation paths, and post-cycle retrospective. 
  • Rally a diverse group of collaborators (HRBPs, Rewards, HRIS, Comms, regional leads) around a single plan, and hold the plan when priorities compete. 
  • Refine and launch cycle communications and manager enablement, iterating each cycle based on completion data, quality signals, and participant feedback. 

Change strategy, communications, and technology enablement 

  • Design communications, resources, and enablement that change how team members and managers think about career and performance tools — not just how they click through them. 
  • Support the Workday configuration story for career and performance: partner with HRIS/IT on design, configuration, testing, and adoption; identify opportunities to streamline workflows and apply AI capabilities to reduce manual effort. 
  • Translate program data into insights and recommendations — surface trends, challenge assumptions, and propose the improvement rather than reporting the number. 

What you'll bring 

  • Experience in talent management, performance management, HR, or organizational development, including ownership of a recurring cyclical program
  • Proven ability to run complex, interdependent workstreams independently and deliver in ambiguity with minimal supervision
  • Hands-on Workday experience; configuration or testing exposure in Talent or Performance modules strongly preferred
  • Strong communicator who creates clarity in complex discussions and influences without authority across functions, levels, and regions
  • Track record of driving outcomes through partnership, not just coordination — you build the coalition, then deliver through it
  • Analytical mindset: comfortable interpreting program data, and using AI tools to sharpen the analysis
  • Growth mindset and genuine curiosity about emerging technology — you challenge the status quo and adapt the plan when conditions shift, without dropping quality
  • Willingness to mentor and share knowledge with junior colleagues on the team

Title: Senior Technical Program Manager
Description:
Who We Are

Founded in 2005, 2K Games is a global video game company, publishing titles developed by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Our studios responsible for developing 2K's portfolio of world-class games across multiple platforms, include Visual Concepts, Firaxis, Hangar 13, CatDaddy, Cloud Chamber, and HB Studios. Our portfolio of titles is expanding due to our global strategic plan, building and acquiring exciting studios whose content continues to inspire all of us! 2K publishes titles in today's most popular gaming genres, including sports, shooters, action, role-playing, strategy, casual, and family entertainment.

Our team of engineers, marketers, artists, writers, data scientists, producers, thinkers and doers, are the professional publishing stewards of our growing library of critically-acclaimed franchises such as NBA 2K, Battleborn, BioShock, Borderlands, The Darkness, Mafia, Sid Meier's Civilization, WWE 2K, and XCOM.

At 2K, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment, which means encouraging our teams to Come as You Are and do your best work! We are dedicated to diversity and inclusion, and want our community of candidates to reflect this commitment. We encourage all qualified applicants to explore our global positions.

2K is headquartered in Novato, California and is a wholly owned label of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ: TTWO).

What We Need:

2K Publishing Tech delivers innovative solutions to our studios and supports all of their technology needs to ensure they can focus on building incredible games. The Senior Technical Program Manager will need to apply their experience and skillset across a variety of roles including project and program management, change management, process documentation and improvement, business requirements definition, tracking schedules, action items, forging strong relationships across the business and most importantly, is experienced with influencing and driving consensus with stakeholders and other team members. They need the interpersonal and organizational skills to navigate our complex and fast-paced environment and have an absolute passion for getting things done.

What You Will Do:

  • Lead Technology engagement with selected 2K studios to Facilitate adoption of Technology shared services and platforms
  • Advocate on behalf of studios for new features and capabilities
  • Communicate updates related to requested features integration
  • Liaise between multiple 2K departments including Studios, Analytics, Global Services, Commercial, and Marketing to ensure requirements are met holistically
  • Establish, maintain, and drive delivery against multiple program and project schedules
  • Tracking all project/program in your purview
  • Partner with team to establish a development timeline
  • Assist with forecasting and scoping tasks
  • Delegate work to Scrum Masters, other Technical Program Managers, and Technical Project Coordinators as needed
  • Partner with IT leads to identify, document, and communicate project / program scope, schedule, risks, and issues
  • Establish and drive successful studio deployments by reviewing test plans and scheduling demos as necessary
  • Proactively identify, track and drive resolution of blocking issues and non-engineering action items
  • Establish, maintain and drive consumption of a high-level project status dashboards and reporting for each Studio assigned
  • Establish and lead regular partner syncs
  • Transition projects into run state and handoff to appropriate team

Who We Believe Will Be A Phenomenal Fit:

You are passionate about technology and you are excited about bringing cutting-edge capabilities to empower studios to make incredible game experiences for consumers. You understand what it means to bring organization in a fast-paced environment that is minimally disruptive. You are interested in exploring opportunities to apply technology to address opportunities in the area of video game backend services, digital sales, marketing, and distribution. You consider excellence in communication to be one of, if not your strongest asset across all mediums.

  • 5+ years in technical program management, technical production, or engineering leadership, ideally including game development and live-service operations
  • Hands-on infrastructure experience across on-premise and cloud environments
  • Video game development knowledge; shipped one or two AAA titles a plus
  • Demonstrated end-to-end program ownership, inception through launch to run-state
  • Proven ability to influence department leaders and drive consensus up, down, and across organizational lines
  • Agile experience a plus
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, Google Suite

Title: Adult Day Program Manager
Description:
AbilityPath is hiring an Adult Day Program Manager

Are you passionate about supporting adults with developmental disabilities to thrive, build skills, and create meaningful pathways to employment and community inclusion?

JOIN OUR TEAM to lead program operations and inspire staff in delivering high-quality adult and employment services.

Compensation: $70,000–$78,000 annually (based on education and experience)

Schedule: Full-time, Monday – Friday

WHAT WE OFFER – Employee Benefits:

At AbilityPath, we support career development, employee wellness, and recognition.

  • 4 weeks of PTO

  • 10 paid holidays

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits upon hire

  • 401(k) plan with employer match

  • Performance bonuses

  • Educational reimbursement for ongoing professional development

WHO WE ARE:

AbilityPath is a non-profit organization that provides a lifespan of services for people with intellectual and developmental disabilities. Our mission is to accept, respect, and include people of all abilities. We are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) learning and building a community where all people can thrive.

ABOUT THE ROLE – What We Value:

As an Adult Day Program Manager, you will provide operational oversight and supervision of program staff while ensuring high-quality adult and employment services.

  • Leadership & Supervision: Hire, train, and supervise program staff, ensuring effective performance and professional growth.

  • Program Quality: Align program design with strategic goals, Employment First principles, and best practices in vocational and human services.

  • Case Management & Compliance: Oversee person-centered planning, documentation, case management, and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.

  • Participant & Family Support: Build meaningful family relationships, guide intake activities, and support participants in achieving success in program trials and transitions.

  • Behavioral Support: Train staff on modifications, develop behavioral plans, and increase participant engagement.

  • Operations Management: Monitor staff ratios, manage budgets, track outcomes, oversee facility needs, and support safety and cleanliness.

  • Community Engagement: Coordinate vocational and volunteer opportunities, and transport participants to community activities as needed.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • B.A. or M.A. in a relevant field

  • Minimum 2 years of program and staff supervision experience, serving adults with developmental disabilities

  • Strong skills in leadership, communication, and family engagement

  • Ability to manage program budgets, reporting, and compliance

  • Commitment to inclusion and supporting individuals of all abilities

HIRING REQUIREMENTS:

  • Valid California Driver’s License with 3 years clean driving record (if applicable)

  • Proof of negative TB test

  • Verification of physical clearance

  • Passing a criminal fingerprint clearance

  • 21 years of age for driving positions; 18 years or older otherwise

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Ability to lift/support at least 40 lbs. as needed

  • Sit, stand, stoop, and bend frequently

  • Walk for extended periods, supporting adults on community outings

  • Drive company vehicles to transport participants

Title: Technical Program Manager
Description:
Back in 2012, we were a group of engineers and designers who decided we wanted to build things, so we did. Able started as an engineering and product hub building for a portfolio of early-stage startups. We built many relationships while developing products that were thoughtful, effective, and genuinely useful. But, since then, we’ve grown… and so has our ambition. 

Now, we’re entering our next chapter, defined by applied AI. AI is a powerful force in the end-to-end software development cycle, and we’re creating practices that allow us to deliver software fast and more effectively than traditional approaches, creating meaningful value for our partners. Today, our builder mindset is driving us to become an AI-native organization across every function. We’re still evolving, and that’s part of the opportunity. If you want to build, learn, and tackle challenges alongside an ambitious team, let’s build together.

This position is 100% remote within LatAm.

About the Role

As a Technical Program Manager at Able, you'll drive the execution of AI and software programs across engineering, product, and partner teams. You'll keep work moving — owning timelines, dependencies, and communication for one or more programs — while working closely with senior TPMs and the hiring manager on the harder tradeoff calls. This is a technical role: you should be comfortable following a system design discussion, understanding the dependencies between services and teams, and asking the right questions when an estimate or integration doesn't line up. You don't need to architect the system yourself, but you do need to understand enough of how it's built to keep delivery on track and spot risk early.

You'll thrive here if you're organized, proactive, comfortable with ambiguity, and eager to grow your technical depth in a fast-moving, AI-native delivery environment.

What We’re Looking For

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

Program Execution

  • Drive one or more AI and software delivery programs through planning, execution, and launch.
  • Own program schedules, execution plans, and cross-functional alignment to ensure delivery commitments are met.
  • Maintain roadmaps, milestones, dependencies, and status; keep plans current as priorities shift.
  • Contribute to design and planning discussions — understand the technical scope well enough to track it accurately.

Engineering Coordination & Delivery

  • Coordinate work across backend, frontend, ML/AI, and data workstreams, keeping handoffs and interfaces clear.
  • Identify and escalate technical blockers, dependencies, and integration gaps before they slip the schedule.
  • Track and report program health using sprint progress, milestones, delivery metrics, risks, dependencies, and launch readiness indicators and keep them visible to the team.

Risk & Communication

  • Track risks and dependencies; flag issues early and help drive them to resolution with engineering leads.
  • Communicate clear, accurate program status to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Keep documentation, action items, and decisions organized and accessible.

Stakeholder Support

  • Support partner and stakeholder communication alongside senior TPMs.
  • Translate program plans into clear updates and help keep business goals and technical execution aligned.
  • Contribute to improving team rituals, documentation, and delivery processes.
  • Drive delivery while helping maintain a high technical bar across the team.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–5 years in Technical Program Management, project coordination, or a related cross-functional role on software teams.
  • Able to engage in technical discussions, read architecture diagrams and tickets, ask clarifying questions, and identify execution risks.
  • Working familiarity with modern software development: APIs, cloud basics, version control, CI/CD, and Agile delivery.
  • Baseline understanding of AI/ML product concepts — LLMs, generative AI, and how AI features move from prototype toward production.
  • Track record keeping software programs organized and on track, ideally in startup or consulting environments.
  • Comfortable operating in fast-moving environments where priorities evolve, ambiguity is common, and processes are still being developed.
  • Solid risk and dependency tracking; able to surface issues early and clearly.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong English verbal and written communication.
  • Hands-on experience with Agile methodologies and modern collaboration tools.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to AI systems — RAG, agentic workflows, vector databases, or prompt/eval workflows.
  • Experience supporting AI, ML, or data-driven product delivery.
  • Background in technical consulting or client-facing project work.
  • A technical foundation in software engineering, computer science, or a related field.
  • Experience with Jira, Linear, Notion, Asana, or similar tools.
  • Scrum Master or Agile certifications.

What Success Looks Like

  • Programs stay organized and on track, with clear status and dependencies always visible.
  • Blockers and risks are surfaced early and escalated to the right people.
  • Engineering and stakeholder communication is timely, accurate, and clear.
  • The TPM grows in technical depth and progressively takes on more program ownership.
  • Delivery processes and documentation improve through consistent, reliable execution.

Able is powered by curious, thoughtful people who care about what they build and how they build it. We’re actively investing in our team through AI training, knowledge-sharing, and hands-on experimentation to ensure everyone grows alongside the technology.

This position is 100% remote within LatAm. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English are a requirement. As a team member, you can expect:

  • To work 40 hours per week, and be available during normal business hours as needed.
  • Payments made in USD.
  • 18 days of PTO per year, observance of local holidays, and an annual break between Christmas and New Years.
  • Wellness + Remote Stipend
  • AI Voucher

About Able

Able builds technology products in a portfolio model. We believe that people, teams, and processes are more important than the ideas themselves, so we’ve focused on bringing great people together, and investing in their growth.

We’ve built products in a variety of industries. Everything from media to finance to toys to healthcare. Sometimes we work with management teams to help their businesses grow faster or unlock value using technology. Other times we start or buy businesses outright. Each time, we look for opportunities to leverage technology built at the portfolio-level to drive value faster.

Able is committed to inclusion and diversity and is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

This is but the beginning of a conversation we’d love to have with you.

Apply, and let’s get this adventure started!

Title: Technical Program Manager -  Release Management
Description:
DataHub is an AI & Data Context Platform adopted by over 3,000 enterprises, including Apple, CVS Health, Netflix, and Visa. Innovated jointly with a thriving open-source community of 13,000+ members, DataHub's metadata graph provides in-depth context of AI and data assets with best-in-class scalability and extensibility.

The company's enterprise SaaS offering, DataHub Cloud, delivers a fully managed solution with AI-powered discovery, observability, and governance capabilities. Organizations rely on DataHub solutions to accelerate time-to-value from their data investments, ensure AI system reliability, and implement unified governance, enabling AI & data to work together and bring order to data chaos.

What you’ll do:

  • Manage end-to-end release cadences for both DataHub Core (OSS) and our Managed Cloud
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams including engineering, product, QA, DevOps, documentation, and customer success
  • Define Quality Gates: Establish the "Go/No-Go" criteria that ensure every release is rock-solid
  • Build Automation: Design the dashboards and runbooks that turn manual release chaos into a streamlined machine
  • Risk Mitigation: Identify breaking changes and dependency conflicts before they hit production
  • Serve as the central point of contact for all release-related questions and updates
  • Facilitate release retrospectives and drive continuous improvement initiatives

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in technical program management or release management roles
  • Proven track record of managing complex software releases in fast-paced startup environments
  • Deep understanding of software development lifecycles, CI/CD practices, and DevOps principles
  • Experience with both open-source and enterprise software release models is a strong plus
  • Strong technical background with ability to understand architecture, dependencies, and technical trade-offs
  • Excellent project management skills with proficiency in tools like Jira, Linear, or similar
  • Outstanding communication skills with ability to translate technical concepts for diverse audiences
  • Experience working with cross timezone & cross-functional teams

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with data platforms, metadata management, or data catalog platforms is a strong plus
  • Background in managing releases for platforms with complex architectures
  • Experience with GitHub workflows, release automation, and version management
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud-native deployment models
  • Previous involvement in open-source communities and understanding of OSS governance
  • Knowledge of SaaS operations, single tenant & multi-tenant architectures, and staged rollout strategies
  • Familiarity with observability tools, incident management, and on-call processes
  • Background in Agile/Scrum methodologies and sprint planning

Benefits and Perks

We invest in people so they can do their best work and enjoy doing it. Our benefits reflect the way we build: practical, thoughtful, and designed to support long-term growth.

Competitive compensation

We offer salaries that reflect your skills, experience, and the impact you make. You bring value—we make sure you're recognized for it.

Equity for everyone

Every team member receives an ownership stake in the company. When we grow, you grow with us.

Remote Work

All roles are remote unless otherwise specified in the job description. Review the job description to confirm if the role you are interested in is remote or hybrid.

Location flexibility

Home office, coworking space, or something in between? We support your ideal setup. You’ll receive a monthly coworking stipend to use whenever you need a change of pace or in-person collaboration time.

Comprehensive health coverage

Your well-being matters. We cover 99% of medical, dental, and vision premiums employees, and 65% for dependents.

Flexible savings accounts

We offer FSAs to help cover planned or unexpected healthcare costs. You can also opt into a Dependent Care FSA to support family needs.

Support for every path to parenthood

Through Carrot Fertility, we provide inclusive fertility benefits and family-forming support. All U.S. employees have access, regardless of age, gender identity, or family structure.

Time off that works for you

We trust you to take the time you need. Our unlimited PTO and sick leave policy is designed for flexibility, rest, and real life.

 

Why Join Us

DataHub is at a rare inflection point: we’ve achieved product-market fit, earned the trust of leading enterprises, and secured backing from top-tier investors like Bessemer Venture Partners and 8VC. The context platform market is expected to grow from $1B to $9B in the next five years—and we’re leading the way.

By joining our team, you’ll:

  • Tackle high-impact challenges at the heart of enterprise AI infrastructure
  • Ship production systems that power real-world use cases at global scale
  • Collaborate with a high-caliber team of builders who’ve scaled some of the most influential data tools in the world
  • Build the next generation of AI-native data systems, including conversational agents, intelligent classification, automated governance, and more

If you're passionate about technology, enjoy working with customers, and want to be part of a fast-growing company changing the industry, we want to hear from you!

Title: Sr. Talent Program Manager - Early Careers
Description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,400 firms in nearly 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $9 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with nearly 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, London, Edinburgh, Pune, Dubai, Geneva, Singapore and São Paulo. 

The Role

We are currently seeking a Sr. Talent Program Manager to join our Talent & Organizational Development team! This individual contributor role directly impacts how emerging talent enters, grows, and thrives across our global organization. You will own and shape our global early careers experience - from designing structured internship and graduate programs to building university partnerships and continuously evolving the experience based on feedback and business needs.

You’ll love this position if you’re driven by variety and eager to make a tangible impact. It’s ideal for someone who effortlessly bridges strategy and hands-on execution, partnering with global teams to build high-impact development programs. This is an exciting opportunity to showcase your passion for talent development and build experiences that enable emerging talent to thrive, build confidence, and perform at their best.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without requiring current or future visa sponsorship (for example, employment-based visas such as H-1B, F-1/OPT, or similar), and must be authorized to begin work in the U.S. on their first day of employment.

What You’ll Do

Early Careers Development

  • Scope, design, and program manage scalable global early career initiatives - including internship programs, new graduate cohorts, and rotational tracks that deliver exceptional learning and development experiences across the organization.
  • Define and monitor program success metrics, using participant feedback, hiring outcomes, retention, performance, and conversion data to continuously improve program effectiveness and demonstrate business impact.
  • Design and facilitate interactive development workshops tailored specifically for early career talent, focusing on essential professional skills, team dynamics, problem-solving, and career navigation.
  • Conduct ongoing needs assessments to continuously refine learning pathways, ensuring program solutions effectively bridge the gap between academic preparation and business performance.
  • Deliver world-class program experiences that elevate our employer brand, directly positioning us as a top employer of choice for early career applicants.
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition and business leaders to optimize intern and new grads to full-time conversion, ensuring strong hiring outcomes and a seamless transition into long-term careers at Addepar.

University Partnerships & Campus Strategy

Title: Senior Content Manager, APAC
Description:
This is Adyen

Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition. 

For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

Senior Content Manager

Adyen is looking for a strategic, hands-on and collaborative senior content manager to own and evolve Adyen’s editorial voice across APAC. You will define how Adyen’s story is told in one of the world's most dynamic fintech landscapes.

You will set the standard for how content drives commercial impact, brand authority, and audience growth in the region.
This role is focused on owning the strategy, execution, and continuous optimization of Adyen’s content marketing in APAC. You will act as the regional authority on content — setting direction, elevating quality, and ensuring all output ladders up to measurable business impact.
You are a master storyteller who can pivot from writing technical white papers to crafting high-engagement LinkedIn posts, with a strong commercial mindset ensuring every piece of content serves a purpose.

What you'll do

  • Regional content and market entry strategy: Own and evolve Adyen’s APAC content roadmap. Identify strategic opportunities and define how we show up across markets, creating localized content strategies that resonate across diverse regulatory and cultural environments.
  • AI & scalability: Leverage AI to scale output and improve efficiency. Build smarter workflows without compromising quality.
  • Social & thought leadership: Own APAC’s social and thought leadership strategy, with a focus on LinkedIn. Define what high-performing looks like, develop social-first content, and grow our audience through meaningful engagement that strengthens Adyen’s authority in B2B.
  • Content creation (including video storytelling): Lead by example with high-quality, hands-on creation. Write and edit across formats — from reports and case studies to video, social, and campaign assets. Partner closely with creative teams to develop compelling video narratives, craft strong hooks that capture attention early, and ensure content is optimized for short-form, platform-first consumption.
  • Platform & media insight: Stay ahead of B2B media trends, platform shifts, and audience behaviors. Turn insights into clear strategic direction, refining formats, tone, and distribution to maximize impact.
  • Stakeholder partnership: Act as a strategic partner to marketing, product, commercial, and agency teams. Shape briefs, influence direction, and elevate the quality and effectiveness of content across the business.
  • Project management: Set the standard for execution. Run multiple complex projects with clear plans, strong prioritization, and consistent on-time delivery.
  • Global to local: Own the adaptation of global content for APAC. Ensure it lands locally while staying true to Adyen’s tone of voice — and identify opportunities to strengthen regional relevance.
  • Agency management: Own agency and freelancer output. Set clear expectations and ensure consistent quality, speed, and brand alignment.
  • Performance and optimization: Define success metrics and use data to continuously improve performance, SEO, and engagement. Turn insights into action.
  • Innovation: Continuously test new formats, channels, and approaches to keep Adyen’s content fresh, relevant, and ahead of the market.

Who You Are

  • Experience: 8+ years in content marketing, editorial, or strategic copywriting, ideally within B2B tech, fintech, or financial services. You bring a strong track record of owning and evolving content strategy, not just executing against it.
  • Strategic mindset: You think beyond individual assets and understand how content drives business outcomes. You can connect content initiatives to broader marketing and commercial goals, identify opportunities, and prioritize where to play.
  • AI fluency: You are comfortable using AI as part of your workflow to scale output, improve efficiency, and enhance creative quality — while maintaining strong editorial standards.
  • Social and LinkedIn expertise: You understand how to build authority and engagement on LinkedIn. You know what performs, why it performs, and how to consistently create content that drives meaningful interaction and audience growth.
  • Video storytelling experience: You have experience shaping compelling video content — from developing narratives to crafting strong hooks that capture attention early. You understand what works in short-form, platform-first video and can partner effectively with creative teams to bring ideas to life.
  • Media and content ecosystem fluency: You have a deep understanding of the evolving media landscape and how B2B audiences consume content across platforms — from long-form reports to short-form, social-first, and video-led formats — and know how to adapt content accordingly.
  • Master storyteller: You have strong editorial judgment and a journalistic mindset. You know how to find the angle, simplify complexity, and turn technical topics into clear, compelling, and differentiated stories.
  • Audience-centric: You are deeply curious about your audience. You actively seek to understand the motivations, behaviors, and pain points of merchants across industries, and use these insights to create relevant and high-impact content.
  • Strong owner and collaborator: You thrive in a fast-paced, flat environment and take full ownership of your work. You’re comfortable working independently while also influencing stakeholders and collaborating across teams, agencies, and freelancers to raise the bar on output.
  • Operational excellence: You have strong project management instincts and a proven ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and deliver consistently high-quality work while remaining open to iteration and feedback.
  • Some domestic and international travel is required

Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments 

Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen. 

Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!

What’s next?

Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here. Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.

This role is based out of our Singapore office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.

Title: Program Manager II, Business Operations
Description:
The Program Manager, Business Operations leads cross-functional initiatives that improve operational efficiency, enhance organizational performance, and support strategic business objectives. This role manages large, complex programs from planning through execution, ensuring alignment across teams such as Operations, Finance, Product, IT, HR, and Executive Leadership. Additionally, Senior Program Managers may also provide leadership, mentorship, and guidance to other members of the Business Operations function and project teams.

Essential Functions

  • Lead end-to-end program planning, execution, and delivery for high-impact business operations (including Value Creation, Compliance, Continuous Improvement and other as assigned) initiatives.
  • Partner with senior leadership to define program scope, objectives, milestones, and success metrics.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure alignment, remove blockers, and drive execution.
  • Analyze operational data to identify inefficiencies, performance gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Develop program roadmaps, timelines, status dashboards, and reporting for executive stakeholders.
  • Facilitate decision-making by providing insights, clear communication, and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Maintain detailed program documentation, including requirements, processes, and post-implementation reviews.
  • Lead operational change management, including training, communication, and adoption plans.
  • Support implementation of new tools, systems, and automation efforts that increase organizational scalability.
  • Track and measure program outcomes, including ROI, process improvements, and operational metrics.
  • Provide expertise exhibiting a depth of knowledge across operations to include operational, engineering, maintenance, system test and technical management disciplines for which they are assigned.
  • Work directly with the customer to determine project requirements, develop a work plan, execute the work.
  • Ensure projects/programs are executed to the highest level of safety and compliance.
  • Ensure all personnel meet/exceed professional standards and embrace the AEVEX culture.
  • Effectively communicate expectations and develop innovative strategies to enhance organizational capabilities that support operational priorities and requirements.
  • Cultivate strong relationships with peers, subordinates, and customers while providing leadership and technical advice to strategic and operational business planning.
  • Be an agile and adaptive leader who consistently meets challenges head-on and ensures organizational success by building effective professional relationships with senior executives and peers.
  • Facilitate alignment and achievement of strategy objectives and performance goals across the company.
  • Manage all aspects of assigned programs to include costs, schedules, and performance.
  • Integrate industry best practices and meet or exceed program financial goals. •
  • Develop processes for identifying, assessing, monitoring and mitigating risk throughout the program life cycle.
  • Perform other duties as required.

Standard Essential Functions

  • Regular and reliable attendance on a full time basis [or in accordance with posted schedule].
  • Responsible for exhibiting professional behavior with both internal and external business associates that reflects positively on the company and is consistent with the company's policies and practices.
  • Embodies AEVEX’s cultural values and aligns daily actions with department goals and company culture.

Qualifications and Competencies

  • Security Clearance- Ability to obtain/maintain a Secret DoD clearance, U.S. Citizenship required. (Top Secret eligibility preferred)
  • Strong program and project management skills, with experience managing multiple concurrent initiatives.
  • Ability to translate complex business needs into actionable plans.
  • Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making capabilities.
  • Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools (e.g., Jira, Microsoft Project Server).

  • Detail oriented with strong planning, organizational, project management, and analytical skills.

Education / Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Program Management, Strategy, or related field from an accredited University (MS or MBA preferred).

Experience

  • 5–7+ years of experience in Business Operations, Program Management, Strategy, or related fields.
  • Experience with operational frameworks such as Lean, Six Sigma, or Agile.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders.
  • Strong financial and business acumen.
  • Experience in A&D, SaaS, tech, or other fast-moving industries. (preferred)

Title: Program Manager (Future Opportunity)
Location: Arlington, VA; Alexandria, VA; Hampton Roads, VA
Description:
About Us

AGE Solutions is a premier technology and professional services company, providing in-depth consulting, advanced technology solutions, and essential services throughout the U.S. government, defense, and intelligence sectors. Prioritizing innovation and client-focused solutions, we assist major agencies in addressing intricate issues and ensuring a more secure future.

The Program Manager is responsible for the execution of task orders for a government customer. The PM ensures all program and project activities meet cost, schedule, and performance objectives while maintaining compliance with DoD, DISA, and Federal policies and standards. This position requires hands-on management of personnel, resources, deliverables, and communications to ensure operational excellence and mission success. The Program Manager serves as the primary interface between the Contractor and Government leadership, responsible for planning, directing, coordinating, and controlling all activities under the task order(s).

This is an onsite position located within the National Capital Region.  Individuals must reside within a commutable distance in order to work onsite full time.

  • Performs enterprise-wide horizontal integration planning and interfaces to other functional systems.
  • Provide full-spectrum program and project management in accordance with DoD and DISA standards and the J6 Unified Framework (UF).
  • Oversee all task order activities, ensuring deliverables meet performance objectives and are submitted on schedule.
  • Establish and maintain a program management structure that facilitates effective coordination across all task areas.
  • Maintain accountability for task performance, staffing levels, and compliance with all applicable regulations.
  • Lead the development and execution of Program Management Plans, Task Area Management Plans, and associated progress reports.

  • Citizenship and Clearance:
    • US Citizenship is required.
    • Must have and maintain a current DoD Secret clearance.
  • Experience: Minimum of 10 years of progressive program or project management experience, with at least 5 years supporting DoD or Federal IT programs.
  • Certifications: PMP
  • Proven success managing large-scale, multi-task technical programs involving cross-functional teams.
  • Experience with DoD systems, DISA J6 operations, or similar defense communications organizations.
  • Expertise in Microsoft Project or equivalent PM tools (e.g., ProMIS).
  • Strong leadership, organizational, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, mission-critical environment.
  • Skilled in risk management, resource allocation, and performance reporting.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to brief senior leadership.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • IAM III certification preferred: CASP+, CISSP, CISM, or other 8140 IAM certification.
  • ITIL, Agile, or Lean Six Sigma certifications preferred.

Compensation: $130,000 - $160,000

This position is part of a pipeline for a future opportunity supporting a DoD customer. Employment is contingent upon contract award and government customer approval. AGE Solutions is actively engaging talent ahead of award and encourages both current incumbents and new candidates to express interest. 

At AGE Solutions, we reward performance, invest in growth, and share success. Our benefits support the whole person, professionally, financially, and personally.

  • 26 Days Paid Leave: Includes vacation, sick, personal time, and holidays. You choose how to use it.
  • Performance Bonuses: Performance bonuses are awarded based on individual contributions and company-wide results, aligning recognition with impact.
  • 401(k) with Match: We match 3% of your contributions with immediate vesting.
  • Financial Protection: Company-paid life insurance up to $300K and options for additional coverage for you and your dependents.
  • Health Benefits: Multiple medical plans, dental, vision, FSA and HSA options to fit your needs.
  • Parental Leave: 15 days of fully paid leave for new parents, because family matters.
  • Military Differential Pay: We bridge the gap for employees on active duty, so they don’t take a financial hit while serving.
  • Professional Growth: Paid training and certifications, tuition reimbursement, and the tools and tech to get the job done right.
  • Shared Success: In the event of a company sale, our CEO has committed to returning 80% of net proceeds to employees. This ensures our team shares in the long term value they help create.

Title: Operations Governance Manager
Description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a hyperscale data centre company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering the digital infrastructure that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

 

A Snapshot 

As Operations Governance Manager, you will report to the Director of Operations Governance and work closely with various teams and leadership across the Asia Pacific region, making your mark in a number of ways: 

  • You will work closely with key business teams to drive, structure, and deliver key data centre operational excellence, governance and compliance initiatives across the APJ region. 
  • You will advise on and shape data centre operational excellence and assurance  throughout AirTrunk, including the initiation and delivery of new build sites, ensuring compliance from a risk management perspective to enable the rapid expansion of AirTrunk data centre developments across APJ. 
  • You will be able to hone new skills and expertise in related workstreams as required, including risk management, business continuity, and emergency response, developing an in-depth knowledge of AirTrunk’s operations and providing strategic operational initiatives. 

 

Duties and Responsibilities  

  • Management of data centre operational excellence, governance and controls. 
  • Support the development and implementation of consistent operational practices across regions and sites. 
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational processes, procedures, controls and supporting tools. 
  • Monitor recurring findings and trends to determine whether broader organisational improvements are required. 
  • Assist and support assurance activities for all operating sites including; external, internal, client, certification and insurer assurance.   
  • Management of DC sites’ assurance, measuring and monitoring adherence to operational process and procedures. Give feedback to sites on common shortcomings and risk consequence. 
  • Coordinate and undertake Severity 1 drills for DC sites, following up on identified lessons learnt and improvements. 
  • Lead or support improvement initiatives arising from assurance findings, incidents, drills, controlled self-assessments and lessons learned. 
  • Monitor and support site teams in the delivery of their Business Continuity, Emergency response and any other required resiliency planning. 
  • Monitor nominated document owners and managers, in timely review and update of their business unit relevant documentation and keep the Governance owned frameworks and policies up to date for review in consultation with stakeholders.  
  • Support Operations teams in identifying and understanding relevant regulatory, statutory, certification and internal compliance obligations. 
  • Work with relevant subject matter experts to assess changes in regulatory or compliance requirements that may impact Data Centre Operations. 
  • Assessment and tracking of DC sites operational risk, working with site teams to effectively manage, control and/or mitigate these risks. 

 

Requirements  

  • Relevant tertiary qualification or equivalent professional experience in operations, engineering, risk, compliance, governance, quality or a related discipline. 
  • Demonstrated experience in operational governance, assurance, compliance, risk management or operational excellence. 
  • Experience working within a critical infrastructure, data centre, engineering, utilities, facilities management or similarly high-reliability operational environment. 
  • Strong understanding of operational risk and control principles. 
  • Demonstrated ability to analyse complex operational issues and identify systemic risks and improvement opportunities. 
  • Ability to travel regularly across operational sites within the APAC region. 
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, attention to detail, and the ability to create and direct cross-functional group forums for managing risks. 
The AirTrunk Culture 
 
Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.
 
The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.
 
Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.
Now’s your chance to Grow@Hyperscale.

Title: Head of Content & Media
Description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

At Alpaca, we believe every meaningful company initiative should become a scalable content opportunity. We don't treat content as a series of one-off announcements—we treat it as an engine.

We’re looking for a Head of Content & Media to build Alpaca into a leading media and lifestyle brand at the intersection of financial services, investing, technology, and global markets.

This person will build and lead our AI-first content engine while developing original media properties, including Alpaca’s podcast platform, video programming, executive-led content, and other recurring editorial franchises. The role is equal parts media strategist, content leader, operator, storyteller, and builder.

You’ll create the strategy, systems, workflows, and automation that transform product launches, customer wins, partnerships, podcasts, industry developments, and company milestones into compelling content across every channel. You will also establish a distinctive editorial voice and build an audience that looks to Alpaca for valuable insights, conversations, and perspectives on the future of financial services.

This is not a traditional content marketing role. You’re building the media and lifestyle brand and content flywheel that power Alpaca’s brand, thought leadership, customer education, audience growth, and commercial success. Business teams own their objectives, audiences, and core messaging; you own the media strategy and operating system that transform those inputs into high-quality content and scalable media programming.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Own the strategy and buildout of Alpaca as a recognized media brand, developing a differentiated editorial voice, recurring programming, and an engaged audience across financial services, investing, technology, and global markets
  • Manage the content team and build Alpaca’s AI-first content operating system, creating a content flywheel that turns every meaningful company initiative and industry conversation into a repeatable media opportunity
  • Build and own Alpaca’s podcast platform from the ground up, including its editorial direction, format, guest strategy, production, distribution, audience development, and performance
  • Develop podcast and video programming featuring executives, customers, partners, industry leaders, and other influential voices, positioning Alpaca at the center of important industry conversations
  • Use podcast conversations and original media programming to amplify product news, fundraising announcements, major partnerships, customer stories, company milestones, and industry insights
  • Create original editorial franchises and repeatable content formats that audiences associate with Alpaca, spanning podcasts, video series, newsletters, interviews, research, events, and social content
  • Own the complete content and media lifecycle, from editorial planning and production through publishing, distribution, audience growth, measurement, and continuous optimization
  • Transform company initiatives into compelling content across all business and product lines by partnering closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Communications, Customer Success, and Executive Leadership
  • Leverage AI and automation to dramatically increase content velocity, consistency, quality, and scale across research, transcription, drafting, video clipping, repurposing, translation, publishing, analytics, and workflow automation
  • Build repeatable processes that ensure every important initiative generates maximum impact across multiple channels and formats, including blog posts, LinkedIn, X, short- and long-form video, podcasts, email newsletters, customer communications, company websites, internal communications, presentations, and case studies
  • Own Alpaca’s content distribution and audience-development strategy, expanding reach across owned, earned, executive, partner, and social channels
  • Craft Alpaca’s executive thought leadership strategy and establish consistent, differentiated messaging across the founders and senior leadership team
  • Establish content governance, editorial standards, production processes, asset-management systems, and performance-reporting methodologies
  • Define and track success across brand reach, audience growth, engagement, content performance, podcast listenership, media influence, and contribution to company growth
  • Build and lead a world-class content and media team over time

 

What we're looking for:

  • 10+ years of content marketing experience, including 3+ years leading and building teams in a high-growth B2B technology or fintech environment 
  • Outstanding storytelling and editorial judgment in pursuit of building trust with a global audience across multiple formats and channels
  • An exceptional operator who isn’t afraid to build the playbook 
  • Deep understanding and track record of leveraging AI-native content creation tools and marketing automation
  • Experience developing executive thought leadership and category-defining narratives 
  • Data-driven, with a focus on measuring business impact and cost efficiency rather than raw content output
  • Comfortable collaborating remotely in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment
  • Clear communication—you can articulate your strategy, align stakeholder priorities, and listen openly to feedback 

 

Nice to have:

  • Experience in fintech, financial services, developer tools, or other highly technical industries where making dense subject matter approachable without losing credibility is essential
  • Hands-on experience building podcast-first or multimedia content programs
  • Proven success standing up and leading a content team from an early stage
  • Familiarity with the developer and investing infrastructure ecosystem

 

Success Looks Like:

  • All major company initiatives enter a repeatable content flywheel
  • Content moves from idea to publication in days, not weeks
  • Every source event produces high-quality assets across every relevant channel
  • AI and automation continuously improve speed, quality, and efficiency
  • Alpaca becomes the most reputable voice in developer infrastructure for investing

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

We're looking for a Content Marketing Manager, Crypto to own content strategy and go-to-market storytelling for Alpaca's crypto and tokenization products. This role is ideal for a crypto-native content marketer who can translate complex concepts—tokenization infrastructure, on-chain asset mechanics, and institutional crypto workflows—into clear, compelling narratives for exchanges, issuers, market makers, and other institutional partners.

 

You'll sit at the intersection of content marketing, product storytelling, and crypto go-to-market, partnering closely with our crypto product team to support launches, partner announcements, and thought leadership. The pace of change in tokenization demands dedicated expertise: this is not a generalist role. You'll help shape how the market understands Alpaca's Instant Tokenization Network (ITN) and broader crypto infrastructure, turning product complexity into content that drives awareness, adoption, and engagement.

What You'll Do

  • Own content strategy for Alpaca's crypto and tokenization products across both B2B and B2C channels
  • Write and edit educational and product-driven content such as launch posts, explainers, blogs, newsletters, and thought leadership on tokenization and digital assets
  • Develop audience-specific messaging for distinct crypto buyer personas—issuers, market makers, exchanges, and institutional partners—and maintain a shared content playbook for approved language and positioning
  • Partner with the crypto product team to turn technical updates into clear, externally ready content, including briefs for upcoming GTMs
  • Translate internal product language into accurate, externally appropriate messaging, framing Alpaca's role in tokenization workflows
  • Collaborate with product, compliance, design, and marketing stakeholders to ensure content is accurate, on-brand, and ready to ship
  • Identify content opportunities based on product priorities, partner launches, and growth goals
  • Help improve discoverability and adoption through SEO, content refreshes, and audience-focused distribution

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in content marketing, content strategy, editorial, or a related role, with meaningful time spent in crypto, Web3, or digital assets
  • Deep familiarity with crypto market structure, tokenization, and institutional crypto workflows
  • Strong writing and editing skills with the ability to simplify technical or complex topics for sophisticated audiences
  • Experience creating go-to-market content for product launches, partner announcements, or B2B fintech/crypto products
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with product, compliance, and marketing stakeholders in a fast-moving environment
  • Strong judgment around audience, tone, and message clarity—especially when navigating regulated financial content
  • Comfortable operating with a high degree of ownership and moving quickly across multiple concurrent launches

Nice to Have

  • Experience at a crypto-native company or with tokenization / RWA infrastructure
  • Background creating content for market makers, crypto exchanges, or institutional crypto audiences
  • Experience building content playbooks or messaging frameworks for technical products
  • Familiarity with compliance constraints in regulated financial and crypto marketing content
  • Knowledge of on-chain asset mechanics, DeFi primitives, and cross-network asset movement
  • Based in North America

Why This Role

Tokenization is moving from narrative to infrastructure, and Alpaca is at the center of that shift. This is a chance to shape how institutional crypto audiences—exchanges, issuers, and market makers—understand what Alpaca's crypto and tokenization products can do, and how to get value from them quickly. You'll play a key role in supporting a growing pipeline of partner launches and product GTMs at a pivotal moment for the business.

What You Bring

  • A collaborative mindset and the ability to partner closely with product leaders to translate technical concepts into externally ready stories
  • A passion for understanding our crypto users: what they're building, what workflows they care about, and how tokenization changes capital efficiency and market structure
  • Experience turning fast-moving product roadmaps into a coherent content and GTM narrative
