At Momentum Financial Services Group, we help people move forward by reimagining how money works for those who need it most. With more than 40 years of experience, we’re the team behind Money Mart—Canada’s largest non-bank branch network—and a leader in financial solutions for underserved communities.

From short-term loans to money transfers and prepaid cards, we power the products, technology, and operations that connect over a million customers a year to the money they need, when they need it.

At MFSG, we come together across teams and departments to create something bigger than ourselves: solutions that remove barriers and give people access to money they might not get anywhere else. Whether you're solving problems, building systems, or shaping strategy, your work fuels real support for real people.

We’ve Got You Covered

Compensation Philosophy: Our strategy is simple—we aim to match the market. We regularly review industry standards to ensure our total rewards package is competitive and fair. This commitment helps us attract and retain talented individuals who share our purpose.

The Job: Director, Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC)

We’re seeking a Director, Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) to lead and operate MFSG’s cybersecurity governance, cyber risk management, compliance, and data governance functions. This is a highly hands-on senior individual contributor role responsible for strengthening governance frameworks, overseeing cyber risk activities, supporting regulatory compliance, and driving risk-informed decision-making across the organization.

What You’ll Do

Cyber Risk Management & Governance:

  • Own and operate the enterprise cyber risk management framework
  • Maintain cybersecurity, technology, and data risk registers
  • Conduct cyber risk assessments across business processes, systems, vendors, and strategic initiatives
  • Define and track key risk indicators (KRIs), metrics, and remediation activities
  • Support post-incident risk reviews and continuous improvement efforts

Compliance, Audit & Regulatory Oversight:

  • Support internal and external audits, regulatory reviews, and customer due diligence requests
  • Validate control effectiveness and coordinate audit evidence collection
  • Manage cybersecurity policy governance and exception management processes
  • Ensure alignment with industry frameworks including NIST, ISO 27001, privacy regulations, and financial sector requirements

Data Governance & Third-Party Risk Management:

  • Partner with data governance, privacy, legal, and compliance teams to manage information risk
  • Oversee data governance activities including classification, retention, protection, access governance, and recovery controls
  • Support vendor and third-party risk assessments and remediation efforts

Reporting, Stakeholder Engagement & Cross-Functional Influence:

  • Prepare executive-level cyber risk reporting and governance updates
  • Present risk trends, control gaps, remediation progress, and emerging risks to leadership
  • Influence business, technology, and control owners to drive risk reduction activities
  • Build strong relationships across cybersecurity, IT, legal, compliance, enterprise risk, and operational teams

Governance Program Development & Operational Leadership:

  • Develop and mature cybersecurity governance programs, policies, standards, and procedures
  • Improve GRC processes, workflows, and governance effectiveness
  • Personally execute critical deliverables in a hands-on leadership capacity
  • Balance business objectives with practical, risk-based governance and security controls

What You’ll Bring to the Table

  • 10+ years of experience in information security, cybersecurity, technology risk, or IT controls
  • At least 5 years of direct GRC experience, including 3+ years in a leadership capacity
  • Experience within banking, fintech, insurance, payments, wealth management, or another regulated financial services environment
  • Proven success operating as a senior individual contributor with ownership of risk assessments, governance documentation, executive reporting, and remediation tracking
  • Strong understanding of enterprise cyber risk management, governance, and compliance practices

  • Experience managing cyber risk registers, risk reviews, issue management, and remediation programs

  • Experience supporting audits, regulatory reviews, customer security assessments, and control testing activities
  • Strong understanding of identity and access management, data protection, cloud security, vulnerability management, incident response, third-party risk, and business continuity

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CGEIT, or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor
  • Experience implementing or enhancing GRC platforms, workflow automation, and reporting dashboards
  • Familiarity with PCI DSS, SOC 2, cloud control frameworks, and privacy control frameworks
  • Experience mapping controls across multiple regulatory and compliance frameworks

Ready to lead cybersecurity governance and influence enterprise risk decisions across a growing organization? Join us and help strengthen the security, resilience, and compliance foundation of MFSG.

Please note: The salary range for this position is between C$175,000 to C$ 190,000.

Title: Product Owner, Content and Web Operations
Description:
About MoneyHero Group

MoneyHero Limited (NASDAQ: MNY) is a leading tech- and AI-powered personal finance aggregation and comparison platform that provides consumers with actionable insights to discover, compare, and choose the best financial products with confidence — bringing data intelligence and seamless digital access across insurance and banking solutions. The Company operates in Singapore, Hong Kong, Taiwan and the Philippines. Its brand portfolio includes B2C platforms MoneyHero, SingSaver, Money101, Moneymax and Seedly, as well as the B2B platform Creatory. The Company also holds a preference share investment in Jirnexu Pte. Ltd. MoneyHero had over 280 commercial partner relationships as at June 30, 2026, and had approximately 3.7 million Monthly Unique Users across its platform for the three months ended June 30, 2026.

About the role

You will own how financial content and campaigns get published across four markets and our brands: SingSaver, MoneyHero, Moneymax and Money101.

This is a hybrid role by design. Roughly 60% is leading a team of Web Operations Executives and keeping campaign delivery running across all four markets. The other 40% is product ownership: defining and shipping the CMS enhancements, templates and workflows that make the first 60% smaller over time.

For the first six months it will skew closer to 80/20 while you learn the stack and earn credibility with the market teams. We are telling you this upfront rather than letting you discover it.

Two things make this job harder and more interesting than a standard content ops role. Every page you publish carries regulated financial information across four different regulatory regimes, so accuracy is a compliance matter, not a quality preference. And the way people find financial content is changing: a growing share of our audience reads about our products through AI answer engines rather than search results, which changes how content needs to be structured and maintained.

What you'll own

Operations and delivery

  • Campaign content delivery across web, email and social in all four markets, including microsites, T&C documents, product catalogs and rewards pages
  • A team of 6-10 Web Operations Executives: hiring, coaching, workload allocation and quality standards
  • Campaign replication across markets, turning high performing launches into a repeatable process rather than a rebuild each time
  • Escalation point for production content issues 

Quality and compliance

  • The QC process that keeps published content accurate: rates, fees, eligibility criteria, promotional claims and expiry dates
  • Sign off paths with legal, compliance and commercial in each market, including how AI assisted content gets reviewed before it goes live

Product ownership

  • The content operations roadmap: what we build, fix and automate, prioritized against business impact and team capacity
  • Requirements and backlog for CMS and workflow improvements, working with engineering and design to ship at least one meaningful improvement per quarter
  • Content structure and metadata standards that keep our pages discoverable in both traditional search and AI answer engines

AI and efficiency

  • Finding and removing the highest cost manual steps in the content workflow, using AI tooling where it holds up and saying so clearly where it doesn't
  • Turning what works into shared prompts, templates and documented workflows the wider Product, Content and Tech team can use
  • Owning the judgement call on where AI output is safe in regulated financial content and where a human has to sign off

Performance

  • Analysis of content and campaign page performance in GA4, using A/B testing and user behaviour to decide what changes next

What success looks like

Month 3: you know the content stack across all four markets, the team's throughput and error rates are measured rather than assumed, and the top three workflow bottlenecks are documented with a plan and an owner.

Month 6: campaign turnaround time down by 10%, published content error rate under 5%, at least one tooling improvement shipped with engineering, and campaign replication documented as a repeatable process.

Month 12: content ops is no longer a delivery bottleneck for marketing and commercial. At least two AI assisted workflows are in daily use by the team with measured time savings, and you have shared at least one of them with the wider PCT org.

What we're looking for

Must have

  • 6+ years in content operations, web operations, digital platform ownership or product ownership, including at least 2 years managing a team
  • Business fluency in English, plus reading and writing in Traditional Chinese.
  • Hands-on experience running content at scale in a CMS (WordPress, HubSpot or similar), including formatting standards, link integrity and publishing governance
  • Daily working use of AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT, with a real point of view on where they help and where they create risk. One round of our interview process is a working session on exactly this
  • Comfortable in GA4 and GTM. You pull your own numbers and interpret them without waiting on an analyst
  • Experience working with engineering in an agile setup: writing clear requirements, prioritizing a backlog, saying no

Nice to have

  • Financial services, fintech or another regulated content environment
  • Multi-market or multi-language content operations, especially where translation and localisation are part of the workflow
  • Enough HTML and CSS to diagnose a broken page and fix the small stuff yourself
  • Experience building repeatable AI workflows for a team, not just for yourself
  • Speak Cantonese. (Our Hong Kong operation is the largest content workload of the four markets and you will manage it directly)

Tools we use, which you'll pick up if you haven't: Claude, JIRA, Confluence, Sendgrid, MoEngage, Rebrandly, Figma.

#MoneyHeroGroup
#LI-AK1

 

What can you expect from us?
 
Impact: We are actively empowering and connecting people to a better financial future. Join us if you want to help us achieve our mission.
Work: We have a team of over 350 talented individuals in 4 markets who are hyper passionate about building innovative financial solutions and making an impact on people’s lives.
Culture: We take our work seriously but don’t hesitate to keep things light. We can only create magic when we have a little bit of fun.
Thrive: We launched in 2014, and now help over 10 million monthly users make the best financial decisions. Accelerate your career and become a pioneer in your field with a leading fintech company that seeks to push the boundaries of your imagination and is committed to growing your career.
Reputation: We are backed by world-class organizations and companies and have raised over US$110 million from investors including Experian, Pacific Century Group, IFC - a member of the World Bank Group

MoneyHero Group is an equal opportunity employer. We value, support and respect all individuals and is committed to maintaining an inclusive and diverse working environment. Decisions in hiring are based on business needs, requirements of the job and individual qualifications and shall not be influenced by any consideration of race, ethnic or national origin, religion, sex (including gender identity and/or expression), age, sexual orientation, marital status, parental status, disability, genetic information, political affiliation or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Most legitimate opportunities at MoneyHero Group are published on our official careers portals, and our Talent Acquisition team will contact candidates only through authorized channels and official MoneyHero Group email addresses. Title: Localization Program Manager, CreatorGlobal
Description:
About Us

Beast Industries is a multifaceted media and entertainment company founded by Jimmy Donaldson, popularly known as MrBeast, the most watched person in the world. Renowned for revolutionizing digital content creation, Beast Industries encompasses a diverse portfolio of ventures that extend far beyond its origins on YouTube. With a mission to entertain, inspire, and create significant social impact, Beast Industries operates across various domains including digital media, philanthropy, consumer products, and innovative business initiatives. At Beast Industries, we believe in the transformative power of digital media and its potential to entertain, educate, and effect positive change. Our commitment to innovation, creativity, and philanthropy drives us to explore new frontiers, create unforgettable experiences, and build a legacy that inspires future generations.

About CreatorGlobal

CreatorGlobal exists to make content a universal language. We specialize in the highest quality and speed of localization. We have an amazing team that not only innovates within the traditional localization industry, but also directly spearheads improvements to multi-language experiences for the world’s largest distribution engines (e.g. Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Twitter, YouTube). Similar to our parent company, MrBeast, we do the impossible – Come make history with us!

About the Role

The Localization Program Manager is the operational backbone of CreatorGlobal’s end-to-end localized content production. This role owns the full project localization lifecycle from initial scoping and vendor engagement to production coordination, delivery, and quality sign-off.

You’ll serve as the primary bridge between our internal production teams and the studio ecosystem, ensuring projects are scoped accurately, approached from a global lens, and executed on time without sacrificing quality. You’ll build and steward strategic vendor relationships while maintaining the operational rigor that allows CreatorGlobal to function globally.

If you thrive in high variability environments, are passionate about making content accessible to the world, and bring a future-focused mindset — always optimizing, evolving, and staying ahead of what's next — this role is for you.

This is a fully remote position; however, candidates must reside in or be aligned with the Eastern Time Zone. Periodic travel will be required.

What You'll Do

  • Production Program Management
    • Own the end-to-end lifecycle of localized asset production across multiple simultaneous workstreams — keeping timelines tight, stakeholders informed, and blockers resolved.
  • Post-Production Coordination
    • Act as the connective tissue between CreatorGlobal’s internal production teams and our localization partners, overseeing handoffs, revision cycles, and final deliverables to ensure every output meets required specifications.
  • Project Scoping & Quotation Consolidation
    • Intake requests from production and brand partnerships teams, engage studios and partners to gather financial quotes, and communicate clear cost summaries to internal stakeholders to make informed decisions.
  • Vendor & Relationship Management
    • Build and steward CreatorGlobal’s network of external localization vendors and studio partners — managing onboarding, developing long-term strategic relationships, and securing the terms and capacity we need to scale.
  • Process & Collaboration
    • Work cross-functionally with production, strategy, and operational leadership to keep programs aligned with business priorities, while continuously improving the SOPs and workflows.

What We're Looking For

  • Required:
    • 4–6 years in program or project management, localization operations, or a closely related production management role
    • Demonstrated experience of end-to-end production workflow ownership in a fast-paced and high-volume media/content environment
    • Proven track record of external vendor relationship management, including scoping, quotation, negotiation, and performance management
    • Strong cross-functional communication skills — comfortable working across production, strategy, and creative teams in a fully remote, asynchronous environment
    • Experience using Monday.com (or similar project management tools) to manage timelines, workflows, and cross-functional coordination.
    • Experience building and maintaining operational systems and documentation (project management tools, SOPs, rate cards, etc.)
  • Nice to Have:
    • Background in media localization, international content production, or post-production workflows (especially for YouTube, Amazon, or other streaming platforms).
    • Familiarity with localization asset types including dubbing, subtitling, and adapted creative assets — even if not hands-on
    • Experience managing and coordinating with post-production agencies or distributed freelance teams
    • Proficiency in DaVinci Resolve and/or Adobe Premiere Pro for post-production workflows

Benefits

The Perks, Why Work On the MrBeast Team

We are redefining what entertainment and storytelling look like at global scale. Every piece of content we publish reaches millions and influences culture in real time. This is your opportunity to lead the team that decides how those moments come to life across every screen.

  • Competitive Salary
  • Generous Medical (Blue Cross Blue Shield), Dental, Vision and company-paid Life Insurance 
  • Company contributions to employee Health Savings Accounts (HSA) 
  • 401k Plan with Safe Harbor company-matching
  • Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
  • Company-provided technology package 
  • Relocation assistance where applicable, including travel and company-provided housing for the first 90 days

Title: Head of Programming, DTC Content
Description:
About Us

Beast Industries is a multifaceted media and entertainment company founded by Jimmy Donaldson, popularly known as MrBeast, the most watched person in the world. Renowned for revolutionizing digital content creation, Beast Industries encompasses a diverse portfolio of ventures that extend far beyond its origins on YouTube. With a mission to entertain, inspire, and create significant social impact, Beast Industries operates across various domains including digital media, philanthropy, consumer products, and innovative business initiatives. At Beast Industries, we believe in the transformative power of digital media and its potential to entertain, educate, and effect positive change. Our commitment to innovation, creativity, and philanthropy drives us to explore new frontiers, create unforgettable experiences, and build a legacy that inspires future generations.

Location: Los Angeles, CA (preferred)
Reporting To: GM and President, Beast Studios

Define the next generation of creator-led programming.

Overview

Beast Industries is building a growing direct-to-consumer content business with an expanding portfolio of original programming. As Head of Programming, you'll define the creative vision, programming strategy, and content roadmap that shapes the member experience and drives long-term engagement.

Reporting to the GM and President, Beast Studios, you oversee a portfolio of original programming—from flagship series and recurring formats to creator partnerships and our growing content library. You'll shape what gets made, how our slate evolves, and how programming drives long-term member engagement.

This is a senior creative leadership role for someone who has successfully built and managed programming across digital platforms, streaming services, studios, or premium entertainment brands. Working closely with Production, Talent, Product, Marketing, Analytics, and executive leadership, you'll guide programming from concept through launch while continually evolving the slate through audience insights, creative vision, and business priorities.

What You'll Do

  • Define the programming vision and long-term content strategy across our growing portfolio of original content.
  • Build and manage a diversified slate of original programming across multiple formats and genres.
  • Identify new series, recurring formats, creator partnerships, and programming opportunities that strengthen the platform.
  • Oversee creative development from concept through greenlight, ensuring ideas align with audience needs and business goals.
  • Partner with Production to successfully launch programming while maintaining creative quality and execution standards.
  • Collaborate with Product, Marketing, Analytics, Audience, and executive leadership to inform programming decisions through audience insights and performance data.
  • Develop programming roadmaps that balance flagship launches, recurring series, evergreen content, and library strategy.
  • Build relationships with creators, production partners, agencies, and industry talent to expand programming opportunities.
  • Continuously evaluate content performance and evolve the slate based on audience behavior, retention, and engagement.
  • Build and lead a high-performing programming organization as the platform grows.

What You'll Bring

  • Significant experience leading programming, creative development, or original content strategy for a digital platform, streaming service, studio, media company, or creator business.
  • A track record of overseeing multiple productions or programming initiatives simultaneously.
  • Experience developing unscripted, entertainment, or creator-led content from concept through launch.
  • Strong creative judgment with the ability to identify formats, talent, and ideas that resonate with audiences.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with production, product, marketing, analytics, and executive stakeholders.
  • A data-informed approach to creative decision-making, using audience insights to guide programming strategy.
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to align diverse stakeholders around a creative vision.
  • Comfort operating in fast-moving, evolving environments where priorities shift and new opportunities emerge.
  • Passion for digital entertainment, creator culture, and building category-defining programming.

The annual base salary range for this role is $170,000–$230,000, in addition to eligibility for an annual bonus, an equity grant under the company's employee equity plan, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Equity awards are granted in good faith and are subject to the terms of the applicable equity plan, company policies, Board approval, and individual eligibility.

Benefits

The Perks, Why Work On the MrBeast Team

We are redefining what entertainment and storytelling look like at global scale. Every piece of content we publish reaches millions and influences culture in real time. This is your opportunity to lead the team that decides how those moments come to life across every screen.

  • Competitive Salary
  • Generous Medical (Blue Cross Blue Shield), Dental, Vision and company-paid Life Insurance 
  • Company contributions to employee Health Savings Accounts (HSA) 
  • 401k Plan with Safe Harbor company-matching
  • Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
  • Company-provided technology package 
  • Relocation assistance where applicable, including travel and company-provided housing for the first 90 days

Title: Technical Program Manager, IR Data Products
Description:
About the role

We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive cross-functional planning and execution for our IR Data Product Team.  This role will focus on managing the delivery of improvements and new capabilities for the IR Data Product team data processing pipeline. In this role, you will work closely with engineering leaders across software, hardware, science, and product to coordinate efforts from early concept through delivery to (literal!) launch. You will develop schedules and milestones, uncover gaps, flag risks, support resource planning, and ensure clear communication across stakeholders. 

As a TPM, you’ll help teams stay aligned, unblock issues quickly, and deliver critical software capabilities that power Muon’s mission. You will provide the structure and process discipline required to scale our development efforts, while enabling teams to make fast, high-quality decisions in a complex, interdisciplinary environment.

This position is hybrid and requires working on-site in our San Jose, CA office three days per week.

Responsibilities

  • Program Planning & Roadmapping: Define objectives, scope, milestones, and success criteria in collaboration with engineering and product stakeholders.
  • Scheduling & Execution Management: Build and maintain project timelines, track dependencies, monitor progress, and adjust plans as priorities shift.
  • Risk & Issue Management: Identify risks early, coordinate mitigation plans, surface blockers, and drive timely resolution.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Facilitate collaboration across software, hardware, science, and product teams, ensuring aligned deliverables and clear handoffs.
  • Communication & Reporting: Provide concise, actionable updates to stakeholders and leadership on progress, changes, risks, and decisions.
  • Process & Continuous Improvement: Identify inefficiencies in workflows, propose improvements, and help implement better practices and tools.
  • Resource & Capacity Planning: Assist in forecasting resource needs, tracking capacity, and supporting prioritization and staffing decisions.
  • Release Planning & Readiness: Coordinate software releases, track readiness criteria, and communicate expectations to impacted teams.

Qualifications

  • BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of experience as a software engineer or in a similar technical role.
  • 3+ years of experience managing or coordinating software development projects.
  • Demonstrated ability to establish and optimize software project management processes.
  • Strong technical background managing or implementing teams or projects in cloud computing, data pipeline processing, and/or data science fields.
  • Strong technical background with knowledge of software development methods, tools, and infrastructure.
  • Proven ability to communicate effectively with diverse technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience leading cross-functional planning, scheduling, and risk management across multiple teams.
  • Results-oriented mindset with a bias toward clarity, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Excited to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with evolving priorities.

Nice to have

  • Experience in aerospace, robotics, logistics, or other domains with real-time high-reliability software development requirements.
  • Experience reviewing technical documentation, architecture proposals, or requirements specifications.
  • Comfort with Jira, Confluence and other productivity tools
  • Exposure to OKR or goal-setting frameworks, and alignment of program priorities with company objectives.
  • Ability to work effectively in distributed team environments.

Salary

The salary range for this role is $206,000 - $232,000, plus a competitive equity grant and comprehensive benefits package. Final compensation will be determined based on skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location as assessed during the interview process. 

About Muon Space

Founded in 2021, Muon Space is an end-to-end Space Systems Provider that designs, builds, and operates LEO satellite constellations delivering mission-critical data. Our revolutionary, integrated technology stack enables customers to optimize every dimension of their missions for faster time-to-orbit and superior constellation remote sensing performance. Our state-of-the-art facility in the heart of Silicon Valley is optimized for manufacturing spacecraft and rapid, flexible payload integration at scale. From climate monitoring to national security, Muon Space is dedicated to delivering Earth Intelligence for a safer and more resilient world.

Taking Care of Our Team

At Muon salary is only part of our total compensation package. In addition to salary, full-time employees receive equity compensation as well as benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401k retirement plan, short & long term disability and life insurance. We also offer three weeks paid vacation for new employees, along with 12 paid holidays, unlimited sick time and paid parental leave. 

Our mission embraces the entire planet and we believe our team should too.  Muon is dedicated to creating a diverse and dynamic company and workforce. We believe in equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, age, national origin, citizenship, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or gender identity. We value diversity in the workplace, and that starts with our applicants. We encourage you to apply, even if you don't check all the boxes, and we look forward to reviewing your application! In addition, if you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.

Muon is currently registered and able to hire in the following states:
AL, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, FL, GA, IL, IA, ID, MD, MA, MI, MN, MO, NJ, NY, NC, OH, OR, PA, TN, TX, VT, VA, WA

Title: Technical Writer
Description:
Technical Writer

Remote, US

About Nametag
Nametag is building the future of secure digital identity. Our mission is to protect every human identity to restore trust in the AI era. We bring workforce-grade identity verification into the enterprise to verify the human behind accounts and critical actions. Today, global enterprises use Nametag across their workforce to prevent social engineering and deepfake impersonation attacks.

The Role

We're looking for a Technical Writer to own Nametag’s technical documentation for customers to  You will write user manuals, step-by-step instructions, and FAQs so our users can use our software with ease

This is a hands-on, high-impact role. You'll work closely with engineering and product leadership to make critical decisions about how we guide our customers, and then execute on them. If you've thrived in fast-moving environments and care deeply about process documentation and customer experience, we'd love to meet you.

What you’ll do

Create and Maintain User Documentation 

Write user manuals, API guides, release notes, and online help FAQs.

Follow and maintain company style guides to ensure consistent messaging across all documents.

Review existing documentation regularly to fix errors and add new feature updates.

Analyze feedback

Use customer support data to improve confusing parts of the guides.

Track page views and user ratings to measure document helpfulness.

Audit systems

Test software directly to ensure the accuracy of the steps written in the manuals.

What You Bring

Work authorization required: Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without current or future need for visa sponsorship.

You do not need to match every bullet. We care most about strong judgment and process documentation ownership.

  • 5+ years of experience turning complex processes into simple documentation. 
  • Understanding user experience principles to layout articles intuitively.
  • Experience working within fast-paced software development cycles and sprints.
  • Knowledge of languages like HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or Python to document APIs.
  • Bonus Points: Experience working in a security, identity, or B2B SaaS environment.

What we value

  • Fast technical learning and curiosity about identity security.
  • Kindness, integrity, and high trust—our core operating principles.
  • Bias for action: iterate quickly and ship pragmatic solutions.

Compensation & perks

  • Competitive salary + meaningful equity.
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision.
  • Remote-first with flexible PTO.
  • Annual team off-sites.
  • New MacBook and home-office equipment.

What We Value

  • Intellectual horsepower. Quickly grasping complex technical and business concepts.
  • Kindness and integrity. Earning trust is central to how we build relationships with customers and colleagues.
  • Bias for action. We move quickly to deliver impact and protect our customers against fast-moving threats.
  • Ownership mindset. You care about uptime and stability the way a founder cares about the product.

Culture & Perks

At Nametag, we believe trust starts with how we treat each other. We're a remote-first team that values autonomy, inclusivity, and collaboration, with regular in-person time to stay connected and innovate together.

  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere in the US. Our team spans Seattle, San Francisco, Ann Arbor, Denver, New York City, and beyond.
  • Off-sites: We bring the team together once per quarter for in-person collaboration, often off-site in new places.
  • Flexible schedules: Work in your own time zone; we align key meetings across a shared window.

We Offer

  • Competitive salary
  • Meaningful equity ownership
  • Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision)
  • Flexible paid time off
  • Quarterly team off-sites and travel support
  • New computer hardware and equipment
  • An inclusive environment where your voice has impact and your work drives change

Title: Content Creator - Miami
Description:
Company Description

1000Media is a global media agency with offices in Dubai, Miami, Singapore, India, and Tel Aviv. Originating as the creative force behind Nas Daily, 1000Media has grown into a global powerhouse managing social media channels with over 70 million followers and billions of views. The company specializes in creating impactful content engineered for virality, merging creativity, strategy, and data-driven growth. We empower some of the world’s most influential organizations by building highly effective social media platforms that amplify their messages.

 

About the Role

We’re looking for a Content Creator who can turn ideas into content people actually want to watch.

You’ll own the creative process, from content strategy and ideation to scripting and production.

We’re looking for someone creative, hands-on, and fast-moving, with strong storytelling skills and the ability to create engaging content across different topics and formats.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Own the content strategy and creative direction for assigned clients
  • Research audiences, competitors, trends, and content opportunities
  • Develop strong concepts, hooks, and creative angles
  • Write scripts for short-form videos, ads, and organic social content
  • Produce content from idea through execution
  • Work closely with Video Makers, Editors, and other creatives to bring ideas to life
  • Lead or support shoots when needed
  • Review content throughout production and give clear creative feedback
  • Quality-check content and make sure it aligns with the agreed strategy, brand, and tone
  • Use performance data to understand what’s working and improve future content
  • Prepare monthly creative learnings and recommendations
  • Create and test different versions of concepts, hooks, and formats
  • Help develop static content, carousels, and other social-first formats
  • Build organic content strategies across platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and Facebook
  • Manage multiple content streams while keeping quality and deadlines high
  • Stay on top of trends and identify new opportunities for relevant, engaging content
 

Sound like you? To apply, you need to be/have

  • IMPORTANT: You care about the “why” behind the work. We’re not just making content for the sake of it. Everything we do comes from a mission. We’re looking for people who are mission-driven, take ownership, and want their work to make an impact.
  • Experience in content creation, production, storytelling, or digital media
  • Ideally, experience creating content within longevity, wellness, health, fitness, nutrition, or lifestyle
  • Strong scriptwriting and storytelling skills
  • Strong understanding of content strategy and audience growth
  • Good understanding of short-form and social-first content
  • Comfortable taking a piece of content from idea to production
  • Able to work closely with creatives, talent, and clients
  • Strong creative judgment and attention to detail
  • Strong ownership and ability to move fast
  • Curious, creative, and always looking for better ways to tell a story

Nex Playground features a growing library of 50+ experiences, including motion and dance games, fitness and educational experiences, and Nex Originals. We're looking for a Senior Program Manager, Retail Demo Content to drive the strategy, roadmap, and execution of what games and content appear in our retail demo experience. This is a highly cross-functional role that sits at the intersection of content strategy, production planning, and retail execution — turning leadership's retail vision into a clear, actionable content roadmap that ships on time, every time.

You'll be the connective tissue between our game production pipeline, developer experience team, retail deployment team, and publishing/marketing — ensuring the retail demo always showcases the right games, at the right time, in a way that drives conversion and supports broader go-to-market strategy.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the retail demo content roadmap — Determine which games should be featured in retail demo units at any given time, based on our production release schedule, business priorities, and retailer needs.   • Translate strategy into execution — Take high-level management direction on retail demo goals and convert it into a concrete, achievable execution plan with clear timelines and milestones.

Title: Program Manager - Enterprise IT
Description:
Program Manager - Enterprise IT

Position Description

The Program Manager will lead the successful delivery of large, high-risk, mission-critical, and complex strategic enterprise programs consisting of multiple related projects. This position is responsible for producing long-term organizational improvements while managing program scope, schedules, activities, resources, budgets, risks, quality, and stakeholder expectations throughout the complete delivery lifecycle.

The ideal candidate is an experienced, hands-on program leader who can coordinate multiple business and technology initiatives within a global manufacturing environment. This individual will lead cross-functional teams, manage vendors, advise project managers, oversee program financials, and ensure projects collectively achieve the program’s strategic objectives.

The Program Manager will also support the continued development and adoption of Project Management Office methodologies, standards, procedures, processes, and tools.

Responsibilities

  • Lead multiple interrelated projects within large, complex, and strategically important enterprise programs.
  • Plan, direct, facilitate, and coordinate program activities and resources to achieve business objectives on time, within budget, and at the required level of quality.
  • Manage program scope, schedules, budgets, dependencies, deliverables, risks, issues, resources, and success criteria.
  • Ensure individual projects remain aligned with the program’s overall strategic objectives and anticipated organizational benefits.
  • Identify and coordinate the business, IT, technical, and vendor resources required to build high-performing program teams.
  • Develop and maintain integrated program plans, project schedules, work breakdown structures, estimates, resource plans, milestones, and dependency maps.
  • Establish strong relationships with business stakeholders and ensure program activities support organizational goals.
  • Facilitate and document program charters, business requirements, approvals, governance materials, and other program-specific documentation.
  • Coordinate program reviews and obtain required stakeholder and executive approvals.
  • Develop the overall testing strategy and oversee integration testing, user acceptance testing, defect resolution, and implementation readiness.
  • Identify, document, escalate, and manage complex program risks and issues through closure.
  • Analyze complex situations and data to determine appropriate solutions and achieve the best possible program outcomes.
  • Maintain program-level risk, issue, action, dependency, and decision logs.
  • Oversee vendor relationships, procurement activities, proposals, and requests for proposals associated with assigned programs.
  • Develop and execute effective organizational and technical change-management plans.
  • Lead program-status meetings with business, IT, project-management, vendor, and executive stakeholders.
  • Prepare and deliver program-status reports, financial updates, risk assessments, and executive presentations.
  • Track, manage, and forecast program financials to ensure costs are properly controlled, accounted for, and communicated.
  • Serve as a mentor, advisor, escalation point, and decision-maker for project managers assigned to the program.
  • Establish accountability across project teams and support project managers in resolving delivery challenges.
  • Capture lessons learned and maintain program documentation for use on future enterprise initiatives.
  • Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of PMO standards, processes, procedures, templates, and tools.
  • Promote consistent adoption of established project and program management methodologies.

Required Skills/Experience

  • Five to nine years of project management, program management, or related professional experience.
  • Progressive experience in project-management and leadership positions within a large or comparably complex organization.
  • Demonstrated experience managing projects or programs valued at $2 million or more.
  • Successful history of delivering multiple large-scale implementation projects on time and within budget.
  • Experience managing programs consisting of multiple projects, workstreams, teams, and dependencies.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional business and IT teams using a formal project-management methodology.
  • Full software development lifecycle experience, including multiple end-to-end technology implementations.

Title: Managing Director of Content and Digital
Description:
Salary is determined based on experience and the Foundation’s structured pay bands, which include steps for growth and performance. Please see the “Pay” section for more details.

Priority Application Deadline: September 28, 2026

FLSA Status: Exempt

Starting Salary: $92,330 - $123,107 (Step I - Step II)

Work Location: Hybrid

About the Position

In this role, you'll drive content development and engagement strategies across a variety of projects and channels, including the Foundation's owned digital properties. You'll conceptualize and execute editorial direction for original and curated content, informed by fundraising strategy, that captivates and engages audiences and reinforces OHSU's position as a health leader worthy of charitable support.

Working under the supervision of and in close partnership with the Managing Senior Director of Communications, you'll shape content strategy, editorial direction, film/audio/multimedia, advertising, websites, social media, the Foundation's biannual magazine, and other digital assets. You'll lead a team of content producers and writers and partner with operational and strategic leaders at the Foundation and OHSU.

What You'll Be Doing

CONTENT STRATEGY & EDITORIAL DIRECTION

  • Oversee content production across websites, email, advertising, social, film/video production, event support and other marketing assets; contribute to the development of content strategy and direction in close collaboration with the Sr. Director of Communications
  • Champion bold ideas and creative approaches to telling OHSU's stories and more deeply connecting with prospective and current donors
  • Manage the centralized editorial calendar for original and curated stories, informed by development priorities; assign due dates to team members and freelancers; and ensure regular publication of content to support OHSU's fundraising priorities
  • Lead development of comprehensive content and creative strategies for key prioritized initiatives, and serve as lead editor for the content team and editor of the Foundation's biannual print magazine (and digital counterpart)
  • Manage partnerships with external teams, OHSU partners, creative agencies, and freelancers, and think creatively about how to introduce OHSU (and its fundraising needs) to new audiences and potential partnerships
  • Prioritize health equity within narrative strategy, and ensure DE&I is implemented within all creative endeavors
  • Ensure initiative and campaign data is accurately analyzed, optimized, and shared with operational or experiential leads to improve future goals and tactics

DIGITAL STRATEGY

  • Oversee strategic development and implementation of websites, email, digital marketing and social
  • Consult and advise internal departments on high-level best practices in the digital space
  • Work closely with the Foundation's and OHSU's principal stakeholders to set direction, vision, and prioritization of strategic communications objectives that are supported by or could be advanced by digital technologies
  • Oversee the coordination of digital properties and content to ensure donors receive an intuitive, seamless, and rewarding experience across our platforms

PEOPLE MANAGEMENT

  • Manage and mentor a team of creatives and content producers; help foster a culture and environment conducive to producing bold, innovative ideas for storytelling and engagement
  • Establish clear individual and team goals, ensuring alignment with OHSU and OHSU Foundation priorities and values
  • Actively seek learning opportunities about DE&I, represent DE&I in annual goal-setting, and promote a culture of DE&I within the team's creative output

Who You Are

  • You have exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • You can manage a number of multi-faceted, deadline-sensitive projects simultaneously
  • You have a proven track record of managing, mentoring, retaining, and recruiting a professional and diverse staff
  • You have excellent interpersonal skills and a proven ability to partner with many different constituencies, including OHSUF colleagues, the OHSU communications team and other staff, and donors
  • You're compassionate and culturally responsive, with the ability to work with a diverse team as well as internal and external stakeholders
  • You're committed to integrating diversity, equity, and inclusion through communications strategy

You Should Have

  • 7+ years of experience leading, creating, and implementing content strategies; some experience in a health care, educational, or fundraising environment preferred
  • Experience managing and mentoring a diverse team
  • Demonstrated leadership in developing and implementing digital strategy
  • Experience managing digital communications and marketing initiatives
  • Expertise in website management and industry-standard tools, including content management systems, web design tools, and website tracking mechanisms
  • Experience using image manipulation software such as Adobe Photoshop
  • Experience using common social media channels (Facebook, LinkedIn, Twitter, blogs, etc.) to implement business communication strategies

We want to emphasize that there is no such thing as the perfect candidate; candidates who do not have all of the required experience are encouraged to apply.

Working Conditions

  • Flexible and off-site working hours occasionally necessary to accommodate reactive deadlines and project needs
  • Hybrid work schedule; some onsite work required for monthly team meetings or other onsite needs
  • General office environment
  • Prolonged use of computer
Salary
$92,330—$123,107 USD

Pay

Salary is dependent on experience. Each salary band is broken into three "steps," which correspond with an employee’s experience/tenure, proficiency and performance in that specific role. New employees will typically start at step I of our pay band to allow for later growth, although more experienced candidates may be eligible to start at step II or III. The OHSU Foundation has a structured process for determining starting compensation, taking into account years of related experience, applicable skills, knowledge and abilities, market parity, and internal equity.

Benefits

The OHSU Foundation also offers an exceptional benefits package including:

  • Comprehensive medical and dental insurance.

  • Pension program (The Foundation contributes 12% of your annual salary to a pension);

  • 22 days of paid vacation, 11 paid holidays, 1 float holiday and 2 days of volunteer time off;

  • Professional development dollars for each employee;

  • Hybrid work allowance and much more!

Plus, we have a flexible work environment for those who prefer a hybrid work schedule, and we close early on Fridays during the summer. Want to learn more about our other amazing benefits? Check out our benefits page to learn more about our benefits.

Please note that benefits may vary for employees residing outside of Oregon, Washington, Arkansas, Alaska and Arizona, and Nevada due to state-specific regulations and coverage differences. Employees located outside of these states may be required to work through a Professional Employer Organization (PEO). 

Our Core Values

If you require support or reasonable accommodation during the application or recruitment process, please submit a request through our Accommodation Request Form.

The OHSU Foundation is an Equal Opportunity Employer 

The OHSU Foundation is committed to being an equal opportunity, affirmative action organization. In keeping with our beliefs and values, no applicant will face discrimination or harassment on the basis of any protected class status, including color, age, current or future military status, disability (physical or mental), gender, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

Title: Tech Governance - Security Compliance & Governance Engineer
Location: Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR; Singapore, Singapore
Description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About the Opportunity

This is not a traditional GRC hire. The Tech Governance Office is looking for someone who combines the governance judgment of a seasoned compliance professional with the drive of a forward-deployed engineer — someone who closes gaps by shipping solutions, navigates ambiguity without hand-holding, and operates with the urgency of a startup and the rigour of a regulated financial institution.
You will own complex cross-functional workstreams independently — coordinating across Engineering, Legal, Product, and Finance — while managing external auditors and regulators. Strong written and verbal communication in both English and Mandarin is a meaningful advantage in this role. AI tooling is not optional; it is how you work.
 

Who You Are

  • Self-directed driver — You run cross-functional workstreams without being managed. Ambiguity is a starting point, not a blocker.
  • AI-native operator — You already use AI to do more, faster — and you raise the floor for the teams around you.
  • Clear communicator — You earn trust across regulators, auditors, and C-suite through precision and consistency — in any room.

Culture Fit

Pace
Standards
Startup velocity — Decisions move fast. Priorities shift. You ship, iterate, and adapt — without waiting for perfect conditions or top-down direction.
Financial institution rigour — Audit trails matter. Regulators scrutinise. The bar for accuracy, documentation, and accountability is institutional-grade — always.
> The tension between these two is not a bug — it is the job. We are looking for someone who holds both without compromise.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Independently lead audit remediation programmes — assess gaps, develop structured plans, and drive verified closure across engineering, product, legal, and operations without escalation dependency.
  • Own cross-functional governance workstreams — set milestones, coordinate accountability, and remove blockers across departments with limited management oversight.
  • Conduct IT security and architecture governance reviews — assess whether systems and processes meet applicable standards, and issue findings with clear ownership and remediation timelines.
  • Build and maintain the policy estate — draft, refine, and operationalise IT governance policies and procedures; translate regulatory requirements into implementation-ready guidance for first-line teams.
  • Lead regulator and auditor engagement — serve as the primary coordination interface for external audit and regulatory correspondence, representing the Tech Governance Office with credibility and precision.
  • Deploy AI to accelerate compliance operations — prototype and scale AI-assisted workflows for evidence collection, control monitoring, audit response, and policy generation; drive team-wide adoption.
  • Deliver Tech Governance-level reporting — produce governance dashboards and executive briefs on remediation status, risk exposure, and regulatory posture, independently and to publication standard.
  • Track the regulatory horizon — monitor evolving requirements across active jurisdictions, translate changes into prioritised internal action, and brief senior leadership proactively.

What We Look For In You

AI Adoption & Application — Must Have

  • Active daily use of AI tools to accelerate compliance and governance work — demonstrated practice with measurable output impact, not theoretical awareness.
  • Ability to identify, build, and scale AI-assisted workflows within a Tech Governance office context — evidence automation, policy generation, audit response, or control monitoring.
  • Working knowledge of AI governance and risk — sufficient to contribute to internal AI oversight frameworks and assess AI-related compliance obligations.

Independent Cross-Functional Leadership — Must Have

  • Demonstrated ability to own and drive complex, multi-stakeholder workstreams independently — setting direction, coordinating accountability, and delivering outcomes without management escalation.
  • Track record of influencing without authority across engineering, legal, finance, and operations in a fast-moving environment.
  • Comfortable operating under ambiguity and shifting priorities while maintaining institutional-grade standards for accuracy and documentation.

Experience

  • 8+ years in IT audit, risk management, compliance, or security governance
  • 3+ years leading governance programmes at a large-scale internet, financial services, or crypto firm
  • Exposure to IPO-readiness or high-scrutiny regulatory examination programmes preferred

Frameworks & Standards

  • ISO 27001, SOC 1/2, PCI-DSS, COBIT, NIST — deep working knowledge
  • GDPR and APAC data protection regimes
  • Crypto and blockchain-specific compliance risk awareness a strong asset

Engineering Sensibility

  • Able to read and interpret code, architecture diagrams, and technical design documents without engineer-translation dependency
  • Familiarity with cloud environments (Alibaba Cloud, AWS, GCP) and associated security tooling

Communication

  • Executive-level written and verbal communication in English — board-ready governance briefs, regulator responses, and Tech Governance-level reporting produced independently
  • Proficiency in Mandarin (written and verbal) is a strong advantage for APAC regulatory and stakeholder engagement
 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional security or governance certification: CISA · CISSP · CRISC · CISM · CCISO · Agentic AI
  • Experience building AI-powered compliance tooling — audit automation, continuous control monitoring, or policy-to-control mapping
  • Prior involvement in SOX ITGC, SEC Reg S-K Item 106, or equivalent listing-authority tech governance programmes
  • Crypto-native compliance exposure — Proof of Reserves, SAB 121, Travel Rule, AML/CFT programme governance
  • Active regulatory footprint across MAS, VARA, FCA, HKMA/SFC, or equivalent

 

Why This Role

OKX operates across 50+ jurisdictions with live regulatory programmes. The Tech Governance Office is building infrastructure-grade compliance capability — not checkbox compliance. This is a rare opportunity to shape how that work gets done: independently, at pace, and with AI at the centre of the method.

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Wellness and meal allowances 
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants 
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!
 

OKX Statement:

OKX is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, genetic information, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, lawful alien status, national origin, age, marital status, and non-job related physical or mental disability, or protected veteran status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Title: Content Creator (Hospitality) 6M+ FTC
Description:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world’s first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences. 

As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. 

Role:  Content Creator

Location:  London, United Kingdom  

 

About the role: 

As Content Creator within the client's team, you'll be responsible for producing and adapting social-first content across platforms and markets — supporting both always-on activity and campaign moments. You'll bring briefs to life efficiently, build modular content systems that scale, and use performance signals to continuously sharpen your output. This is an execution-focused role with real creative scope: you'll concept, shoot (where applicable), edit, and finish content ready for immediate use.

What you will be doing: 

  • Create high-quality social-first content across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, and other key platforms — covering short-form video, static assets, and motion-based content.
  • Turn creative briefs into clear, engaging, platform-native outputs — including captions, hooks, and scripts — quickly and without compromising quality.
  • Develop content ideas that bring the client's brands into relevant cultural and platform moments with authenticity.
  • Build modular content systems — templates, variants, cut-downs, and localisation-ready assets — that can be scaled efficiently across markets.
  • Adapt content for multiple European markets (including UK and France), ensuring cultural relevance, language accuracy, and platform-specific optimisation.
  • Manage content through approval workflows — ensuring all work meets legal, compliance, and brand requirements and is delivered on time.
  • Collaborate closely with Social Media Managers, Strategists, Data Analysts, and Account teams to keep content aligned to both campaign and always-on needs.
  • Use performance data and platform signals — engagement, saves, retention — to refine formats, improve quality, and identify what to scale.
  • Maintain high standards in visual quality, editing, and brand representation, with accessibility and inclusivity considered in every output.
  • Work with creators, influencers, and external partners where relevant.

What you need to be great in this role: 

  • A strong portfolio of social-first content — video and static — produced for consumer brands, ideally in FMCG.
  • Proven skills in concepting, shooting (where applicable), and editing and finishing content for social platforms.
  • Deep, current knowledge of platform best practices across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube Shorts — and a clear understanding of what drives engagement.
  • The ability to work at pace, manage multiple content streams simultaneously, and deliver without compromising craft.
  • Experience working within brand guidelines, approval processes, and multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Proficiency with relevant tools including Adobe Suite, CapCut, Canva, and/or Figma.
  • Proficiency with Gen AI tools relevant to content creation — including ideation support, production speed, versioning, and adaptation workflows.
  • Experience building personal AI workflows to improve efficiency and output quality.
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI outputs and apply strong creative judgement — using AI as a tool, not a shortcut.
  • Agentic approach to creative problem-solving: you break down briefs systematically and find clear, efficient paths to great content.

Description:
ABOUT onX

We’re a team of builders, adventurers, and risk takers using technology to help people confidently explore the outdoors. Driven by our mission to awaken the adventurer inside everyone, we build products that optimize every outdoor experience and inspire confidence to get out and go further.

We’re a high-growth tech company. The pace is fast, the work takes grit, and ambiguity is part of the job. As the world changes around us, we adapt - continuously evolving how we build, prioritize, and deliver.

Our business moves quickly, and there’s real opportunity to shape what we build next. Each of our verticals - Hunt, Offroad, Backcountry, and Fish - is at a different stage of maturity, which means the challenges you encounter and the impact you have will vary depending on where you sit and what the business needs most.

We operate with an experimentation mindset, continually iterating and improving how we solve problems. We expect our people to use the latest tooling, including AI, thoughtfully and responsibly, pairing human judgment with technology to increase quality, speed, and impact.

Our impact comes to life through the products we build, in the stories of our customers, and in our growing commitment to land stewardship and recreational access.

ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY

onX is seeking a Senior Product Manager, Content with a passion for turning offroad customer problems into connected, trustworthy content and data. Your focus will be on Offroad's content and data strategy — defining what data we need to solve customer jobs-to-be-done and how our systems and partnerships bring that data to life, from trail and POI content through third-party and land-manager data. You will be a part of our Offroad Product team, which turns customer research into a product and content roadmap that makes onX Offroad the trusted authority for getting off-road with confidence. This is a great opportunity to be a part of a dynamic, growing company focused on making an impact on the business, and to build the data and content foundation an entire product experience is built on. This role will serve as the strategic owner of Offroad's content and data model, and the direct connective tissue between customer research, third-party/land-manager data, and the Trail Guide contributor community at onX and will report to the Head of Product for Offroad. 

WHAT YOU'LL DO
Essential Job Duties & Functions

  • Own Offroad's content and data strategy — translating customer JTBD (jobs-to-be-done) and market research into a clear point of view on what content (trails, POIs, UGC-sourced conditions, land data, basemaps, and emerging content layers) is needed, and how it should be structured and connected, in close alignment with overall Offroad product strategy.
  • Directly own research and exploration of third-party data, including identifying, evaluating, and prioritizing new external data sources to expand coverage and unlock new capabilities.
  • Partner closely with Product, Design, Engineering, and Content to prioritize the content roadmap and define requirements (data model, schema and UX) that turns content strategy into shipped product.
  • Champion the customer's end-to-end experience with content — thinking beyond the data model and schema to how trail, POI, and land content actually shows up for the off-roader in the field and makes a meaningful difference in their experience
  • Own the measurement and analysis of content’s impact on customer behavior, conversion and ROI, and utilize those insights to inform strategic direction.
  • Build and manage relationships with land management agencies (BLM, USFS, state and local land managers) and other data providers — interpreting regulations, sourcing new data, and negotiating licensing and acquisition agreements.
  • Manage the Trail Guide Program (community and contributed content) through a direct report, setting direction and goals for the program while its Program Owner owns day-to-day execution across contributor acquisition, community management, and trail content delivery.
  • Represent Offroad's content and data roadmap, priorities, and risks to product and cross-functional leadership.
  • Collect and channel market trends, customer feedback, and research to continuously sharpen content and data priorities as the Offroad product evolves.
  • Look for opportunities to embed AI as a repeatable co-pilot in daily workflows by integrating experimentation into real work, and continuously refining its use with sound judgment and validation.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field (Geography, GIS, Business, Data/Analytics) or equivalent experience.
  • Eight (8) or more years of experience leading software products or platforms, including at least four (4) years of product management and three (3) years in content strategy, data management, or program management.
    • Ideally, some of this experience is within geospatial data, outdoor recreation, or consumer technology.
  • Demonstrated experience translating customer needs into content or data-model requirements in partnership with product, design and engineering teams.
  • Demonstrated experience and genuine curiosity about end-user experience and jobs-to-be-done — a track record of thinking beyond the backend data model to how content shows up for and creates value for the customer
  • Genuine, credible ties to the off-road, overlanding, or powersports community.
  • Comfort moving between technical conversations (data models, schemas) and relationship-driven conversations (partners, contributor community) in the same day.
  • Demonstrated people-leadership experience, or a clear track record of directing the work of others without direct authority.
  • A strong curiosity for exploring new technologies, including AI
  • A shared passion for and ability to demonstrate onX’s Company Values.
  • Permanent US work authorization is a condition of employment with onX.
  • Ability to travel quarterly for multiple days to a corporate office or other onX strategic location, such as a Basecamp. 

ADDED BONUSES

Though not required, we would be thrilled to consider candidates with any of the following:

  • Direct experience working with land management agencies (BLM, USFS, state parks) or third-party geospatial data licensing.
  • Experience building and managing external partnerships or data relationships — e.g., government agencies, land managers, or data vendors/licensors.
  • Experience scaling a contributor, community, or ambassador-style program.
  • Familiarity with GIS platforms, geospatial data pipelines, or knowledge-graph/data-model concepts.

THE ONX EXPERIENCE

onX is a distributed company with more than 400 employees across the country. We come together regularly to work in person and stay connected through regional basecamps and a culture that balances individual ownership with deep collaboration.

While we move quickly, we’re not a scrappy start-up. We operate with clear goals, structure, and frameworks that guide how we prioritize and execute. Priorities matter. While they may shift, data shapes how we evolve as our business, products, and the world around us change.

Clear priorities and structure don’t limit ownership - they make it possible. You’ll have the autonomy to define your work and make meaningful decisions within clear strategic boundaries. You’ll partner closely with others to solve complex problems and build solutions that scale across teams and platforms. Along the way, you’ll be supported with feedback, tools, and opportunities to grow your craft as you take on new challenges.

WHERE YOU CAN WORK

onX has created a thriving distributed workforce designed to foster connection, collaboration, and shared experience across several US locations. We have two HQ locations in Bozeman and Missoula, MT and established virtual workforce Basecamps in Austin, TX; Denver, CO; Kalispell, MT; Minneapolis, MN; Portland, OR; Salt Lake City, UT; and Seattle, WA.

HOW YOU’LL BE COMPENSATED

 onX is committed to compensating all employees fairly and equitably for their contributions. For this position, applicants can expect to make between $143,000 and $179,000 upon hire. The pay range will vary based upon experience, skills, certifications, education among other factors as required in the job description. In addition, full-time onX employees are eligible for a grant of common share options with a vesting schedule and an annual bonus of 10% based on company performance.

WHAT WE’RE OFFERING YOU

  • Competitive salaries, annual bonuses, equity, and opportunities for growth
  • Comprehensive health benefits, including a no-monthly-cost medical plan
  • Paid parental leave of 13 weeks for birthing parents and 5 weeks for non-birthing parents
  • 401k matching at 100% for the first 3% you save and 50% from 3-5%
  • Company-wide outdoor adventures and amazing outdoor industry perks
  • Annual “Get Out, Get Active” funds to fuel your active lifestyle
  • Flexible time away package that includes PTO, STO, VTO, and paid holidays

PERFORMANCE ESSENTIALS

In this role, success is driven by cognitive abilities such as concentration and problem-solving, essential for our computer-centric tasks. onX will explore reasonable accommodations to ensure that individuals with diverse abilities can fully engage in and contribute to the essential physical and mental functions of the job. If you need assistance or accommodation, please contact us at PC@onxmaps.com.

Title: Technical Program Manager
Description:
