We are unable to accept applications from individuals residing in countries listed on the Red or Amber list of the Code of Practice for the International Recruitment of Health and Social Care Personnel in England, as defined by the World Health Organisation (WHO) Workforce Support and Safeguard List.

Title: Senior Partner Program Governance Manager
Description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

We are seeking a disciplined, systems-thinker to own the operating model that holds the Global Partner Program Center of Excellence together. This role is the backbone of how Everpure’s partner programs function at scale — ensuring that every program element is governed consistently, compliance is enforced rigorously, and the policies that guide exception decisions are clear, documented, and applied uniformly.

As Senior Partner Program Governance Manager, you will define and maintain the frameworks, policies, and processes that enable the rest of the program team to operate with discipline and confidence. You will not own readiness for each program area — that accountability sits with each program lead — but you will own the governance structure that ensures readiness is defined, measurable, and enforced.

You will work closely with the Resale, Managed Service, and Distribution program leads, as well as Channel Ops, Finance, Legal, and Sales leadership to ensure the partner program operates as a unified, compliant, and auditable system.

This role operates within the overall Global Partner Program Center of Excellence and is expected to operate as part of a coordinated system, not an independent program. You will be accountable for the governance structure and processes that enable consistent and scalable program execution. While you will manage the exception intake, review, and tracking process, final approval authority for program exceptions resides with the Director, Partner Program.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Governance Framework and Operating Model

  • Define and maintain the governance framework for the Global Partner Program Center of Excellence, including RACIs, decision rights, escalation paths, and operating cadences
  • Establish and maintain cross-program standards that ensure consistency across all partner segments and routes-to-market
  • Own the program exception management process, including defining criteria, managing intake and review workflows, and ensuring decisions are documented and tracked. Facilitate decision-making, with final approval authority held by the Director, Partner Programs.
  • Analyze exception trends and identify systemic issues, providing recommendations to program leads and the Director, Partner Program to improve program design and reduce exception volume
  • Drive the program operating cadence including planning cycles, program reviews, and cross-functional alignment forums
  • Define compliance standards and enforcement frameworks, while program leads remain accountable for execution within those standards

Program Compliance

  • Define and maintain compliance standards across all partner program elements, ensuring consistent and auditable enforcement
  • Monitor partner compliance against program requirements and work with program leads to address gaps
  • Partner with Channel Ops on operational compliance tracking and reporting
  • Escalate material compliance issues and recommend corrective action where needed

Policy Design and Documentation

  • Own the design and maintenance of all partner program policies, including eligibility, tier transitions, exception rules, and enforcement guidelines
  • Establish and maintain the single source of truth for all program documentation, requirements, and policies across the Center of Excellence
  • Ensure all program documentation is current, accessible, and clearly written for internal and external audiences
  • Identify gaps and inconsistencies across program policies and drive resolution in collaboration with program leads

Launch Readiness Framework

  • Define and maintain the program launch readiness framework — the gate criteria, checklist, and review process that each program lead is accountable for completing before any program change goes live
  • Conduct pre-launch governance reviews with each program lead to confirm readiness criteria have been met
  • Document launch reviews and maintain a record of readiness confirmations and approvals
  • Continuously improve the readiness framework based on lessons learned from each program launch
  • Ensure readiness standards are consistently applied across all program areas, while program leads remain accountable for meeting those requirements

Cross-Functional Alignment and Reporting

  • Serve as the program team’s primary liaison on governance and compliance matters with Legal, Finance, Channel Ops, and Sales leadership
  • Provide regular reporting on governance health, compliance status, and exception trends to program leadership
  • Support audit and regulatory inquiries related to partner program compliance as needed
  • Identify opportunities to simplify and streamline governance processes without sacrificing rigor

WHAT YOU’LL BRING…

  • 8+ years of experience in channel programs, partner operations, or compliance within a technology company
  • Proven experience building governance frameworks, compliance processes, or operating models in a complex, cross-functional environment
  • Strong understanding of channel program structures, partner compliance dynamics, and exception management
  • Exceptional attention to detail with the ability to design policies that are clear, consistent, and auditable
  • Strong process orientation with the ability to create structure and discipline without creating unnecessary bureaucracy
  • Ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders across Legal, Finance, Channel Ops, and Sales
  • Strong written communication skills with the ability to produce clear, concise, and professional program documentation
  • Ability to hold others accountable to standards while maintaining strong working relationships
  • Experience in a high-growth, fast-paced technology company where ambiguity is common and execution discipline is critical

 

 

Salary ranges are determined based on role, level and location. For positions open to candidates in multiple geographical locations, the base salary range is reflective of the labor market across the applicable locations. 

This role may be eligible for incentive pay and/or equity. 

There is no application deadline and we accept applications on an ongoing basis until the job is filled.

The annual base salary range is:
$182,000—$273,000 USD

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:

  • Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
  • Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
  • Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.

ACCOMMODATIONS AND ACCESSIBILITY:

Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at TA-Ops@purestorage.com if you’re invited to an interview.

OUR COMMITMENT TO A STRONG AND INCLUSIVE TEAM:

We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.

Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire.

Join us and bring your best.

Bring your bold.

Pure and simple.

Title: Distribution Program Manager
Description:

THE ROLE

We are seeking a strategic and execution-oriented leader to own Everpure’s global Distribution Program Manager— end to end. This role is responsible for designing how distribution operates within the Everpure partner ecosystem and then making that design real. You will own not just the strategy, but the outcomes.

As Distribution Partner Program Manager, you will define the structure, economics, and operating model for our global distributor program — and you will be fully accountable for bringing it to life. That means designing the program, driving its operationalization, ensuring field adoption, and measuring its effectiveness. Strategy without execution is not enough in this role.

You will work closely with Distribution Account Managers (DAMs), Partner Account Managers (PAMs), Partner Sales Managers (PSMs), Finance, Channel Ops, Marketing, Enablement, and Sales leadership to ensure the program reflects how distributors sell, deliver, and scale in the market — and that it drives the behaviors aligned to Everpure’s growth priorities.

This role operates within the overall Global Partner Program Center of Excellence and is expected to operate as part of a coordinated system, not an independent program. You will be accountable for defining and executing the distribution program within that framework — translating strategy into a program that works in the field and delivers measurable outcomes.

This role owns the program — the design, economics, and framework that govern how distribution partners engage with Everpure. Distributor relationships are owned and managed by Distribution Account Managers (DAMs) within the GPO Field organization; this role partners closely with DAMs but does not carry direct relationship ownership.

LOCATION: This role is located in Santa Clara, California and is required to be in the office five days a week.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Program Design and Evolution

  • Define and continuously evolve the global distribution partner program, including structure, tier requirements, partner benefits, and distributor expectations
  • Design the distribution program within the strategic direction and guardrails set by the Director, Partner Program
  • Conduct competitive analyses to ensure the Everpure distribution program remains differentiated and compelling in the market
  • Document current-state vs. future-state program design and maintain a clear roadmap of improvements and investments

Program Economics and Incentives

  • Design, execute, and optimize distribution economic models and incentives within the overall investment strategy, including customized partner investment frameworks for top distributors
  • Define customized distribution investment frameworks with clear milestones and measurable outcomes tied to distributor performance and Everpure business priorities
  • Ensure incentive structures reward higher-value contributions from distribution
  • Maintain a strong command of pricing models and discount structures to ensure alignment with distribution strategy

Program Operationalization and Launch Readiness

  • Own end-to-end operationalization of distribution program elements — not just the design, but the delivery
  • Partner cross-functionally with Channel Ops, IT, Finance, Enablement, and Marketing to ensure systems, processes, tools, and content are ready before any program change goes live
  • Drive launch readiness for your program area: documentation, communications, enablement assets, and internal alignment must be complete and confirmed prior to launch
  • Establish and maintain a single source of truth for distribution program requirements, policies, and documentation

Governance, Compliance, and Performance

  • Ensure program compliance for distribution in alignment with standards defined by the Program Governance & Compliance Lead
  • Define and track success criteria, metrics, and KPIs to measure program effectiveness and distributor performance
  • Use performance data to continuously improve program design and investment decisions
  • Participate in governance reviews and cross-program coordination to ensure consistency across the Global Partner Program Center of Excellence
  • Partner with the Program Governance & Compliance Lead to ensure adherence to program policies and escalate exception requests through the defined governance process

Field Alignment and Adoption

  • Partner closely with DAMs, PAMs, and PSMs as the primary program resource — providing the frameworks, policies, and tools that enable them to manage distributor relationships effectively
  • Gather and synthesize field and partner feedback to continuously inform program evolution
  • Drive partner and field adoption of program elements and ensure the program is understood, actionable, and impactful in real-world execution
  • We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Santa Clara office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 8+ years of experience in partner programs, channel strategy, distribution management, or go-to-market roles within a technology company
  • Proven track record of designing and operationalizing distribution or channel programs that deliver measurable business outcomes
  • Strong understanding of distribution business models, including rebates, pricing, discounting, and operational structures
  • Experience building and optimizing incentive models with clear ROI outcomes
  • Demonstrated ability to own both strategy and execution — this role requires you to think and do

Title: Manufacturing Technical Program Manager / Quality Engineer (Heat Pumps FATP)
Description:
Manufacturing Technical Program Manager / Quality Engineer
(Heat Pumps FATP)

 

As the Manufacturing Technical Program Manager / Quality Engineer in the Hardware Operations team, you will be responsible for ensuring the highest quality standards for mid to high-volume production of our heat pump units. This role focuses on the Final Assembly, Test, and Pack (FATP) stages, overseeing in-process quality and the transition from the assembly line to the customer.

The ideal candidate brings deep hands-on experience in high-volume electromechanical assembly, rigorous yield management, and a proactive approach to driving quality improvements within a Contract Manufacturing (CM) environment. You will be driving the technical aspect of production and the primary gatekeeper for fully assembled units, ensuring that every heat pump meeting our customers’ hands is defect-free. 

Key Responsibilities

Production & Yield Management

  • Drive production yield: Monitor daily production yield and lead the "Top Yield Hitters" forum with the CM factory team to identify, contain, and resolve the primary drivers of fallout. You have the authority to pause production on high fallout and convene the team for resolution before restarting. Own first pass yield, the failure Pareto, and reporting.
  • In-process quality control (IPQC): Oversee the effectiveness of in-process stations, ensuring assembly and test processes adhere to established standards.
  • Yield reporting: Maintain real-time quality dashboards and provide detailed yield analysis to leadership, highlighting trends and risks.

Production Test

  • Station bring-up and qualification: Lead bring up and qualification of end-of-line test stations at the CM, including capability studies and golden unit correlation before a station is released to production.
  • Test limits and coverage: Own pass/fail limits and their traceability to product specification.  Confirm the test suite detects the failure modes identified in the PFMEA and close coverage gaps when defects escape.
  • Failure triage and station health: Triage test failures, separating true failures from false rejects and retest passes. Maintain calibration and preventive maintenance schedules, and ensure test results are traceable to each unit's serial number.

Process Control & Documentation

  • Control Plans & PFMEA: Develop, maintain, and audit Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) and Control Plans so that all critical-to-quality (CTQ) parameters are mitigated.
  • Documentation: Keep final product inspection standards and SOPs current. Ensure SOPs capture all corrective actions arising from production, supplier, and field quality issues, and update PFMEAs and Control Plans accordingly.
  • Continuous improvement: Lead improvement initiatives on the factory floor using Lean and Six Sigma methods to reduce variability and scrap.

Quality Assurance & Out-of-Box Audit

  • OBA & sampling: Manage the Out-of-Box Audit process and sampling inspections for fully assembled units to validate the customer view of quality.
  • Root cause analysis: Investigate assembly-level failures and drive corrective actions (8D, CAPA) with CM production and engineering teams.
  • Cross-functional liaison: Act as the primary feedback loop to Design Engineering and Supplier Quality Engineering (SQE), reporting issues found during assembly that stem from design flaws or incoming material (IQC) defects. Where needed, support supplier development and work directly with vendors.
  • Shop Floor and Traceability:  Work closely with process engineers to make sure CM has proper traceability for the product as it flows through the production line. Good documentation of serialization.

Field Returns & Failure Analysis

  • RMA lead: Drive failure analysis of field-returned product with the CM. Determine root cause and drive corrective actions at the factory, or work with SQE to drive improvements at the supplier facility.
  • Containment: Manage containment at the CM for any finished goods requiring re-inspection prior to shipment.

NPI & Line Readiness

  • NPI transition: Own the quality side of the transition from NPI to mass production, working with process and test engineering counterparts to confirm line readiness — validated assembly fixtures, test stations, and operator instructions.
  • Fixture assessment: Review and approve assembly fixtures and measurement tools for repeatability and reproducibility (Gage R&R).
  • Shop floor traceability: Work with the process engineer to confirm the CM maintains proper traceability and serialization documentation as product flows through the line.

 

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Experience: 5–10 years in manufacturing quality or process engineering, specifically in mid- to high-volume electromechanical assembly.
  • Technical Skills:
    • Proficiency in PFMEA, Control Plans, and SPC.
    • Strong understanding of assembly processes, including leak testing, electrical safety testing, and functional performance testing.
    • Experience managing Contract Manufacturers (CM) and driving accountability within their factory teams.
    • Measurements: Experience using tools like calipers, feeler gages, CMM, OMM, colorimeter, etc.
    • Good knowledge of cosmetics requirements and color matching
    • Hands-on experience qualifying end-of-line test stations and owning test limits, including capability studies and distinguishing genuine failures from test escapes and false rejects.
  • Analytical Skills: Expert-level root cause analysis skills and the ability to interpret complex data sets to drive prioritized action plans.
  • Communication: Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to bridge the gap between factory floor operations and supplier quality/design teams. Certifications: Six Sigma Green/Black Belt or ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) is a plus
  • Communication: Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to bridge factory floor operations and supplier quality/design teams. Fluent English for overseas meetings and report-outs.
  • Travel: Will mainly be at CM factory during builds but maybe be tasked to visit supplier facilities to drive quality improvement of issues

Preferred

  • Language: Chinese language skills strongly preferred, to enable direct communication with CM factory staff.
  • HVAC or consumer electronics manufacturing experience.
  • Six Sigma Green or Black Belt, or ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE).
  • Experience standing up a quality program at a new CM or on a new line.

Title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Performance
Description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

We are looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager, Performance to lead company-wide programs that improve the speed, reliability, and quality of Reddit’s user experience. This role will partner with engineering leaders in product engineering, infrastructure, client platforms, data science, and senior technical leadership to make performance a measurable, durable, and consistently protected part of how Reddit builds and ships software.

Performance is foundational to user trust, engagement, and long-term growth. This role will help Reddit build the path for sustained performance improvement: broad enough to work across platforms and organizations, focused enough to address current issues, and measurable enough to prove whether we are improving the lived experience of users. Just as importantly, this role will help bring teams along for that change, building trust across functions and helping Reddit evolve how we make performance part of our engineering culture.

Who We Are

At Reddit, Technical Program Managers use technical judgment to define and drive large programs across multiple teams. They partner closely with engineering and product leaders to develop strategies and solutions, drive project impact, execute on planning, and gain alignment with cross-functional stakeholders. They engage with teams to determine root causes, identify and select alternative solutions, and use their technical expertise to understand the effects, impacts, and risks of a solution. Above and beyond program-level impact, they build execution processes and reduce inefficiencies to build overall scale.

This role reports into the TPM team within Reddit's Engineering Operations organization. As a Principal TPM, you will operate at executive and company scope, shaping strategy across multiple organizations, creating alignment where ownership is ambiguous, and setting the bar for how Reddit executes complex technical programs. High-quality technical program management is a distinct and high-value skill set, and while this role does not involve direct people management, it is part of Reddit's organizational leadership. At this level, success means delivering programs while also changing how teams think, collaborate, and make decisions so that new systems, standards, and behaviors can take root across the company.

What You'll Do

You will own and drive programs across Reddit's Performance portfolio, spanning mobile and web performance, client reliability, critical user journeys, observability, experimentation guardrails, release quality, and long-term performance operating mechanisms. You will partner deeply with engineering teams as a technical peer, not from the stratosphere, but in the details, bringing programs to completion, balancing risk across systems and organizations, and ensuring execution stays aligned to Reddit's long-term performance strategy.

In this role, you will:

  • Partner with Client Platforms, product engineering, Infrastructure, data science, and senior technical leaders to translate performance strategy into executable programs across mobile, web, and shared platform systems.
  • Define and drive the operating model for sustained performance improvement, including how teams prioritize work, how success is measured, how regressions are prevented, and how risks are escalated or resolved.
  • Drive the organizational change required for performance to become a durable part of Reddit’s engineering culture, moving teams from reactive efforts to shared standards and repeatable mechanisms.
  • Develop communication and enablement mechanisms that bring engineers and leaders along for the journey, including leadership forums, working groups, documentation, decision reviews, and clear narratives that connect performance work to user and business outcomes.
  • Build measurement systems that distinguish real user experience improvement from shallow metric movement.
  • Drive performance governance and adoption in a way that preserves team ownership while ensuring user experience, reliability, release quality, experimentation discipline, and business guardrails are not afterthoughts.
  • Use technical judgment to challenge assumptions, identify systemic risks, and guide tradeoffs across client architecture, observability, experimentation, release health, and production reliability.

Who You Are

  • You have 14+ years of experience across technical program management, engineering, infrastructure, client platforms, mobile or web platforms, performance engineering, reliability, observability, or related technical domains.
  • You have led multi-year, multi-organization technical programs with executive visibility and ambiguous ownership. You are comfortable operating with senior executives while still understanding the technical details that make or break execution.
  • You have deep fluency in performance and reliability systems: client platforms, app health, observability, experimentation, release quality, user journey measurement, infrastructure, or production readiness.
  • You understand performance beyond individual metrics. You can reason about user experience, platform tradeoffs, technical debt, regression prevention, and the organizational mechanisms required to make improvements last.
  • You are highly data-driven, but skeptical of shallow metrics. You know how to build measurement systems that connect technical improvements to user, business, and engineering outcomes.
  • You are an exceptional cross-functional operator and communicator. You bring people together, create clarity through the right leadership channels, build trust across functions, and translate complex technical and organizational change into clear narratives.
  • You have led meaningful organizational change, not just program execution. You know how to shift behavior across teams by listening to concerns, creating shared language, and making the desired path easier than the status quo.
  • You get things done. You are not satisfied with status reporting, process theater, or activity metrics. You land outcomes and help teams understand the difference between motion and impact.
  • You are pragmatic and iterative. You can introduce structure without making teams feel constrained.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading performance, reliability, client platform, mobile platform, web platform, infrastructure modernization, observability, or experimentation programs at large scale.
  • Experience with mobile or web performance, including app startup, rendering, media delivery, networking, caching, crashes, hangs, release quality, or user journey performance.
  • Experience building durable operating mechanisms after incident, war room, or Code Yellow style mobilizations.
  • Experience with experimentation systems, holdouts, guardrail metrics, and tradeoff decisions where user experience, engagement, and business metrics need to be evaluated together.
  • Experience building adoption strategies for internal platforms, observability systems, performance tooling, or engineering practices.
  • Experience working in fast-moving environments where technical strategy, organizational design, and execution mechanisms are evolving at the same time.

  • Family Planning Support
  • Gender-Affirming Care

  • Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off
  • Generous Paid Parental Leave

Title: Principal Technical Writer - Customer Onboarding
Description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

We are looking for a Principal Technical Writer to lead the strategy and execution of our customer onboarding and 'Getting Started' content. Your mission is to transform our onboarding materials into a cohesive, narrative-driven experience that guides users to their first 'aha!' moment. You will partner closely with the Self-Service (SSC) team, acting as a bridge between the field, product, and documentation to ensure our content is not just accurate, but effective at guiding trial-to-paid conversion. In this role, you will define the narrative architecture of our user journey, ensuring that every touchpoint, from first-time setup to advanced feature adoption, feels like a seamless, intentional story. You'll be the champion of the new-user experience, working in lockstep with others to turn technical capability into user success.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Align Field, Product, and Docs. Act as a central point of contact for stakeholders. Work with Product teams to understand roadmap changes, Field teams to identify friction points in real-world deployments, and Documentation teams to ensure high-quality content output.
  • Design user-focused flows. Create organized onboarding experiences. These should highlight best practices, troubleshooting, and clear next steps. Avoid confusing 'choose-your-own-adventure' methods.
  • Measure and Iterate. Use user research, support feedback, and telemetry to identify where users stall and iterate on content to reduce churn and improve time-to-first-value.

  • Cross-functional leadership. Proven ability to lead initiatives and influence stakeholders across product, engineering, and sales/field organizations.
  • Deep narrative skills. Experience in creating compelling, cohesive stories for complex technical products.
  • Data-driven mindset. Comfortable using analytics, UXR, and support data to inform documentation decisions and prioritize work.
  • Collaborative spirit. Experience working in large, distributed organizations where alignment across multiple teams is critical to success.

Title: Manager, Process & Content
Description:
Roadie, a UPS company, is a leading logistics and delivery platform that helps businesses tackle the complexities of modern retail with unmatched delivery coverage, flexibility and visibility. Reaching 97% of U.S. households across more than 30,000 zip codes — from urban hubs to rural communities — Roadie provides seamless, scalable solutions that meet a variety of delivery needs.

With a network of more than 310,000 independent drivers nationwide, Roadie offers flexible delivery solutions that make complex logistics challenges easy, including solutions for local same-day delivery, delivery of big and bulky items, ship-from-store and DC-to-door. For more information, visit www.roadie.com.

The Manager, Process & Content will lead a team focused on translating operations and evolving business needs to clear, scalable workflows and content. This role owns the end-to-end lifecycle of agent-facing process documentation, internal knowledge base content, and external help center content for Roadie's Customer Experience (CX) contact center - from process discovery and mapping through content creation, governance, and version control. This work will help our internal and BPO agents deliver a consistent, accurate, current, and accessible Roadie experience across voice, chat, and email support.

What You’ll Do

  • Build, lead and develop the CX Process and Content teams, setting clear priorities and standards and coaching team members for growth
  • Own SOP creation and maintenance for agent-facing processes, applying the tiered SOP framework for consistency and readability
  • Oversee process mapping and documentation (e.g., using tools like Whimsical) to translate informal practices into formal, structured operational workflows across CX segments
  • Manage the end-to-end content lifecycle (creation, review/approval, publishing, maintenance, and retirement) for internal knowledge base articles, job aids, reference materials, and external help center content 
  • Own knowledge base strategy and platform management (e.g., Salesforce) across both internal and external content, including structure, searchability, and content lifecycle
  • Establish and enforce documentation governance: version control, review cadence, approval workflows, and retirement of outdated content
  • Define, track, and report on key documentation health and success metrics (e.g., usage, findability, deflection, staleness) to drive continuous improvement, keeping stakeholders informed of risks and progress
  • Partner with the Training Delivery/Instructional Design Manager to ensure process and content changes are reflected in curriculum and nesting materials without duplication of effort
  • Partner with Quality to turn QA findings, process gaps and other friction points into clearer processes and content
  • Manage BPO-facing process and content updates, from communication through implementation, ensuring parity and compliance across BPO partner sites
  • Partner cross-functionally with stakeholders such as CX leadership, Product, and Marketing to stay ahead of upcoming changes (feature launches, policy updates) that require new or updated process documentation and knowledge base content

What You Bring

  • 3+ years leading process and content functions in a contact center environment
  • Experience supporting outsourced services or BPO operations, maintaining consistent processes and content 
  • Strong experience in knowledge base/content strategy, including managing knowledge base platforms (e.g., Salesforce), for both internal and customer-facing content
  • Experience measuring and reporting on the effectiveness of processes and knowledge base/help center content, leveraging data to prioritize improvements
  • Excellent people leadership background, bringing coaching and prioritization experience to support a scaling team

Title: Senior Technical Program Manager II
Description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

SPACE SYSTEMS

Rocket Lab’s Space Systems division builds complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space including solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, and radios.

The Space Systems division has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. We have built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help get to space — our Space Systems division is empowering the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

SENIOR TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER II

Rocket Lab Optical Systems solves mission-critical space domain and Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance challenges for Department of Defense and Intelligence Community customers. Our vision is to revolutionize the space-based payload market with innovative and novel designs for space, terrestrial, and airborne environments. Building on more than 20 years of electro-optical and infrared systems innovation from Geost, Rocket Lab Optical Systems delivers solutions to the warfighter for responsive, scalable sensing solutions across all orbital domains.

As a Senior Technical Program Manager II for Rocket Lab Optical Systems in Tucson, AZ, you will lead EO/IR space missions and ground-based sensor networks, and the research. You must possess experience in managing programs including electronics, software, and EO/IR sensors on space or ground systems.

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO:

  • Manage multiple contracts, ensuring cost, risk, schedule, staffing resources, and technical performance of company programs or subsystems of major programs, addressing any issues or risks that arise
  • Identify and mitigate potential risks to programs, develop contingency plans, develop and execute recovery plans, ensure timely resolution of issues, and track financial impacts
  • Work on unusually complex technical problems and provide innovative solutions
  • Lead team(s) of engineers in planning and executing test events and resolving issues encountered, both operational and technical
  • Work proactively to complete tasks and meet assigned deadlines with little direction
  • Build and deliver effective presentations to communicate program status and plans with little direction
  • Communicate effectively with team members across disciplines, with project management, and particularly with customers
  • Maintain clear and consistent communication and foster strong relationships with a wide range of internal stakeholders, particularly with functional teams and executive leadership
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with key customers, partners, and stakeholders
  • Lead program and customer meetings and reviews
  • Lead technical interchange meetings with the team members and other project personnel and represent the organization in matters pertaining to project development
  • Lead and mentor junior technical staff and program support resources, providing guidance and support as needed
  • Develop and closely track Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) for projects and manage Earned Value Management (EVM) metrics (as required)
  • Support, and influence/lead where required, proposal and ECP efforts
  • Support travel or off-site work as needed
  • Perform other duties as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS YOU’LL BRING AS SENIOR TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER II:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, or technical discipline
  • 8+ years of experience in managing technical projects for the US Government
  • Proven ability to lead a team to the completion of program and project milestones
  • Hands-on expertise with active optical systems
  • Experience with space EO payloads, test plan development, astronomy, physics, electronics, software, and/or remote sensing
  • Active Secret clearance with TS/SCI eligibility 
  • U.S citizenship is required, due to program requirements

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

  • Current SSBI clearance
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Self-motivated and capable of performing tasks with minimal oversight
  • Superior oral and written communication skills and sound problem-solving skills
  • Continuous improvement mindset and high attention to detail and accuracy
  • Experience performing and working in a dynamic and high-visibility role
  • Excellent management skills, including the ability to prioritize tasks, manage resources, and deliver results within given constraints
  • Internship or research experience supporting aerospace, defense, or optics-related projects
  • Exposure to MBSE concepts and tools such as Cameo Systems Modeler
  • Familiarity with environmental testing flight hardware
  • Experience with configuration management practices and systems engineering documentation
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including use of formulas and data analysis tools
  • Knowledge of astronomy, physics, imaging systems, or remote sensing

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.

WHAT TO EXPECT 

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

Title: Content Lead
Location: New York, New York, United States
Description:
The first baby boomers turn 80 this year. Over the next decade, the population most likely to need daily care will grow faster than the buildings, the staff, or the systems available to serve it.

Sage is the care intelligence platform for senior living and skilled nursing. We connect the hardware senior care runs on, including nurse call, fall management, and wander management, with software caregivers actually use. That consistent use is what produces reliable data, and reliable data is what gives operators a true picture of how their communities are running.

Sage is a collaborative team of ambitious, multi-disciplinary entrepreneurs on a mission to reinvent senior care with a modern operating system for caregivers. Millions of people depend on this care getting better, and we move with the urgency that deserves.

About this Role

As a Content Lead, you will define and own Sage's content strategy, then execute against it through compelling, narrative driven storytelling that drives brand awareness, educates our audiences, and fuels growth. This is a hands-on role that owns content end to end, from strategy and planning through writing, editing, distribution, and measuring content performance. You will also lead our Social Media Manager, ensuring our social channels consistently reflect Sage's brand, voice, and content strategy while maximizing audience engagement.

Success in this role depends on three things above all: being strategic enough to define what content should exist and why before determining how to execute it, being a strong communicator who can translate complex healthcare and technology topics into content that is clear and engaging, and being comfortable operating in ambiguity within a fast paced, mission driven environment where you are building process as you go.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain our overarching content strategy across audiences and formats (web, email, blog, social, long-form, and more).
  • Own content calendars and campaign planning in collaboration with marketing, product, and GTM teams.
  • Define and execute Sage's SEO and generative engine optimization (GEO) strategy to increase discoverability across search engines and AI-powered platforms.
  • Create and manage high-quality editorial content—from thought leadership to case studies, newsletters to landing pages.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to align content with business goals, voice, and positioning.
  • Measure content performance, uncover audience insights, and continuously optimize content strategy based on data.
  • Lead and mentor the Social Media Manager, setting the strategy for Sage's social channels and ensuring content is aligned with our brand, voice, and business objectives.
  • Uphold and evolve Sage's brand voice while managing freelance writers, agencies, and other creative partners as needed.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 4-6+ years of experience in content strategy, brand storytelling, or editorial leadership.
  • Demonstrated ability to craft thoughtful, strategic content across digital channels.
  • Strong writing and editing skills, with a portfolio that shows both creativity and clarity.
  • Experience working in fast-growing, cross-functional teams—particularly in mission-driven or healthcare-related companies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Preference for B2B experience. Open to D2C, but need to have reported into the Marketing function
  • Background in brand development or content design, or experience in virtual healthcare, wellness, or adjacent sectors.

Benefits and Pay

Our headquarters are located near New York City's Union Square. We believe in cross team collaboration. We think good ideas can come from anyone, and we've designed our processes to encourage participation from all. While we take our mission seriously, we don't take ourselves too seriously. We like to host offsites, outings, and team meals where we can connect as people, not just as colleagues. We offer office lunch and a fully stocked snack bar. While we are an in office culture, we allow up to 2 remote days per week.

Our benefits package for employees includes competitive base compensation along with stock options. The expected annual salary range for this role is $155,000-195,000 USD, depending upon the job level, which will depend on your level of expertise, your experience, and your qualifications. We also provide fully-paid health and dental insurance coverage for all of our employees, along with other health benefits including vision insurance, membership to premium primary and urgent care, and online medical health providers. We also have a take as you need time off policy, in addition to 7 paid holidays and a company wide winter break during the holidays.

Title: Technical Program Manager, Federal Deployment and Authorization (DHS/CBP)
Description:
About Sayari: 

Sayari is the judgment infrastructure for trustworthy AI in economic security and commercial risk. The Sayari Commercial World Model resolves 11.7B+ primary-source records from 250+ jurisdictions forming the ground truth of global commerce. A Judgment Ontology, encoding over a decade of investigative tradecraft, and Superconductor, an agentic orchestration platform, deliver AI that reasons like an expert analyst, shows its work, and traces every finding to its source. Trusted by U.S. Customs and Border Protection, HM Revenue & Customs, and Fortune 500 enterprises, Sayari is used by thousands of professionals across 35+ countries to secure supply chains and dismantle illicit networks. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., with offices in London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Tel Aviv.

Technical Program Manager, Federal Deployment and Authorization (DHS/CBP)

Sayari  •  Government Solutions  •  Washington, DC

About Sayari

Sayari is the judgment infrastructure for trustworthy AI in economic security and commercial risk. The Sayari Commercial World Model resolves 10.6B+ primary-source records from 250+ jurisdictions forming the ground truth of global commerce. A Judgment Ontology, encoding over a decade of investigative tradecraft, and Superconductor, an agentic orchestration platform, deliver AI that reasons like an expert analyst, shows its work, and traces every finding to its source. Trusted by U.S. Customs and Border Protection, the U.S. Treasury, and Fortune 500 enterprises, Sayari is used by thousands of professionals across 35+ countries to secure supply chains and dismantle illicit networks. Headquartered in Washington, D.C.

Position Description

Sayari is hiring a Technical Program Manager to own delivery of an enterprise program deploying the Sayari Platform inside U.S. Customs and Border Protection. The program has two parallel tracks: configuring the platform for CBP mission workflows, and taking the system through the DHS security authorization process (Authority to Operate) so it can process live government data. You own the plan, the dependencies, and the accountability for both.

Federal deployments take several forms: a Sayari-operated enclave in a government cloud region, a deployment into an agency-provisioned cloud tenancy, or an on-premises installation. Each changes who provides the security controls, who may access the environment, what personnel security is required, and how long authorization takes. You will build the schedule around those tradeoffs.

Senior individual contributor based in the Washington, D.C. area. Expect to be on-site at CBP [2 to 3 days per week], more during kickoff and assessment fieldwork. Much of the job is producing documents the government will read, sign, or act on, so clear writing matters. Reports to the SVP of Government Solutions and Services.

How This Role Fits the Team

  • Forward Deployed Engineers configure the platform, write infrastructure-as-code, build the agents that automate CBP workflows, and implement technical controls.
  • The Account Executive owns the commercial relationship, executive sponsorship, and expansion.
  • You turn contract obligations into a plan and the plan into weekly accountability for Sayari, subcontractors, and the government. In every CBP working session, you convert open questions into written decisions with an owner and a date.

Job Responsibilities

Program Ownership

  • Integrated program plan: Build and maintain the master schedule for deployment and authorization: work breakdown, critical path, dependencies, and explicit allowances for each government-side gate.
  • Contract delivery: Own scope, schedule, and contractual milestones from award through go-live. Track every deliverable, key personnel requirement, and reporting obligation.
  • Deployment model decisions: Lead the analysis of hosting and boundary options with Sayari Security, Infrastructure, and the FDE team. Present the tradeoffs to CBP and Sayari leadership and drive a decision.

Security Authorization (ATO)

  • Run the authorization program: Own Sayari's side of the NIST Risk Management Framework process under DHS policy, from kickoff to ATO letter. Sequence and track every package artifact, from categorization and System Security Plan through Security Assessment Report and POA&Ms.
  • Coordinate the producers: Partner with the Sayari Security team, who own control implementation and package content, and with Infrastructure and the FDEs, who build the environment the package describes.
  • Manage the assessors: Contract and manage the independent third-party assessor. Schedule a readiness review before formal fieldwork, close remediation before submission, and keep the government's Security Control Assessor engaged throughout.
  • Work the government gates: Coordinate with the CBP System Owner, ISSO, ISSM, CISO, Privacy Office, and Authorizing Official through document review and the authorization decision.
  • Ongoing authorization: After the ATO, establish the continuous monitoring, change control, POA&M, and annual assessment cadence, then hand it to a steady-state owner.

Compliance Workstreams

  • Privacy: Coordinate the Privacy Threshold Analysis, Privacy Impact Assessment, and System of Records Notice determinations, and deliver the technical content (data elements, flows, retention, retrieval paths) the government needs to complete them.
  • Accessibility: Manage Section 508 conformance: Trusted Tester coverage, test plan and results, remediation, and the Accessibility Conformance Report.
  • Operational obligations: Security operations and monitoring arrangements, incident reporting timelines, supply chain and software attestations, and government-furnished information handling.

Personnel Security

  • Clearance pipeline: Own pre-screening, background investigation tracking, reciprocity, badging, and system access for every Sayari and subcontractor person on the program. Plan work around who is cleared to touch which environment on which date.

Government Stakeholder Management

  • Accountability: Build working relationships across CBP program, technical, security, privacy, contracting, and cloud governance offices. Run the recurring cadence, keep a shared action log, follow up on government-side actions, and put the schedule impact of any slip in writing.

Internal Coordination

  • Single source of truth: Maintain the plan, risk register, dependency map, decision log, and status reporting for Sayari leadership and the government.
  • Requirements to work: Map CBP mission workflows to platform capabilities with the FDE team, then scope and sequence the engineering work.

Skills & Experience

Required

  • 7+ years delivering technology programs for U.S. federal customers, including at least one system you personally took through a federal security authorization (ATO) to a signed letter.
  • Working knowledge of FISMA, the NIST Risk Management Framework, NIST SP 800-53, and the authorization package artifacts. Able to read a Security Requirements Traceability Matrix and assign ownership across engineering, security, and the government.
  • Experience with at least one federal deployment model: vendor-operated government cloud (AWS GovCloud, Azure Government), agency-provisioned cloud tenancy, or on-premises secure environment.
  • Program management fundamentals: integrated master schedules, critical path analysis, risk registers, action and decision logs, and executive and customer reporting. Experience coordinating personnel security (background investigations, badging, system access) for a contractor team.
  • Technical fluency without writing code: architecture, authorization boundaries, data flows, infrastructure-as-code, and change control.
  • A record of holding government stakeholders you do not manage to commitments, with patience and documentation.
  • U.S. citizenship and ability to obtain and maintain the DHS/CBP background investigation required for the role (Tier 4 or Tier 5). Lawful permanent resident status does not meet DHS requirements for this position.

Preferred

  • Current DHS or CBP background investigation, suitability determination, or clearance.
  • Prior DHS or CBP program delivery, including DHS 4300A policy, the DHS security authorization process, and the DHS Trusted Tester methodology.
  • Federal privacy compliance (PTA, PIA, SORN) and Section 508 experience.
  • Familiarity with CBP trade and customs workflows or import and export risk analysis.
  • Familiarity with agentic AI platforms, large language models, or graph analytics.
  • PMP, PgMP, CGRC, or CISSP certification.
  • Experience at a high-growth government or defense technology company.

Compensation

The target base salary for this position is $180,000 - $228,000 plus bonus and equity. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, candidate experience and expertise, internal peer equity, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Benefits

  • 100% fully paid medical, vision, and dental for employees and their dependents
  • Generous time off: we observe all US federal holidays, close our office for a winter break (12/24–12/31), and grant 18 PTO days and 10 sick days
  • Outstanding compensation package: competitive commissions for revenue roles and bonuses for non-revenue positions
  • A strong commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion
  • Eligibility to participate in additional benefits such as 401k match up to 5%, 100% paid life insurance (up to $100,000 coverage), and parental leave
  • A collaborative and positive culture: your team will be as smart and driven as you
  • Limitless growth and learning opportunities

Equal Opportunity

Sayari is an equal opportunity employer and strongly encourages diverse candidates to apply. We believe diversity and inclusion mean our team members should reflect the diversity of the United States. No employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on race, color, ethnicity, religion, age, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability status, veteran status, genetics, or political affiliation. We strongly encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply.

Pay Range: $180,000 - $228,000

Title: Data Governance Expert
Description:
Scopely is seeking a highly motivated Data Governance Expert to join our Playgami team in Barcelona!

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to encourage play every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people worldwide daily.

Playgami is building the best SaaS gaming platform ever! The team strives to build the world’s best products for game production, operation, and insights. Powering many award-winning, loved-by-millions franchise games over mobile, web, and PC.

 

What You’ll Do

This role is for an expert who can build and run an enterprise-scale data governance program for a global EDW, with strong fluency across Security, Compliance, and Legal. You will not be hands-on technical, but you will influence technical teams to implement governance rules and controls, and you will chair a complex, globally distributed Data Governance Council.

  • Support the execution of Scopely’s data governance strategy for the global data warehouse
  • Work closely with Security, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, and data teams to translate requirements into clear and actionable policies
  • Help define and implement governance frameworks such as data classification, PII handling, access control, and data lifecycle management
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to ensure governance policies are implemented correctly in data platforms
  • Contribute to access governance processes, including approvals, reviews, and monitoring
  • Help maintain documentation, decision logs, and governance guidelines to ensure transparency and consistency
  • Identify risks related to data usage and support mitigation plans with clear tracking
  • Assist in improving processes, templates, and training materials to increase adoption across teams
  • Support governance needs for new projects, tools, and integrations, including emerging areas like AI usage
  • Participate in governance forums and working groups, contributing to decisions and alignment
  • Contribute to defining data ownership and accountability across datasets
  • Support the implementation of data classification and sensitivity models
  • Help ensure appropriate use of sensitive data based on business needs
  • Assist in defining and applying data lifecycle policies, such as retention and archiving
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to balance data access, risk, and business value

 

What We’re Looking For

  • 4 to 7 years of experience in data governance, data management, privacy, compliance, or related areas
  • Good understanding of data security and privacy concepts, such as PII handling, access control, and auditability
  • Bachelors in Computer Science or related field
  • Experience working with data teams to implement policies in real systems
  • Ability to translate requirements into practical solutions with technical teams
  • Strong collaboration skills and ability to work across different teams and functions
  • Pragmatic mindset, you focus on solutions that work in real environments
  • Clear communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced environments with evolving needs
  • Full on-site presence in the Barcelona office (5 days per week).

 

Bonus Points

  • Experience with modern data platforms such as BigQuery or Snowflake
  • Familiarity with IAM concepts and BI tools
  • Exposure to regulated environments or sensitive data domains
  • Experience working in multi-team or global organizations

 

At Scopely, we create games for everyone, and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! Title: Sr Specialist, Program Manager (Training & Customer Support)
Description:
Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

Overview

Scout Motors is seeking Senior Specialist, Program Manager within the Commercial Office, a coordinating department forming strategic plans with, and setting alignment for all Commercial Operations functions. 

Operating at the intersection of strategy, operations, and planning, the Commercial Office is responsible for driving cross-functional collaboration, professionalizing Commercial Operations business planning and administration, and driving execution of top priorities. 

Within the Commercial Office, the PMO team is hiring a Sr. Specialist, Program Manager to support the Training & Customer Support team.  

 

What you’ll do

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

  • Support the definition and manage the master project plan for Customer Support and Training within Commercial Operations, ensuring proper governance, documentation, coordination, and delivery of numerous complex projects contributing to Scout Motors retail readiness.  
  • Develop Delivery timelines, aligning and coordinating interdependencies both inside and outside of Commercial Operations, as well as establishing a governance process associated with these timelines.  
  • Manage documentation within Confluence and Jira environments, plus create highly professional project documentation for summary-level presentations to executive audiences.  
  • Drive special initiatives across a range of topics in partnership with cross-functional teams and the Commercial Operations PMO.  
  • Survey and collect all relevant milestone planning documentation across Customer Support and Training. 
  • Support and coordinate the development of the top-level budget of Customer Support/Training coordinating with each functional leader to ensure accurate forecasting and timely reporting.  
  • Support, coordinate and align the top-level headcount plan of Customer Support/Training.  
  • Lead meeting execution, decision tracking, and deliverable documentation, following up with responsibilities on behalf of Commercial Office.  
  • Facilitate cross-functional workshops to drive alignment, solve complex business challenges, and accelerate decision making. 
  • Coordinate external vendor and agency business documentation, tracking statements of work, purchase orders, and milestone-based payments in partnership with Finance and Procurement.  

 

Location & Travel Expectations:

  • This role will be based out of the Scout Motors corporate headquarters in Charlotte, NC. 
  • This role requires 4-5 days per week in the office, with regular in-person meetings and events. 
  • Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time.

What you’ll bring 

We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You’ll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You’ll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring: 

  • Education/Certifications: A bachelor’s degree. 
  • Years of Experience required in type of role: 10 years of experience in a Project Management or automotive environment, preferably in a Project Manager role. Automotive experience is preferred but not required.

Title: Vendor Management Program Manager
Description:
The salary range for this role is negotiable, the range being $5,000 - $6,500 USD gross per month. 

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role: 

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Vendor Management Program Manager to lead the execution of our third-party risk management framework. This role is the backbone of our vendor oversight, ensuring that every partnership—from non-critical services to complex bank integrations—aligns with our high standards for security, compliance, and operational excellence. You will have the authority to manage the vendor lifecycle and ensure our program remains robust under regulatory scrutiny.

Compensation

The compensation range for the role is $5,000 - $6,500 USD GROSS per month as a contractor. Specific compensation offered to a candidate may be dependent on factors such as education, experience, qualifications, and alignment with market data. Exceptional candidates may receive salaries outside of the posted ranges.

What You'll Do:

  • Standards & Governance: work cross-functionally with IT, Legal, and Compliance teams to establish and maintain third-party risk standards and governance practices.
  • Due Diligence & Monitoring: Conduct comprehensive vendor due diligence and ongoing monitoring activities, including evaluating consumer-impact risk, complaint analysis, and confirming privacy and data protection standards.
  • Documentation & Reporting: Manage third-party risk documentation and reporting, including maintaining the vendor and data processor inventory, ensuring timely onboarding and offboarding due diligence, and executing periodic compliance reviews.
  • Risk Assessment: Execute day-to-day risk assessments to determine vendor criticality and identify inherent risks in categories such as PII handling, BSA/AML, and credit decisioning.
  • Collaboration: Work cross-functionally with Legal to ensure effective contracts are in place and with Information Security to validate the technical safeguards of our third-party partners.
  • Issue Escalation: Identify, track, and escalate risk events or performance failures to senior leadership and bank partners through established issue-tracking systems.

What We Look For:

  • Experience: 7+ years of professional experience in vendor risk management, procurement, or third-party compliance, preferably within the fintech or regulated financial services industry.
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of third-party risk management lifecycle and regulatory guidance (e.g., PCI-DSS, SOC 2, GLBA, and BSA/AML).
  • Execution: Proven track record of managing a high volume of vendor assessments and maintaining a state of "audit-readiness" for bank partners and regulators.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Law, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

About You: 

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome? 

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Title: QMS Program Manager
Description:
About Us 

SharkNinja is a global product design and technology company, with a diversified portfolio of 5-star rated lifestyle solutions that positively impact people’s lives in homes around the world. Powered by two trusted, global brands, Shark and Ninja, the company has a proven track record of bringing disruptive innovation to market and developing one consumer product after another has allowed SharkNinja to enter multiple product categories, driving significant growth and market share gains. Headquartered in Needham, Massachusetts with more than 4,100 associates, the company’s products are sold at key retailers, online and offline, and through distributors around the world. 

AI at SharkNinja

At SharkNinja, we’re building an AI-native culture. We’re not waiting for the future; we’re creating it. Our people are expected to experiment boldly, adopt new tools, and continuously raise what’s possible to create meaningful impact for our consumers. If you believe the best way to do your job hasn’t been invented yet, you’ll fit right in.

QMS Program Manager, Medical Devices 

Needham, MA, United States 

As the QMS Program Manager, Medical Devices, you will own the general oversight and performance tracking of SharkNinja’s Quality Management System (QMS) as it applies to medical devices and guide New Product Development (NPD) teams across Skincare and Wellness in developing safe and effective devices. This role ensures quality and safety are designed into products from concept through post-market—while enabling SharkNinja’s fast-paced, consumer-driven product development model. 

 

Partnering closely with Product Integrity, Product Development, Engineering, PMO, Compliance, Legal Supply Chain, and Commercial teams, you will translate quality strategy into execution, support the geographic expansion of the medical devices’ portfolio, and lead post-market surveillance activities—ensuring quality is embedded into the product lifecycle, not inspected in after the fact. 

 

Key Responsibilities 

QMS Oversight & Performance Tracking 

  • Provide general oversight of SharkNinja’s Quality Management System for medical devices, ensuring it remains effective, audit-ready, and aligned with applicable standards (e.g., ISO 13485, FDA 21 CFR Part 820 / QMSR). 
  • Track and report QMS performance through clear KPIs, dashboards, and management reviews, driving accountability and continuous improvement across the organization. 

NPD Guidance – Safe & Effective Devices 

  • Guide New Product Development (NPD) teams across Skincare and Medical Devices in developing safe and effective devices, embedding design controls, risk management (ISO 14971), and verification and validation into the development process. 
  • Translate quality and safety requirements into clear, digestible, execution-ready guidance for Product Development and Engineering teams. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Title: Staff NPI Program Manager, Integration
Description:
About Us

We are Sila, a next-generation battery materials company. Our mission is to power the world’s transition to clean energy. To create this future, our team is building a better lithium-ion battery from the inside out today. We engineer and manufacture ground-breaking battery materials that significantly increase the energy density of batteries, while reducing their size and weight. The result? Smaller more powerful batteries that can unlock innovation in consumer devices and accelerate the mass adoption of electric cars to eliminate our dependence on fossil fuels. We're tackling one of the biggest challenges of our time every day, and together we're redefining what's possible. Are you ready to be a part of a team committed to changing the world?

Who You Are

Sila is seeking a high-impact NPI Program Manager to lead new battery cell product development and qualification with key manufacturing partners. Positioned at the intersection of internal R&D, operations, and external suppliers, you will drive high-velocity execution to deliver mass-production-ready cell products.

Responsibilities and Duties  

Strategic NPI & Partner Management

  • Lead end-to-end NPI execution, driving qualification for new suppliers and external manufacturing partners (OEMs).
  • Manage cross-border partner relationships, navigating cross-cultural and organizational dynamics to keep programs on schedule.
  • Coordinate cross-functional deliverables between R&D, Product Management, Operations, and Quality.

Product Risk Management & Quality Engineering

  • Develop and steward DFMEA and PFMEA frameworks for cell designs and manufacturing processes.
  • Support the qualification of new battery materials, cell designs, and advanced manufacturing methods.
  • Ensure products meet global battery safety and certification pathways (e.g., IEC, UL, GB/T, KC, PSE).

Program Documentation & Operational Readiness

  • Own core NPI documentation, including Engineering Bills of Materials (BOMs), design specifications, and partner Statements of Work (SOWs).
  • Hand off mass-production-ready cell products to Operations for scale-up.
  • Present technical updates, risks, and status reports to executive and engineering stakeholders.

Knowledge and Skill Requirements 

Essential Technical Expertise

  • Experience: 6+ years in high-tech, hardware product development (batteries, semiconductors, chemical processing, or automotive). Direct experience with lithium-ion battery manufacturing and cell qualification is strongly preferred.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher in Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Electrochemistry, or a related field.
  • Process Knowledge: Practical understanding of cell manufacturing processes, risk analysis (FMEA), and global safety/certification frameworks.

Key Competencies

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven ability to align diverse engineering, operations, and commercial teams around high-velocity timelines.
  • Communication: Clear verbal and written presenter, comfortable translating technical details for both technical teams and executive leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Fluency in Mandarin, Korean, or Japanese (to support Asian manufacturing partner interfaces).

Physical Demands and Working Conditions

  • Travel: Up to 10% international travel to partners across Asia, North America, and Europe.
  • On-Site & Lab: Ability to wear required PPE (lab coat, safety glasses, steel-toe shoes) and navigate manufacturing or laboratory environments.
