Title: Program Manager, Pre-College Programs & Alumni Engagement
Description:
Thanks for your interest in Success Academy! Running a large, fast-growing, and high-performing network of public charter schools takes a village - families, children, teachers, staff and faculty, advocates, and supporters alike. We are growing fast in New York and expanding to Florida, and we would love to welcome you to our community! We work tirelessly every day to ensure children have access to a fun, rigorous, whole-child education regardless of zip code or economic status. When you join SA, you play a part in giving every student who walks through our doors a fair shot at reaching his or her potential.

About the Role

The mission of Success Academy is to reimagine public education. From the classroom to the halls of government, this means finding profoundly different approaches to how we structure, implement and support learning. We re-conceive every aspect of school design, from writing rigorous new curricula to drawing regularly on the advances in technology and business that are transforming every sector except education.

Over the past decade, Success Academy has grown faster than any charter network in the nation, building a vibrant network of 59 elementary, middle and high schools. Our over 20,000 children – mostly poor and minority – are out-performing students at top city and suburban schools across New York State. Within the next decade, our goals are even more ambitious, bringing transformational change here and across the country.

Within this mission, the External Programs, Alumni & Scholarships portfolio expands opportunities and support for scholars beyond the school day. This includes delivering transformative experiences such as Summer Experience and Dual Enrollment, ensuring scholarship dollars reach scholars efficiently and equitably, and keeping our growing alumni community connected and supported. As we scale to serve more high schools, scholars, and graduating classes, these programs require disciplined execution, strong data systems, and AI-enabled processes to drive accuracy, efficiency, and visibility across the portfolio.

We are seeking a Program Manager, Pre-College Programs & Alumni Engagement (internally titled Specialist, External Programs, Alumni & Scholarships) to serve as the primary owner of this portfolio end-to-end, driving participation, outcomes, and continuous improvement across external programs, scholarships, and alumni engagement.

Reporting to the Head, College Access & Preparedness and External Programs, the Program Manager will own three interconnected functions end-to-end: Pre-College Programs (Summer Experience and Dual Enrollment), Scholarships, and Alumni Engagement. These functions share the same scholars, partners, and annual cycle, and the Program Manager will manage them as one unified portfolio: setting timelines, managing partners and budgets, tracking outcomes, and ensuring every workstream is completed on time and with fidelity to Success Academy standards.

As part of the broader portfolio strategy, we are evolving our operations to become more AI-enabled, integrated, and efficient, and this role will be a key driver of that work. The Program Manager will redesign workflows across all three functions to better connect scholars, school-based teams, School Leaders, and Network teams, using AI to streamline high-volume work such as triage, communications, data validation, and reporting while maintaining appropriate human judgment and oversight.

This role is ideal for a highly organized program manager who thrives with high autonomy, enjoys owning work end-to-end, and is energized by using data and AI to make complex programs clear, trackable, and scalable.

Key Responsibilities:

Pre-College Programs (Summer Experience & Dual Enrollment) Summer Experience includes pre-college programs, service trips, outdoor programs, and study abroad programs. Dual Enrollment includes STEM-focused college courses and local coding and technology programs.

  • Own the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of Summer Experience and Dual Enrollment programming.
  • Drive scholar participation, with targets of 75%+ participation among our scholars.
  • Manage scholar selection, enrollment, and onboarding processes across programs with support from school leadership.
  • Build and manage strong relationships with colleges and universities, program directors, pre-college and enrichment providers, coding and STEM programs, and other external partners to expand and strengthen Summer Experience and Dual Enrollment offerings.
  • Lead informational sessions, workshops, and events to promote participation and guide scholars and families.
  • Set and own budgeting processes, including forecasting, purchase orders, and program invoicing for Dual Enrollment and Summer Experience.
  • Drive a proactive communications strategy to scholars, families, and school leadership to outline all pre-college timelines and requirements throughout the year.

Scholarships

  • Own the end-to-end process for Success Academy-funded scholarships from scholar selection through disbursement and donor impact reporting in partnership with the Advancement (fundraising and donor relations) team.
  • Ensure scholarship timelines, eligibility criteria, and award decisions are executed accurately and on schedule.
  • Maintain accurate records of applications, awards, and disbursements, and prepare reporting for internal leaders and donors.
  • Continuously improve the scholarship experience for scholars, families, and donors.

Alumni Engagement

  • Design a new alumni function to manage alumni engagement, mentorship, and career programming that keeps graduates connected to the Success Academy community.
  • Develop systems to track alumni outcomes, participation, and engagement over time.
  • Create opportunities for alumni to support current scholars through mentorship, panels, and career exposure.

AI Workflow Redesign

  • Use AI and automation to streamline high-volume work across Pre-College Programs, Scholarships, and Alumni Engagement, including application triage, communications, data validation, and reporting.
  • Redesign workflows so scholars, school-based teams, school leaders, and central-office teams have clear, consistent processes and visibility into program status and next steps.
  • Build automated quality checks and escalation points into workflows, automating routine tasks while preserving human judgment for high-stakes decisions.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to make processes faster, more accurate, and easier for scholars, families, staff, and external partners to navigate.

Data Reporting & Tracking

  • Maintain accurate data systems across all three functions, ensuring integrity, consistency, and usability.
  • Manage dashboards and reports that provide visibility into participation, scholarship milestones, alumni engagement, and outcomes.
  • Prepare recurring executive-facing updates that summarize progress, risks, trends, and recommended next steps.
  • Use data to evaluate program effectiveness and make data-driven decisions to improve and adapt programs.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for all issues and inquiries related to Pre-College Programs, Scholarships, and Alumni Engagement.
  • Coordinate with school-based teams, Network teams, Advancement, Data Services, and external partners to ensure timely, accurate completion of deliverables.
  • Maintain organized systems of communication and documentation, including playbooks and standard operating procedures, to support alignment across campuses and network teams.
  • Respond to ad hoc operational and analytical requests with urgency, accuracy, and strong judgment.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • 3–5 years of experience in program management, operations, education, or a related field.
  • Strong execution skills, with a track record of owning programs or workstreams end-to-end and delivering on time.
  • Strong data skills, with experience maintaining data systems, building trackers and dashboards, and using data to drive decisions.
  • Demonstrated aptitude for AI-enabled workflows and process redesign, with the ability to independently improve how work gets done.
  • Experience managing budgets, forecasting, purchase orders, and invoicing.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with scholars, families, educators, partners, and donors.
  • Ability to manage multiple programs and priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced environment while maintaining accuracy and urgency.
  • High level of autonomy, accountability, discretion, and judgment.
  • Mission-driven, with a commitment to educational equity and strong outcomes for scholars.
  • Knowledge of dual enrollment, summer programs, scholarships, or alumni programming preferred.

Attributes:

  • Thrives with high autonomy and takes full ownership of a broad portfolio from start to finish.
  • Enjoys building systems, redesigning processes, and bringing clarity to complex work.
  • Uses data, evidence, and AI to drive decisions and improve execution.
  • Communicates clearly, directly, and professionally with stakeholders at all levels from scholars and families to executives and donors.
  • Proactively flags risks and gaps, and follows through to resolution.
  • Brings a strong service orientation and commitment to scholars, alumni, and the teams that support them.

Compensation, Benefits & Perks

At Success Academy, we invest boldly in our Network team with a comprehensive package designed to support your health, financial future, and overall well-being:

  • Day-One Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting your first day (SA covers 82% of our core medical plan), plus a free One Medical membership and confidential mental health support via EAP/Talkspace.
  • Financial Security: 403(b) retirement plan with a 3% employer match, up to $2,400/year in employer HSA contributions, employer-paid life/disability insurance, and Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) eligibility.
  • Time to Recharge: Generous paid time off, paid holidays, and paid parental leave.
  • Perks & Stipends: A $50/month cellphone stipend ($600/year), pre-tax commuter benefits, backup family care, and performance-based earning incentives.
This is a hybrid position based in our NYC Financial District office, requiring on-site work Tuesday through Thursday and remote work on Monday and Friday.

Title: Technical Growth Content Specialist
Description:
Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale 

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We're looking for a Technical Growth Content Specialist to create educational content that helps enterprise buyers and technical practitioners discover, evaluate, and adopt Tailscale.

This role sits at the intersection of technical writing, content marketing, developer education, and product storytelling. Working closely with the AI & Organic Search Manager, you'll transform customer questions, product launches, search insights, and emerging industry trends into technically accurate content that performs across traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms (ChatGPT, Gemini, AI Overviews), and the social channels where technical audiences discover tools today.

Success isn't measured by how much content you publish, it's measured by the quality, usefulness, and business impact of the content you create. You'll build with the product, collaborate with technical subject matter experts, and create tutorials, implementation guides, comparison pages, demos, and educational resources that earn trust with enterprise audiences and support Tailscale's growth.

We’re looking for someone who has made a significant impact on metrics as a content writer. This is a growth-centered position that will be accountable for specific metrics each quarter.

Key Responsibilities

  • Create hyper-relevant content that drives measurable growth by turning search insights, customer questions, and real-time community signals into high-impact content.
  • Monitor conversations across Twitter, Hacker News, and Reddit, and turn emerging questions and trends into timely content, often same-week, sometimes same-day.
  • Partner with the AI & Organic Search Manager to turn discoverability opportunities into high-impact content.
  • Build hands-on experience with Tailscale to create credible, practical technical content.
  • Produce content at a high velocity while maintaining a high bar for technical accuracy and editorial quality.
  • Partner with Product Marketing, Product, Engineering, Developer Relations, Docs, and subject matter experts to ensure content is accurate and useful.
  • Refresh, expand, and optimize existing content based on performance insights and customer feedback.
  • Develop an AI-first content program that turns search, customer, product, and performance insights into high-quality content faster.
  • Support strategic initiatives with technical content that drives metrics like self-serve revenue and product adoption.

What We Are Looking For

  • 3–6+ years of experience in growth technical content marketing, technical writing, developer marketing, journalism, or a related field
  • Exceptional writing and editing skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly
  • Familiarity with SEO and AI discoverability best practices
  • Highly curious with a hunger to learn and jump head-first into tough challenges
  • Experience creating educational content for technical or enterprise audiences
  • Comfortable learning new technologies and building with products to create authentic technical content
  • Experience using AI tools to research, draft, and improve content quality and production speed
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work closely with engineering, product, and marketing teams
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills

Nice to Have

  • Experience marketing developer tools, infrastructure, networking, cybersecurity, or B2B SaaS products
  • Familiarity with GitHub, Markdown, HTML, or static site generators
  • Experience building sample applications, demos, or interactive technical resources
  • Basic familiarity with scripting or programming languages such as Python, JavaScript, or Go
  • Experience creating videos, diagrams, or other technical educational content
  • An active presence in developer communities through writing, speaking, open source, or personal projects
  • An existing audience on Twitter/X, or a personal blog in the AI space
  • Experience building content clusters that drive topical authority and compounding growth

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

CAN Pay Range
$127,300—$159,460 CAD

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
  • Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!
  • Remote first company—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.
  • Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.
  • Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.
  • Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities. 
  • Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world! 
  • A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own. 
  • Paid parental leave program. We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).

Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process or related to any aspect of this role, please contact your recruiter.

Our hiring process uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people.

Please be aware that legitimate emails from Tailscale's talent team will only originate from @tailscale.com, @greenhouse.io, and @interviews.modernloop.io email addresses. For more information about protecting yourself from impersonators and scams, please visit https://tailscale.com/scam-awareness.

Title: Content Marketing Manager
Department: Takealot Group Customer Service and Insights
Description:
takealot.com, South Africa's leading online retailer, is looking for a highly talented Content Marketing Manager to join our team in Cape Town.

Content Marketing Manager owns the content strategy, narrative and visual identity for TakealotMore as well as cross platform initiatives for Takealot, Mr D and TakealotMORE. This role is responsible for how the brand looks and speaks across every channel, on and off platform, Content Marketing above the line, direct CRM comms and in product. It combines strategic ownership of content and design with hands-on management of a design team and AI-driven production tools, to scale output without compromising consistency and quality.

This position reports to the Group Head: Cross-Platform Customer Growth

Your responsibilities will include:

 Content & Narrative:

  • Own the overarching content marketing and narrative strategy, including the story that drives understanding of TakealotMORE and ecosystem cross-shop.
  • Write and oversee copy for all channels, on and off platform (performance marketing, email, social, onsite, print, PR, video, webinars, UX copy for mobile app and in-app content).
  • Manage content across off-platform channels - using editorials and advertorials to position TakealotMore in the minds of consumers.
  • Own and manage the content calendar, using AI tools to support scheduling, drafting and version management where it reduces manual workload.
  • Build and manage AI agents/tools to support copy creation and content production at scale.
  • Map content to the customer journey (awareness, consideration, conversion, retention) rather than producing content on a channel-by-channel basis.
  • Own content's contribution to acquisition and retention funnels, including TakealotMORE sign-ups, alongside brand and engagement metrics.
  • Contribute towards owned media as a deliberate growth channel (app content, lifecycle emails, push notifications), not only campaign-based content.
  • Develop lifecycle/CRM content tied to customer lifecycle stages, working with the CRM/lifecycle team to fit into the group CRM strategy.
  • Track and report on content-attributed growth metrics (traffic, conversion, retention/repeat-purchase lift), in addition to engagement and brand metrics.

Visual Identity & Design:

  • Create, own and manage the TakealotMORE visual identity end to end on and off platform.
  • Set and enforce templatisation standards so look and feel are consistent across ATL, BTL and direct channels, across both Mr D and Takealot.
  • Manage the graphic design team, including workload, quality control and output against brief.
  • Build and manage AI agents/tools to support visual creation and templating at scale.

Audience, Community & Market Insight:

  • Conduct audience research to understand customer needs, preferences and behaviours, and use this to shape content and design decisions.
  • Monitor the web and social media, engaging in discussions about the company, competitors and industry.
  • Manage online presence across major social media channels, using AI tools to triage and flag customer queries/comments that need action, escalating where human response is needed.
  • Participate in setting marketing plans and strategy, feeding audience and market insight into broader marketing decisions.
  • Keep up to date with competitor developments, industry best practice and global trends, and share insights with the team.

Process & Collaboration:

  • Create and maintain SOPs for cross-company collaboration (Takealot, Mr D, external agencies, internal creative team).
  • Create and maintain SOPs for team briefs, to standardise how work comes into the design and content function.
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with stakeholders across marketing, design, product, partnerships, retail and marketplace.
  • Build out ai agents to help the team create structure and collaboration and manage the ai agent workforce for design and content creation.

 Performance & Reporting:

  • Monitor and report on content and design performance (engagement, ROI, brand consistency, audience growth), using AI tools to automate reporting where possible.
  • Produce regular output reports with insights and recommendations for optimising future content and design strategy.
  • Run experimentation (A/B testing) on format, messaging and creative to optimise outcomes.
  • Continuously refine strategy based on performance data and competitor/industry trends.

Qualification & Experience:

  • Bachelor's Degree  and Master’s Degree preferable.
  • 5 - 7+ years' experience in content, copywriting, brand or design leadership roles.
  • Proven experience owning a brand's visual identity across multiple channels.
  • Strong copywriting and content strategy background, across multiple formats and platforms.
  • Excellent proofreader, with strong attention to detail.
  • Active and well-rounded personal presence on social media, with an understanding of each platform and best practice.

Attributes Required:

  • Strategic mindset, comfortable operating at a level that influences brand and business direction, not just executing on brief.
  • Data-driven, able to interpret performance metrics and translate into strategy.
  • Strong stakeholder management across a matrixed, multi-brand structure.
  • Blogging and ad agency experience advantageous.
  • Knowledge of e-commerce and food delivery industries advantageous.
  • Experience in content-led growth or performance content marketing, in addition to brand/creative content.
  • Understanding of attribution and how content contributes to funnel and growth metrics, beyond engagement numbers.

The Environment:

Title: Sr.  Manager, Brand & Content
Location: New York, New York, United States; San Francisco, California, United States
Description:
About Taskrabbit:

Taskrabbit is a marketplace platform that conveniently connects people with Taskers to handle everyday home to-do’s, such as furniture assembly, handyman work, moving help, and much more.

At Taskrabbit, we want to transform lives one task at a time. As a company we celebrate innovation, inclusion and hard work. Our culture is collaborative, pragmatic, and fast-paced. We’re looking for talented, entrepreneurially minded and data-driven people who also have a passion for helping people do what they love. Together with IKEA, we’re creating more opportunities for people to earn a consistent, meaningful income on their own terms by building lasting relationships with clients in communities around the world.

Taskrabbit is a hybrid company with employees distributed across the US and EU and a Built In — Best Places to Work (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025) continually ranked across multiple national and regional categories. Join us at Taskrabbit, where your work will be meaningful, your ideas valued, and your potential unleashed!

This role operates on a hybrid schedule requiring two days of in-office collaboration per week. The position can be based in either our San Francisco office or our new New York City office.

About the Role

We are looking for a Sr. Manager, Brand & Content to help build and scale Taskrabbit’s brand and content engine. This role will play a critical part in shaping how Taskrabbit shows up to clients, Taskers, partners marketing across channels, translating our brand platform into a cohesive, always-on content system that drives awareness, engagement, and long-term demand.

This is more than a traditional content role. You will define what we say, how often we show up, and how our narrative comes to life across marketing channels. You will work cross-functionally with Creative, PR, Social, Growth, CRM, SEO, and regional teams to ensure we are delivering consistent, high-quality storytelling that resonates with our audiences and supports business growth. 

This role sits at the center of Taskrabbit’s next phase of growth. As we invest in building a scalable brand and a cross-channel content engine, this person will help define how we show up in the world—ensuring we are not just driving demand, but building a brand customers recognize, trust, and choose over time.

Responsibilities

Own the Content Strategy & Narrative

  • Develop and evolve Taskrabbit’s global content strategy and editorial calendar, anchored in brand positioning, key service category insights, and life moments
  • Define clear content pillars, including tone, proof-point hierarchy, and "when to lead with what" guidelines, that balance functional authority with emotional storytelling
  • Translate the brand platform into a scalable content system across channels, audiences, and target demographics 
  • Ensure content is consistent, connected, and reinforcing a unified narrative

Build the Messaging Architecture and Manage a Cross-Channel Content Engine

  • Translate brand positioning into a full messaging hierarchy including core narrative, category-level proof points, audience-specific value props (Client vs. Tasker vs. Partner, by category and life moment) so all teams are pulling from the same architecture
  • Own the message map as a living document; as new categories, markets, or partnerships (IKEA, Wayfair) come online, extend the architecture for teams to leverage 
  • Partner with channel leads to adapt content for platform-specific formats and audiences, maintaining always-on content programming 
  • Partner with SEO/AEO teams to align content strategy with high-intent search and AI discovery opportunities; ensure content supports both human engagement and structured, search-friendly formats

Champion the Brand through Campaign Development

  • Develop and manage end-to-end process for larger campaigns and brand moments
  • Generate campaign concepts: bring point-of-view ideas to Brand Marketing and Creative leadership rooted in cultural moments, category insights, or customer triggers
  • Prototype and pitch multiple campaign directions per quarter (a hook, a proof point, a channel plan), shortening the gap between "we should say something about X" and an executable brief

Partner with Creative to Scale Production

  • Work closely with Creative to brief and develop content formats that can scale (video, social, editorial, etc.)
  • Help define repeatable formats and systems that enable high-quality, high-volume output
  • Contribute to evolving AI-enabled creative workflows to increase efficiency and speed

Measurement and Optimization

  • Define success metrics for content strategy and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, scale what works, and evolve what doesn’t
  • Analyze performance across channels and continuously refine content strategy based on insights and evolving business needs

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in content strategy, brand marketing, or editorial roles
  • Strong strategic thinker with the ability to translate brand positioning into actionable content systems
  • Experience managing cross-channel content (social, video, CRM, PR, or editorial)
  • Proven ability to build and scale content programs, not just execute campaigns
  • Deep understanding of how content performs across platforms (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, etc.)
  • Experience working cross-functionally with creative, growth, and product teams
  • Strong storytelling instincts with a balance of creative taste and analytical rigor
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment and building new systems from the ground up
  • Experience building messaging architecture / message maps that multiple teams can consistently execute against 
  • A track record of originating campaign ideas (not just briefing them); can point to concepts they conceived and got greenlit
  • Quick thinker who is comfortable presenting rough concepts to leadership and iterating in the room

Desired Skills & Experience

  • Experience in marketplace, consumer tech, or home/lifestyle brands
  • Familiarity with SEO/AEO and content for search and AI-driven discovery
  • Experience working with creators or influencer programs
  • Exposure to AI tools for content development and production
  • Proficient with Asana or other project management tools

Compensation & Benefits: 

At Taskrabbit, our approach to compensation is designed to be competitive, transparent, and equitable. Total compensation consists of base pay + bonus + benefits + perks.

The base pay range for this position is $142,000 - $189,000. This range is representative of base pay only, and does not include any other total cash compensation amounts, such as company bonus or benefits. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed above and will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, qualifications, geography, and level.

You’ll love working here because:

  • Taskrabbit is a Hybrid Company. We value flexibility and choice but also stay committed to regular in-person connection.
  • The People. You will be surrounded by some of the most talented, supportive, smart, and kind leaders and teams -- people you can be proud to work with!
  • The Diverse Culture. We believe that we make better decisions when our workforce reflects the diversity of the communities in which we operate. Women make up half of our leadership team and our diversity representation is above that of the tech industry average.
  • The Perks. Taskrabbit offers our employees with employer-paid health insurance and a 401k match with immediate vesting for our US based employees. We offer all of our global employees generous and flexible time off with 2 company-wide closure weeks, Taskrabbit product stipends, wellness + productivity + education stipends, IKEA discounts, reproductive health support, and more. Benefits vary by country of employment. 

Taskrabbit’s commitment to Diversity and Inclusion:

An Active Commitment to Equity within our Company and Platform. We are an inclusive community where all who share our mission and values belong. Our diverse team represents the communities we serve, breaking down systemic barriers, and transforming lives- one action at a time.

Taskrabbit is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military/veteran status, or disability status. Taskrabbit is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with physical and mental disabilities. Taskrabbit will consider for employment all qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law.

This tool does not make hiring decisions — every application and response is reviewed by a member of our recruiting team to determine fit for the role. If you would prefer not to have your application processed using this tool, you may opt out by selecting 'opt out' in the application form or by emailing talentacquisition@taskrabbit.com, and your application will be reviewed manually with no impact on your candidacy.

Title: Senior People Program Manager
Description:
About Tekion:

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

Job Introduction

 Tekion is entering its next phase of growth and is looking for a People Program Manager to support day-to-day People Program operations and help scale the infrastructure that powers our employee experience in India. 

 This is an individual contributor role focused on strong execution, program ownership, and operational excellence. You will partner closely with People Operations, People Partners, Talent Acquisition, Legal/Privacy, and Systems teams to deliver consistent, compliant, and employee centric People programs. For globally owned People programs, this role will serve as the India execution lead, responsible for localizing requirements, coordinating stakeholders, and ensuring successful delivery and adoption in India. 

Key Role & Responsibilities

  • Own and execute People programs end-to-end including performance management cycles, engagement surveys, internal talent movement programs, People/HR system upgrades, and compliance related initiatives. 
  • Manage project delivery by building and maintaining project plans, timelines, milestones, dependencies, and status updates; proactively identify risks and drive mitigation. 
  • Operationalize programs by supporting governance, operating rhythms, documentation, and handoffs to ensure programs are sustainable beyond initial launch. 
  • Drive standardization and continuous improvement by maintaining core program artifacts (project charter, RACI, project plan, comms plan, launch readiness checklist, building repeatable playbooks/SOPs, and running post-launch retros to capture learnings and improve future cycles. 
  • Create clear, scalable resources such as process guides, FAQs, templates, and manager communications to enable self-service and consistent execution. 
  • Partner with Legal/Privacy and India compliance experts to ensure programs align with local statutory, audit, and data privacy requirements. 
  • Maintain and analyze People data, including reporting, data audits, and basic dashboards to track program health and identify improvement opportunities. 
  • Support the People team’s operating cadence, including preparation for Monthly and Quarterly Business Reviews and readiness for peak People cycles. 

What success looks like in this role 

    • Core People programs and cycles run smoothly, on time, and with minimal escalations. 
    • Stakeholders have clear visibility into timelines, ownership, and expectations for People & Cross-functional programs. 
    • Processes and documentation are clear enough to enable consistent execution and increased self-service 
    • The People team can rely on this role for strong operational follow-through and program readiness. 

 About you 

    • A strong executor who brings structure to ambiguity and reliably follows through on commitments. 
    • A process-oriented thinker who looks for practical improvements on that scale. 
    • A collaborative partner who communicates clearly with cross functional stakeholders and balances people's needs with business priorities. 
    • Detail oriented and organized with the confidence to raise risks and push back when needed. 

Basic Qualifications 

  • 4–6 years of experience in HR/People Programs, HR/People Operations, HR/People Project Management, or related roles, ideally in a fast growing or mid to large organization. 
  • Hands-on experience delivering cross-functional projects or recurring cycles (e.g., performance reviews, engagement surveys, system rollouts). 
  • Working knowledge of project management tools (e.g., Jira, Microsoft Planner, Asana) and strong documentation practices. 
  • Solid Excel or Google Sheets skills for reporting, tracking, and basic analysis of HR data. 
  • Experience working with vendors or internal service providers to track deliverables and timelines. 
  • Comfort collaborating with global stakeholders across time zones, including India–US teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to India compliance topics (e.g., statutory processes, audits) through partnership with subject matter experts 
  • Experience with People systems such as Workday (or equivalent HRIS), Greenhouse or Ashby (ATS), or similar tools. 
  • Formal project management training or certification (PMP, Prince2, or equivalent). 

Perks & Benefits 

  • Opportunity to work with some of the smartest minds to solve complex challenges at scale. 
  • Impactful role in shaping and securing a global, cloud-native & AI driven platform. 
  • Innovative, collaborative, and fast-paced culture. 

Current Tekion Employees – Please apply via Greenhouse Internal Job Board

Title: Director, Content Marketing
Location: US - Headquarters - Maryland - Columbia , US - Remote - Massachusetts
Description:
Who is Tenable?

Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey!

What makes Tenable such a great place to work?

Ask a member of our team and they’ll answer, “Our people!” We work together to build and innovate best-in-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. When you’re part of our #OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together!

Your Role:

Tenable is seeking an experienced Director of Content Marketing who will act as the architect of our content strategy, ensuring our thought leadership and marketing assets are strategic and differentiated. Your mission is to bring clarity, consistency and authority to our messaging, positioning Tenable as the undisputed leader in exposure management, winning the trust of the CISO, and empowering the practitioner.  The ideal candidate will bring cybersecurity experience and a journalistic approach to developing content that engages and informs technical B2B audiences. Sitting at the intersection of Corporate Communications, Tenable Research, Product Marketing and Revenue Marketing, this leader will transform proprietary research, executive expertise and customer insights into compelling market narratives. Reporting to the Vice President of Corporate Communications, the Director will lead the content marketing team, combining strategic planning with hands-on writing and editorial leadership.

Your Opportunity:

Strategic Leadership & GEO Transformation

  • Lead Programmatic Growth: Maintain and grow Tenable’s leadership position by driving the global Exposure Management Leadership Council. This requires helping to nurture and support Tenable’s CISO relationships, coordinating regular discussions and peer-to-peer engagement, and translating technical and process insights into regular original reports and content. Act as a valuable partner for Tenable Research, influencing the research calendar and pillar research initiatives that support thought leadership, competitive differentiation and customer engagement.
  • Champion SEO/GEO (Generative Engine Optimization): Implement a GEO-first approach to all external marketing content. Ensure Tenable’s assets are optimized for visibility, authority and citation potential across AI-powered answer engines, AI-assisted search and traditional search results.
  • Utilize AI as a Content Marketing Accelerator: Implement and manage AI-enabled content workflows that drive efficiency, scalability and quality.

Content Strategy & Execution

  • Own the Editorial Framework: Serve as a champion of the Tenable editorial voice across our external thought leadership materials. Manage the editorial calendar, blog strategy, and writing style guide to ensure a cohesive, high-quality narrative across all touchpoints. Must be able to quickly generate blog copy, especially for rapid response and often on highly technical cybersecurity topics. Must be comfortable editing technical and research content on cybersecurity topics.
  • Drive Multi-Format Excellence: Direct the creation of high-impact content including research reports, SEO/GEO-optimized web pages, video scripts and other forms of derivative content to drive long-term engagement. Map derivative content strategies to the buyer journey. Ensure every asset reflects our competitive differentiation and speaks directly to our target personas.

Stakeholder & Operational Management

  • Matrixed Collaboration: Serve as a trusted advisor to key stakeholders within Corporate Communications, Product Marketing, Product Management, Research, Web, Creative and Revenue Marketing. Translate business priorities into effective, actionable content initiatives.
  • Data-Driven Optimization: Monitor, report and analyze content KPIs—including organic visibility, engagement and pipeline contribution—using these insights to refine strategies and demonstrate business impact.

What You’ll Need:

  • Experience: 8-10+ years in content marketing, corporate marketing or journalism, with at least 5+ years of leadership experience at an enterprise-scale organization. Must have experience managing a team as well as the demonstrated ability to write high-quality, technical content across a variety of platforms.
  • GEO/AEO Expertise: Fluency in the emerging AI search landscape. You understand how LLMs and answer engines consume content and know how to optimize for them.
  • Strategic & Operational Balance: Ability to act as both a visionary leader and a hands-on contributor. You are comfortable defining high-level content frameworks while also rolling up your sleeves to edit or write high-priority assets.
  • Stakeholder Influence: Proven track record of operating in a highly matrixed environment. You possess the ability to secure buy-in from senior leadership and drive collaboration across diverse teams (PMM, Legal, Sales, Research).
  • Brand Voice Champion: Demonstrated experience as a protector of editorial brand voice and standards. You have a sharp eye for quality and the ability to coach writers to elevate their work. AP Style preferred.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, journalism, English, or related field.

Title: Head of Content
Description:
Organization Overview:

The Florida Panthers are in their 33rd season in 2026-27 as one of the National Hockey League's premier franchises. As back-to-back Stanley Cup Champions in 2024 and 2025, the Panthers have won 11 of their past 12 postseason series and captured four Eastern Conference Championships. The organization is led by President of Hockey Operations & General Manager Bill Zito, entering his seventh season, and President of Business Operations Michael White, beginning his first full season.

Anchored by a championship culture on the ice, the Panthers are equally committed to building a world-class sports and entertainment platform off of it. The organization focuses on delivering an elite guest experience across all venues, deepening the connection between the team and the South Florida community and continuing to grow the sport for the next generation. The Panthers operate four facilities in Broward County: Amerant Bank Arena in Sunrise which is home of Panthers home games, concerts and events, Panthers IceDen in Coral Springs, the state-of-the-art Baptist Health IcePlex in Fort Lauderdale and renovated War Memorial Auditorium which hosts concerts and events year-round. 

The Panthers are owned by Vincent J. Viola, a graduate of the United States Military Academy at West Point and a veteran of the U.S. Army. That foundation of selfless service shapes the organization's identity at every level. The Panthers' pillar program, "Heroes Among Us," honors a U.S. military veteran at every home game, and the Florida Panthers Foundation directs its efforts across four core pillars: veterans' affairs, children's health and education, raising awareness for the endangered Florida Panther and growing youth hockey throughout the region. The organization remains deeply committed to empowering and strengthening the diverse communities of South Florida and the tri-county area.

 

Head of Content

  • Organization: Florida Panthers Hockey Club
  • Department: Marketing
  • Reports To: Chief Marketing Officer
  • Employment Type: Full-Time
  • Location: Amerant Bank Arena, Sunrise, FL — On-Site

The Opportunity

Two-time Stanley Cup Champions. A sold-out Amerant Bank Arena. A fanbase that has fallen in love with a hockey team in South Florida. The Florida Panthers have built something special — and we're looking for a transformational creative leader to build a content strategy to match.

This is a rare chance to step into one of the most exciting franchises in professional sports and own the entire content ecosystem — from the electricity of a playoff hype reel to the thumb-stopping digital moment that brings a new fan into the fold. The Head of Content will have the creative license, the organizational support, and the platform to build content that reflects the Panthers brand and helps shape where we're going.

Responsibilities

Strategy & Alignment

  • Develop and execute a bold, comprehensive content strategy that reflects the ambition of this organization and puts the Florida Panthers brand at the intersection of sport, culture, and storytelling
  • Partner closely with the Creative Director, VP of Game Presentation, and VP of Digital Marketing to ensure visual consistency, strategic alignment, and cross-functional execution
  • Build a forward-looking content roadmap with fans at the center — one that anticipates where culture is heading and positions this franchise as a leader in premium content

In-Game & Arena Production

  • Own all video production for game presentation: show opens, hype videos, player features, branded content, and special events — setting a new standard for live entertainment every night
  • Conceive and execute seasonal show opens and media day executions that capture the identity of this team and set the tone for what's ahead
  • Create in-arena experiences that energize the team and give fans something they carry with them long after the game ends

Digital Content

  • Lead the creation of original, digital-first content across social, web, and mobile — taking the stories of the Florida Panthers and engaging fans wherever they live online
  • Use data and platform analytics to drive performance, inform creative decisions, and continuously elevate what engagement looks like for this brand
  • Collaborate with Partnerships to produce branded video assets that deliver real, measurable value for partners and fans alike

Leadership & Operations

  • Build, inspire, and develop a high-performing team of producers, editors, and shooters — guiding end-to-end production from concept to delivery
  • Cultivate relationships across the organization — Hockey Operations, PR, broadcast — so that content is always connected to what's happening on and off the ice
  • Manage budgets, staffing, workflows, vendor relationships, and production calendars with the discipline that great creative work demands
  • Oversee equipment, software, and production systems — always investing in the tools that keep the team ahead
  • Stay hands-on: when a big moment calls for it, roll up your sleeves and contribute directly

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of leadership experience in video production and content development
  • High-level video editing expertise with strong proficiency in industry-standard platforms
  • Deep experience conceiving and producing large-scale show opens and premium content
  • Proven ability to lead high-performing creative teams while maintaining your own creative credibility
  • Sharp understanding of digital content trends, fan engagement, and brand audience development
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills — as effective with Marketing, Partnerships, and Broadcast as with your own team
  • A genuine passion for storytelling — not a line on a resume, but a way of seeing the world

 

Position Type / Expected Hours of Work

This is a full-time exempt (salaried) position. Must be able to work flexible hours, nights, weekends, and holidays as needed.

At the Florida Panthers Hockey Club, Arena Operating Company, Panthers IceDen, Sanza Food Service, War Memorial Benefit Corporation, and FLA Team Shop, we strive to make every employee feel valued and respected for who they are and the unique contributions they make. We believe that a diverse and inclusive company is a more innovative and successful company, which is why we aim to infuse diversity, equity, and inclusion (DE&I) into all aspects of our culture and our business.

We welcome all to apply and join our team.

Title: Education Coordinator
Description:
About Altior Healthcare

Our family of services comprises three distinct mental health treatment programs, including a specialized program for US Veterans. With over 15 unique locations, we manage and support 500+ dedicated employees serving over 300 residential clients daily located across five states: California, Idaho, Maine, New Hampshire, and Texas.

Paradigm Treatment (West Coast) and Ridge RTC (East Coast) partner together under Altior, united by a shared commitment to providing exceptional mental health care. For over a decade, our core clinical and support teams have worked side-by-side, delivering compassionate, evidence-based treatment that changes lives.

As part of the Altior network, you’ll find the stability of an established organization with the heart of a close-knit treatment community where every role matters.

Paradigm Treatment Centers and Ridge RTC are seeking an Education Coordinator to support the educational programming within our residential treatment programs. This role is responsible for coordinating and facilitating academic services for adolescents and young adults in treatment while collaborating closely with families, external academic systems, and internal clinical leadership. The ideal candidate brings empathy, organization, and the ability to integrate educational structure within a therapeutic environment.

Responsibilities

  • Support program leadership and clinical teams in implementing organizational values across all aspects of program services and client care.
  • Coordinate and maintain individualized educational plans in collaboration with parents, guardians, and external academic systems.
  • Facilitate and maintain daily classroom structure, ensuring a productive, supportive, and developmentally appropriate learning environment
  • Provide support in clinical programming as needed, including facilitating group conversations and modeling youth-sensitive interactions.
  • Coach and support staff in best practices related to educational services within a residential treatment setting.
  • Assist with discharge planning related to academic transitions, utilizing discharge tools and tracking progress through the EMR.
  • Monitor resident sharps and valuables, ensuring proper labeling, handling, and reporting of safety concerns.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and consistent communication with clinical, billing, and utilization review teams.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in residential treatment, facilities management, education, or supervisory roles preferred.
  • Prior experience in a residential or behavioral healthcare setting required.
  • Experience in a classroom or educational setting preferred.
  • Familiarity with electronic medical records (KIPU experience a plus)
  • Strong organizational, communication, and collaboration skills
  • Ability to work effectively with adolescents, young adults, families, and multidisciplinary teams

Benefits

  • Paid Time Off Programs including vacation, holidays, and illness.
  • Chef made meals onsite.
  • Professional trainings provided for development; continuing education assistance for clinicians.
  • Supportive clinical supervision and professional development.

Title: Education Coordinator/Program Coordinator
Description:
About Altior Healthcare

Our family of services comprises three distinct mental health treatment programs, including a specialized program for US Veterans. With over 15 unique locations, we manage and support 500+ dedicated employees serving over 300 residential clients daily located across five states: California, Idaho, Maine, New Hampshire, and Texas.

Paradigm Treatment (West Coast) and Ridge RTC (East Coast) partner together under Altior, united by a shared commitment to providing exceptional mental health care. For over a decade, our core clinical and support teams have worked side-by-side, delivering compassionate, evidence-based treatment that changes lives.

As part of the Altior network, you’ll find the stability of an established organization with the heart of a close-knit treatment community where every role matters.

The Education Coordinator supports the educational needs of clients by coordinating daily academic assignments in collaboration with the Lead Education Coordinator, supervising a two-hour academic block, assisting clients with schoolwork, maintaining educational materials and records, and helping ensure a structured and supportive learning environment.

In addition to educational responsibilities, the Education Coordinator provides administrative and operational support to help ensure the program runs efficiently. Duties may include coordinating supplies and inventory, processing client mail and packages, organizing program and storage spaces, assisting with documentation and compliance needs, providing basic technology support, and communicating facility and maintenance needs. As a member of the multidisciplinary team, the Education Coordinator may also provide direct client supervision, group support, and other program assistance based on operational needs and assigned responsibilities.

CATEGORIES OF DUTIES

  1. Assists with client educational needs including supporting coursework, communicating requirements, helping meet deadlines, and coordinating with the Lead Education Coordinator. May include communication with schools, parents/guardians, and other providers as assigned.
  2. Assists clients with structured educational programming, therapeutic activities, experiential groups, routines, and other assigned program activities.
  3. Supports development or implementation of age-appropriate educational, recreational, therapeutic, or experiential materials and activities as assigned.
  4. Maintains inventory of household, office, educational, recreational, clinical-support, and other program supplies; identifies replenishment needs and coordinates with the purchasing department to keep essential items stocked.
  5. Processes incoming client mail and packages daily in accordance with program policies.
  6. Supports preparation of materials, supplies, rooms, and technology for meetings, groups, educational activities, client programming, trainings, and special events.
  7. Maintains accurate and timely documentation within the scope of the position and in accordance with program, regulatory, accreditation, and confidentiality requirements.
  8. Assists clinical and program staff with administrative support, including scanning documents, organizing files, printing/copying, and other routine document-management tasks required for compliance.
  9. Monitors program spaces for routine operational needs and communicates concerns related to supplies, equipment, cleanliness, organization, safety, or maintenance to the appropriate department or leader.
  10. Collaborates with clinical, educational, nursing, direct care, admissions/discharge, facilities, and administrative staff to support continuity of care and effective program operations.
  11. Provides basic technology troubleshooting and coordination for routine program needs, including computers, printers, scanners, client educational technology, and other approved devices; escalates unresolved issues as appropriate.

Title: Research Engineer, Developer Experience, Tinker
Description:
Thinking Machines Lab's mission is to empower humanity through advancing collaborative general intelligence. We're building a future where everyone has access to the knowledge and tools to make AI work for their unique needs and goals. 

We are scientists, engineers, and builders who’ve created some of the most widely used AI products, including ChatGPT and Character.ai, open-weights models like Mistral, as well as popular open source projects like PyTorch, OpenAI Gym, Fairseq, and Segment Anything.

About Tinker

Tinker is our fine-tuning API that empowers researchers and developers to customize frontier AI to their needs — opening access to capabilities that have previously been concentrated in a handful of labs. We manage the infrastructure while allowing Tinkerers full flexibility in training open weights models with their own data, algorithms, and for their own needs. Tinker is rapidly adding new customers, features, and novel use-cases. We’re hiring to grow the platform alongside the Tinker community.

About the Role

We’re hiring a research engineer focused on developer experience to build Tinker while using Tinker — working hands-on with real users and turning their challenges into product improvements. You’ll write and update cookbook recipes, add library features,  prototype integrations, and ensure users can customize models smoothly.

This role is a bridge between Tinker users and our research and infrastructure teams. You’ll surface user patterns to guide product and infrastructure priorities, and share what you learn through blog posts, demos, and code examples.

This is a technical-first role with a major user-facing component. It’s ideal for someone who’s happiest in a code editor or Jupyter notebook, but who also enjoys talking to creative people. Tinker is flexible by design to empower novel and ambitious use cases for model fine-tuning — your job is to help them succeed.

What You’ll Do

  • Write, test, and maintain high-quality code examples, recipes, and documentation in the Tinker cookbook.
  • Work directly with a variety of users to debug technical issues and optimize their fine-tuning pipelines.
  • Partner with internal research and infra teams to identify and prioritize improvements to Tinker’s developer experience.
  • Build tools, integrations, and demos that reduce user friction and make it easy to experiment and deploy models.
  • Share insights from the field through posts, guides, and talks.
  • Help develop Tinker’s near-term roadmap and long-term product strategy.

Preferred Qualifications

Enabling user success in building on top of an advanced platform is a skill that can be developed through many paths. You might demonstrate that you have it if you:

  • Experienced with fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) with supervised and reinforcement learning, and how to tune the hyperparameters of these algorithms.
  • Experienced with developing software libraries, especially open-source libraries.
  • Are thoughtful about developer experience, with clear ideas around developer ergonomics, onboarding flow, and sharp edges.
  • Are passionate about engaging with open-source communities, whether by contributing code, answering questions, or sharing learnings.
  • Have written public or internal code examples, tutorials, or papers that helped others understand and apply technical concepts.
  • Are comfortable reasoning about model training, fine-tuning, and inference, and can credibly discuss tradeoffs between different approaches.

Logistics

  • Location: This role is based in San Francisco, California.

Title: Principal Software Engineer, Developer Experience Platform
Description:
Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions is seeking a Principal Software Engineer, Developer Experience Platform to build and operate the engineering system that moves work from requirement through local development, focused validation, CI/CD, deployment, and production feedback across a mature retail point-of-sale estate. 

This is not an advisory architecture role. You will work directly in Java and JavaScript repositories, Maven builds, Docker and Kubernetes environments, GitLab/Jenkins pipelines, platform services, and OpenTelemetry traces. You will reproduce developer friction, write the critical code, and own improvements through rollout and adoption. 

You will also direct agentic engineering workers, AI coding and analysis agents that execute bounded engineering tasks. You will supply context and constraints, decompose work, supervise execution, review and correct output, enforce deterministic gates, and remain accountable for every accepted change. 

Developer Experience is treated as an engineering product, not a collection of tools. Success means engineers can onboard, build, test, provision, deploy, diagnose, and learn from production with less waiting, less cognitive load, and fewer manual handoffs. 

Mission 

Build a developer platform and agentic engineering operating model that lets engineers move from requirement to safe production feedback with less waiting, cognitive load, and manual coordination. Success is demonstrated through working software, faster feedback, reliable self-service, and sustained adoption, not through the volume of diagrams or standards produced. 

Engineering Environment 

  • A mature POS estate spanning Java and JavaScript applications, Maven builds, Docker-based local and CI environments, Kubernetes and Helm deployment assets, and GitLab/Jenkins delivery workflows.
  • Cloud and store-edge software with different connectivity, rollout, recovery, security, and operational constraints.
  • A large business-facing Cucumber BDD suite with browser-driven validation, seeded test data, service dependencies, parallel execution, and release-gating implications.
  • Existing OpenTelemetry-based diagnostics and an evolving browser-automation path that must be integrated into useful developer feedback rather than operated as isolated tooling. 
  • An expanding agentic engineering model in which AI workers assist with analysis, implementation, testing, review, triage, and release preparation under controlled access and deterministic validation. 

Key Responsibilities 

Hands-On Platform Engineering and Technical Ownership 

  • Personally build and operate developer-facing services, command-line tools, integrations, templates, reusable pipeline libraries, portal or catalog capabilities, and environment automation. 
  • Use profiling, logs, metrics, traces, and controlled experiments to reproduce bottlenecks and eliminate root causes across local, CI, environment, deployment, and production-feedback workflows. 
  • Carry critical changes from design through code, migration, deployment, runbooks, adoption, and operational follow-through. A recommendation is not complete until the path works for engineers. 

Developer Experience as an Engineering Product 

  • Map the end-to-end developer journey, identify the highest-cost friction, maintain a prioritized improvement roadmap, and publish clear ownership and service expectations. 
  • Use developer research, workflow telemetry, support demand, and delivery data to distinguish systemic constraints from isolated preferences.
  • Maintain platform contracts, lifecycle policies, deprecation paths, and architecture decisions that are backed by working reference implementations and practical migration plans.

Onboarding, Local Development, and the Inner Loop 

  • Create reproducible, automated setup for source access, dependencies, configuration, secrets, local services, test data, and development environments.
  • Improve edit-build-test-debug cycles through caching, incremental execution, targeted validation, realistic mocks or service virtualization, and actionable local diagnostics.
  • Replace tribal knowledge with executable documentation, ownership metadata, runbooks, and self-service guidance that remains current because it is part of the delivery system. 

Golden Paths and Platform Self-Service 

  • Define paved roads for services, APIs, user interfaces, data and configuration, security, observability, testing, deployment, and store-edge components.
  • Build and govern templates, scaffolding, reusable libraries, pipeline components, policy automation, and a developer portal or catalog that exposes ownership, documentation, dependencies, health, and support paths.
  • Enable on-demand and ephemeral environments, preview environments, seeded or synthetic test data, automated access, and lifecycle cleanup through infrastructure as code. 

CI/CD, Release, and Production Feedback 

  • Engineer and evolve developer-facing GitLab/Jenkins workflows that provide fast, tiered feedback for local changes, merge requests, integration, release qualification, deployment, and post-deployment verification.
  • Improve build and pipeline performance through profiling, caching, parallelism, dependency discipline, failure isolation, and clear separation of product, test, environment, and infrastructure failures.
  • Standardize artifact versioning, provenance, promotion, rollback, SBOM generation, signing, and software-supply-chain controls without turning routine delivery into a ticket queue.
  • Put logs, metrics, traces, deployment state, runbooks, and production signals directly in the engineer's workflow so failures can be understood and acted on quickly. 

Agentic Engineering Workforce 

  • Build controlled integrations that give agentic workers least-privilege, auditable access to source code, work items, documentation, build systems, test systems, environments, and telemetry.
  • Turn ambiguous engineering goals into bounded agent work packets with repository context, architecture constraints, acceptance criteria, risk, test strategy, stop conditions, and escalation paths.
  • Supervise concurrent agent work, detect stalls, loops, scope drift, and conflicting solutions, and intervene directly when the work requires Principal-level judgment.
  • Review, test, and modify agent-produced code and analysis. Require deterministic build, test, security, policy, and observability evidence before accepting output. 
  • Create reusable agent skills and workflows for analysis, implementation, refactoring, test authoring, pipeline changes, documentation, defect triage, and release preparation.
  • Measure accepted output, rework, defect impact, cycle-time change, and execution efficiency so agentic capacity compounds team output without reducing quality or accountability.

Measurement and Continuous Improvement 

  • Own DORA measures together with developer-flow indicators such as onboarding time, feedback speed, build and test duration, environment wait, merge-request cycle time, cognitive load, satisfaction, and tooling or process friction.
  • Create end-to-end observability for the developer platform using OpenTelemetry or equivalent instrumentation, including queueing, environment readiness, pipeline stages, failure classes, and deployment latency. 
  • Use baselines, service-level objectives, experiments, and adoption data to demonstrate measurable improvement without degrading quality, reliability, security, or developer sustainability. 

 

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated success designing and delivering internal developer platforms, developer-productivity capabilities, or large-scale engineering enablement used in complex production environments.

  • Experience directing AI coding agents or agentic engineering workflows, including task decomposition, context design, tool permissions, output review, and deterministic validation.

Title: Engineering, Cybersecurity, Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), Principal
Description:
About TPG

TPG is a leading global alternative asset management firm, founded in San Francisco in 1992, has investment and operational teams around the world. TPG invests across a broadly diversified set of strategies, including private equity, impact, credit, real estate, and market solutions, and our unique strategy is driven by collaboration, innovation, and inclusion. Our teams combine deep product and sector experience with broad capabilities and expertise to develop differentiated insights and add value for our fund investors, portfolio companies, management teams, and communities.

TPG’s success depends on our people, and we build and sustain our world-class team by creating an inclusive, supportive culture within the firm that seeks excellence and encourages humility and transparency. The quality of our investments and our ability to build great companies depend on the originality of our insights. Reaching our firm’s full potential means supporting every team member to bring the fullness of their unique perspective to their work and to our community. We are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace to foster diversity of thought and reflect the breadth of our limited partners and portfolio companies. 

Description of Position

 

TPG has an exciting opportunity for an Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) Principal to join TPG’s Cybersecurity team. The number one focus of this role is the ground-up redesign and ongoing maturity of the firm’s IGA program. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for a senior practitioner who wants to shape an identity program rather than inherit one. TPG’s Cybersecurity team protects the firm’s applications, data, and clients across a fast-moving technology landscape. Identity is at the center of that mission — the firm’s access management platform serves as the hub connecting every business application, and getting identity governance right is foundational to everything else we do.

Principal Responsibilities

  • Serve as a senior leader and subject-matter expert for the firm’s IGA program, helping to drive its strategy, roadmap, and day-to-day operation
  • Play a key role in the ground-up redesign of TPG’s IGA program — partnering with our third-party advisory firm to reimagine identity tools, processes, and governance, and ensuring the resulting design reflects TPG’s business requirement
  • Lead the implementation or migration effort for the selected IGA platform, including solution design, configuration, application onboarding, connector and integration development, and cutover planning
  • Design and operate core IGA processes — joiner/mover/leaver lifecycle management, access requests and approvals, access certifications and reviews, role-based access control and role mining, segregation of duties, and governance of privileged access
  • Serve as a liaison between technical and business teams — communicating effectively with system owners, data owners, and business managers to gather requirements, resolve issues, and drive adoption of new identity processes
  • Develop a deep understanding of the identity and access structure of each supported business application — most importantly Microsoft Entra ID — and integrate those applications into the IGA platform
  • Automate identity lifecycle and governance workflows through scripting, APIs, and platform-native capabilities to reduce manual effort and error
  • Define metrics, reporting, and key performance indicators that demonstrate program maturity, audit readiness, and risk reduction; support internal and external audit requests
  • Mentor and develop junior members of the IGA team, and help build identity governance expertise across the broader Cybersecurity organization
  • Contribute to enterprise identity and access management standards, policies, and governance documentation

Requirements

  • Minimum 5 years of experience focused on identity governance and administration
  • Hands-on experience implementing and administering one or more enterprise IGA platforms (e.g., Saviynt, SailPoint), with experience leading a platform evaluation, migration, or greenfield deployment strongly valued
  • Deep understanding of core identity governance concepts, including identity lifecycle management, provisioning and deprovisioning, access certification, role-based access control, and segregation of duties
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID and modern identity architectures, including federation and authentication standards such as SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and SCIM
  • Software programming or scripting experience (e.g., PowerShell, Python) and comfort working with REST APIs and application connectors
  • Communicate effectively with system owners, data owners, business managers, and senior leadership — including the ability to explain identity risk to non-technical audiences and influence without direct authority
  • Experience working with or managing third-party consultants, advisors, or implementation partners
  • Be comfortable and capable swinging between efforts that are broad and strategic in scope to tasks that are tedious and require strict attention to detail
  • Critically assess existing processes and systems, and drive constructive, evidence-based improvements while keeping current operations running
  • Invite and provide evidence-based feedback in a timely and constructive manner
  • Possess an ownership attitude as it relates to identifying errors, process inconsistencies, or security weaknesses

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Information/Cyber Security, or a related field, or equivalent work experience
  • Experience leading an IGA platform selection, replacement, or re-implementation, including RFP development and proof-of-concept evaluation
  • Platform certifications such as Saviynt IGA Professional or SailPoint Identity Security certifications, or broader credentials such as CISSP, CISM, or CIAM
  • Familiarity with privileged access management (PAM) tools and their integration with IGA platforms
  • Experience securing cloud and SaaS identity environments (e.g., Microsoft 365, AWS, Azure) and integrating SaaS applications into governance workflows
  • Experience in financial services or another regulated industry, including supporting SOX, SOC, or similar audit and compliance requirements
