Compensation will be determined based on several factors including, but not limited to, skill set, years of experience, and the employee’s geographic location.

Pay Range
$175,000—$223,000 USD

Title: Material Program Manager IV
Description:
Voyager is an innovative space, defense, and national security technology company committed to advancing and delivering transformative, mission-critical solutions. We tackle the most complex challenges to unlock new frontiers for human progress, fortify national security, and protect critical assets to lead in the race for technological and operational superiority from ground to space.

Forge the Future: Join Voyager Technologies

The future belongs to those who build it. At Voyager Technologies, we’re building technologies that protect lives, expand frontiers and prepare us for what’s next. And we’re doing that with people who are wired to solve, build, adapt and lead. These roles are not for the faint of heart.

You’ll help lay the foundation for humanity's future. Join a culture where innovation thrives, curiosity is rewarded, and impact is real. We’re a company of doers, thinkers and builders, united by purpose and grounded in reality.

If you want to put your skills to work where the stakes are real and the mission is bigger than any one person, forge the future with Voyager.

The Material Program Manager (level 5) is responsible and accountable for the execution of material schedule and budget for Voyager Technologies, including program execution with key propulsion subcontractors. The MPM leads all phases of subcontract program execution. This includes developing supplier program management documentation such as monthly status reports, SRR/PDR/CDR materials, program planning documentation, and program management related CDRLs, and presenting subcontract program materials to technical teams, leadership, and customers. The Material Program Manager (MPM) is a unique position that requires strategic thinking as well as tactical execution allowing an individual to make immediate tangible impacts. A successful MPM can work with minimal supervision to solve complex problems to ensure both short term and long term success of their respective program. An MPM would need to possess strong hard skills to execute plans to completion, as well as soft skills to appropriately work with multiple disciplines, and communicate challenges to many stakeholders. It is a rare position to stretch your skillsets and test your abilities making real impact on the organization.

Responsibilities include:

  • Demonstrated ability generating, managing, and owning Integrated Master Schedules (IMS), Integrated Master Plans (IMP), and EVMS (earned value management system)
  • Financial responsibilities including project-level profit and loss, EAC’s, material sales forecasting, accruals, and cost account management (CAM)
  • Lead program execution with key subcontractors through all program phases, including SRR/PDR/CDR milestones and program management related CDRLs
  • Serve as a primary customer contact for material and subcontract program information
  • Ability to confidently present and represent Voyager Technologies Global Supply Chain in Program Management Reviews, leadership briefings, and customer briefings
  • Ability to creatively solve complex supply chain problems with data driven strategies
  • Demonstrated aptitude in identifying Risks and Opportunities to the program
  • Consistently work on supply and demand to proactively identify gaps to eliminate them
  • Escalate critical material shortages immediately upon identification and own efforts to resolve them
  • Ability to resolve short term problems while maintaining long term success of the program
  • Demonstrated ability to work in a fast paced development environment
  • Implement solutions to overcome current & future material shortages
  • Coordinate and optimize delivery schedules with critical Suppliers
  • Support follow-on and new business opportunities, including input into proposals
  • Challenge business impediments to excellence and continuous improvement
  • Demonstrated ability to lead others through dynamic and fluid environments

If your experience aligns with our basic qualifications and you are inspired by our mission, we’d like to connect. If you don’t see the right role right now, Join Our Talent Community and stay connected as we continue to build what’s next.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering or business AND a minimum of twenty (20) years of program management and/or supply chain management experience, including five (5) years managing DoD propulsion related programs
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a US Government issued Secret clearance; US citizenship is required
  • Direct experience managing large subcontracts
  • Material Program Management and/or Supply Chain Management experience working on prime defense programs
  • Experience briefing executive management and customers on program status, risks, and future plans
  • Demonstrate strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills
  • Strong Program and Budget Management skills
  • Proficient user with Microsoft Office Suite including Word, Project, Excel and PowerPoint

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Active DoD Secret clearance
  • Management of rocket propulsion defense system programs, including propulsion control systems

Title: Senior Program Manager, Propulsors
Description:
Our Company

Whisper Aero is pioneering a more compelling and connected future by delivering cleaner, quieter, and more efficient propulsion solutions. Today's open rotor propulsion systems are challenged by safety, noise, and performance limitations at all scales. Whisper's breakthrough technologies allow aircraft to fly anywhere at any time without disturbing communities, at greater speeds, and with incredible improvements in efficiency and cost. Their innovations also enable a new generation of air moving products that can blend into the soundscapes of daily life. Whisper was founded by industry veterans, Mark Moore and Ian Villa, and continues to innovate a future that’s as considerate as it is compelling with its world-class team in Tennessee. 

About the Role

Whisper Aero is seeking an experienced Senior Program Manager to lead the development and integration of electric ducted fan propulsion systems for next generation of commercial and defense aircraft in Nashville, TN. In this role, you will oversee cross-functional engineering teams. You’ll drive program execution from concept through certification while meeting performance, schedule, and cost metrics.

 

The successful candidate will be someone with a strong aerospace background in aircraft, propulsion, or aerospace component development who thrives in a fast paced, technically challenging environment. They will be able to clearly communicate with all stakeholders including engineers, suppliers, customers, and leadership.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead program planning and execution for electric propulsion system development from concept through test and certification
  • Manage scope, schedule, and budgets while ensuring alignment across the team
  • Collaborate with cross-functional team to define system requirements, milestones, and risk management strategies
  • Drive issue resolution and program decisions balancing technical performance, risk, and schedule
  • Interface with suppliers, customers, and certification authorities to ensure compliance with aerospace standards and regulatory requirements
  • Support long-term product strategy, roadmap planning, and technology maturation for future propulsion systems
  • Facilitate cross-functional design reviews and program updates to internal and external stakeholders
  • Interact regularly with leadership to communicate status, priorities, issues, and resource needs
  • Use agile management tools to plan sprints, track progress, and maintain documentation across teams

Basic Qualifications

  • S. Person status is required, as this position may access export controlled data
  • 8+ years of experience in the aerospace industry with at least 5 years in a program management role
  • Proven track record managing complex, multi-disciplinary aerospace programs (preferably involving propulsion or power systems)
  • Experience defining and managing program schedules and budgets
  • Experience applying agile methodologies in a hardware or hybrid hardware/software program environment
  • Strong understanding of one of the following areas: aircraft propulsion, electrical power generation/distribution, or hybrid-electric architectures
  • Demonstrated ability to lead diverse technical teams and manage suppliers or partners
  • Proficiency with agile project management tools such as Jira, Confluence, or equivalent to plan, prioritize, track, and execute hardware and software development activities (including resource allocation and workload management)
  • Experience using Jira, Confluence, or similar platforms to maintain technical documentation and design artifacts while enabling effective cross-functional communication and project execution
  • Background in R&D environments developing new aerospace technologies
  • Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills
  • A willingness to work on tasks outside your primary job functions

Bonus Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in aerospace, mechanical, electrical, or systems engineering, or a related field
  • PMP certification
  • Experience with aircraft engine, electrical machine, inverter, or energy storage system development
  • Experience with aircraft propulsion, inlet, or exhaust integration development
  • Working knowledge of industry standards and regulatory requirements related to aircraft, engines, electric machines, or electronics
  • Strong understanding of certification processes (Part 23, 25, or 33) and system safety (ARP4754A, ARP4761)
  • Experience with testing of medium or high voltage power systems
  • Experience with modern requirements management software

You will manage a dedicated delivery team and collaborate closely with the Market Managing Director, Campaign Management Lead, Strategy Lead, Creative Strategist, Media Planning & Buying Team, Paid Social Team, and Partnerships Team.

  3. Collaborate with top-tier creative, media, paid social, influencer marketing, strategy, and partnerships professionals, with access to WPP’s global tools and resources.

  • Take brief and collaborate with the team to deliver best proposal and strategy

Team Management & Development

  • Lead, mentor, and inspire a dedicated delivery team.
  • Foster a collaborative, high-performance culture.
  • Oversee workload allocation, ensuring resources are optimised for delivery excellence.

  • Develop case studies and success stories to showcase the value of WPP Media Influence’s work.

  • Media Planning & Buying Team → Integration with broader media strategy

Must Have

Nice to Have

10–13 years’ experience in advertising, PR, social media, or influencer marketing

FMCG category experience

Proven track record in client leadership & revenue growth

Regional SEA market experience

Strong understanding of influencer marketing ecosystem

Experience with WPP tools & platforms

Excellent analytical & data-to-insight skills

Fluency in Bahasa Malaysia or Mandarin

Leadership experience managing teams

Experience in integrated media/content campaigns

Deep familiarity with Malaysian & Singaporean market context & culture

Experience in trendspotting & emerging platforms

Excellent communication & presentation skills in English

Experience in high-growth digital environments

  • Revenue: Achieves or exceeds quarterly and annual revenue targets.
  • Client Satisfaction: High NPS / feedback scores; contract renewals secured.
  • Campaign Performance: Meets or exceeds agreed KPIs (reach, engagement, conversions).
  • Team Performance: High retention, strong engagement, and skill growth.
  • Strategic Impact: Recognised by client as a key strategic partner.

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. Missions & Responsibilities

The Data Governance Director enforces global data standards, taxonomy integrity, and compliance across all luxury Maisons and markets. He/She is responsible for transitioning data operations from manual checks to an automated Prevention–Monitoring–Correction framework. The rôle ensure strong data quality for global reporting, Optimus dashboards, and ultimately WPP Open integrations.

As the Data Governance Director, you will enforce global data standards, taxonomy integrity, and compliance across all luxury Maisons and markets. You will be responsible for transitioning data operations from manual checks to an automated Prevention–Monitoring–Correction framework. This role ensures strong data quality for global reporting, Optimus dashboards, and ultimately WPP Open integrations.

1. Data Governance & Taxonomy Management

  • Framework & Model Ownership: Build, own, and execute the end-to-end Prevention–Monitoring–Correction data model.
  • Annual Taxonomy Review: Lead the yearly cycle for global taxonomy review, cleanup, and integration of new data dimensions across all Maisons.
  • Naming Conventions: Enforce standardized naming conventions globally, including unique Campaign IDs to enable automated campaign record aggregation via Accutics or internal systems.
  • AdTech & Tracking Governance: Oversee tracking standards across server-side tagging, GA4, channel grouping governance, and migration projects (e.g., BBB – ARM Migration).

2. Operations & Compliance Management

  • Data Accuracy Enforcer: Drive global data compliance from current baselines up to a strict 95% accuracy rate across all channels, Maisons, and markets.
  • Input Data Readiness: Ensure clean, trusted input data flows into Optimus dashboards (and ultimately WPP Open), eliminating fragmented taxonomies and reporting discrepancies.
  • Team & Process Oversight: Direct and advise Data Operations Executives and Associate Directors on best practices for automated data validation beyond basic string checking.

Qualifications & Profile

  • Experience: 8–10+ years of proven experience in Digital Data Governance, Taxonomy Management, or Media Data Operations.
  • Background: Strong AdOps background with hands-on experience in digital tracking, ad serving, and multi-market data compliance.
  • Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of taxonomy architecture, dynamic UTM/naming structures, Accutics, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), server-side tracking, and campaign management workflows.
  • Stakeholder Management: Proven track record of enforcing governance standards across multi-brand, multi-agency, and international team environments.
  • Key Soft Skills: Great autonomy, strong organizational skills, and a strategic mindset. High level of diplomacy, active listening, and the ability to communicate technical data governance standards clearly to both executive stakeholders and operational teams.

Our commitment to shaping the future of media is reflected in active support for the professional development of our talent, helping them reach their full potential. This approach goes hand-in-hand with a responsible vision in our media investment strategies, reflecting our dual priority: valuing our people while adopting sustainable practices across our industry.

We foster an inclusive work culture where team accomplishments and expertise are regularly celebrated through engaging internal events.

  • Additional Time Off: 2 extra days off offered annually, plus additional leave tiers based on seniority.
  • Inclusive Policies & Well-being: Dedicated health leave programs (including up to 5 WFH days/month for employees suffering from endometriosis), specific support programs, and paid leave allowances for employees with recognized disability status (RQTH).
  • Social Impact: Opportunities to participate in community and solidarity missions via our "We care and we act" program.

Title: Program Manager, Prohibited & Regulated Content
Location: Palo Alto, CA; Bastrop, TX; New York, NY
Description:
SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We serve our community of users and customers by working tirelessly to preserve free expression and choice, create limitless interactivity, and maintain a safe digital marketplace. The Safety Integrity Program Manager, Regulated & Prohibited Content will drive priorities, measures, and system health for regulated and prohibited content, owning program standards and execution across upstream systems and downstream operations.

You are an experienced program manager with a strong background in content integrity, enforcement, or risk programs at scale. You are skilled at setting requirements for detection and automation, translating policy and legal constraints into practical workflows and controls, and driving cross-functional partners to improve coverage, precision, and enforcement quality. You thrive in fast-paced environments and excel at turning operational signals into lasting improvements.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Drive priorities, measures, and system health for regulated and prohibited content, and continuously improve execution
  • Set requirements and success criteria for detection and automation, and drive Product, Engineering, and Operations to improve coverage, precision, and enforcement quality at scale.
  • Translate legal, policy, and technical constraints into practical requirements, workflows, controls, and escalation paths for Product, Engineering, and Operations.
  • Identify gaps in the current framework and drive enhancements to policies, procedures, controls, and workflows.
  • Own escalations, quality assurance, and complex case patterns for residual volume, and use those signals to harden standards and automation over time.
  • Align and drive Product, Engineering, Policy, Legal, and Operations partners to resolve dependencies, make decisions, and move critical work forward with clear accountable ownership.
  • Build and maintain the documentation, guidance, and operating standards that embed consistent execution across the program.
  • Monitor relevant regulatory developments, assess impact on the program, and ensure requirements stay accurate and executable.
  • Track and report operational performance, risks, and improvement opportunities with clear recommendations for leadership

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 5+ years in content integrity, safety operations, compliance operations, or related program roles supporting enforcement or risk programs at scale.
  • Experience owning or supporting program priorities, measures, and operational health for content or risk domains.
  • Working knowledge of regulated or prohibited content areas and how policy, legal, and technical constraints shape enforcement.
  • Experience translating policy or legal requirements into practical workflows, controls, and escalation paths.
  • Experience working with automated or model-driven enforcement systems, including detection, classifiers, or policy automation.
  • Proven ability to drive cross-functional work with Product, Engineering, Policy, Legal, and Operations partners.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience using operational data to identify gaps, prioritize interventions, and track outcomes.
  • Clear written and verbal communication; able to brief leadership and document standards, decisions, and recommendations.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Direct experience with regulated or prohibited content programs.
  • Experience setting requirements for detection, classifiers, or automation and partnering with Product or Engineering teams on outcomes.
  • Experience owning escalations, quality assurance, or residual case handling for enforcement programs.
  • Familiarity with regulatory developments affecting online platforms and content enforcement.
  • Exposure to integrity risks involving synthetic content, model misuse, or scaled manipulation.
  • Experience improving operating standards, documentation, and controls in a live program environment.
  • Background in high-scale consumer platforms, marketplaces, or technology products.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

$110,000 - $145,000 USD

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at xAI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here. 

SpaceXAI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our Recruitment Privacy Notice.

Title: Data Transformation  Program Manager
Description:
Xebia is a global AI-first, digital transformation, and engineering partner. With over 25 years of experience and a team of 5,000 professionals across 16 countries, we help organizations design and build scalable products, platforms, and data-driven solutions. 

We specialize in Artificial Intelligence, Data and Cloud, Intelligent Automation, and Digital Products, combining deep technical expertise with a strong focus on engineering excellence and a people-first culture.  

In the CEE region, we’re a team of nearly 1,000 experts delivering modern applications, data platforms, and AI solutions for clients such as McLaren, Aviva, Deloitte, Spotify, Disney, ING, UPS, Tesco, Truecaller, AllSaints, Volotea, Schmitz Cargobull, Allegro, InPost, and many, many more. We work with leading technologies including AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, and Snowflake, and combine strong engineering culture with a consulting mindset and a continuous focus on growth and knowledge sharing. 

You will be:

  • leading the engagement from kickoff through assessment, scope definition, delivery, operationalisation and handover,
  • driving business and technology alignment around data platform adoption, operating model, data ownership, stewardship, data quality and handover,
  • validating whether the BU is genuinely ready to proceed: sponsor commitment, SME availability, data owner authority, source access, decision-making and remediation ownership,
  • acting as the main engagement interface for business sponsors, senior data stakeholders, central programme teams and technology teams,
  • coordinating Data Architect, Platform Engineer, DQ / Analytics and knowledge management roles. Translate technical findings into business-readable decisions,
  • owning risks, issues, decision logs and escalation flow. Escalating early when a local issue may affect readiness, delivery quality or handover,

 

Your profile:

  • 10+ years of experience in IT, data, platform or digital transformation delivery,
  • at least 5 years in senior delivery, programme leadership, engagement leadership, data practice leadership or pre-sales roles related to data transformation,
  • credible experience specifically with data platform, data governance or data transformation initiatives - e.g. data quality remediation, master data / canonical model definition, data stewardship operating models, or migration/adoption of a modern data platform. Generic cloud infrastructure or application modernisation programmes do not count on their own, even when paired with governance or roadmap responsibilities,
  • able to discuss operating model, data stewardship, data quality, source ownership, lineage, integration and platform adoption at a practical delivery level,
  • strong executive stakeholder management; comfortable working with senior business sponsors, central programme teams and senior data / technology leaders,
  • proven ability to challenge business stakeholders constructively when readiness, ownership, scope or data quality is weak,
  • experience with structured delivery governance: steering meetings, risk logs, decision logs, escalation paths and formal client checkpoints,
  • strong communicator who can explain data-related risks in business language and guide stakeholders toward a decision,
  • comfortable managing ambiguity, pressure, conflicting priorities and multiple concurrent engagements,
  • fluent, high-impact English is required. Portuguese, French or Spanish is an advantage depending on region.

  • Work from the European Union region and a work permit are required.

CV review – HR call – Interview – Client Interview – Decision

Title: Product Manager - Developer Experience
Location: Bali, Indonesia; Bangkok, Thailand; Jakarta, Indonesia; Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia; Manila, Philippines; Singapore, Singapore
Description:
Xendit provides payment infrastructure across Southeast Asia and is expanding to Greater China and LATAM. We process payments, power marketplaces, disburse payroll and loans, provide KYC solutions, prevent fraud, and help businesses grow exponentially. We serve our customers by providing a suite of world-class APIs, eCommerce platform integrations, and easy to use applications for individual entrepreneurs, SMEs, and enterprises alike.

Our main focus is building the most advanced payment rails for Southeast Asia, with a clear goal in mind — to make payments across and within SEA simple, secure and easy for everyone. We serve thousands of businesses ranging from SMEs to multinational enterprises, and process millions of transactions monthly. We’ve been growing rapidly since our inception in 2015, onboarding hundreds of new customers every month, and backed by global top-10 VCs. We’re proud to be featured on among the fastest growing companies by Y-Combinator.

Why this role exists

For a payment-infrastructure company, the product is in large part the API. Developers are both the buyers and the daily users, and the quality of the APIs, SDKs, docs, sandbox, and integration path is the product's real surface. This role owns the developer's journey from first API call to production and scale, the difference between a developer who integrates in an afternoon and one who gives up before their first successful transaction.

What you'll own

  • The roadmap for the developer experience: integration flow, SDKs, documentation, sandbox, error handling, and time-to-first-successful-call.
  • Developer activation and retention as headline metrics, from sign-up to first production transaction and beyond.
  • Discovery grounded in developer behavior: integration analytics, support and community signals, and direct developer research.
  • Partnership with Engineering on API design and DX standards, and prioritization of DX debt against new capabilities.
  • Clear communication of trade-offs to senior stakeholders, and translation of platform changes into a coherent developer-facing experience.

How you will work

You report to the Product Design & UX Director for Customer Lifecycle and work most closely with Engineering, whose API and platform decisions shape the experience you own. Part of your early work is helping define where developer-experience ownership sits, since this surface has not had a dedicated product owner before. You are the strategic owner of the developer journey from first API call to production. Your time splits between developer discovery and roadmap delivery, with constant engineering partnership. The domain works from validated findings rather than assumptions and values direct, candid critique.

What we're looking for

  • PM experience with API, platform, or developer-facing products. You have owned products where developers are the user.
  • Genuine technical fluency. You can read API docs and discuss schemas, auth, and webhooks with engineers, here this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.
  • Demonstrated empathy for developer workflows. You understand how developers actually work and where they get stuck.

A strong plus: a background as a developer, or having built SDK, docs, or DX products; payments or fintech experience.

Title: Sr. Staff Technical Program Manager
Location: Remote - USA; San Jose, California, USA
Description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange™️ platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 160+ public exchanges globally and thousands of private exchanges at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Sr. Staff Technical Program Manager to join our team. This is a Hybrid (San Jose, 3 days a week) role or Remote role, reporting to the Cloud Operations Manager in the REIS (Reliability Engineering and Infrastructure Services) department. The Technical Program Management team within the Reliability Engineering and Infrastructure Services (REIS) organization is seeking an experienced, highly technical Project / Program Manager to lead complex, internal infrastructure and services initiatives, large-scale Data Center (DC) migrations, and building new cloud environments. 

Operating within our cross-functional program management organization, this position functions primarily as an internally-facing, hands-on Technical Project Manager (explicitly distinct from Product Management) responsible for orchestrating cross-functional technical projects across various teams for our cloud infrastructure. The ideal candidate brings a deep technical foundation in server, network, data center operations, building new clouds, and DC migration execution paired with proven hands-on project management expertise.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Drive end-to-end project management and execution of complex, internal infrastructure, new cloud builds, Data Center (DC) migrations, and cloud services programs/projects—defining project charters, detailed project plans, milestones, deliverables, and tracking execution through to closure
  • Partner closely with internal technical teams—including system engineers, infrastructure architects, cloud operations, security, and engineering leads—to ensure seamless project execution and internal stakeholder alignment
  • Establish robust project/program management frameworks, project management playbooks, continuous process improvement initiatives, and operational documentation to elevate execution rigor across REIS projects
  • Drive proactive risk management, technical dependency tracking, and executive governance across REIS programs—identifying critical blockers early, establishing mitigation plans, and communicating strategic progress to leadership
  • Maintain high data integrity across internal operational platforms and PM tools (Jira, Confluence, dashboards, and spreadsheets) to drive transparent, data-informed program decisions

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity and feel comfortable building the path as you walk it, viewing a dynamic environment not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
  • You act like an owner with a passion for the mission that fuels your bias for action, operating with integrity and navigating seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator who is ambitious for the team, embracing ongoing feedback with candor, clarity, and respect as the truest form of teamwork.
  • You are a positive force who approaches hard problems with contagious, constructive energy and a can-do spirit that inspires your team to stay focused on solutions.
  • You champion simplicity by distilling complex technical concepts, user needs, and operational challenges into clear, actionable plans and precise communication.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving
  • Demonstrated proficiency utilizing operational information systems and PM tools (spreadsheets, dashboards, Jira, Confluence)
  • 10+ years of hands-on technical project and program management experience within cloud operations, networking, infrastructure, data center operations, building new cloud footprints, or DC migration initiatives in a SaaS/cloud environment
  • Proven hands-on technical project management background working directly with internal infrastructure, servers, networking, and cloud services engineering teams
  • Demonstrated experience driving internal-facing cross-functional projects, new cloud deployment initiatives, data center migrations, and infrastructure programs across system engineering, support, product management, and cloud operations
  • US Citizenship required
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) or Scrum Master (CSM/PSM) certification
  • Hands-on experience leading multi-phase Data Center (DC) migrations, building new cloud infrastructure/footprints, hardware refresh, or cloud migration programs
  • Working knowledge and/or understanding of ISO 27001, FedRAMP High, DoD IL5, or related federal compliance standards

Title: Content Marketing Manager
Description: About Air Apps At Air Apps, we believe in thinking bigger—and moving faster. We’re a family-founded company on a mission to create the world’s first AI-powered Personal & Entrepreneurial Resource Planner (PRP), and we need your passion and ambition to help us change how people plan, work, and live. Born in Lisbon, Portugal in 2018—and now with offices in both Lisbon and San Francisco—we’ve remained self-funded while reaching over 100 million downloads worldwide. Our long-term focus drives us to challenge the status quo every day, pushing the boundaries of AI-driven solutions that truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be a creative force, shaping products that empower people across the globe. Join us on this journey to redefine resource management—and change lives along the way. The Role As a Content Marketing Manager at Air Apps, you will be responsible for developing and executing a content strategy that positions us as a thought leader in the industry. You will create engaging, high-quality content such as blog posts, whitepapers, case studies, and email campaigns to educate and attract users. This role requires a mix of storytelling, SEO expertise, and data-driven decision-making to grow our audience and increase brand visibility. This is a fully onsite position , based at our office in Lisbon, where you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams in person and contribute to a dynamic and fast-paced environment. We are open to support with relocation efforts. Responsibilities Develop and execute a content strategy that aligns with business goals and target audiences. Write, edit, and manage high-quality blog posts, whitepapers, case studies, eBooks, and email campaigns . Conduct keyword research and SEO optimization to improve content visibility and search rankings. Collaborate with designers, developers, and product teams to create compelling content assets. Manage the content calendar to ensure consistent publication and engagement. Analyze content performance metrics and optimize for engagement, lead generation, and conversions. Develop brand messaging and storytelling that resonates with our audience. Research industry trends, competitor content, and best practices to refine strategy. Work with guest bloggers, influencers, and external writers to expand content reach. Requirements Around 4+ years of experience in content marketing, copywriting, or editorial roles . Exceptional writing and editing skills with a strong command of storytelling and brand voice . Experience with SEO tools (Google Search Console, Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz) and content optimization techniques. Strong understanding of digital marketing, inbound marketing, and content distribution . Ability to analyze content metrics and adapt strategies based on data insights. Experience managing content calendars, editorial workflows, and content management systems (CMS) like WordPress. Familiarity with email marketing tools (e.g., Mailchimp, HubSpot) is a plus. Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, remote-first environment . A portfolio of published work showcasing blog posts, whitepapers, or case studies . What benefits are we offering? Apple hardware ecosystem for work. Annual Bonus Top-tier Health and Life Insurance for peace of mind. Transportation Budget to support your commute needs. Coverflex benefits package for meal allowances, well-being, and more. Childcare support. Air Conference - an opportunity to meet the team, collaborate, and grow together. Pension Fund to support your long-term financial planning. Urban Sports Club membership to keep you active. Meals 100% free at the hub. Diversity & Inclusion At Air Apps, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We enthusiastically welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We celebrate diversity in all its forms and believe that varied voices and experiences make us stronger. Application Disclaimer At Air Apps, we value transparency and integrity in our hiring process. Applicants must submit their own work without any AI-generated assistance. Any use of AI in application materials, assessments, or interviews will result in disqualification.

Title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Solutions Strategy & Programs
Description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale. Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us. Attributes We Value We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles . You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor. You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next. About the role We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to help scale the Solutions organization at Airwallex. This role sits at the intersection of strategy, operations, delivery, and technical enablement. It is designed for someone who can translate leadership priorities into clear operating mechanisms, drive cross-functional programs across Solutions, Product, Commercial, DevX, Operations, and Salesforce Ops, and build the systems that allow the team to support more customers with greater consistency and leverage. This is not a traditional project coordinator role. The mandate is to help Solutions evolve into a disciplined global operating model, while also supporting a new builder motion where Solutions teams create reusable tools, automation, AI-assisted workflows, documentation, and product-adjacent assets that improve delivery speed and customer outcomes. What you’ll do Own strategic programs that improve how the Solutions organization operates globally, including capacity planning, intake and prioritization, handoff design, reporting cadences, and cross-functional accountability. Drive the ongoing evolution of the Solutions strategic backlog, turning leadership priorities into scoped initiatives with owners, milestones, and measurable outcomes. Improve operating discipline by defining hygiene standards, status models, prioritization reviews, stale-case handling, and visibility into real workload and blockers. Build and run weekly, monthly, and quarterly business rhythms for Solutions leadership, ensuring metrics are actionable, well-defined, and tied to clear owners and follow-up actions. Partner with regional leads to define and operationalize engagement criteria, delivery frameworks, handoff thresholds, and role clarity across SE, SA, TAM, Delivery, Support, and partner teams. Stand up and manage the Solution team’s Feature Builder Program operating layer, including backlog normalization, prioritization, governance and adoption measurement across regions, moving builder work from ad hoc side effort into a formal execution model with protected time, clear project ownership, risk-based governance, and visible outcomes. Work with DevX, Product, and engineering partners to improve self-serve support, documentation quality, AI workflows, and reusable technical assets that reduce repetitive SE effort. Drive structured voice-of-customer and product feedback loops so field insights become better docs, better tooling, and better product decisions. Who you are You have strong program management instincts and know how to bring structure to ambiguous, cross-functional work. You are comfortable operating in technical environments and can work effectively with Solutions Engineers, Product, and engineering teams, even if you are not expected to be a hands-on coder. You can move between strategy and execution: defining frameworks, writing narratives, building cadences, aligning stakeholders, and following through on details. You are highly organized and know how to turn scattered ideas, competing asks, and evolving priorities into a coherent roadmap and execution plan. You have strong judgment on governance and risk, especially when new tooling, AI workflows, or customer-adjacent assets need to be scaled responsibly. You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and are able to drive alignment across regions and functions. Preferred experience Experience in technical program management, operations strategy, solutions operations, or PMO roles in a B2B SaaS, fintech or fast-paced environment. Past consulting experience is preferred, especially in roles involving cross-functional problem solving, operating model design, or complex program delivery. Experience building or scaling reporting mechanisms, operating cadences, backlog management, or workflow systems across global teams. Familiarity with Salesforce-based operational processes and the realities of customer delivery, go-live readiness, and cross-functional dependencies. Exposure to AI-assisted workflows, internal tools, or builder-style programs that turn field pain points into reusable solutions. Why this role matters Commercial demand is growing faster than Solutions headcount, and leadership has been explicit that the answer cannot be hiring alone. The team needs better prioritization, clearer operating mechanisms, stronger handoffs, more reliable metrics, and reusable builder assets that reduce repetitive work and improve customer outcomes at scale. This role is critical to making that shift happen. Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @ airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page. Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary. Equal opportunity Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

You will work closely with global and regional teammates across Growth, Product Marketing, Product, SEO, Performance Marketing, and Lifecycle to build content that drives qualified demand, pipeline, and revenue. This role is ideal for a hands-on content leader who loves writing and editing SEO content, ebooks, guides, and one-pagers, and who is excited to go deep on technical product narratives—translating complex capabilities into clear, compelling, conversion-oriented content. You will join the Airwallex Marketing team during a critical period of growth. As we scale, we are building a team that balances global consistency in content strategy, quality, and process, with local flexibility and speed in execution. This is a unique opportunity to help shape how growth content drives the next phase of Airwallex’s expansion. This role is based in London. Own the end-to-end demand gen content strategy, spanning SEO, gated assets, mid-funnel conversion content, and product-led narratives. Work closely with SEO and Performance Marketing to align content with keyword intent, funnel stages, and conversion goals. Be obsessive about measurement and iteration, using performance data to continuously optimize content for traffic quality, engagement, and pipeline impact. Hold a high bar for content quality and technical accuracy, ensuring clarity without oversimplifying complex concepts. Build a structured experimentation mindset—scaling what performs, refreshing or retiring what doesn’t. Balance short-term growth outcomes with longer-term investments in evergreen content, topical authority, and durable demand. A proven track record of creating content that drives measurable business outcomes across the funnel—from traffic to MQLs to pipeline. Exceptional writing and editing skills, with the ability to explain technical products, platforms, or workflows clearly and credibly. Strong understanding of SEO fundamentals, including keyword intent, on-page optimization, internal linking, and content clustering. Title: Growth Content Marketing Manager
Description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale. Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us. Attributes We Value We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles . You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor. You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. We work to communicate the value of our financial solutions, attract new customers, and strengthen relationships with existing ones. This role is ideal for a hands-on content leader who loves writing and editing SEO content, ebooks, guides, and one-pagers, and who is excited to go deep on technical product narratives—translating complex capabilities into clear, compelling, conversion-oriented content. You will join the Airwallex Marketing team during a critical period of growth. As we scale, we are building a team that balances global consistency in content strategy, quality, and process, with local flexibility and speed in execution. This is a unique opportunity to help shape how growth content drives the next phase of Airwallex’s expansion. This role is based in San Francisco. Responsibilities: Build Growth Content Marketing as a global discipline at Airwallex, establishing best practices, scalable processes, and a high-performing team over time. Own the end-to-end demand gen content strategy, spanning SEO, gated assets, mid-funnel conversion content, and product-led narratives. Write, edit, and ship high-impact content including: SEO pillar pages, cluster articles, and comparison content Ebooks, whitepapers, and long-form guides One-pagers, solution briefs, and product explainers Partner deeply with Product Marketing and Product to translate launches, features, APIs, and workflows into content that is searchable, understandable, and sellable. Work closely with SEO and Performance Marketing to align content with keyword intent, funnel stages, and conversion goals. Hold a high bar for content quality and technical accuracy, ensuring clarity without oversimplifying complex concepts. Build a structured experimentation mindset—scaling what performs, refreshing or retiring what doesn’t. Balance short-term growth outcomes with longer-term investments in evergreen content, topical authority, and durable demand. Who you are We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory. A proven track record of creating content that drives measurable business outcomes across the funnel—from traffic to MQLs to pipeline.
