Title: Program Manager
Description: Why Aisle? AISLE is building the AI that finds, fixes, and verifies software vulnerabilities autonomously - an end-to-end system that closes the gap between when a vulnerability appears and when it's safely patched. Vulnerabilities are the #1 root cause of cyber incidents, yet most organizations take weeks or months to remediate what attackers now exploit in days. We're ending that backlog. Our systems already find and fix vulnerabilities in the world's most heavily audited codebases - 375+ independently validated CVEs across projects like OpenSSL, curl, Linux, and Chromium - at machine speed and superhuman scale. AISLE runs entirely inside our customers' perimeter (cloud, on-prem, or fully air-gapped) and can run on our optimized models or theirs, so even the most sensitive organizations, including those operating critical infrastructure, stay in full control of their code and their models. Backed by world-class founders, advisors, and angel investors, we're defining a new category: sovereign, AI-native security. Our goal isn't to improve vulnerability management - it's to end the backlog and move toward a future where software defends itself. We’re a small, talent-dense team spread across Europe, the US and Canada. We value high ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration . If you want to work with world-class minds in AI and security, thrive in fast-moving environments, and care about solving one of the toughest challenges in tech, Aisle is the place for you. What we're looking for 3+ years of experience in project coordination, operations, or technical program support (experience in cybersecurity or software is a must) Strong organization and multitasking skills, able to track multiple workstreams at once Excellent communication skills, comfortable working with engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders Familiarity with basic security concepts or experience in a security-related environment Comfortable in a fast-paced, high-growth startup where priorities shift and playbooks are still being built What you’ll do Coordinate engineering and product project timelines, ensuring priorities are clear and progress is tracked Facilitate cross-team communication across engineering, product, GTM, and operations Support vendor assessments and legal coordination (e.g., third-party reviews, contracts) Identify opportunities for workflow automation and help implement process improvements Maintain clear documentation of processes, governance, and delivery frameworks Be the point of structure and organization within fast-moving projects, helping engineering stay focused on delivery

Title: Director, Compliance & AI Governance
Description: About AKASA At AKASA, our mission is to build the future of healthcare with AI. As the leading provider of generative AI solutions for the healthcare revenue cycle, we help health systems comprehensively capture and communicate the full patient clinical journey. By empowering health systems to streamline their operations, they can focus on what matters most - delivering quality patient care. We have raised over $205M in funding from investors such as Andreessen Horowitz, BOND, and Costanoa Ventures. This is the most exciting time to join AKASA. Revenue bookings for our new AI-native product suite have grown over 20x since launching in 2024. In this time, we have broken our record for the largest deal in company history three times consecutively. This growth is driven by the massive improvement we are generating for our customers across clinical quality and documentation accuracy, both top priority areas for health system leaders. Our deployments have been recognized nationally as "one of the most comprehensive real-world uses of GenAI in healthcare finance to date" ( link ). Our customer base represents more than $120B+ in net patient revenue and includes the most innovative health systems in the country, like Cleveland Clinic, Duke, Stanford, and Johns Hopkins. Some of our recent recognitions include being named one of America's Top Startup Employers 2026 by Forbes, #1 most promising healthcare RCM startup of 2025 by Black Book Market Research, and one of the fastest-growing GenAI startups to watch by AIM Research. Our CEO was ranked among the “Top 50 Healthcare Technology CEOs” by the Healthcare Technology Report, and we have been certified as a “Great Place to Work” for the past 6 years in a row. We’re building on this momentum to redefine what’s possible in healthcare. We’re looking for exceptional people to help us accelerate that reality. About the Role We’re looking for a strategic, automation-minded Director of Compliance & AI Governance to own and evolve AKASA’s compliance program as we scale. This role is ideal for someone who has led compliance in a healthcare SaaS or AI environment and wants to build a modern, engineering-forward program rather than a paperwork factory. You’ll own our HITRUST, SOC 2, and HIPAA programs end to end, operationalize emerging AI governance frameworks like the NIST AI RMF, and drive the policy lifecycle across the company. The ideal candidate treats compliance as a product: automated evidence collection, continuous control monitoring, and policies people actually read and follow. You’ll join a small, high-leverage team with immediate ownership and room to build. You thrive in a fast-paced startup environment and are agile with an ownership mindset. This is an on-site position that requires 3+ days a week in our South San Francisco HQ. What You’ll Do Own AKASA’s compliance certification portfolio end to end (including HITRUST CSF, SOC 2 Type II, and HIPAA) from control design and implementation through evidence collection, audit coordination, and remediation. Evaluate and pursue new certifications and attestations (such as ISO 27001, ISO 42001, and HITRUST AI) as customer and market needs evolve. Define compliance roadmaps and ensure org-wide adoption, driving cross-functional alignment and accountability on regulatory requirements. Build our AI governance program grounded in the NIST AI RMF, partnering with Engineering, Product, and Legal to establish model risk assessments, AI use policies, and documentation that meets enterprise health system expectations. Drive compliance automation as a first principle: implement and optimize GRC and continuous control monitoring tooling, automate evidence collection across our stack (Okta, Google Workspace, Kandji/Iru, SentinelOne, Nightfall, AWS), and use AI tools to streamline policy drafting, control mapping, and audit preparation. Own the full policy lifecycle, including authoring, review cadences, exception handling, attestation campaigns, and version control; ensuring policies are clear, practical, and mapped to the frameworks we certify against. Be the compliance face of AKASA for customers and prospects: lead security and compliance questionnaire responses, support enterprise sales cycles, manage customer audits, and maintain trust artifacts including BAAs, our trust center, and shared assessments. Find ways to automate these processes using AI first tooling. Oversee vendor and third-party risk management, the annual risk assessment, security awareness and HIPAA training programs, and incident response documentation and tabletop exercises in partnership with Security and IT. Partner with Legal and Security leadership on all security-related contractual obligations. Skills & Qualifications 8+ years experience in security compliance, GRC, or risk management, including 2+ years leading a team or function. Healthcare SaaS, health tech, or AI startup experience strongly preferred. Deep, hands-on expertise across HITRUST CSF (r2 preferred), SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA Security and Privacy Rules, and emerging AI governance frameworks like NIST AI RMF. You’ve run certification and audit cycles from start to finish and know how to translate AI governance standards into real controls for a company building on PHI. An automation-first instinct: hands-on experience with GRC and continuous control monitoring platforms (Vanta, Drata, Hyperproof, or similar), evidence collection automation, and a track record of using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude) to push the boundaries of what a lean compliance function can do. End-to-end policy ownership: drafting, cross-framework mapping, and running review/exception/attestation cycles. Comfort in front of customers: enterprise security questionnaires, sales-cycle support, BAA/security terms negotiation alongside Legal, and managing customer audits. We’d love to see one or more of: Direct experience achieving or maintaining ISO 27001, ISO 42001, or HITRUST AI certifications. Familiarity with the technical side of a modern security stack (Okta, MDM platforms like Kandji/Iru, SentinelOne, Nightfall, AWS) and the ability to partner credibly with Security and IT on control implementation. Experience with privacy regulations beyond HIPAA, such as CCPA/CPRA, state health data laws, or GDPR. Implementing Compliance Automation Tools and Trust Centers like Drata or Vanta. Scripting or low-code automation skills (Python, Zapier, Tray.io ) for building compliance workflows. Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISA, CIPP/US, HCISPP, or HITRUST CCSFP. What We Offer Flexible paid time off (PTO) Expansive coverage for health, dental, and vision Employer contribution to Health Savings Accounts (HSA) Generous parental leave policy Full employee coverage for life insurance Home office stipend Cell phone/internet reimbursement Commuting benefits Company-paid holidays 401(K) plan Compensation Based on market data and other factors, the salary range for this position is $150,000 - $185,000 + Equity. However, a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description. The above represents the expected salary range for this job requisition. Ultimately, in determining your pay, we'll consider your location, experience, and other job-related factors. We’re committed to doing the best work of our lives, together. Come see if we're the right team for you. AKASA is a proud equal opportunity employer and we believe that a diverse and inclusive workforce is an imperative. We welcome people of different backgrounds, genders, races, ethnicities, abilities, sexual orientations, and perspectives, just to name a few. We do not discriminate based upon any protected class and we encourage candidates of all identities and backgrounds to apply. AKASA considers qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. AKASA is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at recruiting@akasa.com.

Title: Content Lead
Description: TL;DR Own Anon's organic content engine as a sub-function of growth. Plan, produce, publish, and repurpose content across SEO and social, interview subject-matter experts and customers, and make sure sales has the proof assets they need. You may use external creators for volume — your job is the strategy, the editorial bar, and the through-line. Why this role exists We want consistent, on-strategy content across our owned channels — and we want it owned in-house, not contracted out. In our experience, contracting out the strategy of content is what makes it generic. Contracting out the production of content is fine and expected. This role sits inside the growth function and will likely report into the Growth Lead. What you'll do Set the editorial and creative strategy across SEO content, social (LinkedIn, X, Instagram, etc.), paid ad creative, and sales enablement. Generate content with AI as the default production engine. Written long-form and short-form, plus image and video ad creatives — using text, image, and video generation tools to produce variations at a volume manual production can't match. Run the content pipeline end-to-end: topic/angle selection → keyword/intent → brief → generate → edit → publish → distribute → repurpose → measure. Produce ad creative at scale. Spin up dozens of image and video variants per concept so the Growth Lead always has fresh creative to test across paid and social. Treat creative as an experiment input, not a one-off deliverable. Interview internal SMEs and customers to extract real insight — generic, AI-flavored content is the failure mode we're hiring against. Your edge is feeding models the right raw material and taste, not prompting from nothing. Build reusable content systems. Prompt libraries, brand/voice guidelines, and templates so quality holds as volume scales — and so our internal tools can lean on them. Pull in contractors for the work AI can't do well yet, while keeping voice, brand, and quality consistent. Track what moves pipeline. Rankings, impressions, clicks, engagement, creative-level performance, and leads influenced — surfaced in our internal dashboard, not just generic analytics tools. Profile we're optimizing for AI-native content producer. You generate written, image, and video content with AI tools every day — and you have a real point of view on how to keep AI output from looking and sounding like AI output. Hands-on with modern generation tooling: LLMs for copy, image models, and AI video tools for ad creative and short-form. You don't need to be an expert in all of them, but you should be fluent and fast-learning. Strong writing and editing. Direct, clear, persuasive. No corporate gloss. You can tell good output from bad and fix it. A creative eye for visuals — you can direct, select, and refine image and video creative even if you're not a trained designer. 2+ years owning content for a B2B services or agency business (or an equivalent body of work you can show). Understands SEO fundamentals (intent, on-page, internal linking, topical authority, AI-overview formatting). Comfortable with design and editing tools (Canva / Figma / CapCut or similar) to finish what AI starts. Success looks like (first 90 days) A daily content publishing cadence. A measurable lift in inbound (search + social). A library of proof-driven sales assets sales actively uses. A clear point of view from you on which content bets are working and which to kill. Hard requirements Portfolio of published work we can read. Strong opinions on what good B2B content looks like in 2026 (we'll ask). Can self-direct — you'll get strategic input, not daily art direction. Nice to have On-camera comfort for short clips. Past experience writing for founders, operators, or specialty SMB. Familiarity with Google Search Console, analytics tools, and AI-visibility tracking tools. Logistics Remote-friendly. Likely reports to the Growth Lead once that role is filled.

Title: Brand & Content Associate (Contract to Hire)
Description: About Arcade Arcade is a fast-growing company based in San Francisco, helping teams create AI-generated product videos in minutes. Our platform turns product demos, screenshots, and documentation into compelling launch videos automatically, helping software companies announce releases, educate customers, and tell better product stories. We're a small, ambitious team building at the frontier of AI and creative tools. If you love new technology, great storytelling, and shipping quickly, you'll fit right in. About the Role We're hiring a Brand & Content Associate to own how Arcade sounds and looks in the wild, starting with the voice of our founder. We're looking for someone who lives on LinkedIn and X, spots trends before everyone else, writes copy people actually stop to read, and knows how to turn company momentum into compelling storytelling. One minute you're ghostwriting a post that reframes how people think about product storytelling; the next you're creating a punchy video in Arcade itself, or turning a product release into everything social media. You'll work directly with our CEO, product, design, and engineering to tell the story of what we're building, and set the creative bar for everything we ship. If you're chronically online, have genuinely great taste, and know the difference between content that gets impressions and content that builds a generational brand, we'd love to meet you. What You'll Do ✨ Own strategy and execution across Arcade's LinkedIn and X accounts Build and maintain an editorial calendar around product launches, milestones, customer stories, and the AI moments worth jumping on Ghostwrite and co-create founder-led content for our CEO, building her voice and audience, and shaping the category we're creating Capture moments throughout the week and turn them into authentic founder and company content Produce creative yourself, short videos, product moments, and social-native assets, using Arcade and lightweight tools, without waiting on a producer Grow Arcade's social channels by 2x+ followers over the next year while deepening real engagement and reach Protect and level up the brand voice, keeping a consistent, high-quality identity across every channel Track what's resonating and use the data to sharpen the next thing you make Who You Are You have taste. You know the difference between good and great, and you're not satisfied until it's great. You're LinkedIn and X native: you genuinely understand how each platform works and what makes something spread. You're early to trends and tuned into internet and AI culture, and you can turn a cultural moment into a brand moment fast. You can write exceptionally well. We'd trust you to write founder content without heavy editing. You have strong design instincts and can make polished graphics, carousels, and lightweight motion and video content yourself. You're early in your career but punch well above it: a maker who'd rather ship three great things this week than plan one for next month. You're genuinely excited by AI and creative tools, comfortable with ambiguity, and eager to build something with a founder from the ground up. You care deeply about quality, but you also know that consistency beats perfection. Skills and Qualifications 2+ years creating content and/or social for a technology, creative-tools, or consumer brand — or a portfolio strong enough to make the years irrelevant A portfolio you can share (posts, videos, campaigns, brand moments) Exceptional writing: you can nail a founder's voice, a product launch, and a native social post, each in their own register Lightweight video and creative production: assembling clips, adding text and motion, and formatting natively per platform with tools like Screen Studio Fluency in social analytics: you can read a platform dashboard and turn it into a content decision Excited to use AI tools as part of your daily workflow Nice to Have You've worked with founders or executives on personal brand strategy You know your way around Figma, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, CapCut, or similar Experience producing short-form video Experience creating for a product used by creators and marketers (e.g., Canva, Figma, Runway) You have opinions on the best SaaS accounts on X Why Arcade Might Be a Great Fit for You Own founder-led content and brand at one of the fastest-moving AI startups Work directly with the CEO to build her voice and shape how Arcade shows up in the market Be the creative force behind a brand in a category we're helping define Be part of a small, highly collaborative team where your work ships immediately and is seen widely Enjoy a meeting-light culture, rich health and 401(k) benefits, unlimited PTO, remote stipend, and biannual retreats Contract-to-Hire We're initially looking for someone to join us as a contractor (approximately 20–40 hours/week) with the goal of converting to a full-time role if it's a great mutual fit. Compensation Competitive hourly or monthly contract rate based on experience, with the opportunity to convert to a full-time role including salary and meaningful equity. Our values ❤️ Be a coach: We want the best for our customers and ourselves. We coach people to help them achieve their best potential. An "Arcader" is both a teammate and a customer. There is a reason that the same word describes both. Carry the weight: We are owners. Let's empower each other. When we see something that needs change, we lead through it. An open book: We are open as a team and as a product. We don't put walls up unless it's necessary. We become better when we share information. We are open to diversity of opinion, backgrounds, and thought. Play as a team: We play because we're a creator tool. Life is short. Let's build something meaningful. We play as a team because great teams build great things together. We keep those standards high. Be kind: We can be honest and kind. We can have high standards and be kind. We can say no and be kind. Kindness can vary across cultures, upbringings, and languages—but we try our best to be kind. Contact: caroline@arcade.software

Title: Payroll Program Manager
Description: About Arketa Arketa is building the operating system for modern fitness and wellness. Our mission is to make wellness more accessible by empowering studios and wellness entrepreneurs to grow beyond in-person classes. We provide a powerful, all-in-one platform to manage and scale hybrid wellness businesses, whether online, in-person, or both. With Arketa, studios can manage schedules, accept bookings and payments, build on-demand video libraries, host retreats, run automated marketing, and launch fully branded apps and websites. We make it simple for founders to deliver a seamless, professional experience across every customer touchpoint. We've raised $15M in Series A funding and are growing quickly. It's a unique moment to join us. We're building a category-defining company in a fast-moving space, and we're looking for a leader who is excited to help shape what world-class partner support looks like in the wellness category. About the Role We're looking for an Embedded Payroll Program Manager to own the strategy, process design, and success metrics behind Arketa's new embedded payroll offering — and to be a direct point of support for our partners. Day-to-day onboarding and support execution belongs to the Implementation Account Manager and Payroll Specialist, but you'll stay personally connected to partners, especially on the more complex or highest-touch relationships, while designing the playbooks the rest of the team executes against, owning the relationship with our payroll infrastructure partner and managing the two roles below. What You'll Do: Program Strategy & Process Design Design the onboarding playbook, support triage process, and escalation paths, in partnership with the Implementation Account Manager and Payroll Specialist Define the handoff criteria between onboarding and ongoing support, and refine it as volume and the team grow Build the documentation and Help Center foundations the rest of the team executes against Own the roadmap and priorities for the payroll offering's customer-facing operations Metrics & Reporting Define and track key metrics: time-to-launch, onboarding capacity, support resolution time, support volume per customer, CSAT, and documentation coverage Own the reporting cadence to leadership on how the payroll offering is performing operationally Partner Support Serve as a senior point of contact for Arketa's payroll partners, especially on complex, escalated, or strategic relationships Step in directly on partner issues that need program-level context or cross-functional pull Build direct partner relationships that inform how onboarding and support processes should evolve Team & Stakeholder Management Manage and coach the Implementation Account Manager and Payroll Specialist, and unblock escalations they can't resolve on their own Manage the relationship with our payroll provider, and coordinate with engineering, compliance, and customer success to keep implementations and support on track Translate recurring customer pain points into feedback for Product and Engineering What success looks like: New customers launch on time with minimal friction, and support questions get resolved quickly and accurately Clear documentation exists for both onboarding and support workflows Partners feel a direct, senior point of contact is available for their more complex or high-stakes needs The Implementation Account Manager and Payroll Specialist have what they need to execute independently day to day, with you focused on strategy, metrics, partner relationships, and escalations A well-reasoned, evolving plan for how the onboarding/support handoff should work as volume grows What we're looking for: 3-5+ years in program/project management, implementation, or customer-facing operations leadership, ideally at a fintech, HR tech, or payroll company Experience designing processes and playbooks for a customer-facing function, ideally from scratch People management experience, or strong readiness to manage a small team, preferred Strong communication skills — you'll be explaining payroll mechanics to non-experts and translating customer pain points to internal teams Ability to operate with ambiguity; this role and its scope will evolve Experience with payroll, benefits, or embedded financial products is a strong plus What We Offer: Ownership and Opportunity for Advancement Competitive Salary and Stock Options Unlimited PTO: our policy is designed to give you the flexibility to rest, recharge, and take care of personal needs — while staying aligned with your team and responsibilities. Medical, dental and vision health insurance Fitness Class Reimbursement: we’re committed to supporting both employee wellness and our industry relationships. As an Arketa employee we see movement as opportunity. Parental Leave Policy For this role, the estimated hourly rate is $48.08 to $67.31, depending on experience and qualifications. This position is non-exempt and eligible for overtime pay. In addition to base pay, we offer equity. We believe in compensating fairly and transparently, and we're happy to share more detail during the interview process.

Title: Principal Program Manager
Description: Assured is on a mission to modernize insurance. Claims processing (i.e. should we pay this claim?), while often overlooked, is the foundation of the entire industry. It’s currently highly manual, involving phone calls, faxes, and gut instinct, costing tens of billions of dollars a year. We can do better. At Assured, we provide large insurers with the software solutions they need to win in a modern, technology-driven world. From self-service claim-filing software to backend fraud detection, we’re the engine that powers claims processing for some of the largest insurers in the world. The challenges we face are deep and diverse, from creating digital experiences that provide comfort and clarity to claimants at their most stressed and vulnerable to orchestrating large-scale ML-driven decision-making on billions of dollars of claims payments, life at Assured is dynamic, collaborative, and rewarding. We’re looking for an experienced Principal Program Manager to join our Client Engagement team. In this role, you’ll help turn complex client priorities into clear, executable programs across Client Engagement, Product, Engineering, and client stakeholders. You’ll own the operating rhythm for high-stakes client initiatives, from kickoff and scoping through launch, adoption, and long-term success. This is a role for someone who can bring structure to ambiguity, keep cross-functional work moving, and build trust with both internal teams and enterprise customers. P&C insurance industry experience is a strong plus, but not required. What matters most is the ability to learn the domain quickly and build credibility with enterprise clients. Some of the Work You’ll Own: 🔗 Turn client needs into clear execution plans. Sit between Product, Engineering, and client stakeholders to translate client priorities into scoped initiatives, owners, timelines, risks, and next steps. 🚀 Drive high-stakes carrier initiatives from kickoff to launch. Title: Senior Content Marketer
Description: About Us: Founded in 2021, Axion is at the forefront of transforming product quality and customer satisfaction in manufacturing. Our cutting-edge AI-powered platform empowers manufacturers to swiftly identify, thoroughly investigate, and effectively resolve quality issues while simultaneously elevating customer experiences and outcomes. As trailblazers in end-to-end quality intelligence, we're setting new industry standards. Our innovative approach enables industrial, aerospace, consumer, and medtech manufacturers to harness the power of quality and post-market data, driving down costs and boosting business performance. Our vision extends beyond mere problem-solving; we're committed to reshaping the future of manufacturing. By seamlessly integrating advanced AI technology with deep industry expertise, Axion is paving the way for smarter, safer, and more efficient production processes across diverse sectors. Backed by leading investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Amplo, Boeing, and RTX Ventures, Axion is poised to lead the quality revolution in manufacturing. About the Role: Axion is looking for a Senior Content Marketer who can make the unglamorous, high-stakes work of manufacturing quality feel as important as it actually is. Somewhere right now, a quality engineer at one of the world's most consequential manufacturers is staring at a failure they can't explain. A recall that shouldn't have happened. A pattern buried in ten thousand tickets that no one has connected yet. That's the world we work in — and it's full of stories nobody's telling well. We're looking for a storyteller who can sit across from an engineer, executive, customer, or subject-matter expert, ask the right questions, and turn those conversations into compelling content that makes people who live and breathe quality and engineering think, "finally, someone gets it." This isn't a role focused on simply producing content. You'll have the opportunity to help define Axion's narrative, build our content strategy from the ground up, and tell the stories that shape how an industry thinks about an emerging category. Key Responsibilities: Turn conversations with customers, executives, engineers, and internal subject-matter experts into compelling LinkedIn posts, case studies, ebooks, campaigns, and other content Translate complex manufacturing, quality, engineering, and technical concepts into clear and engaging stories Own both short- and long-form writing while maintaining a distinctive and authentic Axion voice Use AI tools thoughtfully to brainstorm, accelerate, and scale content creation while maintaining strong editorial judgment and high-quality human-written work Develop content with the full marketing funnel in mind, helping move audiences from initial awareness through consideration and engagement Help define and build Axion's content narrative, voice, and approach from the ground up Interview customers and subject-matter experts to uncover compelling stories, insights, and perspectives Partner with the broader Marketing team and company leadership to identify opportunities for high-impact content Requirements: 6–8+ years of experience in content marketing, editorial, copywriting, or a closely related writing role Exceptional writing and storytelling skills across both short- and long-form content Strong interviewing skills with the ability to uncover compelling stories and insights from customers and subject-matter experts Ability to understand and translate complex technical topics for different audiences Strong understanding of marketing fundamentals, including audience, positioning, messaging, and the marketing funnel Experience using AI writing and productivity tools thoughtfully to support content creation and scale Ability to operate independently and build structure in an ambiguous, fast-moving startup environment Experience writing about technical, industrial, engineering, manufacturing, or complex B2B topics is a plus Portfolio or writing samples demonstrating range, quality, and storytelling ability Who You Are: You're a storyteller and builder who genuinely enjoys the craft of writing. You're naturally curious and investigative — the person who asks "why does that happen?" when everyone else has moved on. You're comfortable digging into complex technical topics and learning enough to tell the story accurately and compellingly. You know how to interview someone, listen for the interesting part hiding inside a long answer, and ask the follow-up question that gets you to the real story. You understand that great content isn't just about good writing — it has a purpose. You think about audience, positioning, and where a piece fits within the broader customer journey. You're comfortable with ambiguity and energized by the opportunity to build. There won't always be a brief, process, or precedent waiting for you. You'll have the trust and ownership to help create those things as Axion grows. You also use AI thoughtfully. You understand where it can make you faster and more effective, but you don't rely on it to replace your own judgment, curiosity, or voice. Location: Remote, with preference for candidates near our Brooklyn, NY or California teams Team: Marketing, reporting to the Global VP of Marketing Type: Full-time How We Operate We work with focus and intention, holding ourselves to a high bar while respecting the need for balance. Axion isn’t a traditional 9 to 5 job, but it’s also not a place that glorifies overwork. We take pride in the work, support each other through hard problems, and make space to recharge. We’re a highly collaborative team that stays connected throughout the day, often over Slack. We share feedback freely, communicate clearly, and make decisions quickly so we can keep momentum without unnecessary meetings. If you value openness, iteration, and shared problem-solving, you’ll fit right in. We: Collaborate deeply. Feedback is part of how we build; everyone has a voice, and ideas win on merit. Leave ego at the door. Titles don’t define value—contribution does. Bias toward action. We favor progress over perfection and learn as we go. Communicate with clarity. Direct, transparent, and always in service of the mission. Act like owners. Everyone is accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. Aim for excellence sustainably. We challenge ourselves, support each other, and stay in it for the long game. If you’re excited to help shape a company redefining how manufacturing operates—and you thrive in a culture built on ownership, clarity, and trust—you’ll feel at home here. What we Offer Work with cutting-edge AI technology making a tangible impact in manufacturing Collaborative, mission-driven team and supportive leadership Generous time off Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits Lunch stipend…. And much more Ready to drive the future of manufacturing with AI? Apply today to join our team and help us build the category-defining platform for quality intelligence. Title: Senior Technical Support and Documentation Manager
Description: About Us Axle Health builds AI scheduling and workforce management software to empower in-home healthcare providers to deliver exceptional, personalized care right where patients feel most comfortable—at home. Some of the biggest providers in the country use our software (like Cityblock Health and U Penn Health System) to improve the utilization of their field teams by 17%+, and automate the operational burden of scheduling and dispatching. Our platform includes proprietary logistics algorithms to optimize scheduling, a mobile app for field staff, an operations dashboard for office teams, engagement and booking tools for patients, and a wide range of integrations and external APIs for modular access. We’re a team of top-tier engineers and operators, backed by $14m from top investors such as Y Combinator, Pear VC, and F-Prime, applying our intellect and logistics experience to upend how home healthcare is delivered. About You - The Role Axle Health is hiring a Senior Technical Support and Documentation Manager to build and own post-launch technical support as a defined function for the first time. We're building AI-powered scheduling and workforce management software for home health organizations, and getting customers live is only the beginning - keeping them running, resolving issues fast, and making sure the same problems don't resurface is just as critical to the business. This role reports to the Head of Professional Services and owns the full support loop: first response, triage, resolution, and a knowledge base that compounds with every closed ticket. The person who thrives here has no interest in inheriting a playbook. You'll be the one writing it. You'll debug issues directly, own customer-facing communication, and document resolutions so the next occurrence doesn't require a call. This is a hands-on individual contributor role - the expectation is that you're doing the work, not coordinating others to do it for you. If you're energized by building systems from scratch and owning what you create, this is the right kind of challenge. You've been in this position before in a B2B SaaS environment: you've owned post-launch support or technical enablement end to end, built the processes yourself, and measured whether they worked. You can diagnose a customer issue, drive it to resolution, and write it up clearly enough that a customer admin can handle the next one independently. You know the difference between problems that need better documentation and problems that shouldn't exist at all - and you know how to communicate that distinction to engineering in a way that drives action. What You’ll Do Triage: Own first response and severity classification for every incoming issue, using strong technical literacy to route or resolve quickly and keep response times within SLA. Resolution and Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve customer issues directly, or escalate with full root-cause context to the right internal owner when a fix requires engineering intervention. Documentation and Knowledge Base: Own the customer-facing and internal knowledge base end to end - troubleshooting run books, admin documentation, implementation guides, and FAQs built from real resolutions, not assumptions. Self-Service Enablement: Track which issues generate the most volume and write against that list first, with success measured by a falling ticket rate per account over time, not just faster triage. SLA Definition and Ownership: Define resolution-time SLAs by severity level and customer tier, make them visible across the team, and hold the standard you set. Proactive Monitoring: Build and maintain monitoring that surfaces issues before customers report them, shifting the function from reactive to proactive wherever possible. Product and Engineering Feedback Loop: Separate recurring issues into two buckets - what needs better documentation and what shouldn't require documentation at all - and bring the second category to Product and Engineering with supporting data: frequency, accounts affected, and support hours consumed. Tiered Support Design: Design and operationalize a tiered support program - defining Standard, Premium, and Enterprise service levels with differentiated SLAs, response priorities, and support entitlements. Partner with Professional Services and Sales to build the business case for how tiers are priced and resourced. Requirements Must Haves 5-7+ years in technical customer support, customer success, or QA for a B2B SaaS product - with demonstrated ownership of building support processes and documentation from scratch, not inheriting and maintaining someone else's Experience supporting or performing QA on complex SaaS platforms with heavy business logic in regulated environments Technical depth to diagnose customer issues independently - comfortable navigating logs, reproducing issues in a sandbox, and driving root-cause analysis without relying on engineering for the initial diagnostic work Strong written communication - you can write a troubleshooting run book or admin guide that a customer can follow and resolve independently, without a call Experience building and owning a knowledge base or documentation system end to end - not contributing to one someone else structured Data-driven approach to prioritization - tracks issue volume by type, uses that signal to decide what to document first and what to surface to engineering as a product problem rather than a documentation gap Prior experience at an early or growth stage startup - comfortable building structure where none exists and making judgment calls without a defined playbook behind you Nice to Haves Healthcare, home health, or field operations vertical experience - you understand the operational context your customers are managing Experience setting and managing support SLAs in a prior role - you've defined the standard, not just worked within one someone else set Familiarity with monitoring or observability tooling - able to configure alerts and surface issues proactively, not just respond when customers report them SQL or similar ability to pull and aggregate data independently - useful for building the reporting that backs your feedback to engineering Experience using AI tools to accelerate documentation or troubleshooting workflows What We Offer In addition to offering a competitive salary and equity, we want to ensure every team member has the tools they need to work to the best of their ability. To that end… We are committed to your Ownership: We cultivate an environment where team members feel ownership over the work they do. Everyone in an organization has big ideas and we want to hear them and implement them. All of our employees have equity compensation. We want you to benefit from all the hard work you do in helping patients and catalyzing this shift in healthcare. We are committed to your Wellness: Medical, Dental, Vision 401k plan Flexible PTO and sick days Commuter benefits Santa Monica HQ with 180 degree beach views and daily catered lunches We are committed to your Growth: Fast paced work environment geared towards professional growth Get the chance to move roles within the organization to learn new skills and continue to make an impact We are committed to building Community: Monthly team events, dinners, & happy hours Special team outings - some past events have included: yacht cruises, visits to Universal Studios, Magic Castle, and Vegas

Title: Product Manager - Customer Education
Description: About Basis Basis builds real agents that do real work in the real economy. Our agents operate for hours at a time, performing end-to-end work for some of the largest accounting firms in the world. We recently raised $100M at >$1B valuation and are racing to deploy the most advanced applied ML at production scale. Our investors include: Khosla Ventures (Keith Rabois & Vinod Khosla), Accel (Miles Clements), Google Ventures, Nat Friedman & Daniel Gross, Adam D'Angelo, Jeff Dean, Jack Altman, Noam Brown, Kyle Vogt, Amjad Masad, Clem Delangue and many other operators/technical leaders. "Basis is on the frontier of building production-grade, long-horizon agents. They've pushed the limits of what we thought our models could do on real-world, economically valuable, complex accounting tasks. They've been a great collaborator in helping us shape what the future of agents looks like." — Prashant Mital, Applied AI Lead, OpenAI About the role The way accountants work is changing. AI agents are now doing real work – preparing returns, reviewing workpapers, flagging exceptions – and accountants need to learn how to work alongside them. At Basis, we believe you can't just hand someone a powerful tool and walk away. You have to guide them into the future. That's what Basis Academy is for. It's how firms learn to work confidently with Basis agents across Tax, Audit, and Advisory. As Customer Education Product Manager, you will build the Academy into a world-class learning product – one that shortens time-to-value, drives adoption, and earns the kind of credentials that accounting professionals are proud to put on their resume. What you'll do - Own the Academy as a product: strategy, roadmap, content operations, and outcomes - Build best-in-class digital learning experiences: role-based paths tailored to Preparers, Reviewers, and Managers across CAS, Tax, Audit, and Advisory - Design the "Basis Certified" credential ladder: define what it means to be an expert in AI Accounting and build a certification that matters - Build for scale: translate our high-touch, white-glove training into scalable, on-demand courses and interactive simulations - Drive CPE accreditation: work toward making Basis courses eligible for Continuing Professional Education credits, a major differentiator for firm partners - Build the content operations machine: produce high-quality learning content efficiently and keep it current with every product release - Hire and lead a lean, high-output team (instructional designers, content producers, live session facilitators) - Instrument the program end-to-end: connect learning data to product adoption, retention, and business outcomes What you'll bring - 4+ years building or scaling a customer education or technical enablement program at a modern SaaS or AI company - Experience running content operations: you can produce high-quality content efficiently and keep it current in a fast-moving product environment - Proven ability to evolve a program from live-training-only to a hybrid model of self-paced digital learning and live workshops Bonus if you have - Background in accounting, finance, or a similar regulated industry - Experience with AI products, specifically teaching users how to work with AI agents - Familiarity with CPE/CE accreditation programs (NASBA or similar) - Experience with LMS platforms (WorkRamp, Thought Industries, etc.) and/or badging platforms (Credly, Open Badges) What we look for - First principles reasoner: builds frameworks from scratch rather than copying what's been done before - High agency: takes ownership of outcomes and moves fast without waiting for perfect information - Builder mentality: treats the Academy as a product; cares about user journey, platform UX, and whether content actually creates behavior change - Office lover: prefers shouting across a room over a Slack message, seeking full-time in-office in NYC Benefits at Basis We offer a competitive and thoughtful benefits package designed to support your physical, mental, and financial well-being: Health & Wellness: Premium Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage; Life Insurance; and 6 coaching & 6 therapy sessions through Spring Health. Basis will cover 100% of your Wellhub Gold membership. Wellhub gives you access to gyms like Lifetime, SoulCycle, NYSC and so many more - as well as access to wellness apps like Strava & Headspace! Time off: Unlimited PTO + 12 paid company holidays. In-Office Perks: Daily meal stipends, a fully stocked kitchen, and $300 toward your custom desk setup. Financial Benefits: Pre-tax commuter benefits and 401(k) retirement plan Team Culture: Monthly office activities and frequent optional team happy hours. Parental Leave

Title: Technical Program Manager - Implementation

You will be responsible for taking high-level business objectives and breaking them down into technical milestones, ensuring that our EPD (Engineering, Product, Design) teams are aligned with our Operations and Implementation goals. You’ll be the person who ensures that as our product grows more complex, our ability to deliver it to customers remains seamless. You will create the roadmaps, define the milestones, and track progress across multiple teams to ensure on-time delivery. Bridge Operations & EPD: Act as the primary point of contact for Operations teams. You will translate customer implementation needs into technical requirements and manage the rollout of new features to stakeholders. Master Cross-Functional Integration: You will map and manage the complex interdependencies between our core infrastructure and customer-facing workflows. By identifying technical and operational bottlenecks early, you ensure that platform updates and large-scale implementations move forward without friction or surprises. Risk Mitigation: Anticipate bottlenecks and technical risks before they become "fires." You’ll facilitate trade-off organic discussions between speed of delivery and technical debt. Visibility & Communication: Provide clear, concise updates to leadership on program health, resource allocation, and core KPIs. Who You Are Experienced Program Leader: You have 5+ years of experience in Technical Program Management or a similar role. Technically Fluent: You don't need to be an engineer, but you are comfortable in technical environments. You understand how APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure work together and can follow technical discussions with ease. Expert Communicator: You excel at taking a complex technical update and distilling it into a clear status report for non-technical stakeholders. Operational Mindset: You have a bias toward action. You enjoy building the "system for the work" so that everyone else can do their jobs effectively. Collaborative & Resilient: You are a natural relationship builder who can influence teams without having direct authority over them. You stay calm under pressure and help teams navigate shifting priorities. Qualifications Proven track record of managing cross-functional projects from inception to launch. Proficiency with project management tools (Jira, Linear, Asana etc.) and documentation software (Confluence, Notion). Experience in a fast-paced SaaS environment is a major plus. Strong analytical skills; you use data to drive decisions and measure project success. Pay Transparency The estimated starting annual salary range for this position is $165,000 to $210,000 USD; commensurate with experience. The listed range is a guideline from Pave data, and the actual base salary may be modified based on factors including job-related skills, experience/qualifications, interview performance, market data, etc. Total compensation for this position may also include equity, sales incentives (for sales roles), and employee benefits. Given Candid Health’s funding and size, we heavily value the potential upside from equity in our compensation package. Further note that Candid Health has minimal hierarchy and titles, but has broad ranges of experience represented within roles. Please note: we are looking for employees to join our in-person culture at one of our offices (Denver, New York, or San Francisco). Our weekly schedule is 4 days in-office and 1 day working remotely.

Title: Staff Software Engineer - Agentic Workflows
Description: About us: Causaly is redefining how humans acquire knowledge and develop insights in biomedicine. Our AI-powered platform enables researchers and decision-makers to discover and interpret evidence from millions of scientific publications, clinical trials, regulatory documents, and other complex data sources in minutes. We are building the world’s most advanced biomedical knowledge platform, powered by a high-precision Knowledge Graph and GenAI capabilities. Our technology is already used by leading biopharmaceutical organizations to accelerate drug discovery, improve safety, and drive better decision-making. Backed by top-tier investors including ICONIQ, Index Ventures, Pentech, and Marathon, we are scaling rapidly and expanding our product suite and market presence. At a Glance ◆ What you'll build. The platform that runs our long-running orchestrated workflows in production. A single run can last hours, fan out across dozens of subagents, and has to produce evidence a scientist can audit. ◆ What you'll work in. Full-stack engineering, weighted towards backend and platform. TypeScript and Node.js, Restate for durable execution, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud and Azure. ◆ What we need from you. Significant backend depth in TypeScript, experience designing and operating distributed systems, and LLM-backed systems you have run in production. What You'll Do ◆ Workflow orchestration. Design and evolve the workflow definition model: control flow, fan-out, conditional execution and data passing between steps, plus the static validation that rejects an invalid workflow before it runs. ◆ Durable execution. Build the engine that runs workflows, including checkpointing and resumption after failure, retry and abandonment policies, and idempotency guarantees. ◆ Monitoring, tracing and cost attribution. Instrument runs that cross several services and two languages, so that latency and token spend can be attributed to individual steps. These figures feed pricing decisions. ◆ LLM integration. Structured outputs, guardrails and retries, citation integrity across steps, and deciding where deterministic code should replace a model call. ◆ Architecture and technical leadership. Write the design proposal, break a large change into shippable increments, implement the hardest parts and own the result in production. What We're Looking For ◆ Significant backend engineering experience in TypeScript and Node.js. ◆ Experience building LLM-backed systems that run in production, with informed views on how they fail. ◆ Experience designing and operating distributed systems. ◆ Practical experience of correctness under partial failure: idempotency, at-least-once delivery, safe retries, and backwards compatibility between services that deploy independently. ◆ Solid understanding of relational databases, including schema design and safe migration. ◆ Clear technical writing — you can produce a design document that a reviewer can act on. ◆ A product mindset. You are motivated by the outcome for the user, not only by the system. ◆ You measure before you optimise, and you revert a change that does not hold up. Preferred Qualifications ◆ Durable execution or workflow engines (Restate, Temporal, Inngest), or a comparable system you have built yourself. ◆ Python and LLM application frameworks (FastAPI, LangChain, LangGraph). Our GenAI service is written in Python and you will work in it. ◆ Observability and LLM instrumentation (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse). ◆ Multi-tenant SaaS where tenant isolation is a design constraint. ◆ Infrastructure as code (Terraform, Kubernetes). ◆ Search and retrieval at scale (Elasticsearch, vector search, knowledge graphs). ◆ Functional programming, either in TypeScript (fp-ts) or in a functional language. Not Required for This Role ◆ Machine learning research. This is a systems role built around models rather than a modelling role. No model training, fine-tuning or publication record is expected. ◆ Frontend specialism. You will work in React, but the role is weighted towards backend and platform and we are not looking for a frontend specialist. Technology Stack The list below is indicative and not exhaustive of the technologies we use at Causaly. We do not expect experience with all of it, but you should be comfortable learning the parts you have not used. Languages: TypeScript, Node.js, Python Backend: Apollo GraphQL, Zod, fp-ts, FastAPI Frontend: React Workflow & messaging: Restate, Redis Streams, Cloud Tasks Data: PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, Redis, MongoDB GenAI: LangGraph, OpenAI Observability: OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, Datadog Cloud & infrastructure: Google Cloud, Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform, ArgoCD, Docker Tooling: Git, GitHub Actions Benefits 💰 Competitive compensation package 🩺 Private medical & dental insurance 📔 Life insurance (4 x salary) 🤓 Personal development budget 🧘 Individual wellbeing budget 🌴 25 days holiday plus bank holidays 🥳 Your birthday off! 🚀 Potential to have real impact and accelerated career growth as a member of an international team that's building a transformative AI product. We are on a mission to accelerate scientific breakthroughs for ALL humankind, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and fairly consider qualified candidates without regard to race, ethnic or national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, neurodiversity, genetics, age, religion or belief, marital/civil partnership status, domestic / family status, veteran status or any other difference.

Title: Founding Senior Software Engineer, Developer Experience & AI Platform team
Description: ClassDojo's goal is to give every child on Earth an education they love. We started by building a powerful network for communication. ClassDojo’s flagship app is the #1 communication app connecting K-12 teachers, children, and families globally. Teachers use it to share what’s happening throughout the day through photos, videos, and messages that make parents feel like they’re there. It’s actively used in over 95% of US schools, reaching over 45 million children in 180 countries, with a team of just around 200 people [1]. We are now beginning to use this network to give kids the best learning experiences in the world, far beyond those a standard school can provide. We hire for talent density. Our team comprises the most talented, entrepreneurial, and innovative teammates from around the world, with experience in education and large scale consumer internet companies, including Instagram, Netflix, Dropbox, Stripe, Uber, Y Combinator, and more. We’re building a company where the most talented people want to work. We believe you’ll do the best work of your life here—and you’ll pioneer the future of education, too. About the Role: Every feature ClassDojo ships begins with an engineer. Every minute an engineer spends waiting on builds, troubleshooting local environments, repeating manual workflows, or navigating unnecessary complexity is a minute they aren't building magical experiences for children, teachers, and families. Developer Experience Engineering exists to remove that friction. As a Senior Software Engineer, Developer Experience, you'll build the tools, workflows, and AI-powered developer experiences that make every engineer at ClassDojo more effective. This is a unique opportunity to join a newly formed Developer Experience Engineering team and help define what great developer experience looks like at ClassDojo. Rather than inheriting a mature platform, you'll help shape its foundations—partnering closely with engineers across the company to identify opportunities, build high-leverage solutions, and establish trusted paved paths that make shipping software faster, safer, and more enjoyable. We're looking for someone who combines exceptional software engineering with product thinking. You'll treat engineers as customers, build products they'll genuinely enjoy using, and focus relentlessly on creating leverage across the engineering organization. What You’ll Do: Build products for engineers: Design and build internal platforms, tooling, and developer workflows that improve the experience of developing, testing, reviewing, deploying, and operating software. Multiply engineering productivity : Identify opportunities where thoughtful platform investments create outsized impact across the engineering organization. Continuously reduce developer friction while improving engineering velocity, quality, and reliability. Help shape AI-native software development: Build practical AI-powered workflows that help engineers write, review, test, and ship software more effectively. Evaluate emerging technologies thoughtfully and help establish patterns that improve outcomes while maintaining security, reliability, and engineering quality. Partner deeply across engineering : Work closely with product engineering, infrastructure, security, and technical leaders to understand pain points, prioritize opportunities, and build platform capabilities that solve real problems. Create trusted paved paths : Build reusable tools, automation, documentation, and self-service capabilities that become the preferred way engineers work because they're intuitive, reliable, and genuinely useful. Measure impact : Use engineering metrics, developer feedback, and adoption data to continuously improve the developer experience. Focus on meaningful outcomes rather than activity metrics. Help build Developer Experience Engineering : As an early member of the team, contribute to technical direction, engineering standards, and the long-term evolution of Developer Experience Engineering at ClassDojo. You’ll Be A Match If You: Have extensive experience (7-10+ years) building production software in modern engineering organizations. Enjoy solving organization-wide engineering problems rather than only product-specific challenges. Think like a product engineer even when building internal platforms. Demonstrate strong technical judgment and know when to build, simplify, automate, or adopt existing solutions. Thrive in ambiguity and are excited by the opportunity to help build a new Platform Engineering team. Build trust through partnership and influence rather than organizational authority. Care deeply about engineering craftsmanship, maintainability, and long-term platform health. Approach AI as a practical tool for improving engineering effectiveness rather than an end in itself. Measure success through the impact your work has on other engineers. Nice to Have Experiences: Developer Experience or Platform Engineering teams. Internal developer platforms or engineering productivity initiatives. CI/CD, release engineering, developer environments, or software delivery systems. AI-assisted software development or developer tooling. Engineering productivity measurement frameworks such as DORA or SPACE. High-growth engineering organizations where platform investments had organization-wide impact. Developer Experience Engineering is a force multiplier for the entire organization. Every improvement you make has the potential to help engineers build better software, move faster with greater confidence, and spend more of their time focused on creating meaningful experiences for children, teachers, and families. If you're energized by solving hard technical problems, building products for engineers, and creating systems that make everyone around you more effective, we'd love to meet you.
