Title: Founding Developer Experience Lead
Description: We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science. We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world. World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached. Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you. About the role *Open to hiring remote across North America + Europe — we also have offices in NYC, San Francisco, and Seattle We are hiring for our first Developer Experience lead. This role is for someone who lives at the intersection of code and creativity – deeply technical, genuinely plugged into the generative AI space, and excited to build the developer community around putting frontier media models to use. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role with real influence over how developers experience Runway. You will own the end-to-end developer experience – driving awareness, activation, and long-term engagement among the creative technologists and engineers building on the Runway Dev platform. Success in this role requires a blend of technical depth, creative sensibility, and a genuine enthusiasm for where generative AI is going. What you’ll do Produce Content That Gets Developers Building Produce high-quality tutorials, demos, sample repos, and technical walkthroughs that showcase what's possible with media models Own social and X content strategy for the developer audience – rapid demos, creative experiments, prompting tips, and technical threads Run regular developer communications including email newsletters, changelogs, and recurring developer office hours Prototype creative, targeted content that meets developers where they are Build & Energize the Creative Developer Community Lead hackathons, sponsorships, and developer events end-to-end – from concept and logistics to execution and follow-through Build and nurture a community of creative technologists, researchers, and developers pushing the boundaries of generative video and image Represent Runway at conferences, meetups, and online communities; be a recognizable and trusted presence in the generative AI developer ecosystem Surface developer sentiment, emerging use cases, and market signals back to internal teams to inform product direction Optimize the Developer Funnel. Optimize the full developer funnel from awareness to activation; drive adoption and engagement across our Runway Dev user base with a structured, data-informed engagement strategy Partner with product & design to create onboarding experiences that get developers from zero to their first successful API build in minutes Identify high-potential developers through usage and spend signals and route them into the right engagement tracks Track, analyze, and report on developer funnel metrics and API engagement using BI tools and data Champion Developers Internally Serve as the primary point of contact for the developer community; be genuinely accessible, responsive, and useful Build a tight, structured feedback loop between developers and the Product and Engineering teams – surface trends, flag blockers, and advocate for developer needs Partner with Marketing and GTM to create developer-focused activation campaigns that resonate with a technical, creative audience Define and track success metrics tied to developer activation, API engagement, and community growth What you’ll need 5+ years in developer experience, developer advocacy, or a highly technical, community-facing role; ideally within AI/ML, creative tech, or a research-adjacent organization Deep, hands-on familiarity with generative video and image models; you've built with them, you experiment constantly, and you follow this space closely Comfort operating in a startup environment. You've built programs, communities, or developer motions from scratch and know how to create structure and momentum without a playbook to follow. Strong engineering fundamentals: you can build demos independently, debug API integrations, and speak credibly with technical audiences A genuine creative sensibility – you understand the needs of designers, filmmakers, and creative technologists, not just traditional software engineers, and you move fluidly between those worlds Proven track record of driving developer community growth and API adoption with measurable outcomes Experience producing developer-facing content across formats: documentation, video demos, short-form social, and live technical presentations Deep enthusiasm for generative AI; you stay close to the technology, build with it, and have a strong point of view on where it's going Runway strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity for our team. Our salary ranges are based on competitive market rates for our size, stage and industry, and salary is just one part of the overall compensation package we provide. There are many factors that go into salary determinations, including relevant experience, skill level and qualifications assessed during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below is a general expectation for the function as posted, but we are also open to considering candidates who may be more or less experienced than outlined in the job description. In this case, we will communicate any updates in the expected salary range. Lastly, the provided range is the expected salary for candidates in the U.S. Outside of those regions, there may be a change in the range, which again, will be communicated to candidates. Working at Runway Great things come from great teams. We’d love to hear from you. We’re committed to creating a space where our employees can bring their full selves to work and have equal opportunity to succeed. So regardless of race, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, origin, ability, age, veteran status, if joining this mission speaks to you, we encourage you to apply. More about Runway Universal World Simulator GWM-1 Gen-4.5 General World Models Robotics SDK Conversational Real-time Agents Runway Studios We're excited to be recognized as a best place to work: Crain's | InHerSight | BuiltIn NYC | INC

Title: Content Creator - French-speaking markets
Description: Salonkee is one of Europe’s fastest-growing beauty-tech companies , helping thousands of salons simplify their daily operations and offer an outstanding experience to their clients. Our all-in-one software simplifies appointment scheduling, payments, and client management, allowing salons to focus on what truly matters: delivering an exceptional customer experience. We’re proud to shape the future of the beauty industry with innovation, collaboration, and a people-first mindset. The opportunity We’re looking for a Content Creator to own Salonkee’s short-form social media content across French-speaking markets (France, Luxembourg, Belgium & Switzerland). You’ll shape how our community sees Salonkee by turning B2B topics into memorable, engaging reels, stories and posts that salon owners actually stop for, watch to the end and share. From organic social content to paid campaigns and event activations, you’ll create videos that build engagement and generate leads. We’re not looking for cinematic production. We’re looking for someone who understands what makes short-form content work on Instagram, TikTok and LinkedIn - and can turn a strong idea into an engaging video with a phone and a clear point of view. You’ll also occasionally be part of the content yourself, whether speaking to camera, collaborating with colleagues or filming on location with salon owners. What you will be doing Own the social media content strategy and execution for French-speaking markets (France, Luxembourg, Belgium & Switzerland) - organic social, paid campaigns, and event activations Handle the editorial calendar end-to-end: ideate concept, write the hook and script, organize the shoot, shoot (mostly phone-first), edit, caption and publish. Transform complex B2B concepts and product features into memorable, unique & engaging posts/reels/stories that resonate with salon owners, and create video content that drives two outcomes: authentic engagement with our salon community AND lead generation for Salonkee. Appear in our content when the concept calls for it: introducing a feature, interviewing a salon owner, doing a talking-head explainer or an event recap, sometimes solo, often alongside colleagues or clients. You're comfortable speaking to the camera in French, and just as comfortable directing others who aren't used to it. Manage relationships with our influencer ambassadors in relation to social media content; coordinate content collaborations and ensure alignment with our overall content strategy What you need to have 2–3 years creating social content for a brand, an agency, a creator business or your own account. Fluency in French : you'll be speaking on camera and writing for a French-speaking audience, so it needs to sound natural, not just correct; and fluency in English: to collaborate with the team. Proven experience creating organic & paid short-form content, backed by a portfolio, your own account, or videos you've made for a brand. Comfortable with video editing tools such as CapCut, Edits or DaVinci Resolve, as well as AI tools to boost efficiency, quality and optimization of content. You don't need to be a post-production specialist; you need to cut a reel so it holds attention. Comfortable in front of the camera. You won't be in every video, but when a concept needs you to speak to the lens, host a conversation or appear alongside a salon owner, that should feel natural, not stressful. Exceptional ability to translate B2B/technical concepts into accessible, engaging video content. Deep understanding of social media trends and platform algorithms across Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn. Flexibility to travel occasionally (10%) for shoots and professional events Application process We would love to receive the following, and will only review applications that have fully submitted all required content: Your CV A 60-second elevator pitch video - tell us who you are! Your portfolio of link to your social media account - show us reels, TikToks or LinkedIn videos you created, ideally with the numbers behind them. What we offer A competitive remuneration package. Full ownership and autonomy over French-speaking markets' video content strategy - your decisions and creative vision directly impact our business growth. You have real control and the opportunity to make a tangible difference if you invest in it. A dynamic, international, and supportive work environment with a strong team culture. Flat hierarchies that promote open communication and encourage putting your ideas forward The opportunity to be part of a success story and make a tangible impact on the future of the beauty and wellness industry. Regular company events to foster team bonding and create opportunities for networking and collaboration At Salonkee, we believe that innovation thrives in an environment where everyone feels included and empowered. We’re building a diverse team that reflects the industry we serve: creative, passionate, and full of different perspectives. No matter who you are or where you come from, you’ll find a place here to grow, contribute, and be your authentic self.

Title: Creative Lead, Content
Description: About Sandbar Sandbar is an interface company in New York City. We aim to augment individuals so we can each think, act, and move more freely. Our team has built SW, ML, and HW products across Meta, CTRL-labs, Google, Apple, Fitbit, Peloton, and Equinox. Our first product, Stream, is a self extension—a private voice ring and conversational interface. Stream has been featured in WSJ, Bloomberg, & Wired, and begins shipping in Summer '26. Join us in creating technology that extends human thinking. About the Role We're looking for an ambitious creator to tell the story of a new kind of computer—one focused on self extension, expanding human expression, and life in the real world. You'll own social, working directly with our founders & Head of Marketing to develop content which communicates Stream, our brand, and the future we're building towards. We're looking for someone who has built audiences, thinks like a founder, and ships like a creator. There are no playbooks—this role is for someone eager to create things unseen. Responsibilities Own content strategy and creation across Instagram, YouTube, X, and other platforms. Create short-form video, static posts, and motion graphics—concept to publish. Produce content in partnership with external partners Shoot and edit content with an iPhone-native, high-craft aesthetic. Support brand design as needed including emails, brand collateral. Qualifications You've built an audience before—for a brand, a product you started, or yourself. You have a portfolio (or feed) that shows taste across video, static, and motion with content you’ve built. You're full-stack: shoot, edit, design, animate. You don't need a team to ship. You think like an owner—identifying opportunities, making bets, moving fast. FTE Benefits Health, vision, and dental benefits Company-sponsored 401(k) Unlimited PTO and sick time Early stage equity

Title: Software Engineering Manager, Content Agent
Description: At Sanity.io , we’re building the future of AI-powered Content Operations. Our AI Content Operating System gives teams the freedom to model, create, and automate content the way their business works, accelerating digital development and supercharging content operations efficiency. Companies like SKIMS , Figma , Riot Games , Anthropic , COMPLEX , Nordstrom , and Morningbrew are using Sanity to power and automate their content operations. Sanity Content Agent is where AI meets structured content - an intelligent assistant that deeply understands each customer's content model, follows references like an experienced team member, and combines web research with internal content knowledge in a single conversation. Sanity is uniquely positioned for this moment: we already have a scaled Content Lake holding our customers' structured content, which becomes rich context that generic AI tools simply can't match. Your team will push the boundaries of what's possible when AI truly understands content: auditing thousands of documents in seconds, surfacing inconsistencies before customers do, and generating perfectly structured documents that respect complex validation rules. With a strong and growing team of 4 engineers and room to scale as the product grows, you'll shape the AI capabilities that turn hours of content work into minutes. You'll balance the technical challenges of LLM integration and agentic workflows with the product sensibility to make AI that content teams actually trust. Learn more about the team’s products here , here and here . This role requires a good grasp of web fundamentals and toolchains and an understanding of how the modern web works. We also seek someone with strong organizational and planning skills. Leading an engineering team at Sanity is about working with the product manager and designer of the team, to own the strategy, roadmap, and execution. This is achieved by working with great people and creating an environment where your team can shine. As a senior engineering management leader, you’ll be responsible for growing a strong and engaged team to meet these challenges. What you would do: Helping a team of talented engineers to organize and prioritize their work for the highest impact. Balance technical excellence with shipping velocity in a fast-moving environment. Experience working at a product/SaaS company. Champion developer experience while building for non-technical content creators. Influencing the direction of both Sanity and of modern web development and content operations. Work closely with the Head of Engineering, along with leadership in product management and design, to facilitate teamwork and establish processes that can scale as we do. Supporting the growth and development of your team and team members. About you: Based in London, UK, or Oslo, Norway, and able to work at least 2-3 days per week in the office. 1+ years of engineering management experience & 4+ years of engineering experience, ideally in developer tools or content platforms Strong technical background in TypeScript/JavaScript and modern web technologies Ability to navigate ambiguity and drive clarity in product direction Working knowledge of prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, and techniques for improving model reliability Understanding of embedding models, vector search, and how to ground AI outputs in structured data Ability to distinguish AI capabilities that genuinely solve user problems from those that just demo well Track record of shipping user-facing products at scale Experience leading teams building complex, extensible applications An ability to understand software architecture design considerations Not sure you’re exactly what we’re looking for in this role? Apply anyway! What we can offer: A highly-skilled, inspiring, and supportive team Positive, flexible, and trust-based work environment that encourages long-term professional and personal growth A global, multi-culturally diverse group of colleagues and customers Comprehensive health plans and perks A healthy work-life balance that accommodates individual and family needs Competitive salary and stock options program Who we are: Sanity.io is a modern, flexible content operating system that replaces rigid legacy content management systems. One of our big differentiators is treating content as data so that it can be stored in a single source of truth, but seamlessly adapted and personalized for any channel without extra effort. Forward-thinking companies choose Sanity because they can create tailored content authoring experiences, customized workflows, and content models that reflect their business. Sanity recently raised an $85m Series C led by GP Bullhound and is also backed by leading investors like ICONIQ Growth, Threshold Ventures, Heavybit and Shopify, as well as founders of companies like Vercel, WPEngine, Twitter, Mux, Netlify and Heroku. This funding round has put Sanity in a strong position for accelerated growth in the coming years. You can only build a great company with a great culture. Sanity is a 200+ person company with highly committed and ambitious people. We are pioneers , we exist for our customers , we are hel ved , and we love type two fun ! Read more about our values here! Sanity.io pledges to be an organization that reflects the globally diverse audience that our product serves. We believe that in addition to hiring the best talent, a diversity of perspectives, ideas, and cultures leads to the creation of better products and services. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

Title: Senior Developer Experience Engineer
Description: About Savvy Wealth: Wealth management is a $545 billion industry that still runs on manual work. 75% of advisors offer no digital communication beyond email, and most still build financial plans by hand in Excel. Savvy is reinventing what it looks like to be a financial advisor. Founder Ritik Malhotra saw the fragmentation firsthand after seeking out his own advisor, and started Savvy to give independent advisors a modern, AI-native home. Savvy is a registered investment advisor (RIA), and we partner with experienced financial advisors who want to grow without running the back office themselves. Advisors bring their book and join Savvy, running under their own brand (or ours), and Savvy earns a percentage of the assets they manage. In return, they get a true business-in-a-box: a proprietary tech platform and client portal, an in-house marketing team that helps them grow, a world-class investment management team, and a dedicated client services team that runs day-to-day operations and support. Advisors at Savvy service up to 50% more households and save 19 hours a week. AI runs through everything we do. On the product side, Savvy Intelligence (released April 2026) is the only AI built for wealth managers that can see a client's complete financial picture. Internally, everyone at Savvy uses Claude and is encouraged to experiment with it, backed by a dedicated AI enablement team and a RevOps org building agents in-house. The trajectory is steep and it's still early. We're a Series C company with 170+ people, $200M raised, and $100M ARR in sight this year. Inc. ranked us the No. 1 fastest-growing financial services company in America in 2026. Come build the next stage with us! Recognition: We're a Certified Great Place to Work and have been honored for our culture and our growth: Newsweek's America's Greatest Startup Workplaces (2026) Fortune Best Workplaces in New York™ (2026) Great Place to Work Certified™ THE ROLE Savvy is hiring our first dedicated developer experience engineer. Coding agents are already part of how our engineers work, but adoption has moved faster than our ability to make their output consistently good. Wrong code and weak architectural decisions still create review burden. We are hiring someone to treat that as an engineering problem, not solve it with a longer prompt. You will own how developers across EPD interact with coding agents and with the systems around them. That includes the codebase itself, our internal skills and instructions, cloud coding workflows, agentic code review, CI, local development, testing, debugging, and delivery. You will have substantial autonomy to make cross-cutting decisions, change defaults, and set standards across the organization. This is a hands-on platform engineering role. Most of your time will be spent building software and improving the environment in which developers and agents work. You will also talk directly with engineers, study where time and quality are being lost, test your ideas against real work, and help teams adopt better ways of operating. You will join our infrastructure and harness team and partner closely with infrastructure, security, data, and product engineers. WHAT YOU'LL DO Own developer and agent experience: Set the roadmap for how our engineers and coding agents navigate the codebase, use internal tools, run tests, review changes, and ship software. Build the cloud coding experience: Build the developer-facing layer around our existing compute foundations, including task intake, environment setup, context, tools, permissions, observability, review, and delivery. Improve agent output at the source: Change repository structure, interfaces, documentation, instructions, and feedback loops so agents produce correct code and sound architecture more consistently. Engineer context deliberately: Design what agents receive up front, discover progressively, persist, compact, hand off, or discard. Choose models and reasoning effort based on evidence from the job, not habit. Own our internal skills system: Raise the quality of our shared skills and instructions through clear contribution standards, evaluation, discoverability, progressive disclosure, maintenance, and pruning. Fix everyday developer friction: Improve CI speed and reliability, local setup, testing, debugging, deploy workflows, and the other bottlenecks that cost engineers time. Measure what works: Combine developer research and satisfaction data with DORA or SPACE measures and task-level agent evaluations. Inspect traces, establish baselines, and test whether changes improve correctness, reviewability, cost, latency, and human intervention. Drive adoption: Work directly with engineers, teach effective practices, and turn successful experiments into defaults. When the root problem is the codebase or engineering process, make that case and help fix it. Partner on safe autonomy: Work with our infrastructure and security engineers on sandboxing, credentials, approvals, auditability, and the controls needed to give cloud agents useful access without giving them unlimited access. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Exceptional with coding agents: You use Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar tools for substantial work and can show how you decompose tasks, manage context, choose models, inspect failures, and consistently produce maintainable software. Faster output alone is not the bar. Internal tools with real users: You have built developer tooling or a platform that engineers beyond your immediate team relied on. You learned from their behavior and support burden, not only from what they said they wanted. CI or large-codebase experience: You have made a meaningful improvement to CI, testing, repository workflows, or developer productivity in a substantial, long-lived codebase. Product judgment for internal systems: You can interview developers, separate symptoms from root causes, turn evidence into a roadmap, and say no to attractive work that will not improve the system. Strong software engineering: You have built and operated substantial production software. We are open on language and framework, but you must be able to move from diagnosis to a durable implementation yourself. Evaluation over intuition: You know that agent behavior is nondeterministic and changing quickly. You compare prompts, context, tools, models, and workflows against representative tasks rather than declaring success from a demo. Cross-team influence: You can set standards and change defaults across teams without becoming a gatekeeper. You explain the evidence, earn trust, and remain accountable for the experience you create. Pragmatic range: You are comfortable moving between platform code, repository conventions, evaluation data, developer interviews, documentation, and hands-on enablement. This is not a prompt-writing, DevRel, or framework-only role. NICE TO HAVE Experience building cloud or remote development environments, coding-agent control planes, or secure execution sandboxes. Experience building or operating an agentic code review system. Experience designing agent tools, skills, context systems, memory, orchestration, or model-routing infrastructure. Experience using DORA, SPACE, or similar frameworks without reducing developer productivity to a single metric. Experience in financial services or another security- and compliance-sensitive environment. Benefits: Competitive salary and equity package Unlimited PTO + paid company holidays Access to holistic medical, dental, and vision plans Company 401(k), Commuter, and HSA/FSA plans NYC office in the heart of Manhattan Lunch and snacks provided in the office Access to virtual mental health care (Spring Health) and health concierge (Rightway) to help you find the right care Access to counseling for stress management, dependent care, nutrition, fitness, legal, and financial issues (Guardian WorkLifeMatters EAP)

Title: Future Opportunities: Content Specialist
Description: We're looking for a talented, driven, and enthusiastic Technical Content Specialist to join our growing remote team to produce content for us, and the industry-leading organizations we partner with. You'll form a core part of the work we do at ScaleMath, working closely with our Operations Team and Head of Content. Note: We operate a rolling application process. We are not always hiring or looking to fill positions ASAP, so if you apply now, your application will be reviewed but may not be considered and invited for an interview immediately. About ScaleMath About ScaleMathScaleMath is a bootstrapped, profitable, 100% distributed team of creative marketers, makers, and operators backing the world's leading companies on customer acquisition & experience. We pride ourselves on being the very best at what we do and deliver experiences customers fall in love with over and over again. Since 2017, we've been in the business of software – creating category-leading companies on our advisory and services side. Working at ScaleMath is for you if you want to be a part of a driven team that's motivated and fulfilled by doing exceptional work for incredible companies every single day. We'd like to hear from you if: You want to pursue content planning and development as a long-term career . You have experience writing long-form content such as blog posts, guides, eBooks, etc. You’re comfortable as a manager of one. You’re a stickler for style, grammar, punctuation, and finding the words and phrases that best capture an idea or feeling. You are incredibly well-organized and motivated. You want to join a fast-growing organization to work as part of a team that works with industry-leading companies. You understand and have experience with on-page SEO. You understand distribution channels for content, including search engines, social media, and email. You're able to describe or create a content strategy for a given audience. You have a reliable internet connection/access. Know how to construct a narrative that connects the reader’s needs to the proposed solution (the client's product/service) and compels them to take action. Are comfortable with writing about technical topics in detail, including but not limited to Docker, Laravel, PHP, WordPress. You are comfortable receiving constructive criticism and advice aimed at helping you to grow and develop your content writing skills even further. You approach everything you do with a spirit of partnership and collaboration, not exclusion or rigidness. You're resourceful and a true problem solver, able to feel gaps in what you're working on, pitch solutions, and implement them. At ScaleMath, we do so much more than just create great content. We drive growth. This is a job where you can do the best work of your career. ScaleMath is committed to remaining a calm company where we don't regularly work longer than 40 hours per week, and take proper vacations. In your role, you'll need to: Create, edit, and manage content for a variety of mediums that could include: email, newsletters, blogs, white papers/guides, thought leadership articles, customer case studies, website pages, webinar slide decks, sales collateral, event collateral, and video scripts. Maintain the master content calendar that schedules all aspects of the creation and delivery of content throughout the year. Understand and apply SEO best practices, including formatting (H1 tags, etc.). Provide meta descriptions with each article draft. Create content tailored to a specific promotion or business goals. Provide feedback, suggestions, and strategy for improving client outcomes. Be a kick-ass teammate, communicator, and collaborator. Requirements Must be very fluent in written English. Problem-solving aptitude. Analytical mind with business acumen. Excellent communication skills. BSc in Design, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is a plus. Experience working as a part of a remote team where you weren't micro-managed. Ability to solve problems creatively and effectively. Benefits Flexible working hours (ideally 5-6 hours overlap with UK Time zone). 20 days paid holiday per year How To Apply Please send an application tailored to this position that speaks to us. Introduce yourself to us as a colleague. Within your cover letter, give us examples of some of your best-written work, how it was used, and to what effect. We would like to see a resume - but forget that generic resume, we want to see what really sets you apart. This position will be closed as soon as we find the perfect match. So, make sure to read the description carefully and take your time to submit a high-quality application that stands out. If you apply, we’ll respond promptly and keep you updated throughout the process. Send your application to us (cover letter, CV, and a video introducing yourself, and sharing why you feel you're a good fit for this position). You may not hear back from us immediately, as we review all applications very thoroughly. Please note that we’re unable to offer individual feedback during the screening process. We usually see hundreds of applications for roles, and our small hiring team simply doesn’t have the bandwidth to offer personalized feedback before the interview stage. Our interviews are conversations held with future colleagues – no tests, no surprises. Before that, we do require final candidates to complete an at-home written exercise. We look forward to hearing from you. – ScaleMath

Title: Director of Product, Content Intelligence & Growth
Location: San Francisco | Ottawa | Phoenix | Toronto | Los Angeles | Denver | Salt Lake City | Atlanta | Chicago | Houston | Portland | New York City | Vancouver | San Diego | Washington, D.C. | Sacramento | Jacksonville | Seattle | Mexico City | Austin | Miami | Boston | Dallas
Description: Scribd, Inc. is on a mission to advance human understanding. Our four products — Scribd®, Slideshare®, Everand™, and Fable — help billions of people across the globe move beyond access and into insight, application, and expertise. Culture at Scribd, Inc. We support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer. We believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. Occasional in-person attendance is required for all Scribd, Inc. employees, regardless of location. So what are we looking for in new team members? At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude. This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization. The team Content is the foundation of everything we build at Scribd, Inc. Our UGC corpus—more than 400 million user-uploaded documents, distinct from the rights-protected premium catalogs behind Everand and Fable—powers the consumer experience on Scribd and Slideshare and differentiates our search and discovery. The Content pillar is the team responsible for that asset. It spans three connected areas—trust & safety (protecting the corpus), understanding (knowing it), and supply (growing it)—each with dedicated product and engineering leadership, embedded analysts, and applied ML capability. We have high standards, give real feedback, and always bias toward action. Everyone owns their work end-to-end. There's high trust, low hand-holding, and a genuine expectation that you'll push the people around you toward sharper thinking and better outcomes. We celebrate wins, learn from our losses, and laugh through both. Join us! The role We're hiring a Director of Content Intelligence & Supply to own knowing our UGC corpus and growing it as an asset. This is a new role, and it comes at a moment when content has become central to our strategy: the UGC corpus powers our consumer products and feeds search and discovery. You'll bring content intelligence and content supply under one point of leadership—connecting what we know about the corpus (classification, metadata, quality, gaps) with the decisions about how we grow it. Today those efforts run in different parts of the org; your job is to run them as one portfolio with one roadmap. We build products that turn information into understanding, grounded in trusted human-created sources—and we own the data structure and intelligence that make a corpus this large useful. This role reports to the Chief Product Officer. You'll inherit an established team—a content understanding program with its own charter and dedicated engineering squad, and a UGC supply squad that owns the end-to-end contributor experience—with room to shape the org's direction, structure, and future growth. We're looking for a product leader with real data fluency: probably not a traditional consumer product manager, but someone with a foot in the data science world—as comfortable interrogating a classification model as running a product review—who gets excited about turning a 400-million-document UGC corpus into a strategic asset. Know the corpus Own the content understanding roadmap: classification, enrichment, metadata, and quality across the UGC corpus. Drive corpus gap analysis: where the corpus is deep, where it's thin, and how user-generated and partner content behave differently. Make the corpus legible—to our own products (search, discovery, recommendations) and to the teams and systems that build on it. Set direction for classification and corpus-analysis work with credibility, in close partnership with applied ML, engineering, and data science teams. Grow the supply Own UGC supply end to end: uploads, conversions, and the supply-side user experience. The people who add content to our platforms are your customer. Unify content acquisition strategy: set priorities across user-generated supply, partnerships, and other related programs that today run independently—coordinating the strategy while execution stays with the teams closest to it. Connect supply to demand: partner with the consumer product orgs so the corpus grows where it creates the most value for readers, learners, and subscribers. Build the knowledge infrastructure for AI Own the AI product foundation of our UGC corpus: segmentation, sampling, corpus description, and the metadata and retrieval capabilities. The scope is the UGC corpus only: content in our premium catalogs is not part of it. Partner with business development on evolving corpus intelligence needs. Lead and develop the team Lead senior product leaders and an established program with its own charter, engineering squads, and embedded analysts. Step into a team with strong people already in seat: earn trust quickly, raise the bar, and multiply the leaders around you. Operate as a peer among directors and VPs: represent content strategy in executive conversations with clarity and confidence, and connect corpus decisions to business outcomes. The essentials 10+ years of product management experience, including 4+ years leading product teams or senior PMs. Depth in data-heavy product domains: ML/AI-powered products, search, recommendations, content platforms, or marketplaces. Genuine data fluency—you can credibly direct classification and corpus-analysis work and partner with applied ML and data science teams as an equal, even if you don't build the models yourself. Familiarity with common data structures around the use of content for AI training. Experience with supply-side or two-sided product dynamics: creators, contributors, sellers, or content acquisition. A strategic operator who connects content decisions to business outcomes—licensing revenue, product quality, growth—and can hold a portfolio-level roadmap. Strong communication and cross-functional leadership: comfortable operating with executives and setting priorities across teams you don't manage. Experience with content licensing or B2B data products is a plus. The application Resume. Optional: anything that shows how you think about content, data, or supply—writing, a talk, or a product/strategy artifact you're proud of. Title: Manufacturing Training Program Manager
Description: Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders , soldiers in battlefield scenarios , and beyond . About the Role: Skydio is seeking a Manufacturing Training Program Manager to build and scale our manufacturing talent development programs. This role combines operational excellence with workforce strategy, ensuring employees receive exceptional onboarding and technical training while developing long-term partnerships that create sustainable manufacturing talent pipelines. You will own the manufacturing training ecosystem—from learning management systems and training effectiveness to workforce partnerships, public funding opportunities, and hiring programs. Working cross-functionally with Manufacturing, Production, Engineering, Recruiting, HR, Quality, and external partners, you will build the systems and relationships that enable Skydio's continued manufacturing growth. How You’ll Make an Impact: Manufacturing Training & Workforce Development Own the strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of manufacturing training programs across production operations. Schedule, coordinate, and administer instructor-led, on-the-job, and digital training for manufacturing employees. Design and continuously improve onboarding programs that accelerate employee readiness and productivity. Develop cross-training strategies that increase workforce versatility and manufacturing flexibility. Evaluate training effectiveness through KPIs including certification rates, time-to-proficiency, quality performance, safety metrics, and production readiness. Partner with Manufacturing Engineering, Production, EHS, and Quality to develop standardized work instructions, training curricula, and certification programs for compliance, new products, and manufacturing processes. Learning Management & Program Management Act as the primary Manufacturing System Owner for the LMS, overseeing the integrity of qualification tracking, employee certifications, training documentation, and reporting to ensure constant audit readiness. Develop scalable training infrastructure, processes, and reporting dashboards to support a growing manufacturing workforce. Ensure training documentation meets quality, regulatory, and operational requirements. Manage training schedules, instructor coordination, employee certifications, and training records. Workforce Partnerships & Talent Pipeline Lead partnerships with public agencies, workforce development organizations, educational institutions, and community partners to strengthen Skydio's manufacturing talent pipeline. Serve as the primary liaison with colleges, universities, workforce boards, apprenticeship programs, and strategic manufacturing partners. Develop and implement workforce development programs that reduce dependence on staffing agencies through sustainable talent pipelines. Coordinate candidate referrals, workforce program participation, onboarding logistics, internships, apprenticeships, and hiring initiatives. Organize and support hiring events, manufacturing tours, career fairs, and workforce engagement activities in partnership with Recruiting, Production, and external organizations. Public Funding & Strategic Initiatives Identify and pursue workforce development grants, manufacturing incentives, tax credits, and public funding opportunities that support manufacturing workforce growth. Manage administrative requirements associated with public funding, including reporting, documentation, compliance, and performance metrics. Monitor workforce development initiatives and manufacturing programs to identify strategic partnership opportunities. Build scalable systems for managing workforce partnerships, community engagement, and external stakeholder relationships. What Makes You a Good Fit: Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Business, Operations, Manufacturing, Education, Industrial Engineering, Human Resources, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in manufacturing training, workforce development, operations program management, or a related field. Experience administering Learning Management Systems (LMS) or enterprise training platforms. Strong program management experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives. Experience developing training programs, onboarding systems, and competency-based learning. Demonstrated success building partnerships with educational institutions, workforce organizations, government agencies, or community partners. Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple programs simultaneously. Excellent communication and relationship-building skills across technical, operational, and external stakeholders. Experience using data and metrics to evaluate program effectiveness and drive continuous improvement. Obtaining FAA Part 107 certification within the first 60 days of employment is strongly encouraged for all Skydio employees and required for certain positions. Preferred Qualifications Experience in high-tech manufacturing, aerospace, robotics, electronics, automotive, or medical device manufacturing. Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, continuous improvement, or operational excellence methodologies. Experience managing workforce grants, apprenticeship programs, or publicly funded workforce initiatives. Familiarity with California workforce development programs and manufacturing initiatives. Experience with Workday Learning, Cornerstone, Docebo, or other enterprise LMS platforms. PMP, Lean Six Sigma, CPTD, APTD, CIT, or ATD certifications are a plus. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to enroll in the Company’s group health insurance plans. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to receive the following benefits: Paid vacation time, sick leave, holiday pay and 401K savings plan. Title: Lead Technical Writer
Description: About Slash Slash is building the future of business banking, one industry at a time. We believe businesses deserve financial infrastructure tailored to how they actually operate. That's why we're creating a new category of business banking. We combine the reliability of traditional banking (high yields, competitive rewards, and comprehensive security) with industry-specific features that make businesses more efficient, more competitive, and more profitable. Started in 2021, Slash is one of the fastest growing fintechs in the world and we power over ten billion dollars a year in business purchasing across numerous industries. We recently raised a $100M Series C led by Ribbit Capital with participation from Khosla Ventures, Goodwater Capital, NEA, and Y Combinator, accelerating our expansion into new markets and products. Slash is headquartered in San Francisco, and has a strong in-person culture. About the role Slash is, at its core, a technology company, and we have one of the best engineering teams in the world building infrastructure that moves over $10b a year. The problem is, almost nobody knows it yet. We're looking for a Technical Writer to change that. You'll be the voice of Slash engineering: turning the hard, interesting things our team ships into writing that engineers actually want to read, and working closely with our engineers and founders to turn their ideas into published writing. This role blends real technical understanding with sharp writing instincts. You'll go deep on what we're building, find the stories worth telling, and ship them fast, cleanly, and with ownership. What you'll do Own our engineering blog end to end, from sitting with an engineer to understand what they shipped, to publishing a post that does it justice Turn our engineers' and founders' ideas into polished blog posts, technical deep dives, launch write-ups, and social content (LinkedIn/X), written in their voice, not a generic corporate one Make it effortless for our team to get their ideas out. When an engineer has something they want to write about but no time to sit down and do it, you turn it into something even better than they'd have written themselves Help our team post strategically across socials, amplifying the work worth highlighting rather than posting for the sake of volume Embed with the eng team, follow what's being built, and proactively hunt down the stories worth telling rather than waiting to be handed them Work directly with engineering, product, and design to make sure what we publish is technically correct and genuinely compelling We're looking for someone who Genuinely understands technical work, enough to write about systems, tradeoffs, and architecture without hand-waving or getting it wrong. A background in engineering, CS, or serious technical writing is a requirement Writes clearly and with a point of view, and can translate an engineer's rough ideas into sharp, publishable writing without losing their voice Knows how to write for engineers, not at them, no fluff, just clear writing that respects the reader's intelligence Thrives working independently in a small team that ships fast, you go find the stories rather than waiting for a content calendar Bonus: has written technical content that engineers actually shared, whether a blog, docs, a newsletter, or their own posts What's in it for you Opportunity for high growth High autonomy + ownership culture Comprehensive health + benefits plan Working out of our downtown San Francisco office space Unlimited PTO

Title: Events Program Manager
Description: At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done. We are seeking an experienced, strategic, and highly organized Events Program Manager to join our Global Travel & Expense team. This role is responsible for leading the sourcing and operational execution of small- and medium-sized corporate meetings and events while helping build and scale Snowflake’s global Meetings & Events program. This position focuses on internal events, executive meetings, customer-facing business events, offsites, and group travel, partnering closely with Finance, Strategic Sourcing, Procurement, Legal, Workplace, Security, and business stakeholders. The ideal candidate combines operational excellence with strategic thinking and is passionate about building scalable programs, optimizing supplier partnerships, implementing technology, leveraging AI, and delivering exceptional attendee experiences. As an Events Program Manager, you will: Lead sourcing and end-to-end operational execution for small- and medium-sized meetings, offsites, executive meetings, trainings, customer engagements, and internal business events. Manage venue sourcing, contract negotiations, room blocks, group air, and ground transportation. Partner with business stakeholders to understand event objectives and recommend scalable, cost-effective event solutions. Help build and operationalize Snowflake’s global Meetings & Events strategy, including governance, intake processes, planning standards, service models, and operational best practices. Develop and manage preferred supplier relationships. Lead sourcing events and RFPs while negotiating favorable commercial terms and driving measurable cost savings. Partner closely with the Global Travel team to coordinate attendee air travel and deliver a seamless end-to-end experience. Support the implementation, optimization, and ongoing administration of meetings and event technology, including sourcing platforms, venue booking tools, registration systems, reporting solutions, payment capabilities, and future AI-enabled workflows. Build dashboards, reporting, and KPIs that provide visibility into event spend, supplier performance, savings, attendee experience, policy compliance, and program health. Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve automation, and enhance the user experience through technology and AI. Develop playbooks, documentation, and standardized processes that enable scalable event planning across the organization. Ensure compliance with company policies, risk management requirements, and financial controls throughout the event lifecycle. Stay informed on industry trends, supplier innovations, emerging technologies, and best practices to continuously improve the Meetings & Events program. Support additional strategic Travel & Expense initiatives and cross-functional projects as the program evolves. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality, Business, Event Management, Supply Chain, or a related field. 5+ years of experience managing corporate meetings and events, strategic sourcing, travel management, hospitality, procurement, or a related field. Demonstrated experience negotiating venue, hotel, and supplier contracts. Experience managing group travel and complex meeting logistics. Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and relationship-building skills. Strong analytical skills with experience developing reports, dashboards, and program metrics. Experience implementing or administering meetings, travel, or event technology platforms (Cvent, Groupize, HRS, Navan, etc.) is preferred. Experience leveraging automation, AI, or workflow technology to improve business processes is a plus. Professional certifications such as CMP, CMM, or related credentials are a plus. Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake. How do you want to make your impact? For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

Title: Talent Management Program Manager
Description: At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done. Job Summary Snowflake is seeking an organized and detail-oriented Talent Management Program Manager to focus on the day-to-day execution and operational support of our global talent programs. This role is essential to the smooth running of our Performance Excellence cycle, ensuring that every phase of the process is coordinated effectively and on schedule. In this role, you will be the primary "executor" for our established talent milestones. You will handle the logistics for performance review cycles, the administrative coordination of talent and succession reviews, and the delivery of our employee listening surveys. Additionally, you will serve as the primary system administrator and program owner for our voice AI 360 platform, managing its scaling and cross-functional operational workflows. This is a perfect role for someone who loves continuous improvement, process, excels at task management, and enjoys building for scale and ensuring that large-scale, global programs run without a hitch. Responsibilities Drive Performance Excellence: Lead the day-to-day execution of the Performance Excellence cycle — tracking progress against key milestones, sending timely communications and reminders to employees, managers, and global People Team partners at each phase, and ensuring every deadline is met. Own Workday cycle logistics, including testing new launches, validating system configurations, and resolving user issues before each phase goes live. Equip employees and managers with clear, accessible resources — how-to guides, FAQs, and instructional materials — throughout the process. Advance ongoing program evolution by gathering cycle feedback, tracking enhancement requests, and coordinating technology and process improvements across platforms. Coordinate Employee Listening & Pulse Surveys: Manage end-to-end coordination of Employee Voice Survey and pulse survey cycles — from distribution lists and completion tracking to targeted reminders and timely delivery of results to People Business Partners and stakeholders. Equip users with the guidance needed to navigate and act on their results. Partner with the analytics team on data quality checks, anonymity thresholds, and dashboard updates. Maintain survey calendars, align listening program cadences, and track action item follow-through across cycles. Voice AI 360 Platform Administration: Serve as the functional system administrator. Manage the admin dashboard, whitelisting coordination, participant/provider invitation tracking, and real-time completion monitoring. Cross-Functional Stakeholder Interfacing: Act as the primary operational liaison with Procurement and Finance to manage Statement of Work (SOW) legal reviews, purchase orders, budget allocations, and vendor invoicing for platform scaling. Support Talent & Succession Logistics: Assist in the rollout of talent reviews and succession planning by organizing meeting materials, managing participant lists, and ensuring all data templates are updated and ready for use. Maintain Program Documentation: Keep our talent "playbooks" and internal resource pages up to date. Ensure that instructional guides and FAQs are accurate and reflect the current process for each cycle — including documentation for the 360 user experience. System Task Management: Act as a functional user of our talent systems, helping to test new cycle launches and enhancements, and troubleshooting basic user issues. Communication Support: Draft and distribute routine program updates and announcements. Help create simple, visually clear "how-to" materials (using Google Slides or Canva) to assist employees in navigating our talent tools. Reporting & Tracking: Pull regular reports to track participation across all talent programs, identifying any gaps in completion, monitoring anonymized Team Insights dashboards, and escalating issues to the team as needed. Operational Improvement: Provide feedback on the "user experience" of our cycles, suggesting small, practical tweaks to the coordination process to make it more efficient for the next time. Qualifications Experience: 5+ years in HR coordination, talent operations, or program management. Education: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, or a related field — or equivalent experience. Certifications: SHRM-CP or PHR preferred. AI Native: You naturally incorporate AI tools into your daily workflow and are curious about how emerging technology can make programs smarter and more efficient. Proactive Learner: A desire to understand the "why" behind the talent cycles while remaining focused on the "how" of the execution. Execution-Minded: You enjoy working with checklists and project plans; you are motivated by seeing a project through to 100% completion. Detail Obsessed: You have a high bar for accuracy, especially when it relates to employee data, program timelines, and data anonymity boundaries. Technical Proficiency: Comfortable using Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides), navigating HRIS platforms (Workday experience is a major plus), and a quick adaptability to emerging HR tech platforms (such as Voice AI/conversational feedback tools). Clear Communicator: Ability to write clear, concise instructions and communicate effectively with global employees, HR partners, and external vendor teams. Organizational Skills: Proven ability to manage multiple small tasks and deadlines simultaneously without losing focus. Vendor & Stakeholder Management: Proven experience interfacing with cross-functional corporate departments such as Procurement, Legal, and Finance for vendor onboarding, contract execution, and budget tracking. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting survey platforms (e.g., Workday, Qualtrics, AI Powered/Custom Apps). Experience administering AI-driven talent development or conversational feedback platforms. Experience in a high-growth or global corporate environment. Ability to use Canva or similar tools for basic layout/design of instructional materials. Workday HCM certification or equivalent platform training. CAPM, PMP, or equivalent project management credential. Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential. Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake. How do you want to make your impact? For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

Title: Program Manager, Org Effectiveness & Insights
Description: Why Socure? Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day. We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading. Job Summary The Program Manager, Organizational Effectiveness & Insights is a strategic, hands-on program owner responsible for designing, running, and continuously improving the programs and diagnostics that keep Socure organizationally healthy as it scales. Reporting to the Head of Talent Development & OE, this role owns end-to-end delivery of Socure’s engagement survey program, supports operating model design and implementation work, builds and applies org health diagnostics, and develops Socure’s change management practice and playbook. The ideal candidate is a strong program manager and people analytics practitioner who can move fluidly between data, diagnosis, and design — turning insight into structured, well-adopted action. Job Responsibilities Own end-to-end execution of Socure’s engagement survey program — lifecycle surveys (onboarding, engagement/pulse, exit, etc.) — from survey design and vendor/tool management through roll-out communications, reporting, analysis, and action planning with People Partners and people leaders. Consolidate engagement, pulse, exit, and other listening data into clear reporting views and dashboards; identify trends and drivers, and track action-plan progress over time. Support the design, refinement, and rollout of Socure’s operating model work — role definitions, decision rights, team structure optimization, and ways of working — including facilitation, documentation, and change management for operating model shifts that come out of strategic planning. Build and maintain org health diagnostics — a defined set of metrics and dashboards (e.g., turnover, span of control, engagement, performance distribution, headcount health) that give leadership an ongoing read on organizational health — and translate findings into recommendations through root-cause analysis. Develop and own Socure’s change management practice: a standard playbook, toolkit, and set of frameworks (readiness assessment, stakeholder mapping, communication planning, adoption tracking) applied consistently across org changes, new program launches, and restructures. Partner with the AI Ops Committee, HRBPs, and business leaders to assess how AI is reshaping team workflows and operating models — identifying where roles, processes, or org structures need to evolve — and translate those shifts into recommendations, org health diagnostics, and change management support. Partner with the Head of Talent Development and People Partners to plan and execute strategic talent & culture projects as they arise — from culture initiatives to ad hoc organizational assessments. Build repeatable playbooks, templates, and documentation for recurring programs; identify opportunities to automate and streamline workflows (survey comms, reminders, action-plan collection, reporting) using AI-enabled tools. Partner closely with HRBPs, HR Leadership, and business leaders to ensure programs are well adopted, inclusive, and grounded in what the data shows; act as the day-to-day point of contact for program questions and escalations. Stay current on market practice in organizational effectiveness, engagement measurement, and change management, bringing external benchmarks and frameworks into program design. Job Requirements Bachelor’s degree. 5–7+ years of relevant experience in organizational effectiveness, program management, people analytics / insights, employee engagement, or change management, ideally in a fast-paced or tech environment. Proven experience owning an end-to-end engagement survey program (design, launch, reporting, action planning) or comparable organizational diagnostic work. Working knowledge of change management frameworks and methodologies (e.g., Prosci/ADKAR or equivalent); Prosci or CCMP certification a plus. Demonstrated proficiency in people analytics and data storytelling — comfortable working with survey, org health, and HRIS data, and consolidating it into dashboards and reporting views for leaders. Experience supporting operating model or org design work (roles, structures, decision rights) a plus. Strong program and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent programs, build clear project plans, manage dependencies, and deliver on time. High proficiency with project management, collaboration, survey, and analytics tools. Experience using AI or automation tools to streamline workflows or strong aptitude to learn. Excellent written, verbal, and facilitation skills, with the ability to tell a clear, effective story with data and translate complex data and diagnostics into actionable guidance for leadership. Strong stakeholder management skills, the ability to influence without authority, and build trust across People sub-teams and business partners. High attention to detail and ownership, and comfort operating with a mix of structure and ambiguity as programs evolve. Socure is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity in all its forms within our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Title: Technical Content Marketing Manager
Description: Why Socure? Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day. We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading. Senior Technical Content Writer - Job Description About the role This is an employment marketing role for someone who can make exceptional engineers want to work at Socure. Socure is building AI-native infrastructure for identity, fraud prevention, and trust, and we need your help getting that engineering story out to the places where great technical talent discovers ideas, follows builders, and finds its next challenge. You will work closely with engineers, technical leaders, recruiting, and marketing to turn APIs, machine learning models, identity graphs, and decisioning workflows into a compelling case for joining the team. Your work will show software engineers the problems they can solve here, the systems they can help build, and the ambition behind Socure's mission. Why this role matters The best engineers are not looking for generic employer branding. They are looking for hard technical problems, strong peers, meaningful architecture, and a mission worth their time. You will make those things visible - in the communities, publications, developer platforms, social channels, and other talent-rich spaces where engineers actually pay attention. What you will do Tell the engineering story Interview engineers and technical leaders, learn how the platform works, and turn real technical work into stories that make top engineers lean in. Write technical content - including engineering blogs, deep dives, architecture stories, technical whitepapers, and recruiting-facing website copy - that makes the work at Socure tangible. Reach engineers where they are Own an employment-marketing content calendar built around the channels and communities where software engineers discover work, exchange ideas, and decide which companies deserve their attention. Adapt and distribute stories across developer platforms, technical publications, engineering communities, social channels, and other high-signal places where the best talent gathers. Partner with recruiting and employer brand to connect content to talent goals, strengthen candidate interest, and support hard-to-fill engineering hiring. Make difficult technology compelling Translate APIs, machine learning models, identity graphs, decisioning workflows, and cloud-based architectures into accurate, engaging stories for technical audiences. Show why the problems matter, what makes Socure's approach distinctive, and what an engineer could help build next. Build real subject matter depth Develop enough understanding of Socure's products and platform to write with authority, ask sharp questions, and earn the trust of technical experts. Stay current on AI, fraud, identity, security, and infrastructure trends, and turn them into timely points of view that attract the right people. How you will work Collaborate across the company Work with engineering, recruiting, employer brand, product marketing, and technical subject matter experts to find the strongest stories and get them ready for the right audiences. Partner with design, social, and distribution teams to package and place content for reach, credibility, and candidate action. Build a repeatable feedback loop with engineers so the content stays technically honest and genuinely representative of the work. Raise the bar Protect a high editorial standard for clarity, accuracy, voice, and consistency across every channel. Edit and proofread content from other contributors, and help maintain Socure's content style guide. Use AI thoughtfully Use AI tools such as ChatGPT's Deep Research to accelerate research, drafting, and technical enablement while keeping human judgment, verification, and editorial quality at the center. What you bring Demonstrable experience in content writing, technical writing, employer brand, recruiting marketing, or content marketing, ideally in identity verification, fraud, cybersecurity, fintech, infrastructure, or another technical B2B SaaS environment. Strong technical curiosity and the ability to learn and write accurately about APIs, machine learning, and cloud-based architectures. Exceptional writing and storytelling skills, with a talent for making complex technical work clear, credible, and exciting to software engineers. A portfolio of published technical, engineering, employer-brand, or recruiting content, such as blogs, deep dives, whitepapers, case studies, or similar work. Experience partnering cross-functionally with engineering, recruiting, employer brand, product marketing, and subject matter experts. Strong editorial and distribution instincts, with comfort owning a content calendar, finding the right audience and channel, giving and receiving feedback, and maintaining a consistent voice. Experience using AI tools for research, drafting, and content production is a plus. If you can understand ambitious engineering work, find the audience that will appreciate it, and make great engineers curious enough to start a conversation, we want to hear from you. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
