Strong editorial judgment and storytelling skills with the ability to translate complex concepts into simple, compelling narratives. Proficiency with SEO, content analytics, and experimentation to prioritize topics, optimize distribution, and demonstrate ROI. Hands‑on writing and editing skills across long‑form, short‑form, and multimedia formats; comfortable giving and receiving editorial feedback. Experience coordinating external partners and vendors, including budgeting and capacity planning for outsourced work. Familiarity with tools such as CMS platforms, SEO suites, analytics, social scheduling and listening, project management, and marketing automation. Bonus: Experience in B2B SaaS for revenue operations, sales performance, finance, or compensation; executive ghostwriting; original research programs. Core Competencies Proven customer focus; builds trusted relationships and uses voice‑of‑customer to shape content strategy and execution. Consistent results orientation; meets goals, drives impact, and iterates based on outcomes. Strong planning and organization; prioritizes, sequences, and manages multiple workstreams and stakeholders effectively Discipline in managing and measuring work; sets clear objectives, defines success metrics, and builds feedback loops. High creativity; generates original, differentiated ideas and connects dots across channels and formats. Broad perspective; ties day‑to‑day content to business goals, market dynamics, and future implications. Vision and purpose; articulates compelling narratives Benefits (US-ONLY) 100% of medical, dental, and vision covered including 75% for dependents Flexible vacation days and quarterly mental health days so you can recharge Enjoy a one-time expense on your 1-year work anniversary (to use for travel, home furnishings, fancy meal) One time work from home stipend & annual stipends for professional development and caretaking Virtual team lunches to keep you connected (US-ONLY) 401k plan to participate in and save towards the future Newest Apple products to help you do your best work Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) to support and celebrate the shared identities and life experiences of communities within CaptivateIQ. Title: Enterprise Risk Management Program Manager
Description: Come join our team at Crest Operations! With companies located across the United States, Crest Industries is committed to bringing together the best people and the right resources to meet today’s challenges and deliver the innovations of tomorrow. With significant recent growth and company acquisitions, Crest more than ever is a catalyst for change, using a little grit and a lot of determination to drive a forward movement for our customers and our employees. Crest Industries is seeking an Enterprise Risk Management Program Analyst (“ERM Program Analyst”) to support the execution, coordination, and continued maturity of Crest’s Enterprise Risk Management program. This role will help maintain the enterprise risk register, coordinate Risk Owner and Risk Liaison updates, support ERM dashboards and reporting, track mitigation actions, and prepare materials for leadership and ERM Steering Committee review. The ERM Program Analyst reports to the Insurance and Risk Manager and will work closely with Risk Owners, Risk Liaisons, business-unit leaders, functional stakeholders, and external ERM advisors. This role is ideal for someone who is highly organized, analytical, curious, and comfortable working with data, process documentation, cross-functional stakeholders, and recurring reporting cycles. Prior ERM experience is helpful but not required. Relevant experience may include risk management, operations, project coordination, compliance, internal audit, insurance, finance, legal, safety, quality, data analysis, business administration, or process improvement. This role will require the successful candidate to quickly build ERM knowledge, work through ambiguity, and become Crest’s internal owner of the ERM process over time. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: · Support recurring ERM update cycles, including Risk Owner meetings, Risk Liaison communications, data collection, follow-up, and status tracking. Coordinate with Risk Owners and Risk Liaisons to collect updates, clarify information, improve documentation quality, and reduce manual rework. Help improve ERM processes to make update cycles more consistent, efficient, and less dependent on manual coordination. · Maintain and update the enterprise risk register, including risk descriptions, risk owners, gross and net scores, current controls, planned actions, mitigation status, and supporting documentation. Help identify incomplete updates, inconsistent data, documentation gaps, or items requiring escalation. · Support preparation of ERM Steering Committee materials, executive summaries, dashboards, and enterprise risk profile updates. · Track mitigation plans, planned controls, action items, owners, due dates, and follow-up items across business units and functions. · Assist with risk workshops, Risk Owner meetings, scoring calibration discussions, control documentation review, and planned-action tracking. Assist with development of key risk indicators, risk metrics, action-plan reporting, and other reporting enhancements as the ERM program matures. · Support development and maintenance of ERM tools, templates, process documentation, guidance materials, and training resources. Maintain Power BI inputs and support recurring dashboard updates, data validation, trend analysis, and risk reporting. · Own the recurring ERM program calendar, including risk update cycles, Risk Owner meetings, Risk Liaison coordination, Steering Committee preparation, action-item tracking, and follow-up reporting. Promote practical risk ownership by helping teams understand ERM expectations, timelines, and documentation requirements. · Identify opportunities to improve the ERM process, reduce administrative burden, clarify expectations, and improve consistency across business units. Escalate process gaps, incomplete updates, inconsistent information, or items requiring leadership attention. The ERM Program Analyst must demonstrate the core values and purpose of Crest Industries: · We own doing the right thing. · We win together. · We question the status quo. · We rise to the challenge. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS: · Strong organization, follow-through, and attention to detail. · Ability to manage multiple workstreams, deadlines, data requests, meetings, and recurring reporting cycles. · Strong written and verbal communication skills. · Ability to summarize information clearly and professionally. · Comfortable working with employees and leaders across multiple business units and functions. · Ability to ask questions, clarify information, and follow up on incomplete or inconsistent responses. · Strong judgment and comfort working through ambiguity. · Proficiency with Microsoft Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint. · Ability and willingness to learn ERM concepts, risk terminology, reporting tools, and program methodology. · Relevant experience in risk management, operations, project coordination, compliance, audit, insurance, finance, legal, safety, quality, data analysis, business administration, process improvement, or a related field. · Strong ownership mindset and ability to drive work forward with limited structure. · Ability to work independently and proactively, manage competing priorities and deadlines, exercise sound judgment, think creatively, and take ownership of issues and matters through their successful conclusion. · Strong interpersonal skills, including a good sense of humor, patience and an ability to maintain an even keel. · Share the company’s purpose and values, including high ethical standards, teamwork, customer service mindset, and positive attitude. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS: · Experience supporting cross-functional projects, recurring reporting cycles, governance processes, management updates, or committee materials. · Experience working with Power BI, SharePoint, Microsoft Lists, Excel-based reporting tools, GRC systems, RMIS systems, or similar platforms. · Experience documenting processes, controls, action plans, procedures, compliance requirements, or management reports. · Familiarity with risk management, internal controls, audit, insurance, claims, safety, regulatory compliance, business continuity, or operational improvement concepts. · Experience preparing dashboards, summaries, presentations, or reports for leadership review. LOCATION: Pineville, Louisiana (on-site). ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: 1. Mental & Cognitive Requirements · Problem Solving: Resolving abstract or multi-layered issues by evaluating multiple solutions and executing on decisions. · Task Management: Prioritizing multiple competing projects simultaneously while adapting to shifting deadlines and business needs. · Critical Thinking: Synthesizing information from diverse sources to evaluate risks and make independent judgements. · Sustained Attention: Maintaining high focus during long periods of detailed data analysis or technical review. · Continuous Learning: Rapidly mastering new software, complex internal processes, and evolving industry regulations. · Memory Retention: Recalling detailed project histories, compliance guidelines, and technical specifications to guide daily work. · High-Stress Resilience: Maintains composure and focus during critical organizational audits or risk crisis situations. · Information Processing: Analyzing complex data sets, identifying trends, and translating findings into actionable business strategies. 2. Physical & Sensory Requirements · Sedentary Keyboard Work: Performs prolonged data entry, spreadsheet modeling, and screen viewing for up to 8 hours daily. · Virtual & Verbal Communication: Conducts frequent video calls, presentations, and interactive meetings with cross-functional teams. · Auditory Comprehension: Actively listens and captures nuances during complex risk interviews and committee meetings. · Light Transport: Moves materials or laptop equipment up to 10 pounds around the office environment occasionally. 3. Environmental & Travel Requirements · Office Environments: Works primarily in climate-controlled indoor environments. · Field Environments: May be required to visit outdoor job sites and outdoor or open-air industrial and/or manufacturing facilities up to 10% of the time. · Occasional Business Travel: Travels up to 10% annually via plane or car to conferences, trainings or to regional offices for on-site work We know how difficult it is to manage change and solve problems. Continuous improvement is hard work. Founded in 1958, we’ve seen our share of struggles. We’ve failed. We’ve learned and we’ve adapted. We will continue to grow and evolve to meet our customers’ ever-changing needs. To do this, there are three forces that we leverage that will not change: Our Solid Foundation, Innovation, and The Right People. When we bring these three forces together, we get a forward movement. Our logo reflects our respect for the past and our legacy but also supports where our industries are going. THE RIGHT PEOPLE We hire people who share our values and we put the right people in the right seats, with the skill sets that fit our customers’ challenges and we work hard to develop our people. Our people come to work because it feels like home, no matter where they are from. We place each other above egos because, at Crest, our coworkers are like your family. And like family, we believe in honest and clear communication so that the path towards our customers’ success is a united effort. Title: Program Manager
Description: Come join our team at DIS-TRAN Steel! Our people – not our machinery - are our biggest assets. DIS-TRAN Steel’s leadership team lives by our company values, modeling our culture of respect and integrity each day. We're a team that likes to have fun, but we also know how to get stuff done. DIS-TRAN Steel is looking to add a Program Manager to join the team at our Pineville, LA location. The Program Manager is responsible for planning, executing, and delivering multiple cross-functional manufacturing operational technology (OT) and business information technology (IT) programs within DIS-TRAN Steel. This role ensures programs are completed on time, within scope, and in alignment with business objectives. The Program Manager partners closely with operations, engineering, production, quality, supply chain, and leadership teams to improve processes, increase efficiency, support production goals, and deliver successful program outcomes. CORE COMPETENCIES: Implementing Vision and Values: Keeps the organization’s vision and values at the forefront of the associate decision making and action. Safety Orientation: Is aware of conditions that affect employee safety, takes responsible action, and promotes safety throughout the organization. Customer Focus: Proactively works to determine the needs of the internal / external customers and provide solutions; actively focuses on providing high quality service to internal / external customers while addressing the organization’s mission / vision / goals / policies; maintains clear communication regarding mutual expectation. Contributing to Team Success: Works cooperatively with others; is agreeable and team oriented; demonstrates a willingness to put aside personal differences for the benefit of the group as a whole. Quality Orientation: Is aware of quality issues and actively makes suggestions for improvement of product or processes; knows how personal contribution affects overall product and process quality; understands the company’s quality objectives and how they relate to the company’s objectives. Work Ethic: Maintains and promotes social, ethical, and organizational norms in conducting internal and external business activities. Continuous and Applied Learning: Actively identifies new areas for learning; regularly creates and takes advantage of learning opportunities; uses newly gained knowledge and skills on the job and leaning through their application; comprehends new job related information in a timely manner and correctly recalls and applies that information. Productivity Orientation: Takes appropriate actions to satisfy work quotas (e.g. production, assignments, projects, etc.) ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Program Leadership and Delivery Lead and manage multiple manufacturing OT and business IT programs from initiation through completion. Take ownership of program outcomes and ensure work remains aligned with operational and business objectives. Coordinate cross-functional teams, including production, engineering, quality, supply chain, technology, and other business functions. Support new product launches, process-improvement initiatives, capital projects, and technology implementations. Ensure programs are completed on time, within scope, and according to established quality expectations. Effectively prioritize multiple projects and competing requirements in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, safety, quality, and operational efficiency. Program Planning and Administration Define program objectives, scope, deliverables, milestones, dependencies, and success criteria. Develop and maintain project schedules, budgets, resource plans, and implementation roadmaps. Coordinate program resources and activities across internal teams and external stakeholders. Maintain accurate program documentation, action items, decisions, schedules, and supporting materials. Facilitate program meetings, reviews, planning sessions, and stakeholder discussions. Assist with standardizing program-management processes, tools, documentation, and best practices. Performance and Risk Management Monitor program performance and provide regular status updates to leadership and key stakeholders. Track key performance indicators, milestones, budgets, resource utilization, and other program metrics. Identify program risks, issues, constraints, and dependencies. Develop and implement mitigation and corrective-action plans to keep programs on track. Analyze performance information to identify opportunities for improved efficiency, quality, delivery, and cost management. Escalate significant risks and issues appropriately and provide recommendations for resolution. Business Partnership and Communication Maintain clear and consistent communication with internal teams, leadership, and external stakeholders. Promote alignment, accountability, and transparency throughout the program lifecycle. Build and maintain effective working relationships across departments. Facilitate communication among technical teams, operational teams, business stakeholders, and leadership. Communicate complex program information clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Establish mutual expectations with internal and external customers and maintain a strong service orientation. Continuous Improvement Lead and support continuous-improvement initiatives that increase efficiency, reduce waste, improve quality, and strengthen program delivery. Identify opportunities to improve manufacturing processes, production workflows, technology systems, and business practices. Support the development and standardization of processes, tools, and program-management best practices. Apply lessons learned to future programs and improvement initiatives. Support training and onboarding activities related to new programs, systems, processes, or procedures. Participate in audits, reviews, retrospectives, and other improvement activities supporting business objectives. Safety, Quality, and Compliance Ensure program activities comply with company policies, safety standards, quality requirements, and applicable regulations. Consider employee safety, product quality, operational impacts, and customer requirements throughout program planning and execution. Promote responsible safety practices during office, production-floor, and project-site activities. Participate in required meetings, audits, and compliance reviews. Perform other related duties and responsibilities as assigned by the supervisor. REQUIREMENTS FOR PROGRAM MANAGER: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, operations management, information technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Approximately three to seven or more years of program- or project-management experience within a manufacturing environment. Strong understanding of manufacturing operational technology, business information technology, production processes, and operational workflows. Proven ability to manage multiple programs or projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment. Experience developing and managing project schedules, budgets, resource plans, risks, and performance metrics. Experience coordinating cross-functional teams and collaborating with technical, operational, and leadership stakeholders. Strong program-management, organizational, analytical, and time-management skills. Excellent written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, and interpersonal communication skills. Strong leadership, problem-solving, critical-thinking, and decision-making abilities. Ability to manage detailed information while maintaining focus on broader business objectives. Demonstrated accountability, initiative, adaptability, and commitment to continuous learning. Proficiency with Microsoft Office. Proficiency with Epicor ERP is required. Experience with project-management tools and methodologies is preferred. Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, or Agile methodologies is a plus. Project Management Professional certification is a plus. At DIS-TRAN Steel, you'll have the opportunity to make a visible impact on our operations while gaining exposure to production, project management, continuous improvement, and business operations. This role provides an excellent foundation for future leadership opportunities within manufacturing and industrial operations. Title: Enterprise Governance Analyst – Nuclear
Description: Delta Solutions & Strategies is seeking an Enterprise Governance Analyst – Nuclear to support Headquarters Department of the Air Force nuclear enterprise governance activities in the National Capital Region. This position will provide analytical and administrative support to the Nuclear Oversight Council and other designated nuclear-related governance forums. The selected candidate will help prepare senior leaders, manage forum workflows, document strategic decisions, and track actions related to the sustainment and modernization of the Air Force nuclear enterprise. *Anticipated award/start date September 2026 What you will be doing: Provide analytical and administrative support to the Nuclear Oversight Council and other designated nuclear enterprise governance forums. Coordinate and consolidate proposed agenda topics, briefing materials, and stakeholder inputs. Develop senior leader support packages, including draft agendas, read-ahead materials, briefing slides, and supporting documentation. Coordinate with Headquarters Air Force, Major Commands, program offices, and other nuclear enterprise stakeholders. Title: Program Management - Principal TPM – Packaging, SI/PI & System Integration
Description: Join the leading chiplet startup! As an Eliyan Principal Technical Program Manager, you will be working at a fast-paced early-stage startup creating technologies that fuel tomorrow’s chiplet-based systems with best-in-class power, area, manufacturability, and design flexibility. You will drive day-to-day execution across multiple concurrent advanced packaging, SI/PI, and system integration programs — from early feasibility through qualification and production ramp — in close coordination with our broader ASIC development and platform programs. You will work with a cross-functional team of experts who operate from first principles, innovate, and push the envelope to create high-volume, high-performance manufacturable products. We offer a fun work environment with excellent benefits. ON-SITE (BAY AREA) About the Role: This role sits at the intersection of packaging, signal/power integrity, and system design. As a Principal Technical Program Manager , you will own the schedule, risk, and cross-team strategy for our packaging and SI/PI program portfolio, translating between analog and digital design teams, package and substrate engineers, and external vendors to keep every program on track. You will set the standard for how packaging programs are planned and executed across the company and represent packaging and system integration to executive leadership. Strong candidates are comfortable coming up to speed quickly on unfamiliar technical territory, spot bottlenecks before they become critical-path problems, and know how to drive a room of engineers toward a resolution. Key Responsibilities: Packaging & SI/PI Program Execution: Own and drive program schedules for advanced packaging and SI/PI workstreams — including 2.5D/3D IC integration, chiplet interposer/substrate design, bump/RDL planning, and co-packaged optics (CPO) — from early feasibility through qualification and production ramp, ensuring milestones stay synchronized with die-level tapeout schedules. Technical Fluency Across the Design Flow: Maintain a deep working understanding of SI/PI, package, and system design flows — including inputs, outputs, and inter-stage dependencies — with the ability to engage meaningfully with analog and digital design teams as well as external vendors and suppliers. Multi-Program Portfolio Management: Manage multiple concurrent packaging and SI/PI projects simultaneously with clear, real-time visibility into the status of each. Assess and communicate the downstream impact of new or unplanned work on existing commitments, and confidently adjust priorities — or push back — when scope conflicts arise. Rapid Ramp-Up & Structured Problem-Solving: Rapidly come up to speed on new projects and unfamiliar technical domains, quickly identify technical and schedule bottlenecks, and drive structured brainstorming sessions to unblock the team and keep programs on track. Cross-Functional Coordination: Work closely with internal teams — including package/SI-PI engineering, physical design, DFT, analog design, PCB and platform design, silicon bring-up, and optical product development — to keep packaging milestones aligned with the broader ASIC and platform program. OSAT & Foundry/Vendor Management: Manage relationships and schedules with outsourced assembly and test (OSAT) partners, substrate vendors, and foundries; track packaging-specific deliverables (interposer fab, flip-chip assembly, bump qualification, reliability testing) against committed timelines. Customer & Partner Interface: Interface directly with customers and technology partners on packaging-related deliverables, co-design requirements, and integration milestones — particularly for CPO and advanced heterogeneous integration programs. Schedule and Risk Management: Define program timelines, set milestones (DOE runs, qualification builds, reliability testing cycles), and proactively identify and mitigate risks specific to advanced packaging technologies (yield, assembly tolerances, thermal/mechanical qualification). Budget & Resource Allocation: Own packaging program budgets, allocate resources across internal engineering and external OSAT/substrate partners, and track expenses to optimize development efforts. Technical Reviews & Reporting: Lead regular program reviews, maintain clear documentation of program status and risk, and report progress to executive leadership and key stakeholders using dashboards and structured status updates. Process Improvement: Define and continuously improve program management best practices specific to packaging, SI/PI, and advanced integration workflows, improving execution efficiency across teams and projects. Qualifications: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related field. 15+ years of experience in semiconductor program management, with substantial hands-on experience in advanced packaging (2.5D/3D integration, flip-chip, interposers, substrate/RDL, CoWoS/InFO/EMIB or equivalent) and/or SI/PI program execution. Deep technical fluency across SI/PI, package, and system design flows, with credibility engaging analog and digital design teams and external vendors. Develop ability to manage multiple concurrent projects with clear, real-time visibility into status and sound judgment on reprioritization when scope conflicts arise. Track record of ramping quickly on new or unfamiliar technical domains and resolving bottlenecks through structured problem-solving. Experience managing OSAT, substrate vendor, and foundry relationships through qualification and production. Strong understanding of the packaging development lifecycle, including design rules, assembly processes, reliability qualification (thermal cycling, HTOL, THB), and DFM/DFR considerations. Excellent problem-solving, leadership, and decision-making skills, particularly in navigating cross-functional tradeoffs between silicon design, packaging, and manufacturing constraints. Strong verbal and written communication skills, comfortable interfacing with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including customers and external partners. Experience with project management tools (e.g., Jira, MS Project, Confluence, Smartsheet) and methodologies (Agile, Waterfall). Nice to Have: Experience with co-packaged optics (CPO) or advanced heterogeneous integration. Knowledge of high-performance computing, AI/ML accelerator packaging, or networking ASIC packaging. Familiarity with signal/power integrity simulation and analysis at the package or system level. Experience standing up program dashboards, RAID logs, or portfolio-level reporting for multi-project environments. Why Eliyan? Work at the forefront of chiplet interconnect technology, defining the next generation of high-performance, power-efficient chip-to-chip communication. High-visibility role with direct exposure to founders and executive leadership. Competitive salary, meaningful equity, and comprehensive benefits. A collaborative, first-principles culture where your ideas and ownership directly shape outcomes.

Title: Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) Manager
Description: About Fullscript We’re an industry-leading health technology company on a mission to help people get better. We started in 2011 with one simple idea. Make it easier for practitioners to access the products they trust so they can deliver better care. That simple idea grew into a platform that powers every part of care. Today, more than 125,000 practitioners use Fullscript for clinical insights, lab interpretations, patient analytics, education, and access to high-quality supplements. Over 10 million patients rely on Fullscript to stay connected to their care plans and follow through on treatment. We build tools that make care smarter and more human. Tools that save time, simplify decisions, and help practitioners stay closely connected to the people they care for. When everything they need is in one place, they can focus on what matters most: helping people get better. This is your invitation. Bring your ideas, your grit, and your care for people. Join us and shape the future of care. The Opportunity We're looking for an experienced Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) Manager to lead and mature Fullscript's security compliance program. This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for driving our governance, risk, and compliance strategy while directly managing a team of two GRC professionals. You'll own our security compliance program across multiple frameworks, including SOC 2 Type II, PCI DSS, and HITRUST, ensuring we remain continuously audit-ready while scaling our controls alongside the business. You'll lead internal and external audits, partner closely with Security, Engineering, Infrastructure, Privacy, Legal, Product, and IT, and help translate regulatory and customer requirements into practical, scalable security practices. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing strategic program ownership with day-to-day execution and who thrives in highly collaborative, fast-growing SaaS environments. What You'll Do Governance & Compliance Own and evolve Fullscript's Governance, Risk & Compliance program. Maintain and continuously improve compliance across SOC 2 Type II, PCI DSS, and HITRUST. Develop and maintain policies, standards, procedures, and control documentation. Ensure compliance activities are embedded into operational processes rather than point-in-time exercises. Track regulatory, contractual, and customer compliance obligations and ensure appropriate control coverage. Audit & Assurance Lead all external compliance audits, including planning, evidence collection, auditor coordination, issue resolution, and successful certification. Manage internal control assessments and readiness activities throughout the year. Coordinate remediation efforts across Engineering, IT, Security, and business teams. Own relationships with external auditors and assessment firms. Develop reporting and dashboards that communicate compliance posture and audit readiness to leadership. Risk Management Partner with Security leadership to mature enterprise security risk management. Maintain risk registers and facilitate risk assessments across technology and business functions. Drive remediation planning and track progress through completion. Support third-party risk management activities as required. Cross-Functional Partnership Build strong partnerships with Privacy and Legal to ensure alignment between security, regulatory, and privacy obligations. Partner with Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, and IT to operationalize security controls. Support customer security reviews, due diligence requests, and compliance questionnaires. Provide practical guidance that enables business growth while maintaining an appropriate risk posture. Leadership Lead, coach, and develop a team of two GRC professionals. Establish team priorities, operating cadence, and professional development plans. Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence. Remain actively involved in execution, serving as a working manager who contributes directly to audits, control implementation, and compliance initiatives. What You Bring 7+ years of experience in Governance, Risk & Compliance, Information Security, IT Audit, or Security Compliance. Previous people management experience leading small, high-performing teams. Hands-on experience owning enterprise compliance programs within SaaS or healthcare technology organizations. Demonstrated success leading external audits for: SOC 2 Type II PCI DSS HITRUST GDPR Familiarity with HIPAA and its requirements. Experience coordinating multiple concurrent compliance initiatives across engineering and business stakeholders. Strong understanding of security frameworks including NIST CSF, CIS Controls, ISO 27001, and HITRUST. Experience partnering closely with Privacy and Legal teams on regulatory compliance initiatives. Experience managing control evidence, remediation programs, and continuous compliance activities. Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex compliance requirements into practical business guidance. Nice to Have Healthcare or health technology experience. Experience with GRC platforms such as Vanta, Drata, OneTrust, or similar. Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISA, CRISC, CISM, HITRUST CCSFP, PCI ISA/QSA, or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor. Experience supporting customer security reviews and enterprise sales due diligence. Why This Role Matters Trust is one of Fullscript's most important products. As our GRC Manager, you'll help ensure that our security and compliance programs scale alongside the business, enabling innovation while maintaining the confidence of our customers, partners, and regulators. You'll have the opportunity to shape the future of our compliance program, mentor a growing team, and influence security strategy across the organization. What We Can Offer You Generous PTO and competitive pay Fullscript’s RRSP match program for financial health Flexible benefits package and workplace wellness program Training budget and company-wide learning initiatives Discount on Fullscript catalog of products Ability to work Wherever You Work Well* Our Wherever You Work Well philosophy means Fullscript teammates get to pick their own office — whether that’s in-office, at home, or a bit of both 🐶🏡 Compensation range The salary range for this role is between $140,000 and $165,000 CAD. Fullscript shares salary ranges to support transparency and help candidates make informed decisions. The range shown reflects base salary only. Additional incentives, perks, and benefits may be available as part of Fullscript’s total rewards package. Final base salary depends on experience, skills, and location. We review pay regularly to stay aligned with market data and internal equity. Benefits and total rewards may vary by region. Why Fullscript Great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and inspired. At Fullscript, we stay curious and keep finding smarter ways to make care better. We grow together, take on new challenges, and focus on impact. We put people first, work as a team, and leave egos at the door. Title: Sr Manager, Product Design (AI Workflows)
Description: About usHighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes. To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently. Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability. Our peopleWith over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home. Our impactEvery month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that. Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts About the Role We are seeking a Senior Manager, Product Design to lead a high-performing team of product designers focused on AI-powered workflows that span our Product and Revenue product lines — the tools our customers rely on to communicate with their customers. This spans conversations, messaging, automation and intelligence surfaces that sit at the center of how agencies and SMBs run their businesses on HighLevel. You have spent 9+ years designing and leading complex products, including 3+ years managing designers, and are ready to guide a distributed team through ambitious, AI-driven product work. This role will report to the Senior Director, Product Design and manage approximately 8–12 product designers across the United States and India. You will lead design execution across AI workflow surfaces that cut across our Product and Revenue pillars, helping teams turn customer needs, business goals and technical constraints into clear, useful product experiences for the conversations and communications that power our customers' businesses. This is a craft-driven management role for someone who stays close to the work. You will not be the primary production designer, but you should have the taste, product judgment and design fluency to improve direction, sharpen decisions and coach designers — with particular fluency in designing for AI-assisted and AI-generated experiences. We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate exceptional visual and interaction design judgment, strong systems thinking and the ability to grow designers through clear expectations, critique, direct feedback and practical coaching. You should care deeply about the standards that make product experiences feel refined, trustworthy and coherent at scale — especially where AI is shaping how customers communicate with their own customers. Experience leading B2B SaaS, platform, CRM, marketing technology, workflow-heavy or SMB software experiences is highly valuable. Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis, documentation or workflow acceleration is expected, as is experience designing AI-native product experiences (e.g., conversational AI, automation, agentic workflows, or generative communication tools). What You'll Do Manage, coach and develop 8–12 product designers across US- and India-based teams. Lead design execution for AI-powered workflows spanning Product and Revenue lines — the communication, messaging and automation experiences customers use to reach and engage their own customers. Connect customer needs, business goals, technical constraints and product strategy across these cross-cutting AI workflow surfaces. Set expectations for quality, accountability, collaboration, communication and delivery. Keep designers focused on the highest-priority work, help them manage ambiguity and clarify what is expected, blocked or ready for decision. Partner with Product, Engineering, Data, design leadership and the Senior Director, Product Design to shape roadmaps, clarify tradeoffs and improve outcomes across Product and Revenue AI initiatives. Lead critiques, coaching conversations, quality reviews and launch-readiness discussions that improve usability, accessibility, interaction quality, visual consistency, design-system alignment and the quality of AI-assisted experiences. Maintain workstream visibility through useful rituals, crisp updates and timely risk escalation. Hire excellent talent, onboard designers and create clear development plans. Use AI-powered tools and workflows to accelerate exploration, prototyping, synthesis, documentation and production collaboration without lowering the quality bar. What We Are Looking For 9+ years of relevant product design, UX or product experience work, including 3+ years managing product designers. Proven experience managing designers in complex B2B SaaS, platform, workflow-heavy or multi-product environments. An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates product judgment, systems thinking, customer empathy, high-quality execution and measurable product impact — ideally including AI-powered or AI-assisted product experiences. Exceptional visual and interaction design judgment, with the ability to raise the quality of work across a team. Strong management skills with individual contributors, including keeping designers focused, unblocked, accountable and connected to the broader goals of the work. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to maintain visibility across workstreams and give leadership a clear view of progress, risks, tradeoffs and decisions. Experience leading critique, coaching designers, giving direct feedback and helping teams make stronger product design decisions. Working knowledge of design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions. Strong product judgement and comfort balancing customer needs, business outcomes, technical constraints and speed of execution — particularly across cross-functional Product and Revenue initiatives. Comfort designing for AI-native experiences: conversational interfaces, automation, agentic workflows or generative communication tools. Proven ability to hire strong designers, develop existing talent, support career growth and performance manage team members who need additional support. Experience managing distributed teams and working across time zones; experience working closely with India-based teams is highly valuable. Familiarity with AI-assisted production tools and enthusiasm for using them thoughtfully to improve design quality, communication and velocity. How You Work You raise the bar for craft, visual sophistication, product quality and team execution. You stay close enough to the work to improve decisions, not only track progress. You teach designers how to recognize, critique and ship stronger product design, including for AI-powered experiences. You keep work visible, focused and moving without turning management into bureaucracy. You build trust through warmth, candor, accountability, direct feedback and respect for your teammates as people. You enjoy leading collaboration across time zones and cultural contexts, including with US- and India-based teammates. You communicate in ways that help distributed teams work with clarity, care, trust and momentum. You think across product boundaries — connecting Product and Revenue workflows around a shared goal: helping our customers communicate better with their customers. initiatives, owners, milestones, dependencies, decisions, and deadlines • Use data, dashboards, and SQL to independently validate project status rather than relying solely on reported updates • Identify cross functional dependencies and surface risks before they impact critical deadlines • Build alignment and hold owners accountable across teams you don’t directly manage • Maintain clear decision and change documentation across initiatives • Communicate risks early and bring options for moving forward • Transition completed initiatives to day to day business owners with clear ownership, monitoring, and follow through • Use AI agents, workflow automation, and other tools to make portfolio management smarter and more efficient What You'll Bring to the Team • 4 to 8 years of experience managing complex, cross functional projects or programs in a metrics driven environment • Proven ability to manage multiple projects or workstreams simultaneously • Working SQL knowledge in performance marketing, marketplaces, adtech, insurtech, health insurance, lead generation, or a similar environment • Experience working against immovable seasonal deadlines, major launches, building a company for people who want to be part of what’s changing, not watching it happen. Title: Technical Content Writer
Description: About Hive Hive is the leading provider of cloud-based AI solutions to understand, search, and generate content, and is trusted by hundreds of the world's largest and most innovative organizations. The company empowers developers with a portfolio of best-in-class, pre-trained AI models, serving billions of customer API requests every month. Hive also offers turnkey software applications powered by proprietary AI models and datasets, enabling breakthrough use cases across industries. Together, Hive’s solutions are transforming content moderation, brand protection, sponsorship measurement, context-based ad targeting, and more. Hive has raised over $120M in capital from leading investors, including General Catalyst, 8VC, Glynn Capital, Bain & Company, Visa Ventures, and others. We have over 250 employees globally in our San Francisco, Seattle, and Delhi offices. Please reach out if you are interested in joining the future of AI! Technical Content Writer Role We are looking for a talented cross-functional Content Writer to join our Marketing Team. As the Content Writer you will create compelling content for a wide variety of platforms including our Hive Engineering blog, mailing lists, white papers, and op-eds. Day to day, you will manage multiple projects at a time while collaborating with our design team in India. A successful candidate is detail-oriented and committed to meeting tight deadlines. We are looking for a natural storyteller with a high level of creativity, who also has the ability to understand our product deeply and use data-driven insights to write better material. Preference will be given to those with a strong writing portfolio and proven technical understanding. This is a great opportunity to see how a high growth startup functions in action. Responsibilities Collaborate cross functionally between sales, business development, design and engineering teams across different offices to create appropriate content Develop and create content for various platforms including, but not limited to, the Hive Engineering blog, mailing lists, decks, white papers, and web copy Organize and write supporting documents for products Research markets and industries to compare and create content that is innovative and original Determine the needs of end users for technical documentation Standardize content across all platforms and media Maintain awareness of industry best practices for data maintenance handling as it relates to your role Adhere to policies, guidelines and procedures pertaining to the protection of information assets Report actual or suspected security and/or policy violations/breaches to an appropriate authority Requirements You have a Bachelor's degree You have 0-2 years of work experience You have excellent written and verbal communications skills with an analytical mindset You must have written technical content (CS backgrounds are preferred) You are familiar with keyword placement and SEO You are highly organized and detail-oriented; you handle multiple priorities without missing a beat You are highly self-motivated and ambitious in achieving goals You are a strong team player but can work and execute independently You are driven. No one needs to push you to excel; that’s just who you are! You are hungry to learn and are actively looking for opportunities to contribute Who We Are We are a group of ambitious individuals who are passionate about creating a revolutionary AI company. At Hive, you will have a steep learning curve and an opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest growing AI start-ups in San Francisco. The work you do here will have a noticeable and direct impact on the development of the company. The current expected base salary for this position ranges from $60,000 - $90,000. Actual compensation may vary depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience, and location. Base pay is one part of the total compensation package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work; commissions and stock options may be offered in addition to the range provided here. Thank you for your interest in Hive and we hope to meet you soon!

Title: Content Marketing & Editorial, Sr. Manager
Description: About the Institute of Foundation Models We are a dedicated research lab for building, understanding, using, and risk-managing foundation models. Our mandate is to advance research, nurture the next generation of AI builders, and drive transformative contributions to a knowledge-driven economy. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to work on the core of cutting-edge foundation model training, alongside world-class researchers, data scientists, and engineers, tackling the most fundamental and impactful challenges in AI development. You will participate in the development of groundbreaking AI solutions that have the potential to reshape entire industries. Strategic and innovative problem-solving skills will be instrumental in establishing MBZUAI as a global hub for high-performance computing in deep learning, driving impactful discoveries that inspire the next generation of AI pioneers. The Role: IFM is looking for a Content Marketing and Editorial Director to shape the editorial vision and content strategy for IFM. This role will not only lead how IFM communicates its research, Foundational Models and World Models to AI developers, AI industry influencers press, creators, policymakers, and the broader AI community, but also identify emerging trends that help IFM participate at the center of the AI conversation. This is a hands-on role: part strategist, part editor, part publisher. You'll set the narrative, build the processes behind it, and personally shape the flagship pieces that help build the IFM brand. This role is about creating content aligned to IFM’s business objectives with responsibilities covering research “mining” and storytelling, owned channel and content development for launch communications, and thought leadership, community building and forming a point of view that earns the attention of our audience. You'll need to be comfortable translating dense technical work into content that's rigorous enough for experts and clear enough for a broader audience. The role is based in our beautiful new Sunnyvale, CA office. Key Responsibilities Develop and own the editorial voice, calendar and content strategy end-to-end for a deeply technical lab, from long-form narrative to short-form content. Build relationships and partner with IFM engineers so you can sit with them and pull a sharp story out of potentially dense technical work. Own the editorial pipeline — Build and run the content engine. Owns the systems behind the work: how ideas are generated, prioritized, produced and distributed across formats. Push the work past the page. Build a video and multimedia approach where a brand story, a conference clip, and a long-form report all reach an audience in a way that is appropriate. Oversee IFM's owned channels (blog, social, YouTube, and potential new channels) and align them with the website/visual design function. Manage a social media manager Partner with Communications Lead, Research and Product to shape how new models, benchmarks, and demos are communicated via IFM’s owned channels Must be able to collaborate across a team. Work cross functionally on an annual IFM flagship research report — coordinating with research teams, setting methodology-transparency standards, and managing the report from data to publication. Build out a freelance writing team over time Track metrics Qualifications 8-10 years in content marketing, or research communications, ideally with some exposure to technical/scientific fields (AI, ML, or adjacent deep tech). A track record of developing credible, well-sourced long-form content — reports, indices, technical blog posts, as well as short-form content. Experience working directly with researchers or engineers to translate technical work for a broader audience. Work with a a bias toward action. Excellent writing and editing skills; comfortable being the last read on anything IFM publishes externally. Passionate about technology, AI, Open Source—intellectually curious and always learning. Benefits Include *Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits *Bonus *401K Plan *Generous paid time off, sick leave and holidays *Paid Parental Leave *Employee Assistance Program *Life insurance and disability

Title: Marketing & Communications Program Manager
Description: The Marcomm Program Manager is a critical operational role within the Corporate Marketing & Communications team, reporting to the Vice President of Corporate Marketing & Communications. This role serves the entire marcomm function — spanning brand, B2B/corporate marketing/product/client marketing, and content — as its dedicated operational backbone. The Marcomm PM will establish and run a clear cross-functional operating rhythm, and prioritization cadence that brings consistency, visibility, and accountability to how the team plans and delivers work against its most important growth initiatives. By owning the systems and workflows that keep integrated marketing moving, this role directly enables senior marketers to stay focused on high-value strategy and the work that most influences pipeline, retention, and win rate. Responsibilities Own and operate the marcomm team's intake process — creating a single point of entry for all new project requests across corporate marketing, client marketing, brand, and content — ensuring each request is scoped, prioritized, and routed appropriately before work begins. Plug into and reinforce the broader Growth team's existing operating rhythms and reporting structures — rather than standing up marcomm-specific systems in isolation — adapting shared cadences (e.g., weekly prioritization reviews, sprint-style planning, status syncs) to create consistent visibility into active work, dependencies, and capacity across marcomm teams. Help to develop and manage integrated project plans, timelines, and delivery schedules in Asana, keeping all workstreams current and surfacing blockers before they become delays. Produce clear, concise status reporting for marketing leadership — replacing fragmented Slack threads and ad hoc follow-up with structured, repeatable updates that make progress and priorities legible at a glance. Serve as the connective tissue across marcomm teams — facilitating coordination between Corporate Communications, Client Marketing, Creative, and Content — so that cross-functional dependencies are tracked and hand-offs are clean. Proactively identify risks, resource conflicts, and scope creep; escalate to the VP or relevant senior marketers with recommended resolutions. Support program-level prioritization decisions by maintaining a shared view of the team's portfolio, flagging capacity constraints, and helping leadership make informed trade-off calls. Contribute to the development of lightweight, scalable standard operating procedures and workflow documentation that reduce reliance on tribal knowledge and informal communication channels. Partner with senior marketers on campaign and initiative scoping to ensure timelines are realistic, resources are aligned, and deliverables are clearly defined before execution begins. Drive adoption of Asana and shared project management practices across the marcomm team, providing guidance and accountability to ensure consistent use. Spearhead and advance key technology transformation initiatives on behalf of the marcomm team — translating FY27 plan milestones into actionable, repeatable execution plans in close partnership with Growth and Tech counterparts, ensuring marcomm stays aligned and moving in lockstep with broader organizational transformation efforts. Partner with marcomm leadership to foster a strong sense of team culture, engagement, and continuous learning — creating consistent, meaningful touchpoints for employees and sub-teams that reinforce connection, shared purpose, and professional growth across the function. Requirements 3–5 years of experience in program management, marketing operations, or a traffic/production coordination role, ideally within an in-house marketing team or agency environment. Demonstrated experience building or improving intake and workflow systems in a fast-moving, matrixed organization. Proficiency with Asana or a comparable project management platform; comfort configuring projects, templates, and dashboards to support team-wide visibility. Strong organizational skills and a systems-oriented mindset — you find it genuinely satisfying to bring structure to ambiguous, high-velocity environments. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex workstreams into clear, executive-ready status updates. Experience facilitating cross-functional coordination across multiple teams and stakeholders simultaneously. Ability to manage competing priorities without losing sight of what matters most; comfortable asking clarifying questions and pushing back constructively when scope or timelines are unclear. Comfort operating in an environment undergoing process and tooling transformation — you are a change enabler, not a change resistor. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting B2B or enterprise marketing teams, with exposure to demand generation, client marketing, or content marketing workflows. Familiarity with healthcare, tech, or highly regulated industries. PMP, PMI-ACP, or equivalent project management certification. Title: Security Governance Analyst, Italy
Description: About us: We are a community of visionary innovators, dedicated to providing pioneering software and consultancy services to financial institutions, trading firms, central banks, governments, and corporations around the world. We strive to simplify the way people work. We do that by providing workflow and process automation software, as well as providing real-time data and business intelligence to help people make better decisions. We are 13,000+ employees, we operate globally with 80+ global offices, and we serve over 4,800+ customers worldwide. For the strengthening of the Chief Information Security Office (CISO) function within Cedacri companies, part of ION Group, we are looking for talented professionals to grow their career as Security Governance Analyst. This position is targeted at candidates with 2–5 years of relevant experience in Information Security Governance, Cybersecurity Risk Management, or ICT Compliance. Selected candidates will be placed in a dynamic and innovative environment and will collaborate with cross-functional teams to support cybersecurity governance initiatives across the organization. Learn more at www.iongroup.com. Your role Your key duties and responsibilities Support the implementation and continuous improvement of the Information Security Governance framework Support the implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Information Security Governance framework across the organization. Develop, maintain, and review cybersecurity policies, standards, procedures, and governance documentation. Support cybersecurity risk management activities, including risk assessments, remediation tracking, exception management, and risk treatment planning. Monitor the effectiveness and maturity of security controls and ensure governance activities remain aligned with organizational objectives and regulatory requirements. Maintain governance evidence, action plans, ownership records, dependencies, and remediation initiatives to support audit readiness and effective reporting. Prepare KPI/KRI dashboards for management on coverage, timeliness and effectiveness of controls, including asset/API inventories, SBOM/SCA coverage, patching performance, exception aging and action-plan closure. Collaborate with Technology, Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Business stakeholders to ensure alignment with security governance requirements. Support internal audits, external audits, regulatory assessments, and client due diligence activities. Contribute to the implementation of regulatory and industry frameworks, including DORA, NIS2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, and related standards. Support governance transformation initiatives and continuous improvement programs aimed at strengthening cybersecurity oversight capabilities. Other duties We might ask you to perform other tasks and duties as your role expands. Your skills, experience, and qualifications required Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Law, Management Engineering, or a related field (with honors). At least 2-5 years of experience in Information Security Governance, ICT Risk Management, Cybersecurity Compliance, Internal Audit, or related functions. Good understanding of cybersecurity governance principles, governance requirements for vulnerability management, patch management, incident response, secure SDLC, third-party risk and operational resilience. Knowledge of international standards and frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST CSF, COBIT, CIS Controls, DORA, and NIS2. Experience supporting audit activities, compliance assessments, regulatory initiatives, or governance reporting processes. Ability to translate complex technical topics into clear governance, risk, and management reporting outputs. Strong analytical, organizational, and stakeholder management skills. Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint. Excellent knowledge of Italian and English. Professional certifications such as ISO 27001, CISA, CRISC, Security+, or equivalent would be considered a plus. What we offer: Permanent employment contract Italian National Collective Labour Agreement for the Metalworking Industry (CCNL Metalmeccanico) Gross Annual Salary (RAL) ranging from €40,000 to €50,000, depending on experience, skills, and qualifications Job grade to be determined upon completion of the selection process, with final assessment between B2 and B3 level Opportunity to join a leading international technology group operating in the financial services industry Exposure to enterprise-wide cybersecurity governance activities in a dynamic and international environment Location: Milan. Our partner is looking for a Events Program Manager - Freelance based in United States. This role is the central link between clients, warehouse operations, and event production teams, ensuring programs move smoothly from planning through delivery. You’ll own client relationships, manage logistics, translate changing requirements into clear execution plans, and keep complex programs on schedule. The role is highly hands-on, with significant involvement in event kit preparation, packing, asset management, and quality control. You’ll work across fast-moving event environments where priorities can shift quickly and last-minute changes are part of the job. Your experience in event production will help you anticipate on-site challenges, protect timelines, and ensure every kit arrives complete and ready for use. You’ll also contribute to improving operational systems and creating repeatable processes as the programs and client portfolio grow. This is a fully remote contract opportunity with frequent travel to a warehouse facility in Charlotte, North Carolina, and occasional travel to client or vendor locations. Accountabilities: Serve as the primary client contact for production logistics, shipment timelines, specifications, and program updates. Manage changing requirements and last-minute requests by assessing impact, reprioritizing work, communicating clearly, and protecting delivery timelines. Participate in planning calls, understand event requirements, and translate client needs into actionable warehouse instructions. Proactively communicate shipment status, identify potential issues early, and determine when problems can be resolved independently versus escalated. Build strong client relationships through confident, patient, professional, and solution-oriented communication. Anticipate on-site requirements, including tools, backup materials, assembly considerations, and other production needs based on field experience. Oversee event kit preparation, packing, and quality control for displays, branded elements, and activation materials. Ensure kits contain all required components and are correctly labeled, organized, and prepared for their specific event environment. Direct warehouse team members during daily kit assembly while following pull lists, pack lists, and established procedures. Manage inventory, orders, and asset records within operational systems and flag replenishment or lifecycle requirements. Collaborate with event production, operations, and client teams to coordinate program planning and execution. Create and maintain documentation for recurring event programs and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce errors. Use Google Workspace and warehouse management systems to manage information, workflows, and program documentation. Support successful delivery by maintaining clear communication between warehouse teams, production teams, clients, and other stakeholders. Requirements 2–5 years of experience in event production, trade show coordination, experiential marketing, or a closely related field. Hands-on experience setting up brand activations, trade show booths, experiential programs, or similar live events. Practical production and field experience, including physically assembling displays, managing event assets, and working under time pressure. Hands-on warehouse experience and comfort working directly with equipment and physical event assets. Experience managing client relationships, particularly with clients who may provide changing requirements, late decisions, or incomplete information. Strong ability to remain calm, organized, and solutions-focused when timelines are compressed or plans change unexpectedly. Experience owning inventory, orders, and asset records within a dedicated operational or warehouse management system. Experience with scenic and fabricated assets, including intake, installation, management, and lifecycle considerations; experience with multi-piece asset collections is valuable. Strong understanding of event production terminology and equipment, including tension fabric displays, modular exhibits, retractable banners, and activation elements. Understanding of event logistics such as load-in/load-out, venue shipping, drayage, advance warehouses, and different requirements across festivals, controlled venues, and retail activations. Ability to anticipate operational issues based on real-world event and field experience. Strong client communication skills, with a professional and confident approach in meetings, calls, and written communications. Creative and practical problem-solving skills, with a focus on finding workable solutions rather than dwelling on obstacles. Strong judgment regarding when to resolve an issue independently and when to escalate it to leadership. Strong follow-through, ownership, attention to detail, and schedule awareness. Comfortable using Google Workspace, including Sheets, Docs, and Drive. Technologically capable and able to quickly learn warehouse management, shipping, and other operational platforms. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple concurrent programs without losing track of details. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, changing environment while maintaining a high level of professionalism and composure. Willingness to be hands-on and travel frequently to the warehouse facility in Charlotte, NC, with occasional travel to client or vendor sites. Collaborative, empathetic, adaptable, and improvement-oriented approach to working with colleagues and clients. Ability to contribute to a team culture built around collaboration, high standards, smarter processes, inclusivity, transparency, and exceptional client outcomes. Benefits Compensation of $60,000–$75,000 , depending on experience. Fully remote work arrangement within the United States. Initial three-month freelance contract with potential to extend into a full-time employee role based on fit and business needs. Clear potential career path toward project management, production management, and operations leadership as programs scale. Opportunity to build operational systems and processes for a growing events and merchandise division. Cross-functional exposure to creative agency production, event operations, logistics, and client management. Opportunity to support high-profile programs for major technology, entertainment, and consumer brands. Small, collaborative team environment with direct access to leadership. Frequent travel to the warehouse facility in Charlotte, North Carolina. Occasional travel to client sites or vendor facilities. Standard business hours with occasional flexibility required to accommodate event timelines. Opportunity to develop specialized expertise in event logistics, production operations, and experiential programs. You’ll establish practical standards for data classification, ownership, access, quality, and protection across lakehouse, analytics, and internal data products. Manage and develop our editorial team (one full-time writer, one part-time contractor) and coordinate ad-hoc video content with a contractor. Partner closely with the Head of Marketing on shared website acquisition goals: present priorities and rationale, manage work in Notion, and turn performance data into strategy. Title: Senior Technical Program Manager
Description: Kapta Space, a VC-funded early-stage startup in Seattle, WA, is breaking new ground in Geospatial Intelligence. Our technology centers around a proven, scalable electronically-steered radar for sophisticated spaceborne applications such as earth observation using synthetic aperture radar (SAR) techniques, as well as enabling advanced defense missions such as target tracking on the ground and in the air. Role Develop and maintain an integrated program schedule with measurable milestones across design, fabrication, integration and test phases. Own program-level cost, schedule and risk metrics; report status, variances, and recovery plans to leadership and government customers. Drive cross functional execution across Engineering to remove day-to-day execution obstacles. Maintain program risk register and other program specific documentation; identify, escalate and drive risks to closure. Support configuration management activities in coordination with engineering and quality. Proactively collaborate with supply chain on long-lead procurement, supplier qualification, and component availability tied to program milestones. Support radiation qualification and phased test campaign planning as applicable to hardware programs. Support engagement with customers, suppliers, and subcontractors throughout the product development life cycle. Own contract data deliverables (CDRLs) and government reporting requirements for currently funded efforts. Communicate technical and programmatic progress clearly to internal leadership and external government stakeholders. Contribute to proposal development, technical volumes, and program planning for future opportunities. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Physics or related technical discipline. PMP or equivalent program/project management certification. 8-10 years of direct experience in technical program/project management on hardware development programs, ideally in aerospace, defense or space systems. Demonstrated ability to manage complex, multidisciplinary programs (electrical, mechanical, RF and/or software) through full lifecycle: design, integration, test, delivery. Experience with schedule and risk management tools (Smartsheet, JIRA, or similar). Familiarity with US Government contracting environments (FAR/DFARS, OTA). Strong written and verbal communication skills, with ability to present to both engineering teams and executive/external audiences. Demonstrated understanding of program planning, budget control, schedule execution, risk management, and cross-functional resource management. Excellent communication skills, with ability to clearly present technical findings and collaborate effectibely across engineering functions. Bonus if candidates have experience and skills in the following areas: Prior work in small, fast-iteration aerospace teams. Familiarity with space-qualified component engineering, radiation-tolerant design trade-offs and COTS-to-space conversion strategies. Title: Director, Program Management
Description: We are seeking an experienced, driven, and collaborative Director of Program Management to lead the execution of complex, cross-functional client programs in the development and GMP manufacturing of cell and gene therapies. This leader will be responsible for driving program success across multiple client engagements and ensuring alignment with strategic and operational goals. Responsibilities Lead and oversee multiple complex, cross-functional client programs from contract award through closure, ensuring on-time, on-budget, and on-scope delivery. Lead program steering committees and governance forums; prepare executive-level presentations and reports for internal and client leadership. Champion process improvements, lead root-cause analyses for program deviations, and contribute to organizational learning and maturity. Qualifications BA/BS degree in a relevant field required; advanced degree (MS, MBA, PhD) is a plus. 10+ years of program or project management experience in life sciences, with at least 5 years leading cross-functional programs in GMP manufacturing of cell, gene, or biologic therapies. Deep understanding of GMP principles and regulated development environments. PMP certification or equivalent is preferred. Strong knowledge of project management tools and systems, including Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, and PowerPoint. Demonstrated financial acumen, including budget tracking and change order management. Experience working in a matrixed, fast-paced, and early-stage environment is a plus. Ideal Candidate Attributes: Strategic thinker with excellent execution discipline Exceptional communicator and relationship builder High emotional intelligence and leadership presence Comfortable with ambiguity, change, and problem-solving Passionate about improving human health through scientific innovation Landmark Bio is dedicated to translating cutting-edge research into life-changing therapies.
