Title: Technical Content Writer
Description: Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm. Most modernization work doesn't ship, it stalls in pilots, slips a year, or lands at three times the budget. We exist to ship it: production systems running, legacy retired, outcomes measured. Our delivery is built on Aedeon, the agent platform built by Mactores' founders' sister company, which absorbs the repetitive 60–70% of engagement work, discovery, dependency mapping, validation, test generation, that traditional consulting bills human hours against. Forward-deployed engineers own the rest: architecture, judgment, and cutover, on dates we commit to in the contract. Mactores has 21 public case studies and 200+ published blogs. Most consultancy content sounds the same — capability lists, stacked adjectives, claims without baselines. Ours can't. Our positioning voice is flat, declarative, and engineering-led: pain named before capability, numbers with baselines, one contrarian claim per piece that a sharp reader would bookmark. Writing in that voice, at L300/L400 technical depth, for US B2B buyers — that's this job. As our Technical Content Writer, you'll turn complex cloud and data engineering work Apache Iceberg lakehouses, Oracle-to-Aurora migrations, Spark optimization, cloud-native DataOps into deeply technical, visually sharp content that ranks, resonates, and drives enterprise pipeline in the US market. This is not a generalist writing role. You'll go deep technically, and you'll bring marketing judgment to everything you produce: a piece has to land with a data engineer, an IT director, and a CFO evaluating cloud ROI without being rewritten for each. You'll own content from research through publication long-form blogs, whitepapers, case studies, social copy, and the diagrams that make the argument legible. What you will do? Write and ship technical content Research, write, and publish L300/L400-level technical blogs, deep-dive articles, whitepapers, case studies, and solution briefs across AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, and Azure. Turn complex architectural work Iceberg lakehouses, Oracle-to-Aurora migrations, Spark optimization, cloud-native DataOps into structured, accurate, engaging long-form content. Produce both long-form and short-form independently blog posts, tutorials, solution walkthroughs, comparison guides, newsletters, LinkedIn posts, marketing copy without editorial hand-holding. Work closely with solution architects, data engineers, and SMEs to validate technical accuracy and pull out implementation-level insight the reader can't get elsewhere. Make it visual Design and produce the visual assets that carry the writing: custom diagrams, architecture illustrations, infographics, social graphics, data visualizations. Use Canva, Figma, Adobe Express, or equivalent to independently create polished, on-brand visuals that make complex topics immediately digestible. Build graphic-rich formats — one-pagers, solution briefs, visual explainers — optimized for US B2B audiences across digital and print channels. Apply visual storytelling so technical content travels on LinkedIn and partner platforms. Write for the buyer who's actually reading Write with a clear understanding of US B2B buyer behavior, content expectations, and purchasing patterns — from practitioner to VP to C-suite. Adapt tone, format, and messaging by segment, so the same engagement story lands with a data engineer, an IT director, or a CFO. Contribute to co-branded content with AWS, Snowflake, and Databricks — blogs, webinars, roadshow materials aligned with US go-to-market priorities. Repurpose long-form content into social-ready formats for LinkedIn, newsletters, and partner channels, tuned for the US audience. Use AI as a force multiplier Actively use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grammarly, and others) to accelerate research, drafting, editing, and ideation. Apply AI tools to improve structure, readability, and technical depth — a multiplier for quality and velocity, not a substitute for expertise. Stay current with AI content tooling and keep folding better tools and workflows into your process. Own SEO and performance Own the SEO strategy for all published content: keyword research, search intent mapping, on-page optimization, internal linking, meta descriptions, structured data. Use Ahrefs, SEMrush, Google Search Console, or Surfer SEO to find content opportunities, track rankings, and optimize existing content. Write content that holds technical authority and still ranks for the high-intent, long-tail queries US engineers and architects actually search. Run regular content audits and refreshes so published pieces stay current with platform features and industry shifts. Optimize for featured snippets, People Also Ask, and rich results where applicable. Track performance — organic traffic, time on page, conversions, backlinks — and use the data to sharpen the content strategy. What are we looking for? 4+ years creating technical content in the cloud, data engineering, or analytics domain, with a portfolio that shows both technical depth and marketing polish. Demonstrated L300/L400 writing ability comfortable with distributed query optimization, schema evolution in Iceberg, PL/SQL-to-PostgreSQL conversion, or Spark-on-EMR tuning without significant guidance from engineers. Excellent written English for a US B2B audience American business communication norms, tone, and content expectations. A proven record of producing long-form and short-form content across formats without extensive editorial support. Hands-on experience creating graphic-rich content infographics, diagrams, social assets, visual explainers — with design tools. Working knowledge of at least two of: AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, Azure. Strong SEO fundamentals: keyword research, on-page SEO, content architecture, backlink strategy, performance tracking. Proficiency with AI writing and productivity tools, and a demonstrated habit of using them to raise quality and output. Experience with a CMS platform (HubSpot, WordPress, or equivalent). A marketing-focused background formal education or equivalent experience in Marketing, Communications, or a related field is preferred. You'll be preferred if A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field Certification in one or more of: AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, or Azure Certification or coursework in Technical Writing or Content Strategy Experience writing content for an AWS Partner, ISV, or cloud consultancy targeting the US market Familiarity with Apache Iceberg, Apache Spark, dbt, Kafka, or similar open-source data technologies Experience contributing to or ghostwriting for AWS blogs, Databricks blog, or Snowflake Medium publications Working knowledge of HTML/Markdown for CMS publishing Demonstrated understanding of US B2B advertising norms, including familiarity with how US enterprise buyers consume and evaluate technical content How we work? You'll write from shipped work, not abstractions. Our engineers land real migrations with named customers and measurable outcomes, and Aedeon-driven delivery gives you material most content teams never get: agents absorbing 60–70% of engagement hours versus a traditional consulting proposal of equivalent scope, cutovers on committed dates, legacy actually retired. Your job is quality uplift, not volume every piece opinionated, data-led, written for one buyer reading alone, and carrying a claim with a baseline. You'll use AI tools the way our engineers use agents: to absorb the repetitive work so your hours go to the judgment. Life at Mactores We care about creating a culture that makes a real difference in the lives of every Mactorian. Our 10 Core Leadership Principles that honor Decision-making, Leadership, Collaboration, and Curiosity drive how we work. 1. Be one step ahead 2. Deliver the best 3. Be bold 4. Pay attention to the detail 5. Enjoy the challenge 6. Be curious and take action 7. Take leadership 8. Own it 9. Deliver value 10. Title: AI Developer Experience
Description: About Mashgin Mashgin powers the world's best checkout experience for over 40 million users. Customers just place their items on our kiosks and our AI rings up their entire order in less than a second. With Mashgin, lines are now optional. Mashgin's technology powers over 1 billion transactions at your favorite locations, including over half of all US professional sports teams, 4,000 convenience stores, major airports, universities, and more. We’re not just building cutting-edge AI—we’re creating real-world impact and unforgettable experiences. Backed by a well-funded Series B, we’re also one of the rare AI startups that’s already profitable. Our secret? A culture of extreme ownership, autonomy, and customer obsession. At Mashgin, we are building something extraordinary by challenging conventional wisdom. We’ve thrown out the old rules to focus on what truly matters: creating a kickass product that makes people say, 'Wow'. We don’t care about short-term wins; we build systems that stand the test of time. If you thrive in a culture of excellence without compromise and want to see your work have an immediate, remarkable impact, you’re in the right place. Position Summary We are looking for a developer-centric AI Engineer to join us in revolutionizing how we build software. You will be responsible for building the "engine that drives the engineers." By leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) and intelligent automation, your goal is to make our engineering team 10x more productive. This is not a traditional "research" role. This is a highly technical, hands-on, execution-oriented position where you will build production-grade tools that integrate directly into our development and production lifecycle—from automated code reviews, intelligent documentation, and context-aware debugging. We maintain a flat, high-impact engineering culture where every engineer who joins our team carries the title of Member of Technical Staff. What We Value: Impact : You will own significant responsibility and have total ownership over your work. We stay lean and efficient, so your work directly impacts the product we ship every day. Simplicity : Complexity is a waste of time here—we take pride in building things that just work. Hard Work : Forget the glamorous research papers. We prioritize the hard work it takes to achieve real-world clarity and accuracy. You will innovate relentlessly to push the boundaries of what’s possible in visual automation. Humility : No task is beneath you. Whether it's high-level architecture or grunt work to fix a bug, we check our egos at the door and get real work done. Ruthless Prioritization : If everything is on fire, nothing is. You will be expected to prioritize ruthlessly, cutting through distractions to focus on the most impactful product improvements. Customer Innovation : We are customer-centric, not customer-pleasing. You won’t bend to every client demand; you will let innovation drive the product forward to solve the real problems our users face. Efficiency : Meetings suck. We keep them short and only use them for alignment, giving you your time back to focus on real work. You Will Be Owning Developer Productivity: Identifying bottlenecks in the Mashgin engineering workflow and architecting LLM-powered solutions to eliminate them. Interviewing engineers to understand their current process and accelerating them 10x. Building Intelligent Tooling: Implementing 0-to-1 systems for automated code refactoring, test generation, and context-aware documentation. Bridging Infrastructure and AI: Architecting and deploying LLM-powered services using both commercial APIs (like Claude) and open-source models. Scaling Workflows: Rethinking and recreating existing internal CI/CD and build processes to integrate AI-driven bug detection and security vulnerability assessments. Prototyping & Shipping: Building simple MVPs of developer tools and shipping them quickly to the team for immediate feedback and iteration. Minimum Qualifications 6+ years relevant coding experience B.S. or higher in Computer Science (or equivalent work experience) Excellent knowledge of one or more of these languages: Python, Node.js , C++, Go, C#, Java Comfortable learning new languages, libraries, and frameworks when the solution calls for it Experience building production-ready code that’s used regularly by lots of people Preferred Qualifications Experience with LSPs (Language Server Protocols) and IDE integration Experience managing and optimizing large monolithic repositories, including build systems and version control workflows Strong proficiency with SQL and database technologies Knowledge of cloud infrastructure (AWS, Terraform, or similar) What We Offer An opportunity to work on a small, multidisciplinary team with the potential to break new ground in many different industries Excellent health, dental and vision insurance for you and your dependents 401k plan Flexible PTO policy Catered lunch in office with fully stocked snacks and beverages Pet insurance for your fur babies Voluntary life insurance plan Competitive salary and options in a small, rapidly scaling company Mashgin is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Individuals seeking employment at Mashgin are considered without regards to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation. Notice on fraudulent jobs We have been made aware of instances of fraudulent job postings and/or fraudulent recruiting activity by bad actors, claiming to represent Mashgin. These fraudulent schemes often seek monetary contributions or payments from job seekers (such as for "start up costs" or "equipment"), or seek to collect sensitive personal or banking information from job seekers. These job postings and offers are not authorized by Mashgin, and Mashgin is not responsible for fraudulent offers or requests for personal information or payments. Mashgin will never ask for any financial commitment or contribution from a candidate at any stage of the recruitment process. Candidates who have questions about the validity of Mashgin job postings or offers should consult the job postings on our mashgin.com career site. If you think you've been scammed, please reference this site for more information.

Title: Sr. Content Marketing Manager - Industrial (B2B)
Description: Intelligence Center X is Siemens Digital Industries Software's agentic enterprise system, empowering companies to embed agents alongside people with the context, intelligence, orchestration and governance they need to deliver AI-driven business impact. Siemens Digital Industries Software helps organizations of all sizes digitally transform using software, hardware and services from the Siemens Xcelerator business platform. Siemens' software and the comprehensive digital twin enable companies to optimize their design, engineering and manufacturing processes to turn today's ideas into the sustainable products of the future. From chips to entire systems, from product to process, across all industries. Senior Content Marketing Manager – Industrial B2B Siemens Digital Industries Software is looking for a Senior Content Marketing Manager who specializes in marketing to complex, engineering-driven industrial sectors – and lives at the intersection of technical depth and compelling storytelling. We’re looking for someone who has built content programs that speak to these industries’ buyers. You will lead and manage the production of content that earns the trust of an executive level audience, that translates complex concepts into narratives that drive awareness, pipeline, and product adoption. You'll be building category-defining content: SME-driven insight pieces, research-backed reports, practitioner guides, webinars, and executive thought leadership. To be successful in this role, you should be curious, resourceful, process and outcome oriented, and eager to stay ahead of the market to make sure what we publish resonates and leads. What You'll Do Content Manage content across blogs/articles, long-form, video scripts, webinars, and social snippets tied to product capabilities, use cases, pipeline goals, and audience segments, including how-to guides, reports, solution briefs and white papers Manage relationships with freelance writers and agencies, ensuring quality and consistency across contributors Develop thought leadership programs for company executives, including ghostwriting, podcast prep, and byline articles for industry publications Partner with cross-functional marketing teams to translate positioning into always-on content programs that span the full buyer journey Collaborate with subject matter experts (customers, product managers, data scientists, developers, etc.) to produce accurate, credible, practitioner-grade content Identify content gaps by analyzing search intent, competitive coverage, analyst reports, and field feedback from sales Lead a scalable content framework that can support multiple technical personas Own the content repurposing motion: adapting high-performing assets across formats and channels to maximize the reach and shelf-life of every content piece produced SEO & Distribution Support the development of organic content strategy: keyword research, topic clustering, and on-page optimization, with a focus on high-intent, bottom-of-funnel terms Partner with demand gen to integrate content into nurture tracks, paid amplification, and ABM programs Lead content distribution across owned channels (blog, newsletter, developer hub) and earned channels (syndication, guest posts, community forums) Ensure content is discoverable and well-positioned across both traditional search and AI-driven search/answer engines, adapting strategy as the discovery landscape evolves Measurement & Optimization Track content KPIs: organic traffic, engagement, MQL contribution, pipeline influence, and content-assisted revenue Contribute to regular content audits; prune, update, and consolidate underperforming assets to protect domain authority A/B test headlines, CTAs, and formats; use data to iterate quickly and scale what works Cross-Functional Collaboration Serve as the content partner for product launches: owning the blog post, the launch email, the release notes narrative, and the sales one-pager Enable the sales team with content that maps to objection-handling moments, competitive comparisons, and proof points Coordinate with developer relations and community teams to amplify practitioner-generated content and surface customer stories What We're Looking For Required 7+ years of B2B content marketing experience, with at least 2 years Exceptional writing and editing skills. You can go deep on a technical topic and still make it readable for a VP Demonstrated ability to translate complex, highly technical concepts (data pipelines, cloud architecture, observability, security posture) into clear, compelling narratives Strong grasp of SEO fundamentals and experience driving measurable organic growth Proven track record collaborating with product marketing, PMMs, and engineers to ship accurate content on time Familiarity with the modern data stack or cloud security landscape (e.g. you know what a data lakehouse is) Preferred Experience marketing to developer, practitioner, or highly technical audiences at scale Hands-on experience with tools like Salesforce, Marketo, Ahrefs/SEMrush, and CMS platforms (WordPress) Portfolio of published technical content (e.g. long-form guides, whitepapers, or bylines in industry publications) Strongly process-oriented; comfortable both following established workflows and building new ones; fluent with AI writing and research tools, and experience using AI to automate workflows

Title: PR & Content Manager
Description: Merkle Science provides blockchain transaction monitoring and intelligence solutions for web3 companies, digital asset service providers, financial institutions, law enforcement and government agencies to detect, investigate and prevent illicit use of cryptocurrencies. Our vision is to make cryptocurrencies safe and provide infrastructure for the safe and compliant growth of cryptocurrencies. Merkle Science is headquartered in New York with offices in Singapore, Bangalore and London. The team has combined experience across Bank of America, Paypal, Luno, Thomson Reuters and Amazon. The company has raised over US$27 MM from SIG, Beco, Republic, DCG, Kenetic, GGV and several others. Merkle Science is seeking a dynamic Content and PR Lead to join our growing team. The ideal candidate will be a seasoned professional with a proven track record in developing and executing successful content marketing and public relations strategies. As the Content and PR Lead, you will play a crucial role in shaping and communicating Merkle Science's narrative, building brand awareness, and establishing thought leadership in the blockchain and cryptocurrency space. Responsibilities: Content Strategy and Development: ● Develop and execute a comprehensive content strategy aligned with Merkle Science's business goals. ● Create engaging and informative content, including blog posts, whitepapers, case studies, and other collateral, showcasing our expertise in blockchain analytics and compliance. ● Collaborate with subject matter experts and stakeholders to gather insights and technical details for content creation. ● Ensure consistency in messaging and branding across all content channels ● Build brand messaging and guidelines Public Relations: ● Develop and implement a strategic PR plan to enhance Merkle Science's visibility and reputation in the market ● Work closely with regulatory affairs leads and PR agency to execute campaigns ● Cultivate and maintain relationships with key media outlets, journalists, and industry influencers. ● Draft and edit press releases, media pitches, and other PR materials to communicate key announcements and milestones. ● Monitor and analyze media coverage, providing insights and recommendations for continuous improvement. Social Media Management: ● Oversee Merkle Science's social media presence, ensuring regular and engaging content across platforms. ● Collaborate with the marketing team to amplify content through social media channels and enhance brand awareness. ● Monitor social media trends and industry conversations to identify opportunities for engagement. Event Management: ● Coordinate Merkle Science's participation in industry conferences, webinars, and events to maximize brand exposure. ● Develop and manage event-related content and collateral ● Work closely with internal teams to ensure a seamless and impactful presence at events. Qualifications: ● Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, or a related field. ● Proven experience in content creation, PR, and social media management, preferably in the blockchain or fintech industry. ● Demonstrated success in executing PR campaigns and securing media coverage. ❤️ Well Being, Compensation and Benefits We care about your well-being. Along with excellent health insurance, we offer flexible time off, learning & development initiatives and hours that are designed to provide work/life balance. We regularly host team-building sessions and encourage discussions around mental health. We reward talent and believe in acknowledging people for their contributions. We offer industry-leading compensation, along with generous equity. As a rapidly growing business, there are endless opportunities to grow your career with Merkle Science.

Title: Content Marketing Manager
Description: At Mitek, content is how we earn trust and drive engagement. We showcase our expertise through blogs, white papers, and video content that resonate with our customers. We're looking for a detail-oriented Content Marketing Manager to own our editorial agenda from end to end: directing external writers and video partners, shaping their work into polished, on-brand assets, and taking full ownership of our YouTube channel. What You'll Do (Essential Responsibilities) Content Strategy & Topic Planning Set the editorial agenda: Work with the marketing team to set content topics and priorities across blogs, white papers, videos, and social, and maintain the editorial calendar. Managing & Edit Written Content (Blogs & White Papers) Manage external content writers: Brief, schedule, and manage writers for blogs and white papers. Edit for quality & SEO: Edit drafts for accuracy, voice, and on-page SEO best practices before publishing. T his role edits far more than it writes. Publish: Finalize and publish content on schedule. Manage Production & the YouTube Channel (Video) Manage external video firm: Brief concepts and scripts, coordinate shoots, and review cuts for quality and brand fit. Own the YouTube Channel: Manage the channel's branding, content mix, and publishing cadence, including ongoing upkeep which includes removing or refreshing outdated content to keep the channel current and on-brand . Collaboration & Planning Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with the SEO Manager on keyword-informed topics, and with demand, web, creative, and product marketing on messaging and priorities. Annual planning: Contribute content performance and topic insights to annual and quarterly marketing planning. Ideal Candidate A meticulous, detail-oriented editor and content strategist who is skilled at shaping others' drafts into polished, on-brand assets. This role edits far more than it writes, and no writing portfolio is required. Strong project and vendor management skills , comfortable directing outside writers, video firms, or agencies to stay on brief, on brand, and on schedule. An eye for brand and video presentation, with the judgment to shape a YouTube channel's look, feel, and content mix. Working knowledge of SEO fundamentals, enough to edit content well and collaborate effectively with the team. Excellent communication skills and a proactive attitude — comfortable owning a program end to end with minimal oversight. Who You Are (Soft Skills and Attributes) Detail-oriented: you catch what others skim past. A proactive, organized self-starter who keeps vendors and partners aligned and on schedule . A clear communicator who collaborates easily across teams. Adaptable and eager to learn in a fast-changing content landscape. What You Need (Education, Experience, Knowledge, Technical Skills and Abilities) Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or related field, or equivalent experience. 3–5 years in content marketing or editing. Strong editing skills. Experience managing external writers, video firms, or agencies. Working knowledge of SEO/on-page optimization fundamentals. Experience managing a YouTube or similar video platform presence. Strong written communication skills, with close attention to detail. Ability to manage multiple projects, vendors, and priorities in a fast-paced environment. What Would Be Nice (Preferred Skills & Experience) Exposure to AEO/GEO concepts and how content surfaces in AI search platforms. Basic familiarity with video editing concepts/software. Experience with Webflow or a comparable CMS. Industry experience: familiarity with identity verification, fraud prevention, or trust & safety.

Title: Clinical Quality & Compliance Program Manager
Description: Who We Are Novir is an emerging diagnostic biotechnology company with an unmatched team of professionals and trusted partners delivering smart, fast and flexible testing solutions supported by reliable, cost-effective screening products and best-in-class technology. Our Values Care for Tomorrow. Create a lasting, positive difference in the lives of others. Serve people with compassion and understanding. Recognize what truly matters and center every action around meeting the needs of our community both now and into the future. Delight our Customers. Appreciate every interaction with our customers and find ways to bring them joy. See through the Customer’s eyes, understand and anticipate their needs to consistently deliver solutions exceeding their expectations. Be Bold – Say It. Be direct and open. Speak with honesty and courage, and respect others for doing the same. Say what you think, embrace passionate debate, and always bring the issue to the table. Communicate with confidence. Bring Your Best Self. Show up and be authentic. Utilize your greatest strengths and stay true to who you are. Bring positive energy, be genuine in your approach, and continually seek ways to grow. Be uncompromisingly you. Innovate Relentlessly. Explore new possibilities and be willing to take a risk. Challenge status quo. Try new ideas, learn from mistakes, and rally the team to raise the bar. What You'll Do: Lead and support clinical quality, compliance, and risk management initiatives across the organization Develop and maintain standardized onboarding, education, and competency programs for clinical staff Oversee quality assurance activities including documentation audits, corrective action planning, and continuous improvement initiatives Support regulatory readiness and ensure compliance with HIPAA, CDC, state immunization, and customer requirements Manage registry and EMR governance, including access oversight, documentation integrity, and workflow standardization Analyze operational and quality data to identify trends, support reporting, and provide actionable insights to leadership Partner with operations and clinical leadership on vaccine program implementation, process improvement, and operational readiness Assist with policy development, program standardization, and scalable clinical infrastructure initiatives Key Qualifications We're Looking For: RN required; healthcare administration or clinical operations experience preferred Experience in healthcare quality, compliance, clinical operations, education, or program management Knowledge of immunization programs, EMRs, HIPAA, and regulatory requirements Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment Experience developing workflows, policies, and training materials preferred Preferred Experience Multi-state healthcare operations Vaccine or immunization program management Long-term care, senior living, or onsite healthcare services Audit, accreditation, or compliance support What Success Looks Like: Improved compliance and audit readiness Standardized onboarding and competency validation Improved quality oversight and documentation consistency Increased visibility into operational and quality metrics Stronger clinical infrastructure to support scalable growth Perks of Working @ Novir Competitive total compensation offerings Generous paid time off policy Medical, dental, and vision insurance, some of which is covered by the company Company provided Disability and Life Insurance Opportunity to build something incredible while being surrounded by intelligent, hardworking and motivated coworkers Novir is a fast-growing startup with a work hard, play hard attitude. We look for smart, motivated individuals who are excited to build something incredible from the ground up!

Title: Technical Program Manager - US Government
Description: A World-Changing Company Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more. The Role As a Technical Program Manager (TPM), you serve as a technical, external-facing program lead responsible for connecting our internal teams with government program offices, implementation teams and industry partners. You act as a trusted representative with the customer, ensuring our capabilities, priorities and business interests are clearly understood and appropriately prioritized across the broader program. This position requires a combination of project management, process optimization, technical proficiency and execution skills. You are a person who loves fixing problems, scaling technical solutions, and always embraces the best idea, even when it is not your own. Core Responsibilities Develop, maintain and drive execution against integrated master scheduled, requirements documentation, capability briefs and other core program artifacts Translate technical capabilities and implementation progress into concise, decision-oriented briefs for customers, partners and senior leaders Synthesize concrete technical goals from product vision, mapping global product strategy to granular team tasks and issues. This means triaging requests from the field to create maximum focus for the team, while escalating items that need immediate attention. Keep broad and complete state of everything involving or related to your projects. Pre-empt and resolve any issues that may steer projects off-course. Enhance cross-team collaboration. Read a room of technical experts to align them around shared objectives. Improve efficiency where you see miscommunication or lack of coordination. Navigate complex, multi-party program dynamics and proactively identify opportunities to strengthen our position and increase impact with the customer What We Value Demonstrated success managing complex software development projects for an enterprise software company or startup Prior missile or missile defense experience, with experience supporting the Missile Defense Agency strongly preferred An ability to engage in technical discussion and invest in learning technical concepts Excellent judgment and composure in high-pressure situations A creative approach to project management centered around lightweight frameworks that enable rapid iteration, while operating in harmony with a larger development organization An ability to develop strong relationship with customer-facing teams and a high level of empathy with our end-users’ needs Meticulous attention to detail, including holding tightly to your team’s vision and maintaining a high product quality bar Ability to travel up to 75% based on program and customer needs What We Require 2+ years of relevant industry experience, preferably supporting complex government, defense, aerospace or national security programs Active Secret clearance at minimum, TS/SCI strongly preferred Salary The salary range for this position is estimated to be $93,000 - $160,000/year. Total compensation for this position may also include Restricted Stock units, sign-on bonus and other potential future incentives. Further note that total compensation for this position will be determined by each individual's relevant qualifications, work experience, skills, and other factors. This estimate excludes the value of any potential sign-on bonus; the value of any benefits offered; and the potential future value of any long-term incentives. Our benefits aim to promote health and wellbeing across all areas of Palantirians’ lives. We work to continuously improve our offerings and listen to our community as we design and update them. The list below details our available benefits and some of the perks that can be enjoyed as an employee of Palantir Technologies. Benefits • Employees (and their eligible dependents) can enroll in medical, dental, and vision insurance as well as voluntary life insurance • Employees are automatically covered by Palantir’s basic life, AD&D and disability insurance • Commuter benefits • Relocation assistance • Take what you need paid time off, not accrual based • 2 weeks paid time off built into the end of each year (subject to team and business needs) • 10 paid holidays throughout the calendar year • Supportive leave of absence program including time off for military service and medical events • Paid leave for new parents and subsidized back-up care for all parents • Fertility and family building benefits including but not limited to adoption, surrogacy, and preservation • Stipend to help with expenses that come with a new child • Employees can enroll in Palantir’s 401k plan Life at Palantir We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region. In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the state in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office. If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer for all, including but not limited to Veterans and those with disabilities. Palantir is committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process, please reach out and let us know how we can help. Please note that you will never be asked to submit a payment or share financial information to participate in our interview process. If you suspect that you've been contacted by a scammer, we recommend you cease all communication with the individual and consider reporting them to the relevant authorities, such as the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3). If you would like to understand more about how your personal data will be processed by Palantir, please see our Privacy Policy.

Within 1 Year: You will have established a high-performing Higher Education demand engine that consistently meets annual pipeline, win-rate, and ROI benchmarks. Your Legacy: You will have built the vertical campaign framework and data model the team uses as the blueprint for GTM execution across all markets. Values in Action Customer First, Always: You proactively surface friction points in the customer experience before they are escalated — and propose solutions, not just reports. Thrive Together: You share work-in-progress for early feedback, knowing that challenge improves the outcome. You separate critiques of ideas from critiques of people. Elevate the Craft: You hold the bar high on your own work and invest in developing those around you. You treat every project as an opportunity to learn something new. Clarity Over Complexity: You default to the simpler solution. Your written communication — internal or external — is direct, specific, and free of filler. The team partners closely with Product Marketing, Sales, and Marketing Operations to design campaigns that connect Panopto’s unique value with the needs of our audiences in the corporate and higher education markets. We value curiosity, accountability, and collaboration — and we believe in challenging ideas, not people. Cross-Functional Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional working groups, influence stakeholders, and direct agency partners without direct authority. Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) Panopto AI Use Policy: Panopto’s AI Use Policy is committed to a hiring process that is thoughtful, fair, and centered on human connection. As artificial intelligence (AI) becomes more prevalent in the workplace, we believe that it is important to describe our use of AI in the hiring process, as well as outline to candidates what use of AI is and is not allowed. While AI can be a valuable tool, it cannot replace genuine human interaction or an individual’s unique perspective, experience, and voice. Company Use of AI: Panopto may utilize tools to enhance the efficiency, objectivity, and quality of our recruitment and evaluation process. These tools assist our team throughout the hiring lifecycle by focusing on four key areas: Content Creation: Providing a starting point for crafting job descriptions and assisting in building tailored interview questions. Resume Parsing: Analyzing candidate skillsets and resume alignment to efficiently identify qualified candidates. Interview & Assessment Insights: Providing interview transcription, summarization, and identifying key insights from candidate assessments in relation to specific role requirements. Data Organization: Organizing and storing information gathered during assessments to help our team make informed, data-driven decisions. Ultimately, these tools are used to support—not replace—our team in assessing skills, generating insights, and identifying the best talent for Panopto. To ensure fairness and transparency: Human-Centric Decisions: Please be assured that AI tools are used to support our team, and all final hiring decisions are made by human reviewers. Panopto hiring teams will thoroughly review your application and assessment results. AI is not used to make final decisions regarding your candidacy. Bias Mitigation: We are committed to algorithmic fairness. Our AI-assisted tools undergo regular independent audits to detect and mitigate bias, with the goal of keeping our processes equitable and inclusive. Our methodology aligns with global best practices and regional digital ethics standards to provide every candidate with a fair and merit-based evaluation. Your Rights & Accommodations: We provide inclusive access for all applicants. If you require a reasonable adjustment due to a disability, or if you prefer a non-automated review of your application, please contact Panopto Talent Attraction. We respect your right to request human intervention; please note that opting for a manual review may impact the standard processing timeline. Data Privacy and Security: Your personal data and recordings are processed securely in compliance with global privacy and employment regulations (including EEOC, GDPR, and other local or regional privacy laws, as applicable). To facilitate our recruitment and evaluation process, limited candidate data may be shared securely with trusted third-party vendors and service providers acting on our behalf. We retain candidate data only as long as necessary to fulfill the recruitment purpose or as required by applicable statutory retention periods. Once this purpose is met, or the retention period expires, your data is securely deleted or anonymized in accordance with our data governance policy. Panopto is dedicated to a fair and equitable hiring process for all candidates. Use of AI: Statement of Transparency: At Panopto, we embrace the transformative power of AI to enhance productivity and learning. We believe in providing a level playing field where candidates can use modern tools to put their best foot forward, provided those tools support, rather than replace, their authentic voice and expertise. While we encourage the use of AI as a tool for growth and preparation, we require transparency and authenticity to ensure a fair evaluation for all. Acceptable Use: AI-Assisted Preparation: You are encouraged to use Generative AI (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini) as a mock interviewer or coach to refine your speaking points. Research & Knowledge Gathering: Using AI to synthesize industry trends or company background is permitted and viewed as proactive preparation. Career Guidance Tools: Simulation tools that help you practice the STAR method or identify skill gaps are acceptable. Prohibited Use: Live Interview Assistance: The use of real-time AI "teleprompters," live answer-generators, or deepfake audio/video during Panopto recordings or live sessions is strictly prohibited. Plagiarized Work Samples: Any take-home assignments or portfolios must be your original work. While AI can assist in formatting or brainstorming, the core logic and execution must be yours. Panopto has a zero-tolerance policy toward the misrepresentation of job-related skills. Consequences of using prohibited tools may result in my immediate disqualification from the hiring process, the withdrawal of any pending offer, or termination of employment if discovered after hire. Verification of Experience: To ensure the integrity of our hiring process and validate the skills demonstrated during your Panopto submission, Panopto may require the following "Proof of Experience": Work Samples & Portfolios: Candidates may be asked to provide original work samples (e.g., code repositories, design portfolios, case studies) that pre-date the current application. Digital Footprint & Professional Links: We may request links to professional profiles (e.g., LinkedIn, GitHub, Behance) to verify career trajectory and industry contributions. Disclosures: Live Validation: Any technical skill demonstrated in an asynchronous Panopto recording is subject to a live, "Human-in-the-Loop" technical assessment or deep-dive discussion. Fraud Detection: Please be aware that we utilize metadata analysis and fraud detection tools to ensure the authenticity of all video submissions. By submitting your application and participating in the recruitment process, you acknowledge and consent to Panopto's use of AI, as well as the acceptable and prohibited uses of AI as a candidate, as described above. Panopto is dedicated to a fair and equitable hiring process for all candidates.

Title: Finance Controls & Governance
Description: Manager – Finance Controls & Governance Location: Mumbai, India Experience: 5–10 Years Qualification: CA / CMA / MBA (Finance) About the Role We are looking for an experienced Finance professional to join our team as Manager – Finance Controls & Governance. This role is responsible for strengthening the Finance control environment by ensuring adherence to internal policies, monitoring financial and system controls, overseeing critical reconciliations, and driving governance across finance processes. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in financial controls, ERP governance, reconciliations, audit management, and process improvement, with the ability to collaborate across Finance, Technology, Compliance, and Operations teams. Key Responsibilities- 1. Financial Controls & Governance Ensure adherence to approved Finance SOPs, policies, and internal control frameworks. Monitor key financial processes to identify control gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities. Conduct periodic control reviews and ensure timely implementation of corrective actions. Drive process standardization, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives. Strengthen governance practices to ensure finance processes remain compliant, efficient, and audit-ready. 2. Reconciliations & Exception Management Oversee critical reconciliations, including: Bank Reconciliations General Ledger (GL) Reconciliations Settlement Accounts Suspense Accounts Monitor ageing of unreconciled items and ensure timely resolution of exceptions. Investigate recurring reconciliation issues and implement preventive controls. Prepare and publish periodic dashboards on reconciliation status, ageing, and control exceptions. 3. SAP & Financial Systems Controls Monitor SAP financial controls, master data governance, and accounting configurations. Review user access, Segregation of Duties (SoD), and maker-checker controls in collaboration with Technology teams. Monitor system interfaces, manual journal entries, reversals, exception reports, and suspense accounts. Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for ERP enhancements and system upgrades. Ensure financial controls remain effective across SAP and other finance systems. 4. Audit, Compliance & Risk Management Perform periodic control testing and compliance reviews. Support Internal Audit, Statutory Audit, and Regulatory inspections by providing required documentation and audit evidence. Track and ensure timely closure of audit observations and control deficiencies. Escalate significant control breaches, operational risks, and compliance issues to management. Maintain complete documentation and audit trails for all key finance control activities. 5. MIS & Cross-functional Collaboration Prepare Finance Control MIS, governance reports, and management dashboards. Coordinate with Treasury, Operations, Compliance, Technology, and Product teams to resolve finance control issues. Support finance transformation initiatives by promoting automation and technology-driven controls. Provide insights and recommendations to enhance operational efficiency and strengthen the overall control environment. Candidate Profile: - Education : Chartered Accountant (CA) Cost & Management Accountant (CMA) MBA (Finance) -Experience : 5–10 years of relevant experience in: Finance Controls Internal Controls Finance Operations Audit ERP Governance Experience in Financial Services, FinTech, Broking, NBFC, or Banking will be preferred. -Success Measures: The successful candidate will be expected to: Achieve 100% adherence to Finance SOPs and internal control processes. Ensure timely completion of critical reconciliations and reduce ageing of outstanding items. Close audit observations and control deficiencies within agreed timelines. Maintain effective SAP access governance, Segregation of Duties (SoD), and system controls. Drive automation initiatives to reduce manual interventions and improve operational efficiency. Deliver accurate and timely Finance Control MIS with zero material control failures. Location - Mumbai, India Candidates based in Mumbai or willing to relocate are encouraged to apply.

Business Requirement & Problem Discovery Work closely with Business and Collections stakeholders to identify operational pain points, automation opportunities, and AI use cases. Conduct requirement-gathering workshops and translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements. Challenge requirements where necessary and bring structure to ambiguous problem statements. BRD, Workflow & Solution Documentation Create and maintain detailed BRDs, functional requirements, user stories, process flows, workflows, and solution documentation. Define end-to-end process journeys, including inputs, outputs, decisioning logic, exceptions, dependencies, and integrations. Convert business requirements into granular user stories with clear acceptance criteria. Ensure documentation remains aligned with the evolving product and technology solution. 3. AI & Automation Program Management Identify and evaluate opportunities to leverage Generative AI, Agentic AI, AI automation, LLMs, and intelligent workflows within lending collections. Work with AI/Tech teams to translate business use cases into viable AI solutions. Understand the capabilities and limitations of AI technologies and challenge proposed solutions constructively. Drive AI initiatives from ideation → requirement → solutioning → development → testing → deployment → adoption → measurement. Track business outcomes and ensure AI initiatives deliver measurable improvements in productivity, collections, customer experience, or operational efficiency. 4. Technology & Engineering Collaboration Act as the bridge between Business/Product and Engineering. Clearly communicate the “what” and “why” behind requirements to technology teams. Break complex requirements into executable user stories and development milestones. Work closely with Engineering, Data, AI/ML, QA, and other technology teams to resolve dependencies and blockers. Ensure the technology team has sufficient clarity to execute without repeated requirement ambiguity. Participate actively in solution discussions, technical walkthroughs, testing, UAT, and production readiness. 5. Program Governance & Execution Own project/program trackers and maintain complete visibility on milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, owners, and timelines. Drive regular governance forums and stakeholder reviews. Proactively identify risks and unblock teams rather than waiting for escalations. Manage cross-functional dependencies across Business, Product, Technology, Data, Operations, and external partners. Drive initiatives firmly towards closure, adoption, and business outcomes. 6. Data & Analytics Should be comfortable using SQL to independently fetch, analyse, and validate data required for product and business decisions. Work with Data/Analytics teams to define data requirements and validate outputs. Use data to size opportunities, validate assumptions, monitor performance, and measure the impact of AI initiatives. Ability to translate data insights into actionable product/program decisions. Must-Have Skills Project / Program Management experience, preferably in FinTech, Lending, Banking, Collections, or Financial Services. Strong understanding of lending and collections processes. Excellent requirement-gathering and stakeholder-management skills. Strong capability to create BRDs, FRDs, workflows, process maps, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Proven ability to drive Technology/Engineering teams and manage delivery end-to-end. Hands-on proficiency with JIRA for backlog, sprint, issue, and project management. Working knowledge of Figma for reviewing/contributing to product flows, wireframes, and user journeys. Strong understanding of AI/GenAI/LLMs/Agentic AI and automation use cases. Working proficiency in SQL for data extraction and analysis. Strong analytical and problem-solving ability. Excellent written and verbal communication. High ownership, strong execution bias, and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguity. Good-to-Have Experience working on AI agents, conversational AI, LLM-powered workflows, RAG, AI copilots, or intelligent automation. Experience integrating AI solutions with existing enterprise systems/APIs. Understanding of collections technology platforms, dialers, CRM, payment systems, customer communication platforms, or workflow engines. Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodologies. Experience managing multiple concurrent AI/product initiatives. Familiarity with AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, or equivalent enterprise AI platforms. Experience defining AI success metrics, evaluation frameworks, and operational KPIs. What Success Looks Like Within this role, the candidate should be able to take a statement such as: “Can we use AI to improve this part of the collections journey?” …and independently drive it through: Business problem → Opportunity sizing → Requirement discovery → BRD → Workflow → AI solution definition → User stories → Tech execution → Testing/UAT → Production → Adoption → Business impact. The right candidate will be someone who doesn't merely maintain a tracker—they own the outcome. Experience 3-4 years of relevant experience in Project/Program Management, Product Management, Business Analysis, or Technology Program Management, with meaningful exposure to FinTech/Lending/Collections and AI/Automation. Education Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, Business, Finance, or a related discipline. MBA/PGDM is a plus. Why Join Us: 1. A collaborative output driven program that brings cohesiveness across businesses through technology 2. Improve the average revenue per use by increasing the cross-sell opportunities 3. A solid 360 feedback from your peer teams on your support of their goals 4. Respect, that is earned, not demanded from your peers and manager Compensation : If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. We help our go-to-market teams ramp faster, adapt quickly, and execute with confidence. Our vision: to enable the most in-demand GTM organization in the world, where top talent comes to do the best work of their careers, and does it. Overseeing the curriculum, attendee experience, and overarching program facilitation of POP - the abbreviation for Pigment Onboarding Program - now sits within GTM Enablement. Recently redesigned from a fragmented, two-tier program into a consistent 3-day, remote-first experience run in parallel for EMEA and NAMER cohorts, POP is a first-class new hire program and one of the most visible expressions of Pigment's culture. The role We're hiring a Global Employee Onboarding, Program Manager to serve as the driving force behind repeatably executing the industry's leading standard for new hire onboarding. This role will operate in close partnership with Pigment's People team, who will largely support from a logistical coordination standpoint. This role sits at the intersection of program operations and culture-building: you'll own the run-of-show for every cohort, keep EMEA and NAMER tracks running comparably and in parallel without collisions, coordinate a roster of internal facilitators, and continuously improve the experience against hard data — satisfaction, session engagement, content engagement, facilitator efficacy, social amplification, and a capstone AI competency assessment across Pigment's agentic tools. What you'll do Own end-to-end delivery of POP for every cohort: scheduling, facilitator coordination, run-of-show management, logistics, and post-session measurement Keep EMEA and NAMER cohorts running in parallel, managing the shared global anchor sessions (Founder Q&A, Closing Circle) and each region's distinct constraints (e.g.: EMEA's sequential regional benefits tracks; NAMER's 8am PST floor) Coordinate in-person exceptions — e.g: R&D/Product new hires and any Paris-local hires attending in Paris — including stakeholder alignment with R&D leadership Manage the facilitator roster and on any one person's institutional knowledge, and close the current gaps in post-onboarding handoff to managers Partner with the People team, GTM leadership, and cross-functional stakeholders (R&D, Legal, Product Marketing, Finance and Professional Services) to keep content current and the program aligned to business priorities Who you'll work with You'll report into GTM Enablement leadership and work closely with: The People team during program transition Regional facilitators for benefits and culture sessions (e.g., UK, France, DACH tracks) Thought leadership from across the company R&D/Product stakeholders in Paris for Day 1 in-person sessions People team and HRBPs, for probation and manager-accountability touchpoints Vendors supporting swag and new hire experience logistics Who detail: someone who tracks scheduling dependencies, facilitator counts, and time-zone constraints proactively rather than reactively Comfortable running two parallel workstreams (EMEA/NAMER) all simultaneously incorporating regional nuance into each geo-specific delivery A clear, concise verbal and written communicator across audiences — executive updates, facilitator coordination, and warm, participant-facing communications Data-informed: comfortable turning feedback and assessment data into concrete program changes Experienced with (or quick to learn) tools such as Google Docs/Drive, enablement, or training programs across multiple regions/time zones Familiarity with vendor management for swag/gifting platforms (e.g.: Sendoso) Background in GTM Enablement, L&D, or People items (e.g., outstanding content placeholders, vendor decisions) and put durable owners and documentation in place Show measurable improvement in satisfaction, engagement, and capstone AI competency assessment results Strengthen the post-onboarding handoff to managers, improving manager accountability in the 30/45/90/120-day window What we offer Competitive package Stock options to ensure you flexibility Subscription to Egym Wellpass (ex-Gymlib) for full access to gyms, studios, and wellness spaces across France A Learning Stipend per year, for you to develop into areas that amplify impact cities including New York, San Francisco, Toronto, Paris, and London High-end equipment (based on stock/availability) to do your work in the best conditions Why Pigment Pigment is building with ambition. Title: Engineering Program Manager
Description: Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team—from Finance to HR—to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time. Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Snowflake, Siemens, and DPD use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario. With a team of 600+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software. At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you. The opportunity We are looking for an Engineering Program Manager (EPM) to help us scale our engineering team. Because we have EPMs almost since the beginning of Pigment, the role is already well-known. Our team is central to the engineering organization, perceived as a force multiplier by all the other engineers. We are constantly on the lookout to improve how we work. We like to try new ideas, whether it is to accelerate delivery, structure the organization or develop a unique culture. By joining our passionate, close-knitted team, you can have an impact in many different ways and learn in a team that is both young and fast-growing! Here is what the day-to-day of an EPM looks like at Pigment: Deliver: You make a difference every day in the engineering team(s) you are working with, as you enhance clarity, direction, scope, and keep all the parts together with other roles (such as Product Managers). Typically an EPM accompanies 1 to 3 teams in their delivery, ranging from technical projects (e.g. scalability and performance, SRE) to more functional ones (e.g. bringing automations to our product). Scale: You contribute to the engineering instances wherever you can bring added value. For instance, you can contribute to maintaining a healthy release pipeline, participate to incident response, oversee improvements to our monitoring and alerting practices…You also lead initiatives of various sizes to tackle the needs and issues that arise when growing as an organization. For instance, suggest evolutions to roles and responsibilities, better organize knowledge management, or work on large-scale projects related to quality management and production stability. Federate: You contribute to the general well-being of the team, upon opportunity and based on affinity, for example as an organizer of regular instances (all-hands meetings, newsletters…), hackathons, team building activities, and any other idea related to the promotion of Pigment culture internally and externally. You also contribute to Pigment hiring and branding initiatives. The team As a team, we have a mission statement and a roadmap that we maintain over time. We are open to different styles and we rotate responsibilities and projects on a regular basis between us. We regularly exchange on our challenges in “co-development” sessions and sound new ideas to one another. You will also grow as an individual thanks to a career ladder and a culture of on-going feedback. Explore Our Tech Blog: If you're curious about the kind of challenges our engineering team tackles, our culture, and our organization, we invite you to explore our Tech Blog! Who you are We expect demonstrated experience in helping technical teams build and run in a fast-paced environment, with the right touch of processes and empowerment of individuals. Title: Special Education Teacher
Description: At Rocketship Public Schools, we believe in the infinite possibility of human potential. We believe that every student deserves the right to dream, to discover, and to develop their unique potential and it is our responsibility and our privilege to unleash the potential inside every Rocketeer we serve. Our non-profit network of public elementary charter schools propels student achievement, develops exceptional educators, and partners with parents who enable high-quality public schools to thrive in their community. We are a collective of parents, teachers, leaders, and students working together to transform the future for underserved communities across our country. At Rocketship Public Schools, we are unleashing potential. Position Description Rocketship Special Education Teachers, known as Education Specialists, play a critical role in ensuring every student has access to an excellent education and a joyful, inclusive school experience. Specialists serve students with significant support needs, including those with intellectual disabilities, autism, multiple disabilities, and communication or behavioral challenges. At Rocketship, we believe every child deserves to be known, loved, and challenged. Our inclusive model ensures that students with disabilities learn alongside their peers whenever possible, while also receiving individualized instruction in smaller group or specialized settings. Education Specialists collaborate closely with general educators, paraprofessionals, and families to provide accommodations, modifications, and targeted supports that help students build independence, confidence, and academic growth. To ensure students and families receive highly individualized support, Education Specialists maintain a capped caseload of no more than 18 students. This intentional structure allows specialists to deeply know their students, build strong family partnerships, and provide high-quality, responsive services tailored to each learner’s unique needs. Specialists manage their caseload at a single school site, delivering instruction in functional academics, adaptive skills, communication supports, and behavior interventions while ensuring compliance with IDEA and state law. Education Specialists also benefit from dedicated time for case management (2-4 hours each week) to focus on IEP preparation, progress monitoring, family communication, documentation, and collaboration with service providers. At Rocketship, Education Specialists are empowered to focus fully on special education support and student success. Unlike many school settings, specialists are not responsible for operational duties such as arrival, dismissal, lunch coverage, or other classroom coverage (subbing), allowing them to devote their energy to instruction, intervention, family partnership, and individualized student support. Behavior support is also central to the role. Specialists partner with families and staff to implement Behavior Support Plans (BSPs) and Behavior Intervention Plans (BIPs), model strategies for paraprofessionals, and utilize approaches such as Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) and crisis intervention to create safe, structured, and supportive learning environments where students can thrive. Education Specialists receive ongoing support through weekly coaching from school leaders, in addition to specialized coaching from a Special Education Program Specialist to strengthen instructional practice, compliance systems, and long-term professional growth. Education Specialists report to their Principal or Assistant Principal. Title: Pisgah Special Education Occupational Therapist
Description: The Pisgah Program at SAR Academy, a Modern Orthodox, co-educational day school in Riverdale NY is looking for a full-time licensed Occupational Therapist for the 2026–2027 school year to work within our Lower and Middle School divisions. Pisgah is SAR’s integrated support program, which combines the need for intensive support with the benefits of learning as part of the whole-school community. Pisgah offers children the support of a full-time Special Education teacher, along with related service providers, while also allowing them to learn in a General Education classroom. This hybrid approach allows for strong peer models as well as the intensive support a student may need. Pisgah is the Hebrew word for summit and reflects SAR’s commitment to ensuring that students are given the support they need to climb their own personal mountain and reach their own personal summit in an educationally and socially supportive community environment. The Pisgah Occupational Therapist works closely with other members of the Pisgah team, composed of Pisgah Special Education teachers and assistants, psychologists, and Speech-Language Pathologists. The Occupational Therapist will play an important role in supporting students’ fine motor development, sensory processing, self-regulation, and participation in classroom routines and academic tasks. The OT will provide both direct services and consultative support to teachers and staff, helping students access the curriculum and develop the functional skills needed for success in school. Experience supporting students with sensory regulation, fine and visual motor development, handwriting, executive functioning, and adaptive skills is strongly preferred. Familiarity with school-based service delivery models, collaborative consultation with teachers, and interpreting occupational therapy evaluations is important. Position responsibilities include: Maintain a full-time caseload of students Provide individual and small group occupational therapy sessions Provide push-in support in classrooms to assist students in accessing academic and daily school activities Conduct occupational therapy evaluations and contribute to the development of individualized goals and intervention plans Participate in weekly interdisciplinary team meetings Collaborate with Pisgah teachers to support students’ sensory, motor, and functional needs in the classroom Provide strategies and consultation to teachers and assistants to support student participation and independence Collaborate with parents and communicate regularly regarding student progress Maintain appropriate documentation and complete bi-annual Progress Reports for each student on the caseload Additional position details: SAR is committed to the professional and personal growth of its community members, and there are many opportunities to participate in ongoing professional development. Salary commensurate with experience Competitive benefits About SAR: SAR Academy is a Modern Orthodox co-educational nursery through grade 8 day school located in Riverdale, NY. We are dedicated to the belief that every child possesses a divine spark, has unique worth as an individual and should be encouraged to achieve according to his or her ability. Our warm environment promotes confidence, creativity and enthusiasm for learning. In our approach to academics, we nurture students to develop intellectual curiosity, critical thinking skills and a lifelong love of both Torah and Secular studies.

Title: Program Manager
Description: Threat Tec, LLC, a rapidly growing Veteran-Owned Business, is the leader of Operational Environment (OE) replication and Threat Emulation/Wargaming solutions. Threat Tec brings innovative thinking and extensive experience to complex challenges for public and private sector customers. We work alongside our nation's defenders, developing solutions that drive success and protect our future. Join a team that is embodied by an unwavering commitment to professionalism, honesty, and innovation. Threat Tec is seeking an experienced Program Manager to support the Robotic Logistics Support Services contract. The Program Manager will provide comprehensive program management, acquisition, systems engineering, test and evaluation, and integrated logistics support for robotic systems and associated subsystems. The successful candidate will work closely with Government program leadership, technical stakeholders, Integrated Product Teams, and contractor personnel to support program execution, long-range planning, acquisition documentation, lifecycle sustainment, and informed decision-making. Primary Responsibilities Serve as the principal contractor representative responsible for the management, coordination, and execution of program requirements. Plan, organize, and oversee contract activities to ensure technical, schedule, cost, quality, and performance objectives are achieved. Conduct feasibility studies and cost-benefit analyses using Government-approved Systems of Record data for applicable robotic systems and subsystems. Analyze program data and provide findings, recommendations, and courses of action to Government stakeholders. Provide input into draft programmatic and acquisition documentation in accordance with applicable Department of Defense acquisition policies, including DoD 5000-series guidance. Support the development, coordination, and maintenance of acquisition and milestone documentation, including: Acquisition Strategies Acquisition Plans Test and Evaluation Master Plans Integrated Master Schedules Systems Engineering Plans Lifecycle Sustainment Plans Provide recommendations concerning the acquisition, modification, modernization, or upgrade of robotic systems and associated subsystems. Evaluate proposed system changes with consideration for: Long-range program planning Operational effectiveness Safety and risk Cost effectiveness Environmental impacts Integrated Logistics Support Lifecycle sustainment Coordinate program management activities across engineering, logistics, testing, acquisition, operations, and sustainment functional areas. Support the planning and execution of test and evaluation activities, technical reviews, program reviews, and other key functional events. Provide administrative and coordination support for: Test and evaluation meetings Program management reviews Integrated Product Team meetings Technical working groups Government and contractor teleconferences Quality and performance-related reviews Develop meeting agendas, briefing materials, decision papers, action-item trackers, meeting minutes, and follow-up documentation. Maintain and monitor the Integrated Master Schedule, program milestones, deliverables, risks, issues, dependencies, and corrective actions. Identify programmatic, technical, schedule, cost, and sustainment risks and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies. Ensure contract deliverables are accurate, complete, timely, and compliant with Government requirements. Provide routine program status updates, reports, briefings, and recommendations to Government and Threat Tec leadership. Coordinate personnel, resources, subcontractors, and technical activities necessary to successfully execute contract requirements. Ensure effective communication and collaboration among Government customers, contractor personnel, vendors, and other program stakeholders. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in business administration, program management, engineering, logistics, acquisition management, systems management, or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of progressively responsible experience supporting Department of Defense programs, acquisition activities, logistics programs, engineering programs, or complex technical contracts. Demonstrated experience managing Government contracts or major task orders involving multiple technical and functional disciplines. Experience supporting DoD acquisition lifecycle activities and milestone documentation. Working knowledge of DoD 5000-series acquisition policies and processes. Experience developing or contributing to acquisition strategies, acquisition plans, test and evaluation plans, integrated master schedules, systems engineering plans, or lifecycle sustainment plans. Experience conducting feasibility studies, business-case analyses, cost-benefit analyses, or programmatic assessments. Knowledge of Integrated Logistics Support and product-support planning principles. Experience coordinating Integrated Product Teams, technical reviews, test events, program management reviews, and senior-level meetings. Ability to analyze complex technical and programmatic information and communicate clear recommendations to Government leadership. Strong organizational, leadership, analytical, written communication, and briefing skills. Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project, and Teams. Ability to obtain and maintain an active Secret clearance required for the position. Preferred Qualifications Project Management Professional certification. Defense Acquisition Workforce Improvement Act, Defense Acquisition University, or equivalent acquisition-management training. Experience supporting military robotic systems, unmanned ground systems, autonomous systems, tactical vehicles, or related technologies. Experience supporting Army, Marine Corps, Special Operations, or other Department of Defense robotics programs. Familiarity with Systems of Record, configuration management, systems engineering, test and evaluation, and lifecycle sustainment processes. Experience managing cost, schedule, performance, risk, personnel, and deliverables under a performance-based Government contract. Prior military, Government civilian, or defense-contracting experience.
