Title: Lead Product Manager, Client & Developer Experience
Description: About Truv Truv is transforming the financial data industry with a secure, real-time API platform for payroll account access. Our technology streamlines income and employment verification, direct deposit switching, and more—eliminating outdated processes and unlocking greater financial opportunities. Backed by $30M from top investors like Kleiner Perkins and NYCA, we’re disrupting a $2B legacy market with cutting-edge innovation and a customer-first approach. Our leadership team brings expertise from industry giants like Apple, Carta, Venmo, MX, and Okta, driving the future of financial data access. About the Job We are seeking a Lead Product Manager to join Truv’s Product Team. In this role, you’ll build and optimize products that enable lenders to verify income and employment, streamline decisioning, and improve borrower experiences. You’ll work closely with engineering, design, compliance, and analytics teams to deliver solutions that directly client onboarding, go-live and developer experience. This is an execution-focused role where you’ll use your background in lending technology to design, test, and deliver impactful features that serve both lenders and their borrowers. What You’ll Do Partner with engineering and data teams to deliver secure and scalable workflows for income and employment verification for public sector, mortgage and other lending clients. Conduct user testing with clients and end-users to validate workflows and improve usability. Streamline onboarding, implementation, customization and go-live experiences for Truv clients end-to-end including lead generation, demo experience, onboarding, implementation, go-live and post go-live experiences including reporting on metrics, ability for self-serve experience. Capture feedback from agencies and lenders on frictionless onboarding and go-live experience. Collaborate with developers in clients teams, system integrators to streamline developer experience including Truv documentation. Build customization for various types of clients - state agencies, lenders and developers who utilize the Truv admin portal for the day-to-day operations. Collaborate with compliance and risk teams to ensure regulatory alignment across all flows. Gather requirements from multiple stakeholders and synthesize into actionable product plans. Monitor product performance post-launch and iterate quickly using insights from clients and end-user behavior. Who You Are 5+ years of product management experience in government , lending, or financial technology . Proven experience delivering products used by state and federal agencies, risk teams, or financial institutions . Strong understanding of income and employment verification, and decisioning workflows . Track record running user testing and A/B experimentation to inform product decisions. Excellent execution skills—able to manage competing priorities and deliver in fast-paced environments. Make data-driven product decisions , leveraging analytics and experimentation to measure impact and prioritize features. Gather requirements from multiple stakeholders and synthesize into actionable product plans. Strong collaboration skills across engineering, design, compliance, and business teams. Analytical mindset with ability to interpret data and turn insights into product improvements. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience). Experience at startups or high-growth environments preferred. Success Metrics Improved lender adoption and retention of Truv’s lending solutions. Faster and more reliable verification success rates . Increases in loan processing efficiency and borrower conversion rates . Positive feedback from lenders on usability, reliability, and compliance. On-time delivery of high-quality product launches. Benefits Competitive salary and equity package. Fully remote work environment. Health, dental, and vision benefits. 401(k). Flexible time off and paid holidays. Work alongside an experienced leadership team from top tech companies. High-impact role with clear growth trajectory. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status.

Title: Software Engineer - Data Workflows

We focus on large-scale data workflows that ingest, transform, and correlate real-world and simulated driving data. Our team sits at the intersection of simulation, cloud engineering, and data analysis—solving challenges in automation, scalability, and system validation to support cutting-edge vehicle programs. They will lead the design and deployment of cloud-native workflows for large-scale ADAS simulation and evaluation, including analytics applications, test orchestration, and traceability systems. By championing best practices, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and mentoring developers, you will play a key role in building our mission-critical AD/ADAS tools. RESPONSIBILITIES Backend and Data Software Engineering Build and optimize end-to-end data workflows from collection to user-facing tools Create efficient data models and automation pipelines for AD/ADAS systems Develop robust APIs to support data analytics applications Implement comprehensive testing strategies to ensure application reliability Communicate technical concepts and data findings effectively to non-technical team members and leadership Teamwork Collaborate closely with the Product team and internal customers to optimize workflows and user experience. Work with other engineers to promote best practices, conduct code reviews, and ensure consistency and quality across the codebase Ownership Write clear technical design documents and system documentation. Deliver features through the full software lifecycle including requirements gathering, design, implementation, testing, documentation, release, and maintenance. EXPERIENCE Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 3+ years of professional software development experience in backend web services and data pipelines. Technical Expertise Experience with Python in a web and data context Experience with SQL and data schema design. Experience with data ingestion and ETL pipelines. At least 1 year experience with cloud computing (AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud) Familiarity with NoSQL database systems such as DynamoDB. Soft Skills Strong problem-solving and debugging capabilities. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including technical designs and documentation. Preferred Qualifications Experience with microservice and serverless cloud architectures. Experience with performance optimization techniques in various database systems. Experience with infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform). Interested candidates are encouraged to submit their application with a current resume and a portfolio/link to recent projects. Title: Senior/Staff Technical Program Manager, Change Governance
Description: Zoox is seeking a Senior / Staff Technical Program Manager, Change Governance to own the end-to-end orchestration of product changes as they move from tentative engineering approval through cross-functional review to implementation on the production line. This role sits at the center of a multidisciplinary process, ensuring every change is tracked, properly vetted, and executed with full governance and traceability at each stage. In this job, you will Serve as the single point of accountability for governance of a change from tentative Engineering approval through multidisciplinary alignment across Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Purchasing, Supply Chain, and Logistics to production-line implementation. Assess and manage how a change cascades through multi-tier supply chain dependencies, coordinating supplier qualification and launch-readiness requirements as needed Partner with production-line teams at Zoox and relevant change management functions at suppliers to plan and confirm implementation readiness: timing, resourcing, build sequencing, documentation, and training. Maintain accurate, audit-ready records of change status, approvals, and decisions in relevant change management, ERP, and PLM systems. Build and maintain reporting and dashboards on change pipeline health, using scripts (e.g., Python, Apps Script, VBA) or AI tools to automate recurring data retrieval and reporting across Excel, Google Sheets, and Jira. Own and continuously improve the governance framework and checklist — required approvals, documentation, and gate criteria — partnering with IT/business systems teams to implement process and tooling improvements. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Manufacturing Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline 10+ years of program management experience with a core background in physical/hardware product development — managing BOMs, component qualification, hardware validation cycles, manufacturing and physical supply chains. Multi-tier automotive supply chain fluency — direct experience managing or escalating through OEM → Tier1 → Tier2/3 dependencies. Cross-functional program ownership without direct authority — demonstrated accountability spanning engineering, purchasing, supply chain, and manufacturing simultaneously. Automotive program lifecycle experience — hands-on with gate-driven development (APQP, PPAP, SOP milestones); understands cost/schedule implications of late changes across long program timelines. Advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets (pivot tables, complex formulas, data reconciliation across sources); comfortable writing scripts to automate data retrieval and reporting. Experience with at least one change management, PLM, or ERP tool (e.g., SAP, Windchill, or similar). Bonus Qualifications Advanced degree (M.S./MBA) in Engineering or a related technical field. ISO 9001 or IATF 16949 certification (highly desired). Experience with PLM or CAD tools (highly favorable, not mandatory). Supplier nomination and re-sourcing experience — worked alongside purchasing on sourcing decisions, dual-sourcing strategy, and supplier development. Manufacturing launch exposure — line readiness, build sequencing around constraints, launch risk management, run-at-rate/capacity verification. About Zoox Zoox is developing the first ground-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility-as-a-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving and highly execution-oriented team. Project and Program Management 

  • Lead end to end delivery of strategic HR and People Operations initiatives across corporate, manufacturing, and shared services functions. 
  • Develop project plans, timelines, milestones, governance structures, and communication plans. 
  • Facilitate project meetings, track action items, and drive accountability across stakeholders.

Title: Sr. Program Manager, Supplier Industrialization Engineering
Description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience. 

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

The Global Supplier Industrialization group is seeking a Senior Program Manager who will play a key role in supporting the supplier industrialization team. This position is responsible for leading supplier deliverables and ensuring these results are closely aligned with the objectives and timelines set by the vehicle program management group. The Senior Program Manager will respond proactively to any contingencies that arise, providing guidance and support to ensure that the group consistently delivers high-quality products on schedule.

 

YOU WILL: 

  • Lead cross‑functional teams to achieve program objectives, proactively managing risks and resolving issues that could impact program launch timelines.
  • Develop, maintain, and optimize ETL pipelines and KPI dashboards, ensuring clear data visualization and compelling storytelling that enable executive‑level decision‑making.
  • Conduct regular data compliance audits and drive disciplined follow‑up with Supplier Industrialization Engineering (SIE) and key stakeholders to ensure data accuracy and timeliness.
  • Provide hands‑on training, coaching, and continuous support to stakeholders on KPI dashboards, metrics usage, and data interpretation.
  • Contribute to both strategic and tactical planning discussions, translating business objectives into executable program plans.
  • Track and drive execution against key milestones and deliverables to ensure on‑time, high‑quality program launches.
  • Engage directly with suppliers to review program timelines, identify gaps and inefficiencies, and challenge processes, assumptions, and delivery plans as needed.
  • Exercise sound judgment to determine when issues can be resolved within the working team versus when escalation is required, ensuring timely and effective resolution.
  • Influence cross‑functional partners to identify data‑driven improvement opportunities that drive measurable business impact.
  • Oversee the end‑to‑end planning, execution, and delivery of Supplier Industrialization Engineering (SIE) programs, ensuring adherence to scope, schedule, cost, and quality requirements.
  • Stay current on industry trends, emerging tools, and regulatory considerations related to program management and supplier industrialization.
  • Travel domestically and internationally, including short‑notice and extended assignments, to support manufacturing and supplier readiness activities.
  •  

YOU BRING: 

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, industrial engineering or related field.
  • 5 - 7 years of automotive program management experience in any of these commodities:
    • Stamping
    • Casting
    • Injection molding
    • Chassis components
    • Interiors (Interior cabin, passive safety, seats)
  • Exceptional in communication, collaboration, technical writing and presentation
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and identify actionable insights.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Experience working in a dynamic/start-up environment is a plus.
  • Flexibility in work schedule is required (to include evenings and weekends, as needed)
  • Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, Project. Working knowledge of Smartsheet, SAP, JIRA, Tableau, and any costing software is a plus.

  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional programs across Sales, Delivery, Product, IT, Engineering, Production, Supply Chain, Analytics, Fleet, and Leadership stakeholders
  • Experience developing project plans, launch readiness materials, process documentation, stakeholder communications, and executive-level status updates
  • Strong analytical orientation with the ability to translate demand signals, take-rate forecasts, customer order trends, and production constraints into actionable build planning recommendations

Title: Senior Technical Program Manager
Location: Boston, Massachusetts, United States; Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, United States; Remote U.S.
Description:
Mission Summary: 

This is an exciting and pivotal role for an analytically-minded and highly organized individual to directly support the engineering executive leadership team in driving key strategic initiatives across the company. The ideal candidate will blend a technical foundation with proven project management or strategy expertise to effectively coordinate complex, cross-functional efforts and manage critical communication workflows.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Strategic Project Coordination & Execution
  • Lead Project Management: Own the coordination, tracking, and communication of high-priority strategic projects that span multiple internal teams (e.g., Engineering, Operations, Finance, People, Legal) and organizational levels.
  • Cross-Functional Liaison: Serve as the primary point of contact for the engineering with departmental leads, ensuring alignment, surfacing roadblocks, and maintaining momentum on key initiatives.
  • Meeting Management: Prepare agendas, presentations, and follow-up documentation for internal strategy reviews and project steering committee meetings.
2. Analytical Communication & Stakeholder Management
  • Shareholder Communication Support: Conduct analytical review and drafting/editing of responses to high-stakes internal and external communications, particularly emails and reports directed to shareholders, executive leadership, and the Board.
  • Information Synthesis: Digest complex technical, financial, and operational information into clear, concise, and strategic summaries for executive consumption and decision-making.
  • Executive Briefing: Prepare the Engineering leadership team for meetings by providing timely and relevant research, talking points, and data-driven insights.
3. Operational Support & Engineering Partnership
  • Prioritization Support: Assist the engineering leads in managing and prioritizing their strategic calendar, aligning time and resources with the company's highest priorities.
  • Process Improvement: Drive process improvements by identifying and implementing efficiencies across engineering workflows, organizational processes, and reporting structures.
  • Ad-Hoc Analysis: Conduct rapid, targeted research and analysis on emerging business opportunities or threats to inform strategic planning.

Qualifications:

Required:
  • Experience: 5 years of experience in a high-growth environment, ideally within a strategy consulting firm, internal corporate strategy team, Program Management Office (PMO), or an operational role with a strategic focus.
  • Technical Background: Demonstrated understanding of technical concepts, engineering workflows, or data analysis (e.g., a degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field).
  • Project Management Acumen: Proven ability to manage complex projects, involving multiple stakeholders and competing priorities, from inception to completion.
  • Analytical & Communication Skills: Exceptional ability to think analytically, structure complex arguments, and communicate (written and verbal) clearly and persuasively to executive and external audiences.
Preferred:
  • Industry Experience: Experience working in the technology sector.
  • Financial Literacy: Basic understanding of financial statements and corporate governance to effectively support shareholder communications.

This role is hybrid from our Boston office. It requires two in-office days each week, ideally Tuesday and Thursday.

Title: Product Manager, Sustainability Content & Methodology Governance
Description:
We are looking for a Product Manager, Sustainability Content & Methodology Governance to own the product strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle management for Novisto’s ESG framework, questionnaire, and carbon methodology capabilities.

This is a high-impact role for someone who enjoys operating at the intersection of product management, sustainability domain expertise, data governance, regulatory change, carbon accounting, and enterprise SaaS delivery. You will help ensure Novisto’s platform stays aligned with evolving ESG frameworks, CDP questionnaires, S&P questionnaires, carbon protocols, emissions factors, and calculation logic while translating complex methodology changes into scalable product capabilities.

This role is ideal for a structured, customer-oriented product manager who can bring discipline to a fast-changing sustainability domain and create a repeatable operating model for monitoring, assessing, prioritizing, implementing, validating, and communicating content and methodology changes.

Why This Role Matters

  • Customers need confidence that their ESG and carbon data is accurate, current, traceable, and ready for reporting and assurance.
  • Frameworks, questionnaires, protocols, emissions factors, and calculation methodologies are changing continuously and must be managed through a disciplined product lifecycle.
  • Novisto’s differentiation depends on combining deep sustainability expertise with scalable software, strong governance, and a clear customer experience.
  • This role will help Novisto move from content maintenance to a repeatable, productized methodology governance model that supports enterprise adoption and customer trust.

Your responsibilities will include:

Own the product roadmap for frameworks, questionnaires, and methodologies

  • Define and maintain the roadmap for ESG frameworks, CDP questionnaires, S&P questionnaires, carbon protocols, emissions factors, and calculation logic.
  • Translate evolving standards and questionnaire changes into product requirements, data model needs, workflow changes, reporting outputs, QA requirements, and release plans.
  • Prioritize work based on customer impact, regulatory deadlines, business value, risk, implementation complexity, and strategic fit.

Build a scalable monitoring and governance process

  • Establish a recurring monitoring process for supported frameworks, questionnaires, protocols, and carbon methodologies.
  • Work with ESG experts, carbon experts, data analysts, external advisors, and customer-facing teams to identify changes and assess product implications.
  • Create clear governance for content updates, methodology changes, emissions factor updates, calculation logic, templates, mappings, standard phrases, and release documentation.

Lead structured impact assessments

  • Assess whether each change impacts existing implementation, data structures, calculations, downstream reporting, customer workflows, assurance readiness, or exports.
  • Separate routine updates from non-routine changes that require deeper analysis, working groups, customer SME input, or new product capabilities.
  • Produce clear implementation scope, product requirements, acceptance criteria, QA approach, and release readiness plans.

Partner cross-functionally to deliver high-quality product outcomes

  • Collaborate with Product, ESG experts, Carbon experts, Engineering, QA, Design, Customer Success, Implementation, Product Marketing, and Sales Enablement.
  • Ensure domain interpretation is translated into clear, buildable, testable product requirements.
  • Support release readiness, internal enablement, customer-facing documentation, and customer communications for major changes.

Improve carbon calculation transparency and trust

  • Own product requirements for carbon calculation traceability, methodology documentation, emissions factor versioning, data quality checks, variance detection, and audit-ready evidence.
  • Help ensure carbon outputs are explainable, repeatable, and aligned with recognized protocols and enterprise customer expectations.
  • Support the evolution of Novisto’s carbon capabilities across Scope 1, Scope 2, Scope 3, supplier data, and calculation governance.

 

What we’re looking for:

  • 5+ years of product management, product ownership, regulatory content management, sustainability software, carbon accounting, ESG reporting, EHS, compliance, or enterprise SaaS experience.
  • Experience translating complex domain, regulatory, methodological, or data requirements into product capabilities.
  • Familiarity with ESG reporting frameworks, sustainability questionnaires, carbon accounting, data governance, assurance readiness, or regulatory change management.
  • Strong structured thinking and ability to manage complex, recurring update cycles with cross-functional contributors.
  • Ability to work with subject-matter experts and engineering teams to create clear requirements, acceptance criteria, and release plans.
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to write customer-facing release notes, internal enablement materials, and executive-level updates.
  • Strong judgment and prioritization skills across regulatory timelines, customer commitments, implementation complexity, and commercial impact.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with CDP, S&P Global CSA, GRI, SASB, ISSB, ESRS / CSRD, TCFD, SDGs, or other sustainability frameworks.
  • Knowledge of GHG Protocol, Scope 1, Scope 2, Scope 3, emissions factors, supplier data, or product carbon footprint concepts.
  • Experience with taxonomy management, calculation engines, reporting workflows, audit trails, controls, or evidence management.
  • Experience working with consultants, assurance providers, external advisors, customer advisory groups, or enterprise implementation teams.
  • Experience in a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.

What we offer

  • Join an early-stage, well-financed company
  • Advance Novisto’s purpose of contributing to the sustainability of the economy, environment, and society by empowering companies to make better decisions and disclosures through our ESG data management software
  • Contribute your knowledge and insights to increase awareness and knowledge of sustainability
  • Generous health benefits (100% Insurance coverage & access to Dialogue's telemedicine app)
  • Flexible schedules & opportunity to work remotely
  • 4 weeks of vacation
  • Stock option plan
  • Summer hours
  • If you prefer to work at the office, we have a beautiful office in Old Montreal, close to downtown and steps away from a metro (subway) station

Title: Senior Program Manager, Validation Operations
Description:
Who We Are 

Nuro believes self-driving vehicles are the most immediate and profound opportunity for AI to drive positive change in the physical world. Safer streets, more time for what matters, and easier access to the world around us, that’s why we’re building a universal autonomy platform: self-driving for all roads and all rides.

Founded in 2016, Nuro is a physical AI company developing Level 4 autonomous driving technology for a wide range of vehicles, use cases, and markets. Powered by the Nuro Driver™, our universal autonomy platform enables the global mobility ecosystem to deploy autonomy at scale, from robotaxis and logistics fleets to personal vehicles.

With years of real-world deployment experience and a flexible, partner-led business model, Nuro is working toward a future where millions of autonomous vehicles powered by our technology help make everyday life safer, easier, and more connected. Nuro has raised over $2B in capital from Uber, NVIDIA, Google, Softbank, Fidelity, T. Rowe Price, and other leading investors.

About the Team

Software Operations is the processing muscle behind Nuro Driver. We take the onroad miles our fleet collects and turn them into usable data, which becomes the foundation everything downstream depends on. Within Software Operations, Validation Operations holds the bar for safety and system testing, making sure our autonomous driving software is safe before it ever hits the road. It's careful, consequential work, and we take it seriously.

About the Role

Own the systems that make validation operations accurate, scalable, and ready for Nuro’s next stage of growth.

As a Senior Program Manager on the Software Operations team, you’ll partner with Autonomy, Systems, and Data Platform Engineering to deliver the high-quality data that powers critical validation and expansion efforts. You’ll serve as the bridge between Engineering, Operations, and our offshore partner, upholding the quality bar, building scalable workflows, and driving performance across the ecosystem.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who thrives in ambiguity and wants to make a measurable impact. You’ll investigate failures at their root, turn data into decisions, and lead the changes that keep quality, delivery, and operational confidence high.

About the Work

You'll lead the day-to-day operations that keep validation data flowing, accurate, and on schedule, bringing structure to ambiguity and turning quality gaps into lasting improvements.

  • Support critical validation programs: Partner with Autonomy, Systems, and Data Platform Engineering to deliver the operational support and data that validation and expansion efforts depend on.
  • Set the quality standard: Define metrics, sampling approaches, workflows, and operating mechanisms that enable consistent, scalable data quality.
  • Diagnose and fix what’s broken: Audit live workflows, query databases, and trace accuracy or pipeline failures to their root cause, then drive measurable corrective action.
  • Lead global operations: Own the offshore vendor relationship, including budget, capacity, performance, and quality outcomes.
  • Drive improvement: Lead adoption of improved operational practices through clear documentation, stakeholder engagement, pilot programs, and change management.
  • Build the team: Lead a small in-house team, strengthen oversight, and create processes that evolve with Nuro’s needs.
  • Align teams around action: Translate complex operational and technical issues into clear recommendations for Engineering, Operations, and leadership.

You won’t just manage validation operations. You’ll make the whole function better, more scalable, and more trusted.

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years of program management experience embedded with software validation and/or AI/ML operations
  • Quality-obsessed approach to program management: energized by finding what is broken, not just by shipping on time.
  • Deep familiarity with data pipelines and labeling ecosystems, including annotation workflows, quality sampling, taxonomy design, and inter-annotator agreement
  • A track record of identifying and closing data quality gaps, with measurable impact on accuracy or model performance
  • Experience managing large-scale offshore or globally distributed annotation teams
  • Proficiency querying data with SQL and BigQuery, and using KPIs to drive prioritization, capacity management, and continuous improvement
  • Ability to work both strategically and hands-on, from designing a quality framework to personally tracing a labeling fault through a database
  • High agency and a history of building processes where none exist
  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to influence and make complex information accessible to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Bachelor's degree in a technical or business discipline, or equivalent practical experience

Bonus Points

  • Background in autonomous vehicles, software validation, robotics or data engineering

At Nuro, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. For this position, the reasonably expected base pay range is between $132,000 and $198,000 for the level at which this job has been scoped. Your base pay will depend on several factors, including your experience, qualifications, education, location, and skills. In the event that you are considered for a different level, a higher or lower pay range would apply. This position is also eligible for an annual performance bonus, equity, and a competitive benefits package.

You’ll own the end-to-end lifecycle of systems tooling initiatives: defining requirements, managing priorities, coordinating integration with simulation and autonomy stacks, and ensuring test and validation infrastructure meets the evolving needs of driverless programs.

  • Partner with Ops to improve troubleshooting and intervention workflows, reducing time-to-recovery.

Bonus Points 

  • Experience with autonomous systems, vehicle platforms, or robotics simulation environments.
  • Familiarity with data and tooling stacks supporting system V&V (e.g., test harnesses, synthetic data generation, regression testing, scenario replay tools).
  • Technical depth in Python, C++, or data tooling pipelines sufficient to engage engineers on design trade-offs.
  • Prior experience in driverless readiness, safety case validation, or end-to-end system testing.
  • Excellent organizational and interpersonal skills, able to balance fast-paced execution with structured process discipline.

Title: AI Content Creator (Contractor)
Description:
We are looking for a creative and technically strong AI Content Creator (Contractor) to join Picsart's GenAI team. You will build and maintain Picsart's AI Preset and Creatives library, and produce the material that presents it: preset and creative families, promo and social video, before/after demos, landing-page visuals, launch assets and ad variants. Your work appears across the catalogs of different Picsart tools, on quick-action and effect pages, landing pages and other product surfaces, and on our social channels.

 

The work spans text-to-image, image-to-image, image-to-video and video-to-video: stylised looks, avatars, motion, transitions and environmental effects. It combines creative craft with production discipline. Presets have to hold up across a wide range of user inputs, and the volume is high: you may move between a preset family, a launch video and a landing-page asset in the same week. You will work closely with Product, SEO, Growth and Engineering.

 

Please note that this is a Full-time Contractor (6 months) role.

How You'll Make an Impact

  • Create AI presets and creatives across images, avatars, stylised looks, video effects, transitions, camera motions and environmental effects, built as coherent families within each category.
  • Write structured, production-ready prompts with preservation constraints, and maintain reusable prompt frameworks for consistency, identity retention and output quality.
  • Test new models and prototype visual directions to open up categories the library does not yet cover.
  • Produce promo and social video for presets, effects and launches: short-form cuts, before/after reveals and trend-led pieces, adapted across formats and aspect ratios.
  • Create supporting creative for product and marketing surfaces, including preset previews and covers, landing and effect page visuals, campaign and ad assets, and educational content.
  • Run visual QA across a wide range of real user inputs, including different faces, skin tones, lighting conditions, aspect ratios and low-quality uploads, against documented quality standards.
  • Maintain presets, metadata and taxonomy in the CMS, and work with SEO and Product to align the library with search intent and traffic themes.
  • Share findings on model performance and library gaps with Product and Engineering.

What You'll Bring

  • A portfolio of AI-generated visual work: shipped presets, styles, campaigns, social content or creative experiments, across image and video.
  • Hands-on experience across multiple generative image and video models, and a practical understanding of how they differ.
  • Command of visual fundamentals: lighting, composition, framing, colour, character design and stylisation.
  • Experience writing detailed, structured prompts with preservation constraints, and iterating them until results are reliable rather than occasional.
  • Short-form editing ability: cutting, pacing, sound, captions and resizing.
  • Working knowledge of what performs on social, including hooks, pacing, formats and platform conventions.
  • An eye for output defects such as artefacts, identity drift, hand and text errors, and over-smoothing.
  • The range and speed to work across presets, video and marketing assets in parallel.
  • Fluency in English.

Good To Have

  • Background in visual effects, illustration, concept art, motion design, retouching or photography.
  • Familiarity with product and UX workflows, and with SEO-driven creative content.
  • Experience with CMS-driven content systems, presets, filters or creative libraries.
  • Understanding of VFX, camera motion presets and dynamic composition.
  • ComfyUI or node-based generative pipelines, and LoRA training or fine-tuning for style consistency.
  • A public presence as an AI creator.

Title: Risk Data Governance Lead [Integrated Risk Management]
Description:
We are looking for a Risk Data Governance Lead to own and transform our risk data infrastructure into an LLM-agent-ready state.

This is a unique role at the intersection of data engineering, data governance, and risk analytics — you will ensure that both humans and AI agents can reliably consume, query, and act on our risk data.

You will lead a small team of analytics engineers and serve as an agent of change across departments — pushing for data quality, enforcing standards, and building the foundation that enables the entire risk function to scale. As we expand to new countries, you will design the group-wide data governance framework from the ground up.


Challenges that await you:

  • Lead risk data infrastructure to LLM-agent-ready state. Own the full stack of data quality across 40+ analytical tables in Snowflake, spanning 4 product lines and multiple provisioning frameworks (MxGAAP, IFRS, internal). Define and enforce SLAs, build observability for datamarts across all DMBOK quality dimensions (freshness, completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, validity, uniqueness), and drive metadata and lineage completeness. Choose and maintain the right tooling (Git-based, wiki, or hybrid) for documenting schemas, business concepts, query patterns, and pitfalls
  • Design and evolve the LLM context layer. We already maintain a structured knowledge base covering risk data tables, business concept definitions, and query patterns — your job is to scale and formalize this into a production-grade context layer that AI agents can autonomously consume. You will shape how both humans and machines reliably query, interpret, and act on the same data infrastructure
  • Be an agent of change across departments. Lead by example in interactions with DWH, Finance, and other teams. Create data quality requirements, push for standards adoption, and translate risk analytics needs into concrete data platform requirements. You represent risk’s data interests externally
  • Lead a team of 2–3 analytics engineers. Manage their work, grow their skills, and ensure delivery on datamart development, ETL pipelines, and data quality initiatives. Build a culture of ownership and technical excellence within the team
  • Build a group-wide risk data governance framework. As Plata expands into new countries, design and implement data governance standards that scale across geographies. Define reusable patterns for risk data infrastructure that can be rolled out to new markets. The scope of both the framework and the team will grow with the company

What makes you a great fit:

  • 5+ years in data engineering, analytics engineering, or data governance roles
  • Experience leading or mentoring a small technical team (2–5 people)
  • Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience with Snowflake or comparable cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Redshift)
  • Experience with dbt or similar transformation frameworks — we use dbt in production and you will govern the transformation layer
  • Track record of driving data quality improvements in a cross-functional environment
  • Experience building or maintaining data documentation, metadata catalogs, or knowledge bases
  • Hands-on experience with LLM/AI agents and a clear understanding of what makes data infrastructure agent-consumable — you will build this into the foundation of the role
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment with ambiguity — you define the standards, not just follow them
  • B2 or higher English level for effective communication with an international team

       Nice to have

  • Experience in risk management, banking, or fintech data
  • Familiarity with Airflow or similar orchestration tools
  • Experience with regulatory data requirements (CNBV, IFRS 9, Basel)
  • Russian language skills (many team members are Russian-speaking)
  • Experience building data governance frameworks across multiple countries or business units

Our ways of working:

  • Innovative Spirit: a commitment to creativity and groundbreaking solutions
  • Honest Feedback: valuing open, transparent communication
  • Supportive Team: a strong, collaborative community
  • Celebrating Achievements: recognizing our wins together
  • High-Tech Environment: a team full of smart and revolutionary people who date to challenge the status quo of incumbent finances

Our benefits:

  • Relocation support to one of our hubs — Mexico, Cyprus, Spain, Serbia — with assistance for the employee and their family
  • Flexible work from one of our offices or remote
  • Healthcare Coverage
  • Education Budget: Language lessons, professional training and certifications
  • Wellness Budget: Mental health and fitness activity reimbursements
  • Vacation policy: 20 days of annual leave and paid sick leave

Title: Senior Manager, Content Marketing
Description:
About the Role:

At the center of the AI transformation in digital advertising is a belief that human storytelling builds trust in ways that automation cannot replicate. PubMatic is looking for someone who can take strategic insights and turn them into great content, across formats, across channels, on a sustainable basis, that moves the market and moves the business forward. 

This is a role for someone who is equal parts outstanding writer and strategist. Someone who asks the right questions before hitting publish. You're the person who looks at what we know and asks: What story do our customers actually need to hear right now? Why does it matter to them? And where should they hear it? Then you write it brilliantly, get it into market, and measure whether it moved the needle. 

What You'll Do:

You'll build and run PubMatic's content engine: translating research insights and strategic direction into content that reaches and resonate with audiences, strengthens sales conversations, resonates with sales, and builds our credibility in the market.  

You'll sit within a lean, corporate marketing team, reporting to the Senior Director of Corporate Marketing and partnering with communications, research, product marketing, creative, and sales. 

Your job: take insights, product features, partnerships, GTM messaging, and deliver compelling content that audiences want to consume. You own the full cycle across planning, creating across formats, distributing, and measuring impact. You'll partner with research to coordinate how unique insights reach market. You'll work with sales to understand what helps them win. You'll collaborate across teams to ensure content lands with the right people at the right time. 

Content Planning & Strategy: Work with the Senior Director of Corporate Marketing to understand narrative direction, then build your operating model: what content do we need? What’s the cadence? How do long-form and short-form reinforce each other? How do we coordinate with research? 

Long-Form Content Creation: Partner with the Head of Research to take research insights and turn them into high-quality published content: whitepapers, reports, thought leadership pieces, industry guides. Write, edit, and shepherd content through publication. Work with executives and subject matter experts to develop and publish bylines and opinion pieces. Manage the publishing rhythm and coordinate how research gets packaged for different audiences. 

Short-Form Content & Distribution: Develop and execute social media strategy that amplifies long-form content and captures real-time market moments. Create a sustainable flow of blog posts, email content, and newsletter material. Repurpose long-form insights into social series, sales assets, webinar material. Make sure content reaches the audiences who need it. 

Performance & Optimization:  Establish measurement frameworks upfront. Track engagement, reach, audience growth, and business impact. Use data to understand what's resonating: which topics, which formats, which channels? Iterate based on results. Partner with sales to understand how content is being used and where gaps exist. Translate content into compelling social media programming, including executive video content, partner-driven stories, event roundups, and campaign amplification. 

Collaboration & Execution Work seamlessly across teams: research, product marketing, creative, sales, growth marketing. Be the person who knows what's coming, coordinates timing, and makes sure content lands well. Hit deadlines. Manage multiple workstreams. Communicate clearly about progress and blockers. 

AI-Augmented Workflow Leverage AI tools as a core part of your workflow to increase output velocity, accelerate research, and iterate on drafts efficiently. Bring the editorial judgment to know when AI assists and when human voice, nuance, and credibility must lead  

Who You Are:

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in content marketing, content strategy, corporate communications, or related work in B2B tech, SaaS, or ideally ad tech, with evidence of building high impact content programs end-to-end 
  • A genuinely strong writer with demonstrated range: long-form research and reports, short-form social and email, executive voice, and web copy, and the ability to shift voice and format without losing quality 
  • Strategic thinking paired with execution: you ask "what story needs to exist" before deciding how to tell it, but you also know how to get it made and shipped 
  • Experience developing content that ties to business outcomes, whether that's driving customer engagement, enabling sales, or building thought leadership that moves the market 
  • Comfort with data and measurement: you establish success metrics before you create, track what lands, and pivot based on what's actually working 
  • Project management chops: you juggle multiple content workstreams, hit deadlines, coordinate across teams (research, sales, product, creative), and maintain quality at pace 
  • Hands-on approach to AI tools: you leverage AI for research, drafting, and optimization, but you know when human judgment and editorial voice must lead 
  • Familiarity with programmatic advertising, ad tech, or the digital media ecosystem — or a clear, genuine eagerness to develop deep fluency quickly by reading, learning, and asking the right questions

Title: Program Manager
Description:
Clear Creek Federal is part of the Seneca Nation Group (SNG) portfolio of companies. SNG is Seneca Holdings' federal government contracting business that meets mission-critical needs of federal civilian, defense, and intelligence community customers. Our portfolio comprises multiple subsidiaries that participate in the Small Business Administration 8(a) program. To learn more about SNG, visit the website and follow us on LinkedIn.

Our team of talented individuals is what makes us successful. To support our team, we provide a balanced mix of benefits and programs. Your total rewards package includes competitive pay, benefits, and perks, flexible work-life balance, professional development opportunities, and performance and recognition programs. We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life, and disability, voluntary benefit programs (critical illness, hospital, and accident), health savings and flexible spending accounts, and retirement 401K plan. One of our fundamental principles is to offer competitive health and welfare benefits to our team members, providing coverage and care for you and your family. Full-time employees working at least 30 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in our benefits and paid leave programs.  We pride ourselves on our collaborative work environment and culture, which embraces our mission of providing financial and non-financial benefits back to the members of the Seneca Nation.

About the Program

The U.S. Army Communications-Electronics Command (CECOM) Software Engineering Center, Intelligence Electromagnetic Warfare and Sensors (IEW&S) Directorate, operates the Army Reprogramming Analysis Team (ARAT) at Aberdeen Proving Ground. ARAT builds, tests, and distributes mission software for fielded electromagnetic warfare systems, including the AN/APR-39 radar warning receiver family, the AN/APR-48A/B Modernized Radar Frequency Interferometer, the Aircraft Gateway Processor on the AH-64, and the AN/VLQ-12 CREW Duke. ARAT targets its mission software products to 14 geographic areas of responsibility across six combatant commands.

The ARAT Innovation Initiatives effort modernizes that infrastructure: browser-based threat modeling in the Signal Modeling Framework, automated RF hardware-in-the-loop testing through the Unified Test Automation Suite and software-defined radios, an automated Air/Terrestrial Testbed, test data warehousing, automated mission data product generation, and the ASPEN software distribution portal across NIPR, SIPR, and JWICS. Work is executed in Agile sprints with DevSecOps practices in a Government-approved GitLab environment.

Position Summary

The Program Manager is the contractor’s single point of accountability for cost, schedule, and technical performance across the entire ARAT task order. This is a program management position rather than a project scheduling position. The role owns the contract-level baseline, signs the tasking and cost documents that put work on contract, and stands in front of the Government at every formal review.

This is the first position filled on the contract and it is staffed for the life of the effort. The Program Manager builds out the delivery team across roughly 25 labor categories spanning software engineering, test and evaluation, RF and electronic warfare, data and AI, and cyber and cloud, then keeps that team matched to a portfolio of approximately 10 to 15 funded projects per year, with about five running concurrently.

Key Responsibilities

Program leadership and growth

  • Identify capability gaps and deficiencies across the ARAT environment, develop candidate future work, and propose it to the Government for prioritization within the Program Management Plan process.
  • Break complex software requirements into multi-sprint projects and build the long-term roadmap that shows the Government the path to its highest-priority features and capabilities.
  • Serve as the contractor’s day-to-day interface to the Contracting Officer’s Representative and the Government technical lead on cost, schedule, performance, risk, and mitigation.

Contract-level program management

  • Conduct the Post-Award Brief within at start of performance, in coordination with the Contracting Officer’s Representative and the Contracting Officer, covering stakeholder roles, the transition to full performance, and shared cost, schedule, and performance expectations.
  • Own the Program Management Plan, a resource-loaded baseline covering schedule, an expenditure plan aligned to milestones, Other Direct Costs, quantified deliverables, and risk with mitigation. Deliver the initial plan at award, update it quarterly, and update it with each new project tasking.
  • Produce the Monthly Status Reports: per-project and overall task order status, planned versus actual expenditures, monthly and cumulative ODC, risk status and mitigation, deliverables funded and completed, and all funding received with source and date.
  • Conduct Quarterly Management Reviews with the COR covering cost, schedule, performance, risk assessment, and mitigation plans.
  • Deliver Final Technical Reports on the contract schedule, including the initial report at the midpoint of the period of performance and the draft and completed reports at its close.
  • Prepare and sign the Project Task Form for each funded project, covering the capability need, the deliverables table with format and due date, contractor assumptions, risk and mitigation, GFI/GFE/CAP requirements, labor by company and category with hours and rates, travel, and other direct costs. Route each form for budget review and Government concurrence and maintain its change request log.
  • Report all contractor and subcontractor labor hours through the Army Service Contract Report system annually, and report contract expenditures through the eCRAFT Enterprise (E2) system concurrent with each invoice. Compliance with both is a material requirement of the contract.
  • Plan and execute the 60-day phase-out at the end of the contract, including the phase-out plan, the transition summit at APG, and disposition of all Government property.

Project and portfolio management support

  • Provide project status and budget documentation support for approximately 10 to 15 projects per year, including milestone preparation with estimated cost and manpower, cost accounting, documentation of spending delays, revised program and budget submittals, and back-up data and charts for budget reviews. Report percentage complete on each individual project at program milestone reviews.
  • Prepare recommendations on project objectives, operating schedules, resource requirements, and overall program plans for the ARAT Program Office.
  • Prepare, analyze, and update budgetary documentation for all developed software releases, and maintain monthly financial reporting across all ARAT-funded activities.
  • Conduct Government-directed resource studies for systems transitioning to continuous integration and continuous development software support, and recommend resource levels for assigned projects.
  • Maintain Government-provided project tracking databases. GitLab is the current method of record for tracking ARAT research and development efforts.
  • Support technical interchange meetings across an annual rhythm of roughly six monthly engineering briefs, twelve staff briefings, twelve financial meetings, and up to twenty-four ad hoc meetings, including minutes, facilitation, audiovisual support, and technical presentations.
  • Support Program Objective Memorandum review preparation, approximately four per year.
  • Lead, participate in, and coordinate Integrated Product Teams for Concept of Operations development. Typically five to ten IPTs are active at a time.

Research and development oversight

  • Provide technical and programmatic oversight of R&D projects, tracking schedules and evaluating deliverables for up to 15 projects per year.
  • Manage transfer of R&D deliverables to the designated receiving official.
  • Perform requirements document review, editing, change tracking, and staffing for review and approval, and perform quality assurance on R&D project documentation.
  • Ensure accuracy and monitoring of schedules and deliverables on Project Tracking Forms.
  • Perform quality assurance, tracking, and archiving of travel requests and associated trip reports.
  • Support Acceptance Test Plan development, planning, and execution, at an estimated volume of six to eight per year.

Team building and personnel management

  • Recruit, hire, and onboard the delivery team across the contract’s labor categories, working with Seneca Holdings talent acquisition and Clear Creek Federal operating leadership.
  • Fill critical position vacancies within 30 calendar days and non-critical vacancies within 45 calendar days, as the contract requires.
  • Verify that every team member meets or exceeds the labor category description and minimum qualifications, and support COR resume verification.
  • Track mandatory training compliance using contractor resources and report status in the Monthly Status Report. This includes AT Level I at start, iWATCH briefing, ATCTS registration, DoD Cybersecurity Awareness training, OPSEC Level I, annual TARP training, and DoD 8140 / 8570.01-M baseline certification for personnel in cybersecurity and IT functions.
  • Ensure signed non-disclosure agreements are on file for all employees.
  • Manage the subcontractor relationship and the quarterly workshare reconciliation.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, business, or a related discipline.
  • Ten or more years of progressive program or project management experience supporting Department of Defense customers, including at least three years with profit and loss or full cost, schedule, and technical accountability for a contract or task order.
  • Active DoD Secret clearance at time of application.
  • Demonstrated experience managing a cost-reimbursement contract, including monthly cost reporting, estimate at completion and estimate to complete discipline, funding and burn-rate management, and limitation of funds or limitation of cost notification.
  • Experience preparing and delivering formal contract deliverables to a Government customer, including status reports, management review packages, and technical reports.
  • Experience building resource-loaded schedules and basis-of-estimate documentation, including labor category mix, hours, travel, and other direct costs.
  • Advanced Excel, including building and maintaining structured cost and level-of-effort workbooks with linked formulas, and producing recurring cost and status reports from them. Familiarity with eCRAFT or E2 vendor reporting is a plus.
  • Direct working relationships with Contracting Officers, Contracting Officer’s Representatives, and Government technical leads.
  • Experience recruiting and standing up a technical delivery team on a new contract.
  • Working knowledge of the FAR and DFARS as applied to services contracts, including Government property administration under FAR Part 45.
  • Ability to work on-site at Aberdeen Proving Ground as required, and to travel CONUS and occasionally OCONUS.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification. Other credentials that carry weight: PMI-ACP, Certified ScrumMaster or Professional Scrum Master I, ITIL 4 Foundation, and Lean Six Sigma Green Belt.
  • Top Secret clearance eligibility. The majority of the technical team on this effort holds Top Secret, and several positions require TS/SCI.
  • Experience in the electromagnetic warfare, electronic warfare, or aircraft survivability equipment domain, or with Army software reprogramming under AR 525-15.
  • Experience managing Agile and DevSecOps software delivery, including sprint cadence, backlog and milestone management, and release governance.
  • Hands-on familiarity with GitLab issue boards, milestones, and epics as a program management system of record, not only as a developer tool.
  • Experience with Microsoft Project or Jira, and with Power BI or an equivalent tool for management review dashboards.
  • Prior experience at Aberdeen Proving Ground or with CECOM, ACC-APG, or a PEO IEW&S customer.
  • Experience managing a small business prime with a subcontractor team arrangement, including workshare compliance under 13 CFR 125.6.

Work Environment

The primary place of performance is Aberdeen Proving Ground, Maryland. This role is hybrid: contractor location carries some flexibility, but on-site presence at APG is required for integration work on the secret network, for formal reviews, and for laboratory access. ARAT laboratories are available during normal business hours of 0600 to 1800 Eastern; weekend and holiday access is coordinated with COR awareness. Travel is to Government facilities between 10-25% of working time, typically at the end of projects to set up, configure, test and gain acceptance of technical deliverables.
