Title: Senior Program Manager - Data Security & Information Governance
Description:
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers. 

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

Senior Program Manager, Data Security & Information Governance

Why We Have This Role

We’re hiring a Senior Program Manager, Data Security & Information Governance to establish, scale, and orchestrate our enterprise Information Governance program. You’ll sit at the intersection of Legal, Data & Technology Operations, and Enterprise Data, bridging the gap between business strategy, legal compliance, data security, and engineering. Rather than acting as a traditional gatekeeper, you will build and manage our "Data Front Door" to directly address how teams discover data rights, request entitlements, and explore novel data use cases safely and efficiently.

How You’ll Find Success

  • Governance Framework & Tooling Strategy: Deep fluency in establishing enterprise data governance frameworks, data catalogs, and business glossaries that scale across high-growth SaaS environments.

  • Operational Enablement: Proven capability to design centralized intake and triage processes ("Data Front Door") that convert complex legal and security constraints into frictionless, self-service internal workflows.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Ability to bridge legal compliance (HIPAA, GDPR, CCPA) with technical access controls (RBAC/ABAC, tokenization), working seamlessly alongside engineering, security, and product teams.

  • Proactive Execution: Takes initiative to define the "how" in ambiguous regulatory or operational spaces, driving cross-functional alignment and resolving data policy conflicts across teams.

  • Adaptive Curiosity: A drive to stay ahead of evolving data privacy laws, security architectures, and novel AI/ML data use cases to keep our governance models modern and flexible.

How You’ll Grow

  • Master Enterprise Data Architecture: Expand your expertise across cloud data architectures (Snowflake, Databricks, AWS/GCP) and automated metadata pipelines to build modern, tech-enabled governance structures.

  • Bridge Legal and Engineering Operations: Deepen your technical competency in access management (Okta, Immuta, Privacera) and data security capabilities, dissolving the divide between legal strategy and technical execution.

  • Influence Platform Scale: Set the patterns and primitives for data use across a platform serving 18K+ global clients, ensuring data minimization, privacy-by-design, and compliant AI experimentation.

Things You’ll Do

  • Build the "Data Front Door": Design and manage a centralized intake and triage process for custom data access requests, novel data questions, and complex derivative work inquiries.

  • Curate the Data Marketplace: Establish a centralized Use Case Repository and Data Marketplace detailing pre-approved data uses, restrictions, and licensing parameters across distinct datasets.

  • Automate Metadata & Classification: Partner with engineering and security teams to implement automated data classification, lineage tracking, and metadata harvesting.

  • Translate Policy into Technical Controls: Collaborate with InfoSec to operationalize legal requirements into enforced technical access controls (RBAC/ABAC) and row/column-level security protocols.

  • Drive Governance Adoption: Measure program success through adoption KPIs, request turnaround times, and governance maturity metrics, delivering self-service documentation and onboarding across the org.

What We’re Looking For On Your Resume

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Governance, Data Security, Data Operations, or Information Architecture within a high-growth technology, SaaS, or data-intensive organization.

  • Deep understanding of data privacy and security frameworks (HIPAA, GDPR, CCPA) and commercial data licensing nuances.

  • Direct experience setting up, configuring, or administering enterprise data governance & catalog tools (e.g., Collibra, Alation, DataGalaxy, Atlan).

  • Technical aptitude with cloud data ecosystems (Snowflake, Databricks, AWS/GCP), SQL, and data security mechanisms (hashing, tokenization, differential privacy).

  • Demonstrated ability to create business-friendly, self-service workflows that accelerate R&D and AI/ML initiatives while ensuring strict compliance.

  • Preferred certifications: CDMP, CIPP/US, CIPT, CDPSE, CISSP, or CISM.

What You Should Know About This Team

  • Enablement Over Gatekeeping: We view governance as a business driver. Our goal is to make doing the right thing with data the easiest path for our product, engineering, and business teams.

  • Cross-Functional Influence: You will sit at the crossroads of Legal, InfoSec, and Platform Engineering, serving as the connective tissue that translates legal policies into automated technical realities.

  • Built for Scale: As Qualtrics expands its AI and data capabilities, you will build the foundational governance frameworks that ensure our growth remains safe, ethical, and fully compliant.

Why you’ll want to join us: Most design teams are talking about AI; we are the ones building the engine that powers it. If you want to bridge the gap between design and development, thrive in high-autonomy environments, and see your code directly power intelligent experiences for 18K+ global clients, this is the place to be. We don’t just design the future—we code it, test it, and ship it.

Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits 

  • Team cohesion is deeply important to us - we have frequent office events and regular team activities
  • Qualtrics Experience Program - $1,800 for an experience of your choosing (eligible after a year)
  • We take pride in our office design aimed at fostering creativity, from our mountain views to an open and collaborative workspace.
  • 30 paid days off - 15 Vacation Days + 5 Personal Days + 10 Holiday Closures (additional after a year)
  • On top of standard benefits package (medical employees and their families, dental, vision, life insurance, etc) we provide free lunches every work day, snacks, and drinks

 

The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model: Our hybrid work model is elegantly simple: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #remote

Title: Senior Clinical Program Manager
Description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

This is a unique opportunity for a Clinical Operations Professional. As a Sr. Clinical Program Manager, you will be responsible for acting as a central contact for the Clinical Study Team(s) and assist with the execution and management of Revolution Medicines (RevMed) clinical trials.

Responsibilities:

  • Adhere to Clinical Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) Guidelines.

  • Be a team leader, providing guidance and oversight for the successful management of all aspects of clinical trials within timelines and designated program budgets.

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to manage, adjust, and revise project timelines and budgets as needed

  • Analyze data health metrics to be shared with stakeholders.

  • Actively partner with cross-functional teams and vendors to drive the query resolution and data listings review process to meet objectives in a timely and efficient process.

  • Conduct risk management, contingency, and scenario planning.

  • Supervise, communicate project status/issues, and problem solve to ensure project team goals are met.

  • Participate in the development of all study-related documentation, including study protocols.

  • Actively contribute in the selection and management of contract research organizations (CROs) and/or vendors, including development of requests for proposals (RFPs).

  • Use all available tools to track, oversee, and communicate on program status to all key stakeholders.

  • Demonstrate the ability to lead and manage multiple complex clinical trials within one or multiple programs with limited oversight.

  • Independently lead Clinical Study Execution Team (CSETs) and influence relevant stakeholders both internally and externally including management.

  • May lead interdepartmental strategic business initiatives as well as spearhead certain SOP development and training.

  • May provide input into strategic and operational short- and long-term therapeutic area development, as appropriate, including supporting alignment and communication to other team members upon implementation

  • Assists in the hiring, development, and retention of top talent within the team. Coach direct report(s) on their performance, development, and career interests.

  • Participate in other Clinical Operations activities as appropriate. 

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

  • RN or Bachelor’s or Masters degree in biological sciences or health-related field required.

  • 10+ years direct Clinical Operations experience in the pharmaceutical or biotech industry, preferably in Clinical Operations or Clinical Research-related experience. Relevant indirect experiences may also meet the requirement.

  • Minimum of 6 years of cross-functional study management or related leadership experience in life sciences, including multiple years’ experience managing project teams.

  • Experience in Oncology Trials

  • Strong working knowledge of FDA Regulations, ICH Guidelines, and GCP.

  • Proven ability to successfully start-up, manage, and close-out clinical trials, including authoring clinical study and regulatory documentation and SOPs.

  • Experience in selection of CROs/vendors and management of external resources.

  • Thrives in a collaborative team setting that demonstrates flexibility required to maintain a fast pace and is driven by a desire to deploy innovative approaches and technologies in a high-energy environment.

  • Be solution-oriented by anticipating obstacles and difficulties, and proactively providing risk assessment and mitigation strategies to achieve project goals.

  • Excellent written/verbal communication and interpersonal skills.

  • High sense of priority and commitment to excellence in the successful execution of deliverables.

  • Ability to analyze operational data, contribute with a mind on quality, timeliness and fiscal responsibility, make and drive decisions, multi-task, prioritize tasks, anticipate challenges, and execute on goals as a member of an interdisciplinary team.

  • Demonstrate proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint); MS Project and/or Smartsheet a plus.

  • Travel may be required (~25%).

Preferred Skills:

  • Familiarity working with vendor systems/portals (e.g., eTMF, EDC, IRT, CTMS).

  • Oncology experience, early and/or late stage, strongly preferred.

  • Knowledge and/or familiarity with Ex-US region(s) clinical trial operations.

  • Some experience managing direct reports.

Title: Director, Medical Content and Training, Europe
Description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

As we continue to grow, Revolution Medicines is seeking a Director, Medical Content and Training, Europe, to lead the development, implementation, and execution of medical and scientific content and training strategies for the European Medical Affairs teams.

This role will partner closely with the Global Medical Content and Training team to ensure that Field Medical Advisors, Medical Science Liaisons (MSLs), and other Medical Affairs functions across Europe are equipped with timely, rigorous medical resources and have the scientific depth, disease-state knowledge, and engagement skills necessary to support external interactions with the medical and scientific community.

Reporting to the VP, Medical Affairs, Europe, this individual will also play a critical role in preparing the European Medical team for product launches across the region in oncology, supporting field excellence, and ensuring they are equipped with the necessary knowledge and materials to communicate scientific data effectively.

Key Responsibilities

  • Medical Affairs Training Strategy & Execution for the European Region.

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive strategically aligned Medical Affairs training roadmap to ensure scientific fluency across across the European region.

  • Lead the design and implementation of high-impact scientific training and field excellence programs for new hires and ongoing professional development for MSLs and other Medical Affairs functions.

  • Leverage global training resources to prepare training curricula to enhance therapeutic area expertise, scientific knowledge, external engagement skills, and competitive insights for European teams.

  • Organize scientific deep dives, journal clubs, education forums, and training workshops to maintain a high level of scientific competency and field excellence within Medical Affairs.

  • Ensure training programs are adaptable to different levels of scientific expertise within the team and align with product lifecycle milestones.

  • Implement training assessments to measure the effectiveness of scientific learning and identify areas for continuous improvement.

  • ldentifies, evaluates and manages vendors to support training and operational needs.

  • Documents and maintain proper records of training initiatives.

Development of Scientific & Medical Content for Internal & External Use

  • Oversee the regionalization and/or creation of Global scientific materials to support external engagements, including MSL slide decks, infographics, multimedia and other scientific-exchange resources for utilization across the European region.

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders (Medical Strategy, Medical Communications, Clinical Development, Regulatory, Commercial, Legal, Compliance) to ensure medical content is aligned with company strategy and meets regulatory and legal requirements.

Oncology Launch Readiness & Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Partner with Medical Affairs leadership to develop a structured pre-launch training plan, ensuring the team is scientifically prepared to support product launch within Europe.

  • Work closely with Field Medical/MSL teams to ensure alignment between scientific training, medical content, and external engagement strategy.

  • Establish best practices for scientific engagement and communication across all Medical Affairs functions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Leadership

  • Work closely with Global Medical Content and Training, MSL Excellence, Field Medical, Medical Communications, Medical Information, and Medical Strategy teams to align on training priorities and content needs.

  • Partner with Clinical Development, Commercial, and Market Access teams to ensure a cohesive and well-informed approach to scientific communication.

  • Lead cross-functional meetings to assess training needs and ensure scientific alignment across the organization.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

  • Advanced scientific or medical degree (PhD, PharmD, MD) preferred; MS or equivalent experience in biomedical sciences or related field considered.

  • 10+ years of experience in Medical Affairs, Scientific Training, Field Excellence or Medical Communications within the biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry.

  • Strong expertise in scientific content development and training program design for Medical Affairs teams, including Field teams.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex scientific data into clear, engaging, and compliant medical content for various stakeholders.

  • Experience developing scientific training curricula, onboarding programs, and continuous learning initiatives.

  • Proven ability to work cross-functionally with Field Medical, Medical Information, Medical Communications, and Commercial teams to develop consistent messaging and training programs.

  • Strong oncology experience preferred, particularly in precision medicine, targeted therapies, or RAS/oncogene-driven cancers.

  • Deep understanding of European industry guidelines and regulations for scientific content and training.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving biotech environment, managing multiple priorities effectively.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage with diverse internal and external audiences.

Preferred Skills:

  • Prior oncology launch experience in Medical Affairs training and scientific content development.

  • Familiarity with digital training platforms, virtual learning solutions, and e-learning modules.

  • Experience with MSL engagement strategies, medical education planning, and congress preparation.

  • Understanding of emerging trends in scientific communication, digital learning, and knowledge management.

Title: Director, Global Medical Content and Training
Description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

Reporting to the Head of Medical Content and Training, the Director Medical Content and Training will be responsible for shaping the Medical Affairs training and content roadmap in alignment with therapeutic area strategies and launch priorities. This role will play a critical role in preparing the team for product launches in oncology, ensuring they are equipped with the necessary knowledge and materials to communicate scientific data effectively.

This role will help ensure that the Medical Science Liaisons (MSLs), Medical Information, Medical Communications, Medical Strategy Leads, Medical Operations, and other Medical Affairs functions have the scientific depth, disease state knowledge, and engagement skills necessary to support external interactions with the medical and scientific community.

This position would ideally be based at our headquarters in Redwood City, CA., however open to remote candidates who are willing to travel to our CA office on a regular basis. You will be called upon your experience to:

  • Oversees the development of global congress booth materials including clinical trial cards, disease state infographics, MOA videos and additional related resources.

  • Leads development and execution of select global Medical Affairs content and training plans.

  • Provides strategic and scientific oversight of Medical Affairs tactical training roadmap within LMS to ensure scientific fluency across the organization.

  • Partners with Regional Medical teams to optimize regionalization of Global scientific materials to support external engagements, including MSL slide decks, infographics, multimedia and other scientific-exchange resources for utilization

  • Provides input on decisions and implementation strategy and manage actions that impact the team's budget.

  • Supports the implementation of scientific training programs for new hires and ongoing scientific training for MSLs and other Medical Affairs functions.

  • Prepares training curricula to enhance therapeutic area expertise, scientific knowledge, external engagement skills, and competitive insights.

  • Organizes scientific deep dives, medical education forums, and training workshops to maintain a high level of scientific competency within Medical Affairs.

  • Ensures training programs are adaptable to different levels of scientific expertise within the team and align with product lifecycle milestones.

  • Implements training assessments to measure the effectiveness of scientific learning and identify areas for continuous improvement.

  • Leads the creation of select scientific materials to support external engagements, including MSL decks, infographics, videos, and training guides.

  • Collaborates with internal stakeholders (Medical Strategy, Medical Communications, Clinical Development, Regulatory, Commercial, Legal, Compliance) to ensure medical content is aligned with company strategy and meets regulatory and legal requirements.

  • Partners with Medical Affairs leadership to develop a structured pre-launch training plan, ensuring the team is scientifically prepared to support product launch.

  • Works closely with Field Medical/MSL teams to ensure alignment between scientific training, medical content, and external engagement strategy.

  • Works closely with Medical Excellence, Field Medical, Medical Communications, Medical Information, and Medical Strategy teams to align on training priorities and content needs.

  • Supports cross-functional meetings to assess training needs and ensure scientific alignment across the organization.

  • Collaborates with vendor partners to manage development and execution of various deliverables.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

  • Advanced scientific or medical degree (PhD, PharmD, MD).

  • 10+ years of experience in Medical Affairs, Scientific Training, or Medical Communications within the biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry.

  • Strong expertise in scientific content development, including booth materials, and training program design for Medical Affairs teams.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex scientific data into clear, engaging, and compliant medical content for various stakeholders.

  • Experience developing scientific training curricula, onboarding programs, and continuous learning initiatives.

  • Proven ability to work cross-functionally with Field Medical, Medical Information, Medical Communications, and Commercial teams to develop consistent messaging and training programs.

  • Strong oncology experience preferred, particularly in precision medicine, targeted therapies, or RAS/oncogene-driven cancers.

  • Deep understanding of industry guidelines (e.g., PhRMA Code, OIG, ACCME, FDA, and other global regulatory requirements) for scientific content and training.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving biotech environment, managing multiple priorities effectively.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage with diverse internal and external audiences.

Preferred Skills:

  • Prior oncology launch experience in Medical Affairs training and scientific content development.

  • Familiarity with digital training platforms, virtual learning solutions, and e-learning modules.

  • Experience with MSL engagement strategies, medical education planning, and congress preparation.

  • Understanding of emerging trends in scientific communication, digital learning, and knowledge management.

Title: Program Manager -VALORANT Mobile
Description:
Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused game development can result in great games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends to critical and player acclaim. As the most played video game in the world, over 100 million play every month. Players form the foundation of our community and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience.

We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. We embrace those who see things differently, aren’t afraid to experiment, and who have a healthy disregard for constraints.

That's where you come in.

As a Program Manager on the VALORANT Mobile team, you will help the team operate more effectively across Riot partners and external development partners. This role is centered on program leadership rather than direct feature review or product ownership.

You will improve the systems, operating rhythms, and collaboration models that help VALORANT Mobile move with greater clarity, predictability, and efficiency. You will be a force multiplier for the broader product team by helping leaders and partners prioritize work, facilitate alignment, identify the right stakeholders, and define actionable next steps in ambiguous cross-functional spaces.

A key part of this role will be partnering closely with Riot stakeholders to improve our greenlight process for feature and content development, enabling both sides to work with stronger transparency, clearer ownership, and more efficient decision-making.

You will report to the Product Lead of VALORANT Mobile.

Responsibilities:

  • Help the VALORANT Mobile product team prioritize complex work across multiple initiatives, functions, and partner teams by creating clarity on goals, trade-offs, ownership, and actionable next steps
  • Facilitate alignment across Riot and external stakeholders by identifying the right decision-makers, driving discussions to clear outcomes, and helping the team navigate complex cross-functional dependencies and escalation paths
  • Help reshape the current greenlight process across different types of features and content for VALORANT Mobile, to evolve the steps, methods, and collaboration model as the game, its operating needs, and its stakeholder landscape continue to change post-launch
  • Drive cross-functional coordination for regular patches and major moments, ensuring teams stay aligned on scope, timing, dependencies, and readiness
  • Build and maintain strong operating systems, including trackers, planning rituals, decision logs, communication loops, and escalation paths that improve team visibility, accountability, and follow-through
  • Proactively identify risks, blockers, and dependency gaps early, then work with partners to resolve issues and keep strategically important work moving
  • Build effective working relationships across Riot and external partners, while communicating priorities, status, risks, and decisions clearly to leadership and stakeholders over time

Required Qualifications:

  • 6+ years of experience in program management, project management, production, operations, or a related role in game development, live services, or similarly cross-functional environments
  • Demonstrated experience driving high-complexity, strategically important cross-functional programs from planning through execution
  • Strong prioritization and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn ambiguity, competing goals, and incomplete information into clear action plans
  • Excellent facilitation, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with experience guiding teams toward decisions and alignment across complex or contentious spaces
  • Experience building or improving processes, planning rituals, and workflow systems that increase transparency, predictability, and execution quality
  • Experience working with distributed teams and external or co-development partners across different cultures, incentives, and working styles
  • Proven ability to identify risks early, manage dependencies, and drive mitigation plans across multiple workstreams
  • Strong documentation and operational tool fluency, including Google Docs, Google Sheets, Slides, Airtable, Jira, Trello, or similar systems
  • Fluency in both English and Mandarin

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience working on tactical shooters, competitive multiplayer games, or mobile live service products
  • Experience improving approval workflows, collaboration models, or operating processes across internal and external teams
  • Experience working in a large, matrixed, and globally distributed organization
  • Familiarity with live game development rhythms such as patch planning, release readiness, seasonal beats, and ongoing cross-team execution support
  • Passion for VALORANT and strong instincts for how to help teams work effectively in service of a great player experience

For this role, you’ll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players.

 

Riot Games 成立于 2006 年，由一群坚信“以玩家为中心的开发理念可以带来真正伟大游戏”的玩家所创立。2020 年，Riot 正式推出 VALORANT，为战术竞技射击品类树立了新的标杆。随着 VALORANT 持续拓展至更多平台，VALORANT Mobile 将承担把这种高强度、高精度的竞技体验带给更多全球玩家的重要使命。

我们正在寻找兼具谦逊心态、进取精神与优秀判断力的伙伴。你愿意带来自己的经验与观点，也乐于在高标准环境中不断学习和打磨。你相信，优秀的执行并不只来自个人能力，更来自清晰的决策机制、健康的团队运转，以及高质量的跨团队合作。

这就是你登场的舞台。

作为 VALORANT Mobile 团队的项目经理，你将帮助团队在 Riot 内部合作方与外部联合研发伙伴之间建立更高效的协作方式。这个职位的核心并不是直接负责功能评审或产品 owner 工作，而是通过 program leadership 提升团队整体运转效率。

你将负责优化团队的工作机制、协作节奏与跨团队推进方式，帮助 VALORANT Mobile 在复杂环境下更清晰、更可预测、更高效地推进关键事项。你会成为整个产品团队的放大器，帮助团队完成优先级判断、推动对齐、识别正确的相关方，并在模糊且跨职能的问题空间中定义明确、可执行的下一步。

这个职位的关键职责之一，是与Riot 各方伙伴紧密合作，持续优化 feature 与 content 的 greenlight process，让双方在透明度、责任归属与决策效率上都达到更高标准。

你将汇报给 VALORANT Mobile 的 Product Lead。

职责描述

  • 帮助 VALORANT Mobile 产品团队在多个项目、多个职能与多个合作团队之间，对复杂事项进行优先级排序，明确目标、取舍、负责人以及可执行的后续行动
  • 推动 Riot 内外部相关方达成一致，识别正确的决策相关方，推动讨论形成清晰结论，并帮助团队处理复杂的跨团队依赖与升级路径
  • 帮助重塑 VALORANT Mobile 针对不同类型功能与内容的现有 greenlight 流程，随着游戏进入上线后新阶段、运营需求持续演变以及相关方结构发生变化，不断优化 greenlight 的步骤、方法与整体协作模式
  • 推动常规版本与重要版本节点的跨团队协调，确保各团队在范围、节奏、依赖关系与就绪度上保持一致
  • 建立并维护清晰有效的团队运转机制，包括追踪表、规划节奏、决策记录、沟通节奏与升级路径，提升团队整体可见性、责任感与执行跟进质量
  • 提前识别风险、阻塞与依赖缺口，并联合相关团队推动问题解决，确保战略重要事项持续前进
  • 与 Riot及外部合作方建立高质量合作关系，并持续以清晰方式向管理层与相关方同步优先级、状态、风险与关键决策

基本要求

  • 6 年以上项目管理、项目推进、制作、运营，或其他相关岗位经验，具备游戏研发、长线运营或类似复杂跨职能环境中的工作背景
  • 有推动高复杂度、战略优先级高的跨团队项目从规划到落地的实际经验
  • 具备很强的优先级判断与问题拆解能力，能够把模糊信息、冲突目标与不完整输入转化为清晰的行动方案
  • 具备优秀的会议引导、沟通与相关方管理能力，能够在复杂或存在争议的场景中推动团队做出决策并达成一致
  • 有建立或优化流程、计划机制与协作系统的经验，能够有效提升透明度、可预测性与执行质量
  • 有与分布式团队、外部团队或联合研发伙伴合作的经验，能够适应不同文化背景、激励机制与工作方式
  • 能够提前识别风险、管理依赖关系，并推动跨工作流的风险缓解方案
  • 具备良好的文档与运营工具使用能力，包括 Google Docs、Google Sheets、Slides、Airtable、Jira、Trello 或类似工具
  • 中英文流利，能够支持本地与全球团队协作

加分项

  • 有战术射击、竞技多人游戏或移动端长线运营产品相关经验
  • 有优化审批流程、跨团队协作模型或团队运转流程的经验
  • 有在大型矩阵式、全球分布式组织中工作的经验
  • 熟悉长线运营游戏开发的核心节奏，例如版本规划、上线准备、赛季节奏与持续性的跨团队推进
  • 热爱 VALORANT，并对如何通过更好的团队协作来服务玩家体验有较强直觉

这个职位的成功，来自于你扎实的专业能力、合作意识，以及始终把玩家体验放在重要位置的判断方式。

Title: Content Producer, Wild Rift (Contract)

Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused game development can result in great games. Players form the foundation of our community and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience. 

We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. That's where you come in. 

As Content Producer, Wild Rift, you will report to the Publishing creative production Lead and serve as a key pillar of production excellence within the publishing team. This role supports a broad range of content initiatives across channel, product marketing, and moment-based campaigns. 

The Content Producer is expected to flex across different publishing functions, supporting evolving business priorities and creative needs. Your awareness and transparent communication will provide you with a comprehensive understanding of our campaign requirements, allowing you to advocate for their needs and ensure they are fulfilled. 

You will be responsible for translating strategic goals into high-quality creative deliverables that surprise and delight our players , owning end-to-end production workflows, and managing agency partnerships to ensure scalable, efficient, and brand-consistent execution.

Production Excellence 

  • Lead end-to-end production of Wild Rift publishing assets, ensuring high craft standards, efficiency, and timely delivery. 
  • Drive structured production planning, risk management, and cross-functional alignment across internal teams.
  • Maintain clear documentation, content calendars, and production tracking systems to ensure operational rigor. 

Agency & RFP Management 

  • Own the RFP (Request for Proposal) process and agency onboarding. Identify, evaluate, and manage external vendors to ensure high-quality, cost-effective creative execution.

Cross-Functional Production Execution 

Own and drive the production execution of specific publishing tactics across multiple areas, including:

  • Gaming Passion: Strong interest in mobile game marketing (MOBA genre preferred).

Title: Manager, Global Deal Operations & Governance
Description:
Manager, Global Deal Operations & Governance

About the role

Rubrik's Deal Operations team sits at the center of quote-to-cash. We own the complex, exception-based quoting work that keeps deals moving — the things standard systems can't do on their own — and we bring Sales, Finance, Renewals, and IT together so decisions get made with the full picture of how our systems actually work.

We're hiring a Manager, Global Deal Operations and Governance to lead that team day to day — someone equally comfortable running a tight operation and driving change across the organization. It's a role for a leader who thrives in ambiguity, turns deep system complexity into clear recommendations, and knows the difference between keeping the lights on and making the operation fundamentally better.

What you'll do

  • Lead and develop a global team of deal operations analysts across regions and time zones — ownership, workload, coaching, performance, and hiring.
  • Own the health of day-to-day deal operations — exception quoting, case management, approval queues, and CSAT/replacement handling — to the speed and accuracy targets Sales and Finance depend on, especially at quarter-end.
  • Set clear ownership and service levels so work stops falling through the cracks or escalating unnecessarily.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives that make the operation better — streamlining the quoting experience for Sales, partnering with IT/CPQ on system enhancements, and standardizing process documentation and enablement.
  • Represent the team in cross-functional and leadership forums; synthesize system-level complexity into clear, decision-ready recommendations and make defensible calls in ambiguous situations.
  • Partner across quote-to-cash — Deal Governance, Deal Structuring, Finance, Renewals, IT/CPQ, and Sales — so new programs and deal types are designed with operational reality in mind.
  • Distinguish keep-the-lights-on work from root-cause fixes, and drive down manual overhead through better process and automation.
  • Serve as an escalation point and subject-matter expert for complex, exception-based quoting.

What we're looking for

  • 7+ years in deal desk, deal operations, revenue operations, or quote-to-cash, with a strong grasp of CPQ (Salesforce/SFDC) and complex quoting.
  • People-management experience, or clear readiness to step into it — you've led work and people through ambiguity and quarter-end pressure.
  • Comfort in the grey area — energized, not paralyzed, by problems without a clean playbook; you can make a defensible call and move.
  • Strong upward communication — you translate technical, system-level complexity into crisp, decision-ready recommendations for senior leaders.
  • A change-driver's instinct — you see the difference between firefighting and fixing the root cause, and you push for the fix.
  • Systems-and-process orientation: you understand how upstream decisions ripple through downstream systems (booking, revenue, commissions, forecasting).

Title: Breach Readiness Consultant
Description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Breach Readiness Consultant, you will be tasked with supporting the delivery of cutting-edge cybersecurity incident preparation and knowledge-building services to global enterprises. Working alongside senior consultants and engagement leads, you will facilitate tabletop exercises, breach simulations, war rooms, and purple team engagements that push the limits of customer preparedness. This is a role that blends technical acumen with strong communication skills to create lasting, measurable impact.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Assist with the delivery of industry-leading Breach Readiness services, including workshops, tabletops, war rooms, and purple team engagements under the direction of senior consultants and engagement leads.
  • Support the design, facilitation, and execution of realistic incident response exercises tailored to customer environments, threat landscapes, and organizational maturity levels.
  • Contribute to the development of detailed and impactful deliverables, including lessons-learned reports, security improvement recommendations, and incident response playbooks.
  • Collaborate with customers to gather requirements, understand business objectives, and translate technical findings into actionable security improvements.
  • Support the continuous improvement of Breach Readiness services based on evolving threat trends, threat intelligence, and customer feedback.
  • Present technical findings and recommendations to diverse audiences, from frontline security teams to C-level executives, ensuring clarity and impact.
  • Maintain awareness of emerging threats, attacker tactics, and industry best practices in incident response and breach readiness.
  • Contribute to customer success and thought leadership through documentation, case studies, and industry publications where appropriate.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • Experience delivering incident response exercises, tabletop simulations, war games, security awareness training, or similar preparedness engagements.
  • Proven ability to present technical information clearly and persuasively to diverse audiences, from technical practitioners to executive leadership.
  • Enthusiastic, driven, and confident, with the ability to clearly articulate SentinelOne's mission, product value, and business opportunity to customers and internal teams.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to distill complex technical concepts into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Strong interpersonal and client management skills, with the ability to build rapport and collaborate effectively with customers across all levels.
  • Self-starter with intellectual curiosity, adaptability, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, client-facing services environment.
  • Strong foundational knowledge of incident response processes, security frameworks (NIST, ISO 27035, etc.), and breach response best practices.
  • Experience with EDR/XDR platforms (SentinelOne preferred) and security operations centers (SOCs) is preferred.
  • Background in incident response, threat hunting, or security consulting is preferred.
  • Relevant industry certifications such as GCIH, ECIH, CEH, or CISSP are a plus.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Equity & Rewards

  • Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Time Off & Wellbeing

  • Competitive leave benefits
  • Gender-neutral parental leave

Insurance & Financial Security

  • Medical and insurance benefits
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Work Perks & Flexibility

  • Global home office allowance
  • Internet and mobile phone allowance
  • Flexible benefits allowance

SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Title: Technical Program Manager II
Description:
What we want to accomplish and why we need you

Suki is a leading technology company that provides AI voice solutions for healthcare. Its mission is to reimagine the healthcare technology stack, making it invisible and assistive to lift the administrative burden from clinicians. Its flagship product is Suki Assistant, an AI assistant that uses generative AI to automatically create clinical documentation by ambiently listening to patient-clinician conversations. Suki helps clinicians complete notes 72% faster on average, assists with other tasks including coding and answering questions, and generates incremental revenue for organizations, delivering a 9X ROI in year 1. Suki also offers its proprietary AI and speech platform, Suki Platform, to partners who want to create best-in-class ambient and voice experiences for their solutions. Clinicians that use Suki already spend over 70% less time on administrative tasks, and we’re striving to do even better. Come and join us! 

We are a user-driven company and are committed to making sure every pixel of our product is in service of the doctors. We’re a team of technologists, clinicians, and industry experts working together to push the limits on technology used in medicine. We’re confident enough to move fast and talented enough not to break things.

About the role

We're growing our Engineering Operations function and looking for a Technical Program Manager to embed directly in an engineering pod and make execution predictable, measurable, and fast. You'll own your pod's day-to-day execution, give leadership an accurate picture of where things stand, and help scale the operating model that makes execution repeatable across the engineering organization. A hands-on role for someone who likes both running the machine and improving how it runs.

What you'll do

  • Own execution for your pod: run sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives, partnering closely with Product and Engineering leads.
  • Keep the pod's work tracked and trustworthy, so status rolls up accurately from task to program level.
  • Produce clear, regular status reporting for pod leads and senior leadership, surfacing risks early.
  • Own the metrics that matter: delivery predictability, sprint coverage, spillover, backlog health, and cycle time.
  • Drive spec-driven development — ensure work is well-specified before build, and measure and improve time from signed-off spec to shipped code.
  • Champion process, tooling, and AI-assisted productivity improvements, feeding durable wins back into the broader operating model.

What you'll gain

  • Applied clinical AI fluency — work at the center of an ACI platform spanning ASR, NLP, LLMs, and deep EHR integration, and learn how a real production AI system ships.
  • Systems-level judgment — build a rare, end-to-end mental model of how complex software gets built, from spec to production, across Product, Engineering, ML, and QA.
  • Data and metrics craft — own the instrumentation and dashboards leadership runs on.
  • Process architecture — help design the operating model that scales across the org, not just run an existing playbook.
  • Executive-grade influence — regular exposure to senior leadership and the reps to turn ambiguity into decision-ready narratives.

What we're looking for

  • 3–5 years as a Technical Program Manager driving delivery for software engineering teams.
  • Technical fluency to navigate the work:
    - Reads and reasons about system architecture — services, APIs, and how frontend, backend, and ML components fit together.
    - Understands the full software development lifecycle: specs, code review, CI/CD, testing/QA, release, and monitoring.
    - Grounded enough in ML/AI systems to follow conversations about models, data pipelines, evaluation, and what separates a demo from production.
    - Reads a design doc or PRD, asks sharp questions, and spots gaps, assumptions, and risks.
  • Data and metrics craft: fluent with issue-tracking tools (e.g. Jira), keeps a clean backlog as a single source of truth, and drives improvement with data.
  • Excellent written communication: turns messy execution reality into crisp updates for engineers and executives alike, and builds trust fast with Product, Engineering, and Design.
  • Sound judgment and autonomy: thrives in a fast-moving environment, escalates through the right channels, and knows when to standardize versus adapt.

Tell me more about Suki

  • On a roll: Named by Fast Company as one of the most innovative companies, named Google’s Partner of the Year for AI/ML, named by Forbes as one of the top 50 companies in AI .
  • Great team: Founded, managed, and backed by successful tech veterans from Google and Apple and medical leaders from UCSF and Stanford. We have technologists and doctors working side-by-side to solve complex problems.
  • Great investors: We’re backed by Venrock, First Round Capital, Flare Capital, March Capital, Hedosophia and others. With our $165M raised so far, we have the resources to scale.
  • Huge market: Disrupting a massive, growing $30+ billion market for transcription, dictation, and order-entry solutions. Our vision is to become the voice user interface for healthcare, relieving the administrative burden on doctors instead of adding to it.
  • Great customers: Our solutions are used in health systems and clinics across the country, supporting clinicians across dozens of specialties.  Check out what one of our users says about how Suki has helped his practice.
  • Impact: You’ll make an impact from day one. You’ll join a team working towards a shared purpose with a culture built upon deep empathy for doctors and passion for making their lives better.

Suki is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are dedicated to building a company that fosters inclusion and belonging and reflects the diverse communities we serve across the country. We know we are stronger this way, and we look forward to growing our team with these shared values.

Title: Senior Program Manager
Location: New York, New York, United States
Description:
Who We Are

VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore. 

VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. 

For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on LinkedIn #WeAreVML.

WHO IS HUDSON ROUGE?

 

Hudson Rouge is an integrated luxury boutique marketing and communications agency within WPP that works solely on luxury brands and is the exclusive agency of record for the Lincoln Motor Company business across all channels. We combine brand strategy, media strategy, activation, digital, social, earned media, production, and analytics to provide exquisitely crafted creativity. We are a small group of people, spread across several offices -- New York, Detroit, Shanghai, Toronto, Mexico City -- and we care for each other as much as we care for our clients. We are an agency who prides itself on creating irrational desire for luxury brands, and we look for uniquely talented people who are excited about doing their best work and want to grow with us.

 

The Role: Senior Program Manager- Digital Production

We are seeking an exceptionally skilled, strategic, and experienced Senior Digital Program Manager to join our dynamic delivery team. This is a critical leadership role, responsible for the successful planning, execution, and delivery of complex, multi-channel digital marketing campaigns that are audience-centric and results-driven. You will act as the central orchestrator, guiding cross-functional teams and managing all aspects of digital production, with a particular emphasis on .com development, online advertising, and email marketing initiatives.

The ideal candidate possesses a deep understanding of the digital production lifecycle, a proven track record of managing large-scale projects and budgets, and the ability to navigate complex client relationships. You are a natural problem-solver, a skilled communicator, and a proactive leader who can anticipate challenges and implement effective solutions. You thrive in a fast-paced agency environment, balancing strategic oversight with hands-on project management, ensuring seamless collaboration across creative, strategy, media, technical, and client teams.

What you’ll do:

Project Leadership & Management:

  • Lead and manage complex digital projects from inception to completion, encompassing scope definition, detailed project planning, resource allocation, budget management, and timeline adherence.
  • Drive the successful delivery of multi-channel marketing campaigns, including significant .com content development and implementation in a CMS, robust online advertising programs, and sophisticated email marketing journeys.
  • Develop and manage comprehensive project documentation, including SOWs, functional specifications, project plans, risk assessments, and status reports.

Multi-Channel Expertise & Integration:

  • Possess a strong understanding of the technical, creative, and strategic requirements for each digital channel (.com, online advertising, email marketing).
  • Identify and manage interdependencies between channels, ensuring cohesive campaign execution and integrated audience experiences.
  • Oversee content delivery to various platforms and channels (CMS, ESP, Ad Servers, DMPs,).

.com Production Management:

  • Oversee the production lifecycle for website development, landing pages, and other digital experiences, from discovery and wireframing through design, development, QA, and deployment.
  • Manage ensuring adherence to best practices for web content development and speed optimization, as well as SEO technical requirements.
  • Facilitate QA testing and deployment processes.

Online Advertising Production Management:

  • Manage the production of various online advertising assets (display, rich media, video, social ads), including asset gathering, trafficking, and quality control.
  • Oversee dynamic creative optimization (DCO) implementations and manage ad server integrations.
  • Coordinate with media teams to ensure creative assets meet technical specifications and are delivered on schedule for campaign launches.

Email Marketing Production Management:

  • Lead the development and execution of email marketing campaigns, including template design/development, audience segmentation setup, automation flows, and A/B testing implementation.
  • Coordinate with our partner agency for development and delivery.
  • Ensure compliance with email deliverability best practices and privacy regulations (e.g., CAN-SPAM, GDPR).

Stakeholder Management:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for internal team on project status, risks, and changes, building strong, trusted relationships.
  • Lead internal project kick-offs, stand-ups, and review meetings, ensuring clear communication and alignment across creative, strategy, media, technical, and account teams.
  • Effectively manage and coordinate with client-based teams, partners, and external vendors.

Process & Quality Assurance:

  • Define, implement, and optimize project management methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall) tailored to project needs.
  • Establish and enforce rigorous quality assurance (QA) processes for all digital deliverables.
  • Continuously seek opportunities to improve production workflows, efficiency, and overall project delivery.

Risk Management & Problem Solving:

  • Proactively identify potential project risks, develop mitigation strategies, and escalate issues appropriately.
  • Demonstrate strong problem-solving skills, navigating technical challenges, resource constraints, and scope creep.
  • Maintain a flexible and adaptable approach in a constantly evolving digital landscape.

Financial Acumen:

  • Manage large-scale project budgets, track actuals against estimates, and ensure project profitability.
  • Assist in forecasting and resource planning for future projects.

What you’ll bring:

  • Expert-level knowledge of project management methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, Hybrid approaches).
  • Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, Trello, MS Project, Workfront, SmartSheet).
  • Strong technical acumen – ability to understand and discuss development processes, integration points, and digital technologies.
  • Exceptional client-facing communication skills, including presentation, negotiation, and expectation management.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage and motivate cross-functional teams, partners and external vendors.
  • Proactive risk identification and mitigation, with a solution-oriented mindset.
  • Strong financial management and budgeting skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple projects concurrently under pressure.
  • A strategic thinker with a keen understanding of how digital projects contribute to overall business objectives.

What you’ll need:

Experience:

  • 7+ years of progressive digital project management/production experience within an agency environment, with a significant portion in a global or large-scale agency (WPP agency experience preferred).
  • Proven track record of successfully delivering complex, multi-channel digital marketing campaigns.
  • Deep understanding and hands-on experience with .com content implementation d(CMS platforms like AEM), online advertising campaigns (ad servers, DSPs), and advanced email marketing. 

Education: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Project Management, or related experience. PMP, CSM, or other relevant certifications are a strong plus.

Title: Executive Director, Business Lead-Content Supply Chain
Description:
Who We Are

VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore. 

VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. 

For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on LinkedIn #WeAreVML.

Role Summary

WPP Enterprise Solutions is seeking a senior Business Lead to oversee a large-scale AI-enabled Content Supply Chain transformation program for Ford. This role will be the ultimate accountable business leader for the workstream, responsible for ensuring that the program is strategically connected to Ford’s broader marketing, customer experience, personalization, production, data, technology, and business transformation priorities.

This is not a traditional account management role. It requires a senior client and business leader who can translate enterprise ambition into clear priorities, connect workstreams across a complex WPP and Ford ecosystem, and ensure the program delivers meaningful business value. The ideal candidate understands how content, data, technology, decisioning, workflow, governance, and measurement come together to enable modern personalized marketing at scale.

The Business Lead will own the “what” and “why” of the program: what Ford needs, why it matters, how the work connects to enterprise objectives, how priorities should be shaped, and how WPP should organize around the opportunity. This is a hands-on business leadership role, requiring someone who can both lead the room and do the work — shaping strategy, writing POVs, building executive narratives, getting into workstream details, and turning ambiguity into clear decisions and action. They will partner closely with the Program Delivery Lead, who will own the “how” of activation, delivery operations, governance, and execution.

This role requires executive presence, strong commercial judgment, deep client relationship skills, and the ability to bring clarity to ambiguity. The right candidate will be able to lead senior stakeholder conversations, identify growth opportunities, shape strategic narratives, and keep a complex transformation effort moving with focus, confidence, and momentum.

Core Responsibilities

Business Leadership & Strategic Ownership

  • Own the overall business leadership of the Ford Content Supply Chain transformation workstream across WPP Enterprise Solutions, Ford.
  • Serve as the senior business owner responsible for connecting the program to Ford’s broader enterprise priorities, including content personalization, marketing efficiency, customer experience, data enablement, production transformation, AI adoption, and measurable business growth.
  • Translate complex transformation needs into clear business priorities, strategic narratives, workstream objectives, and executive-ready recommendations.
  • Ensure the full program ladder ups to Ford’s ambition to deliver the right content, in the right format, to the right customer, in the right channel, at the right moment.
  • Maintain a clear view of how content production, asset lifecycle management, taxonomy, metadata, DAM modernization, data connectivity, decisioning, workflow governance, and measurement work together as one connected transformation.
  • Help WPP and Ford prioritize the right opportunities, avoiding fragmented activity and ensuring the work remains focused on scalable, enterprise-level outcomes.
  • Act as a senior strategic advisor to Ford and WPP leadership, helping stakeholders understand what matters, what is urgent, what is dependent, and where investment or decision-making is required.

Client Partnership & Stakeholder Leadership

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior Ford stakeholders across marketing, customer digital and loyalty, IT, product, CRM, web, production, media, measurement, legal, governance, and related business units.
  • Serve as a primary client-facing business lead for the CSC transformation workstream, ensuring Ford stakeholders have confidence in the direction, clarity of priorities, and value of WPP’s role.
  • Lead senior-level conversations that require business framing, strategic judgment, prioritization, escalation, and alignment.
  • Understand Ford’s business environment, internal dynamics, stakeholder needs, organizational constraints, and transformation ambitions.
  • Connect dots across Ford teams that may be working on related but disconnected efforts, helping surface overlap, dependencies, opportunities, and risks.
  • Ensure the WPP team is positioned as an integrated enterprise partner, not a collection of disconnected agency or platform workstreams.
  • Bring calm, clarity, and confidence to complex client conversations, especially when scope, ownership, feasibility, budget, or priorities are unclear.

Commercial Ownership & Growth

  • Own the commercial strategy for the CSC transformation workstream, including growth planning, scope development, revenue opportunities, and business case framing.
  • Identify opportunities to expand WPP’s role across strategy, operating model design, production transformation, content automation, data enablement, workflow, measurement, governance, and technology integration.
  • Shape new scopes of work, commercial proposals, pilot packages, transformation roadmaps, and executive business cases in partnership with delivery, strategy, technology, production, finance, and WPP capability leads.
  • Ensure work is commercially viable, properly scoped, and connected to measurable value.
  • Partner with WPP leadership to forecast growth, identify resourcing needs, and package the program in a way that can scale across Ford teams, regions, brands, and business units.
  • Translate technical or operational opportunities into business language that Ford executives can understand, support, and fund.
  • Identify where pilots should become platforms, where one-off efforts should become repeatable operating models, and where WPP can create durable enterprise value.

Cross-WPP Integration

  • Bring together the right WPP capabilities across Enterprise Solutions, WPP Production, WPP Open, WPP Media, partner ecosystems.
  • Operate as a connector across WPP teams, ensuring capabilities are organized around Ford’s business need rather than internal structures.
  • Help define how WPP shows up as one integrated team across strategy, production, delivery, data, experience, technology, measurement, and governance.
  • Partner with the Program Delivery Lead to ensure WPP resources are aligned to the right priorities, decision rights are clear, and workstreams are coordinated.
  • Ensure the team is using consistent language, frameworks, program narratives, and executive materials across the transformation.
  • Identify where WPP should bring forward new capabilities, partnerships, tools, agents, AI workflows, or operating models to strengthen the program.

Program Narrative, Executive Communication & Decision Support

  • Own the strategic narrative of the Content Supply Chain transformation program.
  • Develop clear, executive-ready materials that explain the business problem, transformation opportunity, current-state challenges, future-state model, priority workstreams, dependencies, value case, and roadmap.
  • Prepare senior stakeholders for key decision moments by framing options, tradeoffs, risks, recommendations, and required actions.
  • Ensure leadership communications are concise, connected, and grounded in business impact.
  • Help Ford and WPP leadership understand how individual workstreams connect into a larger transformation architecture.
  • Create alignment around why foundational work — taxonomy, metadata, DAM, asset planning, data connectivity, workflow, decisioning, and measurement — is required to unlock AI-enabled personalization at scale.
  • Continuously translate complexity into a simple, actionable story that builds confidence and momentum.

Transformation Leadership

  • Help move the organization from disconnected projects to a coordinated transformation program.
  • Identify where current processes, platforms, operating models, or ownership structures are limiting scale.
  • Shape recommendations for new ways of working across content planning, production, asset management, content assembly, activation, performance feedback, and optimization.
  • Help establish the business case for investment in content supply chain modernization, including speed, efficiency, personalization, quality, consistency, governance, and measurable performance.
  • Partner with delivery and workstream leads to ensure transformation recommendations are actionable, not theoretical.
  • Champion a practical, progressive approach: prove value through prioritized use cases, then scale through governance, operating model, technology, and adoption.

Measurement & Business Value

  • Ensure the program is anchored in measurable business outcomes.
  • Define and socialize the value story across efficiency, speed to market, asset reuse, content quality, governance, personalization readiness, customer engagement, conversion, and long-term business impact.
  • Partner with analytics and delivery teams to ensure performance measurement is embedded into the program from the beginning.
  • Push the team to connect operational progress to business results, not just activity completion.
  • Help shape dashboards, executive readouts, and value-tracking frameworks that show how the transformation is progressing.
  • Ensure Ford sees a clear connection between investment, operational change, and measurable business return.

Requirements

  • Senior client leadership experience across complex marketing, digital, technology, production, transformation, or enterprise consulting environments.
  • Experience leading large, matrixed client relationships with multiple stakeholders, agencies, partners, platforms, and business units.
  • Strong understanding of modern marketing operations, content supply chains, personalization, customer experience, CRM, web, production, data, measurement, and marketing technology.
  • Business-level fluency in major enterprise marketing technology and content platforms, including Adobe, Salesforce, DAM systems, workflow tools, analytics platforms, AI-enabled production tools, and decisioning environments.
  • Ability to understand technical and operational topics well enough to guide business decisions, frame tradeoffs, and lead executive conversations.
  • Strong commercial acumen, including experience shaping scopes of work, identifying growth opportunities, developing business cases, and supporting revenue expansion.
  • Excellent executive communication skills, including ability to simplify complex ecosystems into clear narratives, recommendations, and decision frameworks.
  • Proven ability to lead through ambiguity, establish structure, and create momentum in complex transformation environments.
  • Experience working across agency, consulting, technology, or client-side organizations preferred.
  • Automotive experience is highly valuable but not required.

Competencies

  • Strategic connector who can see the full ecosystem and understand how individual workstreams ladder up to enterprise transformation.
  • Executive-level communicator who can build trust, simplify complexity, and drive alignment.
  • Commercially sharp business leader who can identify opportunity, shape value, and grow the relationship responsibly.
  • Collaborative operator who knows how to bring multiple disciplines, agencies, partners, and stakeholders together around a shared agenda.
  • Transformation-minded leader who can balance vision with pragmatic execution.
  • Client-first partner who understands how to anticipate needs, manage sensitivities, and create confidence.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity, complexity, and evolving priorities.
  • Fluent in both business and technology conversations, without needing to be the technical architect.
  • Able to challenge constructively, escalate appropriately, and keep teams focused on outcomes.
  • Calm, resilient, and decisive under pressure.

Title: Sr. Program Manager, Content Partnerships
Description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

 

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

 

 

What does the team work on?

Roku's continued success relies on investing in the success of our content partners and the platform we provide to them. The Partner Initiatives team is responsible for partner adoption and support of new Roku initiatives and features. We work with content partners and cross functionally with Roku's product and engineering teams to drive partner integration success and scalability for broad adoption.

What is the role?

As a Senior Program Manager, Content Partnerships, you will lead the successful participation of content providers in Roku's partner-facing engineering development programs, spanning new platform features and hardware product introductions. You will combine strong relationship management, technical understanding, and program management expertise to drive partner participation and program success from concept through delivery. This role requires the ability to build trust with external partners while collaborating cross-functionally with product and engineering teams to align priorities and achieve shared goals. You will develop go-to-market partner strategies, represent partner perspectives within internal program teams, and ensure that engagement deliverables support a positive partner experience throughout the development lifecycle. The ideal candidate brings a track record of managing complex, multi-stakeholder programs in a technology or media environment and thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative setting. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on the growth and scale of Roku's partner ecosystem.

For California Only - The estimated annual salary for this position is between 164,900 − 219,400 annually.

Compensation packages are based on factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, certifications, and specific geographical location.

This role is eligible for health insurance, equity awards, life insurance, disability benefits, parental leave, wellness benefits, and paid time off.

How will I use AI at Roku?

At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability.

We value curious, adaptable builders, who can show how they've used AI, agents, or automation to move faster, improve quality, and scale their impact. Strong candidates know how to frame problems, guide AI-assisted work, check the output, and learn quickly. Above all, they bring curiosity, adaptability, and sound judgment.

What are the responsibilities of the role?

  • Drive content partner adoption of Roku's programs by managing all program, relationship, and operational aspects to on-time completion
  • Develop and execute go-to-market partner strategies and coordinate cross-functional teams to deliver against those plans
  • Represent partner perspectives and needs within internal product program teams, maintaining current insight on partner status and related program details
  • Ensure essential partner engagement deliverables are in place to support program success and a positive partner experience throughout development
  • Maintain partner focus and engagement by proactively communicating new information and ensuring Roku's programs remain a priority for target partners
  • Host regular status reviews to track progress against plan and produce concise, timely status reports for all levels of the organization, escalating issues as needed
  • Manage change, risk, and critical decision-making throughout the project lifecycle by assessing impacts, providing options and recommended action plans, and driving issues to timely resolution

What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?

  • 7+ years of technical program management experience in a technology, engineering, or media company, with a proven track record of developing and executing technical project plans and motivating cross-functional teams to meet goals
  • 5+ years of partner relationship management experience, with demonstrated ability to lead high-stakes partner projects and build effective, collaborative relationships
  • Proficiency in program management concepts, methodologies, and processes, with strong planning, prioritization, and organizational skills
  • Hands-on experience applying AI tools and agentic AI systems to modernize and automate project management workflows, documentation, and data analysis
  • Familiarity with streaming and entertainment technologies, including content delivery platforms, video streaming, digital advertising technologies, consumer electronics products, and TV standards
  • Strong verbal, written, and presentation communication skills, with the ability to lead productive discussions across varying levels of the organization and translate between high-level strategy and detailed technical topics
  • A detail-oriented and organized approach to program management, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
